        ∃ (Cᵢ : ℕ → Submodule R C) (gradedC : GradedAlgebra Cᵢ),
          letI : GradedAlgebra Cᵢ := gradedC
          ∃ (strictC : IsStrictlyGradedComm Cᵢ),
            letI : IsStrictlyGradedComm Cᵢ := strictC
            ∃ (δ : DividedPowerStructure Cᵢ) (ι : A →ₐ[R] C) (T : J → C),
              Function.Injective ι ∧
              (∀ (m : ℕ) (a : A), a ∈ Aᵢ m → ι a ∈ Cᵢ m) ∧
              (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A), a ∈ positiveEvenPart Aᵢ →
                δ.dpow n (ι a) = ι (γ.dpow n a)) ∧
              (∀ j : J, T j ∈ Cᵢ (deg j)) ∧
              (∀ x : C, ∃ S : Finset J,
                x ∈ finiteVariableStage δ ι T S) ∧
              (∀ (S : Finset J) (j : J), j ∉ S →
                letI : DecidableEq J := Classical.decEq J
                ∃ (aS : Algebra R (finiteVariableStage δ ι T S)),
                  letI : Algebra R (finiteVariableStage δ ι T S) := aS
                  (∀ r : R, ((algebraMap R (finiteVariableStage δ ι T S) r :
                    finiteVariableStage δ ι T S) : C) = algebraMap R C r) ∧
                  ∃ (Sᵢ : ℕ → Submodule R (finiteVariableStage δ ι T S))
                    (gS : GradedAlgebra Sᵢ),
                    letI : GradedAlgebra Sᵢ := gS
                    ∃ (cS : IsStrictlyGradedComm Sᵢ),
                      letI : IsStrictlyGradedComm Sᵢ := cS
                      ∃ δS : DividedPowerStructure Sᵢ,
                      (∀ (n : ℕ) (b : finiteVariableStage δ ι T S),
                        b ∈ positiveEvenPart Sᵢ →
                          (δS.dpow n b : C) = δ.dpow n (b : C)) ∧
                      (∀ hodd : Odd (deg j),
                        ∃ e : OddVariableExtension Sᵢ (deg j) ≃+*
                            finiteVariableStage δ ι T (insert j S),
                          (∀ b : finiteVariableStage δ ι T S,
                            ((e (OddVariableExtension.inclusion
                              Sᵢ (deg j) b) : finiteVariableStage δ ι T (insert j S)) : C) = b) ∧
                          ((e (OddVariableExtension.generator
                            Sᵢ (deg j)) : finiteVariableStage δ ι T (insert j S)) : C) = T j ∧
                          (∀ (m : ℕ)
                            (x : OddVariableExtension Sᵢ (deg j)),
                            x ∈
                                OddVariableExtension.grade
                                  Sᵢ (deg j) m ↔
                              (e x : C) ∈ Cᵢ m) ∧
                          (∀ (n : ℕ)
                            (x : OddVariableExtension Sᵢ (deg j)),
                            x ∈ positiveEvenPart
                              (OddVariableExtension.grade Sᵢ (deg j)) →
                            δ.dpow n (e x : C) =
                              (e ((oddVariableDividedPowerStructure
                                Sᵢ δS (deg j) (hdeg j) hodd).dpow n x) : C))) ∧
                      (∀ heven : Even (deg j),
                        letI : Fact (Even (deg j)) := ⟨heven⟩
                        ∃ e : EvenVariableAlgebra
                            (finiteVariableStage δ ι T S) ≃+*
                            finiteVariableStage δ ι T (insert j S),
                          (∀ b : finiteVariableStage δ ι T S,
                            ((e (EvenVariableAlgebra.coeffEmbedding
                              b) :
                              finiteVariableStage δ ι T (insert j S)) : C) = b) ∧
                          ((e (EvenVariableAlgebra.monomial
                            1 1) : finiteVariableStage δ ι T (insert j S)) : C) = T j ∧
                          (∀ (m : ℕ)
                            (x : EvenVariableAlgebra
                              (finiteVariableStage δ ι T S)),
                            x ∈
                                EvenVariableAlgebra.grade
                                  Sᵢ (deg j) m ↔
                              (e x : C) ∈ Cᵢ m) ∧
                          (∀ (n : ℕ)
                            (x : EvenVariableAlgebra
                              (finiteVariableStage δ ι T S)),
                            x ∈ positiveEvenPart
                              (EvenVariableAlgebra.grade Sᵢ (deg j)) →
                            δ.dpow n (e x : C) =
                              (e ((evenVariableDividedPowerStructure (deg j) (hdeg j)
                                δS).dpow n x) : C)))) ∧
              (∀ {D : Type z} [Ring D] [Algebra R D]
                  (Dᵢ : ℕ → Submodule R D) [GradedAlgebra Dᵢ]
                  [IsStrictlyGradedComm Dᵢ] (ε : DividedPowerStructure Dᵢ)
                  (f : A →ₐ[R] D) (t : J → D),
                  (∀ (m : ℕ) (a : A), a ∈ Aᵢ m → f a ∈ Dᵢ m) →
                  (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A), a ∈ positiveEvenPart Aᵢ →
                    ε.dpow n (f a) = f (γ.dpow n a)) →
                  (∀ j : J, t j ∈ Dᵢ (deg j)) →
                  ∃! g : C →ₐ[R] D,
                    (∀ a : A, g (ι a) = f a) ∧
                    (∀ j : J, g (T j) = t j) ∧
                    (∀ (m : ℕ) (x : C), x ∈ Cᵢ m → g x ∈ Dᵢ m) ∧
                    (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : C), x ∈ positiveEvenPart Cᵢ →
                      ε.dpow n (g x) = g (δ.dpow n x)))
declarations.comment: set-indexed construction

declarations.name: DividedPowers.TateResolution.finiteVariableStage_insert
declarations.doc:
A successor finite stage is obtained by adjoining its new variable and all of its
divided powers to the preceding stage. For an odd-degree variable its positive divided
powers vanish, recovering the exterior successor; in even degree this is the divided-power
successor. Iterating this equation over an enumeration of a finite set gives the finite
stages used in the directed colimit.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finiteVariableStage_insert
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {C : Type z} {J : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Ring C] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R C]
    (Cᵢ : ℕ → Submodule R C) [GradedAlgebra Cᵢ]
    [IsStrictlyGradedComm Cᵢ] (δ : DividedPowerStructure Cᵢ)
    (ι : A →ₐ[R] C) (T : J → C) (S U : Finset J) (j : J)
    (hSU : S ⊆ U) (hj : j ∈ U)
    (hU : ∀ k : J, k ∈ U → (k ∈ S ∨ k = j)) :
    finiteVariableStage δ ι T U =
      Subring.closure
        ((finiteVariableStage δ ι T S : Set C) ∪
          {x : C | x = T j ∨ ∃ n : ℕ, x = δ.dpow n (T j)})
declarations.comment: finite iterated one-variable extensions

declarations.name: DividedPowers.TateResolution.finiteVariableStage_empty
declarations.doc: The initial finite stage is generated by the coefficient algebra.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finiteVariableStage_empty
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {C : Type z} {J : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Ring C] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R C]
    (Cᵢ : ℕ → Submodule R C) [GradedAlgebra Cᵢ]
    [IsStrictlyGradedComm Cᵢ] (δ : DividedPowerStructure Cᵢ)
    (ι : A →ₐ[R] C) (T : J → C) :
    finiteVariableStage δ ι T ∅ = Subring.closure (Set.range ι)
declarations.comment: initial finite stage

declarations.name: DividedPowers.TateResolution.finiteVariableStages_directedColimit
declarations.doc:
If the finite-variable stages cover the algebra, they present it as their directed colimit:
a family of ring homomorphisms out of the stages which agree wherever their arguments agree in
the ambient algebra extends uniquely to a ring homomorphism out of the whole algebra.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finiteVariableStages_directedColimit
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {C : Type z} {D : Type w} {J : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Ring C] [Ring D] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R C]
    (Cᵢ : ℕ → Submodule R C) [GradedAlgebra Cᵢ]
    [IsStrictlyGradedComm Cᵢ] (δ : DividedPowerStructure Cᵢ)
    (ι : A →ₐ[R] C) (T : J → C)
    (hfinite : ∀ x : C, ∃ S : Finset J,
      x ∈ finiteVariableStage δ ι T S)
    (f : (S : Finset J) → finiteVariableStage δ ι T S →+* D)
    (hcompat : ∀ (S U : Finset J)
      (x : finiteVariableStage δ ι T S)
      (y : finiteVariableStage δ ι T U),
      (x : C) = (y : C) → f S x = f U y) :
    ∃! g : C →+* D,
      ∀ (S : Finset J) (x : finiteVariableStage δ ι T S),
        g (x : C) = f S x
declarations.comment: directed colimit of finite stages

declarations.name: DividedPowers.TateResolution.existsUnique_dividedPowerStructure_of_finiteStages
declarations.doc:
Let a directed system of strictly graded-commutative graded algebras with divided powers,
indexed by a nonempty directed preorder, map compatibly to a strictly graded-commutative graded
algebra `C` in such a way that homogeneous elements of `C` lift to some stage and two stage
elements with the same image in `C` already agree at a later stage. Then `C` carries exactly one
divided power structure for which every stage map preserves divided powers.

The index order is an arbitrary nonempty directed one; the finite subsets of a set ordered by
inclusion, which is the indexing of the set-variable construction of Tag 0F4I, are the special
case `I = Finset J`, and an `ℕ`-indexed tower is the case `I = ℕ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_dividedPowerStructure_of_finiteStages
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {I : Type w} [LE I] [IsDirectedOrder I] [Nonempty I]
    (B : I → Type v)
    [stageRing : ∀ S, Ring (B S)]
    [stageAlgebra : ∀ S, Algebra R (B S)]
    (Bᵢ : (S : I) → ℕ → Submodule R (B S))
    [stageGraded : ∀ S, GradedAlgebra (Bᵢ S)]
    [stageComm : ∀ S, IsStrictlyGradedComm (Bᵢ S)]
    (γ : (S : I) → DividedPowerStructure (Bᵢ S))
    {C : Type z} [Ring C] [Algebra R C]
    (Cᵢ : ℕ → Submodule R C) [GradedAlgebra Cᵢ] [IsStrictlyGradedComm Cᵢ]
    (transition : ∀ {S T : I}, S ≤ T → B S →ₐ[R] B T)
    (ι : (S : I) → B S →ₐ[R] C)
    (hι : ∀ {S T : I} (h : S ≤ T) (x : B S),
      ι T (transition h x) = ι S x)
    (hgrade : ∀ (S : I) (m : ℕ) (x : B S),
      x ∈ Bᵢ S m → ι S x ∈ Cᵢ m)
    (hgrade_lift : ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : C), x ∈ Cᵢ m →
      ∃ (S : I) (y : B S), y ∈ Bᵢ S m ∧ ι S y = x)
    (heq : ∀ (S T : I) (x : B S) (y : B T),
      ι S x = ι T y →
      ∃ U : I, ∃ (hS : S ≤ U) (hT : T ≤ U),
        transition hS x = transition hT y)
    (htransition_grade : ∀ {S T : I} (h : S ≤ T)
      (m : ℕ) (x : B S), x ∈ Bᵢ S m → transition h x ∈ Bᵢ T m)
    (htransition_dpow : ∀ {S T : I} (h : S ≤ T)
      (n : ℕ) (x : B S), x ∈ positiveEvenPart (Bᵢ S) →
        transition h ((γ S).dpow n x) = (γ T).dpow n (transition h x)) :
    ∃! δ : DividedPowerStructure Cᵢ,
      ∀ (S : I) (n : ℕ) (x : B S),
        x ∈ positiveEvenPart (Bᵢ S) →
          δ.dpow n (ι S x) = ι S ((γ S).dpow n x)
declarations.comment: finite-stage extension

declarations.name: DividedPowers.TateResolution.finiteVariableStage_dpow_mem
declarations.doc:
Divided powers of elements supported on a finite set of homogeneous variables over a
graded coefficient algebra are still supported on that set. The variables need not all have the
same degree: each `T j` is homogeneous of its own degree `deg j`. The coefficient map preserves
grading, as do the inclusions in the extensions of Tags 09PH and 09PI. Thus every
finite-variable stage is a divided-power subalgebra.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finiteVariableStage_dpow_mem
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {C : Type z} {J : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Ring C] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R C]
    (Aᵢ : ℕ → Submodule R A) [GradedAlgebra Aᵢ]
    (Cᵢ : ℕ → Submodule R C) [GradedAlgebra Cᵢ]
    [IsStrictlyGradedComm Cᵢ] (δ : DividedPowerStructure Cᵢ)
    (ι : A →ₐ[R] C) (T : J → C) (S : Finset J) (deg : J → ℕ)
    (hgrade : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : A), a ∈ Aᵢ m → ι a ∈ Cᵢ m)
    (hT : ∀ j : J, T j ∈ Cᵢ (deg j))
    (hcoeff : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A), ι a ∈ positiveEvenPart Cᵢ →
      δ.dpow n (ι a) ∈ Set.range ι)
    (n : ℕ) (x : C)
    (hx : x ∈ finiteVariableStage δ ι T S)
    (hpositive : x ∈ positiveEvenPart Cᵢ) :
    δ.dpow n x ∈ finiteVariableStage δ ι T S
declarations.comment: finite stages preserve divided powers

declarations.name: DividedPowers.TateResolution.dividedPowerStructure_unique_of_generators
declarations.doc:
On a set-indexed extension, divided powers are forced by their restriction to the
coefficient algebra and by their values on the adjoined generators.
declarations.statement:
public theorem dividedPowerStructure_unique_of_generators
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {C : Type z} {J : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Ring C] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R C]
    (Aᵢ : ℕ → Submodule R A) [GradedAlgebra Aᵢ]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (Cᵢ : ℕ → Submodule R C) [GradedAlgebra Cᵢ]
    [IsStrictlyGradedComm Cᵢ]
    (δ ε : DividedPowerStructure Cᵢ) (ι : A →ₐ[R] C) (T : J → C)
    (hgrade : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : A), a ∈ Aᵢ m → ι a ∈ Cᵢ m)
    (hT : ∀ j : J, T j ∈ Cᵢ d)
    (hfinite : ∀ x : C, ∃ S : Finset J, x ∈ finiteVariableStage δ ι T S)
    (hcoeff : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A), ι a ∈ positiveEvenPart Cᵢ →
      ε.dpow n (ι a) = δ.dpow n (ι a))
    (hgenerator : ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : J), T j ∈ positiveEvenPart Cᵢ →
      ε.dpow n (T j) = δ.dpow n (T j)) :
    ε = δ
declarations.comment: uniqueness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isProperOver_of_fpqc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4J.** Properness over a base of a closed subset descends along an fpqc covering
of the base.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isProperOver_of_fpqc {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (Z : Closeds X)
    (h : ∃ (ι : Type v) (Y' : ι → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, Y' i ⟶ Y),
      Presieve.ofArrows Y' g ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage Y ∧
        ∀ i, IsProperOver (pullback.snd f (g i))
          (Z.preimage (pullback.fst f (g i)).continuous)) :
    IsProperOver f Z

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isIso_sigmaDesc_extensionByZeroSummandInclusion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F4K.** The sections of the presheaf `j_{p!} F` over a scheme `V` étale
over `X` are the direct sum, over the morphisms `φ : V ⟶ U` over `X`, of the sections of `F` over
`V` regarded as étale over `U` through `φ`; the comparison map is the one induced on each summand
by the Kan extension unit.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_sigmaDesc_extensionByZeroSummandInclusion (F : (U.Etale)ᵒᵖ ⥤ A) (V : X.Etale) :
    IsIso (Sigma.desc
      (f := fun φ : V ⟶ smallEtaleSource j => F.obj (op (sourceDescend j φ)))
      (P := (extensionByZeroPresheaf j F).obj (op V))
      (fun φ => extensionByZeroSummandInclusion j F φ))
declarations.comment: the presheaf formula (j_{p!} F)(V) = ⨁_{φ : V → U} F(V →^φ U)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.extensionByZeroPresheafSectionIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F4K.** The direct-sum formula for the sections of the presheaf
`j_{p!} F` over a scheme `V` étale over `X`, as an isomorphism.
declarations.comment: the presheaf formula (j_{p!} F)(V) = ⨁_{φ : V → U} F(V →^φ U)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.extensionByZero_obj_eq_sheafify
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F4K.** Extension by zero of an abelian sheaf is the sheafification of
the presheaf `j_{p!} F` whose sections are given by the direct-sum formula.
declarations.statement:
theorem extensionByZero_obj_eq_sheafify
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}]
    (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    (extensionByZero.{u, v} j).obj F =
      (presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}).obj
        (extensionByZeroPresheaf j F.obj)
declarations.comment: j_! F is the sheafification of j_{p!} F

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.ExtensionByZero.isIso_lanSigmaDesc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4K.** The left Kan extension along `(Over.forget U).op` is, over `V`, the
coproduct of the values of `F` at the objects `φ : V ⟶ U` of `C/U`, the comparison map being
the one induced by the Kan extension unit on each summand. Applied to the small étale site of
a scheme and an étale `U ⟶ X`, this is the presheaf extension by zero along `U ⟶ X`: its
sections over `V` are the direct sum of the sections of `F` over the lifts `V ⟶ U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_lanSigmaDesc
    {C : Type u} [Category.{u} C] (U : C)
    [∀ F : (Over U)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}, (Over.forget U).op.HasLeftKanExtension F]
    (F : (Over U)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (V : C) :
    IsIso (Sigma.desc
      (f := fun φ : V ⟶ U => F.obj (op (Over.mk φ)))
      (P := (((Over.forget U).op.lan.obj F).obj (op V)))
      (fun φ => (((Over.forget U).op.lanUnit.app F).app (op (Over.mk φ)))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward
declarations.doc:
The canonical map from extension by zero to the direct image of abelian sheaves along the étale
morphism `U ⟶ X`. On the summand of the presheaf extension indexed by `φ : V ⟶ U` it extends a
section by zero along the open and closed graph of `φ`; that requires `U ⟶ X` to be separated, and
off the separated locus the map is zero.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward :
    let := smallEtaleBaseChange_isContinuous B U.obj.hom
    abelianExtensionByZero B X hX U ⟶
      (smallEtaleBaseChange B U.obj.hom).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (SmallEtale.topology B X hX)
        (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
declarations.comment: abelian natural map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward_mono
declarations.doc:
For a separated étale morphism, every component of the canonical map from extension by zero to
the direct image of abelian sheaves is a monomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward_mono
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    Mono ((abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward B X hX U).app F)
declarations.comment: abelian injectivity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward_graph
declarations.doc:
On the summand indexed by `W ⟶ U`, the canonical map restricts along the graph `W ⟶ W ×_X U` to
the original section.
declarations.statement:
public theorem abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward_graph
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (W : SmallEtale B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
    (s : F.obj.obj (Opposite.op W)) :
    let V := (smallEtalePostcompose B X hX U).obj W
    (F.obj.map (smallEtaleGraph B X hX U W).op)
      (((abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward B X hX U).app F).hom.app
        (Opposite.op V)
        (((abelianExtensionByZeroAdjunction
          B X hX U).unit.app F).hom.app (Opposite.op W) s)) = s
declarations.comment: abelian graph restriction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward_graph_compl
declarations.doc:
The image of the summand indexed by `W ⟶ U` restricts to zero along every morphism into
`W ×_X U` whose image avoids the graph of `W`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward_graph_compl
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (W T : SmallEtale B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
    (g : T ⟶ (smallEtaleBaseChange B U.obj.hom).obj
      ((smallEtalePostcompose B X hX U).obj W))
    (hg : disjointFromSmallEtaleGraph B X hX U W T g)
    (s : F.obj.obj (Opposite.op W)) :
    let V := (smallEtalePostcompose B X hX U).obj W
    (F.obj.map g.op)
      (((abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward B X hX U).app F).hom.app
        (Opposite.op V)
        (((abelianExtensionByZeroAdjunction
          B X hX U).unit.app F).hom.app (Opposite.op W) s)) = 0
declarations.comment: abelian complementary vanishing

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward
declarations.doc:
The canonical map from extension by zero to the direct image of sheaves of `Λ`-modules along
the étale morphism `U ⟶ X`, constructed exactly as in the abelian case.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward
    (Λ : Type v) [Ring Λ] :
    let := smallEtaleBaseChange_isContinuous B U.obj.hom
    moduleExtensionByZero B X hX U Λ ⟶
      (smallEtaleBaseChange B U.obj.hom).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} Λ)
        (SmallEtale.topology B X hX)
        (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
declarations.comment: module natural map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward_mono
declarations.doc:
For a separated étale morphism, every component of the canonical map from extension by zero to
the direct image of sheaves of `Λ`-modules is a monomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward_mono
    (Λ : Type v) [Ring Λ]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} Λ)) :
    Mono ((moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward B X hX U Λ).app F)
declarations.comment: module injectivity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward_graph
declarations.doc:
On the summand indexed by `W ⟶ U`, the canonical map for sheaves of modules restricts along the
graph `W ⟶ W ×_X U` to the original section.
declarations.statement:
public theorem moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward_graph
    (Λ : Type v) [Ring Λ]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} Λ))
    (W : SmallEtale B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
    (s : F.obj.obj (Opposite.op W)) :
    let V := (smallEtalePostcompose B X hX U).obj W
    (F.obj.map (smallEtaleGraph B X hX U W).op)
      (((moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward B X hX U Λ).app F).hom.app
        (Opposite.op V)
      (((moduleExtensionByZeroAdjunction
          B X hX U Λ).unit.app F).hom.app (Opposite.op W) s)) = s
declarations.comment: module graph restriction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward_graph_compl
declarations.doc:
The image of the summand indexed by `W ⟶ U` restricts to zero along every morphism into
`W ×_X U` whose image avoids the graph of `W`, for sheaves of modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward_graph_compl
    (Λ : Type v) [Ring Λ]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} Λ))
    (W T : SmallEtale B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
    (g : T ⟶ (smallEtaleBaseChange B U.obj.hom).obj
      ((smallEtalePostcompose B X hX U).obj W))
    (hg : disjointFromSmallEtaleGraph B X hX U W T g)
    (s : F.obj.obj (Opposite.op W)) :
    let V := (smallEtalePostcompose B X hX U).obj W
    (F.obj.map g.op)
      (((moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward B X hX U Λ).app F).hom.app
        (Opposite.op V)
      (((moduleExtensionByZeroAdjunction
          B X hX U Λ).unit.app F).hom.app (Opposite.op W) s)) = 0
declarations.comment: module complementary vanishing

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering
declarations.doc:
Every object `U` of a chosen big pro-étale site admits a one-element chosen covering
`{V → U}` whose source is a weakly contractible object of the site.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering (U : B.Scheme) :
    ∃ (V : B.Scheme) (p : V ⟶ U),
      B.covering ⟨U, PreZeroHypercover.singleton p⟩ ∧
        B.topology.IsWeaklyContractible V

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_affine_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering
declarations.doc:
If the underlying scheme of an object `U` of a chosen big pro-étale site is quasi-compact,
the one-element covering of
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering` can be chosen with
affine source.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_affine_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering (U : B.Scheme)
    [CompactSpace U.obj] :
    ∃ (V : B.Scheme) (p : V ⟶ U),
      B.covering ⟨U, PreZeroHypercover.singleton p⟩ ∧
        IsAffine V.obj ∧ B.topology.IsWeaklyContractible V
declarations.comment: the quasi-compact case

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4P for the big pro-étale site over a scheme.** Every object `U` of the big
pro-étale site over `S` in a chosen big pro-étale site admits a one-element covering `{V → U}`
whose source is a weakly contractible object of that site.

The covering is the one of
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering` for the underlying
object of the chosen big site, viewed over `S` through the composite to `U`; its source stays
weakly contractible in the slice by
`Stacks.WeaklyContractible.weaklyContractible_over`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering_over (U : BigProetaleOver B S hS) :
    ∃ (V : BigProetaleOver B S hS) (p : V ⟶ U),
      BigProetaleOver.IsCovering B S hS ⟨U, PreZeroHypercover.singleton p⟩ ∧
        (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS).IsWeaklyContractible V
declarations.comment: the big site over a scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_affine_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4P for the big pro-étale site over a scheme, the quasi-compact case.** If the
underlying scheme of an object `U` of the big pro-étale site over `S` is quasi-compact, the
one-element covering of
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering_over` can be chosen
with affine source.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_affine_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering_over
    (U : BigProetaleOver B S hS) [CompactSpace ((BigProetaleOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U)] :
    ∃ (V : BigProetaleOver B S hS) (p : V ⟶ U),
      BigProetaleOver.IsCovering B S hS ⟨U, PreZeroHypercover.singleton p⟩ ∧
        IsAffine ((BigProetaleOver.toScheme B S hS).obj V) ∧
        (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS).IsWeaklyContractible V
declarations.comment: the big site over a scheme, quasi-compact case

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering_small
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4P for the small pro-étale site.** Every object `U` of the small pro-étale site
of `S` in a chosen big pro-étale site admits a one-element covering `{V → U}` whose source is a
weakly contractible object of that site.

The covering is the one of
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_weaklyContractible_coproduct_singleton_covering` for the
underlying object of the chosen big site: its covering morphism is weakly étale, so its source
is again weakly étale over `S`, and the source is a disjoint union of affine objects with
w-contractible rings of global sections, hence weakly contractible in the small site by
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isWeaklyContractible_small_of_coproduct`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering_small (U : SmallProetale B S hS) :
    ∃ (V : SmallProetale B S hS) (p : V ⟶ U),
      SmallProetale.IsCovering B S hS ⟨U, PreZeroHypercover.singleton p⟩ ∧
        (SmallProetale.topology B S hS).IsWeaklyContractible V
declarations.comment: the small site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_affine_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering_small
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4P for the small pro-étale site, the quasi-compact case.** If the underlying
scheme of an object `U` of the small pro-étale site of `S` is quasi-compact, the one-element
covering of
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering_small` can be chosen
with affine source.

An affine weakly contractible object of the chosen big site has w-contractible ring of global
sections by Stacks 098H, which is weak contractibility in the small site by Stacks 0990.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_affine_weaklyContractible_singleton_covering_small
    (U : SmallProetale B S hS) [CompactSpace ((SmallProetale.toScheme B S hS).obj U)] :
    ∃ (V : SmallProetale B S hS) (p : V ⟶ U),
      SmallProetale.IsCovering B S hS ⟨U, PreZeroHypercover.singleton p⟩ ∧
        IsAffine ((SmallProetale.toScheme B S hS).obj V) ∧
        (SmallProetale.topology B S hS).IsWeaklyContractible V
declarations.comment: the small site, quasi-compact case

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isCompactlyGenerated_derivedCategory_bigProetaleOver
declarations.doc:
For a sheaf of rings `𝒜` on the big pro-étale site of a scheme `S`, the unbounded derived
category of sheaves of `𝒜`-modules is compactly generated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCompactlyGenerated_derivedCategory_bigProetaleOver
    (𝒜 : Sheaf (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS) RingCat.{u + 1}) :
    Pretriangulated.IsCompactlyGenerated.{u + 1}
      (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u + 1} 𝒜))
declarations.comment: clause (6): the derived category of sheaves of modules over a sheaf of rings on the big pro-étale site (Sch/S)_proétale of a scheme S in a chosen big pro-étale site

declarations.doc:

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.BigProetaleSite.IsContainedIn.toposRetraction
declarations.doc:
The conclusion of Stacks 00XU for the big sites: the two morphisms of topoi
`g : Sh(Sch_proetale) → Sh(Sch'_proetale)` and `f : Sh(Sch'_proetale) → Sh(Sch_proetale)`
induced by the inclusion, together with the isomorphism `f ∘ g ≅ id`.

The direct image of `g` is the cocontinuous pushforward and the direct image of `f` is the
continuous pushforward, which is also the inverse image of `g`; this is the identification
`f_* = g^{-1}`. The retraction is the counit of the adjunction `g^{-1} ⊣ g_*`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def toposRetraction :
    let : h.functor.IsCocontinuous B.topology B'.topology := h.functor_isCocontinuous
    let : h.functor.IsContinuous B.topology B'.topology :=
      h.functor_isMorphismOfSites.toIsContinuous
    ToposRetraction B.Scheme B'.Scheme B.topology B'.topology h.functor
declarations.comment:
the two morphisms of topoi of the big sites, with `f ∘ g` isomorphic to the identity and
  `f_* = g^{-1}`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.BigProetaleSite.IsContainedIn.toposRetractionOver
declarations.doc:
The conclusion of Stacks 00XU for the slices: the two morphisms of topoi
`g : Sh((Sch/S)_proetale) → Sh((Sch'/S)_proetale)` and `f` in the other direction induced by the
inclusion of the slices over `S`, together with the isomorphism `f ∘ g ≅ id`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def toposRetractionOver :

        (BigProetaleOver.topology B' S (h.contains hS)) :=
      (h.functorOver_isMorphismOfSites S hS).toIsContinuous
    ToposRetraction (BigProetaleOver B S hS) (BigProetaleOver B' S (h.contains hS))
      (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS) (BigProetaleOver.topology B' S (h.contains hS))
      (h.functorOver S hS)
declarations.comment:
the two morphisms of topoi of the slices, with `f ∘ g` isomorphic to the identity and
  `f_* = g^{-1}`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.BigProetaleSite.IsContainedIn.cohomologyRestrictionIso
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme and let `(Sch/S)_proétale` and `(Sch'/S)_proétale` be two big pro-étale
sites of `S` as in Definition 098K, the first contained in the second.  For any object `U` of
`(Sch/S)_proétale` and any degree `p`,

`H^p(U, ℱ'|_{(Sch/S)_proétale}) = H^p(U, ℱ')`

naturally in the abelian sheaf `ℱ'` on `(Sch'/S)_proétale`, where cohomology over an object is
Mathlib's `Ext`-based `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor`.

By Stacks 0F4S the localized inclusion is continuous, cocontinuous and preserves finite limits,
and both localized sites are essentially small, so this is Stacks 03YU,
`Stacks.Cohomology.BiggerSite.cohomologyPresheafFunctorIso`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cohomologyRestrictionIso
    [HasSheafify (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS) Ab.{u}]
    [HasSheafify (BigProetaleOver.topology B' S (h.contains hS)) Ab.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS) Ab.{u})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (BigProetaleOver.topology B' S (h.contains hS)) Ab.{u})]
    (U : BigProetaleOver B S hS) (p : ℕ) :
    (h.functorOver S hS).sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u}
          (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS)
          (BigProetaleOver.topology B' S (h.contains hS)) ⋙
        Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS) p ⋙
          (evaluation (BigProetaleOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ Ab.{w}).obj (op U) ≅
      Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (BigProetaleOver.topology B' S (h.contains hS)) p ⋙
        (evaluation (BigProetaleOver B' S (h.contains hS))ᵒᵖ Ab.{w}).obj
          (op ((h.functorOver S hS).obj U))
declarations.comment:
part (1), the cohomology over an object of the smaller big pro-étale site of the
  restriction of an abelian sheaf agrees with its cohomology over the image of that object

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.BigProetaleSite.IsContainedIn.exists_extension_abelianSheaf
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme and let `(Sch/S)_proétale` and `(Sch'/S)_proétale` be two big pro-étale
sites of `S` as in Definition 098K, the first contained in the second.  For any abelian sheaf
`ℱ` on `(Sch/S)_proétale` there is an abelian sheaf `ℱ'` on `(Sch'/S)_proétale` whose
restriction to `(Sch/S)_proétale` is isomorphic to `ℱ`.

The witness is the sheaf pullback along the inclusion, and the isomorphism is the inverse unit
of the adjunction, invertible by Stacks 00XU.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_extension_abelianSheaf
    (F : Sheaf (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS) Ab.{u}) :
    ∃ F' : Sheaf (BigProetaleOver.topology B' S (h.contains hS)) Ab.{u},
      Nonempty ((h.abelianRestrictionOver S hS).obj F' ≅ F)
declarations.comment:
part (2), every abelian sheaf on the smaller big pro-étale site is the
  restriction of an abelian sheaf on the bigger site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.BigProetaleSite.IsContainedIn.cohomologyPresheafRestrictionIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4T (1).** Let `S` be a scheme and let `(Sch/S)_proétale` and
`(Sch'/S)_proétale` be two big pro-étale sites of `S` as in Definition 098K, the first contained
in the second.  For any object `U` of `(Sch/S)_proétale` and any degree `p`,

`H^p(U, ℱ'|_{(Sch/S)_proétale}) = H^p(U, ℱ')`

naturally in the abelian sheaf `ℱ'` on `(Sch'/S)_proétale`, where cohomology over an object is
Mathlib's `Ext`-based `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor` with values in any
universe `w` where the `Ext`-groups of the two sheaf categories are small (for instance `w = u`,
by `AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.hasExt_sheaf_bigProetaleOver`).

Sheafification on both sites is `AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.hasSheafify_bigProetaleOver_abelian`,
and the comparison is
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.BigProetaleSite.IsContainedIn.cohomologyRestrictionIso`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cohomologyPresheafRestrictionIso
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS) Ab.{u})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (BigProetaleOver.topology B' S (h.contains hS)) Ab.{u})]
    (U : BigProetaleOver B S hS) (p : ℕ) :
    (h.functorOver S hS).sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u}
          (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS)
          (BigProetaleOver.topology B' S (h.contains hS)) ⋙
        Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS) p ⋙
          (evaluation (BigProetaleOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ Ab.{w}).obj (op U) ≅
      Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (BigProetaleOver.topology B' S (h.contains hS)) p ⋙
        (evaluation (BigProetaleOver B' S (h.contains hS))ᵒᵖ Ab.{w}).obj
          (op ((h.functorOver S hS).obj U))
declarations.comment:
part (1), the cohomology over an object of the smaller big pro-étale site of the
  restriction of an abelian sheaf on the bigger site agrees with the cohomology of that sheaf
  over the same object in the bigger site, naturally in the sheaf, for every degree

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.BigProetaleSite.IsContainedIn.essSurj_abelianRestrictionOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4T (2).** Let `S` be a scheme and let `(Sch/S)_proétale` and
`(Sch'/S)_proétale` be two big pro-étale sites of `S` as in Definition 098K, the first contained
in the second.  Restriction of abelian sheaves from `(Sch'/S)_proétale` to `(Sch/S)_proétale` is
essentially surjective: for any abelian sheaf `ℱ` on `(Sch/S)_proétale` there is an abelian
sheaf `ℱ'` on `(Sch'/S)_proétale` whose restriction to `(Sch/S)_proétale` is isomorphic to `ℱ`.

The witness is the sheaf pullback along the inclusion, which exists by
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.hasSheafify_bigProetaleOver_abelian`; this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.BigProetaleSite.IsContainedIn.exists_extension_abelianSheaf`.
declarations.statement: instance essSurj_abelianRestrictionOver : (h.abelianRestrictionOver S hS).EssSurj
declarations.comment:
part (2), restriction of abelian sheaves from the bigger big pro-étale site to
  the smaller one is essentially surjective: every abelian sheaf on the smaller site is
  isomorphic to the restriction of an abelian sheaf on the bigger site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4X.** The condition that a section of the small-étale direct image of `F` over an
étale test object `V ⟶ Y` has proper support over `V`: its support in `X ×_Y V` is proper over
`V`.
declarations.statement:
public def properSupportSections (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
    (s : F.obj.obj (op ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).obj V))) : Prop
declarations.comment: the proper support condition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportSections_restrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4X.** The proper-support condition is stable under restriction along an arrow of
the small étale site of `Y`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem properSupportSections_restrict [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (U V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property) (a : V ⟶ U)
    (s : F.obj.obj (op ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).obj U)))
    (hs : properSupportSections B f F U s) :
    properSupportSections B f F V (F.obj.map ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).map a).op s)
declarations.comment: stability under restriction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportSections_descend
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4X.** The proper-support condition is local for the fpqc topology on the test
object.
declarations.statement:
public theorem properSupportSections_descend [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
    (s : F.obj.obj (op ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).obj V)))
    {ι : Type w} (W : ι → SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property) (a : ∀ i, W i ⟶ V)
    (hcover : Presieve.ofArrows
      (fun i => (SmallEtale.toScheme B Y.obj Y.property).obj (W i))
      (fun i => (SmallEtale.toScheme B Y.obj Y.property).map (a i)) ∈
        Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage ((SmallEtale.toScheme B Y.obj Y.property).obj V))
    (hloc : ∀ i, properSupportSections B f F (W i)
      (F.obj.map ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).map (a i)).op s)) :
    properSupportSections B f F V s
declarations.comment: locality of the proper support condition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekSubsheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4X.** The abelian subsheaf `f_! F` of the small-étale direct image `f_* F`
consisting exactly of the sections whose support is proper over the étale base, bundled with the
sectionwise description of its image.
declarations.statement:
public def fShriekSubsheaf [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)] :
    {G : MonoOver ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{v} (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
          (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) |>.obj F) //
      ∀ (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
        (s : ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{v} (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
            (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)).obj F |>.obj.obj (op V)),
          s ∈ Set.range (G.arrow.hom.app (op V)) ↔
            properSupportSections B f F V s}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.mem_range_fShriekSubsheaf_arrow_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4X.** The sections of `f_! F` over an étale test object are exactly the sections
of `f_* F` whose support is proper over that object.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mem_range_fShriekSubsheaf_arrow_iff [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
    (s : (directImageSheaf B f F).obj.obj (op V)) :
    s ∈ Set.range ((fShriekSubsheaf B f F).val.arrow.hom.app (op V)) ↔
      properSupportSections B f F V s
declarations.comment: the sectionwise characterization

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward_range_eq_fShriekSubsheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4Y.** For a separated étale morphism, the image of extension by zero in the
direct image is precisely the proper-support subsheaf.
declarations.statement:
public theorem abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward_range_eq_fShriekSubsheaf
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : Scheme.{u}) (hX : B.Contains X) (U : SmallEtale B X hX)
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (V : SmallEtale B X hX) :
    Set.range (((abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward B X hX U).app F).hom.app (op V)) =
      Set.range (((fShriekSubsheaf B U.obj.hom F).val.arrow).hom.app (op V))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekSubsheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F4X.** The abelian subsheaf `f_! F` of the small-étale direct image `f_* F`
consisting exactly of the sections whose support is proper over the étale base, bundled with the
sectionwise description of its image.
declarations.statement:
public def fShriekSubsheaf [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)] :
    {G : MonoOver ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{v} (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
          (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) |>.obj F) //
      ∀ (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
        (s : ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{v} (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
            (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)).obj F |>.obj.obj (op V)),
          s ∈ Set.range (G.arrow.hom.app (op V)) ↔
            properSupportSections B f F V s}
declarations.comment: the subsheaf f_! F of f_* F, the direct image with compact support

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportFunctor_compIso
declarations.doc: The canonical comparison is natural in the abelian étale sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def properSupportFunctor_compIso
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)] [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map g)] :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (f ≫ g)) :=
      by rw [Functor.map_comp]; infer_instance
    { e : properSupportFunctor B f ⋙ properSupportFunctor B g ≅
          properSupportFunctor B (f ≫ g) //
      ∀ F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v},
        e.app F = (properSupportSheaf_compIso B f g F).val }

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportIsoPushforward
declarations.doc:
For a proper morphism the proper-support direct image is the ordinary
direct image, naturally in the abelian étale sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public def properSupportIsoPushforward [IsProper (B.inclusion.map g)] :
    properSupportFunctor.{u, v} B g ≅ etalePushforward.{u, v} B g
declarations.comment: natural isomorphism f_! ≅ f_* for proper f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekSubsheaf_arrow_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F51.** For a proper morphism, the canonical inclusion of the proper-support
direct image `f_! F` into the ordinary direct image `f_* F` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekSubsheaf_arrow_isIso [IsProper (B.inclusion.map f)] :
    IsIso ((fShriekSubsheaf B f F).val.arrow)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compactificationProperSupportIso
declarations.doc:
The canonical comparison `f_! ⟶ f̄_! ∘ j_!` of proper-support direct
images through a compactification `j : X ⟶ X̄` of `X` over `Y`, as a natural isomorphism of
functors on abelian étale sheaves.
declarations.statement:
public def compactificationProperSupportIso
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom)] :
    properSupportFunctor.{u, u + 1} B (U.obj.hom ≫ fbar) ≅
      abelianExtensionByZero B Xbar.obj Xbar.property U ⋙
        properSupportFunctor.{u, u + 1} B fbar
declarations.comment: natural isomorphism of proper-support functors

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekFunctorIsoCompactification
declarations.doc:
`f_! = f̄_* ∘ j_!`: the direct image with compact support along
`f = j ≫ f̄`, for `j : X ⟶ X̄` an open immersion and `f̄ : X̄ ⟶ Y` proper, is extension by zero
along `j` followed by the ordinary direct image along `f̄`.
declarations.statement:
public def fShriekFunctorIsoCompactification
    [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map fbar)] :
    fShriekFunctor.{u, u} B (U.obj.hom ≫ fbar) ≅
      abelianExtensionByZero B Xbar.obj Xbar.property U ⋙
        etalePushforward.{u, u + 1} B fbar

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compactificationFShriekMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F52.** The canonical map `f_! F ⟶ f̄_!(j_! F)` for an open immersion `j : X ⟶ X̄`
with `f = j ≫ f̄`: the extension-by-zero unit, which identifies `F` with the restriction of
`j_! F`, followed by the open-inclusion comparison of Stacks 0F53. The subtype records that
factorisation, which is what pins the map down.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def compactificationFShriekMap :
    letI : IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map fbar) := inferInstance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map fbar) := inferInstance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (U.obj.hom ≫ fbar)) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom ≫ B.inclusion.map fbar)
      infer_instance
    let Fbar := (abelianExtensionByZero B Xbar.obj Xbar.property U).obj F
    let pull := (smallEtaleBaseChange B U.obj.hom).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (SmallEtale.topology B Xbar.obj Xbar.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.obj U.obj.left.property)
    let push := (smallEtaleBaseChange B (U.obj.hom ≫ fbar)).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.obj U.obj.left.property)
    let Gsrc := (fShriekSubsheaf B (U.obj.hom ≫ fbar) F).val
    let Gpull := (fShriekSubsheaf B (U.obj.hom ≫ fbar) (pull.obj Fbar)).val
    let Gtgt := (fShriekSubsheaf B fbar Fbar).val
    {α : Gsrc.obj.left ⟶ Gtgt.obj.left //
      ∃ i : Gsrc.obj.left ≅ Gpull.obj.left,
        let unit := (abelianExtensionByZeroAdjunction B Xbar.obj Xbar.property U).unit.app F
        let e := unit ≫ (openRestrictionIso.{u, u} B U.obj.hom).hom.app Fbar
        (i.hom ≫ Gpull.arrow = Gsrc.arrow ≫ push.map e) ∧
        (α = i.hom ≫ (openInclusionShriekMap B U.obj.hom fbar Fbar).val)}
declarations.comment: canonical comparison

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compactificationFShriekMap_isIso
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0F52.** The canonical compactification comparison is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem compactificationFShriekMap_isIso :
    IsIso (compactificationFShriekMap B fbar U F).val
declarations.comment: isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compactificationFShriekMap_to_pushforward_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F52.** Since the compactification is proper, the same canonical map identifies
`f_! F` with the ordinary direct image `f̄_*(j_! F)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem compactificationFShriekMap_to_pushforward_isIso :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map fbar) := inferInstance
    let Fbar := (abelianExtensionByZero B Xbar.obj Xbar.property U).obj F
    IsIso ((compactificationFShriekMap B fbar U F).val ≫
      (fShriekSubsheaf B fbar Fbar).val.arrow)
declarations.comment: ordinary direct image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compactificationFShriekMap_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F52.** The compactification comparison commutes with morphisms of abelian étale
sheaves, hence identifies the two direct-image functors naturally.
declarations.statement:
public theorem compactificationFShriekMap_naturality
    (H : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.obj U.obj.left.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (phi : F ⟶ H) :
    letI : IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map fbar) := inferInstance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map fbar) := inferInstance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (U.obj.hom ≫ fbar)) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom ≫ B.inclusion.map fbar)
      infer_instance
    let ext := abelianExtensionByZero B Xbar.obj Xbar.property U
    let push := (smallEtaleBaseChange B (U.obj.hom ≫ fbar)).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.obj U.obj.left.property)
    let pushbar := (smallEtaleBaseChange B fbar).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B Xbar.obj Xbar.property)
    let GF := (fShriekSubsheaf B (U.obj.hom ≫ fbar) F).val
    let GH := (fShriekSubsheaf B (U.obj.hom ≫ fbar) H).val
    let GbarF := (fShriekSubsheaf B fbar (ext.obj F)).val
    let GbarH := (fShriekSubsheaf B fbar (ext.obj H)).val
    ∀ (a : GF.obj.left ⟶ GH.obj.left) (b : GbarF.obj.left ⟶ GbarH.obj.left),
      (a ≫ GH.arrow = GF.arrow ≫ push.map phi) →
      (b ≫ GbarH.arrow = GbarF.arrow ≫ pushbar.map (ext.map phi)) →
      (a ≫ (compactificationFShriekMap B fbar U H).val =
        (compactificationFShriekMap B fbar U F).val ≫ b)
declarations.comment: naturality and functor comparison

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekMap
declarations.doc:
The induced map on proper-support direct images, characterized by its
inclusion into ordinary direct image.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def fShriekMap
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (F H : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (φ : F ⟶ H) :
    let G := (SmallEtale.fShriekSubsheaf B f F).val
    let K := (SmallEtale.fShriekSubsheaf B f H).val
    let push := (smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
    {m : G.obj.left ⟶ K.obj.left // m ≫ K.arrow = G.arrow ≫ push.map φ}
declarations.comment: open_inclusion_compatibility: induced maps

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekMap_id
declarations.doc: The proper-support direct image takes identity morphisms to identities.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekMap_id
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v}) :
    (fShriekMap B f F F (𝟙 F)).val = 𝟙 _
declarations.comment: open_inclusion_compatibility: identity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekMap_comp
declarations.doc: The proper-support direct image respects composition of sheaf morphisms.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekMap_comp
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (F H K : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (φ : F ⟶ H) (ψ : H ⟶ K) :
    (fShriekMap B f F K (φ ≫ ψ)).val =
      (fShriekMap B f F H φ).val ≫ (fShriekMap B f H K ψ).val
declarations.comment: open_inclusion_compatibility: composition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.openInclusionShriekMap_naturality
declarations.doc: Extension by zero from an open subscheme is natural in the abelian sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public theorem openInclusionShriekMap_naturality
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X' X Y : B.Scheme}
    (j : X' ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (F H : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (φ : F ⟶ H) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (j ≫ f)) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map j ≫ B.inclusion.map f)
      infer_instance
    let pull := (smallEtaleBaseChange B j).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X'.obj X'.property)
    (fShriekMap B (j ≫ f) (pull.obj F) (pull.obj H) (pull.map φ)).val ≫
      (openInclusionShriekMap B j f H).val =
        (openInclusionShriekMap B j f F).val ≫
        (fShriekMap B f F H φ).val
declarations.comment: open_inclusion_compatibility

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.openInclusionShriekMap
declarations.doc:
The canonical injection from the proper-support direct image on an open
subscheme, with its sectionwise extension-by-zero characterization.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def openInclusionShriekMap
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X' X Y : B.Scheme}
    (j : X' ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v}) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (j ≫ f)) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map j ≫ B.inclusion.map f)
      infer_instance
    let F' := ((smallEtaleBaseChange B j).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X'.obj X'.property)).obj F
    let G' := (SmallEtale.fShriekSubsheaf B (j ≫ f) F').val
    let G := (SmallEtale.fShriekSubsheaf B f F).val
    {α : G'.obj.left ⟶ G.obj.left //
      Mono α ∧
      ∀ (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property) (a : G'.obj.left.obj.obj (op V)),
        let W := (smallEtaleBaseChange B f).obj V
        let e := (smallEtaleBaseChange_compIso B X' X Y j f).val
        let s := G.arrow.hom.app (op V) (α.hom.app (op V) a)
        let s' := G'.arrow.hom.app (op V) a
        let s'W := F'.obj.map (e.hom.app V).op s'
        (F'.obj.map (e.hom.app V).op s' =
          (((smallEtaleBaseChange B j).sheafAdjunctionContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{v}
            (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
            (SmallEtale.topology B X'.obj X'.property)).unit.app F).hom.app (op W) s) ∧
        (SmallEtale.supportSection B X.obj X.property F W s =
          (B.inclusion.map (pullback.fst W.obj.hom j)).base ''
            SmallEtale.supportSection B X'.obj X'.property F'
              ((smallEtaleBaseChange B j).obj W) s'W)}
declarations.comment: open_inclusion_mono

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.openInclusionShriekCompIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F53.** Restricting an abelian sheaf to a nested open subscheme in two steps or in
one gives canonically isomorphic proper-support direct images.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def openInclusionShriekCompIso
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X'' X' X Y : B.Scheme}
    (i : X'' ⟶ X') (j : X' ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map i)]
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v}) :
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map (i ≫ j)) := by
      change IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map i ≫ B.inclusion.map j)
      infer_instance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (j ≫ f)) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map j ≫ B.inclusion.map f)
      infer_instance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (i ≫ j ≫ f)) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map i ≫ B.inclusion.map (j ≫ f))
      infer_instance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map ((i ≫ j) ≫ f)) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (i ≫ j) ≫ B.inclusion.map f)
      infer_instance
    let F' := ((smallEtaleBaseChange B j).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X'.obj X'.property)).obj F
    let F'' := ((smallEtaleBaseChange B i).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X'.obj X'.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X''.obj X''.property)).obj F'
    let Fd := ((smallEtaleBaseChange B (i ≫ j)).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X''.obj X''.property)).obj F
    (fShriekSubsheaf B (i ≫ j ≫ f) F'').val.obj.left ≅
      (fShriekSubsheaf B ((i ≫ j) ≫ f) Fd).val.obj.left
declarations.comment: open_inclusion_trans

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.openInclusionShriekCompIso_ambient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F53.** The comparison of proper-support direct images is the comparison of
restrictions, read inside the ordinary direct images.
declarations.statement:
public theorem openInclusionShriekCompIso_ambient
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X'' X' X Y : B.Scheme}
    (i : X'' ⟶ X') (j : X' ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map i)]
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v}) :
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map (i ≫ j)) := by
      change IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map i ≫ B.inclusion.map j)
      infer_instance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (j ≫ f)) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map j ≫ B.inclusion.map f)
      infer_instance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (i ≫ j ≫ f)) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map i ≫ B.inclusion.map (j ≫ f))
      infer_instance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map ((i ≫ j) ≫ f)) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (i ≫ j) ≫ B.inclusion.map f)
      infer_instance
    let F' := ((smallEtaleBaseChange B j).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X'.obj X'.property)).obj F
    let F'' := ((smallEtaleBaseChange B i).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X'.obj X'.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X''.obj X''.property)).obj F'
    let Fd := ((smallEtaleBaseChange B (i ≫ j)).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X''.obj X''.property)).obj F
    let Pi := (smallEtaleBaseChange B (i ≫ j ≫ f)).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      AddCommGrpCat.{v} (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X''.obj X''.property)
    let Pd := (smallEtaleBaseChange B ((i ≫ j) ≫ f)).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      AddCommGrpCat.{v} (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X''.obj X''.property)
    let restrictionIso := (smallEtaleSheafPullbackCompIso B X'' X' X i j
      AddCommGrpCat.{v}).app F
    let pushforwardIso : Pi ≅ Pd :=
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun g : X'' ⟶ Y =>
        (smallEtaleBaseChange B g).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{v} (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
          (SmallEtale.topology B X''.obj X''.property))
        (Category.assoc i j f).symm)
    (openInclusionShriekCompIso B i j f F).hom ≫
        (fShriekSubsheaf B ((i ≫ j) ≫ f) Fd).val.arrow =
      (fShriekSubsheaf B (i ≫ j ≫ f) F'').val.arrow ≫
        (Pi.mapIso restrictionIso ≪≫ pushforwardIso.app Fd).hom
declarations.comment: open_inclusion_trans

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.openInclusionShriekMap_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F53.** Extension by zero is transitive: for nested open subschemes
`X'' ⟶ X' ⟶ X` of the source of a separated morphism locally of finite type, the canonical map
from the proper-support direct image on `X''` is the composite of the two successive canonical
maps, once the two proper-support direct images on `X''` are identified.
declarations.statement:
public theorem openInclusionShriekMap_comp
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X'' X' X Y : B.Scheme}
    (i : X'' ⟶ X') (j : X' ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map i)]
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v}) :
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map (i ≫ j)) := by
      change IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map i ≫ B.inclusion.map j)
      infer_instance
    letI : IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map (j ≫ f)) := by
      change IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map j ≫ B.inclusion.map f)
      infer_instance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (j ≫ f)) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map j ≫ B.inclusion.map f)
      infer_instance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (i ≫ j ≫ f)) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map i ≫ B.inclusion.map (j ≫ f))
      infer_instance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map ((i ≫ j) ≫ f)) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (i ≫ j) ≫ B.inclusion.map f)
      infer_instance
    let F' := ((smallEtaleBaseChange B j).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X'.obj X'.property)).obj F
    (openInclusionShriekCompIso B i j f F).hom ≫
        (openInclusionShriekMap B (i ≫ j) f F).val =
      (openInclusionShriekMap B i (j ≫ f) F').val ≫
        (openInclusionShriekMap B j f F).val
declarations.comment: open_inclusion_trans

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportFunctor_isColimit_openCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F54.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be separated and locally of finite type, and let the
`X_i = U i` form an open covering of `X` that is directed: any two members lie in a third.
Writing `f_i` for the restriction of `f` to `X_i`, the proper-support direct image is the
colimit `f_! F = colim_i f_{i,!}(F|_{X_i})` functorially in the abelian sheaf `F`, along the
canonical extension-by-zero maps: there is a directed diagram of functors whose value at `i` is
`F ↦ f_{i,!}(F|_{X_i})` and a colimit cocone on it, in the category of functors from abelian
sheaves on `X` to abelian sheaves on `Y`, whose vertex is the functor `f_!` and whose legs are,
at every sheaf `F`, the canonical maps `f_{i,!}(F|_{X_i}) ⟶ f_! F`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem properSupportFunctor_isColimit_openCover [IsDirected ι (· ≤ ·)]
    (hcover : ∀ x : X.obj, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (B.inclusion.map (j.app i)).base) :
    ∃ (D : ι ⥤ (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v} ⥤
        Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v}))
      (c : Cocone D) (hpt : c.pt = properSupportFunctor B f),
      (∀ i,
        let ji : U.obj i ⟶ X := j.app i
        letI : IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map ji) := hopen i
        letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (ji ≫ f)) := by
          change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map ji ≫ B.inclusion.map f)
          infer_instance
        let res := (smallEtaleBaseChange B ji).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
          (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
          (SmallEtale.topology B (U.obj i).obj (U.obj i).property)
        ∃ (hi : D.obj i = res ⋙ properSupportFunctor B (ji ≫ f)),
          ∀ F, (c.ι.app i ≫ eqToHom hpt).app F =
            (eqToHom hi).app F ≫ (openInclusionShriekMap B ji f F).val) ∧
        Nonempty (IsColimit c)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F55.** For a cartesian square of a big étale site with horizontal morphisms
`p : X' ⟶ X`, `g : Y' ⟶ Y` and vertical morphisms `f : X ⟶ Y` separated and locally of finite
type and `f' : X' ⟶ Y'`, there is an isomorphism `g⁻¹f_!F ≅ f'_!(p⁻¹F)`, natural in the abelian
sheaf `F` on the small étale site of `X`. Its component at `F` is the base-change map
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportBaseChange`, the restriction of the pullback map
`g⁻¹f_*F ⟶ f'_*(p⁻¹F)` (`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportBaseChange_comp_arrow`), so
the isomorphism is the identification `f'_!(p⁻¹F) = g⁻¹f_!F` of the source inside
`f'_*(p⁻¹F)`. The hypotheses on `f'` are read off the square.
declarations.statement:
public def properSupportBaseChangeIso :
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isPullback B p f' f g sq
    properSupportFunctor B f ⋙ abPullback.{u, v} B g ≅
      abPullback.{u, v} B p ⋙ properSupportFunctor B f'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportFunctor_preservesColimitsOfShape_discrete
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F56.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of schemes which is separated and locally of
finite type. Then the proper-support direct image `f_!` of abelian sheaves on the small étale
sites commutes with direct sums: it preserves colimits indexed by any discrete category, so it
carries a direct sum of an arbitrarily indexed family of abelian sheaves on the small étale
site of `X` to the direct sum of their proper-support direct images.
declarations.statement:
public theorem properSupportFunctor_preservesColimitsOfShape_discrete
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (ι : Type w) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete ι) (properSupportFunctor.{u, v} B f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportStalkFunctorIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F57, part (1).** For a separated locally quasi-finite morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` and a
geometric point `ȳ` of `Y`, the stalk at `ȳ` of the proper-support direct image `f_!F` is the
direct sum of the stalks of `F` at the geometric points `x̄` of `X` with `f(x̄) = ȳ`,
functorially in the abelian étale sheaf `F`.
declarations.statement:
public def properSupportStalkFunctorIso (s : GeometricPoint Y.obj) :
    properSupportFunctor.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f ⋙
        (geometricPointSitePoint B Y.obj Y.property s).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) ≅
      Adjunction.sigmaFamily (fun x : GeometricFiberPoint B f s =>
        (geometricPointSitePoint B X.obj X.property (x.toGeometricPoint B f s)).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}))
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportFunctor_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F57, part (2).** For a separated locally quasi-finite morphism the proper-support
direct image `f_!` on abelian étale sheaves is an exact functor.
declarations.statement:
public theorem properSupportFunctor_exact :
    exactFunctor _ _ (properSupportFunctor.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekModAdjunction
declarations.doc:
The direct image with compact support `f_!` of a locally quasi-finite morphism, on étale
sheaves of `Λ`-modules, is left adjoint to the upper shriek `f^!` with coefficients in `Λ`.
declarations.statement:
public def fShriekModAdjunction :
    fShriekMod.{u, v, r} B Λ f ⊣ fUpperShriekMod.{u, v, r} B Λ f
declarations.comment: part (3), f_! on étale sheaves of Λ-modules has a right adjoint f^!

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fUpperShriekModForgetIso
declarations.doc:
The upper shriek with coefficients in `Λ` agrees with the upper shriek of abelian étale
sheaves on underlying abelian sheaves: the abelian sheaf underlying `f^!G` is `f^!` of the
abelian sheaf underlying `G`.
declarations.comment: part (3), the Λ-linear f^! agrees with f^! on underlying abelian sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekFunctor_isLeftAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F59, part (1).** The direct image with compact support
`f_! : Ab(X_étale) ⟶ Ab(Y_étale)` of a locally quasi-finite morphism of schemes has a right
adjoint `f^! : Ab(Y_étale) ⟶ Ab(X_étale)`.
declarations.statement:
public instance fShriekFunctor_isLeftAdjoint :
    (fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f).IsLeftAdjoint
declarations.comment: part (1), f_! on abelian étale sheaves has a right adjoint f^!

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fUpperShriekSkyscraperIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F59, part (2).** For a locally quasi-finite morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` and a geometric
point `ȳ` of `Y`, the upper shriek of the skyscraper at `ȳ` is the product of the skyscrapers
over the geometric points of `X` lying over `ȳ`: `f^!(ȳ_* A) ≅ ∏_{f(x̄) = ȳ} x̄_* A`, naturally
in the abelian group `A`.
declarations.statement:
public def fUpperShriekSkyscraperIso :
    etaleSkyscraperFunctor B Y.obj Y.property s AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v} ⋙
        fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f ≅
      Adjunction.piFamily (fun x : GeometricFiberPoint B f s =>
        etaleSkyscraperFunctor B X.obj X.property (x.toGeometricPoint B f s)
          AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})
declarations.comment: part (2), f^!(ȳ_* A) ≅ ∏_{f(x̄) = ȳ} x̄_* A, naturally in A

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fUpperShriekSkyscraperObjIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F59, part (2).** The value of the isomorphism at an abelian group `A`:
`f^!(ȳ_* A) ≅ ∏_{f(x̄) = ȳ} x̄_* A`.
declarations.statement:
public def fUpperShriekSkyscraperObjIso (M : AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    (fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f).obj
        (etaleSkyscraper B Y.obj Y.property s AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v} M) ≅
      ∏ᶜ fun x : GeometricFiberPoint B f s =>
        etaleSkyscraper B X.obj X.property (x.toGeometricPoint B f s)
          AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v} M
declarations.comment: part (2), the formula at a given abelian group A

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.etaleUpperShriekIsoRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5A.** For an étale morphism `j : U ⟶ X` the upper shriek `j^!` on abelian étale
sheaves is the inverse image `j^{-1}`: both are right adjoint to `j_!`.
declarations.statement:
public def etaleUpperShriekIsoRestriction :
    fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B U.obj.hom ≅ abelianRestriction B X hX U
declarations.comment: j^! = j^{-1} for an étale morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.upperShriekCompIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5B, the canonical isomorphism.** For composable locally quasi-finite morphisms
`f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` there is a canonical isomorphism `(g ∘ f)^! ≅ f^! ∘ g^!` of upper
shriek functors on abelian étale sheaves: the conjugate, under the adjunctions
`(g ∘ f)_! ⊣ (g ∘ f)^!` and `g_! ∘ f_! ⊣ f^! ∘ g^!`, of the canonical isomorphism
`(g ∘ f)_! ≅ g_! ∘ f_!` of Stacks 0F6T. The source assumes `f` and `g` separated; that
hypothesis is not needed.
declarations.comment: the canonical isomorphism (g ∘ f)^! ≅ f^! ∘ g^!

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.upperShriekCompIso_assoc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5B, the associativity square.** For locally quasi-finite morphisms
`f : X ⟶ Y`, `g : Y ⟶ Z` and `h : Z ⟶ T` the two isomorphisms
`(h ∘ g ∘ f)^! ≅ f^! ∘ g^! ∘ h^!` built from the composition isomorphisms of upper shriek agree:
`(h ∘ g ∘ f)^! → f^! ∘ (h ∘ g)^! → f^! ∘ g^! ∘ h^!` equals
`(h ∘ g ∘ f)^! → (g ∘ f)^! ∘ h^! → f^! ∘ g^! ∘ h^!`. The identification
`(h ∘ (g ∘ f))^! = ((h ∘ g) ∘ f)^!` along the associativity of composition, and the
associator of composition of functors, are written out. The source assumes `f` and `g`
separated; that hypothesis is not needed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem upperShriekCompIso_assoc :
    eqToHom (fUpperShriekFunctor_congr.{u, v} B (Category.assoc f g h).symm) ≫
        (upperShriekCompIso.{u, v} B (f ≫ g) h).hom ≫
          whiskerLeft (fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, v} B h) (upperShriekCompIso.{u, v} B f g).hom =
      (upperShriekCompIso.{u, v} B f (g ≫ h)).hom ≫
        whiskerRight (upperShriekCompIso.{u, v} B g h).hom (fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f) ≫
          (associator (fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, v} B h) (fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, v} B g)
            (fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f)).hom
declarations.comment: the associativity square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.upperShriekCompIso_etaleUpperShriekIsoRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5C.** Let `j : U ⟶ X` and `j' : V ⟶ U` be étale morphisms. The isomorphism
`(j ∘ j')^! ≅ (j')^! ∘ j^!` of Stacks 0F5B and the isomorphism
`(j ∘ j')^{-1} ≅ (j')^{-1} ∘ j^{-1}` of the inverse images agree via the isomorphisms
`j^! ≅ j^{-1}` of Stacks 0F5A: the square
`(j ∘ j')^! → (j')^! ∘ j^! → (j')^! ∘ j^{-1} → (j')^{-1} ∘ j^{-1}` equals
`(j ∘ j')^! → (j ∘ j')^{-1} → (j')^{-1} ∘ j^{-1}`. Here `j` is an object `U` of the small étale
site of `X`, `j'` an object `V` of the small étale site of `U`, and `j ∘ j'` is `V` viewed as an
object of the small étale site of `X`, `AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleCompObject`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem upperShriekCompIso_etaleUpperShriekIsoRestriction :
    upperShriekCompIso.{u, u + 1} B V.obj.hom U.obj.hom ≪≫
        isoWhiskerRight (etaleUpperShriekIsoRestriction B X hX U)
          (fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B V.obj.hom) ≪≫
        isoWhiskerLeft (abelianRestriction B X hX U)
          (etaleUpperShriekIsoRestriction B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property V) =
      etaleUpperShriekIsoRestriction B X hX (smallEtaleCompObject B X hX U V) ≪≫
        (abelianRestrictionCompIso B X hX U V).symm

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekStalkIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5F, part (1).** The stalk of the direct image with compact support `f_!F` of a
locally quasi-finite morphism at a geometric point `ȳ` of `Y` is the direct sum of the stalks of
`F` over the geometric points of `X` lying over `ȳ`: `(f_!F)_ȳ ≅ ⊕_{f(x̄) = ȳ} F_x̄`.
declarations.statement:
public def fShriekStalkIso (s : GeometricPoint Y.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    etaleStalk B Y.obj Y.property s ((fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f).obj F).obj ≅
      AddCommGrpCat.of (fiberStalks.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f s F)
declarations.comment: part (1), stalk decomposition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekStalkIso_comp_sheafification
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5F, part (1).** The stalk decomposition of `f_!F` is the canonical one: the
comparison of the stalk of `f_!F` with the stalk of the finite-support direct image presheaf
`f_{p!}F`, which is induced by the sheafification unit, carries it to the germ decomposition of
Stacks 0F6P.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekStalkIso_comp_sheafification (s : GeometricPoint Y.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    colim.map (Functor.whiskerLeft
        (Functor.Elements.π (geometricPointFiber B Y.obj Y.property s)).op
        (toSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
          ((finiteSupportPushforward.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f
            (fun _ => inferInstance)).1.obj F))) ≫
      (fShriekStalkIso.{u, v} B f s F).hom =
      (finiteSupportStalkIso.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f s F fun _ => inferInstance).hom
declarations.comment: part (1), canonical comparison

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekStalkIso_natural
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5F, part (1).** The stalk decomposition of the direct image with compact support is
natural in the abelian sheaf: a morphism of sheaves on `X` acts on the direct sum of stalks over
the geometric fibre by its maps on those stalks.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekStalkIso_natural (s : GeometricPoint Y.obj)
    {F G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}}
    (φ : F ⟶ G) :
    colim.map (Functor.whiskerLeft
        (Functor.Elements.π (geometricPointFiber B Y.obj Y.property s)).op
        ((fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f).map φ).1) ≫ (fShriekStalkIso.{u, v} B f s G).hom =
      (fShriekStalkIso.{u, v} B f s F).hom ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (fiberStalksMap.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f s φ)
declarations.comment: part (1), functoriality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekFunctor_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5F, part (2).** The direct image with compact support of a locally quasi-finite
morphism is an exact functor on abelian étale sheaves.

Preservation of finite colimits is the colimit preservation of the stalk decomposition;
preservation of finite limits follows from it together with preservation of monomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekFunctor_exact :
    exactFunctor _ _ (fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f)
declarations.comment: part (2), exactness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekFunctor_preservesCoproductsOfShape
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5F, part (2).** The direct image with compact support of a locally quasi-finite
morphism commutes with arbitrary direct sums of abelian étale sheaves.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekFunctor_preservesCoproductsOfShape (I : Type (max (u + 1) v)) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) (fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f)
declarations.comment: part (2), direct sums

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekStalkFunctorIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5F, part (1), as an isomorphism of functors.** The composite of the direct image
with compact support `f_!` with the stalk functor at a geometric point `ȳ` of `Y` is the
coproduct of the stalk functors of `X` at the geometric points lying over `ȳ`.
declarations.statement:
public def fShriekStalkFunctorIso (s : GeometricPoint Y.obj) :
    fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f ⋙ (geometricPointSitePoint B Y.obj Y.property s).sheafFiber
        (A := AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) ≅
      Adjunction.sigmaFamily (fun x : GeometricFiberPoint B f s =>
        (geometricPointSitePoint B X.obj X.property (x.toGeometricPoint B f s)).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}))
declarations.comment: part (1), stalk decomposition as an isomorphism of functors

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.OpenCoverShriek.cechComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5H.** The Čech complex of an open covering `X = ⋃_{i ∈ I} X_i` for the direct
image with compact support along a locally quasi-finite morphism `f : X ⟶ Y`: a complex

`… → ⊕_{i₀,i₁} f_{i₀i₁,!}((-)|_{X_{i₀i₁}}) → ⊕_{i₀} f_{i₀,!}((-)|_{X_{i₀}}) → f_!(-) → 0`

of functors on abelian sheaves on the small étale site of `X`, hence functorial in the sheaf.
declarations.statement: public def cechComplex : ChainComplex (ShriekCat.{u, v} B X Y) ℕ
declarations.comment: the complex, functorial in the abelian sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.OpenCoverShriek.cechComplexObj_acyclic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5H, exactness.** For a family of open subschemes covering `X`, the Čech complex
`⋯ ⟶ ⊕_{i₀} f_{i₀,!}(F|_{X_{i₀}}) ⟶ f_!F ⟶ 0` of an abelian sheaf `F` on the small étale site of
`X` is acyclic.
declarations.comment: exactness of the complex

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.OpenCoverShriek.exists_isSeparated_openCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5I.** A locally quasi-finite morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` admits an open covering
`X = ⋃_{i ∈ I} X_i` such that every restriction `f_{i₀…i_p} : X_{i₀…i_p} ⟶ Y` is separated: the
covering of `X` by its affine opens is one.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isSeparated_openCover :
    ∃ (J : Type (max (u + 1) v)) (V : J → (B.inclusion.obj X).Opens),
      (⨆ j, V j) = ⊤ ∧ (∀ j, IsAffineOpen (V j)) ∧
        ∀ {n : ℕ} (t : Fin (n + 1) → J),
          IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map (openSchemeι B (coverOpen B V t) ≫ f))
declarations.comment: the covering with every restriction separated, by affine opens

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.OpenCoverShriek.cechFamilyIsoProperSupport
declarations.doc:
