**Stacks 0F5I.** Along a covering by affine opens the term of the Čech complex at a tuple of
indices is the proper-support direct image of Section 0F4W: the restriction `f_{i₀…i_p}` is
separated, so the two models of the direct image with compact support agree on it by
Stacks 0F6N.
declarations.statement:
public def cechFamilyIsoProperSupport (hU : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) {n : ℕ}
    (t : Fin (n + 1) → I) :
    cechFamily.{u, v} B f U (n + 1) t ≅
      openRestriction.{u, v} B (openSchemeι B (coverOpen B U t)) ⋙
        properSupportFunctor.{u, max (u + 1) v} B (openSchemeι B (coverOpen B U t) ≫ f)
declarations.comment: each term is the construction of Section 0F4W, the restrictions being separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.OpenCoverShriek.cechComplexObj_isColimit_cokernel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5I.** For an open covering of `X` and an abelian sheaf `F` on the small étale site
of `X`, the sheaf `f_! F` is the cokernel of the penultimate differential of the Čech complex of
Stacks 0F5H:

`f_! F = Coker(⊕_{i₀,i₁} f_{i₀i₁,!} F|_{X_{i₀i₁}} ⟶ ⊕_{i₀} f_{i₀,!} F|_{X_{i₀}})`.
declarations.statement:
public def cechComplexObj_isColimit_cokernel (hU : (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    IsColimit (CokernelCofork.ofπ ((cechAugMap.{u, v} B f U 1).app F)
      ((cechComplexObj.{u, v} B f U F).d_comp_d 2 1 0))
declarations.comment: f_! F is the cokernel of the penultimate map of the complex of Stacks 0F5H

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.OpenCoverShriek.cechComplex_isColimit_cokernel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5I.** The alternative construction of the functor `f_!` for a locally quasi-finite
morphism: for an open covering of `X` the functor `f_!` is the cokernel, in the category of
functors on abelian sheaves of the small étale site of `X`, of the penultimate differential of the
Čech complex of Stacks 0F5H. Taking this cokernel as the definition of `f_!` therefore recovers
`f_!` together with its functoriality.
declarations.comment: the functor f_! is that cokernel, the alternative construction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberPointBaseChange_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** For a cartesian square, `p` induces a bijection from the geometric fibre
of `f'` over a geometric point `t` of `Y'` onto the geometric fibre of `f` over the image of
`t`: transitivity of fibre products identifies `X'_t` with `X_{g ∘ t}`.
declarations.comment: the bijection of geometric fibres induced by the horizontal morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberStalkBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The stalk of the inverse image `p⁻¹F` at a point `x` of the geometric
fibre of `f'` is the stalk of `F` at the corresponding point of the geometric fibre of `f`.
This is the right vertical arrow of the comparison square of Stacks 0F5J.
declarations.statement:
public def fiberStalkBaseChangeIso (sq : IsPullback p f' f g) (t : GeometricPoint Y'.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})
    (x : GeometricFiberPoint B f' t) :
    etaleStalk B X.obj X.property
        ((fiberPointBaseChange B p f' f g sq t x).toGeometricPoint B f
          (t.map (B.inclusion.map g))) F.obj ≅
      etaleStalk B X'.obj X'.property (x.toGeometricPoint B f' t)
        ((abPullback.{u, v} B p).obj F).obj
declarations.comment: the identification of the stalks over corresponding points of the fibres

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberStalksBaseChangeEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The direct sums of stalks over the two geometric fibres agree: the fibres
are in bijection through `p`, and over corresponding points the stalks of `F` and of `p⁻¹F`
agree.
declarations.statement:
public def fiberStalksBaseChangeEquiv (sq : IsPullback p f' f g) (t : GeometricPoint Y'.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    fiberStalks.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f (t.map (B.inclusion.map g)) F ≃+
      fiberStalks.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f' t ((abPullback.{u, v} B p).obj F)
declarations.comment: the comparison of the two direct sums of stalks over the geometric fibres

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberStalksBaseChangeEquiv_natural
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The comparison of the two direct sums of stalks is functorial in the
abelian sheaf: it intertwines the map induced on the direct sum of stalks over the geometric
fibre of `f` by a morphism of sheaves with the map induced over the geometric fibre of `f'` by
its inverse image.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fiberStalksBaseChangeEquiv_natural (sq : IsPullback p f' f g)
    (t : GeometricPoint Y'.obj)
    {F G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}}
    (φ : F ⟶ G) (w : fiberStalks.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f (t.map (B.inclusion.map g)) F) :
    fiberStalksBaseChangeEquiv B p f' f g sq t G
        (fiberStalksMap.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f (t.map (B.inclusion.map g)) φ w) =
      fiberStalksMap.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f' t ((abPullback.{u, v} B p).map φ)
        (fiberStalksBaseChangeEquiv B p f' f g sq t F w)
declarations.comment: functoriality in the sheaf of the comparison of the direct sums of stalks

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekStalkBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The base-change comparison on stalks: for a geometric point `t` of `Y'`
the stalk of `g⁻¹f_!F` at `t` is the stalk of `f'_!p⁻¹F` at `t`. It is obtained from the stalk
decompositions of Stacks 0F5F on both sides, the bijection of geometric fibres and the
identification of the stalks over corresponding points of the fibres, so it is compatible with
those decompositions by construction.
declarations.statement:
public def fShriekStalkBaseChangeIso (sq : IsPullback p f' f g) (t : GeometricPoint Y'.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    etaleStalk B Y'.obj Y'.property t
        ((abPullback.{u, v} B g).obj ((fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f).obj F)).obj ≅
      etaleStalk B Y'.obj Y'.property t
        ((fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f').obj ((abPullback.{u, v} B p).obj F)).obj
declarations.comment: the base-change isomorphism on the stalk at a geometric point of the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekStalkBaseChangeIso_comp_fShriekStalkIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The precise compatibility of the stalkwise base-change comparison with the
stalk decompositions of Stacks 0F5F: the square whose horizontal arrows are those
decompositions, whose left vertical arrow is the comparison preceded by the identification of
the stalk of an inverse image, and whose right vertical arrow is the summandwise comparison of
the two direct sums, commutes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekStalkBaseChangeIso_comp_fShriekStalkIso (sq : IsPullback p f' f g)
    (t : GeometricPoint Y'.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    (etaleStalkSmallEtalePullObjIso B g t AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}
          ((fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f).obj F)).inv ≫
        (fShriekStalkBaseChangeIso B p f' f g sq t F).hom ≫
        (fShriekStalkIso.{u, v} B f' t ((abPullback.{u, v} B p).obj F)).hom =
      (fShriekStalkIso.{u, v} B f (t.map (B.inclusion.map g)) F).hom ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          (fiberStalksBaseChangeEquiv B p f' f g sq t F).toAddMonoidHom
declarations.comment: compatibility of the stalkwise comparison with the decompositions of 0F5F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberStalkComponent_fiberBaseChangeSectionsMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The germ at a point of the geometric fibre of `f'` of the base change of a
supported section is the germ of the section at the corresponding point of the geometric fibre
of `f`, read through the identification of the two stalks. This is the commutative square of the
source, on a single summand of the stalk decompositions of Stacks 0F5F.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fiberStalkComponent_fiberBaseChangeSectionsMap
    (s : supportedSections B X.obj X.property F (baseChange B f V) E.1
      (finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed B f V E))
    (x : GeometricFiberPoint B f' t) :
    fiberStalkComponent.{u, u + 1} B f' t ((abPullback.{u, u + 1} B p).obj F)
        (baseChange B g V) (geometricPointFiberBaseChangeEquiv B g t V u)
        (fiberBaseChangeSupport B p f' f g sq V E)
        (fiberBaseChangeSectionsMap.{u, u + 1} B p f' f g sq V E F s) x =
      (fiberStalkBaseChangeIso.{u, u + 1} B p f' f g sq t F x).hom
        (fiberStalkComponent.{u, u + 1} B f (t.map (B.inclusion.map g)) F V u E s
          (fiberPointBaseChange B p f' f g sq t x))
declarations.comment: the germ of a base-changed supported section at a point of the geometric fibre

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberBaseChangeDiagramMap_comp_fiberStalkHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The germ decompositions of Stacks 0F5F on the two sides of the square are
exchanged by the base-change map on supported sections and the comparison of the direct sums of
stalks over the two geometric fibres.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fiberBaseChangeDiagramMap_comp_fiberStalkHom
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f')] :
    fiberBaseChangeDiagramMap.{u, u + 1} B p f' f g sq V F E ≫
        fiberStalkHom.{u, u + 1} B f' t ((abPullback.{u, u + 1} B p).obj F)
          (baseChange B g V) (geometricPointFiberBaseChangeEquiv B g t V u)
          (fiberBaseChangeSupport B p f' f g sq V E) =
      fiberStalkHom.{u, u + 1} B f (t.map (B.inclusion.map g)) F V u E ≫
        (AddEquiv.toAddCommGrpIso
          (fiberStalksBaseChangeEquiv.{u, u + 1} B p f' f g sq t F)).hom
declarations.comment: the germ decompositions exchanged by the base-change map on supported sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekBaseChangeMap_stalk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** On the stalk at a geometric point `t` of `Y'` the base-change map is the
base-change comparison of stalks: the identification of the stalk of an inverse image, the stalk
decomposition of Stacks 0F5F for `f`, and the comparison of the direct sums of stalks over the
two geometric fibres.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekBaseChangeMap_stalk :
    (etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B Y'.obj Y'.property t AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
          (fShriekBaseChangeMap.{u} B p f' f g sq F).hom ≫
        (fShriekStalkIso.{u, u + 1} B f' t ((abPullback.{u, u + 1} B p).obj F)).hom =
      (etaleStalkSmallEtalePullObjIso B g t AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          ((fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f).obj F)).hom ≫
        (fShriekStalkIso.{u, u + 1} B f (t.map (B.inclusion.map g)) F).hom ≫
        (AddEquiv.toAddCommGrpIso
          (fiberStalksBaseChangeEquiv.{u, u + 1} B p f' f g sq t F)).hom
declarations.comment: the base-change map on the stalk at a geometric point, through the 0F5F decompositions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekBaseChangeMap_stalk_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The base-change map is, on the stalk at a geometric point of `Y'`, the
base-change isomorphism of stalks of `StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.FShriekBaseChange`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekBaseChangeMap_stalk_eq :
    (etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B Y'.obj Y'.property t AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
        (fShriekBaseChangeMap.{u} B p f' f g sq F).hom =
      (fShriekStalkBaseChangeIso.{u, u + 1} B p f' f g sq t F).hom
declarations.comment: the stalk of the base-change map is the stalkwise base-change isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isIso_fShriekBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The base-change map `g⁻¹f_!F ⟶ f'_!(p⁻¹F)` is an isomorphism: it is an
isomorphism on the stalk at every geometric point of `Y'`, both sides becoming the direct sum of
the stalks of `F` over the geometric fibre, and a map of abelian étale sheaves which is an
isomorphism on every geometric stalk is an isomorphism, which is Stacks 03PU.
declarations.statement:
public instance isIso_fShriekBaseChangeMap :
    IsIso (fShriekBaseChangeMap.{u} B p f' f g sq F)
declarations.comment: the base-change map is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekBaseChangeNatIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** For a cartesian square with `f` locally quasi-finite there is an
isomorphism `g⁻¹f_!F ≅ f'_!(p⁻¹F)`, functorial in the abelian sheaf `F` on the small étale site
of `X`: the map `c` of the source, sheafified and transposed, which is an isomorphism because it
is one on every geometric stalk.
declarations.comment: the isomorphism g⁻¹f_!F ≅ f'_!(p⁻¹F), functorial in F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekBaseChangeNatIso_stalk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The base-change isomorphism agrees with the stalk descriptions of
Stacks 0F5F: on the stalk at a geometric point `t` of `Y'` it is the identification of the stalk
of an inverse image followed by the stalk decomposition of `f_!F` at the image point, the
comparison of the direct sums of stalks over the two geometric fibres, and the inverse of the
stalk decomposition of `f'_!(p⁻¹F)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekBaseChangeNatIso_stalk (t : GeometricPoint Y'.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    (etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B Y'.obj Y'.property t AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
          ((fShriekBaseChangeNatIso.{u} B p f' f g sq).hom.app F).hom ≫
        (fShriekStalkIso.{u, u + 1} B f' t ((abPullback.{u, u + 1} B p).obj F)).hom =
      (etaleStalkSmallEtalePullObjIso B g t AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          ((fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f).obj F)).hom ≫
        (fShriekStalkIso.{u, u + 1} B f (t.map (B.inclusion.map g)) F).hom ≫
        (AddEquiv.toAddCommGrpIso
          (fiberStalksBaseChangeEquiv.{u, u + 1} B p f' f g sq t F)).hom
declarations.comment: the isomorphism agrees with the stalk descriptions of 0F5F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_fShriekBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** For a cartesian square of a big étale site with `f` locally quasi-finite
there is an isomorphism `g⁻¹f_!F ≅ f'_!(p⁻¹F)`, functorial in `F` in the abelian sheaves on the
small étale site of `X`, which agrees with the stalk descriptions of Stacks 0F5F: on the stalk
at a geometric point `t` of `Y'` it is the identification of the stalk of an inverse image, the
stalk decomposition of `f_!F` at the image point, and the comparison of the direct sums of the
stalks over the two geometric fibres.

Only the hypotheses of the source are assumed: the finite-type and quasi-finiteness conditions
on the base change `f'` are supplied from the cartesian square.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_fShriekBaseChangeIso :
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isPullback B p f' f g sq
    letI := locallyQuasiFinite_of_isPullback B p f' f g sq
    ∃ e : fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f ⋙ abPullback.{u, u + 1} B g ≅
        abPullback.{u, u + 1} B p ⋙ fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f',
      ∀ (t : GeometricPoint Y'.obj)
        (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}),
        (etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B Y'.obj Y'.property t AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
              (e.hom.app F).hom ≫
            (fShriekStalkIso.{u, u + 1} B f' t ((abPullback.{u, u + 1} B p).obj F)).hom =
          (etaleStalkSmallEtalePullObjIso B g t AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
              ((fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f).obj F)).hom ≫
            (fShriekStalkIso.{u, u + 1} B f (t.map (B.inclusion.map g)) F).hom ≫
            (AddEquiv.toAddCommGrpIso
              (fiberStalksBaseChangeEquiv.{u, u + 1} B p f' f g sq t F)).hom
declarations.comment: the isomorphism, functorial in the sheaf and compatible with the 0F5F stalk descriptions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberBaseChangePresheafMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The map `c` of the proof: the map of abelian presheaves on the small étale
site of `Y` from the finite-support direct image `f_{p!}F` to the direct image along `g` of
`f'_!(p⁻¹F)`.
declarations.statement:
public def fiberBaseChangePresheafMap
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    (finiteSupportPushforward.{u, u + 1} B f (fun _ => inferInstance)).1.obj F ⟶
      (smallEtaleBaseChange B g).op ⋙
        ((fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f').obj ((abPullback.{u, u + 1} B p).obj F)).obj
declarations.comment: the map c of abelian presheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The base-change map `g⁻¹f_!F ⟶ f'_!(p⁻¹F)` of abelian sheaves on the small
étale site of `Y'`: the map `c` of the source, sheafified and transposed through the
inverse-image adjunction along `g`.
declarations.statement:
public def fShriekBaseChangeMap
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    (abPullback.{u, u + 1} B g).obj ((fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f).obj F) ⟶
      (fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f').obj ((abPullback.{u, u + 1} B p).obj F)
declarations.comment: the base-change map of sheaves, before it is shown to be an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekBaseChangeNatTrans
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The base-change map `g⁻¹f_!F ⟶ f'_!(p⁻¹F)` is functorial in `F`: it is a
morphism of functors on abelian sheaves on the small étale site of `X`.
declarations.comment: functoriality in the sheaf of the base-change map of sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberBaseChangeColimitMap_restriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The base-change map on finite-support sections is compatible with the
restriction maps of the finite-support direct image presheaves: restricting a section to a
smaller test object `V₁` of `Y` and then base changing it along the square is base changing it
and then restricting along `V'₁ ⟶ V'`. This is the naturality in `V` of the map `c` of the
source.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fiberBaseChangeColimitMap_restriction :
    finiteSupportBaseChangeHom B f F i ≫ fiberBaseChangeColimitMap B p f' f g sq V₁ F =
      fiberBaseChangeColimitMap B p f' f g sq V F ≫
        finiteSupportBaseChangeHom B f' ((abPullback.{u, v} B p).obj F)
          ((smallEtaleBaseChange B g).map i)
declarations.comment: naturality in the test object of the map c

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberBaseChangeSupport
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The base change of a support finite over `V` along the cartesian square:
the inverse image of the support under the comparison of the two étale base changes. It is
again a support finite over `V'`.
declarations.comment: the base change of a support finite over the test object

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberBaseChangeSectionsMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The pullback map on supported sections: a section of `F` supported on a
support `E` finite over `V` is carried by the unit of the inverse-image adjunction to a section
of `p⁻¹F` supported on the base change of `E`.
declarations.statement:
public def fiberBaseChangeSectionsMap (sq : IsPullback p f' f g)
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property) (E : FiniteSupport B f V)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    supportedSections B X.obj X.property F (baseChange B f V) E.1
        (finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed B f V E) →+
      supportedSections B X'.obj X'.property ((abPullback.{u, v} B p).obj F)
        (baseChange B f' (baseChange B g V)) (fiberBaseChangeSupport B p f' f g sq V E).1
        (finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed B f' (baseChange B g V)
          (fiberBaseChangeSupport B p f' f g sq V E))
declarations.comment: the pullback map H_Z(F) ⟶ H_{Z'}(p⁻¹F) on supported sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberBaseChangeSectionsMap_transition
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The pullback map on supported sections is compatible with the transition
maps of Stacks 0F6H: enlarging the support commutes with base change. This is what makes the
pullback maps a map out of the colimit defining `f_{p!}F`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fiberBaseChangeSectionsMap_transition (sq : IsPullback p f' f g)
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property) {E E₁ : FiniteSupport B f V} (hle : E ≤ E₁)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    (fiberBaseChangeSectionsMap B p f' f g sq V E₁ F).comp
        (supportedSectionsMap B X.obj X.property F (baseChange B f V) E.1 E₁.1
          (finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed B f V E) (finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed B f V E₁) hle
          (finiteSupport_closedWithin B f V E E₁ hle)) =
      (supportedSectionsMap B X'.obj X'.property ((abPullback.{u, v} B p).obj F)
          (baseChange B f' (baseChange B g V))
          (fiberBaseChangeSupport B p f' f g sq V E).1
          (fiberBaseChangeSupport B p f' f g sq V E₁).1
          (finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed B f' (baseChange B g V)
            (fiberBaseChangeSupport B p f' f g sq V E))
          (finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed B f' (baseChange B g V)
            (fiberBaseChangeSupport B p f' f g sq V E₁))
          (fiberBaseChangeSupport_mono B p f' f g sq V hle)
          (finiteSupport_closedWithin B f' (baseChange B g V)
            (fiberBaseChangeSupport B p f' f g sq V E)
            (fiberBaseChangeSupport B p f' f g sq V E₁)
            (fiberBaseChangeSupport_mono B p f' f g sq V hle))).comp
        (fiberBaseChangeSectionsMap B p f' f g sq V E F)
declarations.comment: compatibility of the pullback map with the transitions of the colimit

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberBaseChangeSectionsMap_sheafMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The pullback map on supported sections is functorial in the abelian
sheaf: a morphism of sheaves on `X` acts on the pullbacks through its inverse image.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fiberBaseChangeSectionsMap_sheafMap (sq : IsPullback p f' f g)
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property) (E : FiniteSupport B f V)
    {F G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}}
    (φ : F ⟶ G) :
    (fiberBaseChangeSectionsMap B p f' f g sq V E G).comp
        (supportedSectionsSheafMap B X.obj X.property φ (baseChange B f V) E.1
          (finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed B f V E)) =
      (supportedSectionsSheafMap B X'.obj X'.property ((abPullback.{u, v} B p).map φ)
          (baseChange B f' (baseChange B g V))
          (fiberBaseChangeSupport B p f' f g sq V E).1
          (finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed B f' (baseChange B g V)
            (fiberBaseChangeSupport B p f' f g sq V E))).comp
        (fiberBaseChangeSectionsMap B p f' f g sq V E F)
declarations.comment: functoriality in the sheaf of the pullback map on supported sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberBaseChangeColimitMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The base-change map on finite-support sections over an étale test object
`V` of `Y`: the generator of a support `Z` carrying a section `s` goes to the generator of the
base change of `Z` carrying the pullback of `s`. This is the map `c` of the source, over `V`.
declarations.statement:
public def fiberBaseChangeColimitMap (sq : IsPullback p f' f g)
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    finiteSupportSections B f F V ⟶
      finiteSupportSections B f' ((abPullback.{u, v} B p).obj F) (baseChange B g V)
declarations.comment: the map c on finite-support sections over a test object

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberBaseChangeColimitMap_natural
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5J.** The base-change map on finite-support sections over an étale test object
is functorial in the abelian sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fiberBaseChangeColimitMap_natural (sq : IsPullback p f' f g)
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
    {F G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}}
    (φ : F ⟶ G) :
    colim.map (finiteSupportDiagramMap B f φ V) ≫
        fiberBaseChangeColimitMap B p f' f g sq V G =
      fiberBaseChangeColimitMap B p f' f g sq V F ≫
        colim.map (finiteSupportDiagramMap B f' ((abPullback.{u, v} B p).map φ)
          (baseChange B g V))
declarations.comment: functoriality in the sheaf of the map c over a test object

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekDerivedAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5N.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a locally quasi-finite morphism. The direct image with
compact support `f_!` of Stacks 0F6R, which is exact and therefore induces a functor
`D(X_étale) ⥤ D(Y_étale)` on unbounded derived categories of abelian étale sheaves, is left
adjoint to any total right derived functor `Rf^! : D(Y_étale) ⥤ D(X_étale)` of the upper shriek
`f^!` of Stacks 0F59.
declarations.statement:
public def fShriekDerivedAdjunction
    (RfUpperShriek : DerivedCategory (AbelianSheaf.{u, v} B Y) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (AbelianSheaf.{u, v} B X))
    (β : (fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RfUpperShriek)
    [RfUpperShriek.IsRightDerivedFunctor β
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (AbelianSheaf.{u, v} B Y) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    (fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ RfUpperShriek
declarations.comment: abelian coefficients, the case Λ = ℤ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekRUpperShriekAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5N** for the chosen total right derived functor: `f_!` on unbounded derived
categories of abelian étale sheaves is left adjoint to `rUpperShriekFunctor`.
declarations.statement:
public def fShriekRUpperShriekAdjunction :
    (fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ rUpperShriekFunctor.{u, v, w} B f
declarations.comment: abelian coefficients, for the chosen total right derived functor of f^!

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.moduleFShriekDerivedAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5N** for a general coefficient ring. Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a locally quasi-finite
morphism and let `fShriekMod` be a `Λ`-linear lift of the direct image with compact support
`f_!` of Stacks 0F6R. The lift is then exact, so it induces a functor
`D(X_étale, Λ) ⥤ D(Y_étale, Λ)`, it has a right adjoint `f^!`, and that functor is left adjoint
to any total right derived functor `Rf^! : D(Y_étale, Λ) ⥤ D(X_étale, Λ)` of `f^!`.
declarations.statement:
public def moduleFShriekDerivedAdjunction (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)] [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (fShriekMod : ModuleSheaf.{u, v, r} B X Λ ⥤ ModuleSheaf.{u, v, r} B Y Λ)
    (hlift : fShriekMod ⋙ forgetModuleSheaf.{u, v, r} B Y Λ ≅
      forgetModuleSheaf.{u, v, r} B X Λ ⋙ fShriekFunctor.{u, max v r} B f)
    (RfUpperShriek : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, v, r} B Y Λ) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, v, r} B X Λ))
    (β : moduleUpperShriekQh.{u, v, w, r} B Λ f fShriekMod hlift ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RfUpperShriek)
    [RfUpperShriek.IsRightDerivedFunctor β
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleSheaf.{u, v, r} B Y Λ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    moduleFShriekDerivedFunctor.{u, v, w, r} B Λ f fShriekMod hlift ⊣ RfUpperShriek
declarations.comment: general coefficient ring Λ, from a Λ-linear lift of f_!

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.moduleFShriekRUpperShriekAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5N.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a locally quasi-finite morphism of schemes and let `Λ` be
a ring. The direct image with compact support `f_!` of Stacks 0F6R and the upper shriek `f^!` of
Stacks 0F59 induce adjoint functors `f_! : D(X_étale, Λ) ⟶ D(Y_étale, Λ)` and
`Rf^! : D(Y_étale, Λ) ⟶ D(X_étale, Λ)` on unbounded derived categories of étale sheaves of
`Λ`-modules.

The functor `f_!` with coefficients in `Λ` is `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekMod`; it is
exact and therefore needs no deriving, and `Rf^!` is the total right derived functor of the `f^!`
of Stacks 0F59 part (3).
declarations.statement:
public def moduleFShriekRUpperShriekAdjunction :
    moduleFShriekDerivedFunctor.{u, v, w, r} B Λ f (fShriekMod.{u, v, r} B Λ f)
        (fShriekModForgetIso.{u, v, r} B Λ f) ⊣
      moduleRUpperShriekFunctor.{u, v, w, r} B Λ f
declarations.comment: general coefficient ring Λ, for f_! and f^! themselves

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckAbelian.tensorObjPreadditiveCoyonedaObjAdjunction
registrations.comment: the left adjoint `- ⊗ G` of `Hom(G, -)` into right `End(G)`-modules

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.mono_homEquiv_symm_of_mono
declarations.doc:
Let `G` be a separator of a Grothendieck abelian category. If a map of
`(End G)ᵐᵒᵖ`-modules `f : M ⟶ Hom(G, A)` is a monomorphism, equivalently injective, then the
map `M ⊗ G ⟶ A` adjoint to it is a monomorphism as well.
declarations.statement:
theorem mono_homEquiv_symm_of_mono (G : C) (hG : IsSeparator G)
    {M : ModuleCat (End G)ᵐᵒᵖ} {A : C} (f : M ⟶ (preadditiveCoyonedaObj G).obj A) (hf : Mono f) :
    Mono (((tensorObjPreadditiveCoyonedaObjAdjunction G).homEquiv M A).symm f)

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.preadditiveCoyonedaObjFullyFaithful
declarations.doc:
Let `G` be a separator of a Grothendieck abelian category `C`. The embedding
`Hom(G, -) : C ⥤ Mod (End G)ᵐᵒᵖ` is fully faithful.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def preadditiveCoyonedaObjFullyFaithful (G : C) (hG : IsSeparator G) :
    (preadditiveCoyonedaObj G).FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: (2) for the constructed functor `Hom(G, -)`

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.preservesFiniteLimits_and_preservesFiniteColimits_tensorObj
declarations.doc:
Let `G` be a separator of a Grothendieck abelian category `C`. The left adjoint
`- ⊗ G : Mod (End G)ᵐᵒᵖ ⥤ C` of the embedding `Hom(G, -)` is exact: it preserves finite
limits, and it preserves finite colimits because it is a left adjoint.
declarations.statement:
theorem preservesFiniteLimits_and_preservesFiniteColimits_tensorObj (G : C)
    (hG : IsSeparator G) :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (tensorObj G) ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits (tensorObj G)
declarations.comment: (3) for the constructed functor `- ⊗ G`

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.gabriel_popescu
declarations.doc:
**The Gabriel--Popescu theorem.** For a Grothendieck abelian category `C` there is a
possibly noncommutative ring `R` together with functors `G : C ⥤ Mod R` and `F : Mod R ⥤ C`
such that `F` is left adjoint to `G`, `G` is fully faithful, and `F` is exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem gabriel_popescu (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} C] :
    ∃ (R : Type v) (_ : Ring R) (G : C ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} R) (F : ModuleCat.{v} R ⥤ C),
      Nonempty (F ⊣ G) ∧ G.Full ∧ G.Faithful ∧
        PreservesFiniteLimits F ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits F

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckAbelian.tensorObjPreadditiveCoyonedaObjAdjunction
registrations.comment: (1) for the constructed functors: `- ⊗ G` is left adjoint to `Hom(G, -)`

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.exists_derivedGabrielPopescuData
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F5V (Gabriel--Popescu on derived categories).** The
Gabriel--Popescu embedding of a Grothendieck abelian category admits a fully
faithful right derived functor.  Its left adjoint is induced by the exact
Gabriel--Popescu left adjoint, and the counit is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_derivedGabrielPopescuData (G : C) (hG : IsSeparator G) :
    Nonempty (DerivedGabrielPopescuData G hG)

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.isRepresentable_of_isHomological_of_isGrothendieckAbelian
declarations.doc:
**Brown representability for Grothendieck abelian categories**, with the Grothendieck
condition `IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} A` in the universe `v` of the morphisms of `A`: for a
Grothendieck abelian category `A`, a contravariant cohomological functor
`H : D(A)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}` which transforms direct sums indexed by `Type v` into products
is representable.

This is the statement of [Stacks, Tag 0F5X] for every ordinary Grothendieck abelian category,
e.g. `ModuleCat.{v} R`. The model of `D(A)` is arbitrary; in the model with morphisms in `Type v`
(which exists by `hasDerivedCategory_of_isGrothendieckAbelian`) the functors
`Hom(-, X) = preadditiveYoneda.obj X` themselves satisfy the hypotheses.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isRepresentable_of_isHomological_of_isGrothendieckAbelian (A : Type u)
    [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{z} A]
    (H : (DerivedCategory A)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}) [H.IsHomological]
    [∀ J : Type v, PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete J) H] :
    (H ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat).IsRepresentable
declarations.comment: Brown representability: a contravariant cohomological functor D(A) → Ab, A a Grothendieck abelian category, which transforms direct sums into products is representable

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.exists_exact_rightAdjoint_of_isGrothendieckAbelian
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0F5Y].** Let `A` be a Grothendieck abelian category and `D` a pretriangulated
category. An exact functor `F : D(A) ⥤ D` which transforms direct sums into direct sums, and whose
morphism groups `Hom(F W, Y)` are small, has an exact right adjoint: a functor `G`, an adjunction
`F ⊣ G`, and a commutation of `G` with the shift making `G` triangulated.

Here `A` is Grothendieck abelian relative to its morphism universe `v` and the direct sums are
indexed by `Type v`. The smallness of `Hom(F W, Y)` is the source's standing convention that
morphisms form sets, read at that universe. It is also necessary: if `F ⊣ G`, then
`Hom(F W, Y) ≃ Hom(W, G Y)`, and the derived category of `A` is locally `Type v`-small.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_exact_rightAdjoint_of_isGrothendieckAbelian
    (hsmall : ∀ (W : DerivedCategory A) (Y : D), Small.{v} (F.obj W ⟶ Y)) :
    ∃ (G : D ⥤ DerivedCategory A) (_ : F ⊣ G) (commShift : G.CommShift ℤ),
      letI := commShift
      G.IsTriangulated
declarations.comment: A Grothendieck abelian relative to its morphism universe v, direct sums indexed by Type v, Hom(F W, Y) Type v-small (the source's convention that morphisms form sets); D may be any pretriangulated category

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompactObjects.isCompactObject_jShriek_structureSheaf
declarations.doc:
Finite cohomological dimension and commutation of cohomology with direct sums make
`j_! 𝒪_U` compact in the unbounded derived category of `𝒪_X`-modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCompactObject_jShriek_structureSheaf
    (X : SheafedSpace.{u + 1, u, u} RingCat.{u}) (U : Opens X.carrier)
    (d : ℤ)
    (hvanish : ∀ (p : ℕ) (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (OXSh X)),
      d < (p : ℤ) →
        IsZero (((SheafOfModules.evaluation (OXSh X) (op U)).rightDerived p).obj M))
    (hsums : ∀ (p : ℕ) (I : Type u),
      PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)
        ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (OXSh X) (op U)).rightDerived p)) :
    IsCompactObject.{u}
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (OXSh X)) 0).obj
        ((jShriek00A7 X U).obj (SheafOfModules.unit (OUSh X U))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.bigSmallProetalePushforwardCommIso
declarations.doc: The square of small- and big-site morphisms commutes on direct images.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigSmallProetalePushforwardCommIso :
    (bigProetaleToSmallProetaleMorphism B T.obj T.property).pushforward ⋙
        (smallProetaleMorphism B T S f).pushforward ≅
      (bigProetaleMorphism B T S f).pushforward ⋙
        (bigProetaleToSmallProetaleMorphism B S.obj S.property).pushforward
declarations.comment: (f_big)_* F restricted to S_proet is (f_small)_* of F restricted to T_proet

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.smallProetaleBaseChangePushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
Restriction of a big pro-étale direct image to the small site of `S'`
agrees naturally with small direct image after restriction to `T'`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def smallProetaleBaseChangePushforwardIso
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    (bigProetaleMorphism B T S f).pushforward ⋙
      (smallProetaleToBigProetaleMorphism B S' S g).inverseImage ≅
    (smallProetaleToBigProetaleMorphism B T' T g').inverseImage ⋙
      (smallProetaleMorphism B T' S' f').pushforward
declarations.comment: small-site base change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.bigProetaleBaseChangePushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
Big pro-étale direct image commutes naturally with inverse image along
the horizontal arrows of a cartesian square.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigProetaleBaseChangePushforwardIso
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    (bigProetaleMorphism B T S f).pushforward ⋙
      (bigProetaleMorphism B S' S g).inverseImage ≅
    (bigProetaleMorphism B T' T g').inverseImage ⋙
      (bigProetaleMorphism B T' S' f').pushforward
declarations.comment: big-site base change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.bijective_toSheafify_app_of_isWeaklyContractible
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F63.** Let `S` be a scheme and let `ℱ` be a presheaf of sets on the small
pro-étale site of `S` which sends finite disjoint unions to products. Then the unit of
sheafification is bijective on sections over every affine weakly contractible object `W`, so
that `ℱ^#(W) = ℱ(W)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_toSheafify_app_of_isWeaklyContractible (F : S.ProEtᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1))
    (hF : GrothendieckTopology.SendsFiniteDisjointUnionsToProducts F) (W : S.ProEt)
    [IsAffine W.left] (hW : (ProEt.topology S).IsWeaklyContractible W) :
    Function.Bijective ((toSheafify (ProEt.topology S) F).app (op W))
declarations.comment: sheafification does not change sections over an affine weakly contractible object

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.ProetaleComparison.smallInverseImageColimitMap
declarations.doc:
The canonical comparison from `colim_{W ⟶ f^*V} F(V)`, the colimit over the morphisms from
`W` to a pro-étale object of `S` over `S`, to the sections of `f_{small}^{-1} F` over `W`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def smallInverseImageColimitMap
    (F : Sheaf (SmallProetale.topology B S.obj S.property) (Type (u + 1)))
    (W : SmallProetale B T.obj T.property) :
    colimit (CostructuredArrow.proj
      (smallProetaleBaseChange B T S f).op (op W) ⋙ F.obj) →
      ((smallProetaleMorphism B T S f).inverseImage.obj F).obj.obj (op W)
declarations.comment: the colimit and the canonical map to the inverse-image sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.ProetaleComparison.bijective_smallInverseImageColimitMap
declarations.doc:
For an affine weakly contractible object `W` of the small pro-étale site
of `T`, the sections of `f_{small}^{-1} F` over `W` are the colimit of the sections of `F` over
the pro-étale objects of `S` receiving a map from `W` over `S`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bijective_smallInverseImageColimitMap
    (F : Sheaf (SmallProetale.topology B S.obj S.property) (Type (u + 1)))
    (W : SmallProetale B T.obj T.property)
    [IsAffine ((SmallProetale.toScheme B T.obj T.property).obj W)]
    (hW : (SmallProetale.topology B T.obj T.property).IsWeaklyContractible W) :
    Function.Bijective (smallInverseImageColimitMap B T S f F W)
declarations.comment: the canonical map is a bijection at an affine weakly contractible object

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.bigProetaleInverseImage_sections_and_isSheafFor_fpqc
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme of a chosen big pro-étale site and let
`π_S : Sh((Sch/S)_proetale) → Sh(S_proetale)` be the projection of topoi. For a sheaf `F` on the
small pro-étale site of `S`:

* the value of `π_S⁻¹ F` at `f : T ⟶ S` is `Γ(T_proetale, f_small⁻¹ F)`, naturally in `F`;
* `π_S⁻¹ F` satisfies the sheaf condition with respect to every fpqc covering of the big
  pro-étale site over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bigProetaleInverseImage_sections_and_isSheafFor_fpqc (S : B.Scheme) :
    (∀ (T : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S),
      Nonempty ((bigProetaleToSmallProetaleMorphism B S.obj S.property).inverseImage ⋙
          (sheafSections (BigProetaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property)
            (Type (u + 1))).obj (op (Over.mk f)) ≅
        (smallProetaleMorphism B T S f).inverseImage ⋙
          Sheaf.Γ (SmallProetale.topology B T.obj T.property) (Type (u + 1)))) ∧
    ∀ (F : Sheaf (SmallProetale.topology B S.obj S.property) (Type (u + 1)))
      ⦃X : BigProetaleOver B S.obj S.property⦄ (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage.comap (BigProetaleOver.toScheme B S.obj S.property) X →
        Presieve.IsSheafFor
          ((bigProetaleToSmallProetaleMorphism B S.obj S.property).inverseImage.obj F).obj R

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.bigProetaleInverseImageSectionsIso
declarations.doc:
The value of `π_S⁻¹ F` at `f : T ⟶ S` is the space of global sections of
`f_small⁻¹ F` on the small pro-étale site of `T`, naturally in `F`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigProetaleInverseImageSectionsIso :
    (bigProetaleToSmallProetaleMorphism B S.obj S.property).inverseImage ⋙
      (sheafSections (BigProetaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (Type (u + 1))).obj (Opposite.op (Over.mk f)) ≅
    (smallProetaleMorphism B T S f).inverseImage ⋙
      Sheaf.Γ (SmallProetale.topology B T.obj T.property) (Type (u + 1))
declarations.comment: pullback_value

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.injective_smallProetaleInverseImage
declarations.doc:
Inverse image to the small pro-étale site of `T` preserves injective
abelian sheaves on the big pro-étale site over `S`.
declarations.statement:
public lemma injective_smallProetaleInverseImage
    (I : Sheaf (BigProetaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{w})
    [Injective I] :
    Injective (((smallProetaleToBigProetaleFunctor B T S f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      Ab.{w}
      (SmallProetale.topology B T.obj T.property)
      (BigProetaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property)).obj I)
declarations.comment: injective_pullback_t

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.injective_smallProetaleRestriction
declarations.doc:
Restricting an injective abelian sheaf from the big pro-étale site over `S`
to the small pro-étale site of `S` preserves injectivity.
declarations.statement:
public lemma injective_smallProetaleRestriction
    (I : Sheaf (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS) Ab.{w})
    [Injective I] :
    Injective (((SmallProetale.inclusion B S hS).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      Ab.{w}
      (SmallProetale.topology B S hS)
      (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS)).obj I)
declarations.comment: injective_restriction_s

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isKInjective_smallProetaleInverseImage
declarations.doc:
The inverse image of a K-injective complex of abelian sheaves from the big
pro-étale site over `S` to the small pro-étale site of `T` is K-injective.
declarations.statement:
public lemma isKInjective_smallProetaleInverseImage
    (I : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (BigProetaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) AddCommGrpCat.{w}) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] :
    CochainComplex.IsKInjective
      ((((smallProetaleToBigProetaleFunctor B T S f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{w}
        (SmallProetale.topology B T.obj T.property)
        (BigProetaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)
declarations.comment: kinjective_pullback_t

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isKInjective_smallProetaleRestriction
declarations.doc:
Restricting a K-injective complex from the big pro-étale site over `S`
to the small pro-étale site of `S` preserves K-injectivity.
declarations.statement:
public lemma isKInjective_smallProetaleRestriction
    (I : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] :
    CochainComplex.IsKInjective
      ((((SmallProetale.inclusion B S hS).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (SmallProetale.topology B S hS)
        (BigProetaleOver.topology B S hS)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)
declarations.comment: kinjective_restriction_s

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.bigSmallDerivedPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
Restricting the derived direct image along `f` on the big pro-étale sites to the small
pro-étale site of `S` is naturally isomorphic to taking the derived direct image along `f` on the
small pro-étale sites of the restriction to the small pro-étale site of `T`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigSmallDerivedPushforwardIso
    [HasDerivedCategory (BigAb B T)] [HasDerivedCategory (BigAb B S)]
    [HasDerivedCategory (SmallAb B T)] [HasDerivedCategory (SmallAb B S)]
    (Rbig : DerivedCategory (BigAb B T) ⥤ DerivedCategory (BigAb B S))
    (Rsmall : DerivedCategory (SmallAb B T) ⥤ DerivedCategory (SmallAb B S))
    (αbig : (bigPush B T S f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Q ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ Rbig)
    (αsmall : (smallPush B T S f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Q ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ Rsmall)
    [Rbig.IsRightDerivedFunctor αbig
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (BigAb B T) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rsmall.IsRightDerivedFunctor αsmall
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (SmallAb B T) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    Rbig ⋙ (restrict B S).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (restrict B T).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ Rsmall
declarations.comment: big_small_direct_image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.derivedBigPushforwardSmallBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
The derived big direct image restricted to the small site of `S'` agrees
naturally with small direct image after restriction to `T'`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def derivedBigPushforwardSmallBaseChangeIso
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (RFbig : DerivedCategory (BigAb B T) ⥤ DerivedCategory (BigAb B S))
    (αbig : (bigCocontPush B f).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RFbig)
    [RFbig.IsRightDerivedFunctor αbig
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (BigAb B T) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (RFsmall : DerivedCategory (SmallAb B T') ⥤ DerivedCategory (SmallAb B S'))
    (αsmall : (smallBaseChangePush B f').mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RFsmall)
    [RFsmall.IsRightDerivedFunctor αsmall
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SmallAb B T') (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    RFbig ⋙ (restriction g).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (restriction g').mapDerivedCategory ⋙ RFsmall
declarations.comment: base_changed_small_direct_image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.derivedBigPushforwardBigBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
The derived big direct image along `f`, pulled back to the big pro-étale site over `S'`,
agrees naturally with the derived big direct image along `f'` of the pullback to the big
pro-étale site over `T'`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def derivedBigPushforwardBigBaseChangeIso
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (RFbig : DerivedCategory (BigAb B T) ⥤ DerivedCategory (BigAb B S))
    (αbig : (bigCocontPush B f).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RFbig)
    [RFbig.IsRightDerivedFunctor αbig
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (BigAb B T) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (RFbig' : DerivedCategory (BigAb B T') ⥤ DerivedCategory (BigAb B S'))
    (αbig' : (bigCocontPush B f').mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RFbig')
    [RFbig'.IsRightDerivedFunctor αbig'
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (BigAb B T') (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    RFbig ⋙ (bigInverseImage B S' S g).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (bigInverseImage B T' T g').mapDerivedCategory ⋙ RFbig'
declarations.comment: base_changed_big_direct_image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.nonempty_derivedPushforward_bigSmall_baseChange_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F68.** Let `f : T ⟶ S` be a morphism of a big pro-étale site, `g : S' ⟶ S` an
object of the big pro-étale site of `S`, and `T'` the fibre product, with projections
`g' : T' ⟶ T` and `f' : T' ⟶ S'`. Then, naturally in `K` in `D((Sch/T)_proet)`,
* `(Rf_big,* K)|_{S_proet} ≅ Rf_small,* (K|_{T_proet})` in `D(S_proet)`,
* `i_g⁻¹ (Rf_big,* K) ≅ Rf'_small,* (i_g'⁻¹ K)` in `D(S'_proet)`, and
* `g_big⁻¹ (Rf_big,* K) ≅ Rf'_big,* (g'_big⁻¹ K)` in `D((Sch/S')_proet)`.

Each derived direct image is any right derived functor of the corresponding direct image of
abelian sheaves, given with its comparison transformation. The first equality is the second one
for the identity of `S`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_derivedPushforward_bigSmall_baseChange_iso
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (RFbig : DerivedCategory (BigAb B T) ⥤ DerivedCategory (BigAb B S))
    (αbig : (bigCocontPush B f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RFbig)
    [RFbig.IsRightDerivedFunctor αbig
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (BigAb B T) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (RFsmall : DerivedCategory (SmallAb B T) ⥤ DerivedCategory (SmallAb B S))
    (αsmall : (smallBaseChangePush B f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RFsmall)
    [RFsmall.IsRightDerivedFunctor αsmall
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SmallAb B T) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (RF'small : DerivedCategory (SmallAb B T') ⥤ DerivedCategory (SmallAb B S'))
    (α'small : (smallBaseChangePush B f').mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RF'small)
    [RF'small.IsRightDerivedFunctor α'small
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SmallAb B T') (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (RF'big : DerivedCategory (BigAb B T') ⥤ DerivedCategory (BigAb B S'))
    (α'big : (bigCocontPush B f').mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RF'big)
    [RF'big.IsRightDerivedFunctor α'big
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (BigAb B T') (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    Nonempty (RFbig ⋙ (restriction (𝟙 S)).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (restriction (𝟙 T)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ RFsmall) ∧
    Nonempty (RFbig ⋙ (restriction g).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (restriction g').mapDerivedCategory ⋙ RF'small) ∧
    Nonempty (RFbig ⋙ (bigInverseImage B S' S g).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (bigInverseImage B T' T g').mapDerivedCategory ⋙ RF'big)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.bigProetaleCohomology_inclusionInverseImage
declarations.doc:
The big pro-étale cohomology over `T` of the inverse image of `M` along `f` agrees with the
small pro-étale cohomology of `T` with coefficients in the restriction of `M` along `f`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigProetaleCohomology_inclusionInverseImage
    (M : DerivedCategory (BigAb B S)) (n : ℤ) :
    cohomology (BigProetaleOver.topology B T.obj T.property)
        ((bigInverseImage B T S f).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) n ≃+
      cohomology (SmallProetale.topology B T.obj T.property)
        ((inclusionInverseImage B T S f).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) n
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.bigProetaleCohomology_projectionInverseImage
declarations.doc:
Pulling a small-site complex back to the big site and then computing
cohomology over `T` agrees with its small-site pullback along `f`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigProetaleCohomology_projectionInverseImage
    (K : DerivedCategory (SmallAb B S)) (n : ℤ) :
    cohomology (BigProetaleOver.topology B T.obj T.property)
        ((bigInverseImage B T S f).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((projectionInverseImage B S).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)) n ≃+
      cohomology (SmallProetale.topology B T.obj T.property)
        ((smallInverseImage B T S f).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) n
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.bigProetaleCohomology_projectionInverseImage_self
declarations.doc:
The big pro-étale cohomology over `S` of the inverse image of a small pro-étale complex `K`
along the projection agrees with the small pro-étale cohomology of `K`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigProetaleCohomology_projectionInverseImage_self
    (K : DerivedCategory (SmallAb B S)) (n : ℤ) :
    cohomology (BigProetaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property)
        ((projectionInverseImage B S).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) n ≃+
      cohomology (SmallProetale.topology B S.obj S.property) K n
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.proetaleCohomologicalDescent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6A.** For a scheme `S` of a chosen big pro-étale site and a complex `K` of
abelian sheaves on the small pro-étale site of `S`, the canonical map
`K ⟶ Rπ_{S,*} π_S^{-1} K` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem proetaleCohomologicalDescent
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallProetale.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    IsIso ((derivedProjectionAdjunction B S hS).unit.app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_geometricPoint_lift_of_proetaleCover
declarations.doc: A geometric point of a scheme lifts to a member of any pro-étale covering family.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_geometricPoint_lift_of_proetaleCover
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (s : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricPoint S)
    {I : Type v} {X : I → Scheme.{u}} (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ S)
    (h : Presieve.ofArrows X f ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage S) :
    ∃ i, ∃ t : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricPoint (X i),
      t.map (f i) = s

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.pointFunctions_isSheaf
declarations.doc:
**The point functions form a sheaf.** The rule `U ↦ (|U| → A)` is a sheaf for the pro-étale
topology: it is the sheaf of continuous maps to `A` with the indiscrete topology, which is an
fpqc sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem pointFunctions_isSheaf (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type v) [AddCommGroup A] :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (pointFunctions.{u, v} X A)
declarations.comment: `fun(-, A)` is a sheaf on the pro-étale site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.mono_constantToPointFunctions
declarations.doc:
**The constant sheaf is a subsheaf of `fun(-, A)`**: the map `A ⟶ fun(-, A)` is a
monomorphism, which is exactness on the left of `0 → A → fun(-, A) → F → 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mono_constantToPointFunctions (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type v) [AddCommGroup A] :
    Mono (constantToPointFunctions.{u, v} X A)
declarations.comment: exactness on the left of `0 → A → fun(-, A) → F → 0`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.pointFunctionsShortComplex_shortExact
declarations.doc: **The sequence `0 → A → fun(-, A) → F → 0` is short exact.**
declarations.statement:
theorem pointFunctionsShortComplex_shortExact (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type v) [AddCommGroup A] :
    (pointFunctionsShortComplex X A).ShortExact
declarations.comment: the sequence `0 → A → fun(-, A) → F → 0` is exact

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.ker_pointFunctionsQuotientProjApp
declarations.doc:
**The kernel of `fun(U, A) ⟶ F(U)` is `A(U)`**, for every object `U` of the small pro-étale
site: sections are left exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem ker_pointFunctionsQuotientProjApp (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type v) [AddCommGroup A]
    (U : X.ProEt) :
    (pointFunctionsQuotientProjApp X A U).ker = (constantToPointFunctionsApp X A U).range
declarations.comment: the kernel of `fun(U, A) → F(U)` is `A(U)`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.constantSheafCompEpsilonInverseImageIsoConstantSheaf
declarations.doc:
**The constant sheaf is pulled back from the étale site: `A = ε⁻¹A`.** Both the constant
sheaf functor of the small pro-étale site and the constant sheaf functor of the small étale site
followed by `ε⁻¹` are left adjoint to taking sections over the final object `X ⟶ X`, that is,
both are the pullback from the final topos; the isomorphism is the comparison of these two left
adjoints, natural in the coefficient group.
declarations.comment: `A = ε⁻¹A`: the constant sheaf is pulled back from the étale site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.not_etalePullback_pointFunctionsSheaf
declarations.doc:
**`fun(-, A)` is not pulled back from the étale site.** If `X` is nonempty and `A` has more
than one element, `fun(-, A)` is not in the essential image of `ε⁻¹`.

A pulled back sheaf restricted to the fibre over a point `x` only sees continuous functions on the
fibres of its sections' domains with the discrete topology on `A`, since the fibres of étale
`X`-schemes over `x` are discrete; but there is a weakly étale `X`-scheme whose fibre over `x`
contains a Cantor set, on which not every function is continuous.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_etalePullback_pointFunctionsSheaf (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type v)
    [AddCommGroup A] (hX : Nonempty X) (hA : Nontrivial A) :
    ¬ (epsilonInverseImage.{u, v} X).essImage (pointFunctionsSheaf X A)
declarations.comment: if `A` has more than one element, `fun(-, A)` is not pulled back from the étale site (for `X` nonempty)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isClosed_singleton_of_proetale
declarations.doc:
**Closed points pass to weakly étale `X`-schemes.** If all points of `X` are closed, then all
points of every object `U` of the small pro-étale site of `X` are closed: over an affine open of
`X`, whose spectrum is then profinite, an affine open of `U` has profinite spectrum too.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosed_singleton_of_proetale (X : Scheme.{u})
    (hclosed : ∀ x : X, IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    (U : X.ProEt) (y : U.left) : IsClosed ({y} : Set U.left)
declarations.comment: if all points of `X` are closed, then all points of `U` are closed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isSepClosed_residueField_of_proetale
declarations.doc:
**Separably closed residue fields pass to weakly étale `X`-schemes.** If all residue fields
of `X` are separably closed, then so are all residue fields of every object `U` of the small
pro-étale site of `X`: the residue field extensions of a weakly étale morphism are separable
algebraic.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSepClosed_residueField_of_proetale (X : Scheme.{u})
    (hsep : ∀ x : X, IsSepClosed (X.residueField x))
    (U : X.ProEt) (y : U.left) : IsSepClosed (U.left.residueField y)
declarations.comment: if all residue fields of `X` are separably closed, then so are those of `U`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.subsingleton_etaleH_one_constantSheaf
declarations.doc:
**`H¹_étale(U, A) = 0`** for an affine object `U` of the small pro-étale site of a scheme `X`
all of whose points are closed with separably closed residue fields: the points of `U` are then
closed with separably closed residue fields, and étale cohomology in positive degrees vanishes on
such an affine scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem subsingleton_etaleH_one_constantSheaf (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type v) [AddCommGroup A]
    (hclosed : ∀ x : X, IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    (hsep : ∀ x : X, IsSepClosed (X.residueField x))
    (U : X.ProEt) [IsAffine U.left]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})] :
    Subsingleton (Sheaf.H.{w}
      ((constantSheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}).obj
        (pointFunctionsCoeff.{u} A)) 1)
declarations.comment: `H¹_étale(U, A) = 0` for affine `U`, when all points of `X` are closed with separably closed residue fields

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.subsingleton_proetaleH_one_constantSheaf
declarations.doc:
**`H¹_proétale(U, A) = 0`** for an affine object `U` of the small pro-étale site of a scheme
`X` all of whose points are closed with separably closed residue fields: by the comparison
`H^i(U_étale, ℱ) = H^i(U_proétale, ε⁻¹ℱ)` of étale and pro-étale cohomology on `U` (Stacks 099W
(1), `AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.epsilonInverseImageCompFunctorHIso`) and `A = ε⁻¹A`, it reduces
to `H¹_étale(U, A) = 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem subsingleton_proetaleH_one_constantSheaf (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type v) [AddCommGroup A]
    (hclosed : ∀ x : X, IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    (hsep : ∀ x : X, IsSepClosed (X.residueField x))
    (U : X.ProEt) [IsAffine U.left]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U.left) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})] :
    Subsingleton (Sheaf.H.{w}
      ((constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U.left) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}).obj
        (pointFunctionsCoeff.{u} A)) 1)
declarations.comment: `H¹_proétale(U, A) = 0` for affine `U`, when all points of `X` are closed with separably closed residue fields

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.surjective_pointFunctionsQuotientProjApp
declarations.doc:
**`fun(U, A) ⟶ F(U)` is surjective** for an affine object `U` of the small pro-étale site of
a scheme `X` all of whose points are closed with separably closed residue fields: the obstruction
lies in `H¹_proétale(U, A)`, which vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_pointFunctionsQuotientProjApp (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type v) [AddCommGroup A]
    (hclosed : ∀ x : X, IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    (hsep : ∀ x : X, IsSepClosed (X.residueField x))
    (U : X.ProEt) [IsAffine U.left] :
    Function.Surjective (pointFunctionsQuotientProjApp.{u, v} X A U)
declarations.comment: `F(U) = fun(U, A)/A(U)` for affine `U`: every section of `F` over `U` lifts to `fun(U, A)`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.pointFunctionsQuotientAppEquiv
declarations.doc:
**`F(U) = fun(U, A)/A(U)`** for an affine object `U` of the small pro-étale site of a scheme
`X` all of whose points are closed with separably closed residue fields: the projection
`fun(U, A) ⟶ F(U)` is surjective with kernel the constant sections `A(U)`.
declarations.statement:
def pointFunctionsQuotientAppEquiv (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type v) [AddCommGroup A]
    (hclosed : ∀ x : X, IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    (hsep : ∀ x : X, IsSepClosed (X.residueField x))
    (U : X.ProEt) [IsAffine U.left] :
    (U.left → ULift.{max (u + 1) v} A) ⧸ (constantToPointFunctionsApp.{u, v} X A U).range ≃+
      (pointFunctionsQuotient.{u, v} X A).obj.obj (op U)
declarations.comment: `F(U) = fun(U, A)/A(U)` for affine `U`, when all points of `X` are closed with separably closed residue fields

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.not_etalePullback_pointFunctionsQuotient
declarations.doc:
**`F` is not pulled back from the étale site.** If `X` is nonempty and `A` has more than one
element, the quotient `F = fun(-, A)/A` is not in the essential image of `ε⁻¹`: since
`Rε_*ε⁻¹ℱ = ℱ` for abelian sheaves `ℱ` on `X_étale` (Stacks 099V (1),
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isIso_unit_app_and_isZero_rightDerived_epsilonDirectImage`), the
essential image of `ε⁻¹` is closed under extensions, `A = ε⁻¹A`, and `fun(-, A)` is not in it.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_etalePullback_pointFunctionsQuotient (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type v)
    [AddCommGroup A] (hX : Nonempty X) (hA : Nontrivial A) :
    ¬ (epsilonInverseImage.{u, v} X).essImage (pointFunctionsQuotient X A)
declarations.comment: if `A` has more than one element, the quotient `F` is not pulled back from the étale site (for `X` nonempty)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isFiniteSupport_iff_exists_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6E, the footnote.** For a locally quasi-finite `f`, a subset of `X_V` is an
eligible support of the finite-support direct image — the range of an immersion finite over
`V` — exactly when it is the range of an immersion *proper* over `V`. The source states this as
"since `f` is locally quasi-finite, `Z → V` is finite if and only if it is proper".
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFiniteSupport_iff_exists_isProper
    [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map f)] (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
    (E : Set ((SmallEtale.toScheme B X.obj X.property).obj (baseChange B f V))) :
    IsFiniteSupport B f V E ↔
      ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u})
        (i : Z ⟶ (SmallEtale.toScheme B X.obj X.property).obj (baseChange B f V)),
        IsImmersion i ∧
          IsProper (i ≫ B.inclusion.map (pullback.fst V.obj.hom f)) ∧
          Set.range i.base = E
declarations.comment: the footnote: a support is finite over the base exactly when it is proper

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.FiniteSupport
registrations.comment: the eligible supports, locally closed and finite over the base

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.finiteSupport_closedWithin
registrations.comment: closedness of one eligible support in another

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.finiteSupportSections
registrations.comment: the group of finite-support sections, as a colimit of supported sections

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_finiteSupport_sum
registrations.comment: a finite-support section as a finite formal sum of supported sections

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.finiteSupportPresheaf
registrations.comment: the restriction maps, assembling the groups into a presheaf

registrations.comment: the finite-support direct image presheaf as a functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.supportedSectionsEquiv
declarations.doc:
The canonical bijection between sections supported on corresponding closed
subschemes of two étale neighborhoods.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def supportedSectionsEquiv
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (U U' : SmallEtale B S hS) (φ : U' ⟶ U)
    (Z' : Scheme.{u})
    (i : Z' ⟶ (SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).obj U')
    [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [IsClosedImmersion (i ≫ (SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).map φ)] :
    {s : F.obj.obj (op U) //
        supportSection B S hS F U s ⊆
          Set.range (i ≫ (SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).map φ).base} ≃
      {s' : F.obj.obj (op U') //
        supportSection B S hS F U' s' ⊆
          Set.range i.base}
declarations.comment: canonical bijection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.supportedSectionsEquiv_restrict
declarations.doc:
The canonical bijection is restriction on any étale test object on which
the inverse images of the two closed subsets coincide.
declarations.statement:
public theorem supportedSectionsEquiv_restrict
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (U U' : SmallEtale B S hS) (φ : U' ⟶ U)
    (Z' : Scheme.{u})
    (i : Z' ⟶ (SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).obj U')
    [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [IsClosedImmersion (i ≫ (SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).map φ)]
    (V : SmallEtale B S hS) (f : V ⟶ U')
    (h : Set.preimage ((SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).map (f ≫ φ)).base
        (Set.range (i ≫ (SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).map φ).base) =
      Set.preimage ((SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).map f).base
        (Set.range i.base))
    (s : {s : F.obj.obj (op U) //
      supportSection B S hS F U s ⊆
        Set.range (i ≫ (SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).map φ).base}) :
    F.obj.map f.op (supportedSectionsEquiv B S hS F U U' φ Z' i s).val =
      F.obj.map (f ≫ φ).op s.val
declarations.comment: restriction characterization

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.locallyClosedSupportEquiv
declarations.doc:
The canonical bijection of Tag 0F6G (merged into 0F6F), including its
abelian-group structure. Both opens contain the given support as a closed subset.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def locallyClosedSupportEquiv
    (W : SmallEtale B S hS) (Z : Set ((SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).obj W))
    (U V : ((SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).obj W).Opens)
    (hZU : Z ⊆ U) (hZV : Z ⊆ V)
    (hUc : IsClosed (U.ι.base ⁻¹' Z)) (hVc : IsClosed (V.ι.base ⁻¹' Z)) :
    supportedSectionsOnOpen B S hS F W Z U ≃+
      supportedSectionsOnOpen B S hS F W Z V
declarations.comment: locally closed support

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.locallyClosedSupportEquiv_restrict
declarations.doc: For nested opens the canonical identification is restriction.
declarations.statement:
public theorem locallyClosedSupportEquiv_restrict
    (W : SmallEtale B S hS) (Z : Set ((SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).obj W))
    (U V : ((SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).obj W).Opens)
    (hZU : Z ⊆ U) (hZV : Z ⊆ V)
    (hUc : IsClosed (U.ι.base ⁻¹' Z)) (hVc : IsClosed (V.ι.base ⁻¹' Z))
    (h : V ≤ U) (s : supportedSectionsOnOpen B S hS F W Z U) :
    (locallyClosedSupportEquiv B S hS F W Z U V hZU hZV hUc hVc s).val =
      F.obj.map (openObjectHomOfLE B S hS W h).op s.val
declarations.comment: locally closed support, restriction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.locallyClosedSupportEquiv
declarations.doc:
The canonical bijection of Tag 0F6G (merged into 0F6F), including its
abelian-group structure. Both opens contain the given support as a closed subset.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def locallyClosedSupportEquiv
    (W : SmallEtale B S hS) (Z : Set ((SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).obj W))
    (U V : ((SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).obj W).Opens)
    (hZU : Z ⊆ U) (hZV : Z ⊆ V)
    (hUc : IsClosed (U.ι.base ⁻¹' Z)) (hVc : IsClosed (V.ι.base ⁻¹' Z)) :
    supportedSectionsOnOpen B S hS F W Z U ≃+
      supportedSectionsOnOpen B S hS F W Z V
declarations.comment: the canonical bijection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.locallyClosedSupportEquiv_restrict
declarations.doc: For nested opens the canonical identification is restriction.
declarations.statement:
public theorem locallyClosedSupportEquiv_restrict
    (W : SmallEtale B S hS) (Z : Set ((SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).obj W))
    (U V : ((SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).obj W).Opens)
    (hZU : Z ⊆ U) (hZV : Z ⊆ V)
    (hUc : IsClosed (U.ι.base ⁻¹' Z)) (hVc : IsClosed (V.ι.base ⁻¹' Z))
    (h : V ≤ U) (s : supportedSectionsOnOpen B S hS F W Z U) :
    (locallyClosedSupportEquiv B S hS F W Z U V hZU hZV hUc hVc s).val =
      F.obj.map (openObjectHomOfLE B S hS W h).op s.val
declarations.comment: the canonical bijection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_finiteSupport_sum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6J.** Every section with finite support over `V` is a finite formal sum
`s = ∑ (Z_i, s_i)`, where each `Z_i` is a support finite over `V` and `s_i ∈ H_{Z_i}(F)`,
the pair `(Z_i, s_i)` standing for the image of `s_i` under the colimit inclusion at `Z_i`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finiteSupport_sum
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property) [Small.{v} (FiniteSupport B f V)]
    (s : ↥(finiteSupportSections B f F V)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (Z : Fin n → FiniteSupport B f V)
      (t : ∀ i, supportedSections B X.obj X.property F (baseChange B f V) (Z i).1
        (finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed B f V (Z i))),
      s = ∑ i, colimit.ι (finiteSupportDiagram B f F V) (Z i) (t i)
declarations.comment: the formal sum presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.FiniteSupport
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6M.** The partially ordered set of supports of `X_V` which are finite over
`V`.
declarations.statement: public abbrev FiniteSupport (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
declarations.comment: the index of the colimit

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed
declarations.doc:
The support of a subscheme finite over `V` is locally closed, so the group `H_Z(F)` of
Stacks 0F6F is defined for it.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
    (E : FiniteSupport B f V) : IsLocallyClosed E.1
declarations.comment: local closedness of the supports

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.finiteSupport_closedWithin
declarations.doc:
One support finite over `V` contained in another is closed in it. This is the relation
making the transition maps of Stacks 0F6F available on the index, and in the source it is the
observation that `Z → Z'` is a closed immersion because `Z → V` is finite and `Z' → V` is
separated.
declarations.comment: closedness of the transition inclusions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.finiteSupportDiagram
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6M.** The diagram `Z ↦ H_Z(F)` of supported sections over the supports finite
over `V`, with the transition maps of Stacks 0F6F along the inclusions.
declarations.statement:
public def finiteSupportDiagram
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property) :
    FiniteSupport B f V ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}
declarations.comment: the diagram of supported sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.finiteSupportSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6M.** The abelian group of sections with finite support over `V`, namely the
colimit of `H_Z(F)` over the supports finite over `V`.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev finiteSupportSections
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
    [Small.{v} (FiniteSupport B f V)] : AddCommGrpCat.{v}
declarations.comment: the colimit formula

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isFiniteSupport_preimage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6M.** The inverse image of a support finite over `V` along a morphism
`V' ⟶ V` of the small étale site of `Y` is a support finite over `V'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFiniteSupport_preimage {V V' : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property} (g : V' ⟶ V)
    (E : FiniteSupport B f V) :
    IsFiniteSupport B f V' (((SmallEtale.toScheme B X.obj X.property).map
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).map g)).base ⁻¹' E.1)
declarations.comment: base change of the supports

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.finiteSupportBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6M.** Base change of a support finite over `V` and of its supported sections
along a morphism `V' ⟶ V` of the small étale site of `Y`. The support is the set-theoretic
inverse image and the map on sections is restriction.
declarations.statement:
public def finiteSupportBaseChange
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    {V V' : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property} (g : V' ⟶ V)
    (E : FiniteSupport B f V) : FiniteSupportBaseChange B f F g E
declarations.comment: base change of supported sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.finiteSupportPresheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6M.** The abelian presheaf `V ↦ colim_Z H_Z(F)` on the small étale site of
`Y`, with base change of supports as its restriction maps.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev finiteSupportPresheaf
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (hsmall : ∀ V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property, Small.{v} (FiniteSupport B f V)) :
    (SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}
declarations.comment: the finite-support presheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.finiteSupportPushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6M.** The direct image with finite support, as a functor from abelian sheaves
on the small étale site of `X` to abelian presheaves on the small étale site of `Y`. Its
values are the colimits `colim_Z H_Z(F)` and both of its functorial actions are pinned down on
the colimit generators.
declarations.statement:
public def finiteSupportPushforward
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)] [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (hsmall : ∀ V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property, Small.{v} (FiniteSupport B f V)) :
    {P : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v} ⥤
        ((SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}) //
      FiniteSupportPushforwardSpec B f hsmall P}
declarations.comment: the finite-support direct image functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekFunctorIsoProperSupport
declarations.doc:
The two models of the direct image with compact support agree: the
sheafification of the finite-support direct image presheaf is the proper-support subsheaf of
the ordinary direct image.
declarations.statement:
public def fShriekFunctorIsoProperSupport [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map g)]
    [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map g)] :
    fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B g ≅ properSupportFunctor.{u, max (u + 1) v} B g
declarations.comment: functor comparison of the two models of f_!

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.finiteSupportPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
For a separated, locally finite type and locally quasi-finite morphism `f` of a big étale
site, the finite-support direct image presheaf `f_{p!}` of [Stacks, Tag 0F6M] is isomorphic to
the proper-support direct image `f_!` of [Stacks, Tag 0F4X], as functors from abelian
sheaves on the small étale site of `X` to abelian presheaves on the small étale site of `Y`. The
isomorphism is pinned down on the colimit generators: the generator of an eligible support
carrying a supported section goes to the section of `f_!F` which restricts to that section on
the canonical open of the support.
declarations.statement:
public def finiteSupportPushforwardIso (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map f)] :
    let hsmall : ∀ V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property,
      Small.{max u v} (FiniteSupport B f V) := fun _ => inferInstance
    let P := finiteSupportPushforward.{u, max u v} B f hsmall
    {e : P.val ≅ properSupportFunctor B f ⋙
        sheafToPresheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} //
      ∀ (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v})
        (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property) (E : FiniteSupport B f V)
        (s : supportedSections B X.obj X.property F (baseChange B f V) E.1
          (finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed B f V E)),
        letI := hsmall V
        (F.obj.map (openObjectι B X.obj X.property (baseChange B f V)
            (finiteSupportOpen B f V E)).op).hom
          ((colimit.ι (finiteSupportDiagram B f F V) E ≫
            eqToHom (P.property.obj_eq F V).symm ≫
            (e.hom.app F).app (op V) ≫
            (fShriekSubsheaf B f F).val.arrow.hom.app (op V)).hom s) = s.val}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.finiteSupportStalkFunctorIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6P.** For a locally quasi-finite morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` and a geometric point `ȳ`
of `Y`, functorially in the abelian sheaf `F` on the small étale site of `X`, the stalk at `ȳ` of
the finite-support direct image `f_{p!}F` is the direct sum of the stalks of `F` over the
geometric points of `X` lying over `ȳ`: `(f_{p!}F)_ȳ ≅ ⊕_{f(x̄) = ȳ} F_x̄`. The component at `F`
is `finiteSupportStalkIso`.
declarations.statement:
public def finiteSupportStalkFunctorIso :
    (finiteSupportPushforward B f hsmall).1 ⋙
        etaleStalkPresheafFunctor B Y.obj Y.property s AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} ≅
      fiberStalksFunctor.{u, v} B f s
declarations.comment: the germ decomposition as an isomorphism of functors on `Ab(X_étale)`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.surjective_finiteSupportStalkToFiberStalks
declarations.doc:
**The surjectivity half of Stacks 0F6P.** The germ decomposition map
`(f_{p!}F)_ȳ ⟶ ⊕_{f(x̄) = ȳ} F_x̄` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem surjective_finiteSupportStalkToFiberStalks
