    (hsmall : ∀ V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property, Small.{max u v} (FiniteSupport B f V)) :
    Function.Surjective (finiteSupportStalkToFiberStalks B f s F hsmall)
declarations.comment: surjectivity of the germ decomposition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.injective_finiteSupportStalkToFiberStalks
declarations.doc:
**The injectivity half of Stacks 0F6P.** The germ decomposition map
`(f_{p!}F)_ȳ ⟶ ⊕_{f(x̄) = ȳ} F_x̄` is injective.

An element of the stalk is a finite sum of germs of supported sections over one étale
neighbourhood of `ȳ`, and such a sum of germs vanishes as soon as the family of germ
decompositions does.
declarations.statement:
public theorem injective_finiteSupportStalkToFiberStalks :
    Function.Injective (finiteSupportStalkToFiberStalks B f s F hsmall)
declarations.comment: injectivity of the germ decomposition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.finiteSupportStalkIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6P.** For a locally quasi-finite morphism `f : X ⟶ Y`, the stalk of the
finite-support direct image `f_{p!}F` at a geometric point `ȳ` of `Y` is the direct sum of the
stalks of `F` over the geometric points of `X` lying over `ȳ`:
`(f_{p!}F)_ȳ ≅ ⊕_{f(x̄) = ȳ} F_x̄`.
declarations.comment: the germ decomposition is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.etaleExtensionToFiniteSupport
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6Q.** The canonical map `j_{p!} ⟶ f_{p!}` from the presheaf extension by zero
along the étale morphism `U ⟶ X` to the finite-support direct image presheaf, natural in the
abelian sheaf on the small étale site of `U`. It is the map the universal property of the left
Kan extension produces from the graph generators.
declarations.statement:
public def etaleExtensionToFiniteSupport :
    abelianPresheafExtensionByZero B X hX U ⟶ etaleFiniteSupportPresheaf B X hX U
declarations.comment: canonical natural presheaf map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.etaleExtensionToFiniteSupport_on_graph
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6Q.** The value of the canonical map on a generator of the presheaf extension
by zero: the section of `F` over an étale object `W → U`, viewed in the summand of `j_{p!}F`
over `W` indexed by `W ⟶ U`, goes to the colimit generator of `colim_Z H_Z(F)` at the graph of
`W → U`, carrying the section supported on that graph. Naturality of the comparison then
extends the formula to every lift `V ⟶ U` of an arbitrary étale test object `V ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem etaleExtensionToFiniteSupport_on_graph
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (W : SmallEtale B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property) (s : F.obj.obj (op W)) :
    ((etaleExtensionToFiniteSupport B X hX U).app F).app
        (op ((smallEtalePostcompose B X hX U).obj W))
        (((smallEtalePostcompose B X hX U).op.lanUnit.app F.obj).app (op W) s) =
      colimit.ι (finiteSupportDiagram B U.obj.hom F ((smallEtalePostcompose B X hX U).obj W))
        (etaleGraphFiniteSupport B X hX U W) (etaleGraphSection B X hX U F W s)
declarations.comment: graph-support formula on generators

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.graphSupportedSection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6Q, the graph supports.** For an étale object `W → U` the graph of `W → U` is
an open immersion `W ⟶ U ×_X W` whose image is a support finite over `W`, and a section of an
abelian sheaf over `W` is a section supported on that graph.
declarations.statement:
public def graphSupportedSection (W : SmallEtale B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property) :
    GraphSupportedSectionData B X hX U W
declarations.comment: graph supports

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.etaleExtensionToFiniteSupport_sheafify_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6Q.** The canonical map `j_{p!}F ⟶ f_{p!}F` becomes an isomorphism after
sheafification: it is an isomorphism on every geometric stalk, both sides becoming the direct
sum of the stalks of `F` over the geometric fibre, and a map of abelian étale sheaves which is
an isomorphism on every geometric stalk is an isomorphism. So the sheaf `j_!F = (j_{p!}F)^#` of
Stacks 03S3 is identified with `(f_{p!}F)^#`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem etaleExtensionToFiniteSupport_sheafify_isIso
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    IsIso ((presheafToSheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X hX) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
      ((etaleExtensionToFiniteSupport B X hX U).app F))
declarations.comment: isomorphism after sheafification

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6R.** The direct image with compact support `f_!` of a locally quasi-finite
morphism, on abelian sheaves on the small étale sites: the sheafification of the finite-support
direct image presheaf `f_{p!}` of Stacks 0F6M.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.OpenCoverShriek.shriekLE
declarations.doc:
**The Čech face map.** For an inclusion `V ≤ W` of open subschemes of `X`, the covariance map
`(j_V ≫ f)_!((-)|_V) ⟶ (j_W ≫ f)_!((-)|_W)` of Stacks 0F6S for the open immersion `V ⟶ W`.
declarations.comment: covariance along an inclusion of opens of the source

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.ofHom_of_comp_fShriekStalkIso_openCovariance
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6S, part (1)**, on the stalk decompositions of Stacks 0F5F: on the direct sums of
stalks over the geometric fibres the covariance map of the direct images with compact support is
extension by zero along the inclusion of geometric fibres, so it carries the summand of a point of
the geometric fibre of `j ≫ f` to the summand of its image in the geometric fibre of `f`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem ofHom_of_comp_fShriekStalkIso_openCovariance
    [DecidableEq (GeometricFiberPoint B (j ≫ f) s)]
    [DecidableEq (GeometricFiberPoint B f s)] (y : GeometricFiberPoint B (j ≫ f) s) :
    AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (DirectSum.of (fun y' : GeometricFiberPoint B (j ≫ f) s =>
          ↑(etaleStalk B X'.obj X'.property (y'.toGeometricPoint B (j ≫ f) s)
            ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F).obj)) y) ≫
        (fShriekStalkIso.{u, v} B (j ≫ f) s ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F)).inv ≫
        ((geometricPointSitePoint B Y.obj Y.property s).sheafFiber
            (A := AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})).map
          ((openCovarianceShriekMap.{u, v} B j f).app F) ≫
        (fShriekStalkIso.{u, v} B f s F).hom =
      (openFiberStalkIso.{u, v} B j f F s y).hom ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (DirectSum.of (fun x : GeometricFiberPoint B f s =>
          ↑(etaleStalk B X.obj X.property (x.toGeometricPoint B f s) F.obj))
            (openFiberPoint B j f s y))
declarations.comment: part (1), stalk compatibility on the stalk decomposition of Stacks 0F5F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.openCovariancePresheafMap
declarations.doc:
The canonical covariance map of finite-support direct-image presheaves for an open
subscheme of the source. Its generator formula and the canonical extension of supported
sections are part of the construction; naturality in the test object and in the abelian sheaf
is part of its being a natural transformation of functors.
declarations.comment: covariance, presheaf map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.openCovarianceShriekMap
declarations.doc:
Sheafifying the canonical presheaf map gives covariance of the direct image with compact
support under an open immersion of the source.
declarations.statement:
public def openCovarianceShriekMap :
    openShriekPushforward.{u, v} B j f ⟶ fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f
declarations.comment: covariance

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.mono_openCovarianceShriekMap_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6S, part (4), for a separated morphism.** The covariance map of the direct images
with compact support attached to an open subscheme of the source is a monomorphism: it is the
sheafification of the presheaf covariance map, and sheafification of abelian sheaves is left
exact.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mono_openCovarianceShriekMap_app :
    Mono ((openCovarianceShriekMap.{u, v} B j f).app F)
declarations.comment: part (4), injectivity for a separated morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.openCovariancePresheafMap_comp_finiteSupportPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6S, part (2).** For a separated morphism the covariance map of finite-support
direct-image presheaves attached to an open subscheme of the source is the extension by zero of
Stacks 0F53, transported along the isomorphism of Stacks 0F6N.
declarations.statement:
public theorem openCovariancePresheafMap_comp_finiteSupportPushforwardIso :
    (openCovariancePresheafMap.{u, v} B j f).val.app F ≫
        (finiteSupportPushforwardIso.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f).val.hom.app F =
      (finiteSupportPushforwardIso.{u, max (u + 1) v} B (j ≫ f)).val.hom.app
          ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F) ≫
        (openInclusionShriekMap.{u, max (u + 1) v} B j f F).val.hom
declarations.comment: part (2), agreement with the map of Stacks 0F53 through Stacks 0F6N

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberStalkComponent_covarianceSectionMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F6S part (1)** on a colimit generator, in a summand indexed by a point
of the geometric fibre of `j ≫ f`: the germ of the extended section at the image point is the
germ of the original section, read through the identification of the two stalks.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fiberStalkComponent_covarianceSectionMap
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)] [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
    (u : (geometricPointFiber B Y.obj Y.property s).obj V)
    (E : FiniteSupport B (j ≫ f) V)
    (a : supportedSections B X'.obj X'.property ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F)
      (baseChange B (j ≫ f) V) E.1 (finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed B (j ≫ f) V E))
    (x : GeometricFiberPoint B (j ≫ f) s) :
    fiberStalkComponent.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f s F V u (imageFiniteSupport B j f V E)
        (covarianceSectionMap B j f F V E _ (imageFiniteSupport_coe B j f V E) a)
        (openFiberPoint B j f s x) =
      (openFiberStalkIso.{u, v} B j f F s x).hom
        (fiberStalkComponent.{u, max (u + 1) v} B (j ≫ f) s
          ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F) V u E a x)
declarations.comment: part (1), stalk compatibility on a generator, summand in the open

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberStalkComponent_covarianceSectionMap_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F6S part (1)** on a colimit generator, in a summand outside the image
of the geometric fibre of `j ≫ f`: the germ of the extended section vanishes there, the extended
section being supported on the image of the original support.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fiberStalkComponent_covarianceSectionMap_eq_zero
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
    (u : (geometricPointFiber B Y.obj Y.property s).obj V)
    (E : FiniteSupport B (j ≫ f) V) (D : FiniteSupport B f V)
    (hD : D.1 = (openBaseChangeHom B j f V).base '' E.1)
    (a : supportedSections B X'.obj X'.property ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F)
      (baseChange B (j ≫ f) V) E.1 (finiteSupport_isLocallyClosed B (j ≫ f) V E))
    (y : GeometricFiberPoint B f s)
    (hy : ∀ x : GeometricFiberPoint B (j ≫ f) s, openFiberPoint B j f s x ≠ y) :
    fiberStalkComponent.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f s F V u D
      (covarianceSectionMap B j f F V E D hD a) y = 0
declarations.comment: part (1), stalk compatibility on a generator, summand outside the open

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberStalks_openCovarianceStalkMap_openFiberPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F6S part (1)** for the finite-support direct-image presheaves, in a
summand indexed by a point of the geometric fibre of `j ≫ f`: on the stalk decompositions of
Stacks 0F6P the covariance map of Stacks 0F6S carries the summand at a point of the geometric
fibre of `j ≫ f` to the summand at its image, through the identification of the two stalks.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fiberStalks_openCovarianceStalkMap_openFiberPoint
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
    (w : (geometricPointFiber B Y.obj Y.property s).obj V) (E : FiniteSupport B (j ≫ f) V)
    (a : (finiteSupportDiagram B (j ≫ f) ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F) V).obj E)
    (x : GeometricFiberPoint B (j ≫ f) s) :
    ((finiteSupportStalkIso.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f s F (fun _ => inferInstance)).hom
          ((openCovarianceStalkMap.{u, v} B j f F s)
            (finiteSupportStalkGenerator.{u, v} B (j ≫ f)
              ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F) s
              (Functor.elementsMk (geometricPointFiber B Y.obj Y.property s) V w) E a)) :
        fiberStalks.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f s F) (openFiberPoint B j f s x) =
      (openFiberStalkIso.{u, v} B j f F s x).hom
        (((finiteSupportStalkIso.{u, max (u + 1) v} B (j ≫ f) s
              ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F) (fun _ => inferInstance)).hom
            (finiteSupportStalkGenerator.{u, v} B (j ≫ f)
              ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F) s
              (Functor.elementsMk (geometricPointFiber B Y.obj Y.property s) V w) E a) :
          fiberStalks.{u, max (u + 1) v} B (j ≫ f) s
            ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F)) x)
declarations.comment: part (1), stalk compatibility, presheaf form, summands in the open

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberStalks_openCovarianceStalkMap_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F6S part (1)** for the finite-support direct-image presheaves, in a
summand outside the image of the geometric fibre of `j ≫ f`: on the stalk decompositions of
Stacks 0F6P the covariance map of Stacks 0F6S has vanishing component there. Together with the
previous theorem this says that on the stalk at `s` the covariance map is the extension by zero
along the inclusion of geometric fibres.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fiberStalks_openCovarianceStalkMap_eq_zero
    (V : SmallEtale B Y.obj Y.property)
    (w : (geometricPointFiber B Y.obj Y.property s).obj V) (E : FiniteSupport B (j ≫ f) V)
    (a : (finiteSupportDiagram B (j ≫ f) ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F) V).obj E)
    (y : GeometricFiberPoint B f s)
    (hy : ∀ x : GeometricFiberPoint B (j ≫ f) s, openFiberPoint B j f s x ≠ y) :
    ((finiteSupportStalkIso.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f s F (fun _ => inferInstance)).hom
        ((openCovarianceStalkMap.{u, v} B j f F s)
          (finiteSupportStalkGenerator.{u, v} B (j ≫ f)
            ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F) s
            (Functor.elementsMk (geometricPointFiber B Y.obj Y.property s) V w) E a)) :
      fiberStalks.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f s F) y = 0
declarations.comment: part (1), stalk compatibility, presheaf form, summands outside the open

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberStalks_openCovarianceStalkMap_apply
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6S, part (1)** on an arbitrary element of the stalk: on the stalk decompositions of
Stacks 0F6P the covariance map carries the component at a point of the geometric fibre of `j ≫ f`
to the component at its image, through the identification of the two stalks.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fiberStalks_openCovarianceStalkMap_apply
    (z : ↑(etaleStalk B Y.obj Y.property s
      ((finiteSupportPushforward.{u, max (u + 1) v} B (j ≫ f)
        (fun _ => inferInstance)).val.obj ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F))))
    (x : GeometricFiberPoint B (j ≫ f) s) :
    ((finiteSupportStalkIso.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f s F (fun _ => inferInstance)).hom
          ((openCovarianceStalkMap.{u, v} B j f F s) z) :
        fiberStalks.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f s F) (openFiberPoint B j f s x) =
      (openFiberStalkIso.{u, v} B j f F s x).hom
        (((finiteSupportStalkIso.{u, max (u + 1) v} B (j ≫ f) s
              ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F) (fun _ => inferInstance)).hom z :
          fiberStalks.{u, max (u + 1) v} B (j ≫ f) s
            ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F)) x)
declarations.comment: part (1), stalk compatibility, presheaf form, summands in the open, any element

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fiberStalks_openCovarianceStalkMap_apply_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6S, part (1)** on an arbitrary element of the stalk, in a summand outside the image
of the geometric fibre of `j ≫ f`: the component of the image vanishes there.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fiberStalks_openCovarianceStalkMap_apply_eq_zero
    (z : ↑(etaleStalk B Y.obj Y.property s
      ((finiteSupportPushforward.{u, max (u + 1) v} B (j ≫ f)
        (fun _ => inferInstance)).val.obj ((openRestriction.{u, v} B j).obj F))))
    (y : GeometricFiberPoint B f s)
    (hy : ∀ x : GeometricFiberPoint B (j ≫ f) s, openFiberPoint B j f s x ≠ y) :
    ((finiteSupportStalkIso.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f s F (fun _ => inferInstance)).hom
        ((openCovarianceStalkMap.{u, v} B j f F s) z) :
      fiberStalks.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f s F) y = 0
declarations.comment: part (1), stalk compatibility, presheaf form, summands outside, any element

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.mono_openCovarianceShriekMap_app_general
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F6S, part (4)**, in its unrestricted form: for an open immersion
`j : X' ⟶ X` and a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` locally of finite type and locally quasi-finite, with no
separatedness assumed, the covariance map `(j ≫ f)_!(F|_{X'}) ⟶ f_!F` of the direct images with
compact support is a monomorphism.

On the stalk at a geometric point the map is extension by zero along the inclusion of geometric
fibres of Stacks 0F6P, hence injective; the stalks at the geometric points jointly detect
monomorphisms of abelian sheaves on the small étale site.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mono_openCovarianceShriekMap_app_general :
    Mono ((openCovarianceShriekMap.{u, v} B j f).app F)
declarations.comment: part (4), injectivity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.openCovariancePresheafMap_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6S, part (3).** Transitivity of covariance for the finite-support direct-image
presheaves: for nested open subschemes of the source, the covariance map of the composite open
immersion is the composite of the two covariance maps, once the two descriptions of restriction
to the smallest open subscheme are identified.
declarations.statement:
public theorem openCovariancePresheafMap_comp :
    (openFiniteSupportCompIso.{u, v} B j k f).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (openRestriction.{u, v} B k)
          (openCovariancePresheafMap.{u, v} B j (k ≫ f)).val ≫
        (openCovariancePresheafMap.{u, v} B k f).val =
      (openCovariancePresheafMap.{u, v} B (j ≫ k) f).val
declarations.comment: part (3), transitivity, presheaf form

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.openCovarianceShriekMap_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6S, part (3).** Transitivity of covariance after sheafification: for nested open
subschemes of the source, the covariance map of the direct image with compact support along the
composite open immersion is the composite of the two covariance maps.
declarations.statement:
public theorem openCovarianceShriekMap_comp :
    (openShriekCompIso.{u, v} B j k f).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (openRestriction.{u, v} B k)
          (openCovarianceShriekMap.{u, v} B j (k ≫ f)) ≫
        openCovarianceShriekMap.{u, v} B k f =
      openCovarianceShriekMap.{u, v} B (j ≫ k) f
declarations.comment: part (3), transitivity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekCompIso_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6T, part (5).** For a diagram with both squares cartesian
```
X' --c--> X
|f'       |f
Y' --b--> Y
|g'       |g
Z' --a--> Z
```
and `f`, `g` locally quasi-finite, the composition isomorphisms and the base-change isomorphisms
of Stacks 0F5J make the diagram
```
a⁻¹(g ∘ f)_! ----------------> (g' ∘ f')_! c⁻¹
     |                                |
a⁻¹ g_! f_! --> g'_! b⁻¹ f_! --> g'_! f'_! c⁻¹
```
commute. The base changes `f'` and `g'` are locally quasi-finite because `f` and `g` are.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekCompIso_baseChange :
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isPullback B c f' f b sq₁
    letI := locallyQuasiFinite_of_isPullback B c f' f b sq₁
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isPullback B b g' g a sq₂
    letI := locallyQuasiFinite_of_isPullback B b g' g a sq₂
    (fShriekBaseChangeNatIso.{u} B c (f' ≫ g') (f ≫ g) a (sq₁.paste_vert sq₂)).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (abPullback.{u, u + 1} B c) (fShriekCompIso.{u, u + 1} B f' g').hom =
      Functor.whiskerRight (fShriekCompIso.{u, u + 1} B f g).hom (abPullback.{u, u + 1} B a) ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f)
          (fShriekBaseChangeNatIso.{u} B b g' g a sq₂).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (fShriekBaseChangeNatIso.{u} B c f' f b sq₁).hom
          (fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B g')
declarations.comment: part (5)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekCompIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6T.** For composable locally quasi-finite morphisms `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z`
there is a canonical isomorphism of functors `(g ∘ f)_! ≅ g_! ∘ f_!` on abelian étale sheaves:
the comparison of `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compShriekMap`, glued from the comparisons on the
inverse images of the affine opens of `Y`, natural in the sheaf and an isomorphism on every
geometric stalk.
declarations.statement:
public def fShriekCompIso :
    fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B (f ≫ g) ≅ fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f ⋙ fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B g
declarations.comment: the canonical isomorphism (g ∘ f)_! ≅ g_! ∘ f_!

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekCompIso_stalk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6T, part (3).** At a geometric point `z̄` of `Z`, the isomorphism
`((g ∘ f)_!F)_z̄ ≅ (g_!f_!F)_z̄` followed by the stalk decomposition
`(g_!f_!F)_z̄ = ⊕_{g(ȳ) = z̄} (f_!F)_ȳ` of Stacks 0F5F is the stalk decomposition
`((g ∘ f)_!F)_z̄ = ⊕_{g(f(x̄)) = z̄} F_x̄` followed by the regrouping of the geometric fibre of
`g ∘ f` over the one of `g`, each `F_x̄` being placed in `(f_!F)_{f(x̄)} = ⊕_{f(x̄') = f(x̄)} F_x̄'`
through the decomposition of Stacks 0F5F for `f`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekCompIso_stalk (s : GeometricPoint Z.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    ((geometricPointSitePoint B Z.obj Z.property s).sheafFiber
        (A := AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})).map ((fShriekCompIso B f g).hom.app F) ≫
      (fShriekStalkIso.{u, v} B g s ((fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f).obj F)).hom =
    (fShriekStalkIso.{u, v} B (f ≫ g) s F).hom ≫
      AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (compFiberStalksMap B f g s F)
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekCompIso_assoc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6T, part (4).** For a third locally quasi-finite morphism `h : Z ⟶ T` the two
isomorphisms `(h ∘ g ∘ f)_! ≅ h_! ∘ g_! ∘ f_!` obtained from the composition isomorphisms agree:
through `(h ∘ g)_! ∘ f_!` and through `h_! ∘ (g ∘ f)_!`. The identification
`(h ∘ (g ∘ f))_! = ((h ∘ g) ∘ f)_!` along the associativity of composition is written out.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekCompIso_assoc :
    eqToHom (fShriekFunctor_congr.{u, v} B (Category.assoc f g h)) ≫
        (fShriekCompIso B f (g ≫ h)).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f) (fShriekCompIso B g h).hom =
      (fShriekCompIso B (f ≫ g) h).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (fShriekCompIso B f g).hom (fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B h)
declarations.comment: part (4)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekCompIso_eq_of_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6T, part (1).** If `f` and `g` are separated, the isomorphism
`(g ∘ f)_! ≅ g_! ∘ f_!` agrees with the identification `g_! f_! = (g ∘ f)_!` of proper-support
direct images of Stacks 0F50, read through the identifications of Stacks 0F6N of the
finite-support model of `f_!`, `g_!` and `(g ∘ f)_!` with the proper-support model.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekCompIso_eq_of_isSeparated :
    fShriekCompIso B f g =
      fShriekFunctorIsoProperSupport.{u, v} B (f ≫ g) ≪≫
        (properSupportFunctor_compIso B f g).val.symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerRight (fShriekFunctorIsoProperSupport.{u, v} B f).symm
          (properSupportFunctor.{u, max (u + 1) v} B g) ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f)
          (fShriekFunctorIsoProperSupport.{u, v} B g).symm
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekCompIso_generator_of_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6T, part (2).** If `g` is separated, the isomorphism `(g ∘ f)_! ≅ g_! ∘ f_!`
agrees with the isomorphism of Stacks 0F79: read in the proper-support model of `g_!` through
Stacks 0F6N, it is the sheafification of the map `c` of the proof of Stacks 0F79, which sends a
local generator `(Z, s)` of `(g ∘ f)_{p!}F` over `W` — a section `s` of `F` over `X_W` supported
on `Z ⊆ X_W` finite over `W` — to the generator `(Z, s)` of `f_{p!}F` over `W ×_Z Y`, through
`X_{W ×_Z Y} = X_W`. The generators generate `(g ∘ f)_{p!}F`, so this determines the
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekCompIso_generator_of_isSeparated (W : SmallEtale B Z.obj Z.property)
    (E : FiniteSupport B (f ≫ g) W) (a : (finiteSupportDiagram B (f ≫ g) F W).obj E) :
    properSupportSection B g ((fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f).obj F) W
        (((fShriekFunctorIsoProperSupport.{u, v} B g).hom.app
          ((fShriekFunctor.{u, v} B f).obj F)).hom.app (op W)
          (((fShriekCompIso B f g).hom.app F).hom.app (op W)
            ((finiteSupportPushforwardGenerator B (f ≫ g) F W E ≫
              (toSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B Z.obj Z.property)
                ((finiteSupportPushforward.{u, max (u + 1) v} B (f ≫ g)
                  (fun _ => inferInstance)).val.obj F)).app (op W)) a))) =
      (finiteSupportPushforwardGenerator B f F (baseChange B g W) (sepCompSupport B f g W E) ≫
        (toSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B Y.obj Y.property)
          ((finiteSupportPushforward.{u, max (u + 1) v} B f
            (fun _ => inferInstance)).val.obj F)).app (op (baseChange B g W)))
        (sepCompSection B f g F W E a)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fUpperShriekBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6U.** For a cartesian square with horizontal morphisms `p : X' ⟶ X`,
`g : Y' ⟶ Y`, vertical morphisms `f : X ⟶ Y`, `f' : X' ⟶ Y'` and `f` locally quasi-finite, the
upper shriek commutes with direct image: `p_* f'^! ≅ f^! g_*` as functors on abelian sheaves of
`Y'_étale`. Both sides are right adjoint to the two sides of the base-change isomorphism
`g⁻¹ f_! ≅ f'_! p⁻¹` of Stacks 0F5J, so they agree by uniqueness of right adjoints.
declarations.statement:
public def fUpperShriekBaseChangeIso (sq : IsPullback p f' f g) :
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isPullback B p f' f g sq
    letI := locallyQuasiFinite_of_isPullback B p f' f g sq
    fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f' ⋙ abPushforward.{u, u + 1} B p ≅
      abPushforward.{u, u + 1} B g ⋙ fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fUpperShriekBaseChangeObjIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F6U.** For an abelian sheaf `ℱ` on `Y'_étale` the base-change isomorphism of
Stacks 0F6U reads `p_* (f'^! ℱ) ≅ f^! (g_* ℱ)`, which is the identification the source states
sheaf by sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public def fUpperShriekBaseChangeObjIso (sq : IsPullback p f' f g)
    (ℱ : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B Y'.obj Y'.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isPullback B p f' f g sq
    letI := locallyQuasiFinite_of_isPullback B p f' f g sq
    (abPushforward.{u, u + 1} B p).obj ((fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f').obj ℱ) ≅
      (fUpperShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f).obj ((abPushforward.{u, u + 1} B g).obj ℱ)
declarations.comment: the identification at a single abelian sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_of_weaklyEtale_of_universalHomeomorphism
declarations.doc: A weakly étale universal homeomorphism of schemes is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
instance isIso_of_weaklyEtale_of_universalHomeomorphism
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [WeaklyEtale f]
    [UniversalHomeomorphism f] : IsIso f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_relativeFrobenius_of_weaklyEtale
declarations.doc: The relative Frobenius of a weakly étale scheme is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
instance isIso_relativeFrobenius_of_weaklyEtale (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : ℕ)
    [Fact p.Prime] (hX : IsInCharacteristic X p) (U : Over X) [WeaklyEtale U.hom] :
    IsIso (relativeFrobenius X p hX U)

declarations.name: ToposBaseChange.main
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0F6X (vertical composition of base change maps).** The base change map
`\beta_rect` of the outer rectangle equals the pasted composite obtained from
`\beta_bot` and `\beta_top`, namely the horizontal composite of natural
transformations
```
  m^{-1} \circ g_* \circ f_*
    --> g'_* \circ l^{-1} \circ f_*     (β_bot whiskered by f_* on the right)
    --> g'_* \circ f'_* \circ k^{-1}    (β_top whiskered by g'_* on the left)
```
In Mathlib's notation this two-step whiskered composite is exactly
`(βtop).hComp (βbot)` (the horizontal composition of the two `TwoSquare`s).
declarations.statement:
theorem main :
    βrect adjf adjf' adjg adjg' χtop χbot
      = (βtop adjf adjf' χtop).hComp (βbot adjg adjg' χbot)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.isIso_unit_and_counit_of_isSubterminal_addCommGrpCat
declarations.doc:
Let `C` be a site and `U` an object of `C` such that every object of `C` has at most one
morphism to `U`. For an abelian sheaf `F` on `C/U` the canonical maps
`F ⟶ j_U^{-1}j_{U!}F` and `j_U^{-1}j_{U*}F ⟶ F` are isomorphisms.

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.directImageRestrictionIso
declarations.doc:
For an étale monomorphism `j : U ⟶ X`, the natural isomorphism `j^{-1} j_* F ≅ F` for
abelian sheaves `F` on the small étale site of `U`, given by the counit of `j^{-1} ⊣ j_*`.
declarations.statement:
def directImageRestrictionIso :
    etaleDirectImage.{u, v} j ⋙ etaleRestriction.{u, v} j ≅ 𝟭 _
declarations.comment: the isomorphism j^{-1} j_* F → F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianDirectImageAdjunction_counit_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F70.** Along an open immersion `U ⟶ X` the counit of the adjunction between
restriction and direct image is an isomorphism: an abelian étale sheaf on `U` is recovered from
its direct image by restricting back to `U`. Composition with `U ⟶ X` is continuous,
cocontinuous, and — because the structure morphism of `U` is a monomorphism — fully faithful,
which is exactly the situation of Stacks 00XT.
declarations.statement:
public theorem abelianDirectImageAdjunction_counit_isIso :
    IsIso (abelianDirectImageAdjunction B X hX U).counit
declarations.comment: direct_image_counit

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianExtensionByZeroAdjunction_unit_isIso
declarations.doc:
Along an open immersion `U ⟶ X` the unit of the extension-by-zero adjunction is an
isomorphism: an abelian étale sheaf on `U` is recovered from its extension by zero by
restricting back to `U`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem abelianExtensionByZeroAdjunction_unit_isIso
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    IsIso ((abelianExtensionByZeroAdjunction B X hX U).unit.app F)
declarations.comment: extension_by_zero_unit

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianExtensionByZeroAdjunction_hom_isIso_of_stalk_isZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F70.** An abelian étale sheaf on `X` whose restriction to the open subscheme `U`
is identified with `F` and whose stalks at the geometric points of `X` outside `U` vanish is
canonically the extension by zero of `F`: the map from `j_!F` adjoint to the given
identification is an isomorphism. Together with the vanishing of the stalks of `j_!F` outside
`U` this is the uniqueness assertion of the source.
declarations.statement:
public theorem abelianExtensionByZeroAdjunction_hom_isIso_of_stalk_isZero
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X hX) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (e : F ≅ (abelianRestriction B X hX U).obj G)
    (hG : ∀ x : GeometricPoint X,
      x.hom default ∉ Set.range (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom).base →
        IsZero (etaleStalk B X hX x G.obj)) :
    IsIso (((abelianExtensionByZeroAdjunction B X hX U).homEquiv F G).symm e.hom)
declarations.comment: extension_by_zero_characterization: uniqueness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianExtensionByZero_stalk_isZero_of_not_mem_range
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F70.** The extension by zero of an abelian étale sheaf on `U` has zero stalk at
every geometric point of `X` outside the image of `U`: by the stalk formula the stalk is the
direct sum over the lifts of that point, and there are none.
declarations.statement:
public theorem abelianExtensionByZero_stalk_isZero_of_not_mem_range
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hx : x.hom default ∉ Set.range (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom).base) :
    IsZero (etaleStalk B X hX x ((abelianExtensionByZero B X hX U).obj F).obj)
declarations.comment: extension_by_zero_characterization: zero stalks

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianExtensionByZero_stalk_isZero_of_not_mem_range
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F70.** The extension by zero of an abelian étale sheaf on `U` has zero stalk at
every geometric point of `X` outside the image of `U`: by the stalk formula the stalk is the
direct sum over the lifts of that point, and there are none.
declarations.statement:
public theorem abelianExtensionByZero_stalk_isZero_of_not_mem_range
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hx : x.hom default ∉ Set.range (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom).base) :
    IsZero (etaleStalk B X hX x ((abelianExtensionByZero B X hX U).obj F).obj)
declarations.comment: extension_by_zero_characterization

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compactlySupportedSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F72.** The subgroup of global sections of an abelian sheaf on the small étale
site whose support is proper over the base field.
declarations.statement:
public def compactlySupportedSections :
    AddSubgroup (F.obj.obj (op (SmallEtale.final B X hX)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compactlySupportedSections_eq_top_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F73.** On a scheme proper over a field, every global section of an abelian sheaf
on the small étale site has compact support.
declarations.statement:
public theorem compactlySupportedSections_eq_top_of_isProper :
    compactlySupportedSections k X f B hX F = ⊤

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F74.** Extension by zero gives a canonical injection on compactly supported
sections along an open immersion, characterised by the restriction of its value back to the
open subscheme and by the equality of supports.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion {X' X : B.Scheme}
    (j : X' ⟶ X) (f : X.obj ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v}) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map j ≫ f) := inferInstance
    let F' := ((smallEtaleBaseChange B j).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X'.obj X'.property)).obj F
    {φ : compactlySupportedSections k X'.obj (B.inclusion.map j ≫ f) B X'.property F' →+
        compactlySupportedSections k X.obj f B X.property F //
      Function.Injective φ ∧
      ∀ s, (F'.obj.map ((SmallEtale.finalIsTerminal B X'.obj X'.property).from
            ((smallEtaleBaseChange B j).obj (SmallEtale.final B X.obj X.property))).op s.1 =
          (((smallEtaleBaseChange B j).sheafAdjunctionContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{v}
            (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
            (SmallEtale.topology B X'.obj X'.property)).unit.app F).hom.app
              (op (SmallEtale.final B X.obj X.property)) (φ s).1) ∧
        (supportSection B X.obj X.property F (SmallEtale.final B X.obj X.property) (φ s).1 =
          (B.inclusion.map j).base ''
            supportSection B X'.obj X'.property F'
              (SmallEtale.final B X'.obj X'.property) s.1)}
declarations.comment: canonical injection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion_id
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F74.** For the identity open immersion extension by zero is surjective on
compactly supported sections, hence an isomorphism: the unit of the restriction adjunction
along an identity is an isomorphism, and the characterising restriction equation identifies the
injection with it.
declarations.statement:
public theorem compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion_id (X : B.Scheme)
    (f : X.obj ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v}) :
    Function.Surjective (compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion k B (𝟙 X) f F).1
declarations.comment: precosheaf identity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F74.** Extension by zero on compactly supported sections is transitive for
composable open immersions, once the two restrictions of the sheaf to the smallest open
subscheme are identified by the canonical comparison of inverse images.
declarations.statement:
public theorem compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion_comp {X'' X' X : B.Scheme}
    (i : X'' ⟶ X') (j : X' ⟶ X) (f : X.obj ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map i)] [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v}) :
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map (i ≫ j)) := by
      change IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map i ≫ B.inclusion.map j)
      infer_instance
    letI : IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map j ≫ f) := by infer_instance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map j ≫ f) := by infer_instance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map i ≫ (B.inclusion.map j ≫ f)) := by
      infer_instance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map (i ≫ j) ≫ f) := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map i ≫ B.inclusion.map j ≫ f)
      infer_instance
    let F' := ((smallEtaleBaseChange B j).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X'.obj X'.property)).obj F
    let F'' := ((smallEtaleBaseChange B i).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X'.obj X'.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X''.obj X''.property)).obj F'
    let Fd := ((smallEtaleBaseChange B (i ≫ j)).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X''.obj X''.property)).obj F
    ∀ (s : compactlySupportedSections k X''.obj (B.inclusion.map i ≫ (B.inclusion.map j ≫ f))
        B X''.property F''),
      ∃ (t : compactlySupportedSections k X''.obj (B.inclusion.map (i ≫ j) ≫ f) B X''.property
        Fd),
        (((smallEtaleSheafPullbackCompIso B X'' X' X i j AddCommGrpCat.{v}).app F).hom.hom.app
            (op (SmallEtale.final B X''.obj X''.property)) s.1 = t.1) ∧
        ((compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion k B j f F).1
          ((compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion k B i (B.inclusion.map j ≫ f) F').1 s) =
          (compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion k B (i ≫ j) f F).1 t)
declarations.comment: precosheaf composition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F74.** A compactly supported section of `F` is the extension by zero of a
compactly supported section on an open subscheme exactly when its support lies in that open
subscheme: this identifies the image of the canonical injection.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion_eq {X' X : B.Scheme}
    (j : X' ⟶ X) (f : X.obj ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (t : compactlySupportedSections k X.obj f B X.property F) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map j ≫ f) := inferInstance
    let F' := ((smallEtaleBaseChange B j).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
      (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B X'.obj X'.property)).obj F
    (∃ s : compactlySupportedSections k X'.obj (B.inclusion.map j ≫ f) B X'.property F',
        (compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion k B j f F).1 s = t) ↔
      supportSection B X.obj X.property F (SmallEtale.final B X.obj X.property) t.1 ⊆
        Set.range (B.inclusion.map j).base
declarations.comment: cosheaf, image of the canonical injection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion_inter
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F74.** Mayer–Vietoris for compactly supported sections: two compactly supported
sections on open subschemes with the same extension by zero both come from a compactly
supported section on the intersection of the two open subschemes, an open subscheme `X₀` whose
image is the intersection of the two images — for instance their fibre product, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.range_pullback_fst_comp`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion_inter {X₀ X₁ X₂ X : B.Scheme}
    (j₀ : X₀ ⟶ X) (j₁ : X₁ ⟶ X) (j₂ : X₂ ⟶ X) (f : X.obj ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j₀)]
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j₁)] [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j₂)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (h₀ : Set.range (B.inclusion.map j₀).base =
      Set.range (B.inclusion.map j₁).base ∩ Set.range (B.inclusion.map j₂).base) :
    ∀ (s₁ : compactlySupportedSections k X₁.obj (B.inclusion.map j₁ ≫ f) B X₁.property
        (((smallEtaleBaseChange B j₁).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
          (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
          (SmallEtale.topology B X₁.obj X₁.property)).obj F))
      (s₂ : compactlySupportedSections k X₂.obj (B.inclusion.map j₂ ≫ f) B X₂.property
        (((smallEtaleBaseChange B j₂).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
          (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
          (SmallEtale.topology B X₂.obj X₂.property)).obj F)),
      (compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion k B j₁ f F).1 s₁ =
          (compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion k B j₂ f F).1 s₂ →
        ∃ s₀ : compactlySupportedSections k X₀.obj (B.inclusion.map j₀ ≫ f) B X₀.property
            (((smallEtaleBaseChange B j₀).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
              (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
              (SmallEtale.topology B X₀.obj X₀.property)).obj F),
          (compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion k B j₀ f F).1 s₀ =
            (compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion k B j₁ f F).1 s₁
declarations.comment: cosheaf, Mayer–Vietoris

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion_add
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F74.** Gluing for compactly supported sections: a compactly supported section
whose support is the union of two disjoint closed subsets, one inside each of two open
subschemes, is the sum of the extensions by zero of compactly supported sections on those two
open subschemes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion_add {X₁ X₂ X : B.Scheme}
    (j₁ : X₁ ⟶ X) (j₂ : X₂ ⟶ X) (f : X.obj ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j₁)] [IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j₂)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (t : compactlySupportedSections k X.obj f B X.property F)
    (Z₁ Z₂ : Set ((SmallEtale.toScheme B X.obj X.property).obj
      (SmallEtale.final B X.obj X.property)))
    (hZ₁ : IsClosed Z₁) (hZ₂ : IsClosed Z₂) (hdisj : Disjoint Z₁ Z₂)
    (hsupp : supportSection B X.obj X.property F (SmallEtale.final B X.obj X.property) t.1 =
      Z₁ ∪ Z₂)
    (h₁ : Z₁ ⊆ Set.range (B.inclusion.map j₁).base)
    (h₂ : Z₂ ⊆ Set.range (B.inclusion.map j₂).base) :
    ∃ (s₁ : compactlySupportedSections k X₁.obj (B.inclusion.map j₁ ≫ f) B X₁.property
        (((smallEtaleBaseChange B j₁).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
          (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
          (SmallEtale.topology B X₁.obj X₁.property)).obj F))
      (s₂ : compactlySupportedSections k X₂.obj (B.inclusion.map j₂ ≫ f) B X₂.property
        (((smallEtaleBaseChange B j₂).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v}
          (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
          (SmallEtale.topology B X₂.obj X₂.property)).obj F)),
      (compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion k B j₁ f F).1 s₁ +
        (compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion k B j₂ f F).1 s₂ = t
declarations.comment: cosheaf, gluing

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_zariskiCovering_not_surjective_compactlySupportedSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F74, the cosheaf condition fails for an actual Zariski covering.** For every field
`k` and every big étale site containing the projective line `ℙ¹_k`, the scheme `ℙ¹_k`, separated
and of finite type (indeed proper) over `k`, has a Zariski covering by two open subschemes — the
complements of the zero and of the infinity section — and an abelian sheaf on its small étale
site — the additive group `𝔾_a` — such that the sum of the extension-by-zero maps
`H^0_c(U₁) ⊕ H^0_c(U₂) → H^0_c(ℙ¹_k)` is not surjective. So `H^0_c` is not a cosheaf on the
Zariski site in the literal sense; it is a precosheaf with injective transition maps, see
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_zariskiCovering_not_surjective_compactlySupportedSections
    (hP : B.Contains (Stacks.Chow.relativeProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k)))) :
    ∃ (X X₁ X₂ : B.Scheme) (j₁ : X₁ ⟶ X) (j₂ : X₂ ⟶ X) (f : X.obj ⟶ Spec (.of k))
      (_ : IsProper f) (_ : IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j₁))
      (_ : IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map j₂)),
      Set.range (B.inclusion.map j₁).base ∪ Set.range (B.inclusion.map j₂).base = Set.univ ∧
      ∃ F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u},
        ¬ Function.Surjective
          ((compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion k B j₁ f F).1.coprod
            (compactlySupportedSections_openInclusion k B j₂ f F).1)
declarations.comment: the cosheaf condition is false in the literal sense: a Zariski covering of ℙ¹_k by two opens on which the sum map H^0_c(U₁) ⊕ H^0_c(U₂) → H^0_c(ℙ¹_k, 𝔾_a) is not surjective

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compactlySupportedSections_extensionByZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F75.** For an open immersion `j : X ⟶ X̄` with `X̄` proper over a field `k`, the
compactly supported global sections of an abelian sheaf `F` on the small étale site of `X` are
canonically the compactly supported global sections of its extension by zero `j_! F` on `X̄`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def compactlySupportedSections_extensionByZero :
    compactlySupportedSections k U.obj.left.obj (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom ≫ fbar) B
        U.obj.left.property F ≃+
      compactlySupportedSections k Xbar.obj fbar B Xbar.property
        ((abelianExtensionByZero B Xbar.obj Xbar.property U).obj F)
declarations.comment: canonical isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.compactlySupportedSections_extensionByZero_restrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F75.** The canonical equivalence is determined by the fact that restriction of the
extended section to the open subscheme is the original section, identified through the
extension-by-zero adjunction unit.
declarations.statement:
public theorem compactlySupportedSections_extensionByZero_restrict
    (s : compactlySupportedSections k U.obj.left.obj (B.inclusion.map U.obj.hom ≫ fbar) B
      U.obj.left.property F) :
    ((abelianExtensionByZeroAdjunction B Xbar.obj Xbar.property U).unit.app F).hom.app
        (op (SmallEtale.final B U.obj.left.obj U.obj.left.property)) s.1 =
      ((abelianExtensionByZero B Xbar.obj Xbar.property U).obj F).obj.map
        ((SmallEtale.finalIsTerminal B Xbar.obj Xbar.property).from U).op
        (compactlySupportedSections_extensionByZero k B Xbar fbar U F s).1
declarations.comment: restriction characterization

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekStalkEquivCompactSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F76.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be separated and locally of finite type, `F` an abelian
sheaf on `X_étale` and `ȳ : Spec k ⟶ Y` a geometric point. There is a canonical isomorphism
`(f_!F)_ȳ ≅ H⁰_c(X_ȳ, F|_{X_ȳ})` between the stalk at `ȳ` of the direct image with compact
support (Stacks 0F4X) and the compactly supported sections (Stacks 0F72) of the inverse image of
`F` on the geometric fibre `X_ȳ = X ×_Y Spec k` over `k`. It sends the germ of a section over an
étale neighbourhood `(V, v̄)` to its pullback along `X_ȳ ⟶ X_V`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekStalkEquivCompactSections_apply_germ`).

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekStalkEquivCompactSections_apply_germ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F76, the isomorphism on germs.** Let `(V, v̄)` be an étale neighbourhood of `ȳ`
and `s` a section of `f_!F` over `V`, that is a section of `F` over `X_V` with support proper over
`V`. Let `h : X_ȳ ⟶ X_ȳ ×_X X_V` be a morphism over `X_ȳ` whose composite to `V` is
`X_ȳ ⟶ Spec k ⟶ V`. Then the isomorphism sends the germ of `s` at `ȳ` to the pullback of `s`
along `h`. Such an `h` exists and is unique, `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.geometricFibreLift`;
this is the canonical map `c_ȳ` of the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem fShriekStalkEquivCompactSections_apply_germ
    (N : (geometricPointFiber B Y.obj Y.property y).Elements)
    (s : (fShriekSubsheaf B f F).val.obj.left.obj.obj (op N.1))
    (h : final B (geometricFibreObj B f y hy).obj (geometricFibreObj B f y hy).property ⟶
      (smallEtaleBaseChange B (geometricFibreProj B f y hy)).obj
        ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).obj N.1))
    (hh : (h.hom.left ≫ baseChangeObjProjection B (geometricFibreProj B f y hy)
        ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).obj N.1)) ≫ pullback.fst N.1.obj.hom f =
      geometricFibreStruct B f y hy ≫ neighborhoodPointHom B y hy N) :
    (fShriekStalkEquivCompactSections B f F y hy
        (etaleGerm B Y.obj Y.property y _ N.1 N.2 s) : geometricFibreSections B f y hy F) =
      pullbackSectionAlongHom B (geometricFibreProj B f y hy) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v} F
        ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).obj N.1) _ h
        ((fShriekSubsheaf B f F).val.arrow.hom.app (op N.1) s)
declarations.comment: the isomorphism pulls a section on an étale neighbourhood back to the fibre

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportFunctor_compIso_assoc
declarations.doc: Canonical proper-support direct-image comparisons are associative.
declarations.statement:
public theorem properSupportFunctor_compIso_assoc
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X Y Z T : B.Scheme}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ T)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map g)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map h)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map g)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map h)] :
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_map_comp B f g
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_map_comp B g h
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_map_comp B (f ≫ g) h
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_map_comp B f (g ≫ h)
    letI := isSeparated_map_comp B f g
    letI := isSeparated_map_comp B g h
    let fBang := SmallEtale.properSupportFunctor.{u, v} B f
    let gBang := SmallEtale.properSupportFunctor.{u, v} B g
    let hBang := SmallEtale.properSupportFunctor.{u, v} B h
    (Functor.isoWhiskerRight
        (SmallEtale.properSupportFunctor_compIso.{u, v} B f g).val hBang ≪≫
      (SmallEtale.properSupportFunctor_compIso.{u, v} B (f ≫ g) h).val) =
    (Functor.associator fBang gBang hBang ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft fBang
        (SmallEtale.properSupportFunctor_compIso.{u, v} B g h).val ≪≫
      (SmallEtale.properSupportFunctor_compIso.{u, v} B f (g ≫ h)).val ≪≫
      eqToIso (by
        have heq : f ≫ (g ≫ h) = (f ≫ g) ≫ h := (Category.assoc f g h).symm
        cases heq
        rfl))
declarations.comment: composition_coherence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportBaseChange_compIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Remark 0F77, part (2).** Let
```
X' --c--> X
|f'       |f
v         v
Y' --b--> Y
|g'       |g
v         v
Z' --a--> Z
```
be two cartesian squares of a big étale site, with `f` and `g` separated and locally of finite
type. Then the square
```
a⁻¹ (g ∘ f)_! ------------------------------> (g' ∘ f')_! c⁻¹
     |                                               |
a⁻¹ g_! f_! ------> g'_! b⁻¹ f_! ------> g'_! f'_! c⁻¹
```
of abelian sheaves on the small étale site of `Z'` commutes, where the horizontal arrows are the
base change maps of Stacks 0F55 (`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportBaseChange`) for the
rectangle, for the lower square at `f_! F`, and `g'_!` of that for the upper square, and the
vertical arrows are the composition isomorphisms of Stacks 0F50
(`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properSupportFunctor_compIso`).
declarations.statement:
theorem properSupportBaseChange_compIso (sq₁ : IsPullback c f' f b)
    (sq₂ : IsPullback b g' g a)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map g)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)] [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map g)]
    (F : AbelianSheaf.{u, v} B X) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map f') :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (sq₁.map B.inclusion) inferInstance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map g') :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (sq₂.map B.inclusion) inferInstance
    letI : IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f') :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (sq₁.map B.inclusion) inferInstance
    letI : IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map g') :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (sq₂.map B.inclusion) inferInstance
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_map_comp B f g
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_map_comp B f' g'
    properSupportBaseChange.{u, v} B c (f' ≫ g') (f ≫ g) a (sq₁.paste_vert sq₂) F ≫
        (properSupportFunctor_compIso B f' g').val.inv.app ((abPullback.{u, v} B c).obj F) =
      (abPullback.{u, v} B a).map ((properSupportFunctor_compIso B f g).val.inv.app F) ≫
        properSupportBaseChange.{u, v} B b g' g a sq₂ ((properSupportFunctor B f).obj F) ≫
        (properSupportFunctor B g').map (properSupportBaseChange.{u, v} B c f' f b sq₁ F)
declarations.comment: part (2): compatibility of the base change maps of 0F55 with the composition isomorphisms of 0F50

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.sheafifiedPushforwardMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F78.** The map from the sheafification of `G` to the small-étale direct image of
the sheafification of `G'` induced by a map `α : G ⟶ g_* G'` of abelian presheaves.
declarations.statement:
public def sheafifiedPushforwardMap
    (G : (SmallEtale B S.obj S.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (G' : (SmallEtale B T.obj T.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (α : G ⟶ (smallEtaleBaseChange B g).op ⋙ G') :
    (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property).sheafify G ⟶
      (smallEtaleBaseChange B g).op ⋙
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).sheafify G'
declarations.comment: canonical map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.sheafifiedPushforwardMap_comm
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0F78.** The induced map commutes with the two sheafification maps.
declarations.statement:
public theorem sheafifiedPushforwardMap_comm
    (G : (SmallEtale B S.obj S.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (G' : (SmallEtale B T.obj T.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (α : G ⟶ (smallEtaleBaseChange B g).op ⋙ G') :
    (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property).toSheafify G ≫
        sheafifiedPushforwardMap B g G G' α =
      α ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft (smallEtaleBaseChange B g).op
        ((SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).toSheafify G')
declarations.comment: commutative square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.sheafifiedPushforwardMap_unique
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F78.** The commutative square of the previous result determines the induced map
uniquely.
declarations.statement:
public theorem sheafifiedPushforwardMap_unique
    (G : (SmallEtale B S.obj S.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (G' : (SmallEtale B T.obj T.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (α : G ⟶ (smallEtaleBaseChange B g).op ⋙ G')
    (β : (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property).sheafify G ⟶
      (smallEtaleBaseChange B g).op ⋙
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).sheafify G')
    (hβ : (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property).toSheafify G ≫ β =
      α ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft (smallEtaleBaseChange B g).op
        ((SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).toSheafify G')) :
    β = sheafifiedPushforwardMap B g G G' α
declarations.comment: uniqueness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.sheafifiedPushforwardAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F78.** The induced map transported through the adjunction between the small-étale
inverse image and direct image along `g`.
declarations.statement:
public def sheafifiedPushforwardAdjoint
    (G : (SmallEtale B S.obj S.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (G' : (SmallEtale B T.obj T.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (α : G ⟶ (smallEtaleBaseChange B g).op ⋙ G') :
    ((smallEtaleBaseChange B g).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
      (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)).obj
        ⟨(SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property).sheafify G,
          (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property).sheafify_isSheaf G⟩ ⟶
      ⟨(SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).sheafify G',
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).sheafify_isSheaf G'⟩
declarations.comment: adjoint map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.sheafifiedPushforwardMap_stalk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F78.** The germ, at a lift `p'` of a geometric point of `T`, of a section of `G`
over an étale neighborhood `U` of the image point is carried by the adjoint map to the germ
over the base-changed neighborhood of the image of the section under `α`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem sheafifiedPushforwardMap_stalk
    (G : (SmallEtale B S.obj S.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (G' : (SmallEtale B T.obj T.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (α : G ⟶ (smallEtaleBaseChange B g).op ⋙ G')
    (s' : GeometricPoint T.obj)
    [HasColimit ((Functor.Elements.π
      (geometricPointFiber B T.obj T.property s')).op ⋙
        (((smallEtaleBaseChange B g).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
          (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)).obj
            ⟨(SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property).sheafify G,
              (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property).sheafify_isSheaf G⟩).obj)]
    [HasColimit ((Functor.Elements.π
      (geometricPointFiber B T.obj T.property s')).op ⋙
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).sheafify G')] :
    let F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} :=
      ⟨(SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property).sheafify G,
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property).sheafify_isSheaf G⟩
    let D := (Functor.Elements.π
      (geometricPointFiber B T.obj T.property s')).op ⋙
        (((smallEtaleBaseChange B g).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
          (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)).obj F).obj
    let D' := (Functor.Elements.π
      (geometricPointFiber B T.obj T.property s')).op ⋙
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).sheafify G'
    ∀ (U : SmallEtale B S.obj S.property)
        (p' : (geometricPointFiber B T.obj T.property s').obj
          ((smallEtaleBaseChange B g).obj U)),
        (((SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property).toSheafify G).app (op U) ≫
            (((smallEtaleBaseChange B g).sheafAdjunctionContinuous
              AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
              (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
              (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)).unit.app F).hom.app (op U) ≫
            colimit.ι D (op (Functor.elementsMk _ ((smallEtaleBaseChange B g).obj U) p')) ≫
            colim.map (Functor.whiskerLeft
              ((Functor.Elements.π
                (geometricPointFiber B T.obj T.property s')).op)
              (sheafifiedPushforwardAdjoint B g G G' α).hom)) =
          α.app (op U) ≫
            ((SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).toSheafify G').app
              (op ((smallEtaleBaseChange B g).obj U)) ≫
              colimit.ι D' (op (Functor.elementsMk _ ((smallEtaleBaseChange B g).obj U) p'))
declarations.comment: geometric stalk formula

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekCompProperIso_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F79, part (b).** For a base change `b : Z₁ ⟶ Z`, with cartesian squares
`X₁ = X ×_Y Y₁` and `Y₁ = Y ×_Z Z₁`, the isomorphism `(g ∘ f)_! ≅ g_! ∘ f_!` of Stacks 0F79 is
compatible with the base-change isomorphisms of Stacks 0F5J and 0F55: the base-change
isomorphism `b⁻¹ (g ∘ f)_! F ≅ (g₁ ∘ f₁)_! a⁻¹ F` of Stacks 0F5J followed by the isomorphism for
`f₁` and `g₁` equals `b⁻¹` of the isomorphism for `f` and `g`, followed by the base change
`b⁻¹ g_! ⟶ g₁_! b'⁻¹` of Stacks 0F55 and `g₁_!` of the base-change isomorphism
`b'⁻¹ f_! F ≅ f₁_! a⁻¹ F` of Stacks 0F5J.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekCompProperIso_baseChange :
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isPullback B a f₁ f b' sq₁
    letI := locallyQuasiFinite_of_isPullback B a f₁ f b' sq₁
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isPullback B b' g₁ g b sq₂
    letI : IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map g₁) :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (sq₂.map B.inclusion) inferInstance
    letI : LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map (f₁ ≫ g₁)) :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback ((sq₁.paste_vert sq₂).map B.inclusion) inferInstance
    (fShriekBaseChangeNatIso.{u} B a (f₁ ≫ g₁) (f ≫ g) b (sq₁.paste_vert sq₂)).hom.app F ≫
        (fShriekCompProperIso.{u, u + 1} B f₁ g₁).hom.app ((abPullback.{u, u + 1} B a).obj F) =
      (abPullback.{u, u + 1} B b).map ((fShriekCompProperIso.{u, u + 1} B f g).hom.app F) ≫
        properSupportBaseChange.{u, u + 1} B b' g₁ g b sq₂
          ((fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f).obj F) ≫
        (properSupportFunctor.{u, u + 1} B g₁).map
          ((fShriekBaseChangeNatIso.{u} B a f₁ f b' sq₁).hom.app F)
declarations.comment: part (b), compatibility with the base change isomorphisms of 0F5J and 0F55

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekCompProperIso_eq_of_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F79, part (c).** If `f` is separated as well, the isomorphism
`(g ∘ f)_! ≅ g_! ∘ f_!` of Stacks 0F79 is the isomorphism `(g ∘ f)_! = g_! ∘ f_!` of
proper-support direct images of Stacks 0F50, read through the identifications of Stacks 0F6N of
`(g ∘ f)_!` and `f_!` with their proper-support models.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fShriekCompProperIso_eq_of_isSeparated [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map f)] :
    letI := isSeparated_map_comp B f g
    fShriekCompProperIso.{u, v} B f g =
      fShriekFunctorIsoProperSupport.{u, v} B (f ≫ g) ≪≫
        (properSupportFunctor_compIso B f g).val.symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerRight (fShriekFunctorIsoProperSupport.{u, v} B f).symm
          (properSupportFunctor.{u, max (u + 1) v} B g)
declarations.comment: part (c), the isomorphism of 0F50 via the identifications of 0F6N for f' separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.fShriekCompProperIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F79.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` be morphisms of a big étale site with `f`
and `f ≫ g` locally quasi-finite (locally of finite type and locally quasi-finite) and `g`
separated and locally of finite type. Then there is a canonical isomorphism of functors on
abelian étale sheaves `(g ∘ f)_! ≅ g_! ∘ f_!`, where `f_!` and `(g ∘ f)_!` are the direct images
with compact support of locally quasi-finite morphisms (Stacks 0F6R) and `g_!` is the
proper-support direct image of Stacks 0F4X. Its component at `F` is the map `c'` of the source,
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.sepCompShriekMap`: the sheafification of the map sending a local
generator `(T, s)` of `(g ∘ f)_{p!} F` over `W` to the generator `(T, s)` of `f_{p!} F` over
`W ×_Z Y`, through `X_{W ×_Z Y} = X_W`.
declarations.comment: the canonical isomorphism g_! ∘ f'_! ≅ f_!

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.sepCompShriekMap_openCovariance
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F79, part (a).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` be as in Stacks 0F79, let
`jY : Y₁ ⟶ Y` be an open immersion, and let `X₁ = X ×_Y Y₁` with projections `jX : X₁ ⟶ X` and
`f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Y₁`. Then the isomorphism `c'` of Stacks 0F79 is compatible with covariance with
respect to open embeddings: the composite of the covariance map
`(jX ≫ f ≫ g)_!(F|_{X₁}) ⟶ (f ≫ g)_! F` of Stacks 0F6S with `c' : (f ≫ g)_! F ⟶ g_!(f_! F)`
equals the composite of `c'` for `f₁` and `jY ≫ g`,
`(f₁ ≫ jY ≫ g)_!(F|_{X₁}) ⟶ (jY ≫ g)_!(f₁_!(F|_{X₁}))`, the identification
`f₁_!(F|_{X₁}) ≅ (f_! F)|_{Y₁}` of Stacks 0F5J ("the construction of `f_!` is local on the base")
and the extension by zero `(jY ≫ g)_!((f_! F)|_{Y₁}) ⟶ g_!(f_! F)` of Stacks 0F53.
declarations.statement:
public theorem sepCompShriekMap_openCovariance :
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (B.inclusion.map jX) :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (sq.flip.map B.inclusion) inferInstance
    letI := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isPullback B jX f₁ f jY sq
    letI := locallyQuasiFinite_of_isPullback B jX f₁ f jY sq
    letI : IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map (jY ≫ g)) := by
      rw [Functor.map_comp]
      infer_instance
    letI : LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map (f₁ ≫ jY ≫ g)) := by
      rw [show f₁ ≫ jY ≫ g = jX ≫ f ≫ g by rw [← Category.assoc, ← sq.w, Category.assoc]]
      infer_instance
    (openCovarianceShriekMap.{u, u + 1} B jX (f ≫ g)).app F ≫ sepCompShriekMap.{u, u + 1} B f g F =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun G => G.obj ((openRestriction.{u, u + 1} B jX).obj F))
        (fShriekFunctor_congr.{u, u + 1} B
          (show jX ≫ f ≫ g = f₁ ≫ jY ≫ g by rw [← Category.assoc, sq.w, Category.assoc]))) ≫
      sepCompShriekMap.{u, u + 1} B f₁ (jY ≫ g) ((openRestriction.{u, u + 1} B jX).obj F) ≫
      (properSupportFunctor.{u, u + 1} B (jY ≫ g)).map
        ((fShriekBaseChangeNatIso.{u} B jX f₁ f jY sq).inv.app F) ≫
      (openInclusionShriekMap.{u, u + 1} B jY g ((fShriekFunctor.{u, u + 1} B f).obj F)).val
declarations.comment: part (a), compatibility with covariance for open embeddings, Remarks 0F53, 0F6S

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isIso_properBaseChangeMap_app
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0F7B].** Consider a commutative diagram of schemes of a big étale site
```
X' --k--> X
|         |
f'        f
v         v
Y' --l--> Y
```
with `f` and `f'` proper and `k` and `l` separated and locally quasi-finite (here, as in the
source, locally quasi-finite includes locally of finite type). Let `Λ` be a ring, in the
universe `u` of the site. Functorially in `K ∈ D(X'_étale, Λ)` there is a canonical map
`l_! Rf'_* K ⟶ Rf_*(k_! K)` in `D(Y_étale, Λ)`, namely
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properBaseChangeMap` (for any right derived functors `Rf'_*`, `Rf_*`
of the direct images, with their units). This map is an isomorphism if

* (a) `K` is bounded below and has torsion cohomology sheaves, or
* (b) `Λ` is a torsion ring.

Case (a) is `isIso_properBaseChangeMap_app_of_isGE`, case (b)
`isIso_properBaseChangeMap_of_natCast_eq_zero`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_properBaseChangeMap_app (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X' Λ))
    (hK : (∃ n : ℤ, K.IsGE n ∧ moduleTorsionCohomologyProperty.{u, u, w, u} B X' Λ K) ∨
      ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ (m : Λ) = 0) :
    IsIso ((properBaseChangeMap B Λ k f' f l w RF' αF' RF αF).app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properBaseChangeMap_rectangle_eq_comp
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0F7C]**, in the form the source states it. Consider a commutative diagram of
a big étale site
```
X' --k--> X
|         |
f'        f
v         v
Y' --l--> Y
|         |
g'        g
v         v
Z' --m--> Z
```
with `f`, `f'`, `g` and `g'` proper and `k`, `l` and `m` separated and locally quasi-finite, and
let `Λ` be a ring. Write `R(g ∘ f)_* = Rg_* ∘ Rf_*` and `R(g' ∘ f')_* = Rg'_* ∘ Rf'_*` through
the canonical comparisons, which are isomorphisms
(`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isIso_compComparison_etalePushforwardMod`). Then the map
`m_! ∘ Rg'_* ∘ Rf'_* ⟶ Rg_* ∘ Rf_* ∘ k_!` of [Stacks, Tag 0F7B] for the outer rectangle is the
composite
```
m_! ∘ Rg'_* ∘ Rf'_* ⟶ Rg_* ∘ l_! ∘ Rf'_* ⟶ Rg_* ∘ Rf_* ∘ k_!
```
of the maps of the two squares. This holds for every choice of the six right derived functors.

The source calls the maps of [Stacks, Tag 0F7B] isomorphisms; that is [Stacks, Tag 0F7B]
itself (whose proof rests on proper base change, [Stacks, Tag 0DDF], under its torsion
hypotheses), and is not needed here: the content of this tag is the identity between the maps,
which holds without any hypothesis on `Λ` or on the complexes. The identity before identifying
`R(g ∘ f)_*` with `Rg_* ∘ Rf_*`, which needs no invertibility of the comparisons, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properBaseChangeMap_vertical_paste`.
declarations.statement:
theorem properBaseChangeMap_rectangle_eq_comp (k : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (l : Y' ⟶ Y) (g' : Y' ⟶ Z') (g : Y ⟶ Z) (m : Z' ⟶ Z)
    (w₁ : k ≫ f = f' ≫ l) (w₂ : l ≫ g = g' ≫ m)
    [IsProper (B.inclusion.map f')] [IsProper (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [IsProper (B.inclusion.map g')] [IsProper (B.inclusion.map g)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map k)] [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map k)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map l)] [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map l)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map l)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map m)] [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map m)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map m)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X' Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y' Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Z' Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Z Λ)]
    (RF' : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X' Λ) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y' Λ))
    (αF' : (etaleModuleLift B Λ (etalePushforward.{u, u + 1} B f')).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RF')
    (RF : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y Λ))
    (αF : (etaleModuleLift B Λ (etalePushforward.{u, u + 1} B f)).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RF)
    (RG' : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y' Λ) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Z' Λ))
    (αG' : (etaleModuleLift B Λ (etalePushforward.{u, u + 1} B g')).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RG')
    (RG : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y Λ) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Z Λ))
    (αG : (etaleModuleLift B Λ (etalePushforward.{u, u + 1} B g)).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RG)
    (RP' : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X' Λ) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Z' Λ))
    (αP' : (etaleModuleLift B Λ (etalePushforward.{u, u + 1} B (f' ≫ g'))).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RP')
    (RP : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Z Λ))
    (αP : (etaleModuleLift B Λ (etalePushforward.{u, u + 1} B (f ≫ g))).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RP)
    [RF'.IsRightDerivedFunctor αF'
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X' Λ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor αF
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [RG'.IsRightDerivedFunctor αG'
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y' Λ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [RG.IsRightDerivedFunctor αG
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y Λ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [RP'.IsRightDerivedFunctor αP'
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X' Λ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [RP.IsRightDerivedFunctor αP
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    haveI := isIso_compComparison_etalePushforwardMod B Λ f' g' αF' αG' αP'
    Functor.whiskerRight (inv (compComparison
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X' Λ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
        αF' αG' αP' (Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso (etalePushforwardModCompIso B Λ f' g')
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))))
        (etaleModuleLift B Λ (fShriekFunctor.{u, u} B m)).mapDerivedCategory ≫
      properBaseChangeMap B Λ k (f' ≫ g') (f ≫ g) m (rectangle_comm B w₁ w₂) RP' αP' RP αP ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft (etaleModuleLift B Λ (fShriekFunctor.{u, u} B k)).mapDerivedCategory
        (compComparison
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
          αF αG αP (Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso (etalePushforwardModCompIso B Λ f g)
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) =
      (Functor.associator RF' RG'
          (etaleModuleLift B Λ (fShriekFunctor.{u, u} B m)).mapDerivedCategory).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft RF' (properBaseChangeMap B Λ l g' g m w₂ RG' αG' RG αG) ≫
        (Functor.associator RF'
          (etaleModuleLift B Λ (fShriekFunctor.{u, u} B l)).mapDerivedCategory RG).inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (properBaseChangeMap B Λ k f' f l w₁ RF' αF' RF αF) RG ≫
        (Functor.associator
          (etaleModuleLift B Λ (fShriekFunctor.{u, u} B k)).mapDerivedCategory RF RG).hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.properBaseChangeMap_horizontal_paste
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0F7D].** Consider a commutative diagram of a big étale site
```
X'' --g'--> X' --g--> X
|           |         |
f''         f'        f
v           v         v
Y'' --h'--> Y' --h--> Y
```
with `f`, `f'` and `f''` proper and `g`, `g'`, `h` and `h'` separated and locally quasi-finite,
and let `Λ` be a ring. Then the maps of [Stacks, Tag 0F7B] for the two squares compose to the map
for the outer rectangle. Precisely, as the source states it in its proof: write
`(h' ≫ h)_! = h'_! ⋙ h_!` and `(g' ≫ g)_! = g'_! ⋙ g_!` on derived categories, through the
identifications of Stacks 0F50 (`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.etaleModuleLiftFShriekCompIso`)
induced on unbounded derived categories by
`CategoryTheory.Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIsoOfCompIso`;
then the map `(h' ≫ h)_! ∘ Rf''_* ⟶ Rf_* ∘ (g' ≫ g)_!` of the outer rectangle is the composite
```
h_! ∘ h'_! ∘ Rf''_* ⟶ h_! ∘ Rf'_* ∘ g'_! ⟶ Rf_* ∘ g_! ∘ g'_!
```
of the maps of the two squares. The statement holds for every choice of the three right derived
functors `Rf''_*`, `Rf'_*`, `Rf_*` of the direct images on the unbounded homotopy categories.

The source calls the maps of [Stacks, Tag 0F7B] isomorphisms; that they are is
[Stacks, Tag 0F7B] itself, whose proof rests on proper base change, [Stacks, Tag 0DDF], and it is
not used here: the content of this tag is the identity between the maps, from which the identity
between the isomorphisms follows whenever they are isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem properBaseChangeMap_horizontal_paste (g' : X'' ⟶ X') (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (f'' : X'' ⟶ Y'') (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (f : X ⟶ Y) (h' : Y'' ⟶ Y') (h : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (w₁ : g' ≫ f' = f'' ≫ h') (w₂ : g ≫ f = f' ≫ h)
    [IsProper (B.inclusion.map f'')] [IsProper (B.inclusion.map f')]
    [IsProper (B.inclusion.map f)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map g')] [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map g')]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map g')]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map g)] [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map g)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map g)]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map h')] [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map h')]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map h')]
    [IsSeparated (B.inclusion.map h)] [LocallyQuasiFinite (B.inclusion.map h)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map h)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X'' Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X' Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y'' Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y' Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y Λ)]
    (RF'' : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X'' Λ) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y'' Λ))
    (αF'' : (etaleModuleLift B Λ (etalePushforward.{u, u + 1} B f'')).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RF'')
    (RF' : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X' Λ) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y' Λ))
    (αF' : (etaleModuleLift B Λ (etalePushforward.{u, u + 1} B f')).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RF')
    (RF : DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X Λ) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B Y Λ))
    (αF : (etaleModuleLift B Λ (etalePushforward.{u, u + 1} B f)).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RF)
    [RF''.IsRightDerivedFunctor αF''
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X'' Λ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [RF'.IsRightDerivedFunctor αF'
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleSheaf.{u, u, u} B X' Λ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    properBaseChangeMap B Λ (g' ≫ g) f'' f (h' ≫ h) (rectangle_comm_horizontal B w₁ w₂)
        RF'' αF'' RF αF =
      Functor.whiskerLeft RF''
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIsoOfCompIso
            (etaleModuleLiftFShriekCompIso B Λ h' h (h' ≫ h) rfl)).inv ≫
        (Functor.associator RF''
          (etaleModuleLift B Λ (fShriekFunctor.{u, u} B h')).mapDerivedCategory
          (etaleModuleLift B Λ (fShriekFunctor.{u, u} B h)).mapDerivedCategory).inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (properBaseChangeMap B Λ g' f'' f' h' w₁ RF'' αF'' RF' αF')
          (etaleModuleLift B Λ (fShriekFunctor.{u, u} B h)).mapDerivedCategory ≫
        (Functor.associator
          (etaleModuleLift B Λ (fShriekFunctor.{u, u} B g')).mapDerivedCategory RF'
