        (((K.truncLE k).shortComplexTruncLE (k - 1)).X₁.X i) ∧
      Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
        (((K.truncLE k).shortComplexTruncLE (k - 1)).X₂.X i) ∧
      Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
        (((K.truncLE k).shortComplexTruncLE (k - 1)).X₃.X i)
declarations.comment: the rows of the short exact sequences representing the truncation triangles

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.Eta.etaSectionsIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0F8M], second assertion.** Let `Y` be a scheme, let `D ⊆ Y` be an effective
Cartier divisor with ideal sheaf `I ⊆ 𝒪_Y`, and let `F^•` be a complex of quasi-coherent
`𝒪_Y`-modules whose terms are `I`-torsion free. If `U ⊆ Y` is affine open and `D ∩ U = V(f)`,
then `η_f(F^•(U))` is canonically isomorphic to `(η_I F^•)(U)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def etaSectionsIso (D : Y.IdealSheafData)
    [Stacks.Divisors.IsEffectiveCartierDivisor D]
    (F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} Oᵧ) ℤ)
    (_hqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (F.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (htf : ∀ n : ℤ,
      Stacks.IdealTorsion.IsIdealTorsionFree Y.toRingedSpace (idealSheafι D) (F.X n))
    (U : Y.Opens) (_hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (g : (idealSheaf D).val.obj (op U))
    (hg : Stacks.IdealTorsion.GeneratesIdealOn Y.toRingedSpace U g) :
    EtaComplex.etaObject
        (Stacks.IdealTorsion.Eta.generatorSection Y.toRingedSpace (idealSheafι D) U g)
        (Stacks.IdealTorsion.Eta.sectionsComplex Y.toRingedSpace F U) ≅
      Stacks.IdealTorsion.Eta.sectionsComplex Y.toRingedSpace
        (etaObj Y.toRingedSpace (idealSheaf D) (idealSheafι D) F htf) U
declarations.comment: the affine comparison of eta complexes

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.Eta.isQuasicoherent_etaObj
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0F8M], first assertion.** Let `X` be a scheme, let `D ⊆ X` be an effective
Cartier divisor with ideal sheaf `I ⊆ 𝒪_X`, and let `F^•` be a complex of quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-modules whose terms are `I`-torsion free. Then `η_I F^•` is a complex of quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_etaObj (D : X.IdealSheafData)
    [Stacks.Divisors.IsEffectiveCartierDivisor D] (F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} Oₓ) ℤ)
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (F.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (htf : ∀ n : ℤ,
      Stacks.IdealTorsion.IsIdealTorsionFree X.toRingedSpace (idealSheafι D) (F.X n))
    (n : ℤ) :
    ((etaObj X.toRingedSpace (idealSheaf D) (idealSheafι D) F htf).X n).IsQuasicoherent
declarations.comment: eta is a complex of quasi-coherent modules

declarations.name: Stacks.IdealTorsion.Eta.etaCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F8N.**  In Situation 0GT4, for a complex `F` of `I`-torsion-free
`O_X`-modules there is a canonical isomorphism
`I^{⊗ n} ⊗ (H^n(F)/H^n(F)[I]) ≅ H^n(η_I F)` of cohomology sheaves, where `H^n(F)[I]` is the
subsheaf of `H^n(F)` annihilated by `I`, realized as the ideal-power annihilator subsheaf of
Tag 0GT5, and the quotient as the cokernel of its inclusion.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def etaCohomologyIso (I : SheafOfModules.{u} Oₓ) (ι : I ⟶ 𝒪) [Mono ι]
    [Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf (Oₓ).property I]
    (F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} Oₓ) ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, IsIdealTorsionFree X ι (F.X n))
    (n : ℤ) :
    idealPowerTerm X I n
        (cokernel (idealPowerAnnihilatorSubsheaf X ι (F.homology n) 1).ι) ≅
      (etaObj X I ι F hF).homology n

declarations.name: Stacks.IdealTorsion.Eta.etaCohomologyIso_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F8N.**  The isomorphism of Tag 0F8N is the one the source writes
down: precomposed with the twisted quotient map it is `etaHomologyMap`, which by
`etaHomologyMap_cycles` and `etaCyclesIso_hom_fst` sends a twisted cocycle `g ⊗ s` to the class
of the cocycle of `η_I F` with underlying section `g s`.  Since the twisted quotient map is an
epimorphism, this determines the isomorphism uniquely.
declarations.statement:
public theorem etaCohomologyIso_hom (I : SheafOfModules.{u} Oₓ) (ι : I ⟶ 𝒪) [Mono ι]
    [Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf (Oₓ).property I]
    (F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} Oₓ) ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, IsIdealTorsionFree X ι (F.X n))
    (n : ℤ) :
    idealPowerMap X I n
        (cokernel.π (idealPowerAnnihilatorSubsheaf X ι (F.homology n) 1).ι) ≫
      (etaCohomologyIso X I ι F hF n).hom = etaHomologyMap X I ι F hF n
declarations.comment: the canonical comparison

declarations.name: Stacks.IdealTorsion.Eta.quasiIso_etaMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F8P.**  In Situation 0GT4, if a map `a : F ⟶ G` of complexes of
`I`-torsion-free `O_X`-modules is a quasi-isomorphism, then so is the induced map
`η_I a : η_I F ⟶ η_I G` of décalages.
declarations.statement:
public theorem quasiIso_etaMap (I : SheafOfModules.{u} Oₓ) (ι : I ⟶ 𝒪) [Mono ι]
    [Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj (Oₓ).property I]
    {F G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} Oₓ) ℤ} (a : F ⟶ G)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, IsIdealTorsionFree X ι (F.X n))
    (hG : ∀ n : ℤ, IsIdealTorsionFree X ι (G.X n))
    (ha : QuasiIso a) :
    QuasiIso (etaMap X I ι a hF hG)

declarations.name: Stacks.IdealTorsion.Eta.derivedEtaOfRegular
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F8Q.**  In Situation 0GT4 — `I ⊂ O_X` an ideal sheaf locally
generated by a section that is a nonzerodivisor on `O_X` — there is an additive functor
`Lη_I : D(O_X) ⥤ D(O_X)` whose value on an object represented by a complex `F` of
`I`-torsion-free `O_X`-modules is the class of the décalage `η_I F`, and likewise on morphisms;
`derivedEtaOfRegular_iso` records that comparison and `derivedEtaOfRegular_additive` the
additivity.  The functor is *not* exact: it does not take distinguished triangles to
distinguished triangles, and no such statement is made here.

The termwise `I`-torsion-free resolutions on which the construction rests are supplied by
`hregl`, not assumed.  The form that assumes them, `derivedEta`, is the one to use for an ideal
whose resolutions are available without local generation by a nonzerodivisor — as happens for
the pullback of `I` along a morphism of ringed spaces, and in the comparison of two ideals.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def derivedEtaOfRegular (I : SheafOfModules.{u} Oₓ) (ι : I ⟶ 𝒪) [Mono ι]
    (hregl : IsLocallyGeneratedByRegular X ι) :
    DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} Oₓ) ⥤ DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} Oₓ)

declarations.name: Stacks.IdealTorsion.Eta.derivedEtaOfRegular_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F8Q.**  In Situation 0GT4, on an object of `D(O_X)` represented by a
complex `F` of `I`-torsion-free `O_X`-modules, and on morphisms of such complexes, the derived
décalage is the class of the chain-level décalage `η_I F`.  The form of this comparison that
assumes the torsion-free resolutions is `derivedEta_iso`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def derivedEtaOfRegular_iso (I : SheafOfModules.{u} Oₓ) (ι : I ⟶ 𝒪)
    [Mono ι] (hregl : IsLocallyGeneratedByRegular X ι) :
    letI := Stacks.IdealTorsion.isInvertible_of_isLocallyGeneratedByRegular X ι hregl
    torsionFreeToDerived X ι ⋙ derivedEtaOfRegular X I ι hregl ≅
      etaFunctor X I ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q
declarations.comment: the comparison with the chain-level décalage

declarations.name: Stacks.IdealTorsion.Eta.derivedEtaOfRegular_additive
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F8Q.**  In Situation 0GT4 the derived décalage is additive.  The
form of this statement that assumes the torsion-free resolutions is `derivedEta_additive`.
declarations.statement:
public instance derivedEtaOfRegular_additive (I : SheafOfModules.{u} Oₓ) (ι : I ⟶ 𝒪) [Mono ι]
    (hregl : IsLocallyGeneratedByRegular X ι) :
    (derivedEtaOfRegular X I ι hregl).Additive
declarations.comment: additivity

declarations.name: Stacks.IdealTorsion.Eta.hasTorsionFreeResolutions_of_isLocallyGeneratedByRegular
declarations.doc:
**Termwise `I`-torsion-free resolutions exist.**  For an ideal sheaf locally generated by a
nonzerodivisor, every cochain complex of `O_X`-modules receives a quasi-isomorphism from a
complex of `I`-torsion-free `O_X`-modules.  This is the first step of the proof of
[Stacks, Tag 0F8Q]: a resolution with flat terms exists by Tag 06YS, and a flat module is
`I`-torsion free by the third criterion of Tag 0GT5.
declarations.statement:
public theorem hasTorsionFreeResolutions_of_isLocallyGeneratedByRegular
    (I : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheaf X.sheaf))
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit (structureSheaf X.sheaf)) (hι : Mono ι)
    (hregl : Stacks.IdealTorsion.IsLocallyGeneratedByRegular X ι) :
    HasTorsionFreeResolutions X ι
declarations.comment: the existence of termwise I-torsion-free resolutions of unbounded complexes, the first step of the proof

declarations.name: Stacks.IdealTorsion.Eta.hasTorsionFreeResolutions_of_isInvertible
declarations.doc:
**Termwise `I`-torsion-free resolutions exist for an invertible ideal sheaf.**  On a ringed
space whose stalks are local rings an invertible ideal sheaf is locally generated by a
nonzerodivisor, so every cochain complex of `O_X`-modules receives a quasi-isomorphism from a
complex of `I`-torsion-free modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem hasTorsionFreeResolutions_of_isInvertible
    [∀ x : X.carrier, IsLocalRing
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.TensorStalkRingedSpace.ringStalk X x)]
    (I : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheaf X.sheaf))
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit (structureSheaf X.sheaf)) (hι : Mono ι)
    (hI : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf
      (structureSheafRing X).property I) :
    HasTorsionFreeResolutions X ι
declarations.comment: the existence of termwise I-torsion-free resolutions of unbounded complexes for an invertible ideal sheaf on a ringed space whose stalks are local rings

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.Eta.hasTorsionFreeResolutions
declarations.doc:
**Termwise `I`-torsion-free resolutions exist for an effective Cartier divisor.**  Every
cochain complex of `𝒪_X`-modules receives a quasi-isomorphism from a complex whose terms are
annihilated by no nonzero section of the ideal sheaf: the ideal sheaf is invertible and the
stalks of `𝒪_X` are local rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorsionFreeResolutions (D : X.IdealSheafData)
    [Stacks.Divisors.IsEffectiveCartierDivisor D] :
    HasTorsionFreeResolutions X.toRingedSpace (idealSheafι D)
declarations.comment: the existence of termwise I-torsion-free resolutions for the ideal sheaf of an effective Cartier divisor on a scheme

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.Eta.derivedEtaData
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F8Q, for an effective Cartier divisor on a scheme.**  The derived
décalage `Lη_I : D(𝒪_X) ⟶ D(𝒪_X)`, its identification with the chain-level décalage `η_I` on
complexes of `I`-torsion-free `𝒪_X`-modules, and the fact that every object of `D(𝒪_X)` is
represented by such a complex.
declarations.statement:
def derivedEtaData (D : X.IdealSheafData)
    [Stacks.Divisors.IsEffectiveCartierDivisor D] : DerivedEta D
declarations.comment: the functor, its comparison with the chain-level décalage and the representability of every object, for the ideal sheaf of an effective Cartier divisor on a scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F8S.** The standing situation of a perfect derived object on a
scheme together with an effective Cartier divisor on that scheme.
declarations.statement: structure ComplexAndDivisorSituation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.AffineChart.restrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8T, part (1), for the inclusion of an affine open into a chart.**  An affine
chart `(U, A, f, M^•)` for a triple `(X, D, M)` as in Situation 0F8S restricts to an affine chart
over any affine open `V ⊆ U`: its equation is the restriction `f|_V`, and its bounded complex of
finite free modules is the base change `M^• ⊗_A Γ(X, V)`, i.e. the complex whose differentials
are the entrywise images of those of `M^•` under `A ⟶ Γ(X, V)`.

That `f|_V` is again a nonzerodivisor is
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.isRegular_presheaf_map_of_le`, the restriction between affine
opens being flat; that it cuts out `D ∩ V` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_ideal`; and that `M^• ⊗_A Γ(X, V)` represents the
restriction of `M` is `restrictRepresentsIso`.
declarations.statement:
def restrict (C : AffineChart S) (V : S.X.affineOpens)
    (hle : (V : S.X.Opens) ≤ (C.U : S.X.Opens)) : AffineChart S
declarations.comment: part (1) in the case `h = 𝟙 X`: the restriction of an affine chart to a smaller affine open `V ⊆ U` is an affine chart, with representing complex `M^• ⊗_A Γ(X, V)`. The case of a general `h` is AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.AffineChart.pullback in StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Flatness.BlowUpSquare.ChartPullback, which carries the tag too.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.AffineChart.map_determinantalIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0F8T, second assertion.** For an affine chart `(U, A, f, M^•)` and a
ring map `φ : A ⟶ B`, the ideal generated in `B` by the determinantal ideal `I_i(M^•, f)` is the
determinantal ideal `I_i(M^• ⊗_A B, φ f)` of the base-changed chart data.
declarations.statement:
public theorem map_determinantalIdeal (C : AffineChart S) {B : Type u} [CommRing B]
    (φ : Γ(S.X, C.U) →+* B) (i : ℤ) :
    Ideal.map φ (C.determinantalIdeal i) = idealI (C.complex.baseChange φ) (φ C.f) i
declarations.comment: the determinantal ideals of an affine chart under base change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.AffineChart.pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8T, part (1).**  Let `(X, D, M)` be a triple as in Situation 0F8S, let
`h : Y ⟶ X` be a morphism of schemes along which the pullback `E = h⁻¹D` of the divisor is
defined, let `(U, A, f, M^•)` be an affine chart for `(X, D, M)` and let `V = Spec(B) ⊆ Y` be an
affine open with `h(V) ⊆ U`.  Then `(V, B, g, M^• ⊗_A B)`, with `g ∈ B` the image of `f`, is an
affine chart for `(Y, E, Lh^*M)`.

That `g` is a nonzerodivisor is `isRegular_pullbackRingHom_f`; that it cuts out `E ∩ V` is
`comap_ideal_eq_span`; and that `M^• ⊗_A B` represents the restriction of `Lh^*M` to `V` is
`pullbackRepresentsIso`.
declarations.comment: part (1): an affine chart pulls back, along an arbitrary morphism `h` for which the pullback of the divisor is defined, to an affine chart of the pulled-back triple over any affine open of the source lying over its domain

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.isGoodTriple_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8T, part (3).**  If `(X, D, M)` is a good triple and `h : Y ⟶ X` is a
morphism of schemes along which the pullback `E = h⁻¹D` of the divisor is defined, then
`(Y, E, Lh^*M)` is a good triple.

A point of `E` maps into `D`, so it has an affine chart `(U, A, f, M^•)` of `(X, D, M)` over it
with principal determinantal ideals; the preimage of `U` is an open neighbourhood of the point,
so it contains an affine open `V` containing it; and part (1) turns the chart into a chart of
`(Y, E, Lh^*M)` over `V`, whose determinantal ideals are principal by part (2).
declarations.comment: part (3): goodness of a triple is inherited by the pulled-back triple

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.KFlatDerivedPullback.isPerfect_uniqFunctor_obj
declarations.doc:
**Perfectness survives a change of model of the derived category.**  The canonical
equivalence between two localizations of the complexes at the quasi-isomorphisms carries a
perfect object to a perfect object: the representative does not change, and the isomorphism
exhibiting it is composed with `CategoryTheory.Localization.compUniqFunctor`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_uniqFunctor_obj {X : RingedSpace.{u, u}}
    (inst₁ : HasDerivedCategory.{d} (OXMod.{u, u} X))
    (inst₂ : HasDerivedCategory.{d'} (OXMod.{u, u} X))
    (K : @DerivedCategory (OXMod.{u, u} X) _ _ inst₁)
    (hK : @Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect.{u, u, d} X inst₁ K) :
    @Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect.{u, u, d'} X inst₂
      ((Localization.uniq (@DerivedCategory.Q (OXMod.{u, u} X) _ _ inst₁)
        (@DerivedCategory.Q (OXMod.{u, u} X) _ _ inst₂)
        (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (OXMod.{u, u} X) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))).functor.obj K)

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.AffineChart.pullback_determinantalIdeal
registrations.comment: part (2) for a general `h`: the determinantal ideals of the chart base-changed along the ring map induced by `h` on the two affine opens

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.isPerfect_etaDerivedPullbackObject_goodBlowup
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8U.**  In Situation 0F8S let `b : X' ⟶ X` be the morphism of Stacks tag 0GTY
and `D' = b⁻¹D`, with ideal sheaf `ℐ'`.  Then `Q = Lη_{ℐ'}Lb^*M` is a perfect object of
`D(𝒪_{X'})`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_etaDerivedPullbackObject_goodBlowup :
    RingedSpace.IsPerfect (X := S.goodBlowup.toRingedSpace)
      (S.etaDerivedPullbackObject S.goodBlowupToBase
        S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase.pullbackDefined)
declarations.comment: `Q = Lη_{I'} Lb^* M` is perfect, for `b` the morphism goodBlowupToBase of tag 0GTY (existsUnique_isGoodBlowup), `Lη_{I'}` the derived décalage Stacks.Divisors.Eta.derivedEtaData of `D' = b⁻¹D` and `Lb^*` the derived pullback of modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.isPerfect_etaDerivedPullbackObject_goodBlowupToBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8U for the morphism `b : X' ⟶ X` of Stacks tag 0GTY.**  In Situation 0F8S let
`b` be the morphism of tag 0GTY and `D' = b⁻¹D` with ideal sheaf `ℐ'`.  Then
`Q = Lη_{ℐ'}Lb^*M` is a perfect object of `D(𝒪_{X'})`.

The morphism is `AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.goodBlowupToBase`; it satisfies
condition (1) of tag 0GTY by
`AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase`, so this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.isPerfect_etaDerivedPullbackObject_of_chartDecalage`
read at it.  The hypothesis `hcomp` is the affine-chart comparison for `Lη_{ℐ'}` described in
the module documentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_etaDerivedPullbackObject_goodBlowupToBase
    (hcomp : ChartDecalage
      (S.pullback S.goodBlowupToBase S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase.pullbackDefined)
      (@Stacks.Divisors.Eta.derivedEtaData S.goodBlowup (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase)
        S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase.pullbackDefined)) :
    RingedSpace.IsPerfect (X := S.goodBlowup.toRingedSpace)
      (S.etaDerivedPullbackObject S.goodBlowupToBase
        S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase.pullbackDefined)
declarations.comment: perfectness of `Q = Lη_{I'} Lb^* M` for the morphism `b` of tag 0GTY itself, namely AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.goodBlowupToBase, with the datum `hcomp` of the formalization of tag 0GTW: the second assertion of tag 0GTV read at an affine open of `X'`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.isPerfect_etaDerivedPullbackObject_of_isGoodOver_of_chartDecalage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8U, for a morphism good for the triple.**  Let `(X, D, M)` be a triple as in
Situation 0F8S and let `b : X' ⟶ X` be good for it — condition (1) of tag 0GTY, which the
morphism of that tag satisfies.  Then `Q = Lη_{ℐ'} Lb^*M` is a perfect object of `D(𝒪_{X'})`,
for every affine-chart comparison `hcomp` of the shape of the second assertion of tag 0GTV.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_etaDerivedPullbackObject_of_isGoodOver_of_chartDecalage
    (S : ComplexAndDivisorSituation.{u, d}) {X' : Scheme.{u}} (b : X' ⟶ S.X)
    (hb : S.IsGoodOver b)
    (hcomp : ChartDecalage (S.pullback b hb.pullbackDefined)
      (@Stacks.Divisors.Eta.derivedEtaData X' (S.D.comap b) hb.pullbackDefined)) :
    RingedSpace.IsPerfect (X := X'.toRingedSpace)
      (S.etaDerivedPullbackObject b hb.pullbackDefined)
declarations.comment: perfectness of `Q = Lη_{I'} Lb^* M` for any `b` satisfying condition (1) of tag 0GTY, with the datum `hcomp` of the formalization of tag 0GTW: the second assertion of tag 0GTV read at an affine open of the pulled-back scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.AffineChart.existsUnique_iso_strictTransform
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8V: the modification of the pulled-back triple is the strict transform.**  Let
`h : Y ⟶ X` be a morphism along which `E = h⁻¹D` is defined, let `b : X' ⟶ X` and `c : Y' ⟶ Y` be
the morphisms of Stacks tag 0GTY for `(X, D, M)` and `(Y, E, Lh^*M)`, and let `(U, A, f, M^•)` be
an affine chart for `(X, D, M)`.  Over `U` the morphism `b` is the blowing up of `U` in
`I = ∏ᵢ I_i(M^•, f)`, and `c⁻¹(h⁻¹U) ⟶ h⁻¹(U)` is identified, by exactly one isomorphism over
`h⁻¹(U)`, with the strict transform of `h⁻¹(U)` with respect to that blowing up.

Both are the blowing up of `h⁻¹(U)` in `I𝒪_{h⁻¹(U)}`: the first by
`AffineChart.isGoodBlowupOver_pullbackChartBlowupToBase` and the uniqueness of a morphism with
the two conditions of Stacks tag 0GTY over `h⁻¹(U)`, the second by Stacks tag 080E.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_iso_strictTransform (C : AffineChart S) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ S.X)
    (hD : Stacks.Divisors.IsPullbackDefined h S.D) :
    ∃! e : ((S.pullback h hD).goodBlowupToBase ⁻¹ᵁ
        (h ⁻¹ᵁ (C.U : S.X.Opens))).toScheme ≅
      Stacks.StrictTransform.scheme (h ∣_ (C.U : S.X.Opens))
        (AlgebraicGeometry.blowUpToBase C.blowupCentreIdealSheaf)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.exceptionalIdeal C.blowupCentreIdealSheaf),
      e.hom ≫ (Stacks.StrictTransform.ideal (h ∣_ (C.U : S.X.Opens))
            (AlgebraicGeometry.blowUpToBase C.blowupCentreIdealSheaf)
            (AlgebraicGeometry.exceptionalIdeal C.blowupCentreIdealSheaf)).subschemeι ≫
          pullback.fst (h ∣_ (C.U : S.X.Opens))
            (AlgebraicGeometry.blowUpToBase C.blowupCentreIdealSheaf) =
        (S.pullback h hD).goodBlowupToBase ∣_ (h ⁻¹ᵁ (C.U : S.X.Opens))
declarations.comment: the strict-transform assertion: over an affine chart `(U, A, f, M^•)`, the restriction of the morphism `c` of tag 0GTY for the pulled-back triple is identified, by exactly one isomorphism over `h⁻¹(U)`, with the strict transform of `h⁻¹(U)` with respect to the restriction of `b` over `U`, which is the blowing up of `U` in the product of the determinantal ideals of the chart

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.exists_lift_and_nonempty_etaDerivedPullbackObject_iso_of_isGoodBlowup
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8V, the displayed identification.**  Let `(X, D, M)` be a triple as in
Situation 0F8S, let `b : X' ⟶ X` have the two properties of tag 0GTY for `(X, D, M)`, and let
`Q = Lη_{ℐ'} Lb^*M` be the object of tag 0F8U.  Let `h : Y ⟶ X` be a morphism along which
`E = h^{-1}D` is defined and let `c : Y' ⟶ Y` have the two properties of tag 0GTY for
`(Y, E, Lh^*M)`.  Then there is a morphism `h' : Y' ⟶ X'` with `h' ∘ b = c ∘ h` — unique, by
property (2) of tag 0GTY — and for it

`Lη_{𝒥'} L(h ∘ c)^*M ≅ Lh'^* Q`,

where `𝒥'` is the ideal sheaf of `E' = c^{-1}E = (c ∘ h)^{-1}D`.

The morphism `h'` is produced by property (2) of `b` applied to `c ∘ h`, which is good for
`(X, D, M)` by `AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.isGoodOver_comp`.  The
identification is tag 0F9X
(`AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.nonempty_derivedPullback_derivedEta_iso`) at the
triple `(X', b^{-1}D, Lb^*M)`, which is good because `b` has property (1), followed by the
bookkeeping of
`AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.nonempty_etaDerivedPullbackObject_comp`: the
divisor `h'^{-1}(b^{-1}D)` *is* the divisor `(h' ∘ b)^{-1}D`, and the two routes to the
pulled-back object agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_lift_and_nonempty_etaDerivedPullbackObject_iso_of_isGoodBlowup
    (S : ComplexAndDivisorSituation.{u, d}) {X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    (b : X' ⟶ S.X) (hb : S.IsGoodBlowup b) (h : Y ⟶ S.X)
    (hD : Stacks.Divisors.IsPullbackDefined h S.D) (c : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hc : (S.pullback h hD).IsGoodBlowup c) :
    ∃ h' : Y' ⟶ X', h' ≫ b = c ≫ h ∧
      Nonempty ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
          h'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
            (S.etaDerivedPullbackObject b hb.isGoodOver.pullbackDefined) ≅
        S.etaDerivedPullbackObject (c ≫ h)
          ((S.isGoodOver_comp h hD c hc.isGoodOver.pullbackDefined).mpr
            hc.isGoodOver.isGoodTriple).pullbackDefined)
declarations.comment: the displayed identification: for `b` with the two properties of tag 0GTY for (X, D, M) and `c` with those properties for (Y, E, Lh^* M), the morphism `h' : Y' -> X'` over `h . c` satisfies `L eta_{J'} L(h . c)^* M ≅ L h'^* Q`. The sentence identifying `Y'` with the strict transform of `Y` with respect to `b` rests on the moreover clause of tag 0GTY --- that over an affine chart the restriction of `b` is the blowing up in the product of the determinantal ideals --- and is proved alongside that clause, as AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.AffineChart.existsUnique_iso_strictTransform in GoodBlowupStrictTransform.lean

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.exists_lift_and_nonempty_etaDerivedPullbackObject_iso_of_isGoodOver
declarations.doc:
Let `b : X' ⟶ X` satisfy `IsGoodBlowup`. If moreover `(Y, E, Lh^*M)` is a good triple, then
the unique `k : Y ⟶ X'` with `h = b ∘ k` satisfies

`Lη_𝒥 Lh^*M ≅ Lk^* Q`.

This is `exists_lift_and_nonempty_etaDerivedPullbackObject_iso_of_isGoodBlowup` at `c = 𝟙_Y`,
which satisfies `IsGoodBlowup` for an already good triple by `isGoodBlowup_id`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_lift_and_nonempty_etaDerivedPullbackObject_iso_of_isGoodOver
    (S : ComplexAndDivisorSituation.{u, d}) {X' Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (b : X' ⟶ S.X) (hb : S.IsGoodBlowup b) (h : Y ⟶ S.X) (hh : S.IsGoodOver h) :
    ∃ k : Y ⟶ X', k ≫ b = h ∧
      Nonempty ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
          k.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
            (S.etaDerivedPullbackObject b hb.isGoodOver.pullbackDefined) ≅
        S.etaDerivedPullbackObject h hh.pullbackDefined)
declarations.comment: the final assertion: for `b` with the two properties of tag 0GTY and `h` good for the triple, the unique `k` with `h = b . k` satisfies `L eta_J Lh^* M ≅ Lk^* Q`. It is the displayed identification at c = 1_Y; the displayed identification itself, for a general `c`, is exists_lift_and_nonempty_etaDerivedPullbackObject_iso_of_isGoodBlowup

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.exists_lift_isStrictTransform_and_etaDerivedPullbackObject_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8V.**  Let `(X, D, M)` be a triple as in Situation 0F8S, let `h : Y ⟶ X` be a
morphism such that `E = h⁻¹D` is defined, and let `b : X' ⟶ X` and `c : Y' ⟶ Y` have
properties (1) and (2) of Stacks tag 0GTY for `(X, D, M)` and for `(Y, E, Lh^*M)`.  Then:

* there is a unique `h' : Y' ⟶ X'` with `b ∘ h' = h ∘ c`;
* for every open `W ⊆ X` and every ideal sheaf `ℐ` on `W` with support inside `D` such that
  `b⁻¹(W) ⟶ W` is the blowing up of `W` in `ℐ`, the morphism `(h', c)` identifies `c⁻¹(h⁻¹W)`
  with the strict transform of `h⁻¹W` with respect to that blowing up: there is an isomorphism
  from `c⁻¹(h⁻¹W)` onto the strict transform whose composites with the two projections of
  `h⁻¹W ×_W Bl_ℐ W` are `c` and `h'`;
* `(h ∘ c)⁻¹D` is defined and `Lη_{𝒥'}L(h ∘ c)^*M ≅ Lh'^*Q`, where `Q = Lη_{ℐ'}Lb^*M`.

The last assertion of the tag, the case `c = 𝟙_Y`, is
`exists_lift_and_nonempty_etaDerivedPullbackObject_iso_of_isGoodOver`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_lift_isStrictTransform_and_etaDerivedPullbackObject_iso {X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    (b : X' ⟶ S.X) (hb : S.IsGoodBlowup b) (h : Y ⟶ S.X)
    (hE : Stacks.Divisors.IsPullbackDefined h S.D) (c : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hc : (S.pullback h hE).IsGoodBlowup c) :
    ∃ h' : Y' ⟶ X', h' ≫ b = c ≫ h ∧ (∀ k : Y' ⟶ X', k ≫ b = c ≫ h → k = h') ∧
      (∀ (W : S.X.Opens) (I : W.toScheme.IdealSheafData),
        Disjoint ((W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ S.D.support.compl : W.toScheme.Opens) : Set W.toScheme)
          (I.support : Set W.toScheme) →
        ∀ e : blowUp I ≅ (b ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme,
          e.hom ≫ (b ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ b = blowUpToBase I ≫ W.ι →
          ∃ φ : (c ⁻¹ᵁ (h ⁻¹ᵁ W)).toScheme ≅
              (Stacks.StrictTransform.ideal (h ∣_ W) (blowUpToBase I)
                (exceptionalIdeal I)).subscheme,
            φ.hom ≫ (Stacks.StrictTransform.ideal (h ∣_ W) (blowUpToBase I)
                (exceptionalIdeal I)).subschemeι ≫ pullback.fst (h ∣_ W) (blowUpToBase I) ≫
                (h ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι = (c ⁻¹ᵁ (h ⁻¹ᵁ W)).ι ≫ c ∧
            φ.hom ≫ (Stacks.StrictTransform.ideal (h ∣_ W) (blowUpToBase I)
                (exceptionalIdeal I)).subschemeι ≫ pullback.snd (h ∣_ W) (blowUpToBase I) ≫
                e.hom ≫ (b ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι = (c ⁻¹ᵁ (h ⁻¹ᵁ W)).ι ≫ h') ∧
      ∃ hJ' : Stacks.Divisors.IsPullbackDefined (c ≫ h) S.D,
        Nonempty (S.etaDerivedPullbackObject (c ≫ h) hJ' ≅
          (derivedPullback h'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
            (S.etaDerivedPullbackObject b hb.isGoodOver.pullbackDefined))
declarations.comment: the strict transform assertion, for every blowing up structure on b over an open W whose centre is supported in D, and the identification Lη_J' L(h ∘ c)^* M ≅ L(h')^* Q; the last assertion is `exists_lift_and_nonempty_etaDerivedPullbackObject_iso_of_isGoodOver`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.isIso_pullback_snd_goodBlowupToBase_locallyFreeLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8W.**  In Situation 0F8S let `W ⊂ X` be the maximal open subscheme over which
the cohomology sheaves of `M` are locally free.  The morphism `b : X' ⟶ X` of Stacks tag 0GTY is
an isomorphism over `W`.

Over an affine chart `(U, A, f, M^•)` the morphism `b` is the blowing up of `U` in the product
`∏ᵢ I_i(M^•, f)` of the determinantal ideals of the chart, by
`exists_iso_pullback_blowUp_goodBlowupToBase`; on a chart contained in `W` that centre is locally
generated by a power of the equation `f` of the divisor, hence an effective Cartier divisor, so
blowing up in it changes nothing (`AffineChart.isIso_blowUpToBase_of_le_locallyFreeLocus`); and the
charts contained in `W` cover `W` because the chart domains form a basis of the topology of `X`
(`exists_chart_mem_le`).  Being an isomorphism is Zariski local on the target, so the chart-local
statement globalises.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_pullback_snd_goodBlowupToBase_locallyFreeLocus :
    IsIso (Limits.pullback.snd S.goodBlowupToBase S.locallyFreeLocus.ι)
declarations.comment: the morphism `b : X' ⟶ X` of tag 0GTY is an isomorphism over the maximal open `W ⊆ X` on which the cohomology sheaves of `M` are locally free

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.isIso_morphismRestrict_goodBlowupToBase_locallyFreeLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8W, written as the restriction of `b` over `W`.**  The morphism
`b ∣_ W : b⁻¹W ⟶ W` induced by the morphism of tag 0GTY is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_morphismRestrict_goodBlowupToBase_locallyFreeLocus :
    IsIso (S.goodBlowupToBase ∣_ S.locallyFreeLocus)
declarations.comment: the restriction `b ∣_ W : b^{-1}W ⟶ W` of the morphism of tag 0GTY over the maximal open `W ⊆ X` on which the cohomology sheaves of `M` are locally free is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.AffineChart.isIso_blowUpToBase_of_le_locallyFreeLocus
declarations.doc:
**The affine-chart case of Stacks tag 0F8W.**  Over an affine chart contained in the
locally free locus `W` the centre `∏ᵢ I_i(M^•, f)` in which tag 0GTY blows the chart up is an
effective Cartier divisor, so blowing the chart up in it is an isomorphism; by tag 0GTY that
blowup is the restriction `b⁻¹(U) → U` of `b`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_blowUpToBase_of_le_locallyFreeLocus (C : AffineChart S)
    (hCW : C.U.1 ≤ S.locallyFreeLocus) :
    IsIso (AlgebraicGeometry.blowUpToBase C.blowupCentreIdealSheaf)
declarations.comment:
the affine-chart case: over an affine chart contained in the locally free locus
`W` the centre in which tag 0GTY blows the chart up is locally generated by a power of the
equation of the divisor, hence an effective Cartier divisor, so blowing the chart up in that
centre is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.isIso_pullback_snd_locallyFreeLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8W.**  In Situation 0F8S let `W ⊂ X` be the maximal open subscheme over
which the cohomology sheaves of `M` are locally free.  A morphism `b : X' ⟶ X` which over
every affine chart `(U, A, f, M^•)` of the triple is the blowing up of `U` in the product
`∏ᵢ I_i(M^•, f)` of its determinantal ideals — as the morphism of tag 0GTY is — is an
isomorphism over `W`, provided every point of `W` lies in an affine chart contained in `W`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_pullback_snd_locallyFreeLocus {X' : Scheme.{u}} (b : X' ⟶ S.X)
    (hchart : ∀ C : AffineChart S, ∃ e : Limits.pullback b C.U.1.ι ≅
        AlgebraicGeometry.blowUp C.blowupCentreIdealSheaf,
      e.hom ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.blowUpToBase C.blowupCentreIdealSheaf
        = Limits.pullback.snd b C.U.1.ι)
    (hcov : ∀ x ∈ S.locallyFreeLocus, ∃ C : AffineChart S,
      x ∈ C.U.1 ∧ C.U.1 ≤ S.locallyFreeLocus) :
    IsIso (Limits.pullback.snd b S.locallyFreeLocus.ι)
declarations.comment: the general form, over an arbitrary morphism which has the affine-chart description of tag 0GTY: a morphism which over every affine chart is the blowing up of that chart in the product of its determinantal ideals is an isomorphism over `W`, for an open `W` covered by the affine charts contained in it. The tag for the morphism tag 0GTY produces, with both descriptions discharged, is AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.isIso_pullback_snd_goodBlowupToBase_locallyFreeLocus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.locallyOfFinitePresentation_and_comap_eq_bot_of_isGoodOver
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0F8S let `b : X' ⟶ X` be good for the triple — condition (1) of tag 0GTY —
so that `D' = b⁻¹D` is defined and `(X', D', Lb^*M)` is a good triple, let `W ⊆ X` be the
maximal open over which the cohomology sheaves of `M` are locally free, and suppose that
`b⁻¹W ↪ X' ⟶ X` is flat. Let `T ⊆ D'` be a closed subscheme whose ideal over `D' ∩ U` is the
total obstruction ideal `J(N^•, g)` of More on Algebra, tag 0F81 for every affine chart
`(U, g, N^•)` of the pulled-back triple with principal determinantal ideals. Then

* the closed immersion `i : T ⟶ D'` is locally of finite presentation, and
* `D' ∩ b⁻¹(W) ⊆ T` scheme theoretically: the inverse image on `D' ∩ b⁻¹(W)` of the ideal sheaf
  of `T` is zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyOfFinitePresentation_and_comap_eq_bot_of_isGoodOver
    {X' : Scheme.{u}} (b : X' ⟶ S.X) (hb : S.IsGoodOver b)
    (hflat : AlgebraicGeometry.Flat ((b ⁻¹ᵁ S.locallyFreeLocus).ι ≫ b))
    (T : (S.pullback b hb.pullbackDefined).D.subscheme.IdealSheafData)
    (hT : ∀ C : AffineChart (S.pullback b hb.pullbackDefined),
      (∀ i : ℤ, (C.determinantalIdeal i).IsPrincipal) →
        T.ideal C.divisorAffineOpen = C.obstructionIdeal) :
    LocallyOfFinitePresentation T.subschemeι ∧
      T.comap ((S.pullback b hb.pullbackDefined).D.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ
        (b ⁻¹ᵁ S.locallyFreeLocus)).ι = ⊥
declarations.comment: the finite presentation of `i : T → b^{-1}D` and part (1), in the general form: over any `b` satisfying condition (1) of tag 0GTY and flat over `W` --- which is what Tag 0F8W supplies for the morphism tag 0GTY produces --- and for a closed subscheme `T` of `b^{-1}D` given to cut out the obstruction ideal of Tag 0F81 on every good chart of the pulled-back triple, as in Tag 0GTZ. Parts (2) and (3) specialize parts (2) and (3) of Tag 0GTZ, which need the chart-level comparison AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.ChartDecalage over and above Tag 08DW --- that tag being proved in both its parts. The tag over the morphism tag 0GTY produces is AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.locallyOfFinitePresentation_and_comap_eq_bot_goodBlowupToBase

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.locallyOfFinitePresentation_and_comap_eq_bot_goodBlowupToBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8X for the morphism `b : X' ⟶ X` of Stacks tag 0GTY: the finite presentation
of the closed immersion `i : T ⟶ D'` and part (1).**  Let `b` be the morphism of tag 0GTY, so
that `D' = b⁻¹D` is defined and `(X', D', Lb^*M)` is a good triple, and let `W ⊆ X` be the
maximal open over which the cohomology sheaves of `M` are locally free.  Let `T ⊆ D'` be a closed
subscheme whose ideal over `D' ∩ V` is the total obstruction ideal `J(N^•, g)` of More on
Algebra, tag 0F81 for every affine chart `(V, g, N^•)` of the pulled-back triple with principal
determinantal ideals.  Then

* the closed immersion `i : T ⟶ D'` is locally of finite presentation, and
* `D' ∩ b⁻¹(W) ⊆ T` scheme theoretically.

This is `locallyOfFinitePresentation_and_comap_eq_bot_of_isGoodOver` read at `goodBlowupToBase`:
condition (1) of tag 0GTY holds for it by `isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase`, and the flatness of
`b⁻¹W ↪ X' ⟶ X` is Stacks tag 0F8W, `flat_ι_comp_goodBlowupToBase_locallyFreeLocus`.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyOfFinitePresentation_and_comap_eq_bot_goodBlowupToBase
    (T : (S.pullback S.goodBlowupToBase
      S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase.pullbackDefined).D.subscheme.IdealSheafData)
    (hT : ∀ C : AffineChart (S.pullback S.goodBlowupToBase
        S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase.pullbackDefined),
      (∀ i : ℤ, (C.determinantalIdeal i).IsPrincipal) →
        T.ideal C.divisorAffineOpen = C.obstructionIdeal) :
    LocallyOfFinitePresentation T.subschemeι ∧
      T.comap ((S.pullback S.goodBlowupToBase
        S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase.pullbackDefined).D.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ
          (S.goodBlowupToBase ⁻¹ᵁ S.locallyFreeLocus)).ι = ⊥
declarations.comment: the finite presentation of `i : T → b^{-1}D` and part (1), stated for the morphism `b` of tag 0GTY itself --- namely AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.goodBlowupToBase, whose flatness over `W` is tag 0F8W --- and for a closed subscheme `T` of `b^{-1}D` given to cut out the obstruction ideal of Tag 0F81 on every good chart of the pulled-back triple, as in the formalized Tag 0GTZ. Parts (2) and (3) specialize parts (2) and (3) of Tag 0GTZ, which need the chart-level comparison AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.ChartDecalage over and above Tag 08DW --- that tag being formalized in both its parts

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.exists_closedSubscheme_goodBlowup
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0F8X.**  In Situation 0F8S let `b : X' ⟶ X` be the morphism of tag 0GTY,
`D' = b⁻¹D`, `Q = Lη_{ℐ'}Lb^*M` as in tag 0F8U, and `W ⊆ X` the maximal open where the
cohomology sheaves of `M` are locally free.  There is a closed subscheme `T ⊆ D'`, with
inclusion `i : T ⟶ D'` locally of finite presentation, such that
1. `D' ∩ b⁻¹(W) ⊆ T` scheme theoretically,
2. the cohomology sheaves of `Li^*Q` are finite locally free, and
3. for `t ∈ T` mapping to `x ∈ W`, `H^n(Li^*Q)_t` is free over `𝒪_{T,t}` of the rank of
   `H^n(M)_x` over `𝒪_{X,x}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_closedSubscheme_goodBlowup :
    ∃ T : (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subscheme.IdealSheafData,
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation T.subschemeι ∧
      T.comap ((S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ
          (S.goodBlowupToBase ⁻¹ᵁ S.locallyFreeLocus)).ι = ⊥ ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
        (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology S.goodBlowupToBase
          S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase.pullbackDefined
          (T.subschemeι ≫ (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) n)) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : T.subscheme)
        (_ : ((T.subschemeι ≫ (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) ≫
          S.goodBlowupToBase).base t ∈ S.locallyFreeLocus),
        letI F := S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology S.goodBlowupToBase
          S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase.pullbackDefined
          (T.subschemeι ≫ (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) n
        letI x := ((T.subschemeι ≫ (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) ≫
          S.goodBlowupToBase).base t
        letI : Module (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk T.subscheme.presheaf t))
            (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf t)) :=
          RingedSpace.moduleStalk (X := T.subscheme.toRingedSpace) F t
        letI : Module (ToType (S.X.presheaf.stalk x))
            (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (S.cohomologySheaf n).val.presheaf x)) :=
          RingedSpace.moduleStalk (X := S.X.toRingedSpace) (S.cohomologySheaf n) x
        Module.Free (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk T.subscheme.presheaf t))
            (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf t)) ∧
          Module.finrank (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk T.subscheme.presheaf t))
              (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf t)) =
            Module.finrank (ToType (S.X.presheaf.stalk x))
              (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (S.cohomologySheaf n).val.presheaf x))
declarations.comment: the closed immersion `i : T → D'` of finite presentation (locally of finite presentation) with parts (1), (2) and (3), for the morphism `b` of tag 0GTY, AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.goodBlowupToBase; `Li^*Q` is etaDerivedPullbackRestrict of `Q = Lη_{ℐ'}Lb^*M` along `T → D' → X'`, and the rank of a free stalk is Module.finrank

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.exists_closedSubscheme_etaDerivedPullback_goodBlowupToBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8X.**  Let `b : X' ⟶ X` be the morphism of Stacks tag 0GTY, `D' = b⁻¹D` and
`Q = Lη_{ℐ'}Lb^*M`, and let `W ⊆ X` be the locally free locus of `M`.  There is a closed
immersion `i : T ⟶ D'` of finite presentation such that
1. `D' ∩ b⁻¹(W) ⊆ T` scheme-theoretically,
2. the cohomology sheaves of `L(i ≫ D' ⟶ X')^*Q` are finite locally free, and
3. at a point `t ∈ T` over `W` the rank of `H^n(L(i ≫ D' ⟶ X')^*Q)` at `t` is the rank of
   `H^n(M)` at the image of `t`.

`T` is the closed subscheme of Stacks tag 0GTZ for the pulled-back triple.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_closedSubscheme_etaDerivedPullback_goodBlowupToBase :
    ∃ T : (S.pullback S.goodBlowupToBase
        S.isGoodBlowup_goodBlowupToBase.isGoodOver.pullbackDefined).D.subscheme.IdealSheafData,
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation T.subschemeι ∧
      T.comap ((S.pullback S.goodBlowupToBase
          S.isGoodBlowup_goodBlowupToBase.isGoodOver.pullbackDefined).D.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ
            (S.goodBlowupToBase ⁻¹ᵁ S.locallyFreeLocus)).ι = ⊥ ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
        (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology S.goodBlowupToBase
          S.isGoodBlowup_goodBlowupToBase.isGoodOver.pullbackDefined
          (T.subschemeι ≫ (S.pullback S.goodBlowupToBase
            S.isGoodBlowup_goodBlowupToBase.isGoodOver.pullbackDefined).D.subschemeι) n)) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : T.subscheme),
        ((T.subschemeι ≫ (S.pullback S.goodBlowupToBase
          S.isGoodBlowup_goodBlowupToBase.isGoodOver.pullbackDefined).D.subschemeι) ≫
            S.goodBlowupToBase) t ∈ S.locallyFreeLocus →
        Scheme.Modules.fiberRank (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology S.goodBlowupToBase
            S.isGoodBlowup_goodBlowupToBase.isGoodOver.pullbackDefined
            (T.subschemeι ≫ (S.pullback S.goodBlowupToBase
              S.isGoodBlowup_goodBlowupToBase.isGoodOver.pullbackDefined).D.subschemeι) n) t =
          Scheme.Modules.fiberRank (S.cohomologySheaf n)
            (((T.subschemeι ≫ (S.pullback S.goodBlowupToBase
              S.isGoodBlowup_goodBlowupToBase.isGoodOver.pullbackDefined).D.subschemeι) ≫
                S.goodBlowupToBase) t)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.exists_isClopen_rankStratum_etaDerivedPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8Y.**  In Situation 0F8S let `b : X' ⟶ X` be a morphism along which the
pullback `D' = b⁻¹D` of the effective Cartier divisor is defined, let
`Q = Lη_{ℐ'}Lb^*M` be as in Stacks tag 0F8U, let `i : T ⟶ D'` be as in Stacks tag 0F8X and let
`ρ = (ρ_n)_{n ∈ ℤ}` be ranks.  Then there is an open and closed `T(ρ) ⊆ T` which contains the
inverse image in `T` of `W(ρ)`, the rank-`ρ` stratum of the cohomology sheaves of `M` on the
locally free locus `W`, and on which `H^n(Li^*Q)` is free of rank `ρ_n` near every point.

`T(ρ)` is the rank stratum of the family `H^n(Li^*Q)`, as in the source.  It is open and closed
by `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isClopen_rankStratumSet`; the containment is the rank
agreement `hrank` of tag 0F8X (3) read against the definition of `W(ρ)`, which is the source's
own one-line proof; and the local freeness is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_free_nbhd_of_mem_rankStratumSet`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isClopen_rankStratum_etaDerivedPullback
    (S : ComplexAndDivisorSituation.{u, d}) {X' : Scheme.{u}} (b : X' ⟶ S.X)
    (hb : Stacks.Divisors.IsPullbackDefined b S.D) {T : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : T ⟶ (S.D.comap b).subscheme) (ρ : ℤ → ℕ)
    (hQ : ∀ n : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
      (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology b hb (i ≫ (S.D.comap b).subschemeι) n))
    (hbd : ∀ t : T, ∃ V : T.Opens, t ∈ V ∧ ∃ s : Finset ℤ, ∀ n ∉ s, ∀ v ∈ V,
      @Scheme.Modules.finiteLocallyFreeRank T
        (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology b hb (i ≫ (S.D.comap b).subschemeι) n)
        (hQ n) v = 0)
    (hM : ∀ n : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
      (S.locallyFreeLocusCohomologySheaf n))
    (hrank : ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : T)
      (hw : ((i ≫ (S.D.comap b).subschemeι) ≫ b).base t ∈ S.locallyFreeLocus),
      @Scheme.Modules.finiteLocallyFreeRank T
          (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology b hb (i ≫ (S.D.comap b).subschemeι) n)
          (hQ n) t =
        @Scheme.Modules.finiteLocallyFreeRank S.locallyFreeLocus.toScheme
          (S.locallyFreeLocusCohomologySheaf n) (hM n)
          ⟨((i ≫ (S.D.comap b).subschemeι) ≫ b).base t, hw⟩) :
    ∃ Tρ : Set T, IsClopen Tρ ∧
      (∀ (t : T) (hw : ((i ≫ (S.D.comap b).subschemeι) ≫ b).base t ∈ S.locallyFreeLocus),
        (⟨((i ≫ (S.D.comap b).subschemeι) ≫ b).base t, hw⟩ : S.locallyFreeLocus.toScheme) ∈
            Scheme.Modules.rankStratumSet S.locallyFreeLocusCohomologySheaf hM ρ →
          t ∈ Tρ) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : T), t ∈ Tρ →
        ∃ (V : T.Opens) (_ : t ∈ V) (I : Type u), Nonempty (I ≃ Fin (ρ n)) ∧
          Nonempty (_root_.SheafOfModules.free.{u} I ≅
            (Scheme.Modules.toRingSheafModule
              (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology b hb
                (i ≫ (S.D.comap b).subschemeι) n)).over V)
declarations.comment: the rank stratum `T(ρ)` is open and closed, contains the inverse image of `W(ρ)` and has `H^n(Li^*Q)` free of rank `ρ_n`. The data are the ones tag 0F8Y is given, over an arbitrary `b` along which the pullback of `D` is defined: the morphism `i : T → D'` of tag 0F8X together with its parts (2) and (3), which are the binders `hQ` and `hrank` and are the instance at the pulled-back triple of parts (2) and (3) of tag 0GTZ, which need the chart-level comparison AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.ChartDecalage over and above tag 08DW --- that tag being proved in both its parts; plus `hbd`, the local boundedness of `H^n(Li^*Q)`, a consequence of perfectness of `Li^*Q`, and `hM`, the finite local freeness of `H^n(M)` over `W`, which tag 0GT1's second assertion gives over the universe-lifted locus of Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.cohomologyFiniteFreeLocus rather than over the open subscheme `W` built from AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.cohomologyFiniteFreeLocus. For the morphism tag 0GTY produces see AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.exists_isClopen_rankStratum_goodBlowupToBase

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.exists_isClopen_rankStratum_goodBlowupToBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8Y for the morphism `b : X' ⟶ X` of Stacks tag 0GTY.**  Let `b` be the
morphism of tag 0GTY, `D' = b⁻¹D`, `Q = Lη_{ℐ'}Lb^*M` the object of tag 0F8U, `i : T ⟶ D'` the
closed immersion of tag 0F8X and `ρ = (ρ_n)_{n ∈ ℤ}` ranks.  Then there is an open and closed
`T(ρ) ⊆ T` which contains the inverse image in `T` of `W(ρ)`, the rank-`ρ` stratum of the
cohomology sheaves of `M` on the locally free locus `W`, and on which `H^n(Li^*Q)` is free of
rank `ρ_n` near every point.

This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.exists_isClopen_rankStratum_etaDerivedPullback`
read at `AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.goodBlowupToBase`, whose pullback of `D` is
defined by
`AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.isPullbackDefined_goodBlowupToBase`.  `T(ρ)` is the
rank stratum of the family `H^n(Li^*Q)`, as in the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isClopen_rankStratum_goodBlowupToBase
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (i : T ⟶ (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subscheme) (ρ : ℤ → ℕ)
    (hQ : ∀ n : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
      (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology S.goodBlowupToBase
        S.isPullbackDefined_goodBlowupToBase
        (i ≫ (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) n))
    (hbd : ∀ t : T, ∃ V : T.Opens, t ∈ V ∧ ∃ s : Finset ℤ, ∀ n ∉ s, ∀ v ∈ V,
      @Scheme.Modules.finiteLocallyFreeRank T
        (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology S.goodBlowupToBase
          S.isPullbackDefined_goodBlowupToBase
          (i ≫ (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) n)
        (hQ n) v = 0)
    (hM : ∀ n : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
      (S.locallyFreeLocusCohomologySheaf n))
    (hrank : ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : T)
      (hw : ((i ≫ (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) ≫ S.goodBlowupToBase).base t ∈
        S.locallyFreeLocus),
      @Scheme.Modules.finiteLocallyFreeRank T
          (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology S.goodBlowupToBase
            S.isPullbackDefined_goodBlowupToBase
            (i ≫ (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) n)
          (hQ n) t =
        @Scheme.Modules.finiteLocallyFreeRank S.locallyFreeLocus.toScheme
          (S.locallyFreeLocusCohomologySheaf n) (hM n)
          ⟨((i ≫ (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) ≫ S.goodBlowupToBase).base t, hw⟩) :
    ∃ Tρ : Set T, IsClopen Tρ ∧
      (∀ (t : T) (hw : ((i ≫ (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) ≫
          S.goodBlowupToBase).base t ∈ S.locallyFreeLocus),
        (⟨((i ≫ (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) ≫ S.goodBlowupToBase).base t, hw⟩ :
              S.locallyFreeLocus.toScheme) ∈
            Scheme.Modules.rankStratumSet S.locallyFreeLocusCohomologySheaf hM ρ →
          t ∈ Tρ) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : T), t ∈ Tρ →
        ∃ (V : T.Opens) (_ : t ∈ V) (I : Type u), Nonempty (I ≃ Fin (ρ n)) ∧
          Nonempty (_root_.SheafOfModules.free.{u} I ≅
            (Scheme.Modules.toRingSheafModule
              (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology S.goodBlowupToBase
                S.isPullbackDefined_goodBlowupToBase
                (i ≫ (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) n)).over V)
declarations.comment: the rank stratum `T(ρ)` is open and closed, contains the inverse image of `W(ρ)` and has `H^n(Li^*Q)` free of rank `ρ_n`, stated for the morphism `b` of tag 0GTY itself, namely AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.goodBlowupToBase. The data are the ones tag 0F8Y is given: the closed immersion `i : T → D'` of tag 0F8X together with its parts (2) and (3), which are the binders `hQ` and `hrank` and are the instance at the pulled-back triple of parts (2) and (3) of tag 0GTZ, which need the chart-level comparison AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.ChartDecalage over and above tag 08DW --- that tag being formalized in both its parts; plus `hbd`, the local boundedness of the family `H^n(Li^*Q)`, a consequence of perfectness of `Li^*Q`, and `hM`, the finite local freeness of `H^n(M)` over `W`, which tag 0GT1's second assertion gives over the universe-lifted locus of Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.cohomologyFiniteFreeLocus rather than over the open subscheme `W` built from AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.cohomologyFiniteFreeLocus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.exists_isClopen_rankStratum_goodBlowup
declarations.doc:
For `b` of tag 0GTY, `Q` of tag 0F8U, `i : T ⟶ D'` of tag 0F8X and integers `ρ_n`, some open
and closed `T(ρ) ⊆ T` contains `D' ∩ b⁻¹(V)` scheme theoretically for every open `V` on which
each `H^n(M)` is locally free of rank `ρ_n`, and `H^n(Li^*Q)|_{T(ρ)}` has rank `ρ_n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isClopen_rankStratum_goodBlowup (ρ : ℤ → ℤ) :
    ∃ Tρ : (S.pullbackSubscheme S.goodBlowupToBase S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase).subscheme.Opens,
      IsClopen (Tρ : Set (S.pullbackSubscheme S.goodBlowupToBase
        S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase).subscheme) ∧
      (∀ V : S.X.Opens,
        (∀ (n : ℤ), ∀ x ∈ V, ∃ U : S.X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ U ≤ V ∧ ∃ ι : Type u, Finite ι ∧
          (Nat.card ι : ℤ) = ρ n ∧ Nonempty ((restrictModules S.X.toRingedSpace U).obj
            (S.cohomologySheaf n) ≅ _root_.SheafOfModules.free.{u} ι)) →
        ∃ g : ((S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ
            (S.goodBlowupToBase ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme ⟶ Tρ.toScheme,
          g ≫ Tρ.ι ≫
              (S.pullbackSubscheme S.goodBlowupToBase S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι =
            ((S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ (S.goodBlowupToBase ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℤ), ∀ t ∈ Tρ, ∃ U : (S.pullbackSubscheme S.goodBlowupToBase
        S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase).subscheme.Opens, t ∈ U ∧ U ≤ Tρ ∧ ∃ I : Type u,
        Finite I ∧ (Nat.card I : ℤ) = ρ n ∧
          Nonempty (_root_.SheafOfModules.free.{u} I ≅
            (Scheme.Modules.toRingSheafModule (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology
              S.goodBlowupToBase S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase.pullbackDefined
              ((S.pullbackSubscheme S.goodBlowupToBase
                S.isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι ≫
                  (S.D.comap S.goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) n)).over U)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.exists_isClopen_rankStratum_etaDerivedPullback_of_isGoodOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 0F8Y.**  Let `b : X' ⟶ X` be good for the triple — for instance the morphism of
Stacks tag 0GTY — let `T ⊆ D'` be the closed subscheme of Stacks tag 0F8X and let
`ρ = (ρ_n)_{n ∈ ℤ}` be ranks.  There is an open and closed `T(ρ) ⊆ T` containing the inverse
image of `W(ρ)`, the rank-`ρ` stratum of the cohomology sheaves of `M` on the locally free locus,
on which `H^n(Lj^*Q)` is free of rank `ρ_n` near every point.

This is `exists_isClopen_rankStratum_etaDerivedPullback`, whose inputs — finite local freeness
and local boundedness of `H^n(Lj^*Q)`, finite local freeness of `H^n(M)` on `W`, and the rank
comparison of tag 0F8X, part (3) — are proved in this file.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isClopen_rankStratum_etaDerivedPullback_of_isGoodOver {X' : Scheme.{u}}
    {b : X' ⟶ S.X} (hb : S.IsGoodOver b)
    {T : (S.pullback b hb.pullbackDefined).D.subscheme.IdealSheafData}
    (hT : ∀ C : AffineChart (S.pullback b hb.pullbackDefined),
      (∀ i : ℤ, (C.determinantalIdeal i).IsPrincipal) →
        T.ideal C.divisorAffineOpen = C.obstructionIdeal) (ρ : ℤ → ℕ) :
    ∃ Tρ : Set T.subscheme, IsClopen Tρ ∧
      (∀ (t : T.subscheme)
        (hw : ((T.subschemeι ≫ (S.pullback b hb.pullbackDefined).D.subschemeι) ≫ b) t ∈
          S.locallyFreeLocus),
        (⟨_, hw⟩ : S.locallyFreeLocus.toScheme) ∈
            Scheme.Modules.rankStratumSet S.locallyFreeLocusCohomologySheaf
              S.isFiniteLocallyFree_locallyFreeLocusCohomologySheaf ρ →
          t ∈ Tρ) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : T.subscheme), t ∈ Tρ →
        ∃ (V : T.subscheme.Opens) (_ : t ∈ V) (I : Type u), Nonempty (I ≃ Fin (ρ n)) ∧
          Nonempty (_root_.SheafOfModules.free.{u} I ≅
            (Scheme.Modules.toRingSheafModule
              (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology b hb.pullbackDefined
                (T.subschemeι ≫ (S.pullback b hb.pullbackDefined).D.subschemeι) n)).over V)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.nonempty_etaDerivedPullbackRestrict_divisorComplement
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2) of Stacks tag 0F90.**  Let `(X, D, M)` be a triple as in Situation 0F8S, let
`b : X' ⟶ X` be a morphism along which `D' = b⁻¹D` is defined, and let `Q = Lη_{ℐ'}Lb^*M` be the
object of Stacks tag 0F8U.  The restriction of `Q` to the preimage of the complement `X ∖ D` of
the support of the divisor is the pullback of `M`:

`Lj^*Q ≅ L(b ∘ j)^*M`, where `j : b⁻¹(X ∖ D) ⟶ X'`.

In the graph construction the scheme is `𝐏¹_X`, the divisor is `(𝐏¹_X)_∞`, the complement of its
support is the chart `𝐀¹_X`, and the object of the triple is `Lp^*E`; so the displayed
isomorphism says that the restriction of `Q` to `𝐀¹_X` is the pullback of `E`.  The morphism `b`
is arbitrary: nothing beyond the definedness of `b⁻¹D` is asked of it, so the statement holds
in particular for the morphism of Stacks tag 0GTY, `goodBlowupToBase`; the graph construction
itself is `Stacks.Chow.graphTriple` in `GraphConstructionTriple.lean`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_etaDerivedPullbackRestrict_divisorComplement
    (S : ComplexAndDivisorSituation.{u, d}) {X' : Scheme.{u}} (b : X' ⟶ S.X)
    (hD : Stacks.Divisors.IsPullbackDefined b S.D) :
    Nonempty (S.etaDerivedPullbackRestrict b hD (b ⁻¹ᵁ S.divisorComplement).ι ≅
      S.derivedPullbackObject ((b ⁻¹ᵁ S.divisorComplement).ι ≫ b))
declarations.comment: clause (2): the restriction of Q to A^1_X is the pullback of E

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exists_closedImmersion_graphObjectRestrict
declarations.doc:
For the morphism `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` of the graph construction and `Q = Lη_ℐ Lb^*Lp^*E`, there is
a closed immersion `t : T ⟶ W_∞` of finite presentation such that
* the cohomology sheaves of `L(t ≫ i_∞)^*Q` are finite locally free,
* (3) every point of `W_∞` lying over an open `V ⊆ X` on which all the cohomology sheaves of `E`
  are finite locally free lies in `T`, and
* (4) at a point of `T` lying over such an open `V`, the rank of `H^n(L(t ≫ i_∞)^*Q)` is the rank
  `r` of `H^n(E)` on `V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersion_graphObjectRestrict :
    ∃ (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ modificationFibreAtInfinity f (graphBlowupToBase f E hE)),
      IsClosedImmersion t ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation t ∧
      ∃ hH : ∀ n : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor T.Modules n).obj
            ((derivedPullback (t ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f
              (graphBlowupToBase f E hE)).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (graphObject f E hE))),
        (∀ (w) (V : X.Opens),
          modificationProjectionAtInfinity f (graphBlowupToBase f E hE) w ∈ V →
          (∀ n : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules n).obj E))) →
          w ∈ Set.range t) ∧
        ∀ (τ : T) (V : X.Opens) (n : ℤ) (r : ℕ),
          modificationProjectionAtInfinity f (graphBlowupToBase f E hE) (t τ) ∈ V →
          (∀ m : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules m).obj E))) →
          AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules n).obj E)) r →
          @Scheme.Modules.finiteLocallyFreeRank T _ (hH n) τ = r
declarations.comment: clauses (3) and (4)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isIso_pullback_snd_graphBlowupToBase
declarations.doc:
**Clause (1) of Stacks tag 0F90, over `𝐀¹_X`.** The base change of `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` along
the chart `𝐀¹_X ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_pullback_snd_graphBlowupToBase :
    IsIso (pullback.snd (graphBlowupToBase f E hE) (projectiveLineAffineChart f))
declarations.comment: clause (1), over A^1_X, as the base change of b along A^1_X ⟶ P^1_X

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isIso_resLE_graphBlowupToBase
declarations.doc:
**Clause (1) of Stacks tag 0F90.** The morphism `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` is an isomorphism over
`𝐏¹_U ∪ 𝐀¹_X = p⁻¹U ∪ 𝐀¹_X`, where `U ⊆ X` is the maximal open over which the cohomology
sheaves of `E` are locally free.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_resLE_graphBlowupToBase :
    IsIso ((graphBlowupToBase f E hE).resLE
      (pullback.fst f (relativeProjectiveLine S ↘ S) ⁻¹ᵁ
          ⟨RingedSpace.cohomologyFiniteFreeLocus E,
            RingedSpace.isOpen_cohomologyFiniteFreeLocus E hE⟩ ⊔
        (projectiveLineAffineChart f).opensRange)
      (graphBlowupToBase f E hE ⁻¹ᵁ
        (pullback.fst f (relativeProjectiveLine S ↘ S) ⁻¹ᵁ
          ⟨RingedSpace.cohomologyFiniteFreeLocus E,
            RingedSpace.isOpen_cohomologyFiniteFreeLocus E hE⟩ ⊔
        (projectiveLineAffineChart f).opensRange)) le_rfl)
declarations.comment: clause (1)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.nonempty_derivedPullback_modificationSectionAtZero_graphObject
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2) of Stacks tag 0F90, along the section at zero.** The pullback of `Q` along the
section at zero `i_0 : X ⟶ W`, which exists because `b` is an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`, is
`E`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_derivedPullback_modificationSectionAtZero_graphObject :
    Nonempty ((derivedPullback (modificationSectionAtZero f (graphBlowupToBase f E hE)
        (isIso_modificationFibreAtZeroProjection f _
          (isIso_pullback_snd_graphBlowupToBase f E hE))).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
        (graphObject f E hE) ≅ E)
declarations.comment: clause (2), restricted along the section at zero X ⟶ W

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.nonempty_derivedPullback_graphObject_of_comp_eq
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2) of Stacks tag 0F90.** The restriction of `Q` to `𝐀¹_X` is the pullback of `E`:
for the open immersion `a : 𝐀¹_X ⟶ W` lifting the chart `𝐀¹_X ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` (it exists by
`Stacks.Chow.isIso_pullback_snd_graphBlowupToBase`), `La^*Q` is the pullback of `E` along the
projection `𝐀¹_X ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_derivedPullback_graphObject_of_comp_eq
    (a : affineLineOver X ⟶ graphBlowup f E hE)
    (ha : a ≫ graphBlowupToBase f E hE = projectiveLineAffineChart f) :
    Nonempty ((derivedPullback a.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (graphObject f E hE) ≅
      (derivedPullback (pullback.fst (terminal.from X)
        (terminal.from (Spec (.of (Polynomial (ULift.{u} ℤ)))))).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E)
declarations.comment: clause (2)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exists_isLocallyBoundedFiniteLocallyFree_graphObject
declarations.doc:
**Clause (5) of Stacks tag 0F90.** If `E` is represented by a locally bounded complex of
finite locally free `𝒪_X`-modules, then `Q` is represented by a locally bounded complex of
finite locally free `𝒪_W`-modules. The pullback along `p` of a representative of `E` represents
`Lp^*E`, and Stacks tag 0GU0 applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isLocallyBoundedFiniteLocallyFree_graphObject
    (hrep : ∃ ℳ : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ, IsLocallyBoundedFiniteLocallyFree ℳ ∧
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ℳ ≅ E)) :
    ∃ 𝒬 : CochainComplex (graphBlowup f E hE).Modules ℤ,
      IsLocallyBoundedFiniteLocallyFree 𝒬 ∧
        Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj 𝒬 ≅ graphObject f E hE)
declarations.comment: clause (5)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.isIso_resLE_projectiveLineTriple
declarations.doc:
**Clause (1) of Stacks tag 0F90.**  The morphism `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` of Stacks tag 0GTY for the
triple `(𝐏¹_X, (𝐏¹_X)_∞, Lp^*E)` is an isomorphism over `𝐏¹_U ∪ 𝐀¹_X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_resLE_projectiveLineTriple :
    IsIso ((projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase.resLE
      ((Stacks.Chow.relativeProjectiveLine X ↘ X) ⁻¹ᵁ cohomologyLocallyFreeOpen X E hE ⊔
        (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).divisorComplement)
      ((projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase ⁻¹ᵁ
        ((Stacks.Chow.relativeProjectiveLine X ↘ X) ⁻¹ᵁ cohomologyLocallyFreeOpen X E hE ⊔
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).divisorComplement)) le_rfl)
declarations.comment: clause (1): `b` is an isomorphism over `𝐏¹_U ∪ 𝐀¹_X`, with `𝐀¹_X` the complement of `(𝐏¹_X)_∞`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.nonempty_etaDerivedPullbackRestrict_projectiveLineTriple
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2) of Stacks tag 0F90.**  The restriction of `Q = Lη_ℐ Lb^*Lp^*E` to the preimage
`j : b⁻¹(𝐀¹_X) ⟶ W` of `𝐀¹_X` is the pullback of `E`: `Lj^*Q ≅ L(p ∘ b ∘ j)^*E`.  By clause (1)
`b⁻¹(𝐀¹_X) ⟶ 𝐀¹_X` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_etaDerivedPullbackRestrict_projectiveLineTriple :
    Nonempty ((projectiveLineTriple X E hE).etaDerivedPullbackRestrict
        (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase
        (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).isPullbackDefined_goodBlowupToBase
        ((projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase ⁻¹ᵁ
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).divisorComplement).ι ≅
      (derivedPullback (((projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase ⁻¹ᵁ
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).divisorComplement).ι ≫
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase ≫
          (Stacks.Chow.relativeProjectiveLine X ↘ X)).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E)
declarations.comment: clause (2): the restriction of `Q` to `𝐀¹_X` is the pullback of `E`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.exists_isLocallyBoundedFiniteLocallyFree_projectiveLineTriple
declarations.doc:
**Clause (5) of Stacks tag 0F90.**  If `E` is represented by a locally bounded complex of
finite locally free `𝒪_X`-modules, then `Q = Lη_ℐ Lb^*Lp^*E` is represented by a locally bounded
complex of finite locally free `𝒪_W`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isLocallyBoundedFiniteLocallyFree_projectiveLineTriple
    (hrep : ∃ P : CochainComplex (OXMod.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace) ℤ,
      Stacks.Chow.IsLocallyBoundedFiniteLocallyFree P ∧ Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ E)) :
    ∃ 𝒬 : CochainComplex (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowup.Modules ℤ,
      Stacks.Chow.IsLocallyBoundedFiniteLocallyFree 𝒬 ∧
        Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj 𝒬 ≅
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).etaDerivedPullbackObject
            (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase
            (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).isPullbackDefined_goodBlowupToBase)
declarations.comment: clause (5): a locally bounded finite locally free representative of `E` gives one of `Q`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ComplexAndDivisorSituation.exists_closedSubscheme_projectiveLineTriple
declarations.doc:
**Clauses (3) and (4) of Stacks tag 0F90.**  For the morphism `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` of tag 0GTY
for the triple `(𝐏¹_X, (𝐏¹_X)_∞, Lp^*E)`, with `W_∞ = b⁻¹(𝐏¹_X)_∞` and `Q = Lη_ℐ Lb^*Lp^*E`,
there is a closed immersion `i : T ⟶ W_∞` locally of finite presentation such that
* (3) `(W_∞ ⟶ X)⁻¹U ⊆ T` scheme theoretically and the cohomology sheaves of `Li^*Q` are finite
  locally free, and
* (4) for `t ∈ T` with image `x ∈ U` in `X`, the stalk `H^n(Li^*Q)_t` is free over `𝒪_{T,t}` of
  the rank of `H^n(E)_x` over `𝒪_{X,x}`.

This is tag 0F8X for the triple, read through `H^n(Lp^*E)_y = 𝒪_{𝐏¹_X,y} ⊗ H^n(E)_{p y}`, `p`
being flat, and the inclusion of `𝐏¹_U` in the locus where the cohomology of `Lp^*E` is locally
free.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_closedSubscheme_projectiveLineTriple :
    ∃ T : ((projectiveLineTriple X E hE).D.comap
        (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase).subscheme.IdealSheafData,
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation T.subschemeι ∧
      T.comap ((((projectiveLineTriple X E hE).D.comap
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι ≫
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase ≫
          (Stacks.Chow.relativeProjectiveLine X ↘ X)) ⁻¹ᵁ
            cohomologyLocallyFreeOpen X E hE).ι = ⊥ ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
        ((projectiveLineTriple X E hE).etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase.pullbackDefined
          (T.subschemeι ≫ ((projectiveLineTriple X E hE).D.comap
            (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) n)) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : T.subscheme)
        (_ : ((T.subschemeι ≫ ((projectiveLineTriple X E hE).D.comap
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) ≫
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase ≫
          (Stacks.Chow.relativeProjectiveLine X ↘ X)).base t ∈ cohomologyLocallyFreeOpen X E hE),
        letI F := (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).etaDerivedPullbackRestrictHomology
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).isGoodOver_goodBlowupToBase.pullbackDefined
          (T.subschemeι ≫ ((projectiveLineTriple X E hE).D.comap
            (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) n
        letI x := ((T.subschemeι ≫ ((projectiveLineTriple X E hE).D.comap
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase).subschemeι) ≫
          (projectiveLineTriple X E hE).goodBlowupToBase ≫
          (Stacks.Chow.relativeProjectiveLine X ↘ X)).base t
        letI : Module (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk T.subscheme.presheaf t))
            (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf t)) :=
          RingedSpace.moduleStalk (X := T.subscheme.toRingedSpace) F t
        letI : Module (ToType (X.presheaf.stalk x))
            (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (OXMod.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace) n).obj E).val.presheaf x)) :=
          RingedSpace.moduleStalk (X := X.toRingedSpace)
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (OXMod.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace) n).obj E) x
        Module.Free (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk T.subscheme.presheaf t))
            (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf t)) ∧
          Module.finrank (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk T.subscheme.presheaf t))
              (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf t)) =
            Module.finrank (ToType (X.presheaf.stalk x))
              (ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                (OXMod.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace) n).obj E).val.presheaf x))
declarations.comment: clauses (3) and (4): the closed immersion `i : T → W_∞` locally of finite presentation, with `(W_∞ → X)⁻¹U ⊆ T` scheme theoretically, `Li^*Q` with finite locally free cohomology sheaves, and for `t ∈ T` over `x ∈ U` the stalk `H^n(Li^*Q)_t` free over `𝒪_{T,t}` of the rank (Module.finrank) of `H^n(E)_x` over `𝒪_{X,x}`; `Li^*Q` is etaDerivedPullbackRestrict along `T → W_∞ → W`

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.lineZeroDivisor
declarations.doc:
The zero divisor `D₀ ⊆ ℙ¹_S`, which Stacks 0F93 defines as the closed subscheme cut out by
the section `T₁` of `𝒪(1)`. It is constructed here as the kernel ideal sheaf of the zero section
`T₁/T₀ = 0`, equivalently the scheme-theoretic image of that section. That this is the closed
subscheme cut out by `T₁` is `Stacks.Chow.eq_lineZeroDivisor_iff`, and that it is an effective
Cartier divisor is `Stacks.Chow.lineZeroDivisor_isEffectiveCartierDivisor`.
declarations.statement: def lineZeroDivisor (S : Scheme.{u}) : (relativeProjectiveLine S).IdealSheafData
declarations.comment: the divisor D₀ = V(T₁) ⊆ ℙ¹_S, as the image of the zero section

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.lineInfinityDivisor
declarations.doc:
The infinity divisor `D_∞ ⊆ ℙ¹_S`, which Stacks 0F93 defines as the closed subscheme cut
out by the section `T₀` of `𝒪(1)`. It is constructed here as the kernel ideal sheaf of the
infinity section `T₀/T₁ = 0`. That this is the closed subscheme cut out by `T₀` is
`Stacks.Chow.eq_lineInfinityDivisor_iff`, and that it is an effective Cartier divisor is
`Stacks.Chow.lineInfinityDivisor_isEffectiveCartierDivisor`.
declarations.statement: def lineInfinityDivisor (S : Scheme.{u}) : (relativeProjectiveLine S).IdealSheafData
declarations.comment: the divisor D_∞ = V(T₀) ⊆ ℙ¹_S, as the image of the infinity section

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.eq_lineZeroDivisor_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F93, `D₀ = V(T₁)`.** A closed subscheme `D` of `ℙ¹_S` is the zero divisor `D₀` if
and only if it is the closed subscheme cut out by `T₁`: on the chart `T₀ ≠ 0`, with coordinate
`T₁/T₀`, its ideal on every affine open is generated by the coordinate, and on the chart
`T₁ ≠ 0`, where `T₁` is a unit, it is the unit ideal.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_lineZeroDivisor_iff (S : Scheme.{u}) (D : (relativeProjectiveLine S).IdealSheafData) :
    D = lineZeroDivisor S ↔
      (∀ V : (affineLineOver S).affineOpens, (D.comap (affineChart S)).ideal V =
        Ideal.span {(affineLineOver S).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (affineCoordinate S)}) ∧
      D.comap (affineYChart S) = ⊤
declarations.comment: D₀ is the closed subscheme cut out by T₁: generated by T₁/T₀ on the chart T₀ ≠ 0 and the unit ideal on the chart T₁ ≠ 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.eq_lineInfinityDivisor_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F93, `D_∞ = V(T₀)`.** A closed subscheme `D` of `ℙ¹_S` is the infinity divisor
`D_∞` if and only if it is the closed subscheme cut out by `T₀`: on the chart `T₁ ≠ 0`, with
coordinate `T₀/T₁`, its ideal on every affine open is generated by the coordinate, and on the
chart `T₀ ≠ 0`, where `T₀` is a unit, it is the unit ideal.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_lineInfinityDivisor_iff (S : Scheme.{u})
    (D : (relativeProjectiveLine S).IdealSheafData) :
    D = lineInfinityDivisor S ↔
      (∀ V : (affineLineOver S).affineOpens, (D.comap (affineYChart S)).ideal V =
        Ideal.span {(affineLineOver S).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (affineCoordinate S)}) ∧
      D.comap (affineChart S) = ⊤
declarations.comment: D_∞ is the closed subscheme cut out by T₀: generated by T₀/T₁ on the chart T₁ ≠ 0 and the unit ideal on the chart T₀ ≠ 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.lineInfinityDivisor_isEffectiveCartierDivisor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F93, `D_∞` is an effective Cartier divisor.** `D_∞ ⊆ ℙ¹_S` is an effective
Cartier divisor: on the second affine chart it is cut out by the coordinate `T`, which is a
nonzerodivisor on the inverse image of any affine open of `S`, and away from that chart it is
the unit ideal.
declarations.statement:
theorem lineInfinityDivisor_isEffectiveCartierDivisor (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsEffectiveCartierDivisor (lineInfinityDivisor S)
declarations.comment: D_∞ is an effective Cartier divisor

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.zeroScheme_lineZeroDivisor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F93, the zero divisor as a zero scheme.** `D₀ ⊆ ℙ¹_S` is the zero scheme of a
global section of an invertible module, namely of the canonical section `1_{D₀}` of
`𝒪(D₀)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem zeroScheme_lineZeroDivisor (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme (relativeProjectiveLine S)
        (Stacks.Divisors.divisorSheaf (lineZeroDivisor S))
        (Stacks.Divisors.divisorSheafGlobalSection (lineZeroDivisor S)) =
      lineZeroDivisor S
declarations.comment: D₀ is the zero scheme of a global section of an invertible module

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.zeroScheme_lineInfinityDivisor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F93, the infinity divisor as a zero scheme.** `D_∞ ⊆ ℙ¹_S` is the zero scheme of a
global section of an invertible module, namely of the canonical section `1_{D_∞}` of
`𝒪(D_∞)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem zeroScheme_lineInfinityDivisor (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme (relativeProjectiveLine S)
        (Stacks.Divisors.divisorSheaf (lineInfinityDivisor S))
        (Stacks.Divisors.divisorSheafGlobalSection (lineInfinityDivisor S)) =
      lineInfinityDivisor S
declarations.comment: D_∞ is the zero scheme of a global section of an invertible module

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isTrivial_pullback_divisorSheaf_lineZeroDivisor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F93, the trivial normal bundle of `D₀`.** The invertible module `𝒪(D₀)` restricts
trivially to `D₀`: the support of `D₀` lies in the chart `𝔸¹_S`, where `D₀` is cut out by the
coordinate, a regular global function.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTrivial_pullback_divisorSheaf_lineZeroDivisor (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsTrivial
      (lineZeroDivisor S).subscheme.sheaf.obj (lineZeroDivisor S).subscheme.ringCatSheaf.property
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (lineZeroDivisor S).subschemeι).obj
        (Stacks.Divisors.divisorSheaf (lineZeroDivisor S)))
declarations.comment: the normal bundle of D₀ is trivial

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isTrivial_pullback_divisorSheaf_lineInfinityDivisor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F93, the trivial normal bundle of `D_∞`.** The invertible module `𝒪(D_∞)`
restricts trivially to `D_∞`: the support of `D_∞` lies in the second chart, where `D_∞` is cut
out by the coordinate of that chart, a regular global function.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTrivial_pullback_divisorSheaf_lineInfinityDivisor (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsTrivial
      (lineInfinityDivisor S).subscheme.sheaf.obj
      (lineInfinityDivisor S).subscheme.ringCatSheaf.property
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (lineInfinityDivisor S).subschemeι).obj
        (Stacks.Divisors.divisorSheaf (lineInfinityDivisor S)))
declarations.comment: the normal bundle of D_∞ is trivial

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.lineZeroDivisor_isEffectiveCartierDivisor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F93, `D₀` is an effective Cartier divisor.** `D₀ ⊆ ℙ¹_S` is an effective
Cartier divisor: on the affine chart it is cut out by the coordinate `T`, which is a
nonzerodivisor on the inverse image of any affine open of `S`, and away from the chart it is
the unit ideal.
declarations.statement:
theorem lineZeroDivisor_isEffectiveCartierDivisor (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsEffectiveCartierDivisor (lineZeroDivisor S)
declarations.comment: D₀ is an effective Cartier divisor

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exact_intersectionToSummandsChow_summandsToUnionChow
declarations.doc:
The sequence of Chow groups of a union of two closed subschemes is exact in the middle: a pair
of classes of `k`-cycles on the two closed subschemes has vanishing sum of pushforwards exactly
when it comes from a class of `k`-cycles on the scheme-theoretic intersection.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_intersectionToSummandsChow_summandsToUnionChow
    (hcover : I.support ⊔ J.support = ⊤) :
    Function.Exact (intersectionToSummandsChow C sX I J k) (summandsToUnionChow C sX I J k)
declarations.comment: exactness in the middle

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.surjective_summandsToUnionChow
declarations.doc:
If two closed subschemes cover the ambient scheme set-theoretically, every class of `k`-cycles
on it is the sum of the classes of the pushforwards of a `k`-cycle on each of them.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_summandsToUnionChow (hcover : I.support ⊔ J.support = ⊤) :
    Function.Surjective (summandsToUnionChow C sX I J k)
declarations.comment: surjectivity

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.surjective_chowPushforwardOfIsClosedImmersion_coprod
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0F94, surjectivity, for two closed immersions.** If the images of two closed
