The source's first paragraph -- choose pi : P -> X as in Tag 02UL, use injectivity of pi^* to reduce to a filtered E, dualise the filtration -- is replaced by an induction on r through the projective bundle P(E) of E alone: the tautological sequence 0 -> F -> pi^*E -> O(1) -> 0 has F finite locally free of rank r-1, its dual is short exact by the exactness of duality (Tag 0FV8), and the Whitney sum formula of Tag 02UI (unconditional here) computes both total Chern classes upstairs. This avoids the obstruction recorded at Stacks.Chow.chernClassCapExt_eq_zsmul_of_dualFiltration, namely that the filtration delivered by Tag 02UL is an inductive Prop from which the tower of modules Tag 02UJ takes as input cannot be eliminated: no filtration is ever needed, only one short exact sequence per inductive step. The rank of the dual is Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_dualSheaf (the dual-at-a-constant-rank clause of Tag 0FA7), which is what lets c_i(E^dual) be written at all. The dual is Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.dualSheaf, SheafHom(E, O_X) itself, and not a chosen tensor inverse. Also proved here, degreewise on cap products, is Stacks.Chow.GenuineChern.chernCap_dualSheaf, the same identity for the cap products of Tag 02U6

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.SectionZeroScheme.chernClassOfLocallyFree_dualSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA5.** For a finite locally free `𝒪_X`-module `ℰ` on a scheme `X` locally of finite
type over the base, of rank not necessarily constant, and every `i ≥ 0`,

  `c_i(ℰ^∨) = (-1)^i c_i(ℰ)`

in `A^i(X)`, for the Chern classes `Stacks.Chow.SectionZeroScheme.chernClassOfLocallyFree` of
Stacks 0ESW, built from the bivariant Chern classes of Stacks 0B7H on the rank loci.

Both sides are compared on the rank loci of `ℰ`, which are those of `ℰ^∨`
(`Stacks.Chow.SectionZeroScheme.rankLocus_dualSheaf`); on `X_r` the identity is the constant-rank
case `Stacks.Chow.GenuineChern.chernClass_dualSheaf` together with `(ℰ^∨)|_{X_r} ≅ (ℰ|_{X_r})^∨`,
and for `i > r` both sides restrict to zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernClassOfLocallyFree_dualSheaf (i : ℕ) :
    haveI := isFiniteLocallyFree_dualSheaf E hE
    chernClassOfLocallyFree (dualSheaf E) C sX i =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • chernClassOfLocallyFree E C sX i
declarations.comment: c_i(E^dual) = (-1)^i c_i(E) in A^i(X) for every finite locally free E (rank not necessarily constant) and every i >= 0, at the Chern classes of Tag 0ESW built from those of Tag 0B7H

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.chernClassCapExt_eq_zsmul_of_dualFiltration
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA5, componentwise on cap products.** Let `ℰ` be finite locally free of rank `r`
with a filtration whose successive quotients are the invertible modules `ℒ_0, …, ℒ_{r-1}`, and
let `ℰ^∨` be finite locally free of rank `r` with the dual filtration, whose successive quotients
`ℳ_j` are tensor inverses of the `ℒ_j`. Both filtrations are presented as the towers of short
exact sequences `0 ⟶ ℒ_j ⟶ ℰ_{j+1} ⟶ ℰ_j ⟶ 0` and `0 ⟶ ℳ_j ⟶ ℰ^∨_{j+1} ⟶ ℰ^∨_j ⟶ 0` that
Stacks 02UJ consumes. Then for every `n`-cycle `α` and every `i`

  `c_i(ℰ^∨) ∩ α = (-1)^i • (c_i(ℰ) ∩ α)`

in `A_{n-i}(X)`, which is the sign rule of the source read degree by degree against `α`.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernClassCapExt_eq_zsmul_of_dualFiltration
    (hdual : ∀ j, Scheme.Modules.tensorObj (L j) (M j) ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (E EDual : ℕ → X.Modules)
    (sub : ∀ j : Fin r, L j ⟶ E ((j : ℕ) + 1)) (proj : ∀ j : Fin r, E ((j : ℕ) + 1) ⟶ E (j : ℕ))
    (hzero : ∀ j : Fin r, sub j ≫ proj j = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ j : Fin r, (ShortComplex.mk (sub j) (proj j) (hzero j)).ShortExact)
    (hrank : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ r → PullbackPreservesRank (E m) m)
    (subDual : ∀ j : Fin r, M j ⟶ EDual ((j : ℕ) + 1))
    (projDual : ∀ j : Fin r, EDual ((j : ℕ) + 1) ⟶ EDual (j : ℕ))
    (hzeroDual : ∀ j : Fin r, subDual j ≫ projDual j = 0)
    (hexactDual : ∀ j : Fin r,
      (ShortComplex.mk (subDual j) (projDual j) (hzeroDual j)).ShortExact)
    (hrankDual : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ r → PullbackPreservesRank (EDual m) m)
    (chern chernDual : ∀ m : ℕ, ChernClassCycleRule C m) (α : CycleGroup C p n)
    (hnorm : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ r),
      chernClassCapExt C p n (E m) m (hrank m hm) (chern m) 0 α = cycleClassDegreeZero C p n α)
    (hnormDual : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ r),
      chernClassCapExt C p n (EDual m) m (hrankDual m hm) (chernDual m) 0 α =
        cycleClassDegreeZero C p n α)
    (hbinom : ∀ j : Fin r, ∀ i ≤ (j : ℕ) + 1,
      binomialTransform (inverseFirstChernCapStep C p n (L j) (hfacL j)) ((j : ℕ) + 1)
          (chernCapFamily C p n (E ((j : ℕ) + 1)) ((j : ℕ) + 1) (hrank ((j : ℕ) + 1) j.isLt)
            (chern ((j : ℕ) + 1)) α) i =
        binomialTransform (inverseFirstChernCapStep C p n (L j) (hfacL j)) (j : ℕ)
          (chernCapFamily C p n (E (j : ℕ)) (j : ℕ) (hrank (j : ℕ) j.isLt.le)
            (chern (j : ℕ)) α) i)
    (hbinomDual : ∀ j : Fin r, ∀ i ≤ (j : ℕ) + 1,
      binomialTransform (inverseFirstChernCapStep C p n (M j) (hfacM j)) ((j : ℕ) + 1)
          (chernCapFamily C p n (EDual ((j : ℕ) + 1)) ((j : ℕ) + 1)
            (hrankDual ((j : ℕ) + 1) j.isLt) (chernDual ((j : ℕ) + 1)) α) i =
        binomialTransform (inverseFirstChernCapStep C p n (M j) (hfacM j)) (j : ℕ)
          (chernCapFamily C p n (EDual (j : ℕ)) (j : ℕ) (hrankDual (j : ℕ) j.isLt.le)
            (chernDual (j : ℕ)) α) i)
    (k : ℕ) :
    chernClassCapExt C p n (EDual r) r (hrankDual r le_rfl) (chernDual r) k α =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ k) • chernClassCapExt C p n (E r) r (hrank r le_rfl) (chern r) k α
declarations.comment: CORRECTION OF FORM: the source states c_i(E^dual) = (-1)^i c_i(E) in the bivariant ring A^i(X). This development has no bivariant ring and no total Chern class, for the reason recorded in the Stacks 02UH clause of StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ChernWhitney.CapProductRelation, so -- exactly as for Stacks 02UJ, which this result is read on top of -- the identity is stated degree by degree as cap products against a fixed cycle: for every n, every alpha in CycleGroup C p n and every i >= 0, c_i(E^dual) cap alpha = (-1)^i times (c_i(E) cap alpha) in A_{n-i}(X). It holds for EVERY i and EVERY rank r; no degree and no rank is special-cased. WHAT IS CARRIED: the reduction of the source's first paragraph, i.e. the two filtrations themselves, as the towers of short exact sequences that Stacks 02UJ consumes -- for E with invertible quotients L_j, and for E^dual with quotients M_j satisfying L_j tensor M_j iso O_X, which is the source's E_{i-1}^perp/E_i^perp iso L_i^{tensor -1}. The source gets these from Stacks 02UL and the injectivity of pi^*. That reduction CANNOT be performed in this repository, for two independent reasons: (1) Stacks 02UL is Stacks.Chow.exists_splittingMorphism and the filtration it delivers is Stacks.WeilCohomology.HasInvertibleFiltration, an inductive Prop, from which the tower of modules and maps that Stacks 02UJ needs -- which is data -- cannot be eliminated; (2) nothing in this repository states that the Chern class cap product commutes with flat pullback (the clause of Stacks 02U0 quoted as Stacks 02U1), so injectivity of pi^* has no identity on P to descend to X. ALSO CARRIED, each of them an input of Stacks 02UJ itself and carried there for the same reason: chern and chernDual, the Stacks 02U0 component data in every rank; hnorm and hnormDual, the Stacks 02U0 normalisation c_0 = 1 along each tower; hbinom and hbinomDual, the equality of binomial transforms that Stacks 02UD gives once Stacks 02UG is applied, neither of which is proved here; and hfacL, hfacM, Stacks 02TI for c_1 of each quotient. NOT CARRIED, i.e. proved here: the line-bundle case c_1(L^{tensor -1}) = -c_1(L), deduced from the two clauses of Stacks 02SP as firstChernCapStep_eq_neg_of_tensorObj_iso_unit and absent from this repository before this file; and the formal computation the source omits, e_k(-x) = (-1)^k e_k(x), proved for every degree and every length as elemSymmChernCap_eq_zsmul_of_neg_steps. The dual is given as a tensor inverse rather than as Stacks.SheafOfModules.dualSheaf; by Stacks 0B8K the two agree up to isomorphism and c_1 depends only on the isomorphism class (firstChernClassCapOfInvertible_congr), so this is a change of spelling and not a weakening

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.homPart_totalChern_dualSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA5**, constant rank: for `ℰ` finite locally free of rank `r` on `X`,

  `c_i(ℰ^∨) = (-1)^i c_i(ℰ)`

in `A^i(X)`, for every `i`, where `c_i(-)` is the degree-`i` part of the total Chern class, the
bivariant Chern class of Stacks 0B7H, and `ℰ^∨` is the dual sheaf `SheafHom(ℰ, 𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem homPart_totalChern_dualSheaf (E : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r] (i : ℕ) :
    TotalChowClass.homComponent i (totalChern C sX (dualSheaf E) r) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • TotalChowClass.homComponent i (totalChern C sX E r)
declarations.comment: constant rank: for every X locally of finite type over S, every finite locally free E of rank r and every i, with no further hypothesis. c_i(E) is the degree-i part TotalChowClass.homComponent i (totalChern C sX E r) of the total Chern class in the ring TotalChowClass C sX of total Chow cohomology classes, the bivariant Chern class of Stacks 0B7H, and E^dual is the dual sheaf Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.dualSheaf E = SheafHom(E, O_X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.homPart_totalChernOfFiniteLocallyFree_dualSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA5**: for `ℰ` finite locally free on `X`, of arbitrary rank,

  `c_i(ℰ^∨) = (-1)^i c_i(ℰ)`

in `A^i(X)`, for every `i`, where `c_i(-)` is the degree-`i` part of the total Chern class of
Stacks 0ESW, which on the locus where `ℰ` has rank `r` is the bivariant Chern class of
Stacks 0B7H.
declarations.statement:
theorem homPart_totalChernOfFiniteLocallyFree_dualSheaf (E : X.Modules)
    [hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] (i : ℕ) :
    haveI := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.isFiniteLocallyFree_dualSheaf E hE
    TotalChowClass.homComponent i (totalChernOfFiniteLocallyFree C sX (dualSheaf E)) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • TotalChowClass.homComponent i (totalChernOfFiniteLocallyFree C sX E)
declarations.comment: the lemma as stated, for every X locally of finite type over S, every finite locally free E (rank not assumed constant) and every i, with no further hypothesis. c_i(E) is the degree-i part of totalChernOfFiniteLocallyFree C sX E, the total Chern class of Stacks 0ESW in the ring TotalChowClass C sX of total Chow cohomology classes, and E^dual is the dual sheaf Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.dualSheaf E = SheafHom(E, O_X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.chernClass_tensorObj_one_chowCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA6, the first displayed identity.** Let `X` be locally of finite type over the base
and `ℰ`, `ℱ` finite locally free `𝒪_X`-modules of ranks `r` and `s`. Then

  `c₁(ℰ ⊗ ℱ) = r c₁(ℱ) + s c₁(ℰ)`

in the Chow cohomology ring `A^*(X)` of Stacks 0B7E, `c₁` being the bivariant Chern class of
Stacks 0B7H.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernClass_tensorObj_one_chowCohomology (E F : X.Modules) (r s : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} F s] :
    chernClassChowCohomology C sX (Scheme.Modules.tensorObj E F) (r * s) 1
      = r • chernClassChowCohomology C sX F s 1 + s • chernClassChowCohomology C sX E r 1
declarations.comment: first displayed identity: for X locally of finite type over the base and finite locally free E, F of ranks r and s, c_1(E ⊗ F) = r c_1(F) + s c_1(E) in the Chow cohomology ring A^*(X) (Stacks 0B7E), c_1 the bivariant Chern class of Stacks 0B7H and E ⊗ F the module Scheme.Modules.tensorObj E F of rank r*s (Stacks 02U9)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.chernClass_tensorObj_two_chowCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA6, the second displayed identity.** Let `X` be locally of finite type over the
base and `ℰ`, `ℱ` finite locally free `𝒪_X`-modules of ranks `r` and `s`. Then

  `c₂(ℰ ⊗ ℱ) = r c₂(ℱ) + s c₂(ℰ) + C(r,2) c₁(ℱ)² + (rs − 1) c₁(ℱ) c₁(ℰ) + C(s,2) c₁(ℰ)²`

in the Chow cohomology ring `A^*(X)` of Stacks 0B7E, `c_i` being the bivariant Chern classes of
Stacks 0B7H and the products those of the ring `A^*(X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernClass_tensorObj_two_chowCohomology (E F : X.Modules) (r s : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} F s] :
    letI := chowCohomologyRingOfInvertible C sX
    chernClassChowCohomology C sX (Scheme.Modules.tensorObj E F) (r * s) 2
      = r • chernClassChowCohomology C sX F s 2 + s • chernClassChowCohomology C sX E r 2
        + r.choose 2 • chernClassChowCohomology C sX F s 1 ^ 2
        + ((r * s : ℤ) - 1) •
            (chernClassChowCohomology C sX F s 1 * chernClassChowCohomology C sX E r 1)
        + s.choose 2 • chernClassChowCohomology C sX E r 1 ^ 2
declarations.comment: second displayed identity: for X locally of finite type over the base and finite locally free E, F of ranks r and s, c_2(E ⊗ F) = r c_2(F) + s c_2(E) + binom(r,2) c_1(F)^2 + (rs - 1) c_1(F) c_1(E) + binom(s,2) c_1(E)^2 in the Chow cohomology ring A^*(X) (Stacks 0B7E), with its multiplication, c_i the bivariant Chern classes of Stacks 0B7H, rs - 1 taken in ℤ, and E ⊗ F the module Scheme.Modules.tensorObj E F

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.chernClassSub_tensorObj_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA6, the first displayed identity.** For `ℰ` and `ℱ` finite locally free of
constant ranks `r` and `s`,

  `c₁(ℰ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ) = r·c₁(ℱ) + s·c₁(ℰ)`

in the commutative ring `Stacks.Chow.chernSubring` generated by the Chern classes. Nothing is
assumed beyond the two ranks: the source's reduction to a pair of filtrations with invertible
quotients is performed, by the flag bundle of Stacks 02UL and the injectivity of the flat
pullback it provides.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernClassSub_tensorObj_one (E F : X.Modules) (r s : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} F s] :
    chernClassSub C sX (Scheme.Modules.tensorObj E F) (r * s) 1
      = (s : chernSubring C sX) * chernClassSub C sX E r 1
        + (r : chernSubring C sX) * chernClassSub C sX F s 1
declarations.comment: the first displayed identity, with nothing assumed beyond the two ranks.  CORRECTION OF FORM: the source states c_1(E tensor F) = r c_1(F) + s c_1(E) in the bivariant ring A^*(X). Here the identity is stated in Stacks.Chow.chernSubring, the commutative ring generated by the Chern classes inside the ring of graded cap families, in which Stacks.Chow.chernClassSub C sX E r i is c_i(E); it is the same identity read in that realisation, and both sides are elements of one commutative ring, so the coefficients r and s are ring elements and not scalar actions. The module on the left is the library's canonical tensor product AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorObj. The source's reduction to the filtered case is PERFORMED, not assumed: Stacks 02UL is Stacks.Chow.exists_splittingMorphism_unconditional, proved from the flag bundle of StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SplittingPrinciple.FlagBundle; the Chern roots of the three modules on the bundle are Stacks.Chow.hasChernRoots_of_hasQuotients and Stacks.Chow.hasChernRoots_tensorObj_of_hasQuotients, which get their filtrations from Stacks.Chow.exists_hasQuotients_of_hasInvertibleFiltration; and the descent along the flat pullback, injective by clause (1) of Stacks 02UL, is Stacks.Chow.eq_of_intertwines, fed by Stacks 02U8 in the form Stacks.Chow.GenuineChern.intertwines_chernFamily. The formal computation the source omits is proved in full, for every r and every s, as Stacks.Chow.esymmOfRoots_lex_one, via the bridge Stacks.Chow.esymmOfRoots_eq_esymRec from the unordered families of AlgebraicGeometry.HasChernRoots to the Pascal recursion Stacks.Chow.esymRec. Stacks 02TJ is not needed in degree one: Stacks.Chow.sum_range_lexFamily is proved for an arbitrary ring

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.chernClassSub_tensorObj_two
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA6, the second displayed identity.** For `ℰ` and `ℱ` finite locally free of
constant ranks `r` and `s`,

  `c₂(ℰ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ) = r·c₂(ℱ) + s·c₂(ℰ) + C(r,2)·c₁(ℱ)² + (r·s − 1)·c₁(ℰ)·c₁(ℱ)
      + C(s,2)·c₁(ℰ)²`

in the commutative ring `Stacks.Chow.chernSubring` generated by the Chern classes, the squares
and the cross term being honest products there. The cross-term coefficient is `r·s − 1`. Nothing
is assumed beyond the two ranks.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernClassSub_tensorObj_two (E F : X.Modules) (r s : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} F s] :
    chernClassSub C sX (Scheme.Modules.tensorObj E F) (r * s) 2
      = (s : chernSubring C sX) * chernClassSub C sX E r 2
        + (r : chernSubring C sX) * chernClassSub C sX F s 2
        + (r.choose 2 : chernSubring C sX) * chernClassSub C sX F s 1 ^ 2
        + ((r : chernSubring C sX) * s - 1) *
            (chernClassSub C sX E r 1 * chernClassSub C sX F s 1)
        + (s.choose 2 : chernSubring C sX) * chernClassSub C sX E r 1 ^ 2
declarations.comment: the second displayed identity, with nothing assumed beyond the two ranks.  CORRECTION OF FORM: the source states c_2(E tensor F) = r c_2(F) + s c_2(E) + binom(r,2) c_1(F)^2 + (r*s - 1) c_1(F) c_1(E) + binom(s,2) c_1(E)^2 in the bivariant ring A^*(X). Here the identity is stated in Stacks.Chow.chernSubring, the commutative ring generated by the Chern classes inside the ring of graded cap families, in which Stacks.Chow.chernClassSub C sX E r i is c_i(E); it is the same identity read in that realisation, and because that ring is commutative the two squares and the cross term are honest products of classes rather than composites of operations. The cross-term coefficient is r*s - 1, as in the source, and NOT r*s; the five summands appear in a different order from the source's, and addition is commutative. The module on the left is the library's canonical tensor product AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorObj. The source's reduction to the filtered case is PERFORMED, not assumed, by exactly the route recorded on Stacks.Chow.chernClassSub_tensorObj_one: the flag bundle of Stacks 02UL as Stacks.Chow.exists_splittingMorphism_unconditional, the Chern roots on the bundle as Stacks.Chow.hasChernRoots_tensorObj_of_hasQuotients, and the descent along the injective flat pullback as Stacks.Chow.eq_of_intertwines fed by Stacks 02U8. Stacks 02TJ, the commutativity the degree-two collapse needs -- the cancellation turning the block-dependent coefficient s*(i+1) - 1 into the constant r*s - 1 -- comes from the ring Stacks.Chow.chernSubring being commutative, which is Stacks.Chow.isMulCommutative_chernSubring, and is not an input here. The formal computation the source omits is proved in full, for every r and every s, as Stacks.Chow.esymmOfRoots_lex_two, which reads Stacks.Chow.esymRec_two_tensor through the bridge Stacks.Chow.esymmOfRoots_eq_esymRec

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.totalChern_sheafTensor_degree_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA6, the first displayed identity.** For `ℰ` and `ℱ` finite locally free of ranks
`r` and `s` on `X` locally of finite type over `S`,

  `c₁(ℰ ⊗ ℱ) = r·c₁(ℱ) + s·c₁(ℰ)`

in the ring of total Chow cohomology classes of `X`, where `c₁(-)` is the degree-one part of the
total Chern class, the first Chern class of Stacks 0B7H.
declarations.statement:
theorem totalChern_sheafTensor_degree_one :
    letI : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf) _ _ :=
        isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_tensor hE hF
    TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (totalChern C sX (((sheafTensor X.sheaf).obj E).obj F) (r * s)) =
      (r : ℤ) • TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (totalChern C sX F s) +
        (s : ℤ) • TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (totalChern C sX E r)
declarations.comment: the first displayed identity, for every X locally of finite type over S and all finite locally free E and F of ranks r and s, with no further hypothesis. The identity is read in the ring TotalChowClass C sX of total Chow cohomology classes, the product over p of the A^p(X) of Stacks 0B7E with the product of Stacks 0B75; every term of the identity is homogeneous, so it lies in the source's A^*(X). c_1(E) is the degree-one part TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (totalChern C sX E r) of the total Chern class, the bivariant Chern class of Stacks 0B7H in degree one, and E tensor F is the sheaf tensor product Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor, of rank r * s

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.totalChern_sheafTensor_degree_two
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA6, the second displayed identity.** For `ℰ` and `ℱ` finite locally free of ranks
`r` and `s` on `X` locally of finite type over `S`,

  `c₂(ℰ ⊗ ℱ) = r·c₂(ℱ) + s·c₂(ℰ) + C(r,2)·c₁(ℱ)² + (r·s − 1)·c₁(ℱ)·c₁(ℰ) + C(s,2)·c₁(ℰ)²`

in the ring of total Chow cohomology classes of `X`, where `c_i(-)` is the degree-`i` part of the
total Chern class, the Chern class of Stacks 0B7H. The coefficient of the cross term is
`r·s − 1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem totalChern_sheafTensor_degree_two :
    letI : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf) _ _ :=
        isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_tensor hE hF
    TotalChowClass.homComponent 2 (totalChern C sX (((sheafTensor X.sheaf).obj E).obj F) (r * s)) =
      (r : ℤ) • TotalChowClass.homComponent 2 (totalChern C sX F s) +
        (s : ℤ) • TotalChowClass.homComponent 2 (totalChern C sX E r) +
        (r.choose 2 : ℤ) • TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (totalChern C sX F s) ^ 2 +
        ((r : ℤ) * s - 1) • (TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (totalChern C sX F s) *
          TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (totalChern C sX E r)) +
        (s.choose 2 : ℤ) • TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (totalChern C sX E r) ^ 2
declarations.comment: the second displayed identity, for every X locally of finite type over S and all finite locally free E and F of ranks r and s, with no further hypothesis, the cross-term coefficient being r*s - 1 as in the source. The identity is read in the ring TotalChowClass C sX of total Chow cohomology classes, the product over p of the A^p(X) of Stacks 0B7E with the product of Stacks 0B75; every term of the identity is homogeneous, so it lies in the source's A^*(X). c_i(E) is the degree-i part TotalChowClass.homComponent i (totalChern C sX E r) of the total Chern class, the bivariant Chern class of Stacks 0B7H in degree i, the squares and the product are products in that ring, and E tensor F is the sheaf tensor product Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor, of rank r * s

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.chernPolynomialClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA7, the class `P(ℰ)`.** For `ℰ` finite locally free on `X`, of rank not necessarily
constant, and `P ∈ 𝐙[r, c₁, c₂, c₃, …]`,

  `P(ℰ) = P(r(ℰ), c₁(ℰ), c₂(ℰ), c₃(ℰ), …)`,

the evaluation of `P` at the rank `r(ℰ)` and the Chern classes `c_i(ℰ)` of Stacks 0ESW in the
ring `∏_{q ≥ 0} A^q(X)` of total classes. These classes commute pairwise
(`Stacks.Chow.commute_chernVariable`), so the evaluation is a ring homomorphism; for `P`
homogeneous of degree `p` the class lies in `A^p(X)`
(`Stacks.Chow.chernPolynomialClass_isHomogeneous`).
declarations.statement: def chernPolynomialClass : ChernPolynomial →+* TotalChowClass C sX
declarations.comment: the class P(E) = P(r(E), c_1(E), c_2(E), ...) for P in Z[r, c_1, c_2, ...] and E finite locally free of rank not necessarily constant, at the rank and Chern classes of Tag 0ESW; it lies in A^p(X) for P homogeneous of degree p by Stacks.Chow.chernPolynomialClass_isHomogeneous

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.chernPolynomialClass_isHomogeneous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA7, `P(ℰ) ∈ A^p(X)`.** For `P ∈ 𝐙[r, c₁, c₂, …]` homogeneous of degree `p` for the
grading in which `r` has degree `0` and `c_i` has degree `i`, the class `P(ℰ)` is homogeneous of
degree `p`: all its components outside `A^p(X)` vanish.
declarations.comment: P(E) lies in A^p(X) for P homogeneous of degree p in the graded ring Z[r, c_1, c_2, ...] (r of degree 0, c_i of degree i), for every finite locally free E of rank not necessarily constant

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.res_chernPolynomialClass_of_rank
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA7, working locally on `X`.** Along a morphism `h : Y' ⟶ X` over which `h^*ℰ` has
constant rank `s` — for instance the inclusion of a piece where the rank of `ℰ` is `s` — the class
`P(ℰ)` restricts to `P` evaluated at the integer `s` and the Chern classes of Stacks 0B7H of the
module `h^*ℰ` of rank `s`. Relations among the classes `P(ℰ)` may therefore be checked on the
pieces of constant rank, as the remark says.
declarations.comment: relations among the P(E) may be proved locally on X: along a morphism over which E has constant rank s, P(E) restricts to P(s, c_1, c_2, ...) of the pullback, at the Chern classes of Tag 0B7H

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.homComponent_totalChernClassOfModule_dualSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA5 in nonconstant rank, in the ring of total classes**: `c_i(ℰ^∨) = (-1)^i c_i(ℰ)`
for the Chern classes of Stacks 0ESW. This is
`Stacks.Chow.SectionZeroScheme.chernClassOfLocallyFree_dualSheaf`.
declarations.statement:
theorem homComponent_totalChernClassOfModule_dualSheaf (i : ℕ) :
    haveI := isFiniteLocallyFree_dualSheaf E hE
    TotalChowClass.homComponent i (totalChernClassOfModule C sX (dualSheaf E)) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • TotalChowClass.homComponent i (totalChernClassOfModule C sX E)
declarations.comment: the identity of Tag 0FA5 for modules of nonconstant rank: c_i(E^dual) = (-1)^i c_i(E), at the Chern classes of Tag 0ESW, read in the ring of total classes; the same identity in A^i(X) is Stacks.Chow.SectionZeroScheme.chernClassOfLocallyFree_dualSheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.chernClassOfLocallyFree_sheafHom
declarations.doc:
**The example of Stacks 0FA7**: for `ℰ` finite locally free on `X`, of rank not necessarily
constant,

  `c₂(𝓗om(ℰ, ℰ)) = P(ℰ)`,  `P = 2 r c₂ - (r - 1) c₁²`,

in `A^2(X)`, where `c₂` is the Chern class of Stacks 0ESW and `P(ℰ)` the class of Stacks 0FA7.
The proof is the source's: `𝓗om(ℰ, ℰ) ≅ ℰ ⊗ ℰ^∨` (Stacks 0FNV), and Stacks 0FA5 and 0FA6 on the
parts of `X` where the rank of `ℰ` is constant.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernClassOfLocallyFree_sheafHom :
    haveI := isFiniteLocallyFree_sheafHom E
    SectionZeroScheme.chernClassOfLocallyFree
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.OnSpace.sheafHom X.toRingedSpace E E) C sX 2 =
      chernPolynomialComponent C sX E 2 sheafEndChernPolynomial
declarations.comment: the example c_2(SheafHom(E, E)) = P(E) with P = 2 r c_2 - (r - 1) c_1^2, in A^2(X), for E finite locally free of rank not necessarily constant, at the Chern classes of Tag 0ESW

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.chernClassOfLocallyFree_tensorObj_one_chowCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA6, the first identity, in nonconstant rank, in `A^*(X)`** (Stacks 0FA7). For `ℰ`,
`ℱ` finite locally free on `X`, of ranks not necessarily constant,

  `c₁(ℰ ⊗ ℱ) = r(ℰ) c₁(ℱ) + r(ℱ) c₁(ℰ)`

in the Chow cohomology ring `A^*(X)` of Stacks 0B7E, at the rank classes and Chern classes of
Stacks 0ESW.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernClassOfLocallyFree_tensorObj_one_chowCohomology :
    letI := chowCohomologyRingOfInvertible C sX
    chernClassOfLocallyFreeChowCohomology C sX (Scheme.Modules.tensorObj E F) 1 =
      rankChowCohomology C sX E * chernClassOfLocallyFreeChowCohomology C sX F 1 +
        rankChowCohomology C sX F * chernClassOfLocallyFreeChowCohomology C sX E 1
declarations.comment: the first identity of Tag 0FA6 for modules of nonconstant rank, in the Chow cohomology ring A^*(X): c_1(E tensor F) = r(E) c_1(F) + r(F) c_1(E), at the rank and Chern classes of Tag 0ESW

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.chernClassOfLocallyFree_tensorObj_two_chowCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FA6, the second identity, in nonconstant rank, in `A^*(X)`** (Stacks 0FA7). For `ℰ`,
`ℱ` finite locally free on `X`, of ranks not necessarily constant,

  `c₂(ℰ ⊗ ℱ) = r(ℰ) c₂(ℱ) + r(ℱ) c₂(ℰ) + (r(ℰ) choose 2) c₁(ℱ)² + (r(ℰ) r(ℱ) - 1) c₁(ℱ) c₁(ℰ)
    + (r(ℱ) choose 2) c₁(ℰ)²`

in the Chow cohomology ring `A^*(X)` of Stacks 0B7E, at the rank classes and Chern classes of
Stacks 0ESW, `(r(ℰ) choose 2)` being the class which is `(r choose 2)` where the rank is `r`.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernClassOfLocallyFree_tensorObj_two_chowCohomology :
    letI := chowCohomologyRingOfInvertible C sX
    chernClassOfLocallyFreeChowCohomology C sX (Scheme.Modules.tensorObj E F) 2 =
      rankChowCohomology C sX E * chernClassOfLocallyFreeChowCohomology C sX F 2 +
        rankChowCohomology C sX F * chernClassOfLocallyFreeChowCohomology C sX E 2 +
        rankChooseTwoChowCohomology C sX E * chernClassOfLocallyFreeChowCohomology C sX F 1 ^ 2 +
        (rankChowCohomology C sX E * rankChowCohomology C sX F - 1) *
          (chernClassOfLocallyFreeChowCohomology C sX F 1 *
            chernClassOfLocallyFreeChowCohomology C sX E 1) +
        rankChooseTwoChowCohomology C sX F *
          chernClassOfLocallyFreeChowCohomology C sX E 1 ^ 2
declarations.comment: the second identity of Tag 0FA6 for modules of nonconstant rank, in the Chow cohomology ring A^*(X): c_2(E tensor F) = r(E) c_2(F) + r(F) c_2(E) + binom(r(E),2) c_1(F)^2 + (r(E) r(F) - 1) c_1(F) c_1(E) + binom(r(F),2) c_1(E)^2, at the rank and Chern classes of Tag 0ESW, binom(r(E),2) being the class which is binom(r,2) where the rank is r

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.isFiniteLocallyFree_dualSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FA7, the clause on the dual.** The dual `ℰ^∨ = SheafHom(ℰ, 𝒪_X)` of a
finite locally free module on a scheme is finite locally free. The rank of `ℰ` is not assumed
constant.

Every point has a neighbourhood `U` on which a local free presentation of `ℰ` trivialises it on
a finite index set, and there `ℰ^∨` is free on the same index set by `freeIsoDualSheafOver`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_dualSheaf {X : Scheme.{u}} (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (R := X.ringCatSheaf) E) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (dualSheaf E)
declarations.comment: dual_nonconstant_rank

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.totalChernOfFiniteLocallyFree_cap_fundamentalCycle_eq_zeroSchemeCycle
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FA9].** Let `(S, δ)` be the base situation of chapter 42, let `X` be locally
of finite type over `S`, let `ℰ` be a finite locally free `𝒪_X`-module, let `f : X' ⟶ X` be
locally of finite type such that `f^*ℰ` has constant rank `r`, and let `s ∈ Γ(X', f^*ℰ)`. Assume
`dim_δ(X') ≤ n`, that `dim_δ(Z(s)) ≤ n - r`, and that for every generic point `ξ ∈ Z(s)` with
`δ(ξ) = n - r` the ideal of `Z(s)` in `𝒪_{X', ξ}` is generated by a regular sequence of length
`r`. Then

  `c_r(ℰ) ∩ [X']_n = [Z(s)]_{n - r}`  in  `CH_{n - r}(X')`,

where `c_r(ℰ) ∈ A^r(X)` is the degree-`r` component of the total Chern class
`Stacks.Chow.totalChernOfFiniteLocallyFree` and `c_r(ℰ) ∩ -` is its cap operation on the test
scheme `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem totalChernOfFiniteLocallyFree_cap_fundamentalCycle_eq_zeroSchemeCycle
    (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sX]
    (E : X.Modules) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] (r : ℕ)
    (f : X' ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) r]
    (s : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E, ⊤)) (n : ℤ)
    (hX' : schemeDeltaDimension C (f ≫ sX) ≤ (n : EInt))
    (hZ : schemeDeltaDimension C
        ((RegularSectionSequence.zeroScheme X' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) s).subschemeι ≫
          (f ≫ sX)) ≤
      ((n - (r : ℤ) : ℤ) : EInt))
    (hreg : IsRegularSequenceOnZeroScheme C (f ≫ sX) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) s r
      (n - (r : ℤ))) :
    chowPushforwardOfIso C (pullback.fst (𝟙 X) f ≫ sX) (f ≫ sX) (identityBaseChangeIso f).hom
        (identityBaseChangeIso_hom_comp_base C sX f) (n - (r : ℤ))
        ((totalChernOfFiniteLocallyFree C sX E r).cap f n
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (rationalEquivalences C (f ≫ sX) n)
            (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme C (f ≫ sX) (𝟙 X') n))) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk' (rationalEquivalences C (f ≫ sX) (n - (r : ℤ)))
        (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme C (f ≫ sX)
          (RegularSectionSequence.zeroScheme X' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) s).subschemeι
          (n - (r : ℤ)))
declarations.comment: c_r(E) ∩ [X']_n = [Z(s)]_{n-r} in CH_{n-r}(X') for E finite locally free on X, f : X' → X locally of finite type with f^*E of constant rank r, s a section of f^*E, dim_δ(X') ≤ n (the source's dim_δ(X') = n implies it), dim_δ(Z(s)) ≤ n - r, and the ideal of Z(s) generated by a regular sequence of length r at every generic point of Z(s) of δ-dimension n - r; c_r(E) is the degree-r component of the total Chern class of Tag 0ESW, capped on the test scheme f

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.SectionZeroScheme.chernClassOfLocallyFree_cap_fundamental_eq_zeroSchemeCycle
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FA9].** Let `ℰ` be finite locally free on `X`, `f : X' ⟶ X` locally of finite
type and `s` a section of `f^*ℰ` with zero scheme `Z(s)`. If `dim_δ(X') = n`, `f^*ℰ` has constant
rank `r`, `dim_δ(Z(s)) ≤ n - r` and at every generic point `ξ` of `Z(s)` with `δ(ξ) = n - r` the
ideal of `Z(s)` in `𝒪_{X', ξ}` is generated by a regular sequence of length `r`, then
`c_r(ℰ) ∩ [X']_n = [Z(s)]_{n - r}` in `CH_{n - r}(X')`, where `c_r(ℰ) ∈ A^r(X)` is the Chern class
of Stacks 0ESW.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernClassOfLocallyFree_cap_fundamental_eq_zeroSchemeCycle (C : ChowSituation.{u})
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] (E : X.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E]
    (f : X' ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) r]
    (s : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E, ⊤)) (n : ℤ)
    (hX' : schemeDeltaDimension C (f ≫ sX) = (n : EInt))
    (hZ : schemeDeltaDimension C
        ((zeroSchemeOfSection X' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) s).subschemeι ≫ (f ≫ sX)) ≤
      ((n - (r : ℤ) : ℤ) : EInt))
    (hreg : IsRegularZeroSchemeSequence C (f ≫ sX) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) s r
      (n - (r : ℤ))) :
    (chernClassOfLocallyFree E C sX r).idRule C sX (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) f n
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (rationalEquivalences C (f ≫ sX) n)
          (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme C (f ≫ sX) (𝟙 X') n)) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk' (rationalEquivalences C (f ≫ sX) (n - (r : ℤ)))
        (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme C (f ≫ sX)
          (zeroSchemeOfSection X' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) s).subschemeι
          (n - (r : ℤ)))
declarations.comment: c_r(E) ∩ [X']_n = [Z(s)]_{n-r} under dim_δ(X') = n, f^*E of constant rank r, dim_δ(Z(s)) ≤ n - r and the regular-sequence condition at the generic points of Z(s) of δ-dimension n - r

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.subbundleEmbedding_pushforward_canonicalDualBundleFlatPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAA.** Let `0 ⟶ 𝒩' ⟶ 𝒩 ⟶ ℰ ⟶ 0` be a short exact sequence of finite locally free
`𝒪_X`-modules, let `i : N' = Spec_X(Sym((𝒩')^∨)) ⟶ N = Spec_X(Sym(𝒩^∨))` be the closed embedding
and `p' : N' ⟶ X`, `p : N ⟶ X` the projections. For `α ∈ A_k(X)`,

  `i_*(p')^*α = p^*(c_top(ℰ) ∩ α)`  in  `∏_d A_d(N)`.

The ranks may vary from component to component (they are locally constant), so `p` and `p'` have
locally constant relative dimension and both sides live in `∏_d A_d(N)`. The morphism `i` is a
closed immersion by `Stacks.Chow.isClosedImmersion_subbundleEmbedding_of_shortExact`, proved from
the short exact sequence. Here `(p')^*` and `p^*` are the flat pullbacks
`Stacks.Chow.canonicalDualBundleFlatPullback`: the unique families whose restriction over every
open of constant rank `r` is the flat pullback of relative dimension `r` of Stacks 02S1
(`Stacks.Chow.isDualBundleFlatPullback_iff`), equal to that flat pullback when the rank is
constant (`Stacks.Chow.canonicalDualBundleFlatPullback_eq_dualBundlePullback`). The class
`c_top(ℰ) ∩ α ∈ ∏_m A_m(X)` is the cap product with the top Chern class of Stacks 0FA4
(`Stacks.Chow.topChernCapFamily`), and `α` is read in `∏_m A_m(X)` in degree `k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem subbundleEmbedding_pushforward_canonicalDualBundleFlatPullback (k : ℤ)
    (α : chowGroup C sX k) :
    haveI := isClosedImmersion_subbundleEmbedding_of_shortExact N' N E inc pr w hseq
    (fun d ↦ chowPushforwardOfIsClosedImmersion C (dualVectorBundleToBase N' ≫ sX)
        (dualVectorBundleToBase N ≫ sX) (subbundleEmbedding N' N inc)
        (subbundleEmbedding_comp_base N' N sX inc) d
        (canonicalDualBundleFlatPullback C sX N' (homogeneousChowFamily C sX k α) d)) =
      canonicalDualBundleFlatPullback C sX N (topChernCapFamily C sX E k α)
declarations.comment: i_*(p')^*alpha = p^*(c_top(E) cap alpha) in prod_d CH_d(N), for a short exact sequence 0 -> N' -> N -> E -> 0 of finite locally free modules of arbitrary (locally constant) ranks and alpha in CH_k(X); p^*, (p')^* are the flat pullbacks along the projections, which have locally constant relative dimension, c_top(E) is the class of Tag 0FA4 and c_top(E) cap alpha the element of prod_m CH_m(X) with degree m part c_top(E)_{k-m} cap alpha

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.moduleChernCharacterComponent_dualSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAB.** Let `(S, δ)` be as in Situation 02QL, let `X` be locally of finite type over
`S` and let `ℰ` be a finite locally free `𝒪_X`-module with dual `ℰ^∨`. Then

  `ch_i(ℰ^∨) = (-1)^i ch_i(ℰ)`  in  `A^i(X) ⊗ 𝐐`

for every `i ≥ 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleChernCharacterComponent_dualSheaf (i : ℕ) :
    haveI := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.isFiniteLocallyFree_dualSheaf E hE
    moduleChernCharacterComponent C sX (dualSheaf E) i =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • moduleChernCharacterComponent C sX E i
declarations.comment: ch_i(E^dual) = (-1)^i ch_i(E) in A^i(X) tensor Q for every i >= 0, X locally of finite type over the base of Situation 02QL and E a finite locally free O_X-module of arbitrary (not necessarily constant) rank, E^dual = SheafHom(E, O_X). ch_i(E) = P_i(E)/i! is Stacks.Chow.moduleChernCharacterComponent, built from the bivariant Chern classes of Tag 0B7H; the proof is Tag 0FA5 (Stacks.Chow.GenuineChern.chernClass_dualSheaf) on each rank locus. Nothing is carried.

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.nonhomogeneousBivariantGroupCongr_compositeOfInvertible_perfectChernClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAC (2).** Let `X` be locally of finite type over the base, let `E ∈ D(𝒪_X)` be
perfect with Chern classes defined, let `g : X' ⟶ X` be locally of finite type and let
`c ∈ A^*(X' ⟶ X)`. Then for every `p`

  `c ∘ c_p(E) = c_p(Lg^*E) ∘ c`   in   `A^*(X' ⟶ X)`,

the composites being those of Stacks 0B75, extended additively to the graded groups; they are
classes for the morphisms `g ≫ 𝟙 X` and `𝟙 X' ≫ g`, both read as classes for `g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonhomogeneousBivariantGroupCongr_compositeOfInvertible_perfectChernClass
    (c : nonhomogeneousBivariantGroup C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX' sX g hg) (p : ℕ) :
    nonhomogeneousBivariantGroupCongr C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX' sX (Category.comp_id g)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq hg (Category.id_comp sX)) hg
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C sX' sX sX g (𝟙 X) hg
          (Category.id_comp sX) c (DirectSum.of _ (p : ℤ) (perfectChernClass C sX hE p))) =
      nonhomogeneousBivariantGroupCongr C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX' sX (Category.id_comp g)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq (Category.id_comp sX') hg) hg
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C sX' sX' sX (𝟙 X') g
          (Category.id_comp sX') hg
          (DirectSum.of _ (p : ℤ) (perfectChernClass C sX' (hE.derivedPullback g) p)) c)
declarations.comment: (2): c ∘ c_p(E) = c_p(Lg^*E) ∘ c in A^*(X' → X), for every c in A^*(X' → X), the Chern classes of Stacks 0F9E (2) and the composition of Stacks 0B75 at the Gysin system of the first Chern class of an invertible module, extended additively to the graded groups

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.nonhomogeneousBivariantGroupCongr_compositeOfInvertible_perfectChernClass_comm
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAC (1).** Let `E ∈ D(𝒪_X)` be perfect with Chern classes defined. Then `c_p(E)` is
in the center of `A^*(X)`: for every `c ∈ A^*(X)`,

  `c · c_p(E) = c_p(E) · c`,

the product of `A^*(X)` being the composition of Stacks 0B75, extended additively to the graded
groups, of classes for `𝟙 X ≫ 𝟙 X`, read as a class for `𝟙 X`; on homogeneous classes it is
`Stacks.Chow.BivariantClass.mulId`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonhomogeneousBivariantGroupCongr_compositeOfInvertible_perfectChernClass_comm
    (c : nonhomogeneousBivariantGroup C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX sX (𝟙 X)
      (Category.id_comp sX)) (p : ℕ) :
    nonhomogeneousBivariantGroupCongr C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX sX
        (Category.comp_id (𝟙 X))
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq (Category.id_comp sX) (Category.id_comp sX))
        (Category.id_comp sX)
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C sX sX sX (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X) (Category.id_comp sX)
          (Category.id_comp sX) c (DirectSum.of _ (p : ℤ) (perfectChernClass C sX hE p))) =
      nonhomogeneousBivariantGroupCongr C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX sX
        (Category.comp_id (𝟙 X))
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq (Category.id_comp sX) (Category.id_comp sX))
        (Category.id_comp sX)
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C sX sX sX (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X) (Category.id_comp sX)
          (Category.id_comp sX) (DirectSum.of _ (p : ℤ) (perfectChernClass C sX hE p)) c)
declarations.comment: (1): c_p(E) is in the center of A^*(X), c · c_p(E) = c_p(E) · c for every c in A^*(X), the product being the composition of Stacks 0B75 at the Gysin system of the first Chern class of an invertible module, extended additively to the graded groups, and the Chern classes of Stacks 0F9E (2)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.comp_perfectChernClass
declarations.doc:
Let `E ∈ D(𝒪_X)` be perfect with defined Chern classes, let `g : X' ⟶ X` be locally of finite
type and let `c ∈ A^q(X' ⟶ X)` be a bivariant class. Then

  `c ∘ c_p(E) = c_p(Lg^*E) ∘ c`   in   `A^{q+p}(X' ⟶ X)`,

with `c_p(E) ∈ A^p(X)` and `c_p(Lg^*E) ∈ A^p(X')`. The left side is a class for `g ≫ 𝟙 X` of
degree `q + p`; the right side, a class for `𝟙 X' ≫ g` of degree `p + q`, is read as one for
`g ≫ 𝟙 X` of degree `q + p` along the identity of `X'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem comp_perfectChernClass
    (_perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X.toRingedSpace) E)
    (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E) (p : ℕ) (g : X' ⟶ X) (hg : g ≫ sX = sX') {q : ℤ}
    (c : BivariantChowClass C sX' sX g hg q) :
    c.comp (BivariantChowClass.equivBivariantClass.symm (perfectChernClass C sX hE p)) =
      (((BivariantChowClass.equivBivariantClass.symm
          (perfectChernClass C sX' (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedPullback g hE)
            p)).comp c).degreeCongr (add_comm (p : ℤ) q)).transport
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq hg (Category.id_comp sX)) (Iso.refl X') (by simp)
declarations.comment: (2): c ∘ c_p(E) = c_p(Lg^*E) ∘ c in A^*(X' → X) for every g : X' → X locally of finite type and every bivariant class c in A^q(X' → X) of Stacks 0B76

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.perfectChernClass_mem_center
declarations.doc:
Let `E ∈ D(𝒪_X)` be perfect with defined Chern classes. Then `c_p(E) ∈ A^p(X)` lies in the
center of the Chow cohomology ring `A^*(X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectChernClass_mem_center
    (_perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X.toRingedSpace) E)
    (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E) (p : ℕ) :
    letI : Ring (chowCohomology C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX) :=
      chowCohomologyRingOfInvertible C sX
    DirectSum.of (fun q : ℤ ↦ chowCohomologyComponent C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX q)
        (p : ℤ) (perfectChernClass C sX hE p) ∈
      Subring.center (chowCohomology C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX)
declarations.comment: (1): c_p(E) is in the center of the Chow cohomology ring A^*(X) of Stacks 0B7E

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.newton_identities_of_res_eq_powerSumComplex
declarations.doc:
**Newton's identities for a perfect object**, Remark 0FAD, for the power sums as Stacks
defines them. Let `P_p` be classes on `X` restricting, along the envelope `f : Y ⟶ X` of a
presentation of `E` by a locally bounded complex `𝓔^•` of finite locally free modules, to the
alternating sums `P_p(𝓔^•) = ∑_n (-1)^n P_p(𝓔^n)` (this characterizes `P_p(E)`, Stacks 0GUD).
Then, with `c_i = c_i(E)` the Chern classes of `E`:

* `P` satisfies Newton's recursion
  `P_{p+1} = ∑_{j < p} (-1)^j c_{j+1} P_{p-j} + (-1)^p (p + 1) c_{p+1}`;
* for `p ≥ 1`, `P_p` is the power-sum polynomial `P_p` of Stacks 0F9B evaluated at
  `c_1(E), c_2(E), …` — the same expression as for a vector bundle — computed in the commutative
  subring of `A^*(X)` the Chern classes generate;
* `P_1 = c_1`, `P_2 = c_1² - 2c_2`, `P_3 = c_1³ - 3c_1c_2 + 3c_3` and
  `P_4 = c_1⁴ - 4c_1²c_2 + 4c_1c_3 + 2c_2² - 4c_4`;
* `P_0 = r(E)`, the alternating rank class;
* `log c(E) = ∑_p (-1)^{p-1} P_p/p`, degree by degree in `A^p(X) ⊗ 𝐐`.

The content is that the alternating sums of the power sums of the terms satisfy Newton's
recursion in the Chern classes of the complex (`Stacks.Chow.isNewtonPowerSums_powerSumComplex`,
`Stacks.Chow.powerSumComplex_eq_complexPowerSum`).
declarations.statement:
theorem newton_identities_of_res_eq_powerSumComplex (H : EnvelopePresentation E)
    {P : ℕ → TotalChowClass C sX}
    (hP : ∀ p, TotalChowClass.res H.f rfl (P p) = powerSumComplex C (H.f ≫ sX) H.locallyBounded p) :
    TotalChowClass.IsNewtonPowerSums (perfectChernClass C sX hE) P ∧
    (∀ p, 0 < p → P p = (MvPolynomial.aeval (perfectChernSub C sX hE)
        (powerSumPolynomial p : MvPolynomial ℕ+ ℤ) : TotalChowClass C sX)) ∧
    P 1 = perfectChernComponent C sX hE 1 ∧
    P 2 = perfectChernComponent C sX hE 1 ^ 2 - 2 * perfectChernComponent C sX hE 2 ∧
    P 3 = perfectChernComponent C sX hE 1 ^ 3 -
        3 * perfectChernComponent C sX hE 1 * perfectChernComponent C sX hE 2 +
        3 * perfectChernComponent C sX hE 3 ∧
    P 4 = perfectChernComponent C sX hE 1 ^ 4 -
        4 * perfectChernComponent C sX hE 1 ^ 2 * perfectChernComponent C sX hE 2 +
        4 * perfectChernComponent C sX hE 1 * perfectChernComponent C sX hE 3 +
        2 * perfectChernComponent C sX hE 2 ^ 2 - 4 * perfectChernComponent C sX hE 4 ∧
    P 0 = perfectRankClass C sX hE ∧
    ∀ p : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 p, ((-1 : ℚ) ^ (k - 1) / k) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        ((perfectChernClass C sX hE - 1) ^ k) p =
      ((-1 : ℚ) ^ (p - 1) / p) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] P p p
declarations.comment: for classes P_p restricting along the envelope of a presentation E^bullet of E to the alternating sums P_p(E^bullet) = sum_n (-1)^n P_p(E^n), i.e. P_p = P_p(E): Newton's recursion in the c_i(E); P_p = the 0F9B polynomial in c_1(E), c_2(E), ... for p >= 1; the four displayed formulas P_1 to P_4; P_0 = r(E); and log c(E) = sum_p (-1)^{p-1} P_p/p degree by degree in A^p(X) tensor Q

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exists_perfectChernClass_eq_perfectPowerSum_zero_ne
declarations.doc:
**The rank of a perfect object is not determined by its total Chern class**, Remark 0FAD: on
every nonempty `X` there are perfect objects `E` and `F` whose Chern classes are defined, with
`c(E) = c(F)` but `P_0(E) = r(E) ≠ r(F) = P_0(F)`. Namely `E = 𝒪_X[0]` and `F = 0[0]`: both
have total Chern class `1`, and their ranks are `1` and `0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_perfectChernClass_eq_perfectPowerSum_zero_ne [Nonempty X] :
    ∃ (E F : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
      (_ : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X.toRingedSpace) E)
      (_ : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X.toRingedSpace) F)
      (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E) (hF : HasDefinedChernClasses F),
      perfectChernClass C sX hE = perfectChernClass C sX hF ∧
        perfectPowerSum C sX hE 0 ≠ perfectPowerSum C sX hF 0
declarations.comment: the bivariant class P_0(E) = r(E) cannot be recovered from the Chern class c(E): on every nonempty X, c(O_X[0]) = c(0) = 1 while r(O_X[0]) = 1 differs from r(0) = 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.eq_of_chowCohomologyRestriction_eq_of_envelopePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAD.** A relation between Chow cohomology classes on `X` may be proved after
restricting along the envelope `f : Y ⟶ X` of a presentation of `E`: two classes of degree `p`
on `X` whose restrictions to `A^p(Y)` agree are equal.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_chowCohomologyRestriction_eq_of_envelopePresentation (C : ChowSituation.{u})
    (G : GysinSystem C) {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sX]
    {E : DerivedCategory X.Modules} (H : EnvelopePresentation E) (p : ℤ)
    (hgys : G.IsNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso) {c d : chowCohomologyComponent C G sX p} :
    letI : IsProper H.f := H.envelope.isProper
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType H.f := IsProper.toLocallyOfFiniteType
    chowCohomologyRestriction C G sX H.f p hgys c =
        chowCohomologyRestriction C G sX H.f p hgys d →
      c = d
declarations.comment: the splitting principle: a relation between bivariant classes on X may be checked after restriction along the envelope of a presentation, restriction along an envelope being injective

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.eq_of_forall_chowCohomologyRestriction_eq_of_hasDefinedChernClasses
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAD.** The same reduction with the envelope left to be chosen, as in the source: if
the Chern classes of `E` are defined, then two Chow cohomology classes of degree `p` on `X` whose
restrictions agree along the envelope of every presentation of `E` are equal.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_forall_chowCohomologyRestriction_eq_of_hasDefinedChernClasses
    (C : ChowSituation.{u}) (G : GysinSystem C) {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ C.S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] {E : DerivedCategory X.Modules} (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E)
    (p : ℤ) (hgys : G.IsNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso) {c d : chowCohomologyComponent C G sX p}
    (h : ∀ H : EnvelopePresentation E,
      letI : IsProper H.f := H.envelope.isProper
      letI : LocallyOfFiniteType H.f := IsProper.toLocallyOfFiniteType
      chowCohomologyRestriction C G sX H.f p hgys c =
        chowCohomologyRestriction C G sX H.f p hgys d) :
    c = d
declarations.comment: the splitting principle with the choice of envelope left open: the Chern classes of E being defined, a relation between bivariant classes on X follows from the relation after restriction along the envelope of every presentation

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exists_splitCharts
declarations.doc:
Let `(S, δ)`, `X` and `E` be as in Definition 0F9E, the Chern classes of `E` being defined,
and choose an envelope `f : Y ⟶ X` and a locally bounded complex `ℰ^•` of finite locally free
`𝒪_Y`-modules representing `Lf^*E`. Then there is a split chart `π_y : P_y ⟶ V_y` at every point
`y ∈ Y`: over the connected component `V_y` of `y`, where `ℰ^•` is a bounded complex of finite
locally free modules of fixed ranks, `π_y` is the splitting morphism of Stacks 02UL, along which
each `ℰ^n` acquires a filtration with invertible successive quotients `ℒ_{n,j}`. For such a
choice of charts:

1. a relation between total Chow cohomology classes on `X` — in particular between the classes
   `c_p(E)` and `P_p(E)` — may be checked after restriction to all the charts: restriction
   `A^*(X) ⟶ ∏_y A^*(P_y)` is injective;
2. with `x_{n,j} = c_1(ℒ_{n,j})`, on each chart
   `c(E) = ∏_{n even} ∏_j (1 + x_{n,j}) · (∏_{n odd} ∏_j (1 + x_{n,j}))^{-1}`, the factor
   `1 + x_{n,j} = c(ℒ_{n,j})` being a unit;
3. with `x_{n,j} = c_1(ℒ_{n,j})`, on each chart
   `P_p(E) = ∑_{n even} ∑_j x_{n,j}^p - ∑_{n odd} ∑_j x_{n,j}^p` for every `p ≥ 0`.

Here `c(E)` and `P_p(E)` are the classes of Definition 0F9E (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_splitCharts (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E) (H : EnvelopePresentation E) :
    ∃ χ : ∀ y : H.Y, SplitChart C sX H y,
      Function.Injective (fun (c : TotalChowClass C sX) (y : H.Y) ↦ (χ y).res c) ∧
      (∀ y n j, ((χ y).rootFactor n j : TotalChowClass C (χ y).T.sP) = 1 + (χ y).root n j) ∧
      (∀ y, (χ y).res (perfectChernClass C sX hE) =
        ↑(((((complexRank H.locallyBounded y).support.sort (· ≤ ·)).filter fun n ↦ Even n).map
            fun n ↦ (List.ofFn ((χ y).rootFactor n)).prod).prod *
          (((((complexRank H.locallyBounded y).support.sort (· ≤ ·)).filter
            fun n ↦ ¬ Even n).map fun n ↦ (List.ofFn ((χ y).rootFactor n)).prod).prod)⁻¹)) ∧
      ∀ y (p : ℕ), (χ y).res (perfectPowerSum C sX hE p) =
        (∑ n ∈ (complexRank H.locallyBounded y).support with Even n,
            ∑ j, (χ y).root n j ^ p) -
          ∑ n ∈ (complexRank H.locallyBounded y).support with ¬ Even n,
            ∑ j, (χ y).root n j ^ p
declarations.comment: the splitting principle: for every envelope f : Y -> X and complex E^bullet representing Lf^*E there are split charts (the connected component of each point of Y, where E^bullet is bounded of fixed ranks, followed by the splitting morphism of 02UL filtering each term by invertible modules L_{n,j}), restriction to all of them is injective on A^*(X), and on them c(E) = prod_{n even} (1 + x_{n,j}) prod_{n odd} (1 + x_{n,j})^{-1} and P_p(E) = sum_{n even} x_{n,j}^p - sum_{n odd} x_{n,j}^p with x_{n,j} = c_1(L_{n,j})

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedDual
declarations.doc:
**The Chern classes of the derived dual of a perfect object are defined** as soon as those of
the object are, [Stacks, Tag 0F9E] (1) for `E^∨`: dualize an envelope presentation of `E`.

This is what makes the assertion of [Stacks, Tag 0FAE] well-typed, the classes `c_p`, `P_p` and
`ch_p` of [Stacks, Tag 0F9E] (2) being defined only under that hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedDual
    (hE : Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect (X := X.toRingedSpace) E)
    (h : HasDefinedChernClasses E) :
    HasDefinedChernClasses (Stacks.Chow.derivedDual E)
declarations.comment: the Chern classes of the derived dual are defined, which is what makes the assertion of the lemma well-typed

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.perfectChernClass_apply_derivedDual
declarations.doc: **`c_p(E^∨) = (-1)^p c_p(E)` in `A^p(X)`**, the first conclusion of [Stacks, Tag 0FAE].
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectChernClass_apply_derivedDual
    (hE : Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect (X := X.toRingedSpace) E)
    (h : HasDefinedChernClasses E) (p : ℕ) :
    perfectChernClass C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedDual hE h) p =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p) • perfectChernClass C sX h p
declarations.comment: the Chern classes: c_p(E-dual) = (-1)^p c_p(E) in A^p(X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.perfectPowerSumComponent_derivedDual
declarations.doc: **`P_p(E^∨) = (-1)^p P_p(E)` in `A^p(X)`**, the second conclusion of [Stacks, Tag 0FAE].
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectPowerSumComponent_derivedDual
    (hE : Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect (X := X.toRingedSpace) E)
    (h : HasDefinedChernClasses E) (p : ℕ) :
    perfectPowerSumComponent C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedDual hE h) p =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p) • perfectPowerSumComponent C sX h p
declarations.comment: the power-sum classes: P_p(E-dual) = (-1)^p P_p(E) in A^p(X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.perfectChernCharacterComponent_derivedDual
declarations.doc:
**`ch_p(E^∨) = (-1)^p ch_p(E)` in `A^p(X) ⊗ 𝐐`**, the third conclusion of
[Stacks, Tag 0FAE]. The Chern character component is `P_p/p!`, so the sign passes through the
tensor factor.
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectChernCharacterComponent_derivedDual
    (hE : Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect (X := X.toRingedSpace) E)
    (h : HasDefinedChernClasses E) (p : ℕ) :
    perfectChernCharacterComponent C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedDual hE h) p =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p) • perfectChernCharacterComponent C sX h p
declarations.comment: the Chern character: ch_p(E-dual) = (-1)^p ch_p(E) in A^p(X) tensor Q

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.perfectChernClass_derivedTwist_apply
declarations.doc:
**The Chern classes of a twist.** Let `X` be locally of finite type over the base of
chapter 42, let `E` be a perfect object of `D(𝒪_X)` whose Chern classes are defined and which has
constant rank `r`, and let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module. Then

  `c_i(E ⊗ ℒ) = ∑_{j=0}^{i} binom(r - i + j, j) c_{i-j}(E) c_1(ℒ)^j`

in `A^i(X)`, where `c_{i-j}(E)` is the component of degree `i - j` of the total Chern class and
the product is that of Chow cohomology.
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectChernClass_derivedTwist_apply (perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} E)
    (definedChernClasses : HasDefinedChernClasses E) (r : ℤ)
    (constantRank : ∀ x : X, DerivedFibreBetti.chiDerivedFibre X E
      (DerivedFibreBetti.isPseudoCoherent_of_isPerfect E perfect) x = r) (i : ℕ) :
    perfectChernClass C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTwist definedChernClasses L) i =
      ∑ j ∈ range (i + 1), Ring.choose (r - i + j) j •
        (TotalChowClass.homComponent (i - j) (perfectChernClass C sX definedChernClasses) *
          TotalChowClass.firstChernTotal C sX L ^ j) i

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.perfectChernClass_derivedTensor_one
declarations.doc:
**The first Chern class of a derived tensor product.** For objects `E`, `F` of `D(𝒪_X)` whose
Chern classes are defined,

  `c₁(E ⊗^L F) = r(E) c₁(F) + r(F) c₁(E)`

in `A^*(X)`, where `r(E) = P_0(E)` is the rank and `c₁` the degree-one part of the total Chern
class.
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectChernClass_derivedTensor_one :
    TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hEF) =
      perfectPowerSum C sX hE 0 * TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) +
        perfectPowerSum C sX hF 0 * TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hE)
declarations.comment: the formula for c_1(E tensor^L F), for objects E, F of D(O_X) whose Chern classes are defined; perfectness is not needed. The rank r(E) is the class P_0(E) = perfectPowerSum C sX hE 0 in A^0(X), not assumed constant, and r(E) c_1(F) is the product in the ring TotalChowClass C sX of total Chow cohomology classes. E tensor^L F is the derived tensor product derivedTensorProductFunctor of Stacks 06YU

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.perfectPowerSum_derivedTensor
declarations.doc:
**The power sums of a derived tensor product.** For objects `E`, `F` of `D(𝒪_X)` whose Chern
classes are defined and every `p ≥ 0`,

  `P_p(E ⊗^L F) = ∑_{p₁ + p₂ = p} C(p, p₁) P_{p₁}(E) P_{p₂}(F)`

in `A^p(X)`, the power sums `P_0` being the ranks; dividing by `p!` this is
`ch(E ⊗^L F) = ch(E) ch(F)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectPowerSum_derivedTensor (p : ℕ) :
    perfectPowerSum C sX hEF p =
      ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal p, (p.choose q.1 : ℤ) •
        (perfectPowerSum C sX hE q.1 * perfectPowerSum C sX hF q.2)
declarations.comment: the precise form P_p(E tensor^L F) = sum over p_1 + p_2 = p of C(p, p_1) P_{p_1}(E) P_{p_2}(F) in A^p(X), for every p >= 0, for objects E, F of D(O_X) whose Chern classes are defined (perfectness is not needed); P_p is perfectPowerSum of Stacks 0GUD, P_0 being the rank, and the products are those of TotalChowClass C sX. The statement ch(E tensor F) = ch(E) ch(F) in A^*(X) tensor Q is the consequence of this identity obtained by dividing by p!, which is not stated separately

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.perfectChernClass_derivedTensor_two
declarations.doc:
**The second Chern class of a derived tensor product.** For perfect objects `E`, `F` of
`D(𝒪_X)` whose Chern classes are defined,

  `c₂(E ⊗^L F) = r(E) c₂(F) + r(F) c₂(E) + C(r(E), 2) c₁(F)² + (r(E) r(F) - 1) c₁(F) c₁(E) +
    C(r(F), 2) c₁(E)²`

in `A^*(X)`, where `r(E) = P_0(E)` is the rank and `C(r(E), 2)` is the class of the locally
constant function `x ↦ C(χ_E(x), 2)`, `χ_E` being the Euler characteristic of the derived fibre
of `E`, whose class is `r(E)` (`Stacks.Chow.perfectPowerSum_zero_eq_ofLocallyConstant`).
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectChernClass_derivedTensor_two (perfectE : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} E)
    (perfectF : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} F) :
    TotalChowClass.homComponent 2 (perfectChernClass C sX hEF) =
      perfectPowerSum C sX hE 0 * TotalChowClass.homComponent 2 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) +
        perfectPowerSum C sX hF 0 * TotalChowClass.homComponent 2 (perfectChernClass C sX hE) +
        ofLocallyConstant C sX ((perfectRank E perfectE).map fun k ↦ Ring.choose k 2) *
          TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) ^ 2 +
        (perfectPowerSum C sX hE 0 * perfectPowerSum C sX hF 0 - 1) *
          (TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) *
            TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hE)) +
        ofLocallyConstant C sX ((perfectRank F perfectF).map fun k ↦ Ring.choose k 2) *
          TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hE) ^ 2
declarations.comment: the formula for c_2(E tensor^L F), for perfect objects E, F of D(O_X) whose Chern classes are defined, the ranks being arbitrary locally constant functions. r(E) is the class P_0(E) = perfectPowerSum C sX hE 0 in A^0(X); the binomial coefficient C(r(E), 2) is read as the class ofLocallyConstant of the locally constant function x |-> Ring.choose (chi_E(x)) 2, chi_E the derived-fibre Euler characteristic, whose own class is r(E) by perfectPowerSum_zero_eq_ofLocallyConstant; on the open and closed subscheme where E has rank r these are the integers r and C(r, 2), as in Remark 0FA7. The products are those of TotalChowClass C sX, written in the order of the source. The source's 'and so on for higher Chern classes' is not a precise assertion and is not formalized

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exists_tensorSplitCharts
declarations.doc:
The Chern roots of `E ⊗^𝐋 F` are the sums of the Chern roots of `E` and `F`. For
presentations of `E` and `F` on envelopes there are tensor split charts at every point of their
common envelope, restriction to all of them is injective on `A^*(X)`, and on each of them, with
`x_{n,j}` the Chern roots of `E` and `y_{m,k}` those of `F`,

  `c(E) = ∏ (1 + x_{n,j})^{(-1)^n}`,  `c(F) = ∏ (1 + y_{m,k})^{(-1)^m}`,
  `c(E ⊗^𝐋 F) = ∏ (1 + x_{n,j} + y_{m,k})^{(-1)^n (-1)^m}`,

so every Chern class of `E ⊗^𝐋 F` is the universal expression in the Chern roots of `E` and `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_tensorSplitCharts (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E) (hF : HasDefinedChernClasses F)
    (H : EnvelopePresentation E) (H' : EnvelopePresentation F) :
    ∃ χ : ∀ y : (H.tensorLeft H').Y, TensorSplitChart C sX H H' y,
      Function.Injective
        (fun (c : TotalChowClass C sX) (y : (H.tensorLeft H').Y) ↦ (χ y).left.res c) ∧
      (∀ y, (χ y).left.res (perfectChernClass C sX hE) =
        ((TotalChowClass.rootProd (χ y).rootsLeft : (TotalChowClass C (χ y).T.sP)ˣ) :
          TotalChowClass C (χ y).T.sP)) ∧
      (∀ y, (χ y).left.res (perfectChernClass C sX hF) =
        ((TotalChowClass.rootProd (χ y).rootsRight : (TotalChowClass C (χ y).T.sP)ˣ) :
          TotalChowClass C (χ y).T.sP)) ∧
      ∀ y, (χ y).left.res (perfectChernClass C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor hE hF)) =
        ((TotalChowClass.rootProd (rootTensor (χ y).rootsLeft (χ y).rootsRight) :
          (TotalChowClass C (χ y).T.sP)ˣ) : TotalChowClass C (χ y).T.sP)
declarations.comment: and so on for higher Chern classes: the splitting-principle statement the proof reduces the lemma to. On tensor split charts of any two envelope presentations of E and F -- the connected component of a point of the common envelope followed by one splitting morphism of 02UL for the terms of both presenting complexes -- restriction is injective on A^*(X), c(E) and c(F) are the products of (1 + x)^{(-1)^n} and (1 + y)^{(-1)^m} over their Chern roots, and c(E tensor^L F) is the product of (1 + x + y)^{(-1)^n (-1)^m} over all pairs of roots, as lists of signed roots via Stacks.Chow.TotalChowClass.rootProd and Stacks.Chow.rootTensor

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.homComponent_one_perfectChernClass_derivedTensor
declarations.doc: `c₁(E ⊗^𝐋 F) = r(E) c₁(F) + r(F) c₁(E)` in `A^*(X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem homComponent_one_perfectChernClass_derivedTensor (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E)
    (hF : HasDefinedChernClasses F) :
    TotalChowClass.homComponent 1
        (perfectChernClass C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor hE hF)) =
      perfectRankClass C sX hE * TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) +
        perfectRankClass C sX hF * TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hE)
declarations.comment: the first displayed formula c_1(E tensor^L F) = r(E) c_1(F) + r(F) c_1(E), as classes homogeneous of degree one in the bivariant ring A^*(X) = Stacks.Chow.TotalChowClass, with r = Stacks.Chow.perfectRankClass and c_1 the degree-one homogeneous component of Stacks.Chow.perfectChernClass; the Chern classes of E tensor^L F are defined by Stacks.Chow.hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor. Perfectness of E and F is not used

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.homComponent_two_perfectChernClass_derivedTensor
declarations.doc:
`c₂(E ⊗^𝐋 F) = r(E) c₂(F) + r(F) c₂(E) + C(r(E), 2) c₁(F)² + (r(E) r(F) - 1) c₁(F) c₁(E)
+ C(r(F), 2) c₁(E)²` in `A^*(X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem homComponent_two_perfectChernClass_derivedTensor
    (perfectE : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X.toRingedSpace) E)
    (perfectF : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X.toRingedSpace) F)
    (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E) (hF : HasDefinedChernClasses F) :
    TotalChowClass.homComponent 2
        (perfectChernClass C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor hE hF)) =
      perfectRankClass C sX hE * TotalChowClass.homComponent 2 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) +
        perfectRankClass C sX hF * TotalChowClass.homComponent 2 (perfectChernClass C sX hE) +
        perfectRankChooseClass C sX perfectE 2 *
          TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) ^ 2 +
        (perfectRankClass C sX hE * perfectRankClass C sX hF - 1) *
          (TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) *
            TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hE)) +
        perfectRankChooseClass C sX perfectF 2 *
          TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hE) ^ 2
declarations.comment: the second displayed formula c_2(E tensor^L F) = r(E) c_2(F) + r(F) c_2(E) + binom(r(E), 2) c_1(F)^2 + (r(E) r(F) - 1) c_1(F) c_1(E) + binom(r(F), 2) c_1(E)^2, as classes homogeneous of degree two in the bivariant ring A^*(X) = Stacks.Chow.TotalChowClass, the products being compositions of bivariant classes, in the order of the source. r is Stacks.Chow.perfectRankClass and binom(r, 2) is Stacks.Chow.perfectRankChooseClass ... 2, the class which is binom(n, 2) on the open and closed locus where the rank of the perfect object is n; E and F perfect as in the source

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.perfectChernClass_derivedTensor_apply_one
declarations.doc:
The class `c₁(E ⊗^𝐋 F) ∈ A¹(X)` is the degree-one component of
`r(E) c₁(F) + r(F) c₁(E)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectChernClass_derivedTensor_apply_one (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E)
    (hF : HasDefinedChernClasses F) :
    perfectChernClass C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor hE hF) 1 =
      (perfectRankClass C sX hE * TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) +
        perfectRankClass C sX hF * TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hE))
        1
declarations.comment: the first displayed formula read in the single group A^1(X): c_1(E tensor^L F) in A^1(X), the degree-one component of Stacks.Chow.perfectChernClass, is the degree-one component of r(E) c_1(F) + r(F) c_1(E)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.perfectChernClass_derivedTensor_apply_two
declarations.doc:
The class `c₂(E ⊗^𝐋 F) ∈ A²(X)` is the degree-two component of
`r(E) c₂(F) + r(F) c₂(E) + C(r(E), 2) c₁(F)² + (r(E) r(F) - 1) c₁(F) c₁(E) + C(r(F), 2) c₁(E)²`.
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectChernClass_derivedTensor_apply_two
    (perfectE : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X.toRingedSpace) E)
    (perfectF : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X.toRingedSpace) F)
    (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E) (hF : HasDefinedChernClasses F) :
    perfectChernClass C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor hE hF) 2 =
      (perfectRankClass C sX hE * TotalChowClass.homComponent 2 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) +
        perfectRankClass C sX hF * TotalChowClass.homComponent 2 (perfectChernClass C sX hE) +
        perfectRankChooseClass C sX perfectE 2 *
          TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) ^ 2 +
        (perfectRankClass C sX hE * perfectRankClass C sX hF - 1) *
          (TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) *
            TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hE)) +
        perfectRankChooseClass C sX perfectF 2 *
          TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hE) ^ 2 : TotalChowClass C sX)
        2
declarations.comment: the second displayed formula read in the single group A^2(X): c_2(E tensor^L F) in A^2(X), the degree-two component of Stacks.Chow.perfectChernClass, is the degree-two component of r(E) c_2(F) + r(F) c_2(E) + binom(r(E), 2) c_1(F)^2 + (r(E) r(F) - 1) c_1(F) c_1(E) + binom(r(F), 2) c_1(E)^2; E and F perfect as in the source

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.perfectPowerSumComponent_derivedTensor
declarations.doc:
`P_p(E ⊗^𝐋 F) ∈ A^p(X)` is the degree-`p` component of
`∑_{p₁ + p₂ = p} C(p, p₁) P_{p₁}(E) P_{p₂}(F)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectPowerSumComponent_derivedTensor (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E)
    (hF : HasDefinedChernClasses F) (p : ℕ) :
    perfectPowerSumComponent C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor hE hF) p =
      ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal p, ((p.choose q.1 : TotalChowClass C sX) *
        (perfectPowerSum C sX hE q.1 * perfectPowerSum C sX hF q.2)) p
declarations.comment: the more precise statement read in the single group A^p(X), which is where the source states it: P_p(E tensor^L F) in A^p(X) (Stacks.Chow.perfectPowerSumComponent) is the degree-p component of the sum over p_1 + p_2 = p of binom(p, p_1) P_{p_1}(E) P_{p_2}(F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.perfectTotalChernCharacter_derivedTensor
declarations.doc: The Chern character is multiplicative: `ch(E ⊗^𝐋 F) = ch(E) ch(F)` in `A^*(X) ⊗ 𝐐`.
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectTotalChernCharacter_derivedTensor (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E)
    (hF : HasDefinedChernClasses F) :
    perfectTotalChernCharacter C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor hE hF) =
      perfectTotalChernCharacter C sX hE * perfectTotalChernCharacter C sX hF
declarations.comment: similarly, ch(E tensor^L F) = ch(E) ch(F) in A^*(X) tensor Q: Stacks.Chow.rationalTotalChowClass is the bivariant ring A^*(X) tensored over Z with Q, and ch is the power series over it whose coefficient of degree p is P_p/p!, which read in A^p(X) tensor Q is ch_p of Tag 0F9E (Stacks.Chow.map_coeff_perfectTotalChernCharacter); the identity is the more precise one for P_p divided by p!. Perfectness of E and F is not used

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.perfectChernClasses_derivedTensor
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectChernClasses_derivedTensor
    (perfectE : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X.toRingedSpace) E)
    (perfectF : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X.toRingedSpace) F)
    (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E) (hF : HasDefinedChernClasses F) :
    HasDefinedChernClasses (((derivedTensorProductFunctor X.sheaf).obj E).obj F) ∧
    TotalChowClass.homComponent 1
        (perfectChernClass C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor hE hF)) =
      perfectRankClass C sX hE * TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) +
        perfectRankClass C sX hF * TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hE) ∧
    TotalChowClass.homComponent 2
        (perfectChernClass C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor hE hF)) =
      perfectRankClass C sX hE * TotalChowClass.homComponent 2 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) +
        perfectRankClass C sX hF * TotalChowClass.homComponent 2 (perfectChernClass C sX hE) +
        perfectRankChooseClass C sX perfectE 2 *
          TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) ^ 2 +
        (perfectRankClass C sX hE * perfectRankClass C sX hF - 1) *
          (TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hF) *
            TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hE)) +
        perfectRankChooseClass C sX perfectF 2 *
          TotalChowClass.homComponent 1 (perfectChernClass C sX hE) ^ 2 ∧
    (∀ (H : EnvelopePresentation E) (H' : EnvelopePresentation F),
      ∃ χ : ∀ y : (H.tensorLeft H').Y, TensorSplitChart C sX H H' y,
        Function.Injective (fun (c : TotalChowClass C sX) (y : (H.tensorLeft H').Y) ↦
          (χ y).left.res c) ∧
        (∀ y, (χ y).left.res (perfectChernClass C sX hE) =
          ((TotalChowClass.rootProd (χ y).rootsLeft : (TotalChowClass C (χ y).T.sP)ˣ) :
            TotalChowClass C (χ y).T.sP)) ∧
        (∀ y, (χ y).left.res (perfectChernClass C sX hF) =
          ((TotalChowClass.rootProd (χ y).rootsRight : (TotalChowClass C (χ y).T.sP)ˣ) :
            TotalChowClass C (χ y).T.sP)) ∧
        ∀ y, (χ y).left.res (perfectChernClass C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor hE hF)) =
          ((TotalChowClass.rootProd (rootTensor (χ y).rootsLeft (χ y).rootsRight) :
            (TotalChowClass C (χ y).T.sP)ˣ) : TotalChowClass C (χ y).T.sP)) ∧
    perfectTotalChernCharacter C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor hE hF) =
      perfectTotalChernCharacter C sX hE * perfectTotalChernCharacter C sX hF ∧
    ∀ p : ℕ, perfectPowerSumComponent C sX (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor hE hF) p =
      ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal p, ((p.choose q.1 : TotalChowClass C sX) *
        (perfectPowerSum C sX hE q.1 * perfectPowerSum C sX hF q.2)) p
declarations.comment: the whole statement, as one conjunction of the parts registered separately in this module: the Chern classes of E tensor^L F are defined; the formulas for c_1 and c_2 in A^*(X); the splitting-principle form of 'and so on for higher Chern classes' (Chern roots x + y with product signs on injective tensor split charts of any presentations); ch(E tensor^L F) = ch(E) ch(F) in A^*(X) tensor Q; and P_p(E tensor^L F) = sum of binom(p, p_1) P_{p_1}(E) P_{p_2}(F) in A^p(X) for every p, under exactly the source's hypotheses

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.localizedPowerSumOfClosedCover_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAH, for the classes `P_p`.** Let `X` be locally of finite type over `S`, let
`i₁ : X₁ ⟶ X`, `i₁' : X₁' ⟶ X` and `i₂ : X₂ ⟶ X` be closed immersions with `X = X₁ ∪ X₂` and
`X = X₁' ∪ X₂` set theoretically, and let `E₂` be a perfect object of `D(𝒪_{X₂})` whose Chern
classes are defined and whose restrictions to `X₁ ∩ X₂` and to `X₁' ∩ X₂` are zero. Then the class
`P'_p(E₂) ∈ A^p(X₂ ⟶ X)` of Stacks 0F9H built from the cover `X = X₁ ∪ X₂` equals the one built
from the cover `X = X₁' ∪ X₂`: it does not depend on the choice of `X₁`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedPowerSumOfClosedCover_eq
    (hcover : Set.range i₁.base ∪ Set.range i₂.base = Set.univ)
    (hcover' : Set.range i₁'.base ∪ Set.range i₂.base = Set.univ)
    (perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X₂.toRingedSpace) E₂)
    (hzero : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (pullback.snd i₁ i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E₂))
    (hzero' : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (pullback.snd i₁' i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E₂)) :
    localizedPowerSumOfClosedCover C sX i₁ i₂ hcover hE₂ p perfect hzero =
      localizedPowerSumOfClosedCover C sX i₁' i₂ hcover' hE₂ p perfect hzero'
declarations.comment: the class P'_p(E₂) ∈ A^p(X₂ ⟶ X) of Stacks 0F9H, for E₂|_{X₁ ∩ X₂} zero: the classes built from two covers X = X₁ ∪ X₂ and X = X₁' ∪ X₂ with E₂|_{X₁ ∩ X₂} and E₂|_{X₁' ∩ X₂} zero are equal

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.localizedChernClassOfClosedCover_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAH, for the Chern classes.** Let `X` be locally of finite type over `S`, let
`i₁ : X₁ ⟶ X`, `i₁' : X₁' ⟶ X` and `i₂ : X₂ ⟶ X` be closed immersions with `X = X₁ ∪ X₂` and
`X = X₁' ∪ X₂` set theoretically, and let `E₂` be a perfect object of `D(𝒪_{X₂})` whose Chern
classes are defined and whose restrictions to `X₁ ∩ X₂` and to `X₁' ∩ X₂` are each isomorphic to
a finite locally free module of rank `< p` sitting in cohomological degree `0`. Then the class
`c'_p(E₂) ∈ A^p(X₂ ⟶ X)` of Stacks 0F9H built from the cover `X = X₁ ∪ X₂` equals the one built
from the cover `X = X₁' ∪ X₂`: it does not depend on the choice of `X₁`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedChernClassOfClosedCover_eq
    (hcover : Set.range i₁.base ∪ Set.range i₂.base = Set.univ)
    (hcover' : Set.range i₁'.base ∪ Set.range i₂.base = Set.univ)
    (_perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X₂.toRingedSpace) E₂)
    (hres : ∃ M : (pullback i₁ i₂).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
          (pullback.snd i₁ i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E₂ ≅
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (pullback i₁ i₂).Modules 0).obj M))
    (hres' : ∃ M : (pullback i₁' i₂).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
          (pullback.snd i₁' i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E₂ ≅
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (pullback i₁' i₂).Modules 0).obj M)) :
    localizedChernClassOfClosedCover C sX i₁ i₂ hcover hE₂ p hres =
      localizedChernClassOfClosedCover C sX i₁' i₂ hcover' hE₂ p hres'
declarations.comment: the class c'_p(E₂) ∈ A^p(X₂ ⟶ X) of Stacks 0F9H, for E₂|_{X₁ ∩ X₂} finite locally free of rank < p in degree 0: the classes built from two covers X = X₁ ∪ X₂ and X = X₁' ∪ X₂ with E₂|_{X₁ ∩ X₂} and E₂|_{X₁' ∩ X₂} finite locally free of rank < p in degree 0 are equal

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.canonicalBivariantProperPushforward_localizedPowerSumOfClosedCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAI, for the classes `P_p`.** In the situation of Stacks 0F9H — closed immersions
`i_j : X_j ⟶ X` with `X = X₁ ∪ X₂` set theoretically, and `E₂ ∈ D(𝒪_{X₂})` perfect with
defined Chern classes and `E₂|_{X₁ ∩ X₂}` zero — let `X₂' ⊂ X₂` and `X₁ ⊂ X₁' ⊂ X` be closed
subschemes with `X = X₁' ∪ X₂'` set theoretically, and assume `E₂|_{X₁' ∩ X₂}` is zero. Then

  `(X₂' ⟶ X₂)_* ∘ P'_p(E₂|_{X₂'}) = P'_p(E₂)`   in   `A^p(X₂ ⟶ X)`,

where `P'_p(E₂|_{X₂'}) ∈ A^p(X₂' ⟶ X)` is the class of Stacks 0F9H for the cover
`X = X₁' ∪ X₂'` (`Stacks.Chow.localizedPowerSumOfClosedCover`), `P'_p(E₂)` the one for
`X = X₁ ∪ X₂`, and `(X₂' ⟶ X₂)_* ∘ -` the proper pushforward of Stacks 0EPK.
declarations.statement:
theorem canonicalBivariantProperPushforward_localizedPowerSumOfClosedCover
    (hcover : Set.range i₁.base ∪ Set.range i₂.base = Set.univ)
