    (perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X₂.toRingedSpace) E₂)
    (hzero : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (pullback.snd i₁ i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E₂))
    (_hX₁ : ∃ ι : X₁ ⟶ X₁', ι ≫ i₁' = i₁)
    (hcover' : Set.range i₁'.base ∪ Set.range (j ≫ i₂).base = Set.univ)
    (hzero' : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (pullback.snd i₁' i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E₂)) :
    canonicalBivariantProperPushforward C ((j ≫ i₂) ≫ sX) (i₂ ≫ sX) sX j i₂
        (Category.assoc j i₂ sX).symm rfl (p : ℤ)
        (localizedPowerSumOfClosedCover C sX i₁' (j ≫ i₂) hcover'
          (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedPullback j hE₂) p (isPerfect_shrink j perfect)
          (isZero_shrink i₁' i₂ j hzero')) =
      localizedPowerSumOfClosedCover C sX i₁ i₂ hcover hE₂ p perfect hzero
declarations.comment: the classes P'_p: (X₂' ⟶ X₂)_* ∘ P'_p(E₂|_{X₂'}) = P'_p(E₂) for E₂|_{X₁' ∩ X₂} zero

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.canonicalBivariantProperPushforward_localizedChernClassOfClosedCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAI, for the Chern classes.** In the situation of Stacks 0F9H — closed immersions
`i_j : X_j ⟶ X` with `X = X₁ ∪ X₂` set theoretically, and `E₂ ∈ D(𝒪_{X₂})` perfect with
defined Chern classes and `E₂|_{X₁ ∩ X₂}` isomorphic to a finite locally free module of rank
`< p` in degree `0` — let `X₂' ⊂ X₂` and `X₁ ⊂ X₁' ⊂ X` be closed subschemes with
`X = X₁' ∪ X₂'` set theoretically, and assume `E₂|_{X₁' ∩ X₂}` is isomorphic to a finite locally
free module of rank `< p` placed in degree `0`. Then

  `(X₂' ⟶ X₂)_* ∘ c'_p(E₂|_{X₂'}) = c'_p(E₂)`   in   `A^p(X₂ ⟶ X)`,

where `c'_p(E₂|_{X₂'}) ∈ A^p(X₂' ⟶ X)` is the class of Stacks 0F9H for the cover
`X = X₁' ∪ X₂'` (`Stacks.Chow.localizedChernClassOfClosedCover`), `c'_p(E₂)` the one for
`X = X₁ ∪ X₂`, and `(X₂' ⟶ X₂)_* ∘ -` the proper pushforward of Stacks 0EPK.
declarations.statement:
theorem canonicalBivariantProperPushforward_localizedChernClassOfClosedCover
    (hcover : Set.range i₁.base ∪ Set.range i₂.base = Set.univ)
    (_perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X₂.toRingedSpace) E₂)
    (hres : ∃ M : (pullback i₁ i₂).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
          (pullback.snd i₁ i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E₂ ≅
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (pullback i₁ i₂).Modules 0).obj M))
    (_hX₁ : ∃ ι : X₁ ⟶ X₁', ι ≫ i₁' = i₁)
    (hcover' : Set.range i₁'.base ∪ Set.range (j ≫ i₂).base = Set.univ)
    (hres' : ∃ M : (pullback i₁' i₂).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
          (pullback.snd i₁' i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E₂ ≅
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (pullback i₁' i₂).Modules 0).obj M)) :
    canonicalBivariantProperPushforward C ((j ≫ i₂) ≫ sX) (i₂ ≫ sX) sX j i₂
        (Category.assoc j i₂ sX).symm rfl (p : ℤ)
        (localizedChernClassOfClosedCover C sX i₁' (j ≫ i₂) hcover'
          (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedPullback j hE₂) p
          (exists_iso_single_shrink i₁' i₂ j p hres')) =
      localizedChernClassOfClosedCover C sX i₁ i₂ hcover hE₂ p hres
declarations.comment: the classes c'_p: (X₂' ⟶ X₂)_* ∘ c'_p(E₂|_{X₂'}) = c'_p(E₂) for E₂|_{X₁' ∩ X₂} finite locally free of rank < p in degree 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.comp_localizedChernClassOfClosedCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAJ, for the classes `c'_p`.** Let `X` be locally of finite type over `S`, let
`i_j : X_j ⟶ X` be closed immersions with `X = X₁ ∪ X₂` set theoretically, and let
`E₂ ∈ D(𝒪_{X₂})` be an object whose Chern classes are defined and whose restriction to
`X₁ ∩ X₂` is isomorphic to a finite locally free module of rank `< p` in degree `0`, so that
Stacks 0F9H gives `c'_p(E₂) ∈ A^p(X₂ ⟶ X)`. Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type and
`c ∈ A^r(Y ⟶ X)`. Then

  `c ∘ c'_p(E₂) = c'_p(Lf₂^*E₂) ∘ c`,

where `f₂ : X₂ ×_X Y ⟶ X₂` is the base change of `f` and `c'_p(Lf₂^*E₂) ∈ A^p(X₂ ×_X Y ⟶ Y)` is
the class of Stacks 0F9H for the cover of `Y` by the base changes `X_j ×_X Y` and the derived
pullback `Lf₂^*E₂` (which satisfies the hypotheses of Stacks 0F9H by
`Stacks.Chow.hasDefinedChernClasses_baseChange` and `Stacks.Chow.exists_iso_single_baseChange`).
The left side is `res(c) ∘ c'_p(E₂)`, a class for `Y ×_X X₂ ⟶ X` of degree `r + p`; the right side,
a class for `X₂ ×_X Y ⟶ X` of degree `p + r`, is read on `Y ×_X X₂` through the symmetry of the
fibre product. Perfectness of `E₂`, assumed in Stacks 0F9H, is not used for `c'_p`.
declarations.statement:
theorem comp_localizedChernClassOfClosedCover
    (hres : ∃ M : (pullback i₁ i₂).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
          (pullback.snd i₁ i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E₂ ≅
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (pullback i₁ i₂).Modules 0).obj M))
    (c : BivariantChowClass C (f ≫ sX) sX f rfl r) :
    (c.restrict i₂ rfl).comp (BivariantChowClass.equivBivariantClass.symm
        (localizedChernClassOfClosedCover C sX i₁ i₂ hcover hE₂ p hres)) =
      (((BivariantChowClass.equivBivariantClass.symm
          (localizedChernClassOfClosedCover C (f ≫ sX) (pullback.snd i₁ f) (pullback.snd i₂ f)
            (range_pullbackSnd_union_range_pullbackSnd i₁ i₂ hcover f)
            (hasDefinedChernClasses_baseChange i₂ hE₂ f) p
            (exists_iso_single_baseChange i₁ i₂ p f hres))).comp c).degreeCongr
        (add_comm (p : ℤ) r)).transport
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq (BivariantChowClass.restrict_structure_eq rfl i₂ rfl) rfl)
        (pullbackSymmetry i₂ f) (pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd_comp f i₂)
declarations.comment: the classes c'_p: c ∘ c'_p(E₂) = c'_p(Lf₂^*E₂) ∘ c for every bivariant class c in A^r(Y → X), f : Y → X locally of finite type, the composites read as in Remark 0FA2

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.comp_localizedPowerSumOfClosedCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAJ, for the classes `P'_p`.** Let `X` be locally of finite type over `S`, let
`i_j : X_j ⟶ X` be closed immersions with `X = X₁ ∪ X₂` set theoretically, and let
`E₂ ∈ D(𝒪_{X₂})` be a perfect object whose Chern classes are defined and whose restriction to
`X₁ ∩ X₂` is zero, so that Stacks 0F9H gives `P'_p(E₂) ∈ A^p(X₂ ⟶ X)`. Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be
locally of finite type and `c ∈ A^r(Y ⟶ X)`. Then

  `c ∘ P'_p(E₂) = P'_p(Lf₂^*E₂) ∘ c`,

where `f₂ : X₂ ×_X Y ⟶ X₂` is the base change of `f` and `P'_p(Lf₂^*E₂) ∈ A^p(X₂ ×_X Y ⟶ Y)` is
the class of Stacks 0F9H for the cover of `Y` by the base changes `X_j ×_X Y` and the derived
pullback `Lf₂^*E₂`, the composites being read as in
`Stacks.Chow.comp_localizedChernClassOfClosedCover`.
declarations.statement:
theorem comp_localizedPowerSumOfClosedCover
    (perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := X₂.toRingedSpace) E₂)
    (hzero : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (pullback.snd i₁ i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E₂))
    (c : BivariantChowClass C (f ≫ sX) sX f rfl r) :
    (c.restrict i₂ rfl).comp (BivariantChowClass.equivBivariantClass.symm
        (localizedPowerSumOfClosedCover C sX i₁ i₂ hcover hE₂ p perfect hzero)) =
      (((BivariantChowClass.equivBivariantClass.symm
          (localizedPowerSumOfClosedCover C (f ≫ sX) (pullback.snd i₁ f) (pullback.snd i₂ f)
            (range_pullbackSnd_union_range_pullbackSnd i₁ i₂ hcover f)
            (hasDefinedChernClasses_baseChange i₂ hE₂ f) p (isPerfect_baseChange i₂ f perfect)
            (isZero_baseChange i₁ i₂ f hzero))).comp c).degreeCongr
        (add_comm (p : ℤ) r)).transport
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq (BivariantChowClass.restrict_structure_eq rfl i₂ rfl) rfl)
        (pullbackSymmetry i₂ f) (pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd_comp f i₂)
declarations.comment: the classes P'_p: c ∘ P'_p(E₂) = P'_p(Lf₂^*E₂) ∘ c for every bivariant class c in A^r(Y → X), f : Y → X locally of finite type, the composites read as in Remark 0FA2

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_closedCoverPowerSum
declarations.doc:
Let `i₁ : X₁ ⟶ X`, `i₂ : X₂ ⟶ X` be closed immersions covering `X`, let `E₂ ∈ D(𝒪_{X₂})` have
defined Chern classes and restrict to zero on `X₁ ∩ X₂`, let `f : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type
and let `c ∈ A^*(Y ⟶ X)`. Then

  `c ∘ P'_p(E₂) = P'_p(Lf₂^*E₂) ∘ c`   in   `A^*(Y₂ ⟶ X)`,

where `Y₂ = X₂ ×_X Y`, `f₂ : Y₂ ⟶ X₂` is the base change of `f`, `P'_p(Lf₂^*E₂) ∈ A^p(Y₂ ⟶ Y)` is
the class of Stacks 0F9H for the base-changed cover of `Y`, and `c ∘ P'_p(E₂)` is the composite of
the restriction of `c` to `X₂` with `P'_p(E₂)`, carried from `Y ×_X X₂` to `Y₂`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_closedCoverPowerSum
    (hzero : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (pullback.snd i₁ i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E₂))
    (c : nonhomogeneousBivariantGroup C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (f ≫ sX) sX f rfl) :
    nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C)
        (pullback.fst f i₂ ≫ (f ≫ sX)) (pullback.fst i₂ f ≫ (i₂ ≫ sX)) sX
        (pullback.snd f i₂ ≫ i₂)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (f ≫ sX) sX f rfl i₂) rfl)
        (pullback.snd i₂ f ≫ f)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl f) rfl)
        (pullbackSymmetry f i₂) (by simp [pullback.condition])
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C)
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (pullback.fst f i₂ ≫ (f ≫ sX)) (i₂ ≫ sX)
          sX (pullback.snd f i₂) i₂
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (f ≫ sX) sX f rfl i₂) rfl
          (nonhomogeneousBivariantRestriction C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (f ≫ sX) sX f rfl i₂
            (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C) c)
          (DirectSum.of _ (p : ℤ)
            (closedCoverPowerSum C sX i₁ i₂ (i₂ ≫ sX) rfl hE₂ p hcover hzero))) =
      nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (pullback.fst i₂ f ≫ (i₂ ≫ sX)) (f ≫ sX) sX
        (pullback.snd i₂ f) f
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl f) rfl
        (DirectSum.of _ (p : ℤ)
          (closedCoverPowerSum C (f ≫ sX) (pullback.snd i₁ f) (pullback.snd i₂ f)
            (pullback.fst i₂ f ≫ (i₂ ≫ sX))
            (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl f)
            (hE₂.derivedPullback (pullback.fst i₂ f)) p
            (range_pullbackSnd_union_eq_univ i₁ i₂ hcover f)
            (isZero_derivedPullback_of_isZero_of_comp_eq
              (pullbackLift_comp_pullbackSnd_eq_pullbackSnd_comp_pullbackFst i₁ i₂ f) hzero)))
        c
declarations.comment: for P'_p: c ∘ P'_p(E₂) = P'_p(Lf₂^*E₂) ∘ c in A^*(Y₂ → X), for every c in A^*(Y → X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_closedCoverChernClass
declarations.doc:
Let `i₁ : X₁ ⟶ X`, `i₂ : X₂ ⟶ X` be closed immersions covering `X`, let `E₂ ∈ D(𝒪_{X₂})` have
defined Chern classes and restrict on `X₁ ∩ X₂` to a finite locally free module of rank `< p` in
degree `0`, let `f : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type and let `c ∈ A^*(Y ⟶ X)`. Then

  `c ∘ c'_p(E₂) = c'_p(Lf₂^*E₂) ∘ c`   in   `A^*(Y₂ ⟶ X)`,

where `Y₂ = X₂ ×_X Y`, `f₂ : Y₂ ⟶ X₂` is the base change of `f`, `c'_p(Lf₂^*E₂) ∈ A^p(Y₂ ⟶ Y)` is
the class of Stacks 0F9H for the base-changed cover of `Y`, and `c ∘ c'_p(E₂)` is the composite of
the restriction of `c` to `X₂` with `c'_p(E₂)`, carried from `Y ×_X X₂` to `Y₂`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_closedCoverChernClass
    (hrank : ∃ M : (pullback i₁ i₂).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (pullback.snd i₁ i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E₂ ≅
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))
    (c : nonhomogeneousBivariantGroup C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (f ≫ sX) sX f rfl) :
    nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C)
        (pullback.fst f i₂ ≫ (f ≫ sX)) (pullback.fst i₂ f ≫ (i₂ ≫ sX)) sX
        (pullback.snd f i₂ ≫ i₂)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (f ≫ sX) sX f rfl i₂) rfl)
        (pullback.snd i₂ f ≫ f)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl f) rfl)
        (pullbackSymmetry f i₂) (by simp [pullback.condition])
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C)
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (pullback.fst f i₂ ≫ (f ≫ sX)) (i₂ ≫ sX)
          sX (pullback.snd f i₂) i₂
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (f ≫ sX) sX f rfl i₂) rfl
          (nonhomogeneousBivariantRestriction C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (f ≫ sX) sX f rfl i₂
            (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C) c)
          (DirectSum.of _ (p : ℤ)
            (closedCoverChernClass C sX i₁ i₂ (i₂ ≫ sX) rfl hE₂ p hcover hrank))) =
      nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (pullback.fst i₂ f ≫ (i₂ ≫ sX)) (f ≫ sX) sX
        (pullback.snd i₂ f) f
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl f) rfl
        (DirectSum.of _ (p : ℤ)
          (closedCoverChernClass C (f ≫ sX) (pullback.snd i₁ f) (pullback.snd i₂ f)
            (pullback.fst i₂ f ≫ (i₂ ≫ sX))
            (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl f)
            (hE₂.derivedPullback (pullback.fst i₂ f)) p
            (range_pullbackSnd_union_eq_univ i₁ i₂ hcover f)
            (exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT_derivedPullback_of_comp_eq
              (pullbackLift_comp_pullbackSnd_eq_pullbackSnd_comp_pullbackFst i₁ i₂ f) hrank)))
        c
declarations.comment: for c'_p: c ∘ c'_p(E₂) = c'_p(Lf₂^*E₂) ∘ c in A^*(Y₂ → X), for every c in A^*(Y → X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.closedCoverPowerSum_succ
declarations.doc:
In the situation of Stacks 0F9H, assume that `E₂` restricts to zero on `X₁ ∩ X₂`, so that
`c'_p(E₂)` is defined for every `p ≥ 1`. Then the classes `P'_p(E₂) ∈ A^p(X₂ ⟶ X)` are Newton's
polynomials in the classes `c'_i(E₂)`, with the multiplication of Stacks 0FA0
(`(c, c') ↦ res(c) ∘ c'`, `Stacks.Chow.supportedMul`):

  `P'_{p+1}(E₂) = ∑_{j < p} (-1)^j c'_{j+1}(E₂) P'_{p-j}(E₂) + (-1)^p (p + 1) c'_{p+1}(E₂)`

for every `p ≥ 0`. This is the recursion defining the universal power-sum polynomials of Stacks
0F9B, so `P'_1 = c'_1`, `P'_2 = c'_1² - 2c'_2`, `P'_3 = c'_1³ - 3c'_1c'_2 + 3c'_3`, and so on.
The summand `c'_{j+1} P'_{p-j}` lies in `A^{(j+1)+(p-j)}(X₂ ⟶ X)`, read in degree `p + 1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem closedCoverPowerSum_succ (q : ℕ) :
    closedCoverPowerSum C sX i₁ i₂ sX₂ hi₂ hE₂ (q + 1) hcover hzero =
      ∑ j ∈ (Finset.range q).attach, ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ)) •
          bivariantClassDegreeCongr C _ sX₂ sX i₂ hi₂ (newton_degree_eq (Finset.mem_range.mp j.2))
            (supportedMul C sX₂ sX i₂ hi₂
              (closedCoverChernClassOfIsZero C sX i₁ i₂ sX₂ hi₂ hE₂ hcover hzero ((j : ℕ) + 1)
                (Nat.succ_pos _))
              (closedCoverPowerSum C sX i₁ i₂ sX₂ hi₂ hE₂ (q - j) hcover hzero)) +
        ((-1 : ℤ) ^ q * ((q : ℤ) + 1)) •
          closedCoverChernClassOfIsZero C sX i₁ i₂ sX₂ hi₂ hE₂ hcover hzero (q + 1)
            (Nat.succ_pos _)
declarations.comment: Newton's recursion P'_{p+1} = ∑_{j<p} (-1)^j c'_{j+1} P'_{p-j} + (-1)^p (p+1) c'_{p+1}, for every p ≥ 0, with the multiplication of 0FA0; it determines every displayed identity and the ones after it (and so on)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.closedCoverPowerSum_first_four
declarations.doc:
In the situation of Stacks 0F9H, with `E₂` restricting to zero on `X₁ ∩ X₂`,

* `P'_1 = c'_1`,
* `P'_2 = c'_1² - 2c'_2`,
* `P'_3 = c'_1³ - 3c'_1c'_2 + 3c'_3`,
* `P'_4 = c'_1⁴ - 4c'_1²c'_2 + 4c'_1c'_3 + 2c'_2² - 4c'_4`

in `A^p(X₂ ⟶ X)`, with the multiplication `(c, c') ↦ res(c) ∘ c'` of Stacks 0FA0
(`Stacks.Chow.supportedMul`), products bracketed to the right and read in the degree of the
left-hand side. The general case ("and so on") is `Stacks.Chow.closedCoverPowerSum_succ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem closedCoverPowerSum_first_four :
    let c := fun i (hi : 0 < i) =>
      closedCoverChernClassOfIsZero C sX i₁ i₂ (i₂ ≫ sX) rfl hE₂ hcover hzero i hi
    let m := fun {a b : ℤ} (x : BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl a)
      (y : BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl b) =>
        supportedMul C (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl x y
    let P := fun q => closedCoverPowerSum C sX i₁ i₂ (i₂ ≫ sX) rfl hE₂ q hcover hzero
    let d := fun {a b : ℤ} (h : a = b) =>
      bivariantClassDegreeCongr C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl h
    P 1 = c 1 (by norm_num) ∧
    P 2 = d (by norm_num) (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (c 1 (by norm_num))) -
      (2 : ℤ) • c 2 (by norm_num) ∧
    P 3 = d (by norm_num) (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (d (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) + 1 = 2)
        (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (c 1 (by norm_num))))) -
      (3 : ℤ) • d (by norm_num) (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (c 2 (by norm_num))) +
      (3 : ℤ) • c 3 (by norm_num) ∧
    P 4 = d (by norm_num) (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (d (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) + 2 = 3)
        (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (d (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) + 1 = 2)
          (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (c 1 (by norm_num))))))) -
      (4 : ℤ) • d (by norm_num) (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (d (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) + 2 = 3)
        (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (c 2 (by norm_num))))) +
      (4 : ℤ) • d (by norm_num) (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (c 3 (by norm_num))) +
      (2 : ℤ) • d (by norm_num) (m (c 2 (by norm_num)) (c 2 (by norm_num))) -
      (4 : ℤ) • c 4 (by norm_num)
declarations.comment: the four displayed identities, with the multiplication of 0FA0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.closedCoverTotalChernClass
declarations.doc:
**The class `c^{(p)}(E) ∈ A^{(p)}(X₂ ⟶ X)`.** Let `i₁ : X₁ ⟶ X`, `i₂ : X₂ ⟶ X` be closed
immersions whose images cover `X`, and let `E ∈ D(𝒪_X)` have defined Chern classes, with
`(E|_{X₂})|_{X₁ ∩ X₂}` isomorphic to a finite locally free module of rank `< p` placed in degree
`0`. Then

  `c^{(p)}(E) = 1 + c_1(E) + … + c_{p-1}(E) + c'_p(E|_{X₂}) + c'_{p+1}(E|_{X₂}) + …`:

its component in a degree `0 ≤ i < p` is `c_i(E) ∈ A^i(X)`, in a negative degree it is `0`, and
in a degree `i ≥ p` it is the class `c'_i(E|_{X₂}) ∈ A^i(X₂ ⟶ X)` of Stacks 0F9H
(`Stacks.Chow.closedCoverChernClass`), which is defined since a rank `< p` is a rank `< i`.
declarations.statement:
def closedCoverTotalChernClass {E : DerivedCategory X.Modules} (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E)
    (p : ℕ)
    (hrank : ∃ M : (pullback i₁ i₂).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (pullback.snd i₁ i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
          ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
            i₂.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E) ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) :
    localizedBivariantGrading C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl p
declarations.comment: the class c^(p)(E) in A^(p)(X₂ → X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.closedCoverTotalChernClass_biprod
declarations.doc:
Let `i₁ : X₁ ⟶ X`, `i₂ : X₂ ⟶ X` be closed immersions with `X = X₁ ∪ X₂` set-theoretically,
and let `E, F ∈ D(𝒪_X)` have defined Chern classes, with `E|_{X₁}` and `F|_{X₁}` isomorphic to
finite locally free `𝒪_{X₁}`-modules of rank `< p` and `< q` placed in degree `0`. Then

  `c^{(p+q)}(E ⊕ F) = c^{(p)}(E) c^{(q)}(F)`   in `A^{(p+q)}(X₂ ⟶ X)`,

with the multiplication of Stacks 0FA0 (`Stacks.Chow.localizedGradingMul`). The hypotheses of
Stacks 0F9H on `E|_{X₂}`, `F|_{X₂}` and `(E ⊕ F)|_{X₂}`, under which the classes `c^{(·)}` are
defined, follow from these
(`Stacks.Chow.exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT_derivedPullback_pullbackSnd`,
`Stacks.Chow.exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT_derivedPullback_biprod`), and so does the
definedness of the Chern classes of `E ⊕ F` (`Stacks.Chow.hasDefinedChernClasses_biprod`).

**The correction.** The source assumes in (2) that the restrictions `E|_{X₁ ∩ X₂}` and
`F|_{X₁ ∩ X₂}` are finite locally free of rank `< p`, `< q` (calling them `𝒪_{X₁}`-modules). As
written, on `X₁ ∩ X₂`, the statement is false: let `X = X₁ ⊔ X₂` be a disjoint union of
`X₁ = ℙ¹_k` over a field and a point `X₂`, so that (2) is vacuous; take `E = 𝒪(1)^{⊕ 2}` on `X₁`
and `0` on `X₂`, `F = 0` and `p = q = 1`. In degree `1 < p + q` the component of
`c^{(2)}(E ⊕ F)` is `c_1(E) ≠ 0`, while that of `c^{(1)}(E) c^{(1)}(F)` is
`(i_{2,*} c'_1(E|_{X₂})) · 1 + 1 · (i_{2,*} c'_1(0)) = 0`. The hypothesis on `X₁`, to which the
phrase "`𝒪_{X₁}`-modules" points, is the one Stacks 0F9I needs to compare the pushed classes
`i_{2,*} c'_i(E|_{X₂})` with `c_i(E)`, and with it the statement holds. Perfectness of `E`, `F`
is not used, only that their Chern classes are defined.
declarations.statement:
theorem closedCoverTotalChernClass_biprod
    (hrankE : ∃ M : X₁.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        i₁.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))
    (hrankF : ∃ M : X₁.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M q ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        i₁.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj F ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) :
    closedCoverTotalChernClass C sX i₁ i₂ hcover (hasDefinedChernClasses_biprod hE hF) (p + q)
        (exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT_derivedPullback_pullbackSnd i₁ i₂
          (exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT_derivedPullback_biprod i₁ hrankE hrankF)) =
      localizedGradingMul C (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl
        (closedCoverTotalChernClass C sX i₁ i₂ hcover hE p
          (exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT_derivedPullback_pullbackSnd i₁ i₂ hrankE))
        (closedCoverTotalChernClass C sX i₁ i₂ hcover hF q
          (exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT_derivedPullback_pullbackSnd i₁ i₂ hrankF))
declarations.comment: CORRECTED: hypothesis (2) is imposed on E|_{X₁}, F|_{X₁} (as written, on X₁ ∩ X₂, it is false: X = ℙ¹ ⊔ pt, E = 𝒪(1)² on ℙ¹ and 0 on pt, F = 0, p = q = 1, where the degree-1 components are c₁(E) ≠ 0 and 0)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.closedCoverPowerSum_biprod
declarations.doc:
Let `i₁ : X₁ ⟶ X`, `i₂ : X₂ ⟶ X` be closed immersions with `X = X₁ ∪ X₂` set-theoretically, and
let `E, F ∈ D(𝒪_{X₂})` have defined Chern classes and restrict to zero on `X₁ ∩ X₂`. Then
`P'_p(E ⊕ F) = P'_p(E) + P'_p(F)` in `A^p(X₂ ⟶ X)` for every `p ≥ 0`, with `P'_p` the classes of
Stacks 0F9H. (The Chern classes of `E ⊕ F` are defined and it restricts to zero on `X₁ ∩ X₂`, so
`P'_p(E ⊕ F)` is defined; perfectness of `E`, `F` is not needed.)
declarations.statement:
theorem closedCoverPowerSum_biprod {E F : DerivedCategory X₂.Modules}
    (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E) (hF : HasDefinedChernClasses F)
    (hzE : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (pullback.snd i₁ i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E))
    (hzF : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (pullback.snd i₁ i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj F)) (p : ℕ) :
    closedCoverPowerSum C sX i₁ i₂ sX₂ hi₂ (hasDefinedChernClasses_biprod hE hF) p hcover
        (isZero_derivedPullback_biprod (pullback.snd i₁ i₂) hzE hzF) =
      closedCoverPowerSum C sX i₁ i₂ sX₂ hi₂ hE p hcover hzE +
        closedCoverPowerSum C sX i₁ i₂ sX₂ hi₂ hF p hcover hzF

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.closedCoverChernClass_derivedTwist
declarations.doc:
In the situation of Stacks 0F9H — `E₂ ∈ D(𝒪_{X₂})` perfect with defined Chern classes,
restricting on `X₁ ∩ X₂` to a finite locally free module of rank `< p` placed in degree `0` —
assume that `E₂` has constant rank `0`, and let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module. Then the
restriction of `E₂` to `X₁ ∩ X₂` is zero (`hzero` in the statement, by the assumption on the rank),
so `c'_i(E₂)` and `c'_i(E₂ ⊗ ℒ)` are defined for every `i ≥ 1`, and

  `c'_i(E₂ ⊗ ℒ) = ∑_{j=0}^{i-1} binom(-i + j, j) c'_{i-j}(E₂) c_1(ℒ)^j`

in `A^i(X₂ ⟶ X)`. Here `E₂ ⊗ ℒ` is the twist of `E₂` by `ℒ|_{X₂}` (Stacks 0FAF),
`c_1(ℒ)^j ∈ A^j(X)`, and the product `A^{i-j}(X₂ ⟶ X) × A^j(X) ⟶ A^i(X₂ ⟶ X)` is the first
multiplication of Stacks 0FA0 (`Stacks.Chow.supportedRightComp`), the summand being read in
degree `i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem closedCoverChernClass_derivedTwist {E₂ : DerivedCategory X₂.Modules}
    (perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} E₂) (hE₂ : HasDefinedChernClasses E₂)
    (constantRank : ∀ x : X₂, DerivedFibreBetti.chiDerivedFibre X₂ E₂
      (DerivedFibreBetti.isPseudoCoherent_of_isPerfect E₂ perfect) x = 0) {p : ℕ}
    (hrank : ∃ M : (pullback i₁ i₂).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (pullback.snd i₁ i₂).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E₂ ≅
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) (i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    haveI := isInvertible_pullback i₂ L
    let hzero := DerivedFibreBetti.isZero_derivedPullback_of_chiDerivedFibre_eq_zero
      (pullback.snd i₁ i₂) E₂ perfect constantRank hrank
    closedCoverChernClassOfIsZero C sX i₁ i₂ (i₂ ≫ sX) rfl
        (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTwist hE₂ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i₂).obj L)) hcover
        (isZero_derivedPullback_derivedTwist (pullback.snd i₁ i₂) _ hzero) i hi =
      ∑ j ∈ (Finset.range i).attach, Ring.choose (-(i : ℤ) + (j : ℕ)) (j : ℕ) •
        bivariantClassDegreeCongr C _ (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl
          (twist_degree_eq (Finset.mem_range.mp j.2))
          (supportedRightComp C (i₂ ≫ sX) sX i₂ rfl
            (closedCoverChernClassOfIsZero C sX i₁ i₂ (i₂ ≫ sX) rfl hE₂ hcover hzero (i - j)
              (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp j.2; omega))
            ((TotalChowClass.firstChernTotal C sX L ^ (j : ℕ)) (j : ℕ)))

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.gysinAtInfinityClass_properPushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAQ.** Let `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` be proper and an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`, and let
`g : W' ⟶ W` be proper and an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`. Let `C' ∈ A⁰(W'_∞ ⟶ X)` and
`C ∈ A⁰(W_∞ ⟶ X)` be the classes of Stacks 0F9J for `b ∘ g` and for `b`
(`Stacks.Chow.gysinAtInfinityClass`). Then `g_{∞,*} ∘ C' = C`, the left side being the proper
pushforward of Stacks 0EPK along `g_∞ : W'_∞ ⟶ W_∞`.
declarations.statement:
theorem gysinAtInfinityClass_properPushforward :
    bivariantProperPushforwardOfInvertible C (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f (g ≫ b) ≫ f)
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f) f (modificationFibreAtInfinityMap f b g)
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) (modificationFibreAtInfinityMap_comp_over f b g)
        rfl 0
        ((gysinAtInfinityClass C f (g ≫ b)
            (isIso_pullbackSnd_comp_projectiveLineAffineChart f b g hA hg)).congrHom
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity_comp_eq f b g)
          (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq (modificationFibreAtInfinityMap_comp_over f b g) rfl)) =
      gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA
declarations.comment: g_{∞,*} ∘ C' = C for the canonical classes of Lemma 0F9J

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.GysinAtInfinity.properPushforward_gysinAtInfinityClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAQ.** Let `X` be locally of finite type over the base of chapter 42, let
`b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` be proper and an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`, and let `g : W' ⟶ W` be proper and an
isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`, that is, over `b⁻¹(𝐀¹_X)`. Let `C' ∈ A⁰(W'_∞ ⟶ X)` and
`C ∈ A⁰(W_∞ ⟶ X)` be the classes of Stacks 0F9J for `b ∘ g` and for `b`. Then

  `g_{∞,*} ∘ C' = C`  in  `A⁰(W_∞ ⟶ X)`,

where `g_∞ : W'_∞ ⟶ W_∞` is the restriction of `g` and the left side is the proper pushforward of
Stacks 0EPK. The class `C'` is read for the morphism `g_∞ ≫ (W_∞ ⟶ X)`, which equals the structure
morphism `W'_∞ ⟶ X`, through `Stacks.Chow.BivariantClass.copy`.
declarations.statement:
theorem properPushforward_gysinAtInfinityClass
    (hA : IsIso (pullback.snd b (projectiveLineAffineChart f)))
    (hg : IsIso (pullback.snd g (chartInclusion f b))) :
    haveI := hA
    haveI := hg
    canonicalBivariantProperPushforward C (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f (g ≫ b) ≫ f)
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f) f (infinityMap f b g)
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b)
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, infinityMap_comp_projection]) rfl 0
        (BivariantClass.copy C (canonicalGysinSystem C)
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f (g ≫ b) ≫ f) f
          (infinityMap_comp_projection f b g).symm rfl
          (by rw [infinityMap_comp_projection]) rfl
          (gysinAtInfinityClass C f (g ≫ b) (isIso_pullbackSnd_comp f b g))) =
      gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.GysinAtInfinity.gysinAtInfinity_retraction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAR.** Let `X` be locally of finite type over the base of chapter 42, let
`b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` be proper and an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`, let `i_∞ : W_∞ ⟶ W` be the fibre at
infinity, `p : W ⟶ X` the projection and `C ∈ A⁰(W_∞ ⟶ X)` the class of Stacks 0F9J. Then
`C ∘ (W_∞ ⟶ X)_* ∘ i_∞^* = i_∞^*`, in the two readings of the module docstring:

1. as bivariant classes over `W`, valid on every test scheme `W' ⟶ W`:
   `res(C) ∘ (i_{∞,*} ∘ i_∞^*) = Γ_* ∘ i_∞^*` in `A¹(W_∞ ×_X W ⟶ W)`, with `res` the restriction
   of Stacks 0F9Z along `p`, `i_∞^*` the Gysin class of Stacks 0B79, the pushforwards those of
   Stacks 0EPK along `i_∞` and along the graph `Γ : W_∞ ⟶ W_∞ ×_X W`, and `∘` that of
   Stacks 0B75;
2. as the operation of the source on the test schemes `W ×_X T`, `T ⟶ X` locally of finite type:
   for `β ∈ A_{k+1}(W ×_X T)`, `C ∩ (W_∞ ×_X T ⟶ T)_*(i_∞^* β) = i_∞^* β` in `A_k(W_∞ ×_X T)`,
   with `C ∩ -` landing in degree `k - 0`, identified with `k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem gysinAtInfinity_retraction :
    bivariantCompositeOfInvertible C
        (pullback.fst (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) (modificationProjection f b) ≫
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f))
        (modificationProjection f b ≫ f) (modificationProjection f b ≫ f)
        (pullback.snd (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) (modificationProjection f b)) (𝟙 W)
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f) f
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) rfl (modificationProjection f b))
        (Category.id_comp _) 0 1
        (bivariantRestrictionOfInvertible C (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f) f
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) rfl (modificationProjection f b) 0
          (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA))
        (infinityGysinPushforwardClass C f b) =
      BivariantClass.copy C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) _ _ (Category.comp_id _).symm _ _
        (zero_add 1).symm (infinityGraphPushforwardClass C f b) ∧
    ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (k : ℤ)
      (β : chowGroup C (testStr C f (modificationProjection f b) g) (k + 1)),
      (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA).cap g k
          (properChowPushforward C (modificationInfinityBaseChangeOver f b g) (g ≫ f)
            (pullback.snd (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) g)
            (modificationInfinityBaseChange_snd_over f b g) k
            (properPushforwardDescends C _ _ _ _ _) (infinityGysin C f b g k β)) =
        chowGroupDegreeEquiv C _ (sub_zero k).symm (infinityGysin C f b g k β)
declarations.comment: C ∘ (W_∞ → X)_* ∘ i_∞^* = i_∞^*: as bivariant classes over W, res(C) ∘ (i_∞,* ∘ i_∞^*) = Γ_* ∘ i_∞^* in A¹(W_∞ ×_X W → W), on every test scheme W' → W; and as the operation β ↦ C ∩ (W_∞ → X)_* i_∞^* β on A_{k+1}(W ×_X T) for T → X

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.gysinCapOfLift_chowPush_modificationInfinityGysin
declarations.doc:
In the situation of Stacks 0F9J, `C ∘ (W_∞ ⟶ X)_* ∘ i_∞^* = i_∞^*`, on every test scheme
`g : T ⟶ X`: for `β ∈ A_{k+1}(W ×_X T)`, the cap operation of the class `C` of Stacks 0F9J on the
pushforward of `i_∞^* β` along `W_∞ ×_X T ⟶ T` is `i_∞^* β`. The identity of bivariant classes is
the case `g = 𝟙 X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem gysinCapOfLift_chowPush_modificationInfinityGysin (k : ℤ)
    (β : chowGroup C (modificationBaseChangeOver f b g) (k + 1)) :
    gysinCapAtInfinity C f b hA g k
        (chowPush C (modificationInfinityBaseChangeOver f b g) (g ≫ f)
          (pullback.snd (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) g)
          (modificationInfinityBaseChange_snd_over f b g) k
          (modificationInfinityGysin C f b g k β)) =
      modificationInfinityGysin C f b g k β
declarations.comment: C ∘ (W_∞ ⟶ X)_* ∘ i_∞^* = i_∞^*, on every test scheme T ⟶ X

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.GysinAtInfinity.gysinAtInfinityClass_comp_comm
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAS.** Let `(S, δ)` be as in Situation 02QL, let `X` be locally of finite type over
`S`, let `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` be a proper morphism which is an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`, and let
`C ∈ A⁰(W_∞ ⟶ X)` be the class of Stacks 0F9J. Let `fY : Y ⟶ X` be a morphism locally of finite
type and `c ∈ A^p(Y ⟶ X)`. Then

  `C ∘ c = c ∘ C`   in   `A^p(W_∞ ×_X Y ⟶ X)`.

Here, as in Remark 0FA2, `C ∘ c = res(C) ∘ c` with `res(C) ∈ A⁰(W_∞ ×_X Y ⟶ Y)` the restriction
of `C` along `fY` (Stacks 0F9Z), and `c ∘ C = res(c) ∘ C` with `res(c) ∈ A^p(Y ×_X W_∞ ⟶ W_∞)` the
restriction of `c` along `W_∞ ⟶ X`; the second composite lives on `Y ×_X W_∞` and in degree
`p + 0`, and is read on `W_∞ ×_X Y` through the canonical isomorphism and in degree `0 + p`. The
bivariant classes are those of Stacks 0B76, `Stacks.Chow.BivariantChowClass`, and `C` is
`Stacks.Chow.GysinAtInfinity.gysinAtInfinityClass` read through the bridge
`Stacks.Chow.BivariantChowClass.equivBivariantClass`.
declarations.statement:
theorem gysinAtInfinityClass_comp_comm {sY : Y ⟶ C.S} [LocallyOfFiniteType sY]
    (hY : fY ≫ f = sY) (c : BivariantChowClass C sY f fY hY p) :
    ((BivariantChowClass.equivBivariantClass.symm (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA)).restrict fY
        hY).comp c =
      (((c.restrict (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) rfl).comp
          (BivariantChowClass.equivBivariantClass.symm (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA))).degreeCongr
        (add_comm p 0)).transport
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq (BivariantChowClass.restrict_structure_eq rfl fY hY) hY)
        (pullbackSymmetry fY (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b))
        (pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd_comp (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) fY)
declarations.comment: C ∘ c = c ∘ C in A^p(W_∞ ×_X Y → X) for the class C of 0F9J and every c in A^p(Y → X), as an equality of bivariant classes after the symmetry W_∞ ×_X Y ≅ Y ×_X W_∞

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_gysinAtInfinityClass
declarations.doc:
Let `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` be proper and an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`, let `C ∈ A⁰(W_∞ ⟶ X)` be the class
of Stacks 0F9J, let `fY : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type and let `c ∈ A^*(Y ⟶ X)`. Then

  `C ∘ c = c ∘ C`   in   `A^*(W_∞ ×_X Y ⟶ X)`,

where `C ∘ c = res(C) ∘ c` and `c ∘ C = res(c) ∘ C`, the latter a class for `Y ×_X W_∞ ⟶ X`
carried to `W_∞ ×_X Y` along the symmetry of the fibre product.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_gysinAtInfinityClass
    (c : nonhomogeneousBivariantGroup C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (fY ≫ f) f fY rfl) :
    nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C)
        (pullback.fst fY (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) ≫ (fY ≫ f))
        (pullback.fst (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) fY ≫
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f)) f
        (pullback.snd fY (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) ≫
          modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (fY ≫ f) f fY rfl _) rfl)
        (pullback.snd (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) fY ≫ fY)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C _ f (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) rfl
            fY) rfl)
        (pullbackSymmetry fY (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b))
        (by simp [pullback.condition])
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C)
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C
          (pullback.fst fY (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) ≫ (fY ≫ f))
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f) f
          (pullback.snd fY (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b))
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b)
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (fY ≫ f) f fY rfl _) rfl
          (nonhomogeneousBivariantRestriction C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (fY ≫ f) f fY rfl
            (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b)
            (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C) c)
          (DirectSum.of _ 0 (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA))) =
      nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C
        (pullback.fst (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) fY ≫
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f)) (fY ≫ f) f
        (pullback.snd (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) fY) fY
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C _ f (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) rfl
          fY) rfl
        (DirectSum.of _ 0 (bivariantRestriction C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C)
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f) f (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) rfl
          fY 0 (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C)
          (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA))) c
declarations.comment: C ∘ c = c ∘ C in A^*(W_∞ ×_X Y → X), for every c in A^*(Y → X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.localizedModificationClass_eq
declarations.doc:
**The localized class does not depend on `T`**, for a general class. Two closed subschemes
`T, T' ⊆ W_∞` containing every point of `W_∞` over `X ∖ Z`, over both of which `q` vanishes, give
the same localized class; for `q = P_p(Q)`, resp. `q = c_p(Q)`, this is the independence of
`P'_p(Q)`, resp. `c'_p(Q)`, of the choice of `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedModificationClass_eq {T' : Scheme.{u}} (t' : T' ⟶ modificationFibreAtInfinity f b)
    [IsClosedImmersion t']
    (hT : ∀ w, modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b w ∉ Set.range z → w ∈ Set.range t)
    (hT' : ∀ w, modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b w ∉ Set.range z → w ∈ Set.range t')
    (hq : BivariantClass.VanishesOver q (t ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b))
    (hq' : BivariantClass.VanishesOver q (t' ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b)) :
    localizedModificationClass D z t hT hq = localizedModificationClass D z t' hT' hq'
declarations.comment: first assertion: P'_p(Q), resp. c'_p(Q), is independent of the closed subscheme T, for a general class q in place of P_p(Q), resp. c_p(Q)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.modificationPowerSum_eq_of_modification
declarations.doc:
**The second assertion of Stacks 0FAU, for `P'_p`.** Let `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` be proper and an
isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`, let `g : W' ⟶ W` be proper with `b' = b ∘ g` an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`
(as it is when `g` is one, `Stacks.Chow.isIso_pullbackSnd_comp_projectiveLineAffineChart`), and
set `Q' = Lg^*Q`. Then `P'_p(Q') = P'_p(Q)` in `A^p(Z ⟶ X)`, the left side built from
`b'`, `Q'` and any closed `T' ⊆ W'_∞` with the properties of Stacks 0F9K, the right side from `b`,
`Q` and `T ⊆ W_∞`.
declarations.statement:
theorem modificationPowerSum_eq_of_modification
    (hT : ∀ w, modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b w ∉ Set.range z → w ∈ Set.range t)
    (hT' : ∀ w, modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b' w ∉ Set.range z → w ∈ Set.range t')
    (hzero : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (t ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q))
    (hzero' : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (t' ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b').toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
        ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback g.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q))) :
    modificationPowerSum C f b' hA' z t' (hQ.derivedPullback g) p hT' hzero' =
      modificationPowerSum C f b hA z t hQ p hT hzero
declarations.comment: second assertion, for P'_p: for g : W' ⟶ W proper with b ∘ g an isomorphism over A^1_X (as when g is one), P'_p(g^*Q) = P'_p(Q)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.modificationChernClass_eq_of_modification
declarations.doc:
**The second assertion of Stacks 0FAU, for `c'_p`.** Let `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` be proper and an
isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`, let `g : W' ⟶ W` be proper with `b' = b ∘ g` an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`
(as it is when `g` is one, `Stacks.Chow.isIso_pullbackSnd_comp_projectiveLineAffineChart`), and
set `Q' = Lg^*Q`. Then `c'_p(Q') = c'_p(Q)` in `A^p(Z ⟶ X)`, the left side built from
`b'`, `Q'` and any closed `T' ⊆ W'_∞` with the properties of Stacks 0F9K, the right side from `b`,
`Q` and `T ⊆ W_∞`.
declarations.statement:
theorem modificationChernClass_eq_of_modification
    (hT : ∀ w, modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b w ∉ Set.range z → w ∈ Set.range t)
    (hT' : ∀ w, modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b' w ∉ Set.range z → w ∈ Set.range t')
    (hrank : ∃ M : T.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (t ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q ≅
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))
    (hrank' : ∃ M : T'.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (t' ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b').toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
          ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback g.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q) ≅
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) :
    modificationChernClass C f b' hA' z t' (hQ.derivedPullback g) p hT' hrank' =
      modificationChernClass C f b hA z t hQ p hT hrank
declarations.comment: second assertion, for c'_p: for g : W' ⟶ W proper with b ∘ g an isomorphism over A^1_X (as when g is one), c'_p(g^*Q) = c'_p(Q)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.GysinAtInfinity.localizedPowerSumAtInfinity_invariance
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAU, for `P'_p(Q)`.** In the situation of Stacks 0F9K — `X` locally of finite type
over `S`, `Z ⊆ X` closed, `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` proper and an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X` (A1), `Q ∈ D(𝒪_W)`
perfect with Chern classes defined (A0) — the class `P'_p(Q) ∈ A^p(Z ⟶ X)`

1. is independent of the choice of the closed subscheme `T ⊆ W_∞` containing all points of `W_∞`
   lying over `X \ Z` with `Q|_T = 0` (A2);
2. is unchanged when `b` is replaced by `b ∘ g` and `Q` by `Q' = g^*Q`, for `g : W' ⟶ W` proper
   and an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`: `T' = g^{-1}(T)` satisfies (A2) for `b ∘ g` and `Q'`, so that
   `P'_p(Q')` is defined, and `P'_p(Q) = P'_p(Q')`, the right side computed with any closed
   subscheme `T' ⊆ W'_∞` satisfying (A2) for `b ∘ g` and `Q'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedPowerSumAtInfinity_invariance
    (perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := W.toRingedSpace) Q)
    (hQ : HasDefinedChernClasses Q) (p : ℕ) :
    (∀ {T₁ : Scheme.{u}} (iT₁ : T₁ ⟶ modificationFibreAtInfinity f b) [IsClosedImmersion iT₁]
      (hT₁ : ∀ w : modificationFibreAtInfinity f b,
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b).base w ∉ Set.range iZ.base →
          w ∈ Set.range iT₁.base)
      (hzero₁ : IsZero (restrictToInfinity C f b Q iT₁))
      {T₂ : Scheme.{u}} (iT₂ : T₂ ⟶ modificationFibreAtInfinity f b) [IsClosedImmersion iT₂]
      (hT₂ : ∀ w : modificationFibreAtInfinity f b,
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b).base w ∉ Set.range iZ.base →
          w ∈ Set.range iT₂.base)
      (hzero₂ : IsZero (restrictToInfinity C f b Q iT₂)),
      localizedPowerSumClassAtInfinity (p := p) C hA iZ hQ perfect hT₁ hzero₁ =
        localizedPowerSumClassAtInfinity (p := p) C hA iZ hQ perfect hT₂ hzero₂) ∧
    (∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (iT : T ⟶ modificationFibreAtInfinity f b) [IsClosedImmersion iT]
      (hT : ∀ w : modificationFibreAtInfinity f b,
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b).base w ∉ Set.range iZ.base → w ∈ Set.range iT.base)
      (hzero : IsZero (restrictToInfinity C f b Q iT))
      {W' : Scheme.{u}} (g : W' ⟶ W) [IsProper g]
      (hg : IsIso (pullback.snd g (chartInclusion f b))),
      ((∀ w : modificationFibreAtInfinity f (g ≫ b),
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f (g ≫ b)).base w ∉ Set.range iZ.base →
            w ∈ Set.range (pullback.snd iT (infinityMap f b g)).base) ∧
        IsZero (restrictToInfinity C f (g ≫ b)
          ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback g.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q)
          (pullback.snd iT (infinityMap f b g)))) ∧
      ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (iT' : T' ⟶ modificationFibreAtInfinity f (g ≫ b))
        [IsClosedImmersion iT']
        (hT' : ∀ w : modificationFibreAtInfinity f (g ≫ b),
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f (g ≫ b)).base w ∉ Set.range iZ.base →
            w ∈ Set.range iT'.base)
        (hzero' : IsZero (restrictToInfinity C f (g ≫ b)
          ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback g.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q)
          iT')),
        haveI := hA
        haveI := hg
        localizedPowerSumClassAtInfinity (p := p) C (isIso_pullbackSnd_comp f b g) iZ
            (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedPullback g hQ)
            (RingedSpace.KFlatDerivedPullback.isPerfect_derivedPullback g.toLRSHom.toShHom Q
              perfect)
            hT' hzero' =
          localizedPowerSumClassAtInfinity (p := p) C hA iZ hQ perfect hT hzero)
declarations.comment: the P'_p(Q) half: independence of the choice of the closed subscheme T, and P'_p(Q) = P'_p(Q') for a proper g : W' ⟶ W which is an isomorphism over 𝐀¹_X and Q' = g^*Q

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.GysinAtInfinity.localizedChernClassAtInfinity_invariance
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAU, for `c'_p(Q)`.** In the situation of Stacks 0F9K — `X` locally of finite type
over `S`, `Z ⊆ X` closed, `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` proper and an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X` (A1), `Q ∈ D(𝒪_W)`
perfect with Chern classes defined (A0) — the class `c'_p(Q) ∈ A^p(Z ⟶ X)`

1. is independent of the choice of the closed subscheme `T ⊆ W_∞` containing all points of `W_∞`
   lying over `X \ Z` with `Q|_T` isomorphic to a finite locally free `𝒪_T`-module of rank `< p`
   in degree `0` (A2);
2. is unchanged when `b` is replaced by `b ∘ g` and `Q` by `Q' = g^*Q`, for `g : W' ⟶ W` proper
   and an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X`: `T' = g^{-1}(T)` satisfies (A2) for `b ∘ g` and `Q'`, so that
   `c'_p(Q')` is defined, and `c'_p(Q) = c'_p(Q')`, the right side computed with any closed
   subscheme `T' ⊆ W'_∞` satisfying (A2) for `b ∘ g` and `Q'`.

Perfectness of `Q` is a hypothesis of the source; the construction of `c'_p(Q)` does not use it.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedChernClassAtInfinity_invariance
    (_perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := W.toRingedSpace) Q)
    (hQ : HasDefinedChernClasses Q) (p : ℕ) :
    (∀ {T₁ : Scheme.{u}} (iT₁ : T₁ ⟶ modificationFibreAtInfinity f b) [IsClosedImmersion iT₁]
      (hT₁ : ∀ w : modificationFibreAtInfinity f b,
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b).base w ∉ Set.range iZ.base →
          w ∈ Set.range iT₁.base)
      (hsmall₁ : RestrictionIsLocallyFreeOfRankLT f b iT₁ Q p)
      {T₂ : Scheme.{u}} (iT₂ : T₂ ⟶ modificationFibreAtInfinity f b) [IsClosedImmersion iT₂]
      (hT₂ : ∀ w : modificationFibreAtInfinity f b,
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b).base w ∉ Set.range iZ.base →
          w ∈ Set.range iT₂.base)
      (hsmall₂ : RestrictionIsLocallyFreeOfRankLT f b iT₂ Q p),
      localizedChernClassAtInfinity C hA iZ hQ hT₁ hsmall₁ =
        localizedChernClassAtInfinity C hA iZ hQ hT₂ hsmall₂) ∧
    (∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (iT : T ⟶ modificationFibreAtInfinity f b) [IsClosedImmersion iT]
      (hT : ∀ w : modificationFibreAtInfinity f b,
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b).base w ∉ Set.range iZ.base → w ∈ Set.range iT.base)
      (hsmall : RestrictionIsLocallyFreeOfRankLT f b iT Q p)
      {W' : Scheme.{u}} (g : W' ⟶ W) [IsProper g]
      (hg : IsIso (pullback.snd g (chartInclusion f b))),
      ((∀ w : modificationFibreAtInfinity f (g ≫ b),
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f (g ≫ b)).base w ∉ Set.range iZ.base →
            w ∈ Set.range (pullback.snd iT (infinityMap f b g)).base) ∧
        RestrictionIsLocallyFreeOfRankLT f (g ≫ b) (pullback.snd iT (infinityMap f b g))
          ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback g.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q)
          p) ∧
      ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (iT' : T' ⟶ modificationFibreAtInfinity f (g ≫ b))
        [IsClosedImmersion iT']
        (hT' : ∀ w : modificationFibreAtInfinity f (g ≫ b),
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f (g ≫ b)).base w ∉ Set.range iZ.base →
            w ∈ Set.range iT'.base)
        (hsmall' : RestrictionIsLocallyFreeOfRankLT f (g ≫ b) iT'
          ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback g.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q)
          p),
        haveI := hA
        haveI := hg
        localizedChernClassAtInfinity C (isIso_pullbackSnd_comp f b g) iZ
            (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedPullback g hQ) hT' hsmall' =
          localizedChernClassAtInfinity C hA iZ hQ hT hsmall)
declarations.comment: the c'_p(Q) half: independence of the choice of the closed subscheme T, and c'_p(Q) = c'_p(Q') for a proper g : W' ⟶ W which is an isomorphism over 𝐀¹_X and Q' = g^*Q

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.GysinAtInfinity.gysinAtInfinity_comp_localizedChernClassAtInfinity
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAV.** Let `(S, δ)` be as in Situation 02QL, let `X` be locally of finite type over
`S`, let `Z ⊆ X` be a closed subscheme, let `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` be a proper morphism which is an
isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X` (assumption (A1)), and let `Q ∈ D(𝒪_W)` be a perfect object whose Chern
classes are defined (assumption (A0)). Let `T ⊆ W_∞` be a closed subscheme containing all points
of `W_∞` lying over `X \ Z` such that `Q|_T` is isomorphic to a finite locally free
`𝒪_T`-module of rank `< p` sitting in cohomological degree `0` (assumption (A2), in the case of
the lemma). Let `C ∈ A⁰(W_∞ ⟶ X)` be the class of Stacks 0F9J and `c'_p(Q) ∈ A^p(Z ⟶ X)` the
class of Stacks 0F9K. Then

  `C ∘ c_p(Q|_{X × {0}}) = C ∘ (Z ⟶ X)_* ∘ c'_p(Q) = c_p(Q|_{W_∞}) ∘ C`

in `A^p(W_∞ ⟶ X)`. Here `X × {0}` is identified with `X` by the section at zero, the classes
`c_p` are those of Stacks 0GUD, the composites are those of Stacks 0B75 read at `W_∞ ⟶ X` in
degree `0 + p`, and `(Z ⟶ X)_* ∘ c'_p(Q) ∈ A^p(X)` is the pushforward of Stacks 0EPK.
declarations.statement:
theorem gysinAtInfinity_comp_localizedChernClassAtInfinity
    (hA : IsIso (pullback.snd b (projectiveLineAffineChart f)))
    (jZ : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion jZ]
    (iV : V ⟶ modificationFibreAtInfinity f b) [IsClosedImmersion iV]
    (hV : ∀ w, (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b).base w ∉ Set.range jZ.base →
      w ∈ Set.range iV.base)
    {Q : DerivedCategory W.Modules}
    (_perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := W.toRingedSpace) Q)
    (hQ : HasDefinedChernClasses Q) (p : ℕ)
    (hres : RestrictionIsLocallyFreeOfRankLT f b iV Q p) :
    bivariantCompositeIdRightHom C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) f
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b)
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C)
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderPullbackCompPushforward C) (p : ℤ) 0
        (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA) (chernClassAtZero C f b hA hQ p) =
      bivariantCompositeIdRightHom C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) f
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b)
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C)
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderPullbackCompPushforward C) (p : ℤ) 0
        (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA)
        (properPushforwardLocalizedChernClassAtInfinity C hA jZ hQ hV hres) ∧
    bivariantCompositeIdRightHom C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) f
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b)
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C)
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderPullbackCompPushforward C) (p : ℤ) 0
        (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA)
        (properPushforwardLocalizedChernClassAtInfinity C hA jZ hQ hV hres) =
      bivariantCompositeIdLeftHom C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) f
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b)
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C)
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderPullbackCompPushforward C) (p : ℤ) 0
        (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA) (chernClassAtInfinity C f b hQ p)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.gysinAtInfinityClass_comp_modificationChernClass
declarations.doc:
In the situation of Stacks 0F9K, let `Q|_T` be finite locally free of rank `< p` in degree
`0`, and let `C ∈ A⁰(W_∞ ⟶ X)` be the class of Stacks 0F9J (`Stacks.Chow.gysinAtInfinityClass`).
Then

  `C ∘ c_p(Q|_{X × {0}}) = C ∘ (Z ⟶ X)_* ∘ c'_p(Q) = c_p(Q|_{W_∞}) ∘ C`   in   `A^p(W_∞ ⟶ X)`,

where `c'_p(Q)` is `Stacks.Chow.modificationChernClass`, `Q|_{X × {0}}` and `Q|_{W_∞}` are the
derived pullbacks of `Q` along the section at zero and the inclusion of the fibre at infinity,
and `∘` is the composition of Stacks 0B75. The composites, of degrees `0 + p` and `p + 0` for
`W_∞ ⟶ X ⟶ X` and `W_∞ ⟶ W_∞ ⟶ X`, are read as classes of degree `p` for `W_∞ ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem gysinAtInfinityClass_comp_modificationChernClass
    (hT : ∀ w, modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b w ∉ Set.range z → w ∈ Set.range t)
    (hrank : ∃ M : T.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (t ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q ≅
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) :
    BivariantClass.copy C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f) f
        (Category.comp_id (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b))
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq rfl (Category.id_comp f)) rfl (zero_add (p : ℤ))
        (bivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f) f f
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) (𝟙 X) rfl (Category.id_comp f) 0 p
          (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA)
          (perfectChernClass C f (hQ.derivedPullback
            (modificationSectionAtZero f b (isIso_modificationFibreAtZeroProjection f b hA))) p)) =
      BivariantClass.copy C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f)
        f (Category.comp_id (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b))
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq rfl (Category.id_comp f)) rfl (zero_add (p : ℤ))
        (bivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f) f f
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) (𝟙 X) rfl (Category.id_comp f) 0 p
          (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA)
          (properPushforwardChowCohomology C f (z ≫ f) z rfl
            (modificationChernClass C f b hA z t hQ p hT hrank))) ∧
    BivariantClass.copy C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f) f
        (Category.comp_id (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b))
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq rfl (Category.id_comp f)) rfl (zero_add (p : ℤ))
        (bivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f) f f
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) (𝟙 X) rfl (Category.id_comp f) 0 p
          (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA)
          (properPushforwardChowCohomology C f (z ≫ f) z rfl
            (modificationChernClass C f b hA z t hQ p hT hrank))) =
      BivariantClass.copy C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C)
        (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f) f
        (Category.id_comp (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b))
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq (Category.id_comp _) rfl) rfl (add_zero (p : ℤ))
        (bivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f)
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f) f (𝟙 _)
          (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) (Category.id_comp _) rfl p 0
          (perfectChernClass C (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b ≫ f)
            (hQ.derivedPullback (modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b)) p)
          (gysinAtInfinityClass C f b hA))
declarations.comment: C ∘ c_p(Q|_{X × {0}}) = C ∘ (Z ⟶ X)_* ∘ c'_p(Q) = c_p(Q|_{W_∞}) ∘ C, for Q|_T finite locally free of rank < p in degree 0, the composites read in A^p(W_∞ ⟶ X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_modificationPowerSum
declarations.doc:
In the situation of Stacks 0F9K with `Q|_T` zero, let `g : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type and
let `c ∈ A^*(Y ⟶ X)`. Then

  `P'_p(Q) ∘ c = c ∘ P'_p(Q)`   in   `A^*(Y ×_X Z ⟶ X)`,

where `P'_p(Q) ∘ c = res(P'_p(Q)) ∘ c` is a class for `Z ×_X Y ⟶ X`, carried to `Y ×_X Z` along
the symmetry of the fibre product, and `c ∘ P'_p(Q) = res(c) ∘ P'_p(Q)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_modificationPowerSum
    (hT : ∀ w, modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b w ∉ Set.range z → w ∈ Set.range t)
    (hzero : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (t ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q))
    (c : nonhomogeneousBivariantGroup C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (g ≫ f) f g rfl) :
    nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (pullback.fst z g ≫ (z ≫ f))
        (pullback.fst g z ≫ (g ≫ f)) f (pullback.snd z g ≫ g)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (z ≫ f) f z rfl g) rfl)
        (pullback.snd g z ≫ z)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (g ≫ f) f g rfl z) rfl)
        (pullbackSymmetry z g) (by simp [pullback.condition])
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C)
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (pullback.fst z g ≫ (z ≫ f)) (g ≫ f) f
          (pullback.snd z g) g
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (z ≫ f) f z rfl g) rfl
          (DirectSum.of _ (p : ℤ)
            (bivariantRestriction C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (z ≫ f) f z rfl g p
              (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C)
              (modificationPowerSum C f b hA z t hQ p hT hzero))) c) =
      nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (pullback.fst g z ≫ (g ≫ f)) (z ≫ f) f
        (pullback.snd g z) z
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (g ≫ f) f g rfl z) rfl
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantRestriction C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (g ≫ f) f g rfl z
          (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C) c)
        (DirectSum.of _ (p : ℤ) (modificationPowerSum C f b hA z t hQ p hT hzero))
declarations.comment: for P'_p: P'_p(Q) ∘ c = c ∘ P'_p(Q) in A^*(Y ×_X Z → X), for every c in A^*(Y → X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_modificationChernClass
declarations.doc:
In the situation of Stacks 0F9K with `Q|_T` finite locally free of rank `< p` in degree `0`,
let `g : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type and let `c ∈ A^*(Y ⟶ X)`. Then

  `c'_p(Q) ∘ c = c ∘ c'_p(Q)`   in   `A^*(Y ×_X Z ⟶ X)`,

where `c'_p(Q) ∘ c = res(c'_p(Q)) ∘ c` is a class for `Z ×_X Y ⟶ X`, carried to `Y ×_X Z` along
the symmetry of the fibre product, and `c ∘ c'_p(Q) = res(c) ∘ c'_p(Q)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_modificationChernClass
    (hT : ∀ w, modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b w ∉ Set.range z → w ∈ Set.range t)
    (hrank : ∃ M : T.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (t ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q ≅

    (c : nonhomogeneousBivariantGroup C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (g ≫ f) f g rfl) :
    nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (pullback.fst z g ≫ (z ≫ f))
        (pullback.fst g z ≫ (g ≫ f)) f (pullback.snd z g ≫ g)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (z ≫ f) f z rfl g) rfl)
        (pullback.snd g z ≫ z)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (g ≫ f) f g rfl z) rfl)
        (pullbackSymmetry z g) (by simp [pullback.condition])
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C)
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (pullback.fst z g ≫ (z ≫ f)) (g ≫ f) f
          (pullback.snd z g) g
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (z ≫ f) f z rfl g) rfl

              (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C)
              (modificationChernClass C f b hA z t hQ p hT hrank))) c) =
      nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (pullback.fst g z ≫ (g ≫ f)) (z ≫ f) f
        (pullback.snd g z) z
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C (g ≫ f) f g rfl z) rfl
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantRestriction C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (g ≫ f) f g rfl z
          (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C) c)
