declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.GysinAtInfinity.localizedPowerSumAtInfinity_comp_comm
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAW, for the classes `P'_p`.** Let `(S, δ)` be as in Situation 02QL, let `X` be
locally of finite type over `S`, let `Z ⊆ X` be a closed subscheme, let `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` be a
proper morphism which is an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X` (A1), let `Q ∈ D(𝒪_W)` be perfect with
defined Chern classes (A0), and let `T ⊆ W_∞` be a closed subscheme containing all points of
`W_∞` lying over `X \ Z` with `Q|_T` zero (A2). Let `fY : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type and
`c ∈ A^r(Y ⟶ X)`. Then

  `P'_p(Q) ∘ c = c ∘ P'_p(Q)`   in   `A^{p+r}(Y ×_X Z ⟶ X)`,

where `P'_p(Q) ∈ A^p(Z ⟶ X)` is the class of Stacks 0F9K. As in Remark 0FA2 (and Stacks 0FAS),
`P'_p(Q) ∘ c = res(P'_p(Q)) ∘ c` with `res(P'_p(Q)) ∈ A^p(Z ×_X Y ⟶ Y)` the restriction along
`fY` (Remark 0F9Z), and `c ∘ P'_p(Q) = res(c) ∘ P'_p(Q)` with `res(c) ∈ A^r(Y ×_X Z ⟶ Z)`; the
second composite is read on `Z ×_X Y` through the canonical isomorphism and in degree `p + r`.
The bivariant classes are those of Stacks 0B76, `Stacks.Chow.BivariantChowClass`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedPowerSumAtInfinity_comp_comm
    (perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := W.toRingedSpace) Q)
    (hQ : HasDefinedChernClasses Q)
    (hT : ∀ w : modificationFibreAtInfinity f b,
      (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b).base w ∉ Set.range iZ.base → w ∈ Set.range iT.base)
    (p : ℕ) (hzero : IsZero (restrictToInfinity C f b Q iT)) {r : ℤ} {sY : Y ⟶ C.S}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (hY : fY ≫ f = sY) (c : BivariantChowClass C sY f fY hY r) :
    ((BivariantChowClass.equivBivariantClass.symm
        (localizedPowerSumClassAtInfinity (p := p) C hA iZ hQ perfect hT
          hzero)).restrict fY hY).comp c =
      (((c.restrict iZ rfl).comp (BivariantChowClass.equivBivariantClass.symm
          (localizedPowerSumClassAtInfinity (p := p) C hA iZ hQ perfect hT hzero))).degreeCongr
        (add_comm r (p : ℤ))).transport
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq (BivariantChowClass.restrict_structure_eq rfl fY hY) hY)
        (pullbackSymmetry fY iZ) (pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd_comp iZ fY)
declarations.comment: the classes P'_p: P'_p(Q) ∘ c = c ∘ P'_p(Q) for every bivariant class c

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.GysinAtInfinity.localizedChernClassAtInfinity_comp_comm
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAW, for the classes `c'_p`.** Let `(S, δ)` be as in Situation 02QL, let `X` be
locally of finite type over `S`, let `Z ⊆ X` be a closed subscheme, let `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` be a
proper morphism which is an isomorphism over `𝐀¹_X` (A1), let `Q ∈ D(𝒪_W)` be perfect with
defined Chern classes (A0), and let `T ⊆ W_∞` be a closed subscheme containing all points of
`W_∞` lying over `X \ Z` with `Q|_T` isomorphic to a finite locally free `𝒪_T`-module of
rank `< p` sitting in cohomological degree `0` (A2). Let `fY : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type
and `c ∈ A^r(Y ⟶ X)`. Then

  `c'_p(Q) ∘ c = c ∘ c'_p(Q)`   in   `A^{p+r}(Y ×_X Z ⟶ X)`,

where `c'_p(Q) ∈ A^p(Z ⟶ X)` is the class of Stacks 0F9K, the composites being read as in
`Stacks.Chow.GysinAtInfinity.localizedPowerSumAtInfinity_comp_comm`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedChernClassAtInfinity_comp_comm
    (_perfect : RingedSpace.IsPerfect.{u, u + 1} (X := W.toRingedSpace) Q)
    (hQ : HasDefinedChernClasses Q)
    (hT : ∀ w : modificationFibreAtInfinity f b,
      (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b).base w ∉ Set.range iZ.base → w ∈ Set.range iT.base)
    (p : ℕ)
    (hsmall : RestrictionIsLocallyFreeOfRankLT f b iT Q p)
    {r : ℤ} {sY : Y ⟶ C.S} [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (hY : fY ≫ f = sY)
    (c : BivariantChowClass C sY f fY hY r) :
    ((BivariantChowClass.equivBivariantClass.symm
        (localizedChernClassAtInfinity C hA iZ hQ hT hsmall)).restrict fY hY).comp c =
      (((c.restrict iZ rfl).comp (BivariantChowClass.equivBivariantClass.symm
          (localizedChernClassAtInfinity C hA iZ hQ hT hsmall))).degreeCongr
        (add_comm r (p : ℤ))).transport
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq (BivariantChowClass.restrict_structure_eq rfl fY hY) hY)
        (pullbackSymmetry fY iZ) (pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd_comp iZ fY)
declarations.comment: the classes c'_p: c'_p(Q) ∘ c = c ∘ c'_p(Q) for every bivariant class c

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.modificationPowerSum_succ
declarations.doc:
In the situation of Stacks 0F9K, assume that `Q|_T` is zero, so that `c'_p(Q)` is defined
for every `p ≥ 1`. Then the classes `P'_p(Q) ∈ A^p(Z ⟶ X)` are Newton's
polynomials in the classes `c'_i(Q)`, with the multiplication of Stacks 0FA0
(`(c, c') ↦ res(c) ∘ c'`, `Stacks.Chow.supportedMul`):

  `P'_{p+1}(Q) = ∑_{j < p} (-1)^j c'_{j+1}(Q) P'_{p-j}(Q) + (-1)^p (p + 1) c'_{p+1}(Q)`

for every `p ≥ 0`. This is the recursion defining the universal power-sum polynomials, so
`P'_1 = c'_1`, `P'_2 = c'_1² - 2c'_2`, `P'_3 = c'_1³ - 3c'_1c'_2 + 3c'_3`, and so on. The summand
`c'_{j+1} P'_{p-j}` lies in `A^{(j+1)+(p-j)}(Z ⟶ X)`, read in degree `p + 1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem modificationPowerSum_succ (q : ℕ) :
    modificationPowerSum C f b hA z t hQ (q + 1) hT hzero =
      ∑ j ∈ (Finset.range q).attach, ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ)) •
          bivariantClassDegreeCongr C _ (z ≫ f) f z rfl
            (newton_degree_eq (Finset.mem_range.mp j.2))
            (supportedMul C (z ≫ f) f z rfl
              (modificationChernClassOfIsZero C f b hA z t hQ hT hzero ((j : ℕ) + 1)
                (Nat.succ_pos _))
              (modificationPowerSum C f b hA z t hQ (q - j) hT hzero)) +
        ((-1 : ℤ) ^ q * ((q : ℤ) + 1)) •
          modificationChernClassOfIsZero C f b hA z t hQ hT hzero (q + 1) (Nat.succ_pos _)
declarations.comment: Newton's recursion P'_{p+1} = ∑_{j<p} (-1)^j c'_{j+1} P'_{p-j} + (-1)^p (p+1) c'_{p+1}, for every p ≥ 0, with the multiplication of 0FA0; it determines every displayed identity and the ones after it (and so on)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.modificationPowerSum_first_four
declarations.doc:
In the situation of Stacks 0F9K, with `Q|_T` zero,

* `P'_1 = c'_1`,
* `P'_2 = c'_1² - 2c'_2`,
* `P'_3 = c'_1³ - 3c'_1c'_2 + 3c'_3`,
* `P'_4 = c'_1⁴ - 4c'_1²c'_2 + 4c'_1c'_3 + 2c'_2² - 4c'_4`

in `A^p(Z ⟶ X)`, with the multiplication `(c, c') ↦ res(c) ∘ c'` of Stacks 0FA0
(`Stacks.Chow.supportedMul`), products bracketed to the right and read in the degree of the
left-hand side. The general case ("and so on") is `Stacks.Chow.modificationPowerSum_succ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem modificationPowerSum_first_four :
    let c := fun i (hi : 0 < i) =>
      modificationChernClassOfIsZero C f b hA z t hQ hT hzero i hi
    let m := fun {a b : ℤ} (x : BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (z ≫ f) f z rfl a)
      (y : BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (z ≫ f) f z rfl b) =>
        supportedMul C (z ≫ f) f z rfl x y
    let P := fun q => modificationPowerSum C f b hA z t hQ q hT hzero
    let d := fun {a b : ℤ} (h : a = b) =>
      bivariantClassDegreeCongr C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (z ≫ f) f z rfl h
    P 1 = c 1 (by norm_num) ∧
    P 2 = d (by norm_num) (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (c 1 (by norm_num))) -
      (2 : ℤ) • c 2 (by norm_num) ∧
    P 3 = d (by norm_num) (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (d (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) + 1 = 2)
        (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (c 1 (by norm_num))))) -
      (3 : ℤ) • d (by norm_num) (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (c 2 (by norm_num))) +
      (3 : ℤ) • c 3 (by norm_num) ∧
    P 4 = d (by norm_num) (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (d (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) + 2 = 3)
        (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (d (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) + 1 = 2)
          (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (c 1 (by norm_num))))))) -
      (4 : ℤ) • d (by norm_num) (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (d (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) + 2 = 3)
        (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (c 2 (by norm_num))))) +
      (4 : ℤ) • d (by norm_num) (m (c 1 (by norm_num)) (c 3 (by norm_num))) +
      (2 : ℤ) • d (by norm_num) (m (c 2 (by norm_num)) (c 2 (by norm_num))) -
      (4 : ℤ) • c 4 (by norm_num)
declarations.comment: the four displayed identities, with the multiplication of 0FA0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.modificationTotalChernClass
declarations.doc:
**The class `c^{(p)}(Q) ∈ A^{(p)}(Z ⟶ X)` of Stacks 0FAY.** In the situation of Stacks 0F9K
(`Stacks.Chow.modificationChernClass`), with `Q|_T` isomorphic to a finite locally free module of
rank `< p` placed in degree `0`,

  `c^{(p)}(Q) = 1 + c_1(Q|_{X × {0}}) + … + c_{p-1}(Q|_{X × {0}}) + c'_p(Q) + c'_{p+1}(Q) + …`:

its component in a degree `0 ≤ i < p` is `c_i(Q|_{X × {0}}) ∈ A^i(X)`, with `Q|_{X × {0}}` the
derived pullback along the section at zero, in a negative degree it is `0`, and in a degree
`i ≥ p` it is the class `c'_i(Q) ∈ A^i(Z ⟶ X)` of Stacks 0F9K, which is defined since a rank
`< p` is a rank `< i`.
declarations.statement:
def modificationTotalChernClass (p : ℕ)
    (hT : ∀ w, modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b w ∉ Set.range z → w ∈ Set.range t)
    (hrank : ∃ M : T.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (t ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q ≅
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) :
    localizedBivariantGrading C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (z ≫ f) f z rfl p
declarations.comment: the class c^(p)(Q) in A^(p)(Z → X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.modificationTotalChernClass_biprod
declarations.doc:
In the situation of Stacks 0F9K, let `Q, Q' ∈ D(𝒪_W)` have defined Chern classes, with `Q|_T`
and `Q'|_T` isomorphic to finite locally free modules of ranks `< p` and `< p'` placed in degree
`0`. Then

  `c^{(p+p')}(Q ⊕ Q') = c^{(p)}(Q) c^{(p')}(Q')`   in `A^{(p+p')}(Z ⟶ X)`,

with the classes of `Stacks.Chow.modificationTotalChernClass` and the multiplication of
Stacks 0FA0 (`Stacks.Chow.localizedGradingMul`). The hypothesis on `(Q ⊕ Q')|_T`, under which
`c^{(p+p')}(Q ⊕ Q')` is defined, follows from those on `Q|_T` and `Q'|_T`
(`Stacks.Chow.exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT_derivedPullback_biprod`), and so does the
definedness of the Chern classes of `Q ⊕ Q'` (`Stacks.Chow.hasDefinedChernClasses_biprod`).
Perfectness of `Q`, `Q'` is not used, only that their Chern classes are defined.
declarations.statement:
theorem modificationTotalChernClass_biprod
    (hrank : ∃ M : T.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (t ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q ≅
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))
    (hrank' : ∃ M : T.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p' ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (t ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q' ≅
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) :
    modificationTotalChernClass C f b hA z t (hasDefinedChernClasses_biprod hQ hQ') (p + p') hT
        (exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT_derivedPullback_biprod _ hrank hrank') =
      localizedGradingMul C (z ≫ f) f z rfl
        (modificationTotalChernClass C f b hA z t hQ p hT hrank)
        (modificationTotalChernClass C f b hA z t hQ' p' hT hrank')
declarations.comment: c^(p+p')(Q ⊕ Q') = c^(p)(Q) c^(p')(Q') in A^(p+p')(Z → X), with the multiplication of 0FA0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.modificationPowerSum_biprod
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FAZ.** In the situation of Stacks 0F9K, let `Q, Q' ∈ D(𝒪_W)` have defined Chern
classes, and let `T ⊆ W_∞` be closed, contain every point of `W_∞` lying over `X ∖ Z`, and be such
that `Q|_T` and `Q'|_T` are zero. Then the classes `P'_p(Q)`, `P'_p(Q')`, `P'_p(Q ⊕ Q')` of
`A^p(Z ⟶ X)` constructed in Stacks 0F9K (`Stacks.Chow.modificationPowerSum`) satisfy
`P'_p(Q ⊕ Q') = P'_p(Q) + P'_p(Q')`.
declarations.statement:
theorem modificationPowerSum_biprod (hQ : HasDefinedChernClasses Q)
    (hQ' : HasDefinedChernClasses Q') (p : ℕ)
    (hT : ∀ w, modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b w ∉ Set.range z → w ∈ Set.range t)
    (hzero : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (t ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q))
    (hzero' : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (t ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj Q')) :
    modificationPowerSum C f b hA z t (hasDefinedChernClasses_biprod hQ hQ') p hT
        (isZero_derivedPullback_biprod _ hzero hzero') =
      modificationPowerSum C f b hA z t hQ p hT hzero +
        modificationPowerSum C f b hA z t hQ' p hT hzero'

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedPowerSum
declarations.doc:
**The localized class `P_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∈ A^p(Z ⟶ X)` of Stacks 0FB2 and Definition 0FB5 (1)**,
when `E|_{X ∖ Z}` is zero, for every `p ≥ 0`: the class `P'_p(Q)` of Stacks 0F9K for the graph
construction `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X`, `Q` of `E` and the open and closed `T' ⊆ T ⊆ W_∞` on which `Q` is
zero, where `T ⊆ W_∞` is the closed subscheme of Stacks 0F90 (3), (4). The Chern classes of `Q`
are defined in Situation 0GUJ (`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.hasDefinedChernClasses_graphObject`,
from condition (3)).
declarations.statement:
abbrev localizedPowerSum (h : S.IsZeroOnComplement) (p : ℕ) :
    BivariantClass S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl p
declarations.comment: P_p(Z → X, E) ∈ A^p(Z → X), when E|_{X ∖ Z} is zero

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedChern
declarations.doc:
**The localized Chern class `c_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∈ A^p(Z ⟶ X)` of Stacks 0FB2 and
Definition 0FB5 (2)**, when `E|_{X ∖ Z}` is finite locally free of rank `< p` in degree `0`: the
class `c'_p(Q)` of Stacks 0F9K for the graph construction `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X`, `Q` of `E` and the open
and closed `T' ⊆ T ⊆ W_∞` on which `Q` is finite locally free of rank `< p` in degree `0`, where
`T ⊆ W_∞` is the closed subscheme of Stacks 0F90 (3), (4). The Chern classes of `Q` are defined in
Situation 0GUJ (`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.hasDefinedChernClasses_graphObject`, from
condition (3)).
declarations.statement:
abbrev localizedChern (h : S.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement) :
    BivariantClass S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl S.p
declarations.comment: c_p(Z → X, E) ∈ A^p(Z → X), when E|_{X ∖ Z} is finite locally free of rank < p in degree 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.properPushforwardChowCohomology_localizedPowerSum
declarations.doc:
**`i_* ∘ P_p(Z ⟶ X, E) = P_p(E)`** (Stacks 0FB2, equation 0FB1) as bivariant classes on `X`,
with `∘` the pushforward of Stacks 0EPK, when `E|_{X ∖ Z}` is zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem properPushforwardChowCohomology_localizedPowerSum (h : S.IsZeroOnComplement) (p : ℕ) :
    properPushforwardChowCohomology S.base S.a (S.i ≫ S.a) S.i rfl (S.localizedPowerSum h p) =
      perfectPowerSumComponent S.base S.a S.hasDefinedChernClasses_E p
declarations.comment: i_* ∘ P_p(Z → X, E) = P_p(E), when E|_{X ∖ Z} is zero

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.properPushforwardChowCohomology_localizedChern
declarations.doc:
**`i_* ∘ c_p(Z ⟶ X, E) = c_p(E)`** (Stacks 0FB2, equation 0FB1) as bivariant classes on `X`,
with `∘` the pushforward of Stacks 0EPK, when `E|_{X ∖ Z}` is finite locally free of rank `< p`
in degree `0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem properPushforwardChowCohomology_localizedChern
    (h : S.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement) :
    properPushforwardChowCohomology S.base S.a (S.i ≫ S.a) S.i rfl (S.localizedChern h) =
      perfectChernClass S.base S.a S.hasDefinedChernClasses_E S.p
declarations.comment: i_* ∘ c_p(Z → X, E) = c_p(E), when E|_{X ∖ Z} is finite locally free of rank < p in degree 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.bivariantRestriction_localizedPowerSum
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0GUJ with `E|_{X ∖ Z}` zero, let `f : X' ⟶ X` be
locally of finite type, `E' = Lf^*E` and `Z' = f^{-1}(Z) = Z ×_X X'`. Then the class
`P_p(Z' ⟶ X', E') ∈ A^p(Z' ⟶ X')` of Stacks 0FB2, constructed from `X'`, `Z'`, `E'` (the
situation `Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.pullback`), is the restriction (Remark 0F9Z) of
`P_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∈ A^p(Z ⟶ X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantRestriction_localizedPowerSum (h : S.IsZeroOnComplement) (p : ℕ) :
    bivariantClassCongrBase S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (Limits.pullback.snd S.i f)
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq S.base (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl f).symm rfl
        (hv := pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq S.base (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl f)
        (hv' := rfl) p
        (bivariantRestriction S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl f p
          (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso S.base)
          (S.localizedPowerSum h p)) =
      (S.pullback f).localizedPowerSum h.pullback p
declarations.comment: for P_p: the class P_p(Z' → X', E') of Lemma 0FB2 for X', Z' = f^{-1}(Z) and E' = f^*E is the restriction (Remark 0F9Z) of P_p(Z → X, E)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.bivariantRestriction_localizedChern
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0GUJ with `E|_{X ∖ Z}` finite locally free of rank
`< p` in degree `0`, let `f : X' ⟶ X` be locally of finite type, `E' = Lf^*E` and
`Z' = f^{-1}(Z) = Z ×_X X'`. Then the class `c_p(Z' ⟶ X', E') ∈ A^p(Z' ⟶ X')` of Stacks 0FB2,
constructed from `X'`, `Z'`, `E'` (the situation `Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.pullback`),
is the restriction (Remark 0F9Z) of `c_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∈ A^p(Z ⟶ X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantRestriction_localizedChern (h : S.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement) :
    bivariantClassCongrBase S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (Limits.pullback.snd S.i f)
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq S.base (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl f).symm rfl
        (hv := pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq S.base (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl f)
        (hv' := rfl) S.p
        (bivariantRestriction S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl f
          S.p (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso S.base)
          (S.localizedChern h)) =
      (S.pullback f).localizedChern h.pullback
declarations.comment: for c_p: the class c_p(Z' → X', E') of Lemma 0FB2 for X', Z' = f^{-1}(Z) and E' = f^*E is the restriction (Remark 0F9Z) of c_p(Z → X, E)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedPowerSum_cap_chowPush
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FB4, for `P_p(Z ⟶ X, E)`.** In Situation 0GUJ, when `E|_{X ∖ Z}` is zero,
`P_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∩ i_* α = P_p(E|_Z) ∩ α` for `α ∈ CH_*(Z)`, and similarly after every base change:
on every test scheme `g : T ⟶ X`, the cap product of `P_p(Z ⟶ X, E)` with a class pushed forward
from `T ×_X Z` is the operation of `P_p(Li^*E) ∈ A^p(Z)` on it. This is the first formula of the
characterization of Stacks 0F9H. The Chern classes of `Li^*E` are defined by Stacks 0GUE (5), from
those of `E` (`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.hasDefinedChernClasses_E`).
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedPowerSum_cap_chowPush (h : S.IsZeroOnComplement) (p : ℕ)
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S.X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (k : ℤ)
    (α : chowGroup S.base (pullback.fst S.i g ≫ (S.i ≫ S.a)) k) :
    (S.localizedPowerSum h p).cap g k
        (chowPush S.base _ _ (pullback.snd S.i g) (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism rfl g) k
          α) =
      (perfectPowerSumComponent S.base (S.i ≫ S.a)
          (hasDefinedChernClasses_of_derivedPullback S.i _ S.E S.hasDefinedChernClasses_E
            (Iso.refl _)) p).idRule S.base (S.i ≫ S.a)
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (pullback.fst S.i g) k α
declarations.comment: P_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∩ i_* α = P_p(E|_Z) ∩ α, after every base change

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedChern_cap_chowPush
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FB4, for `c_p(Z ⟶ X, E)`.** In Situation 0GUJ, when `E|_{X ∖ Z}` is finite locally
free of rank `< p` in degree `0`, `c_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∩ i_* α = c_p(E|_Z) ∩ α` for `α ∈ CH_*(Z)`, and
similarly after every base change: on every test scheme `g : T ⟶ X`, the cap product of
`c_p(Z ⟶ X, E)` with a class pushed forward from `T ×_X Z` is the operation of
`c_p(Li^*E) ∈ A^p(Z)` on it. This is the first formula of the characterization of Stacks 0F9H.
The Chern classes of `Li^*E` are defined by Stacks 0GUE (5), from those of `E`
(`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.hasDefinedChernClasses_E`).
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedChern_cap_chowPush (h : S.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement)
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S.X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (k : ℤ)
    (α : chowGroup S.base (pullback.fst S.i g ≫ (S.i ≫ S.a)) k) :
    (S.localizedChern h).cap g k
        (chowPush S.base _ _ (pullback.snd S.i g) (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism rfl g) k
          α) =
      (perfectChernClass S.base (S.i ≫ S.a)
          (hasDefinedChernClasses_of_derivedPullback S.i _ S.E S.hasDefinedChernClasses_E
            (Iso.refl _)) S.p).idRule S.base (S.i ≫ S.a)
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (pullback.fst S.i g) k α
declarations.comment: c_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∩ i_* α = c_p(E|_Z) ∩ α, after every base change

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedPowerSum
declarations.doc:
**The localized class `P_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∈ A^p(Z ⟶ X)` of Stacks 0FB2 and Definition 0FB5 (1)**,
when `E|_{X ∖ Z}` is zero, for every `p ≥ 0`: the class `P'_p(Q)` of Stacks 0F9K for the graph
construction `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X`, `Q` of `E` and the open and closed `T' ⊆ T ⊆ W_∞` on which `Q` is
zero, where `T ⊆ W_∞` is the closed subscheme of Stacks 0F90 (3), (4). The Chern classes of `Q`
are defined in Situation 0GUJ (`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.hasDefinedChernClasses_graphObject`,
from condition (3)).
declarations.statement:
abbrev localizedPowerSum (h : S.IsZeroOnComplement) (p : ℕ) :
    BivariantClass S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl p
declarations.comment: (1): P_p(Z → X, E) for every p ≥ 0, when E|_{X ∖ Z} is zero

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedChern
declarations.doc:

Definition 0FB5 (2)**, when `E|_{X ∖ Z}` is finite locally free of rank `< p` in degree `0`: the
class `c'_p(Q)` of Stacks 0F9K for the graph construction `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X`, `Q` of `E` and the open
and closed `T' ⊆ T ⊆ W_∞` on which `Q` is finite locally free of rank `< p` in degree `0`, where
`T ⊆ W_∞` is the closed subscheme of Stacks 0F90 (3), (4). The Chern classes of `Q` are defined in
Situation 0GUJ (`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.hasDefinedChernClasses_graphObject`, from
condition (3)).
declarations.statement:
abbrev localizedChern (h : S.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement) :
    BivariantClass S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl S.p
declarations.comment: (2): the localized pth Chern class c_p(Z → X, E), when E|_{X ∖ Z} is finite locally free of rank < p in degree 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedChernChar
declarations.doc:
**The localized Chern character `ch(Z ⟶ X, E) = ∑_p P_p(Z ⟶ X, E)/p!` of
Definition 0FB5 (1)**, when `E|_{X ∖ Z}` is zero, as an element of
`∏_{p ≥ 0} A^p(Z ⟶ X) ⊗ 𝐐`, built from `Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedPowerSum`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev localizedChernChar (h : S.IsZeroOnComplement) (p : ℕ) :
    TensorProduct ℤ ℚ
      (BivariantClass S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl (p : ℤ))
declarations.comment: (1): the localized Chern character ch(Z → X, E) = Σ_p P_p(Z → X, E)/p! in Π_{p ≥ 0} A^p(Z → X) ⊗ Q, when E|_{X ∖ Z} is zero

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedPowerSum_capVanishesOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FB6, for `P_p(Z ⟶ X, E)`.** In Situation 0GUJ, when `E|_{X ∖ Z}` is zero: if
`α ∈ CH_k(X)` has support disjoint from `Z`, then `P_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∩ α = 0`, and similarly after
every base change: the class caps to zero over every `z : V ⟶ X` whose image is disjoint from `Z`.
This is the second formula of the characterization of Stacks 0F9H.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedPowerSum_capVanishesOver (h : S.IsZeroOnComplement) (p : ℕ)
    {V : Scheme.{u}} (z : V ⟶ S.X) (hz : Disjoint (Set.range z) (Set.range S.i)) :
    (S.localizedPowerSum h p).CapVanishesOver z
declarations.comment: P_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∩ α = 0 for α supported away from Z, after every base change

declarations.statement:
theorem localizedChern_capVanishesOver (h : S.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedPowerSum_withLargerClosed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FB7** (Lemma 42.50.8), for `P_p`. In Situation 0GUJ with `E|_{X ∖ Z}` zero, let
`Z ⊆ Z' ⊆ X` be closed, with `j : Z ⟶ Z'`. Then
`P_p(Z' ⟶ X, E) = (Z ⟶ Z')_* ∘ P_p(Z ⟶ X, E)` in `A^p(Z' ⟶ X)`, with `∘` as in Stacks 0EPK; the
class `P_p(Z' ⟶ X, E)` is that of the situation
`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.withLargerClosed` for `Z'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedPowerSum_withLargerClosed (h : S.IsZeroOnComplement) (p : ℕ) :
    (S.withLargerClosed i' j hj).localizedPowerSum h.withLargerClosed p =
      bivariantProperPushforwardOfInvertible S.base (S.i ≫ S.a) (i' ≫ S.a) S.a j i'
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, hj]) rfl p
        ((S.localizedPowerSum h p).congrHom hj.symm (by rw [hj]))
declarations.comment: for P_p

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedChern_withLargerClosed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FB7** (Lemma 42.50.8), for `c_p`. In Situation 0GUJ with `E|_{X ∖ Z}` finite
locally free of rank `< p` in degree `0`, let `Z ⊆ Z' ⊆ X` be closed, with `j : Z ⟶ Z'`. Then
`c_p(Z' ⟶ X, E) = (Z ⟶ Z')_* ∘ c_p(Z ⟶ X, E)` in `A^p(Z' ⟶ X)`, with `∘` as in Stacks 0EPK; the
class `c_p(Z' ⟶ X, E)` is that of the situation
`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.withLargerClosed` for `Z'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedChern_withLargerClosed (h : S.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement) :
    (S.withLargerClosed i' j hj).localizedChern h.withLargerClosed =
      bivariantProperPushforwardOfInvertible S.base (S.i ≫ S.a) (i' ≫ S.a) S.a j i'
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, hj]) rfl S.p
        ((S.localizedChern h).congrHom hj.symm (by rw [hj]))
declarations.comment: for c_p

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.closedCoverPowerSum_eq_localizedPowerSum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FB8, for `P_p`.** Let `X = X₁ ∪ X₂` be a closed cover, let `E` be a perfect object
of `D(𝒪_X)` whose restriction to `X₁` is zero, and let `(X, X₂, E)` satisfy the finiteness
condition (3) of Situation 0GUJ, i.e. form a situation `S` with `S.Z = X₂`. Then the class
`P'_p(E|_{X₂}) ∈ A^p(X₂ ⟶ X)` of Stacks 0F9H agrees with the localized class
`P_p(X₂ ⟶ X, E)` of Definition 0FB5. Condition (2) of Situation 0GUJ for `X₂` is
`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.isZeroOnComplement_of_isZero_derivedPullback`, and the
vanishing of `E|_{X₂}` on `X₁ ∩ X₂` is that of `E|_{X₁}`.

By Stacks 0BCD `E` vanishes on an open `U ⊇ X₁`; let `Z` be the reduced closed subscheme on
`X ∖ U`, so that `Z ⊆ X₂` and `Z ∩ X₁ = ∅`. By Stacks 0FB7 `P_p(X₂ ⟶ X, E)` is pushed forward from
`P_p(Z ⟶ X, E)`, which kills the classes from `X₁` by Stacks 0FB6; and it caps the classes from
`X₂` as `P_p(E|_{X₂})` does by Stacks 0FB4. Uniqueness in Stacks 0F9H concludes.
declarations.statement:
theorem closedCoverPowerSum_eq_localizedPowerSum
    (hzero : IsZero ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      i₁.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (S.E : DerivedCategory S.X.Modules))) (p : ℕ) :
    closedCoverPowerSum S.base S.a i₁ S.i (S.i ≫ S.a) rfl
        (S.hasDefinedChernClasses_E.derivedPullback S.i) p hcover
        (isZero_derivedPullback_of_isZero_of_comp_eq pullback.condition hzero) =
      S.localizedPowerSum (S.isZeroOnComplement_of_isZero_derivedPullback i₁ hcover hzero) p
declarations.comment: for P_p: P'_p(E₂) = P_p(X₂ → X, E) when E|_{X₁} is zero

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.closedCoverChernClass_eq_localizedChern
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FB8, for `c_p`.** Let `X = X₁ ∪ X₂` be a closed cover, let `E` be a perfect object
of `D(𝒪_X)` whose restriction to `X₁` is a finite locally free module of rank `< p` placed in
degree `0`, and let `(X, X₂, E)` satisfy the finiteness condition (3) of Situation 0GUJ, i.e.
form a situation `S` with `S.Z = X₂` and `S.p = p`. Then the class `c'_p(E|_{X₂}) ∈ A^p(X₂ ⟶ X)`
of Stacks 0F9H agrees with the localized Chern class `c_p(X₂ ⟶ X, E)` of Definition 0FB5.
Condition (2) of Situation 0GUJ for `X₂` is
`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_of_iso_singleFunctor`,
and the hypothesis of Stacks 0F9H on `E|_{X₂}` along `X₁ ∩ X₂` is the restriction of that on
`E|_{X₁}`.

By Stacks 0BCD `E` is a finite locally free module of rank `< p` in degree `0` on an open
`U ⊇ X₁`; let `Z` be the reduced closed subscheme on `X ∖ U`, so that `Z ⊆ X₂` and `Z ∩ X₁ = ∅`.
By Stacks 0FB7 `c_p(X₂ ⟶ X, E)` is pushed forward from `c_p(Z ⟶ X, E)`, which kills the classes
from `X₁` by Stacks 0FB6; and it caps the classes from `X₂` as `c_p(E|_{X₂})` does by
Stacks 0FB4. Uniqueness in Stacks 0F9H concludes.
declarations.statement:
theorem closedCoverChernClass_eq_localizedChern
    (hrank : ∃ M : X₁.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M S.p ∧
      Nonempty ((Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        i₁.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (S.E : DerivedCategory S.X.Modules) ≅
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) :
    closedCoverChernClass S.base S.a i₁ S.i (S.i ≫ S.a) rfl
        (S.hasDefinedChernClasses_E.derivedPullback S.i) S.p hcover
        (exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT_derivedPullback_pullbackSnd i₁ S.i hrank) =
      S.localizedChern
        (S.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_of_iso_singleFunctor i₁ hcover hrank)
declarations.comment: for c_p: c'_p(E₂) = c_p(X₂ → X, E) when E|_{X₁} is finite locally free of rank < p in degree 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedPowerSum_succ
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0GUJ assume `E|_{X ∖ Z}` is zero. Then the
localized classes `P_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∈ A^p(Z ⟶ X)` of Stacks 0FB2 are Newton's polynomials in the
localized Chern classes `c_i(Z ⟶ X, E)` (defined for every `i ≥ 1`, the zero module having
rank `< i`), with the multiplication of the algebra `A^{(1)}(Z ⟶ X)` of Stacks 0FA0
(`(c, c') ↦ res(c) ∘ c'`, `Stacks.Chow.supportedMul`):

  `P_{q+1} = ∑_{j < q} (-1)^j c_{j+1} P_{q-j} + (-1)^q (q + 1) c_{q+1}`

for every `q ≥ 0`. This is the recursion defining the universal power-sum polynomials, so
`P_1 = c_1`, `P_2 = c_1² - 2c_2`, `P_3 = c_1³ - 3c_1c_2 + 3c_3`, and so on. The summand
`c_{j+1} P_{q-j}` lies in `A^{(j+1)+(q-j)}(Z ⟶ X)`, read in degree `q + 1`.

Here `P_p(Z ⟶ X, E)` is `Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedPowerSum` and `c_i(Z ⟶ X, E)` is
`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedChernClassOfIsZero`, the class
`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedChern` for the situation in degree `i`; both are formed
in Situation 0GUJ, condition (3) making the Chern classes of the object `Q` of the graph
construction defined (`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.hasDefinedChernClasses_graphObject`,
Stacks 0GUE).
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedPowerSum_succ (q : ℕ) :
    S.localizedPowerSum h (q + 1) =
      ∑ j ∈ (Finset.range q).attach, ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ)) •
          bivariantClassDegreeCongr S.base _ (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl
            (newton_degree_eq (Finset.mem_range.mp j.2))
            (supportedMul S.base (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl
              (localizedChernClassOfIsZero h (Nat.succ_pos (j : ℕ)))
              (S.localizedPowerSum h (q - j))) +
        ((-1 : ℤ) ^ q * ((q : ℤ) + 1)) • localizedChernClassOfIsZero h (Nat.succ_pos q)
declarations.comment: In Situation 0GUJ with E|_{X ∖ Z} zero: Newton's recursion P_{q+1} = ∑_{j<q} (-1)^j c_{j+1} P_{q-j} + (-1)^q (q+1) c_{q+1} for every q ≥ 0, products in the algebra A^{(1)}(Z → X) of 0FA0; it gives P_1 = c_1, P_2 = c_1² - 2c_2, P_3 = c_1³ - 3c_1c_2 + 3c_3 and so on, the whole lemma

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_localizedPowerSum
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0GUJ with `E|_{X ∖ Z}` zero, let `g : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type and let
`c ∈ A^*(Y ⟶ X)`. Then

  `P_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∘ c = c ∘ P_p(Z ⟶ X, E)`   in   `A^*(Y ×_X Z ⟶ X)`,

where `P_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∘ c = res(P_p(Z ⟶ X, E)) ∘ c` is a class for `Z ×_X Y ⟶ X`, carried to
`Y ×_X Z` along the symmetry of the fibre product, and `c ∘ P_p(Z ⟶ X, E)` is
`res(c) ∘ P_p(Z ⟶ X, E)`. The class is `P'_p(Q)` of Stacks 0F9K for the graph construction, so
this is `Stacks.Chow.nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_modificationPowerSum`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_localizedPowerSum
    (h : S.IsZeroOnComplement) (p : ℕ)
    (c : nonhomogeneousBivariantGroup S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (g ≫ S.a) S.a g
      rfl) :
    nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base)
        (pullback.fst S.i g ≫ (S.i ≫ S.a)) (pullback.fst g S.i ≫ (g ≫ S.a)) S.a
        (pullback.snd S.i g ≫ g)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq S.base (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl g) rfl)
        (pullback.snd g S.i ≫ S.i)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq S.base (g ≫ S.a) S.a g rfl S.i) rfl)
        (pullbackSymmetry S.i g) (by simp [pullback.condition])
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso S.base)
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible S.base (pullback.fst S.i g ≫ (S.i ≫ S.a))
          (g ≫ S.a) S.a (pullback.snd S.i g) g
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq S.base (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl g) rfl
          (DirectSum.of _ (p : ℤ)
            (bivariantRestriction S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl
              g p (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso S.base)
              (S.localizedPowerSum h p))) c) =
      nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible S.base (pullback.fst g S.i ≫ (g ≫ S.a))
        (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a (pullback.snd g S.i) S.i
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq S.base (g ≫ S.a) S.a g rfl S.i) rfl
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantRestriction S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (g ≫ S.a) S.a
          g rfl S.i (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso S.base) c)
        (DirectSum.of _ (p : ℤ) (S.localizedPowerSum h p))
declarations.comment: for P_p(Z → X, E), when E|_(X ∖ Z) is zero: P_p(Z → X, E) ∘ c = c ∘ P_p(Z → X, E) in A^*(Y ×_X Z → X), for every c in A^*(Y → X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_localizedChern
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0GUJ with `E|_{X ∖ Z}` finite locally free of rank `< p` in degree `0`, let
`g : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type and let `c ∈ A^*(Y ⟶ X)`. Then

  `c_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∘ c = c ∘ c_p(Z ⟶ X, E)`   in   `A^*(Y ×_X Z ⟶ X)`,

where `c_p(Z ⟶ X, E) ∘ c = res(c_p(Z ⟶ X, E)) ∘ c` is a class for `Z ×_X Y ⟶ X`, carried to
`Y ×_X Z` along the symmetry of the fibre product, and `c ∘ c_p(Z ⟶ X, E)` is
`res(c) ∘ c_p(Z ⟶ X, E)`. The class is `c'_p(Q)` of Stacks 0F9K for the graph construction, so
this is
`Stacks.Chow.nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_modificationChernClass`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport_compositeOfInvertible_localizedChern
    (h : S.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement)
    (c : nonhomogeneousBivariantGroup S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (g ≫ S.a) S.a g
      rfl) :
    nonhomogeneousBivariantTransport S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base)
        (pullback.fst S.i g ≫ (S.i ≫ S.a)) (pullback.fst g S.i ≫ (g ≫ S.a)) S.a
        (pullback.snd S.i g ≫ g)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq S.base (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl g) rfl)
        (pullback.snd g S.i ≫ S.i)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq S.base (g ≫ S.a) S.a g rfl S.i) rfl)
        (pullbackSymmetry S.i g) (by simp [pullback.condition])
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso S.base)
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible S.base (pullback.fst S.i g ≫ (S.i ≫ S.a))
          (g ≫ S.a) S.a (pullback.snd S.i g) g
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq S.base (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl g) rfl
          (DirectSum.of _ (S.p : ℤ)
            (bivariantRestriction S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl
              g S.p (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso S.base)
              (S.localizedChern h))) c) =
      nonhomogeneousBivariantCompositeOfInvertible S.base (pullback.fst g S.i ≫ (g ≫ S.a))
        (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a (pullback.snd g S.i) S.i
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq S.base (g ≫ S.a) S.a g rfl S.i) rfl
        (nonhomogeneousBivariantRestriction S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (g ≫ S.a) S.a
          g rfl S.i (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso S.base) c)
        (DirectSum.of _ (S.p : ℤ) (S.localizedChern h))
declarations.comment: for c_p(Z → X, E), when E|_(X ∖ Z) is finite locally free of rank < p in degree 0: c_p(Z → X, E) ∘ c = c ∘ c_p(Z → X, E) in A^*(Y ×_X Z → X), for every c in A^*(Y → X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedChernData.totalLocalizedChern
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBC for a perfect object: the total localized Chern class**
`c⁽ᵖ⁾(Z ⟶ X, E) ∈ A⁽ᵖ⁾(Z ⟶ X)`. Its component in a degree `0 ≤ i < p` is the Chern class
`c_i(E) ∈ Aⁱ(X)`, in a negative degree it is `0`, and in a degree `i ≥ p` it is the localized Chern
class `c_i(Z ⟶ X, E) ∈ Aⁱ(Z ⟶ X)` of Remark 0GUK. In Situation 0GUJ it is the class of
Remark 0FBC, built from the classes of Stacks 0FB2
(`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.totalLocalizedChern_toLocalizedChernData`).
declarations.statement:
def totalLocalizedChern :
    localizedBivariantGrading D.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible D.base) (D.i ≫ D.a) D.a D.i rfl D.p
declarations.comment: c^(p)(Z → X, E) for E whose Chern classes are defined, with the localized Chern classes of 0GUK; in Situation 0GUJ it is the class of the remark (LocalizedSituation.totalLocalizedChern_toLocalizedChernData)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedChernData.totalLocalizedChern_fst
declarations.doc:
The components of `c⁽ᵖ⁾(Z ⟶ X, E)` below the cutoff are the Chern classes of `E` (zero in the
negative degrees).
declarations.statement:
theorem totalLocalizedChern_fst (i : {i : ℤ // i < (D.p : ℤ)}) :
    (totalLocalizedChern hE h).1 i =
      (perfectChernClass D.base D.a hE).intComponent D.base D.a i.1
declarations.comment: the components c_i(E) in the degrees i < p, for E whose Chern classes are defined

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedChernData.totalLocalizedChern_snd
declarations.doc: The components of `c⁽ᵖ⁾(Z ⟶ X, E)` from the cutoff on are the localized Chern classes.
declarations.statement:
theorem totalLocalizedChern_snd (i : {i : ℤ // (D.p : ℤ) ≤ i}) :
    (totalLocalizedChern hE h).2 i = localizedChernOfLe hE h i
declarations.comment: the components c_i(Z → X, E) of 0GUK in the degrees i ≥ p, for E whose Chern classes are defined

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.totalLocalizedChern
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBC: the total localized Chern class**
`c⁽ᵖ⁾(Z ⟶ X, E) = 1 + c₁(E) + … + c_{p-1}(E) + c_p(Z ⟶ X, E) + c_{p+1}(Z ⟶ X, E) + …` in the
algebra `A⁽ᵖ⁾(Z ⟶ X)` of Remark 0FA0, in Situation 0GUJ with `E|_{X ∖ Z}` finite locally free of
rank `< p` in degree `0`. Its component in a degree `i < p` is the Chern class `c_i(E) ∈ Aⁱ(X)`
(zero in the negative degrees, `1` in degree `0`), and in a degree `i ≥ p` it is the localized
Chern class `c_i(Z ⟶ X, E) ∈ Aⁱ(Z ⟶ X)` of Stacks 0FB2.
declarations.statement:
def totalLocalizedChern :
    localizedBivariantGrading S.base (gysinSystemOfInvertible S.base) (S.i ≫ S.a) S.a S.i rfl S.p
declarations.comment: the total localized Chern class c^(p)(Z → X, E) in A^(p)(Z → X), in Situation 0GUJ, with the localized Chern classes of 0FB2

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.totalLocalizedChern_fst
declarations.doc:
The components of `c⁽ᵖ⁾(Z ⟶ X, E)` in the degrees `i < p` are the Chern classes `c_i(E)`
(zero in the negative degrees).
declarations.statement:
theorem totalLocalizedChern_fst (i : {i : ℤ // i < (S.p : ℤ)}) :
    (totalLocalizedChern h).1 i =
      (perfectChernClass S.base S.a S.hasDefinedChernClasses_E).intComponent S.base S.a i.1
declarations.comment: the components c_i(E) in the degrees i < p

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.totalLocalizedChern_fst_zero
declarations.doc:
For `p > 0` the component of `c⁽ᵖ⁾(Z ⟶ X, E)` in degree `0` is `c₀(E) = 1`, the leading term
`1` of the display of Remark 0FBC.
declarations.statement:
theorem totalLocalizedChern_fst_zero (hp : 0 < S.p) :
    (totalLocalizedChern h).1 ⟨0, by exact_mod_cast hp⟩ =
      (1 : TotalChowClass S.base S.a).intComponent S.base S.a 0
declarations.comment: the leading term 1 = c_0(E) when p > 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.totalLocalizedChern_snd
declarations.doc:
The components of `c⁽ᵖ⁾(Z ⟶ X, E)` in the degrees `i ≥ p` are the localized Chern classes
`c_i(Z ⟶ X, E)` of Stacks 0FB2.
declarations.statement:
theorem totalLocalizedChern_snd (i : {i : ℤ // (S.p : ℤ) ≤ i}) :
    (totalLocalizedChern h).2 i = localizedChernOfLe h i
declarations.comment: the components c_i(Z → X, E) of 0FB2 in the degrees i ≥ p

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedChernData.totalLocalizedChern_triangle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBD.** Let `(S, δ)` be as in Situation 02QL, let `X` be locally of finite type
over `S`, let `Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion and let `E₁ ⟶ E₂ ⟶ E₃ ⟶ E₁[1]` be a distinguished
triangle of perfect objects of `D(𝒪_X)`. Assume (1) `E₁|_{X ∖ Z}` and `E₃|_{X ∖ Z}` are finite
locally free of rank `< p₁` and `< p₃` placed in degree `0`, and (2) one of: (a) `X` is
quasi-compact, (b) `X` has quasi-compact irreducible components, (c) `E₃ ⟶ E₁[1]` is represented
by a map of locally bounded complexes of finite locally free `𝒪_X`-modules, (d) the same holds for
`Lf^*E₃ ⟶ Lf^*E₁[1]` after an envelope `f : Y ⟶ X`. These are stated as the hypothesis `hc`,
in the source's order (a), (b), (c), (d). Then

  `c⁽ᵖ¹⁺ᵖ³⁾(Z ⟶ X, E₂) = c⁽ᵖ¹⁾(Z ⟶ X, E₁) c⁽ᵖ³⁾(Z ⟶ X, E₃)`   in `A⁽ᵖ¹⁺ᵖ³⁾(Z ⟶ X)`,

with the classes of Remark 0FBC (`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedChernData.totalLocalizedChern`) and the
multiplication of Remark 0FA0 (`Stacks.Chow.localizedGradingMul`). That the statement makes
sense, i.e. that `E₂|_{X ∖ Z}` is finite locally free of rank `< p₁ + p₃` in degree `0` and that
the Chern classes of `E₁`, `E₂`, `E₃` are defined, is
`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedChernData.exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT_restrict_obj₂` and
`Stacks.Chow.hasDefinedChernClasses_triangle_of_mor₃`. This is the output cutoff `r = p₁ + p₃` of
`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedChernData.totalLocalizedChern_triangle_eq_cutoffMul`.
declarations.statement:
theorem totalLocalizedChern_triangle
    (a : E₁ ⟶ E₂) (b : E₂ ⟶ E₃) (c : E₃ ⟶ E₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (hT : Triangle.mk a b c ∈ distTriang _)
    (r₁ : (∃ M : OXMod.{u, u, u} (D.X.toRingedSpace.restrict (⟨(Set.range D.i.base)ᶜ,
      D.i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl⟩ : D.X.Opens).isOpenEmbedding),
      IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p₁ ∧
        Nonempty ((derivedPullback (D.X.toRingedSpace.ofRestrict (⟨(Set.range D.i.base)ᶜ,
          D.i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl⟩ :
            D.X.Opens).isOpenEmbedding)).obj E₁ ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)))
    (r₃ : (∃ M : OXMod.{u, u, u} (D.X.toRingedSpace.restrict (⟨(Set.range D.i.base)ᶜ,
      D.i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl⟩ : D.X.Opens).isOpenEmbedding),
      IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT M p₃ ∧
        Nonempty ((derivedPullback (D.X.toRingedSpace.ofRestrict (⟨(Set.range D.i.base)ᶜ,
          D.i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl⟩ :
            D.X.Opens).isOpenEmbedding)).obj E₃ ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)))
    (hc : CompactSpace D.X ∨ (∀ T ∈ irreducibleComponents D.X, IsCompact T) ∨
      HasMapPresentation c ∨ HasEnvelopeMapPresentation c) :
    totalLocalizedChern (D := D.withObject E₂ (p₁ + p₃) h₂
        (D.exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLT_restrict_obj₂ a b c hT (by omega) r₁ r₃))
        (hasDefinedChernClasses_triangle_of_mor₃ D.base D.a h₁ h₂ h₃ hT
          (hasTriangleChernCondition_of_conditions hc)).2.1
        (D.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_withObject _) =
      localizedGradingMul D.base (D.i ≫ D.a) D.a D.i rfl
        (totalLocalizedChern (D := D.withObject E₁ p₁ h₁ r₁)
          (hasDefinedChernClasses_triangle_of_mor₃ D.base D.a h₁ h₂ h₃ hT
            (hasTriangleChernCondition_of_conditions hc)).1
          (D.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_withObject r₁))
        (totalLocalizedChern (D := D.withObject E₃ p₃ h₃ r₃)
          (hasDefinedChernClasses_triangle_of_mor₃ D.base D.a h₁ h₂ h₃ hT
            (hasTriangleChernCondition_of_conditions hc)).2.2
          (D.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_withObject r₃))

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedChernData.localizedPowerSum_localizedChernChar_triangle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBE.** Let `(S, δ)` be as in Situation 02QL, let `X` be locally of finite type
over `S`, let `Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion and let `E₁ ⟶ E₂ ⟶ E₃ ⟶ E₁[1]` be a distinguished
triangle of perfect objects of `D(𝒪_X)`. Assume (1) `E₁|_{X ∖ Z}` and `E₃|_{X ∖ Z}` are zero,
and (2) one of the conditions (a)–(d) of Stacks 0FBD on `E₃ ⟶ E₁[1]`, stated as the hypothesis `hc`
in the source's order: (a) `X` is quasi-compact, (b) `X` has quasi-compact irreducible components,
(c) `E₃ ⟶ E₁[1]` is represented by a map of locally bounded complexes of finite locally free
`𝒪_X`-modules, (d) the same holds for `Lf^*E₃ ⟶ Lf^*E₁[1]` after an envelope `f : Y ⟶ X`. Then

  `P_p(Z ⟶ X, E₂) = P_p(Z ⟶ X, E₁) + P_p(Z ⟶ X, E₃)`   for all `p`,

and consequently `ch(Z ⟶ X, E₂) = ch(Z ⟶ X, E₁) + ch(Z ⟶ X, E₃)`, in every degree `p`, for the
classes of Remark 0GUK (`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedChernData.localizedPowerSum`,
`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedChernData.localizedChernChar`). The case `p = 0` is included.

The localized classes `P_p(Z ⟶ X, E)` are defined for `p ≥ 0` (Definition 0FB5); the source's
`p ∈ 𝐙` ranges over those.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedPowerSum_localizedChernChar_triangle
    (a : E₁ ⟶ E₂) (b : E₂ ⟶ E₃) (c : E₃ ⟶ E₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (hT : Triangle.mk a b c ∈ distTriang _)
    (z₁ : IsZero ((derivedPullback (D.X.toRingedSpace.ofRestrict (⟨(Set.range D.i.base)ᶜ,
      D.i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl⟩ : D.X.Opens).isOpenEmbedding)).obj E₁))
    (z₃ : IsZero ((derivedPullback (D.X.toRingedSpace.ofRestrict (⟨(Set.range D.i.base)ᶜ,
      D.i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl⟩ : D.X.Opens).isOpenEmbedding)).obj E₃))
    (hc : CompactSpace D.X ∨ (∀ T ∈ irreducibleComponents D.X, IsCompact T) ∨
      HasMapPresentation c ∨ HasEnvelopeMapPresentation c) :
    (∀ p : ℕ,
      (D.withZeroObject E₂ h₂ (D.isZero_restrict_obj₂ a b c hT z₁ z₃)).localizedPowerSum
          (hasDefinedChernClasses_triangle_of_mor₃ D.base D.a h₁ h₂ h₃ hT
            (hasTriangleChernCondition_of_conditions hc)).2.1
          (D.isZero_restrict_obj₂ a b c hT z₁ z₃) p =
        (D.withZeroObject E₁ h₁ z₁).localizedPowerSum
            (hasDefinedChernClasses_triangle_of_mor₃ D.base D.a h₁ h₂ h₃ hT
              (hasTriangleChernCondition_of_conditions hc)).1 z₁ p +
          (D.withZeroObject E₃ h₃ z₃).localizedPowerSum
            (hasDefinedChernClasses_triangle_of_mor₃ D.base D.a h₁ h₂ h₃ hT
              (hasTriangleChernCondition_of_conditions hc)).2.2 z₃ p) ∧
      ∀ p : ℕ,
        (D.withZeroObject E₂ h₂ (D.isZero_restrict_obj₂ a b c hT z₁ z₃)).localizedChernChar
            (hasDefinedChernClasses_triangle_of_mor₃ D.base D.a h₁ h₂ h₃ hT
              (hasTriangleChernCondition_of_conditions hc)).2.1
            (D.isZero_restrict_obj₂ a b c hT z₁ z₃) p =
          (D.withZeroObject E₁ h₁ z₁).localizedChernChar
              (hasDefinedChernClasses_triangle_of_mor₃ D.base D.a h₁ h₂ h₃ hT
                (hasTriangleChernCondition_of_conditions hc)).1 z₁ p +
            (D.withZeroObject E₃ h₃ z₃).localizedChernChar
              (hasDefinedChernClasses_triangle_of_mor₃ D.base D.a h₁ h₂ h₃ hT
                (hasTriangleChernCondition_of_conditions hc)).2.2 z₃ p

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedPowerSum_derivedTensor
declarations.doc:
**The localized power sums of a derived tensor product.** In Situation 02QL let `X` be locally
of finite type over `S`, let `Z₁, Z₂ ⊆ X` be closed subschemes and let `F₁, F₂ ∈ D(𝒪_X)` be perfect
with `F_i|_{X ∖ Z_i}` zero and satisfying condition (3) of Situation 0GUJ. Then

  `P_p(Z₁ ∩ Z₂ ⟶ X, F₁ ⊗^L F₂) = ∑_{p₁ + p₂ = p} C(p, p₁) P_{p₁}(Z₁ ⟶ X, F₁) P_{p₂}(Z₂ ⟶ X, F₂)`

in `A^p(Z₁ ∩ Z₂ ⟶ X)`, the class of `F₁ ⊗^L F₂` being that of Remark 0GUK; the source leaves
implicit in which sense `F₁ ⊗^L F₂` satisfies condition (3) in the mixed cases of alternatives
(c) and (d), which the classes of Remark 0GUK cover.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedPowerSum_derivedTensor (p : ℕ) :
    (LocalizedChernData.derivedTensorOfIsZero C a i₁ i₂ hF₁ hF₂ h₁ h₂ 0).localizedPowerSum
        (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor
          (ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 0).hasDefinedChernClasses_E
          (ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 0).hasDefinedChernClasses_E)
        (isZero_derivedTensor_compl_pullback i₁ i₂ hF₁ hF₂ h₁ h₂) p =
      ∑ q ∈ (antidiagonal p).attach, (p.choose q.1.1 : ℤ) •
        bivariantClassDegreeCongr C _ _ _ _ rfl (by have := mem_antidiagonal.1 q.2; omega)
          (supportedIntersectionMul C a i₁ i₂ (IsPullback.of_hasPullback i₁ i₂) _ rfl
            ((ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 0).localizedPowerSum h₁ q.1.1)
            ((ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 0).localizedPowerSum h₂ q.1.2))
declarations.comment: the formula for P_p(Z_1 cap Z_2 -> X, F_1 tensor^L F_2), with Z_1 cap Z_2 = Z_1 x_X Z_2 and the products those of 0FE5 (supportedIntersectionMul). The source leaves implicit in which sense F_1 tensor^L F_2 satisfies (3) of 0GUJ in the mixed cases ((c) for one factor and (d) for the other, or (d) for both with different X'); the classes of F_1 tensor^L F_2 are those of Remark 0GUK, defined for every perfect object with defined Chern classes, which covers them.

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedChern_one_derivedTensor
declarations.doc:
**The first localized Chern class of a derived tensor product.** In the situation of
`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedPowerSum_derivedTensor`, with
`r_i = P_0(Z_i ⟶ X, F_i)`,

  `c_1(Z₁ ∩ Z₂ ⟶ X, F₁ ⊗^L F₂) = r₁ c_1(Z₂ ⟶ X, F₂) + r₂ c_1(Z₁ ⟶ X, F₁)`

in `A^1(Z₁ ∩ Z₂ ⟶ X)`, the class of `F₁ ⊗^L F₂` being that of Remark 0GUK.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedChern_one_derivedTensor :
    (LocalizedChernData.derivedTensorOfIsZero C a i₁ i₂ hF₁ hF₂ h₁ h₂ 1).localizedChern
        (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor
          (ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 0).hasDefinedChernClasses_E
          (ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 0).hasDefinedChernClasses_E)
        (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _
          (isZero_derivedTensor_compl_pullback i₁ i₂ hF₁ hF₂ h₁ h₂) one_pos) =
      bivariantClassDegreeCongr C _ _ _ _ rfl (by norm_num)
          (supportedIntersectionMul C a i₁ i₂ (IsPullback.of_hasPullback i₁ i₂) _ rfl
            ((ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 0).localizedPowerSum h₁ 0)
            ((ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 1).localizedChern
              (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _ h₂
                one_pos))) +
        bivariantClassDegreeCongr C _ _ _ _ rfl (by norm_num)
          (supportedIntersectionMul C a i₂ i₁ (IsPullback.of_hasPullback i₁ i₂).flip _
            pullback.condition
            ((ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 0).localizedPowerSum h₂ 0)
            ((ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 1).localizedChern
              (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _ h₁
                one_pos)))
declarations.comment: the formula for c_1(Z_1 cap Z_2 -> X, F_1 tensor^L F_2), r_i = P_0(Z_i -> X, F_i); the product r_2 c_1(Z_1 -> X, F_1) is taken for Z_1 cap Z_2 presented as Z_2 x_X Z_1 through the flipped square. The source leaves implicit in which sense F_1 tensor^L F_2 satisfies (3) of 0GUJ in the mixed cases ((c) for one factor and (d) for the other, or (d) for both with different X'); the classes of F_1 tensor^L F_2 are those of Remark 0GUK, defined for every perfect object with defined Chern classes, which covers them.

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedChern_two_derivedTensor
declarations.doc:
**The second localized Chern class of a derived tensor product.** In the situation of
`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedPowerSum_derivedTensor`, with
`r_i = P_0(Z_i ⟶ X, F_i)`, `γ_{i,p} = c_p(Z_i ⟶ X, F_i)` and `C(r_i, 2)` the class
`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedChernData.rankChoose`,

  `c_2(Z₁ ∩ Z₂ ⟶ X, F₁ ⊗^L F₂) = r₁ γ_{2,2} + r₂ γ_{1,2} + C(r₁, 2) γ_{2,1}² +
    ((r₁ r₂) (γ_{2,1} γ_{1,1}) - γ_{2,1} γ_{1,1}) + C(r₂, 2) γ_{1,1}²`

in `A^2(Z₁ ∩ Z₂ ⟶ X)`, the class of `F₁ ⊗^L F₂` being that of Remark 0GUK. The products of a
class supported on `Z₂` with one supported on `Z₁` are taken for `Z₁ ∩ Z₂` presented as
`Z₂ ×_X Z₁` through the flipped square, and the squares are the products of
`Stacks.Chow.supportedMul`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedChern_two_derivedTensor :
    (LocalizedChernData.derivedTensorOfIsZero C a i₁ i₂ hF₁ hF₂ h₁ h₂ 2).localizedChern
        (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor
          (ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 0).hasDefinedChernClasses_E
          (ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 0).hasDefinedChernClasses_E)
        (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _
          (isZero_derivedTensor_compl_pullback i₁ i₂ hF₁ hF₂ h₁ h₂) two_pos) =
      bivariantClassDegreeCongr C _ _ _ _ rfl (by norm_num)
          (supportedIntersectionMul C a i₁ i₂ (IsPullback.of_hasPullback i₁ i₂) _ rfl
            ((ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 0).localizedPowerSum h₁ 0)
            ((ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 2).localizedChern
              (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _ h₂
                two_pos))) +
        bivariantClassDegreeCongr C _ _ _ _ rfl (by norm_num)
          (supportedIntersectionMul C a i₂ i₁ (IsPullback.of_hasPullback i₁ i₂).flip _
            pullback.condition
            ((ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 0).localizedPowerSum h₂ 0)
            ((ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 2).localizedChern
              (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _ h₁
                two_pos))) +
        bivariantClassDegreeCongr C _ _ _ _ rfl (by norm_num)
          (supportedIntersectionMul C a i₁ i₂ (IsPullback.of_hasPullback i₁ i₂) _ rfl
            ((LocalizedChernData.ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ 0).rankChoose h₁ 2 two_pos)
            (supportedMul C (i₂ ≫ a) a i₂ rfl ((ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 1).localizedChern
              (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _ h₂
                one_pos))
              ((ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 1).localizedChern
              (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _ h₂
                one_pos)))) +
        (bivariantClassDegreeCongr C _ _ _ _ rfl (by norm_num)
            (supportedMul C ((pullback.snd i₁ i₂ ≫ i₂) ≫ a) a (pullback.snd i₁ i₂ ≫ i₂) rfl
              (supportedIntersectionMul C a i₁ i₂ (IsPullback.of_hasPullback i₁ i₂) _ rfl
                ((ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 0).localizedPowerSum h₁ 0)
                ((ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 0).localizedPowerSum h₂ 0))
              (supportedIntersectionMul C a i₂ i₁ (IsPullback.of_hasPullback i₁ i₂).flip _
            pullback.condition
                ((ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 1).localizedChern
              (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _ h₂
                one_pos))
                ((ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 1).localizedChern
              (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _ h₁
                one_pos)))) -
          bivariantClassDegreeCongr C _ _ _ _ rfl (by norm_num)
            (supportedIntersectionMul C a i₂ i₁ (IsPullback.of_hasPullback i₁ i₂).flip _
            pullback.condition
              ((ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 1).localizedChern
              (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _ h₂
                one_pos))
              ((ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 1).localizedChern
              (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _ h₁
                one_pos)))) +
        bivariantClassDegreeCongr C _ _ _ _ rfl (by norm_num)
          (supportedIntersectionMul C a i₂ i₁ (IsPullback.of_hasPullback i₁ i₂).flip _
            pullback.condition
            ((LocalizedChernData.ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ 0).rankChoose h₂ 2 two_pos)
            (supportedMul C (i₁ ≫ a) a i₁ rfl ((ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 1).localizedChern
              (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _ h₁
                one_pos))
              ((ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 1).localizedChern
              (LocalizedChernData.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRankLTOnComplement_ofIsZero C a _ _ _ h₁
                one_pos))))
declarations.comment: the formula for c_2(Z_1 cap Z_2 -> X, F_1 tensor^L F_2); the squares are the products res(c) o c of 0FA0 (supportedMul), C(r_i, 2) is the class of x |-> C(chi_{F_i}(x), 2) (LocalizedChernData.rankChoose), and (r_1 r_2 - 1) c c' is read as (r_1 r_2)(c c') - c c'. The source's 'and so on for higher Chern classes' is not formalized. The source leaves implicit in which sense F_1 tensor^L F_2 satisfies (3) of 0GUJ in the mixed cases ((c) for one factor and (d) for the other, or (d) for both with different X'); the classes of F_1 tensor^L F_2 are those of Remark 0GUK, defined for every perfect object with defined Chern classes, which covers them.

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedChernChar_derivedTensor
declarations.doc:
**The localized Chern character of a derived tensor product.** In the situation of
`Stacks.Chow.LocalizedSituation.localizedPowerSum_derivedTensor`,

  `ch(Z₁ ∩ Z₂ ⟶ X, F₁ ⊗^L F₂) = ch(Z₁ ⟶ X, F₁) ch(Z₂ ⟶ X, F₂)`

in `∏_p A^p(Z₁ ∩ Z₂ ⟶ X) ⊗ 𝐐`, read in each degree `p`: the component of degree `p` of the left
side is `∑_{p₁ + p₂ = p} ch_{p₁}(Z₁ ⟶ X, F₁) ch_{p₂}(Z₂ ⟶ X, F₂)`, the degree `p` component of the
product, with the products of `Stacks.Chow.rationalSupportedIntersectionMul`. The Chern character
of `F₁ ⊗^L F₂` is that of Remark 0GUK.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizedChernChar_derivedTensor (p : ℕ) :
    (LocalizedChernData.derivedTensorOfIsZero C a i₁ i₂ hF₁ hF₂ h₁ h₂ 0).localizedChernChar
        (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor
          (ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 0).hasDefinedChernClasses_E
          (ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 0).hasDefinedChernClasses_E)
        (isZero_derivedTensor_compl_pullback i₁ i₂ hF₁ hF₂ h₁ h₂) p =
      ∑ q ∈ (antidiagonal p).attach,
        rationalBivariantClassDegreeCongr C _ _ _ _ rfl (by have := mem_antidiagonal.1 q.2; omega)
          (rationalSupportedIntersectionMul C a i₁ i₂ (IsPullback.of_hasPullback i₁ i₂) _ rfl
            ((ofIsZero C a i₁ F₁ hF₁ h₁ hfin₁ 0).localizedChernChar h₁ q.1.1)
            ((ofIsZero C a i₂ F₂ hF₂ h₂ hfin₂ 0).localizedChernChar h₂ q.1.2))
declarations.comment: the formula ch(Z_1 cap Z_2 -> X, F_1 tensor^L F_2) = ch(Z_1 -> X, F_1) ch(Z_2 -> X, F_2), read degree by degree in prod_p A^p(Z_1 cap Z_2 -> X) tensor Q. The source leaves implicit in which sense F_1 tensor^L F_2 satisfies (3) of 0GUJ in the mixed cases ((c) for one factor and (d) for the other, or (d) for both with different X'); the classes of F_1 tensor^L F_2 are those of Remark 0GUK, defined for every perfect object with defined Chern classes, which covers them.

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.blowupAtInfinity
declarations.doc: **The deformation space `W` of Stacks 0FBG**: the blowup of `𝐏¹_X` in the centre `∞(Z)`.
declarations.statement: def blowupAtInfinity : Scheme.{u}
declarations.comment: the scheme W, the blowup of 𝐏¹_X in the centre ∞(Z)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.blowupAtInfinityToLine
declarations.doc: **The structure morphism `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X`** of the blowup at infinity.
declarations.statement: def blowupAtInfinityToLine : blowupAtInfinity ℐ ⟶ relativeProjectiveLine X
declarations.comment: the structure morphism b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X of the blowup at infinity

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exceptionalIdealAtInfinity
declarations.doc:
The ideal of the exceptional divisor `E ⊆ W`: the inverse image of the centre `∞(Z)`
along `b`.
declarations.statement: def exceptionalIdealAtInfinity : (blowupAtInfinity ℐ).IdealSheafData
declarations.comment: the exceptional divisor E ⊆ W of the blowup at infinity

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.fibreIdealAtInfinity
declarations.doc:
The ideal of the fibre at infinity `W_∞ ⊆ W`: the inverse image along `b` of the divisor at
infinity `(𝐏¹_X)_∞`.
declarations.statement: def fibreIdealAtInfinity : (blowupAtInfinity ℐ).IdealSheafData
declarations.comment: the fibre at infinity W_∞ ⊆ W, the inverse image of (𝐏¹_X)_∞ under b

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.fibreIdealAtInfinity_le_exceptionalIdealAtInfinity
declarations.doc:
`E` is contained in `W_∞`: the centre `∞(Z)` contains the divisor at infinity, so its
inverse image along `b` does too.
declarations.statement:
theorem fibreIdealAtInfinity_le_exceptionalIdealAtInfinity :
    fibreIdealAtInfinity ℐ ≤ exceptionalIdealAtInfinity ℐ
declarations.comment: E ⊆ W_∞ as closed subschemes of W

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEffectiveCartierDivisor_fibreIdealAtInfinity
declarations.doc:
The fibre at infinity `W_∞` is an effective Cartier divisor on `W`: the divisor at infinity
of `𝐏¹_X` is one, and the inverse image of an effective Cartier divisor under a blowup is again
one.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEffectiveCartierDivisor_fibreIdealAtInfinity :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsEffectiveCartierDivisor (fibreIdealAtInfinity ℐ)
declarations.comment: W_∞ is an effective Cartier divisor on W

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exists_isEffectiveCartierDivisor_fibreIdealAtInfinity_eq
declarations.doc:
**The fibre at infinity decomposes as `W_∞ = D + E`.** Both `E` and `W_∞` are effective
Cartier divisors on `W` and `E ⊆ W_∞`, so `W_∞` is the sum of `E` and a third effective Cartier
divisor `D`, written in the ideal-sheaf presentation `ℐ_{W_∞} = ℐ_E · ℐ_D`. That `D` is the
divisor `X'` is `Stacks.Chow.eq_strictTransformIdealAtInfinity_of_mul_eq`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isEffectiveCartierDivisor_fibreIdealAtInfinity_eq :
    ∃ D : (blowupAtInfinity ℐ).IdealSheafData,
      Stacks.Divisors.IsEffectiveCartierDivisor D ∧
        fibreIdealAtInfinity ℐ = exceptionalIdealAtInfinity ℐ * D
declarations.comment: W_∞ is the sum of E and a second effective Cartier divisor on W

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.blowUpToBlowupAtInfinity
declarations.doc:
**The closed immersion `X' ⟶ W`** of the commutative square of Stacks 0FBG: the blowup `X'`
of `X` in `Z` is the classifying morphism of `X' ⟶ X ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` for the centre `∞(Z)`.
declarations.statement: def blowUpToBlowupAtInfinity : blowUp ℐ ⟶ blowupAtInfinity ℐ
declarations.comment: the closed immersion X' ⟶ W of the square, X' the blowup of X in Z

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.blowUpToBlowupAtInfinity_comp
declarations.doc: The square of Stacks 0FBG commutes: `X' ⟶ W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` equals `X' ⟶ X ⟶ 𝐏¹_X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem blowUpToBlowupAtInfinity_comp :
    blowUpToBlowupAtInfinity ℐ ≫ blowupAtInfinityToLine ℐ =
      blowUpToBase ℐ ≫ lineInfinitySection X
declarations.comment: commutativity of the square X' ⟶ W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X = X' ⟶ X ⟶ 𝐏¹_X

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.comap_exceptionalIdealAtInfinity
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBG, assertion (3).** The inverse image of the exceptional divisor `E ⊆ W` on
`X'` is the exceptional divisor of the blowup `X' ⟶ X` of `X` in `Z`; that is, `X' ∩ E` is the
exceptional divisor of `X' ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem comap_exceptionalIdealAtInfinity :
    (exceptionalIdealAtInfinity ℐ).comap (blowUpToBlowupAtInfinity ℐ) = exceptionalIdeal ℐ
declarations.comment: (3): X' ∩ E is the exceptional divisor of X' ⟶ X

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.lineToBlowupAtInfinity
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBG, assertion (8), the morphism.** The closed immersion `𝐏¹_Z ⟶ W`: the
classifying morphism for the centre `∞(Z)` of the inclusion `𝐏¹_Z ⟶ 𝐏¹_X`, along which `∞(Z)`
pulls back to the divisor at infinity of `𝐏¹_Z`.
declarations.statement:
def lineToBlowupAtInfinity :
    relativeProjectiveLine ℐ.subscheme ⟶ blowupAtInfinity ℐ
declarations.comment: (8): the closed immersion 𝐏¹_Z ⟶ W

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.lineToBlowupAtInfinity_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBG, assertion (8), the triangle.** The composite of `𝐏¹_Z ⟶ W` with `b` is the
inclusion morphism `𝐏¹_Z ⟶ 𝐏¹_X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem lineToBlowupAtInfinity_comp :
    lineToBlowupAtInfinity ℐ ≫ blowupAtInfinityToLine ℐ =
      projectiveLineBaseChange ℐ.subschemeι
declarations.comment: (8): the composite of 𝐏¹_Z ⟶ W with b is the inclusion 𝐏¹_Z ⟶ 𝐏¹_X

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isIso_blowupAtInfinityToLine_restrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBG, assertion (1).** The blowup at infinity is an isomorphism over
`𝐀¹_X ∪ 𝐏¹_{X ∖ Z}`: that open misses the centre, and a blowup is an isomorphism over the
complement of its centre.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_blowupAtInfinityToLine_restrict :
    IsIso (blowupAtInfinityToLine ℐ ∣_ isomorphismLocusAtInfinity ℐ)
declarations.comment: (1): b is an isomorphism over 𝐀¹_X ∪ 𝐏¹_{X ∖ Z}

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.fibreIdealAtInfinity_eq_mul_strictTransformIdealAtInfinity
declarations.doc:
`W_∞ = X' + E` as effective Cartier divisors on `W`, in the
ideal-sheaf presentation `ℐ_{W_∞} = ℐ_E · ℐ_{X'}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem fibreIdealAtInfinity_eq_mul_strictTransformIdealAtInfinity :
    fibreIdealAtInfinity ℐ =
      exceptionalIdealAtInfinity ℐ * strictTransformIdealAtInfinity ℐ
declarations.comment: (4): W_∞ = X' + E as effective Cartier divisors on W

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEffectiveCartierDivisor_strictTransformIdealAtInfinity
declarations.doc: The strict transform `X'` is an effective Cartier divisor on `W`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEffectiveCartierDivisor_strictTransformIdealAtInfinity :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsEffectiveCartierDivisor (strictTransformIdealAtInfinity ℐ)
declarations.comment: (2): X' is an effective Cartier divisor on W

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exceptionalDivisorIsoConormalPolynomialProj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBG, assertion (5).** `E = Proj_Z(𝒞_{Z/X,*}[S])`, with `S` a variable placed in
degree one: the exceptional divisor of the blowup of `𝐏¹_X` in `∞(Z)` is the relative `Proj` over
`Z` of the conormal algebra of `Z` in `X` with a degree-one variable adjoined.
declarations.statement:
def exceptionalDivisorIsoConormalPolynomialProj :
    (exceptionalIdealAtInfinity i.ker).subscheme ≅ conormalPolynomialProj i
declarations.comment: (5): E = Proj_Z(C_{Z/X,*}[S]), S a variable of degree one

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exceptionalDivisorIsoConormalPolynomialProj_hom_toBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBG, assertion (5), over `Z`.** The isomorphism `E ≅ Proj_Z(𝒞_{Z/X,*}[S])` carries
the projection `E ⟶ Z` to the projection of the relative `Proj`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exceptionalDivisorIsoConormalPolynomialProj_hom_toBase :
    (exceptionalDivisorIsoConormalPolynomialProj i).hom ≫ conormalPolynomialProjToBase i =
      exceptionalDivisorToCentre i
declarations.comment: (5): the identification E = Proj_Z(C_{Z/X,*}[S]) is over Z

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.lineToBlowupAtInfinity_spec
declarations.doc:
Let `Z ⊆ X` be the closed subscheme of the closed immersion `i`, let `b : W ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` be the
blowup of `𝐏¹_X` in `∞(Z)`, with exceptional divisor `E` and fibre at infinity `W_∞`. Then
`lineToBlowupAtInfinity : 𝐏¹_Z ⟶ W` is a closed immersion, its composite with `b` is the
inclusion `𝐏¹_Z ⟶ 𝐏¹_X`, and its base change by `∞` (along `W_∞ ⟶ W`, with `(𝐏¹_Z)_∞ = Z`) is
the composite `Z ⟶ C_ZX ⟶ E ⟶ W_∞` of the vertex of the normal cone, the open immersion
`C_ZX ⟶ E` and the inclusion `E ⊆ W_∞`.
declarations.statement:
theorem lineToBlowupAtInfinity_spec :
    IsClosedImmersion (lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker) ∧
      lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker ≫ blowupAtInfinityToLine i.ker =
        projectiveLineBaseChange i.ker.subschemeι ∧
      IsPullback (i.toImage ≫ lineInfinitySection i.ker.subscheme)
        (normalConeZeroSection i ≫ normalConeToExceptionalDivisor i ≫
          Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion
            (fibreIdealAtInfinity_le_exceptionalIdealAtInfinity i.ker))
        (lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker) (fibreIdealAtInfinity i.ker).subschemeι
declarations.comment: (8): a closed immersion P¹_Z → W over P¹_X whose base change by ∞ is Z → C_ZX → E → W_∞, the first arrow the vertex of the cone

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.normalConeToExceptionalDivisor_spec
declarations.doc:
Let `Z ⊆ X` be the closed subscheme of a quasi-coherent ideal `i.ker`, let `W` be the blowup
of `𝐏¹_X` in `∞(Z)`, with exceptional divisor `E` and strict transform `X'` of `X`. Then

  `E ∖ X' = E ∖ (X' ∩ E) = Spec_Z(𝒞_{Z/X,*}) = C_ZX`:

the morphism `normalConeToExceptionalDivisor : C_ZX ⟶ E` is an open immersion whose image is
`E ∖ (X' ∩ E)`, which is the inverse image `E ∖ X'` of `W ∖ X'`, and it is a morphism over `X`
(so the identification is one of schemes over `Z`).
declarations.statement:
theorem normalConeToExceptionalDivisor_spec :
    IsOpenImmersion (normalConeToExceptionalDivisor i) ∧
      (normalConeToExceptionalDivisor i).opensRange =
        (strictTransformIdealOnExceptional i.ker).support.compl ∧
      (strictTransformIdealOnExceptional i.ker).support.compl =
        (exceptionalIdealAtInfinity i.ker).subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ
          (strictTransformIdealAtInfinity i.ker).support.compl ∧
      normalConeToExceptionalDivisor i ≫ (exceptionalIdealAtInfinity i.ker).subschemeι ≫
          blowupAtInfinityToBase i.ker =
        Stacks.Conormal.normalConeToBase i ≫ i
declarations.comment: (7): E ∖ X' = E ∖ (X' ∩ E) = Spec_Z(C_{Z/X,*}) = C_ZX

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.strictTransformOnExceptionalIsoProjectivizedNormalCone
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBG, assertion (6).** `X' ∩ E = Proj_Z(𝒞_{Z/X,*})`: the intersection of the blowup
`X'` of `X` in `Z` with the exceptional divisor `E` of the blowup at infinity, as a closed
subscheme of `E`, is the projectivized normal cone of `Z` in `X`, the relative `Proj` over `Z` of
the conormal algebra.

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.strictTransformOnExceptionalIsoProjectivizedNormalCone_hom_toBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBG, assertion (6), over `Z`.** The identification `X' ∩ E ≅ Proj_Z(𝒞_{Z/X,*})`
is one of schemes over `Z`: followed by the projection `P_ZX ⟶ Z ⟶ X` it is the inclusion
`X' ∩ E ⟶ E ⟶ W` followed by `W ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem strictTransformOnExceptionalIsoProjectivizedNormalCone_hom_toBase :
    (strictTransformOnExceptionalIsoProjectivizedNormalCone ℐ).hom ≫
        Stacks.Conormal.projectivizedNormalConeToBase ℐ.subschemeι ≫ ℐ.subschemeι =
      (strictTransformIdealOnExceptional ℐ).subschemeι ≫
        (exceptionalIdealAtInfinity ℐ).subschemeι ≫ blowupAtInfinityToBase ℐ
declarations.comment: (6): the identification X' ∩ E = Proj_Z(C_{Z/X,*}) is over Z

declarations.name: Stacks.Conormal.projectivizedNormalCone
declarations.doc:
**The projectivized normal cone `P_ZX = Proj_Z(𝒞_{Z/X,*})`** of an immersion `i : Z ⟶ X`:
the relative `Proj` over `Z` of the conormal algebra. This is the scheme appearing in clause (6)
of [Stacks, Tag 0FBG].
declarations.statement: def projectivizedNormalCone : Scheme.{u}
declarations.comment: the scheme Proj_Z(C_{Z/X,*}) of clause (6), as a relative Proj over Z

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.support_compl_strictTransformIdealOnExceptional
declarations.doc:
The open subscheme `E ∖ (X' ∩ E)` of the exceptional divisor is the inverse image of the open
`W ∖ X'`, so `E ∖ (X' ∩ E) = E ∖ X'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem support_compl_strictTransformIdealOnExceptional :
    (strictTransformIdealOnExceptional ℐ).support.compl =
      (exceptionalIdealAtInfinity ℐ).subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ
        (strictTransformIdealAtInfinity ℐ).support.compl
declarations.comment: E ∖ (X' ∩ E) = E ∖ X' as open subschemes of E

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.mem_pow_infinityChartIdeal_iff
declarations.doc:
**The powers of `J = (I, s)`.** A polynomial lies in `Jᵐ` exactly when its coefficient of
`sʲ` lies in `I^(m - j)` for every `j`, so `Jᵐ = Iᵐ ⊕ sI^(m-1) ⊕ ⋯ ⊕ sᵐA ⊕ s^(m+1)A ⊕ ⋯`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_pow_infinityChartIdeal_iff {I : Ideal A} {m : ℕ} {f : A[X]} :
    f ∈ infinityChartIdeal I ^ m ↔ ∀ j, f.coeff j ∈ I ^ (m - j)
declarations.comment: the powers of J = (I, s): the coefficient of s^j lies in I^(m-j)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.infinityChartMk_mem_fibreIdeal_iff
declarations.doc:
**`s` cuts the chart down to the associated graded ring.** The fraction `p/sᴺ` on the chart
`A[s][J/s]` is divisible by `s` exactly when `p` lies in `J^(N+1)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem infinityChartMk_mem_fibreIdeal_iff {I : Ideal A} {N : ℕ} {q : A[X]}
    (hq : q ∈ infinityChartIdeal I ^ N) :
    infinityChartMk I N q hq ∈ infinityChartFibreIdeal I ↔
      q ∈ infinityChartIdeal I ^ (N + 1)
declarations.comment: on D₊(S) the ideal (s) consists of the fractions p/s^N with p in J^(N+1)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.conormalEquivInfinityChartFibre
declarations.doc:
The quotient of the affine blowup algebra `A[s][J/s]`, `J = (I, s)`, by the element `s`
cutting out the exceptional divisor is the conormal algebra `A/I ⊕ I/I² ⊕ I²/I³ ⊕ ⋯` of `I` in
`A`.
declarations.comment: the quotient of A[s][J/s] by s is the conormal algebra of I in A

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.normalConeToExceptionalDivisor_spec
declarations.doc:
Let `Z ⊆ X` be the closed subscheme of a quasi-coherent ideal `i.ker`, let `W` be the blowup
of `𝐏¹_X` in `∞(Z)`, with exceptional divisor `E` and strict transform `X'` of `X`. Then

  `E ∖ X' = E ∖ (X' ∩ E) = Spec_Z(𝒞_{Z/X,*}) = C_ZX`:

the morphism `normalConeToExceptionalDivisor : C_ZX ⟶ E` is an open immersion whose image is
`E ∖ (X' ∩ E)`, which is the inverse image `E ∖ X'` of `W ∖ X'`, and it is a morphism over `X`
(so the identification is one of schemes over `Z`).
declarations.statement:
theorem normalConeToExceptionalDivisor_spec :
    IsOpenImmersion (normalConeToExceptionalDivisor i) ∧
      (normalConeToExceptionalDivisor i).opensRange =
        (strictTransformIdealOnExceptional i.ker).support.compl ∧
      (strictTransformIdealOnExceptional i.ker).support.compl =
        (exceptionalIdealAtInfinity i.ker).subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ
          (strictTransformIdealAtInfinity i.ker).support.compl ∧
      normalConeToExceptionalDivisor i ≫ (exceptionalIdealAtInfinity i.ker).subschemeι ≫
          blowupAtInfinityToBase i.ker =
        Stacks.Conormal.normalConeToBase i ≫ i
declarations.comment: E ∖ X' = E ∖ (X' ∩ E) = Spec_Z(C_{Z/X,*}) = C_ZX: an open immersion C_ZX → E with image E ∖ (X' ∩ E) = E ∖ X', over X

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.normalConeToFibreAtInfinity_spec
declarations.doc:
The morphism `j : C_ZX ⟶ W_∞` of Stacks 0FBK is an open immersion with image `W_∞ ∖ X'`, it
factors through the exceptional divisor as `C_ZX ≅ E ∖ X' ⊆ E`, and it lies over `X`:
`C_ZX ⟶ W_∞ ⟶ X` is `C_ZX ⟶ Z ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem normalConeToFibreAtInfinity_spec :
    IsOpenImmersion (normalConeToFibreAtInfinity i f) ∧
      (normalConeToFibreAtInfinity i f).opensRange =
        modificationFibreAtInfinityComplStrictTransform i.ker f ∧
      normalConeToFibreAtInfinity i f ≫
          modificationInclusionAtInfinity f (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker f) =
        normalConeToExceptionalDivisor i ≫ (exceptionalIdealAtInfinity i.ker).subschemeι ∧
      normalConeToFibreAtInfinity i f ≫
          modificationProjectionAtInfinity f (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker f) =
        Stacks.Conormal.normalConeToBase i ≫ i
declarations.comment: the open immersion j : C_ZX → W_∞ of 0FBK: image W_∞ ∖ X', through E, over X

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle.baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBJ.** For a cartesian square of schemes whose horizontal arrows `i : Z ⟶ X`
and `i' : Z' ⟶ X'` are immersions, the pullback `g^* 𝒩` of a virtual normal bundle `𝒩` for
`Z` in `X` is a virtual normal bundle for `Z'` in `X'`: it is finite locally free, and the
surjection `(g^* 𝒩)^∨ ⟶ 𝒞_{Z'/X'}` is the composite of the base-change isomorphism
`(g^* 𝒩)^∨ ≅ g^* (𝒩^∨)`, the pullback of the given surjection, and the surjection
`g^* 𝒞_{Z/X} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z'/X'}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 0473].

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBK, the class `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧`** of a virtual normal bundle `𝒩` of
arbitrary rank for a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X`. On a connected component `Z_a` of `Z`, on which
`𝒩` has constant rank `r_a`, it is the class `c(Z_a ⟶ U_a, 𝒩|_{Z_a}) ∘ (U_a ⟶ X_b)^*` of degree
`r_a`, for the open `U_a = X_b ∖ i(Z ∖ Z_a)` of the connected component `X_b` of `X` containing
`i(Z_a)`, through which `Z_a ⟶ X_b` factors as the closed immersion `Z_a ⟶ U_a` cut out by the
base change of `i`.
declarations.statement:
def completedVirtualNormalGysinClass (𝒩 : VirtualNormalBundle i) :
    completedBivariantGroup C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sZ sX i hi
declarations.comment: the bivariant class c(Z → X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z → X)^∧ of a virtual normal bundle 𝒩 of arbitrary rank for a closed immersion Z → X

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.completedBivariantRestriction_completedVirtualNormalGysinClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBK, the base-change clause, for a virtual normal sheaf of arbitrary rank.** For
`f : X' ⟶ X` locally of finite type, the restriction (Stacks 0F9Z) of
`c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧` along `f` is `c(Z ×_X X' ⟶ X', g^*𝒩)`, for the virtual normal sheaf
`g^*𝒩` of Stacks 0FBJ. Both are read degree by degree (Stacks 0FE0), and in each degree the cap
operations agree by `Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinClass_cap_baseChange`.
declarations.statement:
theorem completedBivariantRestriction_completedVirtualNormalGysinClass (C : ChowSituation.{u})
    {Z X X' : Scheme.{u}} (sZ : Z ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sZ] (sX : X ⟶ C.S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ sX = sZ)
    (f : X' ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (𝒩 : VirtualNormalBundle i) :
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Z := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X' := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (f ≫ sX)
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback i f) :=
      LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.fst i f ≫ sZ)
    completedBivariantRestrictionViaSequence C sZ sX i hi f
        (completedVirtualNormalGysinClass C sZ sX i hi 𝒩) =
      completedVirtualNormalGysinClass C (pullback.fst i f ≫ sZ) (f ≫ sX) (pullback.snd i f)
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C sZ sX i hi f)
        (baseChangeVirtualNormalBundle i f 𝒩)
