declarations.comment: base change: the restriction of c(Z → X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z → X)^∧ along X' → X is c(Z ×_X X' → X', g^*𝒩), for 𝒩 of arbitrary rank

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalBundleClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBK, the class `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∈ A^r(Z ⟶ X)`** of a virtual normal bundle `𝒩` of
constant rank `r` for a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X`: the unique bivariant class with
`p^* ∘ c = ι_* ∘ j^* ∘ C`, the division of `Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalConeClass` by the flat
pullback `p^*` along the bundle projection.
declarations.comment: the bivariant class c(Z → X, 𝒩) ∈ A^r(Z → X) of a virtual normal bundle 𝒩 of constant rank r for a closed immersion Z → X

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.projectionPullbackClass_comp_virtualNormalBundleClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBK, the defining relation `p^* ∘ c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = ι_* ∘ j^* ∘ C`**, as an equality
of bivariant classes in `A⁰(N ⟶ X)`: the composite (Stacks 0B75) of the class with the flat
pullback along the bundle projection is the class `ι_* ∘ j^* ∘ C`, read in degree
`-r + r = 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem projectionPullbackClass_comp_virtualNormalBundleClass (𝒩 : VirtualNormalBundle i) (r : ℕ)
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} 𝒩.bundle r] :
    bivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (𝒩.projection ≫ sZ) sZ sX 𝒩.projection i rfl hi (-(r : ℤ))
        r (𝒩.projectionPullbackClass C sZ i r) (virtualNormalBundleClass C sZ sX i hi 𝒩 r) =
      BivariantClass.copy C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (𝒩.projection ≫ sZ) sX rfl
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq rfl hi) (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq rfl hi)
        (by ring : (0 : ℤ) = -(r : ℤ) + r) (virtualNormalConeClass C sZ sX i hi 𝒩)
declarations.comment: the construction: p^* ∘ c(Z → X, 𝒩) = i_* ∘ j^* ∘ C in A⁰(N → X), for 𝒩 of constant rank r

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.eq_virtualNormalBundleClass_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBK, uniqueness**: a bivariant class `c ∈ A^r(Z ⟶ X)` is `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩)` exactly
when `p^* ∘ c = ι_* ∘ j^* ∘ C`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_virtualNormalBundleClass_iff (𝒩 : VirtualNormalBundle i) (r : ℕ)
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} 𝒩.bundle r]
    (c : BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sZ sX i hi (r : ℤ)) :
    c = virtualNormalBundleClass C sZ sX i hi 𝒩 r ↔
      bivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (𝒩.projection ≫ sZ) sZ sX 𝒩.projection i rfl hi
          (-(r : ℤ)) r (𝒩.projectionPullbackClass C sZ i r) c =
        BivariantClass.copy C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (𝒩.projection ≫ sZ) sX rfl
          (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq rfl hi) (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq rfl hi)
          (by ring : (0 : ℤ) = -(r : ℤ) + r) (virtualNormalConeClass C sZ sX i hi 𝒩)
declarations.comment: uniqueness: c(Z → X, 𝒩) is the only class in A^r(Z → X) with p^* ∘ c = i_* ∘ j^* ∘ C (Stacks 02TY)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle.bivariantRestriction_virtualNormalClass
declarations.doc:
**Compatibility with base change**: for a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X`, a virtual normal
bundle `𝒩` for `i` of constant rank `r` and `h : X' ⟶ X` locally of finite type, the class
`c(Z' ⟶ X', 𝒩')` of the virtual normal bundle `𝒩' = g^*𝒩` for `Z' = Z ×_X X' ⟶ X'` is the
restriction of `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantRestriction_virtualNormalClass :
    bivariantRestrictionOfInvertible C sZ sX i hZ h (r : ℤ) (𝒩.virtualNormalClass C sX sZ hZ r) =
      (𝒩.baseChangeAlong (IsPullback.of_hasPullback i h).flip).virtualNormalClass C (h ≫ sX)
        (pullback.fst i h ≫ sZ) (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C sZ sX i hZ h) r
declarations.comment: compatibility with base change at constant rank r: for X' → X locally of finite type, c(Z ×_X X' → X', g^*𝒩) = res(c(Z → X, 𝒩)) in A^r(Z ×_X X' → X') (Stacks 0FBJ, 0F9Z)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle.completedClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBK.** The class `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧` of a virtual normal bundle whose rank
need not be constant: the element of the completed bivariant group of Stacks 0FE0 whose degree
`p` part is the class `c_p ∈ A^p(Z ⟶ X)` restricting to `c(Z_k ⟶ W_k, 𝒩|_{Z_k})` on every connected
component `Z_k` on which `𝒩` has rank `p`, and to zero on the others. The schemes `Z` and `X`
are locally Noetherian, being locally of finite type over the base.
declarations.statement: def completedClass : completedBivariantGroup C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sZ sX i hZ
declarations.comment: the class c(Z → X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z → X)^∧ of a virtual normal bundle of arbitrary rank; its degree p part restricts on each connected component Z_k to c(Z_k → W_k, 𝒩|Z_k) of the construction when 𝒩 has rank p there, and to zero otherwise

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle.virtualNormalClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBK, the construction: the class `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∈ A^r(Z ⟶ X)`** of a virtual normal
bundle of constant rank `r` for a closed immersion: the bivariant class with
`p^* ∘ c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = ι_* ∘ j^* ∘ C`, that is, `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∩ α` is the unique `β` with
`p^* β = ι_* j^*(C ∩ α)`.
declarations.statement:
def virtualNormalClass :
    BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sZ sX i hZ r
declarations.comment: the construction at constant rank r: the class c(Z → X, 𝒩) ∈ A^r(Z → X), the quotient of ι_* ∘ j^* ∘ C by p^*, which is bijective on Chow groups (Stacks 02TY)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle.isBivariantClassComposition_virtualNormalClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBK, the characterizing relation `p^* ∘ c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = ι_* ∘ j^* ∘ C`**, as an
identity of bivariant classes in `A⁰(N ⟶ X)` (Stacks 0FE0).
declarations.statement:
theorem isBivariantClassComposition_virtualNormalClass :
    haveI := 𝒩.locallyOfFiniteType_projection r
    haveI := 𝒩.flat_projection r
    IsBivariantClassComposition C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (𝒩.proj ≫ sZ)
      sZ sX 𝒩.proj i rfl hZ (properPushforwardDescends C) (-(r : ℤ)) r
      (𝒩.pullbackClass C sZ r) (𝒩.virtualNormalClass C sX sZ hZ r)
      (𝒩.pushforwardClass C sX sZ hZ r)
declarations.comment: the construction at constant rank r: p^* ∘ c(Z → X, 𝒩) = ι_* ∘ j^* ∘ C as an identity of bivariant classes in A⁰(N → X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle.eq_virtualNormalClass_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBK (1), constant rank.** For `𝒩` of constant rank `r`, with `p : N ⟶ Z` the vector
bundle of `𝒩`, `C ∈ A^0(W_∞ ⟶ X)` the class of Stacks 0F9J, `j : C_ZX ⟶ W_∞` and
`ι : C_ZX ⟶ N`, a class `c ∈ A^r(Z ⟶ X)` satisfies `p^* ∘ c = ι_* ∘ j^* ∘ C` (read on
`T ×_X N` for every `T ⟶ X` locally of finite type) if and only if it is the class
`c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩)` of the construction; such a class exists because `p^*` is bijective on Chow groups
(Stacks 02TY).
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_virtualNormalClass_iff (r : ℕ)
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} 𝒩.bundle r]
    (c : BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sZ sX i hZ r) :
    c = 𝒩.virtualNormalClass C sX sZ hZ r ↔
      ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType t] (k : ℤ)
        (α : chowGroup C (t ≫ sX) k),
        haveI := 𝒩.locallyOfFiniteType_projection r
        haveI := 𝒩.flat_projection r
        middleCap C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (𝒩.proj ≫ sZ) sZ 𝒩.proj i
            rfl (-(r : ℤ)) (𝒩.pullbackClass C sZ r) t (k - r) (c.cap t k α) =
          chowGroupDegreeEquiv C (pullback.fst (𝒩.proj ≫ i) t ≫ (𝒩.proj ≫ sZ))
            (by ring : k - (-(r : ℤ) + r) = k - r - -(r : ℤ))
            ((𝒩.pushforwardClass C sX sZ hZ r).cap t k α)
declarations.comment: (1), constant rank r: a class c ∈ A^r(Z → X) equals the constructed class c(Z → X, 𝒩) iff p^* ∘ c = ι_* ∘ j^* ∘ C on Chow groups of T ×_X N for every T → X locally of finite type, so c(Z → X, 𝒩) is the unique class with this property

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle.restriction_completedClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBK (1).** The degree `p` part of `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧`, restricted to the
piece `Z_k ⟶ W_k` of a connected component `Z_k` of `Z` (Stacks 0FDZ), is the class
`c(Z_k ⟶ W_k, 𝒩|_{Z_k})` of the construction when `𝒩` has rank `p` on `Z_k`, and zero otherwise.
declarations.statement:
theorem restriction_completedClass (p : ℤ) (k : _root_.ConnectedComponents Z) :
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    bivariantPieceRestrictionOfInvertible C sZ sX i hZ p Z.connectedComponentOpens
        (componentAmbient i) id (le_preimage_componentAmbient i) k
        (completedBivariantSequenceOfInvertible C sZ sX i hZ (𝒩.completedClass C sX sZ hZ) p) =
      𝒩.componentFamily C sX sZ hZ p k
declarations.comment: (1): the degree p part of c(Z → X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z → X)^∧ restricts on each connected component Z_k to the class of the construction for 𝒩|Z_k if 𝒩 has rank p there, else to zero

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle.eq_completedClass_of_restriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBK (1), uniqueness.** `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩)` is the only element of `A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧` whose
degree `p` parts restrict on the connected components of `Z` to the classes of the construction
in the degree of the rank of `𝒩`, and to zero in the other degrees.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_completedClass_of_restriction
    (c : completedBivariantGroup C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sZ sX i hZ) :
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    (∀ (p : ℤ) (k : _root_.ConnectedComponents Z),
      bivariantPieceRestrictionOfInvertible C sZ sX i hZ p Z.connectedComponentOpens
          (componentAmbient i) id (le_preimage_componentAmbient i) k
          (completedBivariantSequenceOfInvertible C sZ sX i hZ c p) =
        𝒩.componentFamily C sX sZ hZ p k) →
      c = 𝒩.completedClass C sX sZ hZ
declarations.comment: (1), uniqueness: c(Z → X, 𝒩) is the only element of A^*(Z → X)^∧ with these restrictions to the connected components

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle.baseChange_completedClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBK (2), compatibility with base change.** For `h : X' ⟶ X` locally of finite type,
`Z' = Z ×_X X'` and the virtual normal bundle `𝒩' = g^*𝒩` of Stacks 0FBJ for `Z' ⟶ X'`,
`c(Z' ⟶ X', 𝒩')` is the restriction `res(c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩))` of Stacks 0F9Z, on the completed groups
of Stacks 0FE0.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChange_completedClass {X' : Scheme.{u}} (h : X' ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType h] :
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (h ≫ sX)
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.fst i h ≫ sZ)
    (𝒩.baseChangePullback h).completedClass C (h ≫ sX) (pullback.fst i h ≫ sZ)
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C sZ sX i hZ h) =
      completedBivariantRestrictionOfInvertible C sZ sX i hZ h (𝒩.completedClass C sX sZ hZ)
declarations.comment: (2): c(Z' → X', g^*𝒩) = res(c(Z → X, 𝒩)) in A^*(Z' → X')^∧ for every X' → X locally of finite type

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle.completedClass_of_constantRank
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBK (3).** If `𝒩` has constant rank `r`, then `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∈ A^r(Z ⟶ X)`: its degree
`r` part is the class `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩)` of the construction (the unique class with
`p^* ∘ c = ι_* ∘ j^* ∘ C`) and its other parts vanish.
declarations.statement:
theorem completedClass_of_constantRank (r : ℕ)
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} 𝒩.bundle r] (p : ℤ) :
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    completedBivariantSequenceOfInvertible C sZ sX i hZ (𝒩.completedClass C sX sZ hZ) p =
      if h : (r : ℤ) = p then h ▸ 𝒩.virtualNormalClass C sX sZ hZ r else 0
declarations.comment: (3): for 𝒩 of constant rank r, c(Z → X, 𝒩) lies in A^r(Z → X): its degree r part is the class of the construction and its other parts vanish

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinClass_eq_of_isTopChernComposition
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBL.** Let `(S, δ)` be the base situation of chapter 42, let `X` be locally of
finite type over `S`, let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed subscheme with virtual normal sheaf `𝒩`, and
let `0 ⟶ 𝒩' ⟶ 𝒩 ⟶ ℰ ⟶ 0` be a short exact sequence of finite locally free `𝒪_Z`-modules, of
arbitrary ranks, such that the conormal surjection `σ : 𝒩^∨ ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` factors as
`σ' ∘ (𝒩^∨ ⟶ (𝒩')^∨)` through that of `𝒩'`. Then

  `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = c_top(ℰ) ∘ c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩')`

in the completed bivariant group `A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧` of Stacks 0FE0, for the classes of Stacks 0FBK,
the top Chern class of Stacks 0FA4 and the composition on completions; the composite is a class
for `𝟙 Z ≫ i = i`.

On a connected component `Z_a` of `Z` both sides are concentrated in the degree `r_a` of `𝒩`, and
there this is Stacks 0FBL at constant rank for `Z_a ⟶ U_a` composed with `(U_a ⟶ X_b)^*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem completedVirtualNormalGysinClass_eq_of_isTopChernComposition
    (w : inc ≫ pr = 0) (hseq : (ShortComplex.mk inc pr w).ShortExact)
    (hsigma : dualMap inc ≫ 𝒩'.surjection = 𝒩.surjection) :
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Z := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    completedVirtualNormalGysinClass C sZ sX i hi 𝒩 =
      completedBivariantGroup.copy C (Category.id_comp i) _ hi
        (completedBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C sZ sZ sX (𝟙 Z) i (Category.id_comp sZ) hi
          (topChernClassOfInvertible C sZ Eb)
          (completedVirtualNormalGysinClass C sZ sX i hi 𝒩'))
declarations.comment: c(Z → X, N) = c_top(E) ∘ c(Z → X, N') in A^*(Z → X)^∧ for a short exact sequence 0 → N' → N → E → 0 of finite locally free modules of arbitrary rank whose surjection factors through that of N'

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalGysinCap_eq_topChernCap_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBL**, on cap operations. Let `(S, δ)` be the base situation of chapter 42, let `X`
be locally of finite type over `S`, let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed subscheme with virtual normal
sheaf `𝒩` of constant rank `m`, and let `0 ⟶ 𝒩' ⟶ 𝒩 ⟶ ℰ ⟶ 0` be a short exact sequence of finite
locally free `𝒪_Z`-modules of constant ranks `m'`, `m` and `e` whose inclusion dualizes to a
factorization `σ = σ' ∘ (𝒩^∨ ⟶ (𝒩')^∨)` of the conormal surjection of `𝒩` through that of `𝒩'`.
Then, for the classes `c = c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩)` and `c' = c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩')` of Stacks 0FBK,

  `c ∩ α = c_top(ℰ) ∩ (c' ∩ α)`

on every test scheme `g : T ⟶ X`, in every degree and for every `α ∈ A_k(T)`. Since a bivariant
class is determined by its cap operations (`Stacks.Chow.BivariantClass.ext`), this is the tag's
equality `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = c_top(ℰ) ∘ c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩')` of bivariant classes; see
`Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalGysinClass_eq_of_isTopChernComposition`.
declarations.statement:
theorem virtualNormalGysinCap_eq_topChernCap_comp
    (w : inc ≫ pr = 0) (hseq : (ShortComplex.mk inc pr w).ShortExact)
    (_hsigma : dualMap inc ≫ P'.normalBundle.surjection = P.normalBundle.surjection) (x : Z)
    (hinj : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (k : ℤ),
      Function.Injective
        (bundleFlatPullback C sZ sN i q hq m P.flat P.relativeDimension hdesc g k))
    (hfactor : SubbundleGysinFactorization C G sZ sX sN sN' i hi q q' hq hq' j hj E E')
    (hstep : SubbundleGysinTopChernStep C sZ sN sN' i q q' hq hq' j hj m m' e Eb cap hdesc P P')
    {c : BivariantClass C G sZ sX i hi (m : ℤ)}
    {c' : BivariantClass C G sZ sX i hi (m' : ℤ)}
    (hc : IsVirtualNormalGysinClass C G sZ sX sN i hi q hq m 0 E
      (bundleFlatPullback C sZ sN i q hq m P.flat P.relativeDimension hdesc) P c)
    (hc' : IsVirtualNormalGysinClass C G sZ sX sN' i hi q' hq' m' 0 E'
      (bundleFlatPullback C sZ sN' i q' hq' m' P'.flat P'.relativeDimension hdesc) P' c')
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (k : ℤ)
    (α : chowGroup C (g ≫ sX) k) :
    c.cap g k α =
      chowGroupDegreeEquiv C (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ)
        (subbundleVirtualNormalDegree_eq P P' Eb inc pr w hseq x k)
        (subbundleTopChernCap C sZ i m' e Eb cap g k (c'.cap g k α))
declarations.comment:
c(Z -> X, N) = c_top(E) composed with c(Z -> X, N') for a short exact sequence
0 -> N' -> N -> E -> 0 of finite locally free O_Z-modules of constant ranks m', m, e whose
conormal surjection factors. The short exact sequence IS consumed: it gives m = m' + e, which
is what puts the two sides in the same Chow group. Both classes are the ones CHARACTERIZED by
Tag 0FBK, neither being constructed in this repository, and the composite is spelled by the
top Chern cap rule at `Fin.last e` as Tag 0FAA spells it. CARRIED: Tag 0FAA at the
base changes of the two bundle projections (`SubbundleGysinTopChernStep`) -- 0FAA is proved
only over the base scheme for the canonical bundles, with no identification of a base-changed
vector bundle with the bundle of a pulled-back module; the geometric consequence of the tag's
own factoring hypothesis, i_* = j_* composed with i'_* (`SubbundleGysinFactorization`), Tags
0637, 0FBH and 0F9J being absent. THE TAG'S SHEAF-LEVEL FACTORING HYPOTHESIS IS PRESENT AS
`_hsigma` BUT UNUSED: the proof runs on that carried geometric consequence instead. Also
carried: Tag 02TY injectivity only, Tag 02S1 descent, Tag 0B7G as this directory's standing
cap-rule parameter

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalGysinClass_eq_of_isTopChernComposition
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBL**, as an equality in `A^m(Z ⟶ X)`. If `d` is a bivariant class of degree `m`
for `i : Z ⟶ X` whose cap operation is cap with `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩')` followed by `c_top(ℰ)`, that is
if `d` is the composite `c_top(ℰ) ∘ c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩')`, then `d = c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩)`.

The composite is described by its cap operation, in the idiom of
`Stacks.Chow.IsBivariantClassComposition`.
declarations.statement:
theorem virtualNormalGysinClass_eq_of_isTopChernComposition
    (w : inc ≫ pr = 0) (hseq : (ShortComplex.mk inc pr w).ShortExact)
    (hsigma : dualMap inc ≫ P'.normalBundle.surjection = P.normalBundle.surjection) (x : Z)
    (hinj : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (k : ℤ),
      Function.Injective
        (bundleFlatPullback C sZ sN i q hq m P.flat P.relativeDimension hdesc g k))
    (hfactor : SubbundleGysinFactorization C G sZ sX sN sN' i hi q q' hq hq' j hj E E')
    (hstep : SubbundleGysinTopChernStep C sZ sN sN' i q q' hq hq' j hj m m' e Eb cap hdesc P P')
    {c d : BivariantClass C G sZ sX i hi (m : ℤ)}
    {c' : BivariantClass C G sZ sX i hi (m' : ℤ)}
    (hc : IsVirtualNormalGysinClass C G sZ sX sN i hi q hq m 0 E
      (bundleFlatPullback C sZ sN i q hq m P.flat P.relativeDimension hdesc) P c)
    (hc' : IsVirtualNormalGysinClass C G sZ sX sN' i hi q' hq' m' 0 E'
      (bundleFlatPullback C sZ sN' i q' hq' m' P'.flat P'.relativeDimension hdesc) P' c')
    (hd : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (k : ℤ)
      (α : chowGroup C (g ≫ sX) k),
      d.cap g k α =
        chowGroupDegreeEquiv C (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ)
          (subbundleVirtualNormalDegree_eq P P' Eb inc pr w hseq x k)
          (subbundleTopChernCap C sZ i m' e Eb cap g k (c'.cap g k α))) :
    d = c
declarations.comment:
c(Z -> X, N) = c_top(E) composed with c(Z -> X, N') for a short exact sequence
0 -> N' -> N -> E -> 0 of finite locally free O_Z-modules of constant ranks m', m, e whose
conormal surjection factors. The short exact sequence IS consumed: it gives m = m' + e, which
is what puts the two sides in the same Chow group. Read as an equality of classes in
A^m(Z -> X) via `BivariantClass.ext`. Both classes are the ones CHARACTERIZED by
Tag 0FBK, neither being constructed in this repository, and the composite is spelled by the
top Chern cap rule at `Fin.last e` as Tag 0FAA spells it. CARRIED: Tag 0FAA at the
base changes of the two bundle projections (`SubbundleGysinTopChernStep`) -- 0FAA is proved
only over the base scheme for the canonical bundles, with no identification of a base-changed
vector bundle with the bundle of a pulled-back module; the geometric consequence of the tag's
own factoring hypothesis, i_* = j_* composed with i'_* (`SubbundleGysinFactorization`), Tags
0637, 0FBH and 0F9J being absent. THE TAG'S SHEAF-LEVEL FACTORING HYPOTHESIS IS PRESENT AS
`_hsigma` BUT UNUSED: the proof runs on that carried geometric consequence instead. Also
carried: Tag 02TY injectivity only, Tag 02S1 descent, Tag 0B7G as this directory's standing
cap-rule parameter

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle.completedClass_eq_topChernClassCompleted_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBL.** Let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion with virtual normal sheaf `𝒩`, let
`0 ⟶ 𝒩' ⟶ 𝒩 ⟶ ℰ ⟶ 0` be a short exact sequence of finite locally free `𝒪_Z`-modules, and let
`σ' : (𝒩')^∨ ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` be such that `σ = σ' ∘ (𝒩^∨ ⟶ (𝒩')^∨)`. Then

  `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = c_top(ℰ) ∘ c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩')`   in   `A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧`,

where `c(Z ⟶ X, -)` is the class of Stacks 0FBK, `c_top(ℰ) ∈ A^*(Z)^∧` the top Chern class of
Stacks 0FA4, `∘` the composition `A^*(Z)^∧ × A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧ ⟶ A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧` of Stacks 0FE0, and the
composite, a class for `𝟙 Z ≫ i`, is read at `i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem completedClass_eq_topChernClassCompleted_comp :
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    𝒩.completedClass C sX sZ hZ =
      completedBivariantGroupCongr C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sZ sX (Category.id_comp i)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq (Category.id_comp sZ) hZ) hZ
        (completedBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C sZ sZ sX (𝟙 Z) i (Category.id_comp sZ) hZ
          (topChernClassCompleted C sZ E).1
          ((𝒩.ofFactor N' inc σ' hσ).completedClass C sX sZ hZ))
declarations.comment: c(Z → X, 𝒩) = c_top(ℰ) ∘ c(Z → X, 𝒩') in A^*(Z → X)^∧, for a short exact sequence 0 → 𝒩' → 𝒩 → ℰ → 0 of finite locally free O_Z-modules along which σ factors through σ' : (𝒩')^∨ → C_{Z/X}; ranks arbitrary, c(Z → X, -) the completed classes of Tag 0FBK, c_top(ℰ) the completed class of Tag 0FA4, ∘ the composition of Tag 0FE0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinCap_fundamentalChowClass_excess
declarations.doc:
Let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion of schemes locally of finite type over the base with a
virtual normal sheaf `𝒩` (Stacks 0FBQ), of arbitrary rank, and let `g : Y ⟶ X` be locally of
finite type such that the base change `i' : Z' = Z ×_X Y ⟶ Y` is a regular closed immersion whose
conormal sheaf `𝒞_{Z'/Y}` has constant rank `r`. Let `ℰ` be the excess normal sheaf,
`0 ⟶ ℰ^∨ ⟶ 𝒩^∨|_{Z'} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z'/Y} ⟶ 0`. If `dim_δ(Y) ≤ n` then

  `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∩ [Y]_n = c_top(ℰ) ∩ [Z']_{n - r}`

in `CH_*(Z ×_X Y)`, for the class `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧` of Stacks 0FBK
(`Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinClass`) and the top Chern class of Stacks 0FA4: in
degree `n - (r + e)` the degree-`(r + e)` part of the left-hand side is the cap product of
`[Z']_{n - r}` with the degree-`e` part of `c_top(ℰ)` (`Stacks.Chow.topChernCap`), and in degree
`n - p` for `p < r` the left-hand side vanishes, as the right-hand side does.
declarations.statement:
theorem completedVirtualNormalGysinCap_fundamentalChowClass_excess
    (hreg : IsRegularImmersion i') (r : ℕ)
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (conormalModule i') r]
    (n : ℤ) (hY : schemeDeltaDimension C (g ≫ sX) ≤ (n : EInt)) :
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Z := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    haveI : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
        (𝒩.baseChange i i' g' g sq).excessNormalSheaf :=
      (𝒩.baseChange i i' g' g sq).isFiniteLocallyFree_excessNormalSheaf
        (SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree _ r)
    (∀ e : ℕ, (completedBivariantSequenceOfInvertible C sZ sX i hi
        (completedVirtualNormalGysinClass C sZ sX i hi 𝒩) ((r + e : ℕ) : ℤ)).cap g n
          (fundamentalChowClass C (g ≫ sX) n) =
        chowPushforwardOfIso C sZ' (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ) sq.flip.isoPullback.hom
          (isoPullback_hom_comp_structureMorphism C sZ sX sq hi sZ' hi') (n - ((r + e : ℕ) : ℤ))
          (chowGroupDegreeEquiv C sZ' (by push_cast; ring)
            (topChernCap C sZ' (𝒩.baseChange i i' g' g sq).excessNormalSheaf (n - (r : ℤ)) e
              (fundamentalChowClass C sZ' (n - (r : ℤ)))))) ∧
      ∀ p : ℤ, p < r → (completedBivariantSequenceOfInvertible C sZ sX i hi
        (completedVirtualNormalGysinClass C sZ sX i hi 𝒩) p).cap g n
          (fundamentalChowClass C (g ≫ sX) n) = 0
declarations.comment: c(Z → X, N) ∩ [Y]_n = c_top(E) ∩ [Z ×_X Y]_{n-r} in CH_*(Z ×_X Y), for N a virtual normal sheaf of arbitrary rank, c(Z → X, N) ∈ A^*(Z → X)^∧, Z ×_X Y → Y regular with conormal sheaf of constant rank r, E the excess normal sheaf, and dim_δ(Y) ≤ n; stated degree by degree

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalGysinCap_fundamentalChowClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBM at vanishing excess.** In the situation of the virtual normal sheaf, let
`g : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type and assume that `Z ×_X Y ⟶ Y` is cut out by a regular
sequence of length `m`, so that the excess normal sheaf vanishes and `c_top(ℰ) = 1`. If
`dim_δ(Z ×_X Y) ≤ n - m` then

  `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∩ [Y]_n = [Z ×_X Y]_{n - m}`

in `A_{n-m}(Z ×_X Y)`, for the class `c` of Stacks 0FBK, that is for any bivariant class of
degree `m` satisfying the characterizing relation of that tag against the genuine flat pullback
`Stacks.Chow.bundleFlatPullback` of the bundle projection.

The proof is the source's: the relation says `p^*(c ∩ [Y]_n) = (ι_* ∘ j^* ∘ C) ∩ [Y]_n`, the
right-hand side is the fundamental class of `N ×_X Y` — the hypothesis `hcone` — and the left-hand
side is `p^*` of the candidate, which is that same fundamental class by
`Stacks.Chow.bundleFlatPullbackChow_fundamentalChowClass`; now divide by `p^*`.

See the implementation notes for what `hcone`, `hinj` and `hdim` are and why none of them is this
conclusion.
declarations.statement:
theorem virtualNormalGysinCap_fundamentalChowClass
    (hinj : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (k : ℤ),
      Function.Injective
        (bundleFlatPullback C sZ sN i q hq m P.flat P.relativeDimension hdesc g k))
    {c : BivariantClass C G sZ sX i hi (m : ℤ)}
    (hc : IsVirtualNormalGysinClass C G sZ sX sN i hi q hq m 0 E
      (bundleFlatPullback C sZ sN i q hq m P.flat P.relativeDimension hdesc) P c)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (n : ℤ)
    (hdim : schemeDeltaDimension C (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ) ≤ ((n - (m : ℤ) : ℤ) : EInt))
    (hcone : chowGroupDegreeEquiv C (pullback.fst (q ≫ i) g ≫ sN)
        (by omega : n - (0 : ℤ) = (n - (m : ℤ)) + (m : ℤ))
        (E.cap g n (fundamentalChowClass C (g ≫ sX) n)) =
      fundamentalChowClass C (pullback.fst (q ≫ i) g ≫ sN) ((n - (m : ℤ)) + (m : ℤ))) :
    c.cap g n (fundamentalChowClass C (g ≫ sX) n) =
      fundamentalChowClass C (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ) (n - (m : ℤ))
declarations.comment: at vanishing excess, where `c_top(ℰ) = 1`: `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∩ [Y]_n = [Z ×_X Y]_{n-m}` for the class of Stacks 0FBK, proved from its characterizing relation; carried: `ι_* j^* C` on `[Y]_n` — 0F9J, 02TB and most of 0FBG and 0FBH are proved, but the map `j : C_ZX ⟶ W_∞` is not, needing clauses (4) and (5) of 0FBG and condition (3) of 063M; see the implementation notes — injectivity of `p^*` (02TY), the δ-dim bound

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalGysinCap_fundamentalChowClass_excess
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBM.** In the situation of the virtual normal sheaf, let `g : Y ⟶ X` be locally of
finite type, assume `Z ×_X Y ⟶ Y` is a regular closed immersion whose conormal sheaf has constant
rank `r`, and let `ℰ` be the excess normal sheaf, of rank `m - r`. If `dim_δ(Y) = n` then

  `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∩ [Y]_n = c_top(ℰ) ∩ [Z ×_X Y]_{n - r}`

in `A_{n-m}(Z ×_X Y)`.

The regular immersion and the excess sheaf enter through the data they produce: the normal cone
`C_{Z ×_X Y} Y` is a vector bundle `CN` of rank `r` over `Z ×_X Y`, by the identification
`𝒞_{*} = Sym(𝒞)` of Stacks 063M, embedded in `N ×_X Y` over `Z ×_X Y` by `ιC` and `pC`; and the
cap product with `c_top(ℰ)` is the additive map `cTop`, of degree `m - r` by its typing. See the
implementation notes.

Besides the three hypotheses of `Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalGysinCap_fundamentalChowClass` the proof
carries one statement, `hexcess`, which is **Stacks 0FAA** for the embedding `CN ⟶ N ×_X Y` of
vector bundles over `Z ×_X Y`: `ι_* (p')^* α = p^*(c_top(ℰ) ∩ α)`. That lemma is proved, as
`Stacks.Chow.subbundleEmbedding_pushforward_flatPullback_eq_topChernCap`, but at the canonical
constructed bundles of a short exact sequence rather than at an arbitrary sub-bundle `CN`, so it
does not discharge the hypothesis as stated here; see the implementation notes. It is a formula in
`A_*(N ×_X Y)`, one bundle level above this conclusion, and mentions no bivariant class for
`Z ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem virtualNormalGysinCap_fundamentalChowClass_excess
    (hinj : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (k : ℤ),
      Function.Injective
        (bundleFlatPullback C sZ sN i q hq m P.flat P.relativeDimension hdesc g k))
    {c : BivariantClass C G sZ sX i hi (m : ℤ)}
    (hc : IsVirtualNormalGysinClass C G sZ sX sN i hi q hq m 0 E
      (bundleFlatPullback C sZ sN i q hq m P.flat P.relativeDimension hdesc) P c)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (n : ℤ) (r : ℕ)
    (hdim : schemeDeltaDimension C (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ) ≤ ((n - (r : ℤ) : ℤ) : EInt))
    {CN : Scheme.{u}} (ιC : CN ⟶ pullback (q ≫ i) g) [IsClosedImmersion ιC]
    (pC : CN ⟶ pullback i g) [LocallyOfFiniteType pC] [AlgebraicGeometry.Flat pC]
    (hpC : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension pC r)
    (hCN : ιC ≫ bundleTestBaseChange i q g = pC)
    (cTop : chowGroup C (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ) (n - (r : ℤ)) →+
      chowGroup C (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ) (n - (m : ℤ)))
    (hcone : chowGroupDegreeEquiv C (pullback.fst (q ≫ i) g ≫ sN)
        (by omega : n - (0 : ℤ) = (n - (r : ℤ)) + (r : ℤ))
        (E.cap g n (fundamentalChowClass C (g ≫ sX) n)) =
      chowPushforwardOfIsClosedImmersion C (pC ≫ (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ))
        (pullback.fst (q ≫ i) g ≫ sN) ιC
        (by rw [← bundleTestBaseChange_comp_structureMorphism i q sZ sN hq g,
          ← Category.assoc, hCN]) ((n - (r : ℤ)) + (r : ℤ))
        (fundamentalChowClass C (pC ≫ (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ)) ((n - (r : ℤ)) + (r : ℤ))))
    (hexcess : ∀ α : chowGroup C (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ) (n - (r : ℤ)),
      chowGroupDegreeEquiv C (pullback.fst (q ≫ i) g ≫ sN)
          (by omega : (n - (m : ℤ)) + (m : ℤ) = (n - (r : ℤ)) + (r : ℤ))
          (bundleFlatPullbackChow C sZ sN i q hq m P.flat P.relativeDimension hdesc g
            (n - (m : ℤ)) (cTop α)) =
        chowPushforwardOfIsClosedImmersion C (pC ≫ (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ))
          (pullback.fst (q ≫ i) g ≫ sN) ιC
          (by rw [← bundleTestBaseChange_comp_structureMorphism i q sZ sN hq g,
            ← Category.assoc, hCN]) ((n - (r : ℤ)) + (r : ℤ))
          (flatPullbackChow C (pC ≫ (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ)) (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ) pC rfl r hpC
            (n - (r : ℤ))
            (hdesc (pC ≫ (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ)) (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ) pC rfl r hpC
              (n - (r : ℤ))) α)) :
    c.cap g n (fundamentalChowClass C (g ≫ sX) n) =
      cTop (fundamentalChowClass C (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ) (n - (r : ℤ)))
declarations.comment: with excess: `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∩ [Y]_n = c_top(ℰ) ∩ [Z ×_X Y]_{n-r}`, the normal cone given as a rank-`r` sub-bundle `CN` (063M) and `c_top(ℰ)` as the map `cTop` — `Stacks.Chow.topChernClassOfInvertible` of 0FA4 is proved, but at the Gysin system of the first Chern class, while the higher Chern classes for the Gysin system here are carried as elsewhere in this directory; carried also: Stacks 0FAA for `CN ⟶ N ×_X Y`, proved at the constructed bundles of a short exact sequence but not at an arbitrary sub-bundle

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.gysinBivariantClass_eq_virtualNormalBundleClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBN.** Let `(S, δ)` be as in Situation 02QL, let `X` be locally of finite type over
`S` and let `(ℒ, s, i : D ⟶ X)` be a triple as in Definition 02T8. The Gysin homomorphism `i^*`,
viewed as an element of `A^1(D ⟶ X)` (Stacks 0B79, `Stacks.Chow.gysinBivariantClass`), is the
bivariant class `c(D ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∈ A^1(D ⟶ X)` of Stacks 0FBK (`Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalBundleClass`)
constructed using `𝒩 = i^*ℒ` viewed as a virtual normal sheaf for `D` in `X`
(`Stacks.Chow.zeroSchemeVirtualNormalBundle`, with the canonical surjection
`(i^*ℒ)^∨ ⟶ 𝒞_{D/X}`).

This is `Stacks.Chow.gysinBivariantClass_eq_virtualNormalBundleClass_of_iso`, which holds for any
surjection `(i^*ℒ)^∨ ⟶ 𝒞_{D/X}`, at the canonical one.
declarations.statement:
theorem gysinBivariantClass_eq_virtualNormalBundleClass :
    (gysinBivariantClass C sX L s).1 =
      virtualNormalBundleClass C (gysinTripleInclusion L s ≫ sX) sX (gysinTripleInclusion L s)
        rfl (zeroSchemeVirtualNormalBundle L s) 1
declarations.comment: unconditional: the constructed Gysin class of Tag 0B79 equals the constructed class c(D → X, 𝒩) of Tag 0FBK for 𝒩 = i^*L with the canonical surjection onto the conormal sheaf, as bivariant classes, so on every test scheme and in every degree

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalGysinClass_bivariantCommute_of_subbundle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBP with the factorization proved.** Let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed subscheme with
virtual normal sheaf `𝒩` of constant rank `m`, let `0 ⟶ 𝒩' ⟶ 𝒩 ⟶ ℰ ⟶ 0` be a short exact
sequence of finite locally free modules whose conormal surjection factors as Stacks 0FBL asks,
let `g : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type and let `c ∈ A^p(Y ⟶ X)`. If `c` commutes with
`c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩')` and the top Chern cap of `ℰ` is central for `c`, then `c` commutes with
`c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩)`.

The factorization `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = c_top(ℰ) ∘ c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩')` is **not** carried here: it is
Stacks 0FBL, `Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalGysinCap_eq_topChernCap_comp`, and its hypotheses — the
short exact sequence, the factoring of the conormal surjection, the injectivity of Stacks 02TY,
and the two carried inputs of that tag — are threaded through. What is carried is the centrality
of the top Chern cap, which is Stacks 02UA; the commutation with `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩')` is a hypothesis
here and is discharged for a divisor in
`Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalGysinClass_bivariantCommute_of_divisor`.
declarations.statement:
theorem virtualNormalGysinClass_bivariantCommute_of_subbundle
    (w : inc ≫ pr = 0) (hseq : (ShortComplex.mk inc pr w).ShortExact)
    (hsigma : dualMap inc ≫ P'.normalBundle.surjection = P.normalBundle.surjection) (x : Z)
    (hinj : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (k : ℤ),
      Function.Injective
        (bundleFlatPullback C (i ≫ sX) sN i q hq m P.flat P.relativeDimension hdesc g k))
    (hfactor : SubbundleGysinFactorization C G (i ≫ sX) sX sN sN' i rfl q q' hq hq' j hj E E')
    (hstep : SubbundleGysinTopChernStep C (i ≫ sX) sN sN' i q q' hq hq' j hj m m' e Eb cap hdesc
      P P')
    {cN : BivariantClass C G (i ≫ sX) sX i rfl (m : ℤ)}
    {cN' : BivariantClass C G (i ≫ sX) sX i rfl (m' : ℤ)}
    (c : BivariantClass C G (f ≫ sX) sX f rfl p)
    (hcN : IsVirtualNormalGysinClass C G (i ≫ sX) sX sN i rfl q hq m 0 E
      (bundleFlatPullback C (i ≫ sX) sN i q hq m P.flat P.relativeDimension hdesc) P cN)
    (hcN' : IsVirtualNormalGysinClass C G (i ≫ sX) sX sN' i rfl q' hq' m' 0 E'
      (bundleFlatPullback C (i ≫ sX) sN' i q' hq' m' P'.flat P'.relativeDimension hdesc) P' cN')
    (hcentral : ExcessChernCapCommutesWithCap C G sX i f (m' : ℤ) (m : ℤ) p c
      (subbundleExcessChernOperator C sX i m m' e Eb cap P P' inc pr w hseq x))
    (hb : BivariantCommute C G sX i f (m' : ℤ) p cN' c) :
    BivariantCommute C G sX i f (m : ℤ) p cN c
declarations.comment: with the factorization c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = c_top(ℰ) ∘ c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩') PROVED, by consuming Stacks 0FBL for a short exact sequence 0 ⟶ 𝒩' ⟶ 𝒩 ⟶ ℰ ⟶ 0. CARRIED: the centrality of the top Chern cap of ℰ for c (Stacks 02UA, formalized only against the projective bundle rule and not this directory's carried cap rule), and that c commutes with c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩')

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalGysinClass_bivariantCommute_of_divisor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBP for an effective Cartier divisor**, the case the source's reduction lands in.
Let `(𝓛, s, i : Z ⟶ X)` be a triple as in Stacks 02T8, so that `Z` is the zero scheme of `s` and
hence an effective Cartier divisor, let `𝒩` be a virtual normal sheaf for `i` of constant rank
`m`, let `𝒩' = i^*𝓛` be the rank-one virtual normal sheaf of the divisor sitting inside `𝒩` with
quotient the excess sheaf `ℰ`, let `g : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type and let
`c ∈ A^p(Y ⟶ X)`. Then `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩)` commutes with `c`.

This is the source's argument with everything but one input discharged. The factorization
`c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = c_top(ℰ) ∘ c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩')` is Stacks 0FBL; the identification of the second factor

condition in the definition of a bivariant class. The one carried input is the centrality of the
top Chern cap of `ℰ`, Stacks 02UA.
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle.completedClass_bivariantCommute
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBP.** Let `(S, δ)` be as in Situation 02QL, let `X` be a scheme locally of finite
type over `S`, let `Z ⊆ X` be a closed subscheme with virtual normal sheaf `𝒩`, let `g : Y ⟶ X`
be locally of finite type and let `c ∈ A^p(Y ⟶ X)`. Then `c` and the class
`c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧` of Stacks 0FBK commute in the sense of Remark 0FA2: for every
degree `n`, the degree `n` part of `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩)` and `c` satisfy
`c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩)_n ∩ (c ∩ α) = c ∩ (c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩)_n ∩ α)` in `CH_{k-n-p}(Z ×_X Y ×_X T)` for every
`α ∈ CH_k(T)` and every `T ⟶ X` locally of finite type (`Stacks.Chow.BivariantCommute`). As
commuting is additive in `c`, this is the commutation with every `c ∈ A^*(Y ⟶ X)`.

The rank of `𝒩` is arbitrary. The class is `Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle.completedClass`, the
class constructed in Stacks 0FBK from the class `C` of Stacks 0F9J, the normal cone and the vector
bundle of `𝒩`; `Z` lies over `S` through `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem VirtualNormalBundle.completedClass_bivariantCommute (𝒩 : VirtualNormalBundle i)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (n p : ℤ)
    (c : BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (g ≫ sX) sX g rfl p) :
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (i ≫ sX)
    haveI := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    BivariantCommute C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX i g n p
      (completedBivariantSequenceOfInvertible C (i ≫ sX) sX i rfl
        (𝒩.completedClass C sX (i ≫ sX) rfl) n) c
declarations.comment: c(Z → X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z → X)^∧ of Tag 0FBK commutes (Remark 0FA2) with every c ∈ A^p(Y → X), Y → X locally of finite type: each homogeneous part c(Z → X, 𝒩)_n and c commute on every test scheme T → X; 𝒩 a virtual normal sheaf of arbitrary rank

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.completedCommutesWithEveryClass_completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen
declarations.doc:
**The counterpart of Stacks 0FBP for immersions** (Stacks 0FBQ). For an immersion
`i : Z ⟶ X` with a virtual normal bundle `𝒩` of arbitrary rank, the class
`c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = c(Z ⟶ U, 𝒩) ∘ (U ⟶ X)^* ∈ A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧` commutes with every bivariant class over
`X`, degree by degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem completedCommutesWithEveryClass_completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ sX = sZ) (U : X.Opens) (i' : Z ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (hU : i' ≫ U.ι = i) (𝒩 : VirtualNormalBundle i) :
    completedCommutesWithEveryClass C sZ sX i hi
      (completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sZ sX i hi U i' hU 𝒩)
declarations.comment: (3), counterparts: the counterpart of Lemma 0FBP, c(Z → X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z → X)^∧ commutes with every c ∈ A^*(Y → X), for an immersion Z → X and 𝒩 of arbitrary rank

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.completedBivariantTransport_completedBivariantRestriction_completedVirtualNormalGysinClass
declarations.doc:
**The counterpart for immersions of the base-change clause of Stacks 0FBK, at arbitrary
rank.** For a cartesian square `Z' = Z ×_X X'` of immersions with `f : X' ⟶ X` locally of finite
type, the restriction (Stacks 0F9Z) of `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧` along `f`, carried to `Z'`
along `Z ×_X X' ≅ Z'`, is `c(Z' ⟶ X', g^*𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z' ⟶ X')^∧`, with `g^*𝒩` the virtual normal
bundle of Stacks 0FBJ; the opens through which the two immersions factor as closed immersions are
arbitrary. Both sides are read degree by degree (Stacks 0FE0), and in each degree the cap
operations agree by `Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen_cap_baseChange`.
declarations.statement:
theorem completedBivariantTransport_completedBivariantRestriction_completedVirtualNormalGysinClass
    (V : X'.Opens) (iV : Z' ⟶ V.toScheme) [IsClosedImmersion iV] (hV : iV ≫ V.ι = i₂) :
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Z := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Z' := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ'
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X' := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (f ≫ sX)
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback i f) :=
      LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.fst i f ≫ sZ)
    completedBivariantTransport C (pullback.fst i f ≫ sZ) sZ' (f ≫ sX) (pullback.snd i f)
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C sZ sX i hi f) i₂ hi₂ sq.flip.isoPullback.symm
        sq.flip.isoPullback_inv_snd
        (completedBivariantRestrictionViaSequence C sZ sX i hi f
          (completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sZ sX i hi U i' hU 𝒩)) =
      completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sZ' (f ≫ sX) i₂ hi₂ V iV hV
        (𝒩.baseChange i i₂ g' f sq)
declarations.comment: (3), counterparts: the counterpart of the base-change clause of Lemma 0FBK, the restriction of c(Z → X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z → X)^∧ along X' → X is c(Z' → X', g^*𝒩), for a cartesian square of immersions and 𝒩 of arbitrary rank

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinRestrictionOfOpen_eq_of_isTopChernComposition
declarations.doc:
**The counterpart of Stacks 0FV7 for immersions, at arbitrary rank.** Let `Z' = Z ×_X X'` be
the chosen base change of an immersion `i : Z ⟶ X` along `f : X' ⟶ X`, let `𝒩` be a virtual normal
bundle for `Z ⟶ X` and `𝒩'` one for `Z' ⟶ X'`, of arbitrary ranks, and let
`0 ⟶ 𝒩' ⟶ g^*𝒩 ⟶ ℰ ⟶ 0` be a short exact sequence of finite locally free `𝒪_{Z'}`-modules such
that the square of `hcomm` commutes. Then

  `res(c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩)) = c_top(ℰ) ∘ c(Z' ⟶ X', 𝒩')`

in `A^*(Z' ⟶ X')^∧`, for the classes of Stacks 0FBQ (3) built from arbitrary opens through which
the two immersions factor as closed immersions. By the counterpart of the base-change clause of
Stacks 0FBK and the counterpart of Stacks 0FBL.
declarations.statement:
theorem completedVirtualNormalGysinRestrictionOfOpen_eq_of_isTopChernComposition (V : X'.Opens)
    (iV : pullback i f ⟶ V.toScheme) [IsClosedImmersion iV] (hV : iV ≫ V.ι = pullback.snd i f)
    (w : inc ≫ pr = 0) (hseq : (ShortComplex.mk inc pr w).ShortExact)
    (hcomm : pullbackDualMap (pullback.fst i f) N.bundle ≫
        dualMap inc ≫ 𝒩'.surjection =
      (modulePullback (pullback.fst i f).toLRSHom.toShHom).map N.surjection ≫
        Stacks.Immersion.immersionConormalSheafMap (pullback.snd i f) i (pullback.fst i f) f
          (Stacks.Immersion.toShHom_square (isPullback_pullbackSnd i f).w)) :
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Z := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X' := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (f ≫ sX)
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback i f) :=
      LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.fst i f ≫ sZ)
    completedBivariantRestrictionViaSequence C sZ sX i hi f
        (completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sZ sX i hi U i' hU N) =
      completedBivariantGroup.copy C (Category.id_comp (pullback.snd i f)) _
        (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C sZ sX i hi f)
        (completedBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C (pullback.fst i f ≫ sZ)
          (pullback.fst i f ≫ sZ) (f ≫ sX) (𝟙 _) (pullback.snd i f) (Category.id_comp _)
          (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C sZ sX i hi f)
          (topChernClassOfInvertible C (pullback.fst i f ≫ sZ) Eb)
          (completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C (pullback.fst i f ≫ sZ) (f ≫ sX)
            (pullback.snd i f) (pullbackSnd_comp_structureMorphism_eq C sZ sX i hi f) V iV hV
            𝒩'))
declarations.comment: (3), counterparts: the counterpart of Lemma 0FV7, res(c(Z → X, N)) = c_top(E) ∘ c(Z' → X', N') in A^*(Z' → X')^∧ for the chosen base change Z' = Z ×_X X' of an immersion, virtual normal bundles N, N' of arbitrary rank and a short exact sequence 0 → N' → g^*N → E → 0 of finite locally free modules whose dual square against the conormal sheaves commutes

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen_comp
declarations.doc:
**The counterpart of Stacks 0FEC for immersions, at arbitrary rank.** Let `Z ⟶ Y ⟶ X` be
immersions of schemes locally of finite type over the base, and let `D` be a conormal-compatible
triple of virtual normal bundles `𝒩`, `𝒩'`, `𝒩''` for `Z ⊆ X`, `Z ⊆ Y` and `Y ⊆ X`, of arbitrary
(locally constant) ranks. Then

  `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = c(Z ⟶ Y, 𝒩') ∘ c(Y ⟶ X, 𝒩'')`   in `A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧`,

for the classes of Stacks 0FBQ (3) built from arbitrary opens `W`, `V`, `U` in which the three
immersions are closed.
declarations.statement:
theorem completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen_comp
    (W : X.Opens) (iW : Z ⟶ W.toScheme) [IsClosedImmersion iW] (hW : iW ≫ W.ι = i ≫ j)
    (V : Y.Opens) (iV : Z ⟶ V.toScheme) [IsClosedImmersion iV] (hV : iV ≫ V.ι = i)
    (U : X.Opens) (jU : Y ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsClosedImmersion jU] (hU : jU ≫ U.ι = j) :
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Z := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sY
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sZ sX (i ≫ j) (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq hi hj)
        W iW hW D.bundleZX =
      completedBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C sZ sY sX i j hi hj
        (completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sZ sY i hi V iV hV D.bundleZY)
        (completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sY sX j hj U jU hU D.bundleYX)
declarations.comment: (3), counterparts: the counterpart of Lemma 0FEC, c(Z → X, 𝒩) = c(Z → Y, 𝒩') ∘ c(Y → X, 𝒩'') in A^*(Z → X)^∧ for immersions Z → Y → X and a conormal-compatible triple of virtual normal bundles of arbitrary rank

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.VirtualNormalBundle
declarations.doc:
A *virtual normal bundle* for an immersion `i : Z ⟶ X`: a finite locally free `𝒪_Z`-module
together with a surjection from its dual onto the conormal sheaf `𝒞_{Z/X}` of `i`.
declarations.statement: structure VirtualNormalBundle {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsImmersion i]
declarations.comment: (2): a virtual normal bundle for an immersion

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBQ (3), the construction, for a virtual normal bundle of arbitrary rank.** For an
immersion `i : Z ⟶ X`, an open subscheme `U ⊆ X` with `i = i' ≫ ι_U` and `i' : Z ⟶ U` a closed
immersion, and a virtual normal bundle `𝒩` for `i`: the class

  `c(Z ⟶ U, 𝒩) ∘ (U ⟶ X)^* ∈ A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧`,

the composite on completions (Stacks 0FE0) of flat pullback along `U ⟶ X` (Stacks 0B78) with the
class of Stacks 0FBK of `𝒩` in `A^*(Z ⟶ U)^∧`, read as a virtual normal bundle for `i'`.
declarations.comment: (3), the construction: c(Z → X, 𝒩) = c(Z → U, 𝒩) ∘ (U → X)^* in A^*(Z → X)^∧ for a choice of an open U through which Z → X factors as a closed immersion, 𝒩 of arbitrary rank

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen_independent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBQ (3): the bivariant class `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧` does not depend on the
choice of the open subscheme `U`**, for a virtual normal bundle `𝒩` of arbitrary rank: two opens
`U₁, U₂ ⊆ X` through which the immersion `i` factors as a closed immersion give the same class
`c(Z ⟶ U₁, 𝒩) ∘ (U₁ ⟶ X)^* = c(Z ⟶ U₂, 𝒩) ∘ (U₂ ⟶ X)^*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen_independent (U₁ U₂ : X.Opens)
    (i₁ : Z ⟶ U₁.toScheme) [IsClosedImmersion i₁] (h₁ : i₁ ≫ U₁.ι = i) (i₂ : Z ⟶ U₂.toScheme)
    [IsClosedImmersion i₂] (h₂ : i₂ ≫ U₂.ι = i) :
    completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sZ sX i hi U₁ i₁ h₁ 𝒩 =
      completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sZ sX i hi U₂ i₂ h₂ 𝒩
declarations.comment: (3), the bivariant class c(Z → X, 𝒩) ∈ A^*(Z → X)^∧ does not depend on the choice of U, for 𝒩 of arbitrary rank

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen_cap_fundamentalChowClass_excess
declarations.doc:
**The counterpart of Stacks 0FBM for immersions, at unbounded rank.** Let `i : Z ⟶ X` be an
immersion with a virtual normal bundle `𝒩` of arbitrary rank, and let `g : Y ⟶ X` be locally of
finite type such that the base change `i₂ : Z' = Z ×_X Y ⟶ Y` is a regular immersion whose
conormal sheaf has constant rank `r`; let `ℰ` be the excess normal sheaf. If `dim_δ(Y) ≤ n` then

  `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∩ [Y]_n = c_top(ℰ) ∩ [Z']_{n - r}`

degree by degree in `CH_*(Z ×_X Y)`, for `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = c(Z ⟶ U, 𝒩) ∘ (U ⟶ X)^*` in
`A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧`: the degree-`(r + e)` part of the left side is the degree-`e` part of `c_top(ℰ)`
capped with `[Z']_{n - r}` (`Stacks.Chow.topChernCap`), and the parts of degree `p < r` vanish.
This is how the source reads the equality when the rank is unbounded on the connected components.

On `V = g⁻¹(U)` the immersion `i₂` factors through the regular closed immersion `Z' ⟶ V`, the
base change of `Z ⟶ U`, with the same conormal and excess normal sheaves, and `[Y]_n` restricts
to `[V]_n`; so this is Stacks 0FBM at arbitrary rank
(`Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinCap_fundamentalChowClass_excess`) for `Z ⟶ U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen_cap_fundamentalChowClass_excess {Y Z' : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : Y ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (i₂ : Z' ⟶ Y) [IsImmersion i₂] (g' : Z' ⟶ Z)
    (sq : IsPullback i₂ g' g i) (sZ' : Z' ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sZ']
    (hi₂ : i₂ ≫ (g ≫ sX) = sZ') (hreg : IsRegularImmersion i₂) (r : ℕ)
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (conormalModule i₂) r]
    (n : ℤ) (hY : schemeDeltaDimension C (g ≫ sX) ≤ (n : EInt)) :
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Z := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    haveI : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
        (𝒩.baseChange i i₂ g' g sq).excessNormalSheaf :=
      (𝒩.baseChange i i₂ g' g sq).isFiniteLocallyFree_excessNormalSheaf
        (SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree _ r)
    (∀ e : ℕ, (completedBivariantSequenceOfInvertible C sZ sX i hi
        (completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sZ sX i hi U i' hU 𝒩) ((r + e : ℕ) : ℤ)).cap g n
          (fundamentalChowClass C (g ≫ sX) n) =
        chowPushforwardOfIso C sZ' (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ) sq.flip.isoPullback.hom
          (isoPullback_hom_comp_structureMorphism C sZ sX sq hi sZ' hi₂) (n - ((r + e : ℕ) : ℤ))
          (chowGroupDegreeEquiv C sZ' (by push_cast; ring)
            (topChernCap C sZ' (𝒩.baseChange i i₂ g' g sq).excessNormalSheaf (n - (r : ℤ)) e
              (fundamentalChowClass C sZ' (n - (r : ℤ)))))) ∧
      ∀ p : ℤ, p < r → (completedBivariantSequenceOfInvertible C sZ sX i hi
        (completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sZ sX i hi U i' hU 𝒩) p).cap g n
          (fundamentalChowClass C (g ≫ sX) n) = 0
declarations.comment: (3), counterparts: the counterpart of Lemma 0FBM when the virtual normal bundle has unbounded rank, c(Z → X, N) ∩ [Y]_n = c_top(E) ∩ [Z ×_X Y]_{n-r} degree by degree in CH_*, for an immersion Z → X, c(Z → X, N) ∈ A^*(Z → X)^∧, Z ×_X Y → Y regular with conormal sheaf of constant rank r, E the excess normal sheaf and dim_δ(Y) ≤ n

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen_cap_fundamentalChowClass_of_isCohenMacaulayLocalRing
declarations.doc:
**The counterpart of Stacks 0FEA for immersions.** Let `i : Z ⟶ X` be an immersion with a
virtual normal bundle `𝒩`, let `g : Y ⟶ X` be locally of finite type, and given integers `r` and
`n` assume

1. `𝒩` is locally free of rank `r`,
2. every irreducible component of `Y` has `δ`-dimension `n`,
3. `dim_δ(Z ×_X Y) ≤ n - r`, and
4. `𝒪_{Y, ξ}` is Cohen–Macaulay for every `ξ ∈ Z ×_X Y` with `δ(ξ) = n - r`.

Then `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) ∩ [Y]_n = [Z ×_X Y]_{n - r}`, for `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = c(Z ⟶ U, 𝒩) ∘ (U ⟶ X)^*`.

On `V = g⁻¹(U)` the four hypotheses hold for the closed immersion `Z ⟶ U` and `V ⟶ U`: the
irreducible components of the open `V` are pure of `δ`-dimension `n`, `Z ×_U V = Z ×_X Y`, and the
local rings of `V` are those of `Y`. So this is Stacks 0FEA
(`Stacks.Chow.virtualNormalGysinClass_cap_fundamentalChowClass_of_isCohenMacaulayLocalRing`) for
`Z ⟶ U`, and `[Y]_n` restricts to `[V]_n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem virtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen_cap_fundamentalChowClass_of_isCohenMacaulayLocalRing
    {n : ℤ} {Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType g]
    (hY : ∀ W : irreducibleComponents Y,
      deltaDimension C (g ≫ sX)
        ⟨W, W.2.1, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents (W : Set Y) W.2⟩ = n)
    (hZY : schemeDeltaDimension C (pullback.snd i g ≫ (g ≫ sX)) ≤ ((n - r : ℤ) : EInt))
    (hCM : ∀ ξ : (pullback i g : Scheme.{u}),
      relativeDimension C.dimensionFunction (g ≫ sX) ((pullback.snd i g).base ξ) = n - r →
      letI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (g ≫ sX)
      IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing (Y.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.snd i g).base ξ))) :
    (virtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sZ sX i hi U i' hU 𝒩 r).cap g n
        (fundamentalChowClass C (g ≫ sX) n) =
      fundamentalChowClass C (pullback.fst i g ≫ sZ) (n - r)
declarations.comment: (3), counterparts: the counterpart of Lemma 0FEA, c(Z → X, N) ∩ [Y]_n = [Z ×_X Y]_{n-r} for an immersion Z → X, N locally free of rank r, Y pure of δ-dimension n, dim_δ(Z ×_X Y) ≤ n - r and O_{Y,ξ} Cohen-Macaulay at the points of Z ×_X Y of δ = n - r

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen_eq_of_isTopChernComposition
declarations.doc:
**The counterpart of Stacks 0FBL for immersions, at arbitrary rank.** Let `i : Z ⟶ X` be an
immersion with a virtual normal bundle `𝒩`, and let `0 ⟶ 𝒩' ⟶ 𝒩 ⟶ ℰ ⟶ 0` be a short exact
sequence of finite locally free `𝒪_Z`-modules, of arbitrary ranks, such that the surjection
`σ : 𝒩^∨ ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` factors as `σ' ∘ (𝒩^∨ ⟶ (𝒩')^∨)` through that of `𝒩'`. Then

  `c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩) = c_top(ℰ) ∘ c(Z ⟶ X, 𝒩')`

in `A^*(Z ⟶ X)^∧`, both classes built from the same open `U`. By Stacks 0FBL at arbitrary rank
(`Stacks.Chow.completedVirtualNormalGysinClass_eq_of_isTopChernComposition`) for `Z ⟶ U` and the
associativity of the composition on completions (Stacks 0FE0).
declarations.statement:
theorem completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen_eq_of_isTopChernComposition
    (w : inc ≫ pr = 0) (hseq : (ShortComplex.mk inc pr w).ShortExact)
    (hsigma : dualMap inc ≫ 𝒩'.surjection = 𝒩.surjection) :
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Z := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sZ
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sZ sX i hi U i' hU 𝒩 =
      completedBivariantGroup.copy C (Category.id_comp i) _ hi
        (completedBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C sZ sZ sX (𝟙 Z) i (Category.id_comp sZ) hi
          (topChernClassOfInvertible C sZ Eb)
          (completedVirtualNormalGysinClassOfOpen C sZ sX i hi U i' hU 𝒩'))
declarations.comment: (3), counterparts: the counterpart of Lemma 0FBL in A^*(Z → X)^∧, c(Z → X, N) = c_top(E) ∘ c(Z → X, N') for an immersion Z → X and a short exact sequence 0 → N' → N → E → 0 of finite locally free modules of arbitrary rank whose surjection factors through that of N'

registrations.name: VirtualNormalBundle.baseChange
registrations.comment: (3), counterparts: the counterpart of Lemma 0FBJ, g^*𝒩 is a virtual normal bundle for Z' → X' for a cartesian square whose horizontal arrows are immersions

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isRegularImmersion_diagonal_of_smooth
declarations.doc: The diagonal `Δ : X ⟶ X ×_Y X` of a smooth morphism is a regular immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRegularImmersion_diagonal_of_smooth [Smooth f] :

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.gysinMapExists_diagonal_of_smooth
declarations.doc: The Gysin map exists for the diagonal of a smooth morphism, in the sense of Stacks 0FF3.
declarations.statement:
theorem gysinMapExists_diagonal_of_smooth [Smooth f] :
    GysinMapExists (pullback.diagonal f)
declarations.comment: the Gysin map Δ^! is available for the diagonal

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.diagonalGysinClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBR, the Gysin class `Δ^! ∈ A^d(Y ⟶ Y ×_Z Y)`** of the diagonal of a smooth
morphism `g : Y ⟶ Z` of constant relative dimension `d`: the class `c(Y ⟶ Y ×_Z Y, 𝒩)` of Stacks
0FBQ (3) of the normal bundle `𝒩` of the diagonal (Stacks 0FEZ), at the open subscheme
`U = (pullback.diagonal g).coborderRange` in which the diagonal is closed. It is
`c(Y ⟶ U, 𝒩) ∘ ι^*` by `Stacks.Chow.diagonalGysinClass_eq_bivariantCompositeOfInvertible`.
declarations.statement:
def diagonalGysinClass :
    BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C)
      (pullback.diagonal g ≫ (pullback.fst g g ≫ sY)) (pullback.fst g g ≫ sY)
      (pullback.diagonal g) rfl d
declarations.comment: the Gysin class Δ^! ∈ A^d(X → X ×_Y X) of the diagonal of a smooth morphism of constant relative dimension d

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_diagonalVirtualNormalBundle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Section 42.60 (Tag 0FBR), the degree.** For `f` smooth of constant relative
dimension `d`, the normal bundle of the diagonal is finite locally free of rank `d`; this is why
the Gysin class `Δ^!` lies in `A^d(Y ⟶ Y ×_Z Y)`.
declarations.comment: constant relative dimension d: the normal bundle of the diagonal has rank d

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.diagonalGysinMap_comp_eq_completedIdentityClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBS: `Δ^! ∘ pr_i^! = 1` in `A^0(X)`, for `i = 1, 2`.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a smooth
morphism of schemes locally of finite type over the base, let `Δ : X ⟶ X ×_Y X` be its diagonal
and `pr_1, pr_2 : X ×_Y X ⟶ X` the projections. Write `Δ^! ∈ A^*(X ⟶ X ×_Y X)^∧` and
`pr_i^! ∈ A^*(X ×_Y X ⟶ X)^∧` for their Gysin maps (Stacks 0FF3), which exist since `Δ` is a
regular immersion (Stacks 0FBR) and the projections are smooth. Then for both projections the
composite `Δ^! ∘ pr_i^!` (Stacks 0FE0), read as a class for `𝟙 X` through `Δ ≫ pr_i = 𝟙 X`, is
the unit `1 ∈ A^0(X) ⊆ A^*(X)^∧`. No constancy of the relative dimension of `f` is assumed.
declarations.statement:
theorem diagonalGysinMap_comp_eq_completedIdentityClass :
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback f f) :=
      LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.fst f f ≫ sX)
    completedBivariantGroup.copy C (pullback.diagonal_fst f)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq (by simp) rfl) (Category.id_comp sX)
        (completedBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C sX (pullback.fst f f ≫ sX) sX
          (pullback.diagonal f) (pullback.fst f f) (by simp) rfl
          (lciGysinMap C sX (pullback.fst f f ≫ sX) (by simp)
            (isLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism_of_isRegularImmersion _
              (isRegularImmersion_diagonal_of_smooth f))
            (gysinMapExists_diagonal_of_smooth f))
          (lciGysinMap C (pullback.fst f f ≫ sX) sX rfl
            (isLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism_of_syntomic (syntomic_of_smooth _))
            (GysinMapExists.of_smooth _))) =
        completedIdentityClass C sX ∧
      completedBivariantGroup.copy C (pullback.diagonal_snd f)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq (by simp)
          (pullback_snd_comp_structureMorphism_of_comp_eq C sX sY f hf)) (Category.id_comp sX)
        (completedBivariantCompositeOfInvertible C sX (pullback.fst f f ≫ sX) sX
          (pullback.diagonal f) (pullback.snd f f) (by simp)
          (pullback_snd_comp_structureMorphism_of_comp_eq C sX sY f hf)
          (lciGysinMap C sX (pullback.fst f f ≫ sX) (by simp)
            (isLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism_of_isRegularImmersion _
              (isRegularImmersion_diagonal_of_smooth f))
            (gysinMapExists_diagonal_of_smooth f))
          (lciGysinMap C (pullback.fst f f ≫ sX) sX
            (pullback_snd_comp_structureMorphism_of_comp_eq C sX sY f hf)
            (isLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism_of_syntomic (syntomic_of_smooth _))
            (GysinMapExists.of_smooth _))) =
        completedIdentityClass C sX
declarations.comment: Δ^! ∘ pr_i^! = 1 for both projections i = 1, 2, Δ^! and pr_i^! the Gysin maps of Stacks 0FF3, in the completed ring A^*(X)^∧, for any smooth X → Y

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.smoothRelativeDimensionShiftEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBT.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` be morphisms of schemes locally of finite
type over `S`, with `g` smooth of relative dimension `d`. Then `c ↦ c ∘ g^*` is an isomorphism

  `A^p(X ⟶ Y) ≃ A^{p-d}(X ⟶ Z)`,

with inverse `c' ↦ res(Δ^!) ∘ res(c')`, where `Δ^!` is the Gysin class of the diagonal of `g`
(Stacks 0FBR). For a smooth `g` the Gysin map `g^!` of Stacks 0FEZ is the flat pullback `g^*`.
declarations.statement:
def smoothRelativeDimensionShiftEquiv :
    BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX sY f hf p ≃+
      BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX sZ (f ≫ g)
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq hf hg) (p - d)
declarations.comment: g^! read as the flat pullback g^* of the smooth morphism g; bivariant classes are those of the Gysin system of invertible modules, `Stacks.Chow.gysinSystemOfInvertible`

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exteriorProduct_mem_rationalEquivalences_right
declarations.doc:
The exterior product of an `n`-cycle on `X` with an `m`-cycle on `Y` which is rationally
equivalent to zero is rationally equivalent to zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem exteriorProduct_mem_rationalEquivalences_right (C : ChowSituation.{u}) [Subsingleton C.S]
    [IsIntegral C.S] [JacobsonSpace C.S]
    (hδ : ∀ s : C.S, IsClosed ({s} : Set C.S) → C.dimensionFunction s = 0)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : Y ⟶ C.S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (n m : ℤ)
    (α : CycleGroup C f n) {β : CycleGroup C g m} (hβ : β ∈ rationalEquivalences C g m) :
    exteriorProduct C f g n m α β ∈ rationalEquivalences C (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (n + m)
declarations.comment: well defined in the second variable, unconditionally

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exteriorProduct_mem_rationalEquivalences_left
declarations.doc:
The exterior product of an `n`-cycle on `X` which is rationally equivalent to zero with an
`m`-cycle on `Y` is rationally equivalent to zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem exteriorProduct_mem_rationalEquivalences_left (C : ChowSituation.{u}) [Subsingleton C.S]
    [IsIntegral C.S] [JacobsonSpace C.S]
    (hδ : ∀ s : C.S, IsClosed ({s} : Set C.S) → C.dimensionFunction s = 0)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : Y ⟶ C.S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (n m : ℤ)
    {α : CycleGroup C f n} (hα : α ∈ rationalEquivalences C f n) (β : CycleGroup C g m) :
    exteriorProduct C f g n m α β ∈ rationalEquivalences C (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (n + m)
declarations.comment: well defined in the first variable, unconditionally

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.chowExteriorProduct
declarations.doc:
The exterior product on Chow groups,

  `× : CH_n(X) ⊗_ℤ CH_m(Y) ⟶ CH_{n+m}(X ×_k Y)`,

for `X` and `Y` locally of finite type over a field: the exterior product of cycles,
`Stacks.Chow.exteriorProduct`, read modulo rational equivalence.
declarations.statement:
def chowExteriorProduct (C : ChowSituation.{u}) [Subsingleton C.S] [IsIntegral C.S]
    [JacobsonSpace C.S] (hδ : ∀ s : C.S, IsClosed ({s} : Set C.S) → C.dimensionFunction s = 0)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : Y ⟶ C.S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (n m : ℤ) :
    TensorProduct ℤ (chowGroup C f n) (chowGroup C g m) →+
      chowGroup C (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (n + m)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantToBaseEval
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBW.** The canonical map `A^p(X ⟶ Spec k) ⟶ CH_{-p}(X)`: cap product with the
fundamental class of the point, read through the collapse of `X ×_{Spec k} Spec k` onto `X` along
its first projection. It is injective by `Stacks.Chow.bivariantToBaseEval_injective`;
surjectivity is not proved here, see the implementation notes of this module.
declarations.statement: def bivariantToBaseEval : bivariantToBase C G sX p →+ chowGroup C sX (-p)
declarations.comment: the canonical map A^p(X → Spec k) → CH_{-p}(X), cap product with the fundamental class of the point

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantToBaseEval_injective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBW, injectivity.** The canonical map `A^p(X ⟶ Spec k) ⟶ CH_{-p}(X)` of Stacks 0FBW
is injective: a bivariant class of degree `p` for the structure morphism of `X` is determined by
its cap product with the fundamental class of the point. Surjectivity is not proved here; see the
implementation notes of this module.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantToBaseEval_injective
    [Subsingleton C.S] [IsIntegral C.S] (hS1 : FlatPullbackDescends C)
    (hfund : IntegralFundamentalClassIsFlatPullback C hS1) :
    Function.Injective (bivariantToBaseEval C G sX p)
declarations.comment: injectivity of the canonical identification, for the base being the spectrum of a field; hS1 is Stacks 02S1 and hfund is Stacks 02NK with Stacks 02R4

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantToBaseEval_bijective_field
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field and `X` a scheme locally of finite type over `k`. For
every `p ∈ ℤ` the canonical map `A^p(X ⟶ Spec k) ⟶ CH_{-p}(X)`, `c ↦ c ∩ [Spec k]`, is
bijective. Here `A^p(X ⟶ Spec k)` is the group of bivariant classes of degree `p` for the
structure morphism (Stacks 0B76), read at the Gysin system of the first Chern class of an
invertible module, and the cap product with the fundamental class of the point is read on `X`
through the first projection `X ×_{Spec k} Spec k ≅ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantToBaseEval_bijective_field (p : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective
      (bivariantToBaseEval (fieldChowSituation k)
        (gysinSystemOfInvertible (fieldChowSituation k)) sX p)
declarations.comment: the canonical map A^p(X → Spec k) → CH_{-p}(X), c ↦ c ∩ [Spec k], is bijective

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantToBaseEquivField
declarations.doc:
The canonical identification `A^p(X ⟶ Spec k) = CH_{-p}(X)` over a field,
as an isomorphism of abelian groups: cap product with the fundamental class of the point.
declarations.comment: the canonical identification A^p(X → Spec k) = CH_{-p}(X) as an isomorphism of groups

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantChowClassToBaseEquivField
declarations.doc:
For the bivariant group `A^p(X ⟶ Spec k)` of Stacks 0B76 in the form
`Stacks.Chow.BivariantChowClass`, whose cap operations are plain maps, cap product with the
fundamental class of the point is an isomorphism `A^p(X ⟶ Spec k) ≃ CH_{-p}(X)`.
declarations.statement:
def bivariantChowClassToBaseEquivField (p : ℤ) :
    BivariantChowClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (𝟙 (fieldChowSituation k).S) sX
        (Category.comp_id sX) p ≃+
      chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-p)
declarations.comment: the canonical identification A^p(X → Spec k) = CH_{-p}(X), c ↦ c ∩ [Spec k], for the bivariant group of Stacks 0B76 whose cap operations are maps

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantToBaseEval_surjective
declarations.doc:
The canonical map `A^p(X ⟶ Spec k) ⟶ CH_{-p}(X)`, cap product with the fundamental class of the
point, is surjective. The hypotheses are the existence of proper pushforwards of bivariant classes
(`hEPK`, Stacks 0EPK), the generation of `CH_{-p}(X)` by proper pushforwards of flat pullbacks of
`[Spec k]` (`hgen`), the descent of flat pullback and proper pushforward to Chow groups (`hS1`,
`hpp`), Stacks 02RG (`hRG`) and Stacks 0B71 in every relative dimension (`h71`).
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantToBaseEval_surjective (hS1 : FlatPullbackDescends C)
    (hRG : ProperPushforwardFlatPullbackBaseChange C) (hpp : ProperPushforwardDescends C)
    (h71 : ∀ r : ℕ, G.FlatPullbackNaturality r)
    (hEPK : BivariantProperPushforwardExists C G)
    (hgen : ChowClassesGeneratedByBaseFlatPullbacks C hS1 hpp) :
    Function.Surjective (bivariantToBaseEval C G sX p)
declarations.comment: surjectivity of the canonical identification; hEPK is Stacks 0EPK, hgen is the generation of Chow homology by proper pushforwards of flat pullbacks of the class of the point (Stacks 02UC with Stacks 02R4), hS1 is Stacks 02S1, hpp is Stacks 02S2, hRG is Stacks 02RG and h71 is Stacks 0B71 in every relative dimension

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantToBaseEval_bijective
declarations.doc:
The canonical map `A^p(X ⟶ Spec k) ⟶ CH_{-p}(X)` is bijective when the base has one point and
is integral, that is, is the spectrum of a field: cap product with the fundamental class of the
point identifies the bivariant classes of degree `p` for the structure morphism of `X` with the
Chow homology of `X` in degree `-p`. The hypotheses are those of
`Stacks.Chow.bivariantToBaseEval_injective` and `Stacks.Chow.bivariantToBaseEval_surjective`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantToBaseEval_bijective
    [Subsingleton C.S] [IsIntegral C.S] (hS1 : FlatPullbackDescends C)
    (hfund : IntegralFundamentalClassIsFlatPullback C hS1)
    (hRG : ProperPushforwardFlatPullbackBaseChange C) (hpp : ProperPushforwardDescends C)
    (h71 : ∀ r : ℕ, G.FlatPullbackNaturality r)
    (hEPK : BivariantProperPushforwardExists C G)
    (hgen : ChowClassesGeneratedByBaseFlatPullbacks C hS1 hpp) :
    Function.Bijective (bivariantToBaseEval C G sX p)
declarations.comment: the canonical identification A^p(X → Spec k) = CH_{-p}(X), for the base being the spectrum of a field; hEPK is Stacks 0EPK, hgen is Stacks 02R4, hS1 is Stacks 02S1, hpp is Stacks 02S2, hRG is Stacks 02RG, h71 is Stacks 0B71 and hfund is Stacks 02NK with Stacks 02R4

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantToBaseEval_bijective_of_field
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBW.** Let `X` be locally of finite type over a field `k`. Cap product with the
fundamental class of the point, `A^p(X ⟶ Spec k) ⟶ CH_{-p}(X)`, is bijective.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantToBaseEval_bijective_of_field :
    Function.Bijective (bivariantToBaseEval (fieldChowSituation k)
      (gysinSystemOfInvertible (fieldChowSituation k)) sX p)
declarations.comment: the bivariant classes are those of the Gysin system of invertible modules, `Stacks.Chow.gysinSystemOfInvertible`

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantToBaseEquivOfField
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBW.** For `X` locally of finite type over a field `k`, the identification
`A^p(X ⟶ Spec k) ≃ CH_{-p}(X)`, `c ↦ c ∩ [Spec k]`, as an isomorphism of groups.
declarations.comment: the bivariant classes are those of the Gysin system of invertible modules, `Stacks.Chow.gysinSystemOfInvertible`

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantCommute_bivariantToBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBX.** Let `c ∈ A^p(X ⟶ S)` be a bivariant class towards the point and let
`c' ∈ A^q(Y ⟶ Z)` be an arbitrary bivariant class, for an arbitrary morphism `f : Y ⟶ Z` of
schemes locally of finite type over the base. Then the base change of `c` to `Z` and `c'`
commute, in the sense of Stacks 0FA2.

The proof is the source's. By Stacks 0FBW the map `c ↦ c ∩ [Spec k]` is a bijection of
`A^p(X ⟶ S)` with `CH_{-p}(X)`, and `CH_{-p}(X)` is generated by proper pushforwards of flat
pullbacks of the class of the point; so `c` is a `ℤ`-combination of classes `g_* ∘ (flat
pullback)`. Commuting with `c'` is preserved by `ℤ`-combinations, so it is enough to treat one
such class. Its base change to `Z` is again a proper pushforward of a flat-pullback class, by
`Stacks.Chow.isBivariantProperPushforward_bivariantToBaseRestriction`; that flat-pullback class
commutes with `c'` by the flat law of Stacks 0B76, which is
`Stacks.Chow.bivariantCommute_flatPullbackBivariantClass`; and proper pushforward preserves
commuting by `Stacks.Chow.bivariantCommute_of_isBivariantProperPushforward`.

Nothing here assumes that `c` and `c'` commute, nor that any other pair of classes does; the
hypotheses are the prerequisites of Stacks 0FBW together with the descent statements this part of
the library quantifies rather than parameterizes.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantCommute_bivariantToBase [Subsingleton C.S] [IsIntegral C.S]
    (c : bivariantToBase C G sX p)
    (c' : BivariantClass C G (f ≫ sZ) sZ f rfl q)
    (hpp : ProperPushforwardDescends C) (hS1 : FlatPullbackDescends C)
    (hRG : ProperPushforwardFlatPullbackBaseChange C)
    (h71 : ∀ r : ℕ, G.FlatPullbackNaturality r)
    (hEPK : BivariantProperPushforwardExists C G)
    (hgen : ChowClassesGeneratedByBaseFlatPullbacks C hS1 hpp)
    (hfund : IntegralFundamentalClassIsFlatPullback C hS1) :
    BivariantCommute C G sZ (pullback.snd sX sZ) f p q
      (bivariantToBaseRestrictionHom C G sX sZ p hgys c) c'
declarations.comment: a bivariant class towards the point commutes with every bivariant class, in the form of Stacks 0FA2, for the base being the spectrum of a field; hfund, hEPK and hgen are the prerequisites of Stacks 0FBW, hS1 is Stacks 02S1, hpp is Stacks 02S2, hRG is Stacks 02RG, h71 is Stacks 0B71 and hgys is the isomorphism case of Stacks 02TA

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.bivariantToBase_commuteCompositeCap_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBX, in the shape the tag states it.** The two composites `c ∘ c'` and `c' ∘ c`,
both bivariant classes of degree `p + q` for `X ×_S Y ⟶ Z`, agree as operations on every test
Chow group, under the canonical identification of their sources and the equality `p + q = q + p`
of their degrees.

This is `Stacks.Chow.bivariantCommute_bivariantToBase` read through
`Stacks.Chow.bivariantCommute_iff_commuteCompositeCap_eq`, the equivalence of Stacks 0FA2 between
commuting and the equality of the two composites.
declarations.statement:
theorem bivariantToBase_commuteCompositeCap_eq [Subsingleton C.S] [IsIntegral C.S]
    (c : bivariantToBase C G sX p)
    (c' : BivariantClass C G (f ≫ sZ) sZ f rfl q)
    (hpp : ProperPushforwardDescends C) (hS1 : FlatPullbackDescends C)
    (hRG : ProperPushforwardFlatPullbackBaseChange C)
    (h71 : ∀ r : ℕ, G.FlatPullbackNaturality r)
    (hEPK : BivariantProperPushforwardExists C G)
    (hgen : ChowClassesGeneratedByBaseFlatPullbacks C hS1 hpp)
    (hfund : IntegralFundamentalClassIsFlatPullback C hS1) :
    ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ Z) [LocallyOfFiniteType t] (k : ℤ)
      (α : chowGroup C (t ≫ sZ) k),
      chowPushforwardOfIso C
          (pullback.fst (pullback.snd (pullback.snd sX sZ) f ≫ f) t ≫
            (pullback.fst (pullback.snd sX sZ) f ≫ (pullback.snd sX sZ ≫ sZ)))
          (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f (pullback.snd sX sZ) ≫ pullback.snd sX sZ) t ≫
            (pullback.fst f (pullback.snd sX sZ) ≫ (f ≫ sZ)))
          (compositeComparisonHom (pullback.snd sX sZ) f t)
          (compositeComparisonHom_comp_structureMorphism C sZ (pullback.snd sX sZ) f t)
          ((k - q) - p)
          (commuteCompositeCap C G sZ (pullback.snd sX sZ) f p q
            (bivariantToBaseRestrictionHom C G sX sZ p hgys c) c' hgys hpp t k α) =
        chowGroupDegreeEquiv C
          (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f (pullback.snd sX sZ) ≫ pullback.snd sX sZ) t ≫
            (pullback.fst f (pullback.snd sX sZ) ≫ (f ≫ sZ)))
          (by ring : (k - p) - q = (k - q) - p)
          (commuteCompositeCap C G sZ f (pullback.snd sX sZ) q p c'
            (bivariantToBaseRestrictionHom C G sX sZ p hgys c) hgys hpp t k α)
declarations.comment: the equality of the two composites c ∘ c' = c' ∘ c of the tag, as operations on every test Chow group; the hypotheses are those of Stacks.Chow.bivariantCommute_bivariantToBase

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.BivariantChowClass.comp_comm_of_field
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBX.** Let `k` be a field and let `X` be a scheme locally of finite type over `k`.
Let `c ∈ A^p(X ⟶ Spec k)`. Let `f : Y ⟶ Z` be a morphism of schemes locally of finite type over
`k` and let `c' ∈ A^q(Y ⟶ Z)`. Then `c ∘ c' = c' ∘ c` in `A^{p+q}(X ×_k Y ⟶ Z)`.

Here `c ∘ c' = res(c) ∘ c'` with `res(c) ∈ A^p(X ×_k Y ⟶ Y)` the restriction of `c` along
`Y ⟶ Spec k`, and `c' ∘ c = res(c') ∘ res(c)` with `res(c) ∈ A^p(X ×_k Z ⟶ Z)` the restriction of
`c` along `Z ⟶ Spec k` and `res(c') ∈ A^q(Y ×_Z (X ×_k Z) ⟶ X ×_k Z)` the restriction of `c'`
along `X ×_k Z ⟶ Z` (Stacks 0F9Z, 0FA2). The second composite lives on `Y ×_Z (X ×_k Z)` and in
degree `q + p`; it is read on `X ×_k Y` through the canonical isomorphism and in degree `p + q`.
declarations.statement:
theorem BivariantChowClass.comp_comm_of_field
    (c : BivariantChowClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (𝟙 (fieldChowSituation k).S) sX
      (Category.comp_id sX) p)
    (c' : BivariantChowClass (fieldChowSituation k) sY sZ f hf q) :
    (c.restrict sY (Category.comp_id sY)).comp c' =
      (((c'.restrict (pullback.snd sX sZ)
          (BivariantChowClass.restrict_structure_eq (Category.comp_id sX) sZ
            (Category.comp_id sZ))).comp
        (c.restrict sZ (Category.comp_id sZ))).degreeCongr (add_comm q p)).transport
        (comp_comp_structureMorphism_eq
          (BivariantChowClass.restrict_structure_eq (Category.comp_id sX) sY
            (Category.comp_id sY)) hf)
        (pointClassCompositeIso (fieldChowSituation k) sX sZ f hf)
        (pointClassCompositeIso_hom_comp (fieldChowSituation k) sX sZ f hf)
declarations.comment: c ∘ c' = c' ∘ c in A^{p+q}(X ×_k Y → Z) for c ∈ A^p(X → Spec k) and c' ∈ A^q(Y → Z), the composites read as in Stacks 0FA2

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.commutesExteriorProductCapAt_fundamentalChowClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FBY for the fundamental class of an integral scheme flat over the base.** Let the
base be the spectrum of a field, let `X` be integral and flat over it of relative dimension `d`,
let `u : Y ⟶ Z` be a morphism of schemes locally of finite type over the base and let
`c ∈ A^p(Y ⟶ Z)` be a bivariant class. Then for every `β ∈ CH_m(Z)`

  `[X] × (c ∩ β) = c ∩ ([X] × β)`

in `CH_{d + (m - p)}(X ×_S Y)`, where `[X] ∈ CH_d(X)` is the fundamental class of `X` and the two
sides are read through the canonical identifications of `Stacks.Chow.exteriorProductCap` and
`Stacks.Chow.capExteriorProduct`.

The first variable is a fundamental class and not a general `α ∈ CH_n(X)`; see the implementation
notes of `StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExteriorProductCapCommuting` for what the general
case needs and for why it is unavailable here.

The proof replaces `[X] × -` by the cap operation of the flat-pullback class of Stacks 0B78 for
the structure morphism of `X`, whose base change to `Z` is the flat-pullback class for
`pr_Z : X ×_S Z ⟶ Z`, and that class commutes with `c` by the smooth half of Stacks 0FF6. The
commuting identity is then instantiated at the test scheme `𝟙 Z` and both of its sides are
transported to `X ×_S Y`.
declarations.statement:
