declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.ClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory
declarations.doc:
A classical Weil cohomology theory over an algebraically closed field `k` with coefficients
in a field `F` of characteristic zero, for a given theory of Chow groups: the contravariant
multiplicative graded-commutative cohomology theory and the trace maps satisfying Poincaré
duality, together with the cycle class maps, the Künneth formula, and compatibility of the cycle
class maps with Gysin pullback, proper pushforward, the intersection product and the class of a
point.
declarations.statement:
structure ClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (F : Type v) [Field F] [CharZero F] (Ch : ChowCycleData.{u, t} k)
    extends PoincareDualityPushforwardSetup.{u, v, w} k F

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.ClassicalWeilCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Definition 0FGV.** A *classical Weil cohomology theory* over an
algebraically closed field `k` with coefficients in a field `F` of characteristic zero: the data
(D1), (D2), (D3) subject to the axioms (A), (B), (C) of Section 45.7.

* (D1) and (D3), with axiom (A), Poincaré duality, are the parent structure
  `Stacks.WeilCohomology.PoincareDualityPushforwardSetup`: a contravariant functor `H^*` from
  smooth projective varieties over `k` to graded commutative `F`-algebras and the trace maps
  `∫_X : H^{2d}(X) ⟶ F`, with finite dimensionality, perfectness of the trace pairings, vanishing
  outside `[0, 2d]`, and `∫_X` an isomorphism.
* (D2) is `cycleClass`: a group homomorphism `γ : CH^i(X) ⟶ H^{2i}(X)`, where
  `CH^i(X) = CH_{d-i}(X)` is the Chow group of codimension-`i` cycles of the variety `X` of
  dimension `d` (Stacks 0FE2), `CH_*` being the Chow groups of Stacks 02RW over `Spec k` with the
  zero dimension function (Stacks 02QM).
* (B) is `kunneth`.
* (C)(a)–(d) are `cycleClass_gysinPullback`, `cycleClass_properChowPushforward`,
  `cycleClass_diagonalIntersectionProduct` and `integration_cycleClass_point`, for the Gysin
  pullback of Stacks 0FF3, the proper pushforward of Stacks 02R4, the intersection product
  `α · β = Δ^!(α × β)` of Stacks 0FC0, and the fundamental class `[Spec k]`.

The Gysin pullback `f^!β` and the intersection product `α · β` are classes in `CH_*(X)`, given
by their parts in each dimension; the identities `γ(f^!β) = f^*γ(β)` and
`γ(α · β) = γ(α) ∪ γ(β)` of `H^*(X) = ⨁_n H^n(X)` are stated in each degree `2j`, the right-hand
sides being homogeneous of degrees `2i` and `2(r + s)`. Since every class of
`CH^*(Y) = ⨁_i CH^i(Y)` is a finite sum of homogeneous classes and all the maps involved are
additive (the product biadditive), the axioms are stated for homogeneous classes.
declarations.statement:
structure ClassicalWeilCohomology (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (F : Type v) [Field F] [CharZero F]
    extends PoincareDualityPushforwardSetup.{u, v, w} k F

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.integration_cycleClass_codimensionClassOfZeroCycle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FGW.** Let `X` be a smooth projective variety of dimension `d`. Then
`∫_X γ(α) = deg(α)` for every zero cycle class `α ∈ CH_0(X) = CH^d(X)`: the composite
`CH^d(X) → H^{2d}(X) → F` of the cycle class map and the trace is the degree of zero cycles
(Chow Homology, Section 0AZ0) followed by `ℤ → F`.

Chow groups graded by codimension are `CH^d(X) = ∏_e CH_{e-d}(X_e)`, the product over the open
and closed parts `X_e` of `X` of dimension `e`; a variety of dimension `d` is its own part `X_d`,
so a zero cycle class on `X` is a class `α ∈ CH_0(X_d)`, and its class in `CH^d(X)` is
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.codimensionClassOfZeroCycle α`. The degree is `Stacks.Chow.chowDegree`
(Stacks 0AZ1).
declarations.statement:
theorem integration_cycleClass_codimensionClassOfZeroCycle
    (X : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory)
    (α : chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k)
      (partBase ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj X).obj.hom (T.dimension X)) 0) :
    haveI := (isClopenDecomposition_dimPart
      ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj X).obj.hom).isProper_ι (T.dimension X)
    T.integration X (T.cycleClass X (T.dimension X)
        (codimensionClassOfZeroCycle (X := (SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj X) α)) =
      (chowDegree (fieldChowSituation k) (fieldChowSituation_dimensionFunction k)
        (partBase ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj X).obj.hom (T.dimension X)) default α :
        F)

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChowClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.integration_mul_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FGX.** Let `H^*` be a classical Weil cohomology theory and let `X` and
`Y` be smooth projective varieties. Then `∫_{X × Y} = ∫_X ⊗ ∫_Y`: for `P` a fibre product of `X`
and `Y` over `k`, with projections `p` and `q`, and classes `a ∈ H^{2 dim X}(X)`,
`b ∈ H^{2 dim Y}(Y)`, `∫_P p^*a ∪ q^*b = ∫_X a · ∫_Y b`.

The source reads `∫_X ⊗ ∫_Y` through the Künneth isomorphism `H^*(X) ⊗ H^*(Y) ≅ H^*(X × Y)`,
`a ⊗ b ↦ p^*a ∪ q^*b`, on the top piece `H^{2 dim X}(X) ⊗ H^{2 dim Y}(Y)` of
`H^{2(dim X + dim Y)}(X × Y)`, which is this identity. The extension to the other Künneth
components, where `∫_X ⊗ ∫_Y` vanishes, is
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.PoincareDualityPushforwardSetup.traceExtension_mul_pullback`.

As in the source, `H^{2 dim X}(X)` and `H^{2 dim Y}(Y)` are lines, so it suffices to evaluate on
one pair of classes. The proof takes `γ([x])` for a `k`-point `x` of `X` and any class `v` with
`∫_Y v = 1`, and computes `∫_P p^*γ([x]) ∪ q^*v = ∫_Y v` through the fibre `x × Y`
(`integration_mul_pullback_cycleClass_point`); the source instead uses the class
`γ([(x, y)]) = p^*γ([x]) ∪ q^*γ([y])` of a point of `X × Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem integration_mul_pullback (hP : IsPullback p.hom.left q.hom.left X.obj.hom Y.obj.hom)
    (a : (T.H X).piece (2 * (T.dimension X : ℤ))) (b : (T.H Y).piece (2 * (T.dimension Y : ℤ))) :
    T.integration P (ExternallyGraded.degreeCast (R := F) (X := (T.H P).piece)
        (show 2 * (T.dimension X : ℤ) + 2 * (T.dimension Y : ℤ) = 2 * (T.dimension P : ℤ) by
          rw [T.dimension_eq_add p q hP]; push_cast; ring)
        ((T.H P).mul _ _ (T.pullback p _ a) (T.pullback q _ b))) =
      T.integration X a * T.integration Y b

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChowClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.integration_comp_kunnethMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FGX**, as an identity of linear maps
`H^*(X) ⊗_F H^*(Y) → F`. Let `∫_X : H^*(X) → F` be the trace map on the piece of degree
`2 dim X`, extended by zero to the other pieces. Then `∫_{X × Y}`, composed with the Künneth map
`H^*(X) ⊗_F H^*(Y) → H^*(X × Y)`, `a ⊗ b ↦ p^*a ∪ q^*b`, is `∫_X ⊗ ∫_Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem integration_comp_kunnethMap
    (hP : IsPullback p.hom.left q.hom.left X.obj.hom Y.obj.hom) :
    ((T.integration P).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        DirectSum.component F ℤ (T.H P).piece (2 * (T.dimension P : ℤ))) ∘ₗ
      kunnethMap (T.H X) (T.H Y) (T.H P) (fun i ↦ T.pullback p i) (fun j ↦ T.pullback q j) =
    TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.mul F F).compl₁₂
      ((T.integration X).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        DirectSum.component F ℤ (T.H X).piece (2 * (T.dimension X : ℤ)))
      ((T.integration Y).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        DirectSum.component F ℤ (T.H Y).piece (2 * (T.dimension Y : ℤ))))
declarations.comment: as linear maps on H^*(X) ⊗ H^*(Y), through the Künneth map

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChowClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.pushforward_mul_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FGY.** Let `H^*` be a classical Weil cohomology theory and let `P`,
with projections `p : P ⟶ X` and `q : P ⟶ Y`, be the product of smooth projective varieties `X`
and `Y`. For `a` of degree `i` on `X` and `b` of degree `j` on `Y`, the pushforward along the
second projection sends `a ⊗ b = p^*a ∪ q^*b` to `(∫_X a) b`: to `∫_X a • b` when `i = 2 dim X`,
and to zero otherwise, where `∫_X a` is zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforward_mul_pullback (p : P ⟶ X) (q : P ⟶ Y)
    (hP : IsPullback p.hom.left q.hom.left X.obj.hom Y.obj.hom)
    (i j : ℤ) (a : (T.H X).piece i) (b : (T.H Y).piece j) :
    T.pushforward q (2 * (T.dimension P : ℤ) - (i + j))
        (ExternallyGraded.degreeCast (R := F) (X := (T.H P).piece)
          (show i + j = 2 * (T.dimension P : ℤ) - (2 * (T.dimension P : ℤ) - (i + j)) by omega)
          ((T.H P).mul i j (T.pullback p i a) (T.pullback q j b))) =
      if h : i = 2 * (T.dimension X : ℤ) then
        T.integration X (ExternallyGraded.degreeCast (R := F) (X := (T.H X).piece) h a) •
          ExternallyGraded.degreeCast (R := F) (X := (T.H Y).piece)
            (show j = 2 * (T.dimension Y : ℤ) - (2 * (T.dimension P : ℤ) - (i + j)) by
              rw [T.dimension_eq_add p q hP]; push_cast; omega) b
      else 0

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChowClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.integration_mul_diagonalKunnethCoordinate
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FGZ.** Let `H^*` be a classical Weil cohomology theory and `X` a smooth
projective variety of dimension `d`. Choose a basis `e_{i, j}` of `H^i(X)` over `F` and, using
Künneth, write `γ([Δ]) = ∑_i ∑_j e_{i, j} ⊗ e'_{2d - i, j}` in `⨁_i H^i(X) ⊗_F H^{2d - i}(X)`
with `e'_{2d - i, j} ∈ H^{2d - i}(X)`. Then `∫_X e_{i, j} ∪ e'_{2d - i, j'} = (-1)^i δ_{jj'}`.

The product `X × X` is a smooth projective variety `P` with projections `p, q : P ⟶ X`
exhibiting it as the fibre product over `k`, and the diagonal is `δ : X ⟶ P` with
`δ ≫ p = δ ≫ q = 𝟙`; `[Δ] ∈ CH^d(P)` is the class of the closed subscheme `δ(X)`, and the
decomposition of `γ([Δ])` is read through the inverse of the Künneth isomorphism of axiom `(B)`.
The hypothesis `hdecomp` is the `(i, 2d - i)` component of the source's decomposition, for the one
degree `i` the conclusion concerns; `(-1)^i` is `gradedSign F i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem integration_mul_diagonalKunnethCoordinate {X P : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory}
    (p q : P ⟶ X) (hpq : IsPullback p.hom.left q.hom.left X.obj.hom X.obj.hom) (δ : X ⟶ P)
    (hδp : δ ≫ p = 𝟙 X) (hδq : δ ≫ q = 𝟙 X) (i : ℤ) {J : Type t} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    (e : Module.Basis J F ((T.H X).piece i))
    (e' : J → (T.H X).piece (2 * (T.dimension X : ℤ) - i))
    (hdecomp :
      haveI := SmoothProjective.isClosedImmersion_of_section p δ hδp
      DirectSum.component F (ℤ × ℤ) (fun ij => (T.H X).piece ij.1 ⊗[F] (T.H X).piece ij.2)
          (i, 2 * (T.dimension X : ℤ) - i)
          (TensorProduct.directSum F F (fun n : ℤ => (T.H X).piece n)
            (fun n : ℤ => (T.H X).piece n)
            ((T.kunnethEquiv X X P p q hpq).symm
              (DirectSum.lof F ℤ (fun n => (T.H P).piece n) (2 * (T.dimension X : ℤ))
                (T.cycleClass P (T.dimension X)
                  (closedSubschemeClass ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj P).obj.hom δ.hom.left
          (T.dimension X)))))) =
        ∑ j : J, e j ⊗ₜ[F] e' j)
    (j j' : J) :
    T.integration X (ExternallyGraded.degreeCast (R := F) (X := (T.H X).piece)
        (show i + (2 * (T.dimension X : ℤ) - i) = 2 * (T.dimension X : ℤ) by omega)
        ((T.H X).mul i (2 * (T.dimension X : ℤ) - i) (e j) (e' j'))) =
      gradedSign F i * (if j = j' then 1 else 0)

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.degree_diagonal_mul_eq_degree_chernCap_tangentSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FH0**, the equality on the right: for a smooth projective variety `X`
of dimension `d` over `k`, `deg([Δ] · [Δ]) = deg(c_d(𝒯_X) ∩ [X])`.

The product `X × X` is a smooth projective variety `P` with projections `p, q : P ⟶ X`
exhibiting it as the fibre product over `k`, the diagonal is `δ : X ⟶ P` with
`δ ≫ p = δ ≫ q = 𝟙`, `[Δ] ∈ CH^d(P)` is the class of the closed subscheme `δ(X)`
(`Stacks.WeilCohomology.closedSubschemeClass`), `·` is the intersection product of Chapter 42
(Stacks 0FC0) and `deg` the degree of zero cycles (Stacks 0AZ1) on `CH^{2d}(P) = CH_0(P)` and on
`CH_0(X)`. `𝒯_X` is the tangent sheaf
(`Stacks.WeilCohomology.SmoothProjectiveScheme.tangentSheaf`), finite locally free
of rank `d`, and `c_d(𝒯_X) ∩ -` is the Chern class cap product of Stacks 02U5.

The proof is the source's: `[Δ] · [Δ] = δ_*(δ^![Δ])` (Stacks 0FFE), `δ_*` preserves degrees, and
`δ^![Δ] = c_d(𝒩) ∩ [X]` for the normal bundle `𝒩` of `δ` (the excess intersection formula,
Stacks 0FBM), which is `𝒯_X` because the conormal sheaf of the diagonal is `Ω_{X/k}` (Stacks
08S2). The theory `H^*` of the source plays no role in this equality, so it is not assumed, and
neither is `k` algebraically closed.
declarations.statement:
theorem degree_diagonal_mul_eq_degree_chernCap_tangentSheaf
    (X P : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory) {d : ℕ}
    (hd : topologicalKrullDim X.obj.left = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (p q : P ⟶ X)
    (hpq : IsPullback p.hom.left q.hom.left X.obj.hom X.obj.hom) (δ : X ⟶ P)
    (hδp : δ ≫ p = 𝟙 X) (hδq : δ ≫ q = 𝟙 X) :
    haveI := SmoothProjective.isClosedImmersion_of_section p δ hδp
    haveI := SmoothProjectiveScheme.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_tangentSheaf
      ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj X)
      (SmoothProjective.relativeDimension_hom X hd)
    codimensionDegree ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj P) (d + d)
        (codimensionChowGroupCongr _ (by push_cast; rfl) ((chowCycleData k).mul d d
          (closedSubschemeClass ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj P).obj.hom δ.hom.left d)
          (closedSubschemeClass ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj P).obj.hom δ.hom.left d))) =
      chowDegree (fieldChowSituation k) (fieldChowSituation_dimensionFunction k) X.obj.hom
        default (chowGroupDegreeEquiv _ _ (sub_self (d : ℤ))
          (GenuineChern.chernCap (fieldChowSituation k) d X.obj.hom
            (SmoothProjectiveScheme.tangentSheaf ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj X)) d
            (Fin.last d) (fundamentalChowClass (fieldChowSituation k) X.obj.hom d)))
declarations.comment: the equality on the right: deg([Δ] · [Δ]) = deg(c_d(T_X) ∩ [X]), for X × X any fibre product P of X with itself over k and Δ the diagonal section

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChowClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.eulerCharacteristic_eq_degree_diagonal_mul
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FH0**, the equality on the left: for a classical Weil cohomology theory
`H^*` and a smooth projective variety `X` of dimension `d`,
`∑_{i = 0}^{2d} (-1)^i dim_F H^i(X) = deg([Δ] · [Δ])`.

The product `X × X` is a smooth projective variety `P` with projections `p, q : P ⟶ X`
exhibiting it as the fibre product over `k`, the diagonal is `δ : X ⟶ P` with
`δ ≫ p = δ ≫ q = 𝟙`, `[Δ] ∈ CH^d(P)` is the class of the closed subscheme `δ(X)`, `·` is the
intersection product of Chapter 42 and `deg` the degree of zero cycles on
`CH^{2d}(P) = CH_0(P)` (`Stacks.WeilCohomology.codimensionDegree`).

The proof is the source's: `deg([Δ] · [Δ]) = ∫_P γ([Δ] · [Δ])` (Stacks 0FGW), which is
`∫_P γ([Δ]) ∪ δ_*1 = ∫_X δ^*γ([Δ])` by axiom (C)(c) and `γ([Δ]) = δ_*1`; writing
`γ([Δ]) = ∑ e_{i,j} ⊗ e'_{2d-i,j}` through the Künneth isomorphism, `δ^*` is the cup product, and
`∑_{i,j} ∫_X e_{i,j} ∪ e'_{2d-i,j} = ∑_i (-1)^i dim H^i(X)` by Stacks 0FGZ.
declarations.statement:
theorem eulerCharacteristic_eq_degree_diagonal_mul :
    haveI := SmoothProjective.isClosedImmersion_of_section p δ hδp
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 * T.dimension X + 1),
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ i * (Module.finrank F ((T.H X).piece (i : ℤ)) : ℤ) =
      codimensionDegree ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj P) (T.dimension X + T.dimension X)
        (codimensionChowGroupCongr _ (by push_cast; rfl)
          ((chowCycleData k).mul (T.dimension X) (T.dimension X)
            (closedSubschemeClass ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj P).obj.hom δ.hom.left
              (T.dimension X))
            (closedSubschemeClass ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj P).obj.hom δ.hom.left
              (T.dimension X))))
declarations.comment: the equality on the left: Σ (-1)^i dim H^i(X) = deg([Δ] · [Δ])

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChowClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.eulerCharacteristic_eq_degree_diagonal_mul_eq_degree_chernCap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FH0.** Let `H^*` be a classical Weil cohomology theory (Stacks 0FGV)
and `X` a smooth projective variety of dimension `d`. Then
`∑_{i = 0}^{2d} (-1)^i dim_F H^i(X) = deg([Δ] · [Δ]) = deg(c_d(𝒯_X) ∩ [X])`.

The product `X × X` is a smooth projective variety `P` with projections `p, q : P ⟶ X`
exhibiting it as the fibre product over `k`, and the diagonal is `δ : X ⟶ P` with
`δ ≫ p = δ ≫ q = 𝟙`; `[Δ]`, the intersection product, the degree and `c_d(𝒯_X) ∩ -` are those of
`ChowClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.eulerCharacteristic_eq_degree_diagonal_mul`
(the equality on the left) and
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.degree_diagonal_mul_eq_degree_chernCap_tangentSheaf`
(the equality on the right).
declarations.statement:
theorem eulerCharacteristic_eq_degree_diagonal_mul_eq_degree_chernCap :
    haveI := SmoothProjective.isClosedImmersion_of_section p δ hδp
    haveI := SmoothProjectiveScheme.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_tangentSheaf
      ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj X)
      (SmoothProjective.relativeDimension_hom X (T.dimension_eq X))
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 * T.dimension X + 1),
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ i * (Module.finrank F ((T.H X).piece (i : ℤ)) : ℤ) =
      codimensionDegree ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj P) (T.dimension X + T.dimension X)
        (codimensionChowGroupCongr _ (by push_cast; rfl)
          ((chowCycleData k).mul (T.dimension X) (T.dimension X)
            (closedSubschemeClass ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj P).obj.hom δ.hom.left
              (T.dimension X))
            (closedSubschemeClass ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj P).obj.hom δ.hom.left
              (T.dimension X)))) ∧
    codimensionDegree ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj P) (T.dimension X + T.dimension X)
        (codimensionChowGroupCongr _ (by push_cast; rfl)
          ((chowCycleData k).mul (T.dimension X) (T.dimension X)
            (closedSubschemeClass ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj P).obj.hom δ.hom.left
              (T.dimension X))
            (closedSubschemeClass ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj P).obj.hom δ.hom.left
              (T.dimension X)))) =
      chowDegree (fieldChowSituation k) (fieldChowSituation_dimensionFunction k) X.obj.hom
        default (chowGroupDegreeEquiv _ _ (sub_self (T.dimension X : ℤ))
          (GenuineChern.chernCap (fieldChowSituation k) (T.dimension X) X.obj.hom
            (SmoothProjectiveScheme.tangentSheaf ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).obj X))
            (T.dimension X) (Fin.last (T.dimension X))
            (fundamentalChowClass (fieldChowSituation k) X.obj.hom (T.dimension X))))

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilRealization.toPreClassical
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0FH1.** Let `k` be algebraically closed and `F` of characteristic
`0`. A `ℚ`-linear functor `G : M_k ⥤ graded F-vector spaces` of symmetric monoidal categories
with `G(𝟏(1))` nonzero only in degree `-2` gives data (D1), (D2), (D3) satisfying all of (A),
(B), (C) except possibly (A)(c) and (A)(d): on a smooth projective variety `X`,
`H^*(X) = G(h(X))`, the cycle class map is `α ↦ G(a_α)(e_{-r})` and the trace is
`x ↦ G([X])(x ⊗ e_d)`, for generators `e_n` of `G(𝟏(n))` with `e_1` a basis of `G^{-2}(𝟏(1))`.
declarations.statement: def toPreClassical : PreClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.{u, w, w, u} k F (chowCycleData k)
declarations.comment: a Q-linear functor G : M_k → graded F-vector spaces of symmetric monoidal categories with G(1(1)) nonzero only in degree -2 gives data (D1), (D2), (D3) satisfying (A), (B), (C) except possibly (A)(c) and (A)(d)

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.ClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.exists_motiveFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FH2.** Let `k` be an algebraically closed field, `F` a field of
characteristic zero and `H^*` a classical Weil cohomology theory. Then there is a `ℚ`-linear
functor `G : M_k ⥤ graded F-vector spaces` of symmetric monoidal categories (for the
Koszul-signed symmetry of Stacks, Homology, Example 0FFX) with `H^*(X) = G(h(X))`, naturally in
the smooth projective variety `X` (pullbacks `f^*` corresponding to `G(h(f))`).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_motiveFunctor :
    ∃ (G : ChowMotiveCat k ⥤ GradedObject ℤ (ModuleCat.{v} F))
      (_ : @Functor.Braided (ChowMotiveCat k) _ _ _ (GradedObject ℤ (ModuleCat.{v} F)) _ _
        GradedObject.koszulBraidedCategory G) (_ : G.Additive) (_ : Functor.Linear ℚ G),
      Nonempty ((SmoothProjective.toSchemeCat k).op ⋙ ChowMotiveCat.h k ⋙ G ≅
        T.toPre.toPoincarePairingSetup.cohomologyFunctor)
declarations.comment:
a classical Weil cohomology theory gives a Q-linear symmetric monoidal functor
G : M_k -> graded F-vector spaces with H^*(X) = G(h(X))

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.ClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.exists_isoClassEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FH3.** Let `k` be an algebraically closed field and `F` a field of
characteristic `0`. A classical Weil cohomology theory (Stacks 0FGV, over the Chow groups of
Chapter 42) is the same thing as a `ℚ`-linear functor `G : M_k ⥤ graded F-vector spaces` of
symmetric monoidal categories together with an isomorphism `F[2] ≅ G(𝟏(1))` such that `G(h(X))`
lives in nonnegative degrees and `dim_F G⁰(h(X)) = 1` for every smooth projective variety `X`
(`ClassicalMotiveRealization`): there is a bijection `e` between isomorphism classes of the two,
under which a theory `H^*` and a realization `R = (G, F[2] ≅ G(𝟏(1)))` correspond exactly when
`H^*(X) = G(h(X))` with all its structure (`ClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.Corresponds`: natural
isomorphisms of graded algebras `H^*(X) ≅ G(h(X))`, carrying `γ(α)` to `G(a_α)(e_{-r})` and `∫_X`
to `x ↦ G([X])(x ⊗ e_d)`, for the generators `eₙ` of `F[2] ≅ G(𝟏(1))`). The inverse bijection
sends `R` to the theory `H^*(X) = G(h(X))` of the first paragraph of the proof
(`ClassicalMotiveRealization.toClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory`).
declarations.statement:
theorem ClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.exists_isoClassEquiv :
    ∃ e : Quotient (ClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.isoSetoid.{u, v, v, u} k F (chowCycleData k)) ≃
        Quotient (ClassicalMotiveRealization.isoSetoid k F),
      (∀ (T : ClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory.{u, v, v, u} k F (chowCycleData k))
        (R : ClassicalMotiveRealization k F), e ⟦T⟧ = ⟦R⟧ ↔ T.Corresponds R) ∧
      ∀ R : ClassicalMotiveRealization k F, e.symm ⟦R⟧ = ⟦R.toClassicalWeilCohomologyTheory⟧
declarations.comment: a classical Weil cohomology theory is the same thing as a Q-linear symmetric monoidal G : M_k → graded F-vector spaces with F[2] ≅ G(1(1)), G(h(X)) in nonnegative degrees and dim G⁰(h(X)) = 1: a bijection of isomorphism classes, through H^*(X) = G(h(X)) with its cup product, pullbacks, cycle classes and traces

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.mem_closure_separablePointClasses_of_isProjectiveMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FH5.** Let `k` be a field and let `X` be a smooth projective scheme over `k`. Then
`CH_0(X)` is generated by the classes of the closed points of `X` whose residue fields are
separable over `k`. No hypothesis on `k` is imposed: the per-point statement
`Stacks.Chow.separablePointComplementaryCycles` is proved for every field above, and
`Stacks.Chow.mem_closure_separablePointClasses` passes from one closed point to all of `A_0(X)`.
Properness, needed there for finiteness of supports, follows from projectivity.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_closure_separablePointClasses_of_isProjectiveMorphism (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ (fieldChowSituation k).S) [Smooth p]
    (hproj : IsProjectiveMorphism p) (α : chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k) p 0) :
    α ∈ AddSubgroup.closure (separablePointClasses k p)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.chowColimitAddEquiv_algebraicExtensionSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FH6.** For an algebraic field extension `K/k` and a quasi-compact
scheme `X` of finite type over `k`, the Chow group `CH_i(X_K)` is the colimit of the Chow groups
`CH_i(X_{k'})` over the finite subextensions `K/k'/k`, along the base-change homomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
def chowColimitAddEquiv_algebraicExtensionSystem [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K]
    (X : Over (fieldChowSituation k).S) [CompactSpace X.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
    [QuasiCompact X.hom] (i : ℤ) :
    ↥(colimit ((algebraicExtensionSystem k K X).chowDiagram i)) ≃+
      chowGroup (fieldChowSituation K)
        (pullback.snd X.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) i
declarations.comment:
CH_i(X_K) is the colimit of the CH_i(X_{k'}) over the finite subextensions
K/k'/k of an algebraic extension

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.exists_finiteSeparable_rationalPointChowClass_sub_eq_zsmul_of_isProjectiveMorphism
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FH7].** Let `k` be a field, `X` a geometrically irreducible smooth projective
scheme over `k`, `x, x'` two `k`-rational points of `X` and `n` an integer invertible in `k`.
Then there is a finite separable extension `K/k` such that the pullback of `[x] - [x']` to `X_K`
is divisible by `n` in `CH_0(X_K)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finiteSeparable_rationalPointChowClass_sub_eq_zsmul_of_isProjectiveMorphism
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ (fieldChowSituation k).S) [Smooth f]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible f] (hproj : IsProjectiveMorphism f)
    (n : ℤ) (hn : IsUnit ((n : ℤ) : k)) (x x' : (fieldChowSituation k).S ⟶ X)
    (hx : x ≫ f = 𝟙 _) (hx' : x' ≫ f = 𝟙 _) :
    ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Field K) (_ : Algebra k K) (_ : FiniteDimensional k K)
        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable k K)
        (δ : chowGroup (fieldChowSituation K)
          (pullback.snd f (fieldExtensionBaseChangeSituation k K).g) 0),
      baseChangeChowPullbackOfIsPullback (fieldExtensionBaseChangeSituation k K) rfl f
          (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f (fieldExtensionBaseChangeSituation k K).g) 0
          (rationalPointChowClass k f x hx - rationalPointChowClass k f x' hx') = n • δ

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isOfFinAddOrder_of_baseChangeChowPullback_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
Let `K/k` be an algebraic extension of fields and let `X` be a scheme of finite type over
`k`. The kernel of the map `CH_i(X) ⟶ CH_i(X_K)` is torsion: every class it kills has finite
additive order.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOfFinAddOrder_of_baseChangeChowPullback_eq_zero (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K]
    [Algebra k K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] (X : Over (fieldChowSituation k).S)
    [CompactSpace X.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom] (i : ℤ)
    (α : chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k) X.hom i)
    (hα : baseChangeChowPullback (fieldExtensionBaseChangeSituation k K) X.hom i α = 0) :
    IsOfFinAddOrder α

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isOfFinAddOrder_smashPointDifference
declarations.doc:
**Smash nilpotence for differences of rational points (Voevodsky).** Let `k` be a field and
`X` a geometrically irreducible smooth projective scheme over `k`, with `k`-rational points
`x, x'`. For `n` large enough the class of the zero cycle `([x] - [x']) × ⋯ × ([x] - [x'])` in
`CH_0(Xⁿ)` is torsion. Here `Stacks.Chow.smashPointDifference` is the class of the `n`-th exterior
power of `[x] - [x']`, built with the exterior product of Stacks 0FBV.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOfFinAddOrder_smashPointDifference (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [GeometricallyIrreducible f] [Smooth f]
    (hproj : AlgebraicGeometry.IsProjectiveMorphism f) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (x x' : Spec (.of k) ⟶ X) (hx : x ≫ f = 𝟙 _) (hx' : x' ≫ f = 𝟙 _) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, IsOfFinAddOrder (smashPointDifference k f x x' hx hx' n).cycle

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilData.pushforward_cupTw_pullTw
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FHB, the projection formula.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of nonempty
equidimensional smooth projective schemes over `k`, of dimensions `d` and `e`, and classes
`a ∈ H^j(X)(t)`, `b ∈ H^m(Y)(s)`,

`f_*(f^*b ∪ a) = b ∪ f_*a` in `H^{m+j'}(Y)(s+t')`,

where `f_* : H^j(X)(t) → H^{j'}(Y)(t')` with `j' = j + 2(e - d)`, `t' = t + (e - d)`.
The proof uses only axiom (A)(b).
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforward_cupTw_pullTw (hA : W.PerfectPairing)
    {X Y : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {d e : ℕ} (hX : IsNonemptyEquidimensional X d)
    (hY : IsNonemptyEquidimensional Y e) (m s j t j' t' : ℤ) (hj : j' + 2 * d = j + 2 * e)
    (ht : t' + d = t + e) (b : W.Tw Y m s) (a : W.Tw X j t) :
    W.pushforward hA f hX hY (m + j) (s + t) (m + j') (s + t') (by omega) (by omega)
        (W.cupTw X m j _ rfl s t _ rfl (W.pullTw f m s b) a) =
      W.cupTw Y m j' _ rfl s t' _ rfl b (W.pushforward hA f hX hY j t j' t' hj ht a)
declarations.comment: the projection formula f_*(f^*b ∪ a) = b ∪ f_*a, over the actual category of smooth projective schemes over k, in every degree and Tate twist

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilData.pushforward_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FHB, functoriality of the pushforward.** For morphisms `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z`
of nonempty equidimensional smooth projective schemes over `k`, `g_* ∘ f_* = (g ∘ f)_*`.
The proof uses only axiom (A)(b).
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforward_comp (hA : W.PerfectPairing)
    {X Y Z : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) {d e c : ℕ} (hX : IsNonemptyEquidimensional X d)
    (hY : IsNonemptyEquidimensional Y e) (hZ : IsNonemptyEquidimensional Z c)
    (j t j' t' j'' t'' : ℤ) (hj : j' + 2 * d = j + 2 * e) (ht : t' + d = t + e)
    (hj' : j'' + 2 * e = j' + 2 * c) (ht' : t'' + e = t' + c) (a : W.Tw X j t) :
    W.pushforward hA g hY hZ j' t' j'' t'' hj' ht' (W.pushforward hA f hX hY j t j' t' hj ht a) =
      W.pushforward hA (f ≫ g) hX hZ j t j'' t'' (by omega) (by omega) a
declarations.comment: functoriality g_* ∘ f_* = (g ∘ f)_* of the pushforward, over the actual category of smooth projective schemes over k, in every degree and Tate twist

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.poincareDualPushforward_comp
declarations.doc: Poincaré-dual pushforward is covariantly functorial for composable pullbacks.
declarations.statement:
theorem poincareDualPushforward_comp
    {R : Type uR} [CommSemiring R]
    {HX : Type uHX} [AddCommMonoid HX] [Module R HX]
    {HY : Type uHY} [AddCommMonoid HY] [Module R HY]
    {HZ : Type uHZ} [AddCommMonoid HZ] [Module R HZ]
    {DX : Type uDX} [AddCommMonoid DX] [Module R DX]
    {DY : Type uDY} [AddCommMonoid DY] [Module R DY]
    {DZ : Type uDZ} [AddCommMonoid DZ] [Module R DZ]
    (pairX : HX →ₗ[R] DX →ₗ[R] R)
    (pairY : HY →ₗ[R] DY →ₗ[R] R)
    (pairZ : HZ →ₗ[R] DZ →ₗ[R] R)
    [pairY.IsPerfPair] [pairZ.IsPerfPair]
    (pullbackF : HY →ₗ[R] HX) (pullbackG : HZ →ₗ[R] HY) :
    (poincareDualPushforward pairY pairZ pullbackG).comp
        (poincareDualPushforward pairX pairY pullbackF) =
      poincareDualPushforward pairX pairZ (pullbackF.comp pullbackG)
declarations.comment: pushforward_composition

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.poincareDualPushforward_cup
declarations.doc:
The projection formula `f₊ (f⁺ b ∪ a) = b ∪ f₊ a` for the pushforward defined by Poincaré
duality.  The pairing identities are associativity of cup product under integration, and
`pullback_cup` is its naturality.
declarations.statement:
theorem poincareDualPushforward_cup
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    {HX DX HX' DX' HY DY HY' DY' BX BY : Type*}
    [AddCommMonoid HX] [Module R HX]
    [AddCommMonoid DX] [Module R DX]
    [AddCommMonoid HX'] [Module R HX']
    [AddCommMonoid DX'] [Module R DX']
    [AddCommMonoid HY] [Module R HY]
    [AddCommMonoid DY] [Module R DY]
    [AddCommMonoid HY'] [Module R HY']
    [AddCommMonoid DY'] [Module R DY']
    [AddCommMonoid BX] [Module R BX]
    [AddCommMonoid BY] [Module R BY]
    (pairX : HX →ₗ[R] DX →ₗ[R] R)
    (pairY : HY →ₗ[R] DY →ₗ[R] R) [pairY.IsPerfPair]
    (pairX' : HX' →ₗ[R] DX' →ₗ[R] R)
    (pairY' : HY' →ₗ[R] DY' →ₗ[R] R) [pairY'.IsPerfPair]
    (pullback : HY →ₗ[R] HX)
    (pullback' : HY' →ₗ[R] HX')
    (pullbackB : BY →ₗ[R] BX)
    (cupX : BX →ₗ[R] DX →ₗ[R] DX')
    (cupY : BY →ₗ[R] DY →ₗ[R] DY')
    (cupLeftX : HX' →ₗ[R] BX →ₗ[R] HX)
    (cupLeftY : HY' →ₗ[R] BY →ₗ[R] HY)
    (pullback_cup : ∀ c b,
      pullback (cupLeftY c b) = cupLeftX (pullback' c) (pullbackB b))
    (trace_assoc_X : ∀ c b a,
      pairX' c (cupX b a) = pairX (cupLeftX c b) a)
    (trace_assoc_Y : ∀ c b a,
      pairY' c (cupY b a) = pairY (cupLeftY c b) a)
    (b : BY) (a : DX) :
    poincareDualPushforward pairX' pairY' pullback'
        (cupX (pullbackB b) a) =
      cupY b (poincareDualPushforward pairX pairY pullback a)
declarations.comment: projection_formula

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilData.pushforward_snd_externalProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FHC.** Let `H^*` be data (D0), (D1), (D3) over a field `k`
satisfying axioms (A) and (B), and let `X`, `Y` be nonempty smooth projective schemes over `k`,
equidimensional of dimensions `d` and `e`. Then `pr_{2, *} : H^*(X × Y)(d + e) ⟶ H^*(Y)(e)`
sends `a ⊗ b = pr₁^*a ∪ pr₂^*b` to `(∫_X a) b`:

* for `a ∈ H^{2d}(X)(d)` and `b ∈ H^q(Y)(t)`, `pr_{2, *}(a ⊗ b) = (∫_X a) b`;
* for `a ∈ H^p(X)(s)` with `p ≠ 2d`, where `∫_X a` is read as zero, `pr_{2, *}(a ⊗ b) = 0`.

The source's twists are `t = e`, resp. `s + t = d + e`; any twist is allowed here. Only (A)(b)
and (B)(b) are used.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforward_snd_externalProduct (hA : W.PerfectPairing) (hK : W.KunnethTrace)
    {X Y : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory} {d e : ℕ}
    (hX : IsNonemptyEquidimensional X d) (hY : IsNonemptyEquidimensional Y e) :
    (∀ (q t : ℤ) (a : W.Tw X (2 * d) d) (b : W.Tw Y q t),
      W.pushforward hA (snd X Y) (isNonemptyEquidimensional_prod hX hY) hY (2 * d + q) (d + t)
          q t (by push_cast; ring) (by push_cast; ring)
          (W.cupTw (prod X Y) (2 * d) q _ rfl d t _ rfl (W.pullTw (fst X Y) _ _ a)
            (W.pullTw (snd X Y) _ _ b)) =
        W.trace X d hX a • b) ∧
    ∀ (p q s t : ℤ), p ≠ 2 * d → ∀ (a : W.Tw X p s) (b : W.Tw Y q t),
      W.pushforward hA (snd X Y) (isNonemptyEquidimensional_prod hX hY) hY (p + q) (s + t)
          (p + q - 2 * d) (s + t - d) (by push_cast; ring) (by push_cast; ring)
          (W.cupTw (prod X Y) p q _ rfl s t _ rfl (W.pullTw (fst X Y) _ _ a)
            (W.pullTw (snd X Y) _ _ b)) = 0
declarations.comment: over any field k, for nonempty equidimensional (possibly disconnected) smooth projective X, Y and the actual WeilData of Section 0FHA under (A)(b) and (B)(b): pr_{2,*}(pr₁^*a ∪ pr₂^*b) = (∫_X a) b for a of top degree 2d, and = 0 for a of any other degree, where ∫_X a is read as zero; b in any degree and Tate twist

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.codimensionIntersectionProduct_eq_codimensionGysin_diag
declarations.doc:
**Remark 0FHD: the intersection product is `α · β = Δ^!(α × β)`**, the Gysin map of the
diagonal `Δ : X ⟶ X ×_k X` (Stacks 0FF3) applied to the exterior product (Stacks 0FBV), for `X`
smooth and proper over `k` and `α ∈ CH^i(X)`, `β ∈ CH^j(X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem codimensionIntersectionProduct_eq_codimensionGysin_diag (i j : ℤ)
    (α : codimensionChowGroup k sX i) (β : codimensionChowGroup k sX j) :
    codimensionIntersectionProduct k sX i j α β =
      codimensionGysin sX (prodBase sX sX) (f := pullback.diagonal sX)
        (by rw [prodBase, pullback.diagonal_fst_assoc]) (i + j)
        (codimensionExteriorProduct k sX sX i j α β)
declarations.comment: the intersection product is α · β = Δ^!(α × β)

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilData.cycleClassMul_iff_cycleClass_codimensionExteriorProduct
declarations.doc:
**Remark 0FHD.** Given axiom (C)(a), `γ(f^!β) = f^*γ(β)`, axiom (C)(c),
`γ(α · β) = γ(α) ∪ γ(β)` for every smooth projective `X` over `k`, holds if and only if `γ` is
compatible with exterior products in the sense that `γ(α × β) = pr₁^*γ(α) ∪ pr₂^*γ(β)` in
`H^*(X × X)` for every smooth projective `X` over `k` and `α ∈ CH^i(X)`, `β ∈ CH^j(X)`. The source
assumes (A) and (B) as well; they are not needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem cycleClassMul_iff_cycleClass_codimensionExteriorProduct (hCa : W.CycleClassPullback) :
    W.CycleClassMul ↔
      ∀ (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory) (i j : ℤ)
          (α : codimensionChowGroup k X.obj.hom i)
        (β : codimensionChowGroup k X.obj.hom j),
        W.cycleClass (SmoothProjectiveScheme.prod X X) (i + j)
            (codimensionExteriorProduct k X.obj.hom X.obj.hom i j α β) =
          W.cupTw (SmoothProjectiveScheme.prod X X) (2 * i) (2 * j) _ (by ring) i j _ rfl
            (W.pullTw (SmoothProjectiveScheme.fst X X) _ _ (W.cycleClass X i α))
            (W.pullTw (SmoothProjectiveScheme.snd X X) _ _ (W.cycleClass X j β))
declarations.comment: given (C)(a), axiom (C)(c) is equivalent to compatibility of γ with exterior products; (A) and (B), assumed in the source, are not used

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.cycleClass_mul_iff_cycleClass_externalProduct
declarations.doc:
Let the intersection and exterior products of cycles satisfy `α · β = Δ^!(α × β)` and
`α × β = pr₁^!α · pr₂^!β`, and let the cycle class map satisfy axiom `(C)(a)`,
`γ(f^!β) = f^*γ(β)`. Then axiom `(C)(c)`, `γ(α · β) = γ(α) ∪ γ(β)`, holds for every smooth
projective variety if and only if the cycle class map is compatible with exterior products, that
is `γ(α × β) = pr₁^*γ(α) ∪ pr₂^*γ(β)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cycleClass_mul_iff_cycleClass_externalProduct (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [HasBinaryProducts ((SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory)]
    (A : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory → ℤ → Type v)
    (cup : ∀ {X : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory} (r s : ℤ), A X r → A X s → A X (r + s))
    (pullback : ∀ {X Y : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory}, (X ⟶ Y) → ∀ r : ℤ, A Y r → A X r)
    (pullback_id : ∀ (X) (r : ℤ) (u : A X r), pullback (𝟙 X) r u = u)
    (pullback_comp : ∀ {X Y Z : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
      (r : ℤ) (u : A Z r), pullback (f ≫ g) r u = pullback f r (pullback g r u))
    (pullback_cup : ∀ {X Y : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory} (f : X ⟶ Y) (r s : ℤ)
      (u : A Y r) (v : A Y s),
      pullback f (r + s) (cup r s u v) = cup r s (pullback f r u) (pullback f s v))
    (CH : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory → ℤ → Type w)
    (chowMul : ∀ {X : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory} (r s : ℤ),
      CH X r → CH X s → CH X (r + s))
    (gysin : ∀ {X Y : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory}, (X ⟶ Y) → ∀ r : ℤ, CH Y r → CH X r)
    (externalProduct : ∀ {X Y : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory} (r s : ℤ),
      CH X r → CH Y s → CH (X ⨯ Y) (r + s))
    (cycleClass : ∀ (X) (r : ℤ), CH X r → A X r)
    -- naturality, `(C)(a)`
    (cycleClass_gysin : ∀ {X Y : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory} (f : X ⟶ Y) (r : ℤ)
      (β : CH Y r), cycleClass X r (gysin f r β) = pullback f r (cycleClass Y r β))
    -- `α × β = pr₁^!α · pr₂^!β`
    (externalProduct_eq : ∀ {X Y : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory} (r s : ℤ)
      (α : CH X r) (β : CH Y s), externalProduct r s α β =
        chowMul r s (gysin (prod.fst : X ⨯ Y ⟶ X) r α) (gysin (prod.snd : X ⨯ Y ⟶ Y) s β))
    -- `α · β = Δ^!(α × β)`, the definition of the intersection product
    (chowMul_eq : ∀ {X : (SmoothProjective k).FullSubcategory} (r s : ℤ)
      (α : CH X r) (β : CH X s), chowMul r s α β =
        gysin (prod.lift (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X) : X ⟶ X ⨯ X) (r + s) (externalProduct r s α β)) :
    (∀ (X) (r s : ℤ) (α : CH X r) (β : CH X s),
        cycleClass X (r + s) (chowMul r s α β) =
          cup r s (cycleClass X r α) (cycleClass X s β)) ↔
      ∀ (X Y) (r s : ℤ) (α : CH X r) (β : CH Y s),
        cycleClass (X ⨯ Y) (r + s) (externalProduct r s α β) =
          cup r s (pullback (prod.fst : X ⨯ Y ⟶ X) r (cycleClass X r α))
            (pullback (prod.snd : X ⨯ Y ⟶ Y) s (cycleClass Y s β))
declarations.comment: axiom (C)(c) as compatibility with exterior products

declarations.doc:
The coefficient-field algebra map is an isomorphism onto degree-zero
cohomology of the base point, and it is the unique algebra isomorphism.

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.fundamentalChowClass_baseChowMul_self
declarations.doc:
**The Chow identity `[S] · [S] = [S]`.** The self-intersection of the fundamental class of
the base is the fundamental class: it is the unit of the ring `A_0(S) = ℤ` of Stacks 0AZ1. This
is the step of Stacks 0FHE's proof that the cohomological statements of
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.F6Rank201.WeilCohomologyBasePoint` carry as a hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
theorem fundamentalChowClass_baseChowMul_self (s : C.S) :
    baseChowMul C hδ s (fundamentalChowClass C (𝟙 C.S) 0)
        (fundamentalChowClass C (𝟙 C.S) 0) =
      fundamentalChowClass C (𝟙 C.S) 0
declarations.comment: the Chow identity `[Spec(k)] · [Spec(k)] = [Spec(k)]`, proved from the identification `A_0(Spec(k)) = ℤ` of Stacks 0AZ1 and the normalisation `[Spec(k)] ↦ 1`

declarations.name: Stacks.Weil.cycleClass_fundamentalChowClass_eq_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FHE**, third clause, with the Chow identity proved rather than
assumed. The cycle class of the fundamental class of the base point is the unit of
`H⁰(Spec(k))`.

The cycle group is the zeroth Chow group `A_0(Spec(k))` of chapter 42, which is where the cycle
class map `γ` of `(D2)` is defined, and the only hypothesis on `γ` beyond additivity is axiom
`(C)(c)`, that it is multiplicative for the intersection product. The idempotency of
`γ([Spec k])` — the hypothesis `cycleClass_fundamental_mul` of
`Stacks.Weil.cycleClass_fundamentalClass_eq_one` — is obtained here from
`Stacks.Chow.fundamentalChowClass_baseChowMul_self`, the Chow identity
`[Spec(k)] · [Spec(k)] = [Spec(k)]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cycleClass_fundamentalChowClass_eq_one :
    cycleClass (fundamentalChowClass C (𝟙 C.S) 0) = 1
declarations.comment: cycle class of the point

declarations.name: Stacks.Weil.trace_one_fundamentalChowClass_eq_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FHE**, fourth clause, with the Chow identity proved rather than
assumed. Integration of the unit over the base point gives `1`.

Axiom `(C)(d)` normalises the integral at the cycle class of the fundamental class; this is the
same normalisation read at the unit, which the third clause licenses.
declarations.statement: theorem trace_one_fundamentalChowClass_eq_one : trace 1 = 1
declarations.comment: trace of one

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilData.grade_point_eq_bot

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilData.cycleClass_fundamentalClass_point

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilData.cycleClass_fundamentalClass
declarations.doc:
For every smooth projective scheme `X` over `k`, the cycle class of the fundamental class is
the unit: `γ([X]) = 1` in `H^0(X)`.

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilData.nontrivial_of_isNonemptyEquidimensional
