`c^A_i(ℰ ⊗ ℒ) = ∑_{j=0}^{i} binom(r + 1 - i + j, j) c^A_{i-j}(ℰ) ∪ c₁^A(ℒ)^j`,
given an isomorphism `g : 𝐏(ℰ) ≅ 𝐏(ℰ ⊗ ℒ)` over `X` under which `c₁^A(𝒪_{𝐏(ℰ ⊗ ℒ)}(1))` pulls
back to `c₁^A(𝒪_{𝐏(ℰ)}(1)) + p^*c₁^A(ℒ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernClass_tensorObj (𝔄 : ChernSetup.{u, v, v₁, w} C S) (X : C)
    (E L : (S.obj X).Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E (r + 1))
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
      (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L)
    (hEL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorObjRingedSpace (S.obj X) E L) (r + 1))
    (g : (𝔄.bundleDatum X E r hE).bundle ≅
      (𝔄.bundleDatum X (Scheme.Modules.tensorObjRingedSpace (S.obj X) E L) r hEL).bundle)
    (hg : g.hom ≫ (𝔄.bundleDatum X
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorObjRingedSpace (S.obj X) E L) r hEL).proj =
      (𝔄.bundleDatum X E r hE).proj)
    (htwist : 𝔄.pull g.hom
        (𝔄.c₁ (𝔄.bundleDatum X (Scheme.Modules.tensorObjRingedSpace (S.obj X) E L) r hEL).bundle
          (𝔄.bundleDatum X
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorObjRingedSpace (S.obj X) E L) r hEL).twistClass) =
      𝔄.c₁ (𝔄.bundleDatum X E r hE).bundle (𝔄.bundleDatum X E r hE).twistClass +
        𝔄.pull (𝔄.bundleDatum X E r hE).proj (𝔄.c₁ X (picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL)))
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ r + 1) :
    𝔄.chernClass X (Scheme.Modules.tensorObjRingedSpace (S.obj X) E L) r hEL i =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (r + 1 - i + j).choose j •
        (𝔄.chernClass X E r hE (i - j) * 𝔄.c₁ X (picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL) ^ j)
declarations.comment:
the comparison `𝐏(ℰ) ≅ 𝐏(ℰ ⊗ ℒ)` of projective bundles and its effect on the
tautological class are hypotheses, the situation carrying no functoriality of `𝐏`; the rank is
constant and that of `ℰ ⊗ ℒ` is assumed; see the module documentation

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.IsTotalChernClassOnLocallyFree.apply_classOf_tensorObj_invertible
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FI8: the Chern classes of a twist.** In the standing situation of
Section 45.12, let `c^A` be a rule with the three properties of Tag 0FI5, let `ℰ` be a finite
locally free `𝒪_X`-module of constant rank `r` and `ℒ` an invertible `𝒪_X`-module. Then for
`i ≤ r`

`c^A_i(ℰ ⊗ ℒ) = ∑_{j=0}^{i} binom(r - i + j, j) c^A_{i-j}(ℰ) ∪ c₁^A(ℒ)^j`,

where `c^A_i(ℱ)` is the `i`-th component of `c^A([ℱ])`. By the splitting principle, Tag 0FI7,
after an injective pullback `ℰ` has Chern roots `x_1, …, x_r` and `ℰ ⊗ ℒ` the roots `x_k + t`
with `t` the pullback of `c₁^A(ℒ)`; the formula is then
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.esymm_map_add_const`.
declarations.statement:
theorem apply_classOf_tensorObj_invertible (hc : IsTotalChernClassOnLocallyFree 𝔄 c) (X : C)
    (E L : (S.obj X).Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r)
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
      (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ r) :
    c X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X)
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorObjRingedSpace (S.obj X) E L)) i =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (r - i + j).choose j •
        (c X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) E) (i - j) *
          𝔄.c₁ X (picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL) ^ j)
declarations.comment: for every rule c^A with the three properties of Tag 0FI5 (by that proposition there is exactly one), at the Chern classes c^A_i(E) = the i-th component of c^A([E]); E of constant rank r, L invertible, i <= r. Unconditional: no comparison of projective bundles is assumed; the proof is the splitting principle 0FI7 instead of Constructions 02NC

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.chernClass_tensorObjRingedSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FI8.** In the standing situation of Section 45.12, let `ℰ` be a finite
locally free `𝒪_X`-module of constant rank `r + 1` and `ℒ` an invertible `𝒪_X`-module. Then for
every `i`
`c^A_i(ℰ ⊗ ℒ) = ∑_{j=0}^{i} binom(r + 1 - i + j, j) c^A_{i-j}(ℰ) ∪ c₁^A(ℒ)^j`,
the binomial coefficient written `(r + 1 + j - i).choose j` (see the module documentation).

The situation is `Stacks.WeilCohomology.SourceChernSetup` with the source's condition (3),
clause (3)(b) and clause (3)(c), each in the source's own form. The comparison of `𝐏(ℰ)` with
`𝐏(ℰ ⊗ ℒ)` and its effect on `c₁^A(𝒪(1))` are proved
(`Stacks.WeilCohomology.exists_bundleTensor_comparison`, from Tag 02NC), and so is the rank of
`ℰ ⊗ ℒ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernClass_tensorObjRingedSpace (𝔄 : SourceChernSetup.{u, v, v₁, w} C S)
    (hpull : PullbackFirstChernCondition 𝔄) (hcompare : BundleCompareClause 𝔄)
    (hquot : QuotientBundleEmbeddingClause 𝔄) (X : C) (E L : (S.obj X).Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E (r + 1))
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
      (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L) (i : ℕ) :
    𝔄.chernClass X (Scheme.Modules.tensorObjRingedSpace (S.obj X) E L) r
        (isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_tensorObjRingedSpace_of_isInvertible E L (r + 1) hE hL) i =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (r + 1 + j - i).choose j •
        (𝔄.chernClass X E r hE (i - j) * 𝔄.c₁ X (picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL) ^ j)
declarations.comment: for E of constant rank r + 1 and every i, the binomial coefficient binom(r - i + j, j) written (r + 1 + j - i).choose j in N, which agrees with it wherever the term c_{i-j}(E) is nonzero. The situation is SourceChernSetup with the source's condition (3), clause (3)(b) and clause (3)(c) (QuotientBundleEmbeddingClause, the closure property for an arbitrary surjection), each as the source states it. PROVED, not assumed: the comparison of P(E) with P(E tensor L) inside the category and g^*c_1(O(1)) = c_1(O(1)) + p^*c_1(L) (exists_bundleTensor_comparison, from Tag 02NC exists_bundleTensorIso, Tag 01CD and Tag 01CX), and the rank of E tensor L. The rule c^A on K_0 and an arbitrary finite locally free E are ChernSituation.totalChernClass_classOf_tensorObjRingedSpace and ChernSituation.pull_totalChernClass_classOf_tensorObjRingedSpace

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSituation.totalChernClass_classOf_tensorObjRingedSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FI8, for the rule `c^A` of Tag 0FI5.** In the standing situation, for
`ℰ` finite locally free of constant rank `r` (`r = 0` included) and `ℒ` invertible,
`c^A_i([ℰ ⊗ ℒ]) = ∑_{j=0}^{i} binom(r - i + j, j) c^A_{i-j}([ℰ]) ∪ c₁^A(ℒ)^j` for every `i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem totalChernClass_classOf_tensorObjRingedSpace
    (hquot : QuotientBundleEmbeddingClause 𝔖.toSourceChernSetup) (X : C)
    (E L : (S.obj X).Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r)
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
      (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L) (i : ℕ) :
    𝔖.totalChernClass X
        (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) (Scheme.Modules.tensorObjRingedSpace (S.obj X) E L))
        i =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (r + j - i).choose j •
        (𝔖.totalChernClass X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) E) (i - j) *
          𝔖.c₁ X (picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL) ^ j)
declarations.comment: for the rule c^A of Tag 0FI5 (ChernSituation.totalChernClass on K_0(Vect(X))), E of constant rank r, r = 0 included, and every i; binom(r - i + j, j) written (r + j - i).choose j in N, which agrees with it wherever c_{i-j}(E) is nonzero. The situation is ChernSituation, the source's clauses and conditions each in the source's form, with the source's clause (3)(c) for an arbitrary surjection (QuotientBundleEmbeddingClause). The comparison of P(E) with P(E tensor L) and the rank of E tensor L are proved; see chernClass_tensorObjRingedSpace

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSituation.pull_totalChernClass_classOf_tensorObjRingedSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FI8, for the rule `c^A` of Tag 0FI5 and an arbitrary finite locally
free module.** In the standing situation, let `ℰ` be finite locally free, of possibly
non-constant rank, and `ℒ` invertible. On every object `f : Z ⟶ X` over `X` on which `ℰ` has
constant rank `r`,
`f^*c^A_i([ℰ ⊗ ℒ]) = ∑_{j=0}^{i} binom(r - i + j, j) f^*c^A_{i-j}([ℰ]) ∪ f^*c₁^A(ℒ)^j`.

The source's `r` is the rank of `ℰ`, and its proof begins "by the construction of `c^A_i` we may
assume `ℰ` has constant rank `r`": the formula is read on the loci of constant rank, and by
condition (2) these determine `A(X)` (`Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSituation.eq_of_pull_one`).
declarations.statement:
theorem pull_totalChernClass_classOf_tensorObjRingedSpace
    (hquot : QuotientBundleEmbeddingClause 𝔖.toSourceChernSetup) (X : C)
    (E L : (S.obj X).Modules)
    (hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
      (R := (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf) E)
    (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
      (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L) (Z : C) (f : Z ⟶ X) (r : ℕ)
    (hr : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (S.map f)).obj E) r) (i : ℕ) :
    𝔖.pull f (𝔖.totalChernClass X
        (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) (Scheme.Modules.tensorObjRingedSpace (S.obj X) E L))
        i) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), (r + j - i).choose j •
        (𝔖.pull f (𝔖.totalChernClass X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) E) (i - j)) *
          𝔖.pull f (𝔖.c₁ X (picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL)) ^ j)
declarations.comment: for the rule c^A of Tag 0FI5 and an ARBITRARY finite locally free E: the formula holds after pullback along every morphism f : Z to X of the category along which E has constant rank r, which by condition (2) (ChernSituation.eq_of_pull_one) determines c^A_i(E tensor L); binom(r - i + j, j) written (r + j - i).choose j in N, which agrees with it wherever c_{i-j}(f^*E) is nonzero. The situation is ChernSituation with the source's clause (3)(c) for an arbitrary surjection (QuotientBundleEmbeddingClause). Proved, not assumed: the comparison of P(E) with P(E tensor L), the rank of E tensor L, and f^*(E tensor L) = f^*E tensor f^*L (Tag 01CD)

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.eq_of_isChernCharacter
declarations.doc:
**The uniqueness half of Stacks Tag 0FI9.** Properties (1), (2) and (3) determine the Chern
character of the class of a finite locally free module of constant rank: any two rules with those
properties agree there.

The splitting principle of Tag 0FI7 supplies `p : P ⟶ X` with `p^*` injective on `A` and a
filtration of `p^*ℰ` with invertible successive quotients. That filtration writes `[p^*ℰ]` as a
sum of classes of invertible modules in `K₀(Vect(P))`, where additivity and the value on an
invertible module determine the Chern character; property (2) identifies the result with
`p^*ch^A([ℰ])`, and `p^*` is injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_isChernCharacter {𝔄 : ChernSetup.{u, v, v₁, w} C S}
    [∀ X : C, Algebra ℚ (𝔄.A X)]
    {ch ch' : ∀ X : C, VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X) → ℕ → 𝔄.A X}
    (hch : IsChernCharacter 𝔄 ch) (hch' : IsChernCharacter 𝔄 ch') (X : C)
    (E : (S.obj X).Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r) (n : ℕ) :
    ch X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) E) n =
      ch' X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) E) n
declarations.comment:
uniqueness, for the class of a module of constant rank; the existence half needs
the locally constant rank r^A, which is indexed by condition (2) of the situation, and the Chern
classes of Tag 0FI5 on all of K₀, and property (2) is stated on generators — see the module
documentation

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.existsUnique_isChernCharacter_of_source
declarations.doc:
In the standing situation of Section 45.12, read with `𝐐`-coefficients, there is exactly one
rule assigning to every object `X` of `𝒞` a Chern character

`ch^A : K₀(Vect(X)) ⟶ ∏_{i ≥ 0} A^i(X)`

which is a ring map, is compatible with pullback, and sends an invertible module `ℒ` to
`exp(c₁^A(ℒ))`.

The situation is a `Stacks.WeilCohomology.SourceChernSetup` together with the section's three
remaining conditions as the hypotheses `hpull`, `hcompare` and `hdivisor`
(`Stacks.WeilCohomology.PullbackFirstChernCondition`, `Stacks.WeilCohomology.BundleCompareClause`,
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.DivisorDatumClause`), and the `𝐐`-coefficients are the `ℚ`-algebra
structure together with `hq`, which says that the rationals lie in `A^0(X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_isChernCharacter_of_source (𝔄 : SourceChernSetup.{u, v, v₁, w} C S)
    [∀ X : C, Algebra ℚ (𝔄.A X)]
    (hq : ∀ (X : C) (q : ℚ), algebraMap ℚ (𝔄.A X) q ∈ 𝔄.grade X 0)
    (hpull : PullbackFirstChernCondition 𝔄) (hcompare : BundleCompareClause 𝔄)
    (hdivisor : DivisorDatumClause 𝔄) :
    ∃! ch : ∀ X : C, VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X) → ℕ → 𝔄.A X,
    IsChernCharacterOnLocallyFree 𝔄.toChernSetup ch
declarations.comment: the unique rule `ch^A : K₀(Vect(X)) ⟶ ∏_{i ≥ 0} A^i(X)` with properties (1), (2) and (3), both halves, on all of `K₀(Vect(X))` and with no restriction on the rank, in the standing situation of Section 45.12 read with `𝐐`-coefficients. The standing situation is the structure Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSetup -- the data the source fixes, with clause (1), clause (2), clause (3)(a), condition (1), condition (2), condition (4) and the source's grading A(X) = sum of the A^i(X) -- together with the section's three remaining conditions (PullbackFirstChernCondition, BundleCompareClause, DivisorDatumClause), each in the source's own form, and the `𝐐`-coefficients as an algebra structure with the rationals lying in `A^0(X)`. The structures Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSituation and RationalChernSituation are built inside the proof and are not arguments. PROVED and not assumed: the total Chern classes of Tag 0FI5, which the source's own proof cites as Proposition 45.12.1 (Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSituation.isTotalChernClass_totalChernClass); the rank class `r^A`, which is Stacks.WeilCohomology.SourceChernSetup.rankClass, constructed from condition (2) as the source constructs it, with its membership in `A^0(X)` and its compatibility with pullback along an arbitrary morphism; and the projective bundle with its flat projection, invertible twist and tautological sequence, from clause (3)(a). Property (2) is stated on the generators, which `IsChernCharacterOnLocallyFree.map_pull_kzero` upgrades to the source's form, read against the CONSTRUCTED pullback homomorphism AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom of `K₀(Vect(-))`. NO hypothesis is read more strongly than the source states it: BundleCompareClause is clause (3)(b) at f^*E itself, and the invariance of the total Chern class under an isomorphism of modules, together with the pseudofunctoriality coherence isomorphism h^*(g^*E) = (h . g)^*E, are PROVED (chernSeries_eq_of_iso, pull_chernSeries_coeff_of_iso) rather than obtained by asking that clause at every module isomorphic to f^*E

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.eq_of_isChernCharacterOnLocallyFree
declarations.doc:
**The uniqueness half of Stacks Tag 0FI9.** Properties (1), (2) and (3) determine the Chern
character on all of `K₀(Vect(X))`: any two rules with those properties are equal.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_isChernCharacterOnLocallyFree {𝔄 : SourceChernSetup.{u, v, v₁, w} C S}
    [∀ X : C, Algebra ℚ (𝔄.A X)]
    {ch ch' : ∀ X : C, VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X) → ℕ → 𝔄.A X}
    (hch : IsChernCharacterOnLocallyFree 𝔄.toChernSetup ch)
    (hch' : IsChernCharacterOnLocallyFree 𝔄.toChernSetup ch') (X : C)
    (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X)) (n : ℕ) :
    ch X α n = ch' X α n
declarations.comment: uniqueness, on all of `K₀(Vect(X))` and with no restriction on the rank: two rules with properties (1), (2) and (3) are equal. Property (2) is stated on the generators, which `IsChernCharacterOnLocallyFree.map_pull_kzero` upgrades to the source's form, read against the CONSTRUCTED pullback homomorphism AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom of `K₀(Vect(-))`

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.chernClass_secondAdams_kZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FIA for the total Chern class.** The second Adams operator scales the
degree-`n` part of the total Chern class by `2^n`: `c^A_n(ψ²(α)) = 2^n c^A_n(α)` for every
`α ∈ K₀(Vect(X))`.

The rule `c^A` is the one of Tag 0FI5, named by
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.IsTotalChernClassOnLocallyFree`, and
`ψ²` is named by the two properties Tag 0FEJ gives it. The pullback of `K₀(Vect(-))` is the
constructed `AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom`; see the module documentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernClass_secondAdams_kZero
    {c : ∀ X : C, VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X) → ℕ → 𝔄.A X}
    (hc : IsTotalChernClassOnLocallyFree 𝔄.toChernSetup c)
    (hψpull : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj Y)),
      VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom (S.map f) (ψ Y α) =
        ψ X (VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom (S.map f) α))
    (hψinv : ∀ (X : C) (L : (S.obj X).Modules)
      (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
        (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L),
      ∃ (M : (S.obj X).Modules) (hM : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible
        (S.obj X).presheaf (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 M),
        ψ X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) L) =
            VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) M ∧
          picardClassOf (S.obj X) M hM = 2 • picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL)
    (X : C) (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X)) (n : ℕ) :
    c X (ψ X α) n = (2 ^ n : ℕ) • c X α n
declarations.comment: the identity `c^A_i(psi^2(alpha)) = 2^i c^A_i(alpha)` for EVERY element alpha of K_0(Vect(X)) and a module of ARBITRARY rank -- the source's own statement, with no restriction to generators and no constant rank: the reduction to the generators is eq_of_convolutive_of_eq_classOf and the reduction to constant rank is the source's decomposition of X by the rank, ChernSetup.eq_of_pull_constantRank. The rule c^A is the predicate IsTotalChernClassOnLocallyFree of Tag 0FI5, which exactly one rule satisfies (existsUnique_isTotalChernClass_of_source), so fixing it by that predicate is the source's 'let c^A be as in Proposition 45.12.1'. psi^2 is named by the two properties Tag 0FEJ gives it, its value on an invertible module and its commutation with the pullback of K_0(Vect(-)), and the identity is proved for every ring endomorphism with those two properties; this repository CONSTRUCTS such a map, VectorBundleKZero.secondAdamsRingHom, and the two properties are verified for it in chernClass_secondAdams_secondAdamsRingHom. The pullback of K_0(Vect(-)) is NOT named by a property: it is the constructed ring homomorphism VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom, with its defining property pullback_classOf, and property (2) is read against it by IsTotalChernClassOnLocallyFree.map_pull_kZero. psi^2([L]) = [L tensor L] is read in Pic, where addition is the tensor product by Tag 01CX (picardClassOf_tensorObjRingedSpace)

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.chernCharacter_secondAdams_kZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FIA for the Chern character.** The second Adams operator scales the
degree-`n` part of the Chern character by `2^n`: `ch^A_n(ψ²(α)) = 2^n ch^A_n(α)` for every
`α ∈ K₀(Vect(X))`.

The rule `ch^A` is the one of Tag 0FI9, named by
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.IsChernCharacterOnLocallyFree`, and
`ψ²` is named by the two properties Tag 0FEJ gives it. The pullback of `K₀(Vect(-))` is the
constructed `AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom`; see the module documentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem chernCharacter_secondAdams_kZero [∀ X : C, Algebra ℚ (𝔄.A X)]
    {ch : ∀ X : C, VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X) → ℕ → 𝔄.A X}
    (hch : IsChernCharacterOnLocallyFree 𝔄.toChernSetup ch)
    (hψpull : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj Y)),
      VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom (S.map f) (ψ Y α) =
        ψ X (VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom (S.map f) α))
    (hψinv : ∀ (X : C) (L : (S.obj X).Modules)
      (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
        (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L),
      ∃ (M : (S.obj X).Modules) (hM : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible
        (S.obj X).presheaf (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 M),
        ψ X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) L) =
            VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) M ∧
          picardClassOf (S.obj X) M hM = 2 • picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL)
    (X : C) (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X)) (n : ℕ) :
    ch X (ψ X α) n = (2 ^ n : ℕ) • ch X α n
declarations.comment: the identity `ch^A_i(psi^2(alpha)) = 2^i ch^A_i(alpha)` for EVERY element alpha of K_0(Vect(X)) and a module of ARBITRARY rank -- the source's own statement, with no restriction to generators and no constant rank: the reduction to the generators is VectorBundleKZero.addHom_ext and the reduction to constant rank is the source's decomposition of X by the rank, ChernSetup.eq_of_pull_constantRank. The rule ch^A is the predicate IsChernCharacterOnLocallyFree of Tag 0FI9, which exactly one rule satisfies (existsUnique_isChernCharacter_of_source), so fixing it by that predicate is the source's 'let ch^A be as in Proposition 45.12.4'. psi^2 is named by the two properties Tag 0FEJ gives it, its value on an invertible module and its commutation with the pullback of K_0(Vect(-)), and the identity is proved for every ring endomorphism with those two properties; this repository CONSTRUCTS such a map, VectorBundleKZero.secondAdamsRingHom, and the two properties are verified for it in chernCharacter_secondAdams_secondAdamsRingHom. The pullback of K_0(Vect(-)) is NOT named by a property: it is the constructed ring homomorphism VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom, with its defining property pullback_classOf, and property (2) is read against it by IsChernCharacterOnLocallyFree.map_pull_kzero. psi^2([L]) = [L tensor L] is read in Pic, where addition is the tensor product by Tag 01CX (picardClassOf_tensorObjRingedSpace)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundleKZero.exists_lambdaOperations_pullbackRingHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FIC.** Let `X` be a scheme. There are maps
`λ^r : K₀(Vect(X)) → K₀(Vect(X))` which send `[ℰ]` to `[⋀^r ℰ]` when `ℰ` is a finite locally free
`𝒪_X`-module and which are compatible with pullbacks: for every morphism of schemes `f : Y ⟶ X`,
`λ^r ∘ f^* = f^* ∘ λ^r`, where `f^*` is the pullback ring map `pullbackRingHom f`.

The family is `X ↦ lambdaOperation (exteriorPowersData X)`, so nothing is assumed: the filtration
relation the construction consumes is `exteriorPowersData`, and the pullback map is the one
constructed in `StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.VectorBundleKZeroPullback`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_lambdaOperations_pullbackRingHom :
    ∃ lam : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, ℕ → VectorBundleKZero X → VectorBundleKZero X,
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (r : ℕ) (E : X.Modules),
          IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (R := X.ringCatSheaf) E →
            lam X r (classOf X E) = classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower E (r : ℤ))) ∧
        (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (r : ℕ) (a : VectorBundleKZero X),
          lam Y r (pullbackRingHom f a) = pullbackRingHom f (lam X r a))
declarations.comment: there exist maps `λ^r : K₀(Vect(X)) → K₀(Vect(X))`, `r : ℕ`, for every scheme `X`, with `λ^r [ℰ] = [⋀^r ℰ]` for each finite locally free `𝒪_X`-module `ℰ` and `λ^r (f^* a) = f^* (λ^r a)` for every morphism `f : Y ⟶ X`, `f^*` being `pullbackRingHom f`

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.eq_of_cohomologicalChernCharacter
declarations.doc:
**The uniqueness half of Stacks Tag 0FIE.** Two rules assigning to every object `X` of `𝒞` a
ring homomorphism `K₀(Vect(X)) ⟶ ∏_{i ≥ 0} H^{2i}(X)(i)`, compatible with pullbacks and taking
the value `exp(c_1^H(ℒ))` on every invertible module, agree on the class of every finite locally
free module of constant rank.

The splitting principle of Tag 0FI7 supplies `p : P ⟶ X` with `p^*` injective on `A` and a
filtration of `p^*ℰ` with invertible successive quotients. That filtration writes `[p^*ℰ]` as a
sum of classes of invertible modules in `K₀(Vect(P))`, where additivity and the prescribed value
determine the character; compatibility with pullbacks identifies the result with
`p^*ch^H([ℰ])`, and `p^*` is injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_cohomologicalChernCharacter
    (hκ : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (E : (S.obj Y).Modules),
      Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E →
        κ f (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj Y) E) =
          VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (S.map f)).obj E))
    {ch ch' : ∀ X : C, VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X) →+* PowerSeries (𝔄.A X)}
    (hpull : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj Y)),
      PowerSeries.map (𝔄.pull f) (ch Y α) = ch X (κ f α))
    (hpull' : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj Y)),
      PowerSeries.map (𝔄.pull f) (ch' Y α) = ch' X (κ f α))
    (hinv : ∀ (X : C) (L : (S.obj X).Modules)
      (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
        (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L),
      ch X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) L) =
        expFirstChernClass 𝔄 X (picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL))
    (hinv' : ∀ (X : C) (L : (S.obj X).Modules)
      (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
        (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L),
      ch' X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) L) =
        expFirstChernClass 𝔄 X (picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL))
    (X : C) (E : (S.obj X).Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r) :
    ch X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) E) =
      ch' X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) E)
declarations.comment: uniqueness, for the class of a finite locally free module of constant rank: two rules compatible with pullbacks and taking the value `exp(c₁^H(ℒ))` on an invertible module agree there. Constant rank is the source's reduction by condition (2) of the situation of Section 45.12, which `ChernSetup` does not transcribe, and the pullback homomorphism of `K₀(Vect(-))`, which this repository does not construct, is a hypothesis

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.exists_cohomologicalChernCharacter
declarations.doc:
**The existence half of Stacks Tag 0FIE.** The cohomological Chern character of a single
finite locally free module extends to a ring homomorphism
`ch^H : K₀(Vect(X)) ⟶ ∏_{i ≥ 0} H^{2i}(X)(i)` for every object `X` of `𝒞`, which is graded,
compatible with pullbacks, and takes the value `exp(c_1^H(ℒ))` on an invertible module.

The extension is Tag 0FEM's universal property of the Grothendieck ring, applied to the given
additive, multiplicative and unital assignment; the grading and the compatibility with pullbacks
pass from the generators to all of `K₀(Vect(X))` because the graded series form a subgroup and
because both sides of the pullback equation are additive.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_cohomologicalChernCharacter
    (hκ : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (E : (S.obj Y).Modules),
      Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E →
        κ f (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj Y) E) =
          VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (S.map f)).obj E))
    (chM : ∀ X : C, (S.obj X).Modules → PowerSeries (𝔄.A X))
    (hzero : ∀ (X : C) (M : (S.obj X).Modules),
      ¬ Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} M → chM X M = 0)
    (hadd : ∀ (X : C) {E F G : (S.obj X).Modules} (f : E ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ G) (w : f ≫ g = 0),
      Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E →
        Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} F →
          Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} G →
            Mono f → Epi g → (ShortComplex.mk f g w).Exact →
              chM X F = chM X E + chM X G)
    (hmul : ∀ (X : C) (M N : (S.obj X).Modules),
      Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} M →
        Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} N →
          chM X (Scheme.Modules.tensorObjRingedSpace (S.obj X) M N) = chM X M * chM X N)
    (hone : ∀ X : C, chM X (SheafOfModules.unit (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf) = 1)
    (hgrade : ∀ (X : C) (M : (S.obj X).Modules), chM X M ∈ gradedPowerSeries 𝔄 X)
    (hinvM : ∀ (X : C) (L : (S.obj X).Modules)
      (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
        (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L),
      chM X L = expFirstChernClass 𝔄 X (picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL))
    (hpullM : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (E : (S.obj Y).Modules),
      Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E →
        PowerSeries.map (𝔄.pull f) (chM Y E) =
          chM X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (S.map f)).obj E))
    (hflf : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (E : (S.obj Y).Modules),
      Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E →
        Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (S.map f)).obj E)) :
    ∃ ch : ∀ X : C, VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X) →+* PowerSeries (𝔄.A X),
      (∀ (X : C) (M : (S.obj X).Modules),
          Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} M →
          ch X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) M) = chM X M) ∧
        (∀ (X : C) (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X)), ch X α ∈ gradedPowerSeries 𝔄 X) ∧
          (∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj Y)),
            PowerSeries.map (𝔄.pull f) (ch Y α) = ch X (κ f α)) ∧
            ∀ (X : C) (L : (S.obj X).Modules)
              (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
                (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L),
              ch X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) L) =
                expFirstChernClass 𝔄 X (picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL)
declarations.comment: existence: the rule, as a ring homomorphism out of `K₀(Vect(X))` into `∏_{i ≥ 0} H^{2i}(X)(i)`, together with its grading, its compatibility with pullbacks and its value `exp(c₁^H(ℒ))` on an invertible module. The cohomological Chern character of a single finite locally free module, which Tag 0FI9's existence half constructs from the locally constant rank `r^A` and the Chern classes of Tag 0FI5 on all of `K₀` — neither available here, both resting on condition (2) of the situation, which `ChernSetup` does not transcribe — is a hypothesis, as is the pullback homomorphism of `K₀(Vect(-))`

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.eq_of_cohomologicalChernCharacter'
declarations.doc:
**The uniqueness half of Stacks Tag 0FIE.** Two rules assigning to every object `X` of `𝒞` a
ring homomorphism `K₀(Vect(X)) ⟶ ∏_{i ≥ 0} H^{2i}(X)(i)`, compatible with pullbacks and taking
the value `exp(c_1^H(ℒ))` on every invertible module, are equal: they agree on every class of
`K₀(Vect(X))`, for every object `X` of `𝒞`.

Both rules are additive, so it is enough that they agree on the classes `[ℰ]` of finite locally
free modules, which generate `K₀(Vect(X))`. For `ℰ` of constant rank that is
`eq_classOf_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank`, read off the splitting principle. An arbitrary `ℰ` is
reduced to that case by `Stacks.WeilCohomology.SourceChernSetup.exists_clopenRankPieces`:
restriction
to the finitely many loci where the rank of `ℰ` is constant is injective on `A(X)` by condition
(2) of the situation, and both rules commute with those restrictions.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_cohomologicalChernCharacter'
    {ch ch' : ∀ X : C, VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X) →+* PowerSeries (𝔄.A X)}
    (hpull : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj Y)),
      PowerSeries.map (𝔄.pull f) (ch Y α) = ch X (VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom (S.map f) α))
    (hpull' : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj Y)),
      PowerSeries.map (𝔄.pull f) (ch' Y α) = ch' X (VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom (S.map f) α))
    (hinv : ∀ (X : C) (L : (S.obj X).Modules)
      (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
        (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L),
      ch X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) L) =
        expFirstChernClass 𝔄.toChernSetup X (picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL))
    (hinv' : ∀ (X : C) (L : (S.obj X).Modules)
      (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
        (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L),
      ch' X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) L) =
        expFirstChernClass 𝔄.toChernSetup X (picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL))
    (X : C) (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X)) :
    ch X α = ch' X α
declarations.comment: uniqueness: two rules assigning to every object a ring homomorphism out of `K₀(Vect(X))`, compatible with pullbacks and taking the value `exp(c₁^H(ℒ))` on an invertible module, agree on every class and at every object. Every input is discharged here: compatibility with pullbacks is read against the CONSTRUCTED pullback homomorphism AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom of `K₀(Vect(-))`

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.exists_cohomologicalChernCharacter_of_source
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FIE, existence half.** In the standing situation of Section 45.12,
read with the `𝐐`-structure data (D0) and (D1) of Section 45.14 give, there is a rule assigning
to every object `X` of `𝒞` a ring homomorphism

`ch^H : K₀(Vect(X)) ⟶ ∏_{i ≥ 0} H^{2i}(X)(i)`

which is graded, is compatible with pullbacks, and takes the value `exp(c_1^H(ℒ))` on every
invertible module. With `Stacks.WeilCohomology.eq_of_cohomologicalChernCharacter'` for
uniqueness this is the tag.

**What the situation is.** `Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSetup` is the source's own standing
situation — the data the source fixes, with clause (1), clause (2), clause (3)(a), condition
(1), condition (2), condition (4) and the grading `A(X) = ⨁_{i ≥ 0} A^i(X)`; in particular
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSetup.bundleDatum` is a definition and not a field. The section's
three remaining conditions, each in the source's own form, are the arguments `hpull`,
`hcompare` and `hdivisor` (`Stacks.WeilCohomology.PullbackFirstChernCondition`,
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.BundleCompareClause`, `Stacks.WeilCohomology.DivisorDatumClause`), and
the `𝐐`-structure is the `ℚ`-algebra structure on the `A X` together with
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSetup.IsRationallyGraded`, which is data (D0) and (D1) of Section
45.14 read for `A`. The `Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSituation` the development is written over
is assembled from those three by `Stacks.WeilCohomology.chernSituationOfSource` inside the
proof, so it is not an argument of this statement, and no
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.RationalChernSituation` occurs: condition (5), together with clause
(3)(c), is the argument `hdivisor` rather than a field, and the one-degree form of the
`𝐐`-structure is derived by
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSetup.algebraMap_mem_grade_zero_of_isRationallyGraded`.

**All three conditions are in the source's own form.** In particular
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.BundleCompareClause` is clause (3)(b) at `f^*ℰ` itself, and not at every
`ℰ'` carrying an isomorphism `f^*ℰ ≅ ℰ'` — that reading would be a closure property clauses (1),
(2) and (3) do not give, since at `f = 𝟙 X` it is the closure of `𝒞` under the `𝐏(ℰ') ⟶ 𝐏(ℰ)`
induced by an arbitrary `ℰ ≅ ℰ'`. The invariance of the total Chern class under an isomorphism of
modules, which `K₀(Vect(X))` forces on any rule out of it, and the pseudofunctoriality coherence
isomorphism `h^*(g^*ℰ) ≅ (h ∘ g)^*ℰ`, which the source has for free, are both theorems:
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSituation.chernSeries_eq_of_iso` and
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSituation.pull_chernSeries_coeff_of_iso`.

Nothing is assumed beyond that data and those conditions. The
cohomological Chern character of
a single finite locally free module, which the source's proof of this tag cites from the
existence half of Tag 0FI9 and which
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.exists_cohomologicalChernCharacter` leaves open as `chM` with seven
properties, is `Stacks.WeilCohomology.chernCharacterOfModule` with its seven lemmas; the total
Chern classes of Tag 0FI5 those rest on are
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSituation.isTotalChernClass_totalChernClass` at the constructed
situation; the rank class `r^A` is `Stacks.WeilCohomology.SourceChernSetup.rankClass`, built from
condition (2); and the pullback homomorphism of `K₀(Vect(-))` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_cohomologicalChernCharacter_of_source (𝔄 : SourceChernSetup.{u, v, v₁, w} C S)
    [∀ X : C, Algebra ℚ (𝔄.A X)] (hgr : 𝔄.IsRationallyGraded)
    (hpull : PullbackFirstChernCondition 𝔄) (hcompare : BundleCompareClause 𝔄)
    (hdivisor : DivisorDatumClause 𝔄) :
    ∃ ch : ∀ X : C, VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X) →+* PowerSeries (𝔄.A X),
      (∀ (X : C) (M : (S.obj X).Modules),
          Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} M →
          ch X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) M) =
            chernCharacterOfModule (𝔄 := 𝔄) (chernSituationOfSource 𝔄 hpull hcompare
              hdivisor).isTotalChernClass_totalChernClass X M) ∧
        (∀ (X : C) (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj X)), ch X α ∈ gradedPowerSeries 𝔄.toChernSetup X) ∧
          (∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (α : VectorBundleKZero (S.obj Y)),
            PowerSeries.map (𝔄.pull f) (ch Y α) =
              ch X (VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom (S.map f) α)) ∧
            ∀ (X : C) (L : (S.obj X).Modules)
              (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (S.obj X).presheaf
                (S.obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L),
              ch X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf (S.obj X) L) =
                expFirstChernClass 𝔄.toChernSetup X (picardClassOf (S.obj X) L hL)
declarations.comment: existence: the rule, as a ring homomorphism out of `K₀(Vect(X))` into `∏_{i ≥ 0} H^{2i}(X)(i)`, together with its grading, its compatibility with the CONSTRUCTED pullback homomorphism AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom of `K₀(Vect(-))` and its value `exp(c₁^H(ℒ))` on an invertible module, stated over the data and the conditions of Sections 45.12 and 45.14 themselves and over NO structure argument. The standing situation is the structure Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSetup -- the data the source fixes, with clause (1), clause (2), clause (3)(a), condition (1), condition (2), condition (4) and the source's grading A(X) = sum of the A^i(X) as isInternal_grade -- together with the section's three remaining conditions: condition (3) at f^*L itself, in the source's own form (PullbackFirstChernCondition); clause (3)(b) as the closure property IsBundleCompare at f^*E itself, in the source's own form (BundleCompareClause); clause (3)(c) as the closure property IsBundleEmbedding with condition (5) read at c_1^A(O_P(P')) for the divisor module characterized divisor-theoretically by IsSubbundleDivisorModule (DivisorDatumClause); and the Q-structure of A as data (D0) and (D1) of Section 45.14 read for A, that is Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSetup.IsRationallyGraded. The structure Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSituation is built inside the proof by Stacks.WeilCohomology.chernSituationOfSource and is not an argument, and no RationalChernSituation occurs. PROVED and not assumed: the cohomological Chern character of a single finite locally free module, which the source's proof cites from Tag 0FI9's existence half and which Stacks.WeilCohomology.exists_cohomologicalChernCharacter leaves open as `chM` with seven properties, discharged here by Stacks.WeilCohomology.chernCharacterOfModule and its seven lemmas; the total Chern classes of Tag 0FI5 those rest on, at the constructed situation (ChernSituation.isTotalChernClass_totalChernClass); the rank class `r^A`, which is Stacks.WeilCohomology.SourceChernSetup.rankClass, built from condition (2); the pullback homomorphism of K_0(Vect(-)), which is AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom; the Whitney formula this half needs, proved from clause (3)(c) with condition (5); and the one-degree form of the Q-structure, the rationals lying in A^0(X), DERIVED from (D0) and (D1) by Stacks.WeilCohomology.ChernSetup.algebraMap_mem_grade_zero_of_isRationallyGraded. Nothing outside the data and the conditions of Sections 45.12 and 45.14 is assumed, and NO hypothesis is read more strongly than the source states it: the invariance of the total Chern class under an isomorphism of modules, which K_0(Vect(X)) forces on any rule out of it and which a comparison of P(E) with P(E') would get only by asking clause (3)(b) at every module isomorphic to f^*E, is PROVED (chernSeries_eq_of_iso), as is the pseudofunctoriality coherence isomorphism h^*(g^*E) = (h . g)^*E (pull_chernSeries_coeff_of_iso)

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.FirstChernClassData.existsUnique_cohomologicalChernCharacter
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FIE.** Assume given data (D0), (D1), (D2') satisfying axioms (A1),
(A2), (A3) and (A4). There is a unique rule which assigns to every smooth projective `X` over `k`
a ring homomorphism

`ch^H : K₀(Vect(X)) ⟶ ∏_{i ≥ 0} H^{2i}(X)(i)`

compatible with pullbacks such that `ch^H(ℒ) = exp(c₁^H(ℒ))` for every invertible
`𝒪_X`-module `ℒ`.

The twists are the tensor-defined ones, `Stacks.WeilCohomology.tateTwist`. A family
`(a_i)_{i ≥ 0}` with `a_i ∈ H^*(X)(i)` lies in `∏_{i ≥ 0} H^{2i}(X)(i)` when each `a_i` lies in the
image of `H^{2i}(X)(i)`. The ring structure of the product is the cup product
`Stacks.WeilCohomology.FirstChernClassData.cupConv`, `(a ∪ b)_n = ∑_{i + j = n} a_i ∪ b_j`, with
unit `Stacks.WeilCohomology.FirstChernClassData.oneConv`; a ring homomorphism is an additive,
multiplicative and unital map. Compatibility with pullbacks is `f^* ∘ ch^H = ch^H ∘ f^*`, the
pullback of `K₀(Vect(-))` being `AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom`, and
`exp(c₁^H(ℒ)) = ∑_n (1/n!) c₁^H(ℒ)^n` is `Stacks.WeilCohomology.FirstChernClassData.expTw`.

The proof is the source's: Proposition 45.12.4 (Tag 0FI9) for the category of smooth projective
schemes over `k`, the functor `A : X ↦ ⨁_{i ≥ 0} H^{2i}(X)(i)` and `c₁^H`, whose standing
assumptions are (A1)–(A4). The projective bundle formula is used in the weak form that (A3)
provides when `H^*` is nonzero in negative degrees; see the module documentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_cohomologicalChernCharacter [CharZero F] (hA1 : 𝔇.CoproductAxiom)
    (hA2 : 𝔇.PullbackAxiom) (hA3 : 𝔇.ProjectiveBundleAxiom) (hA4 : 𝔇.DivisorAxiom) :
    ∃! ch : ∀ X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory,
        VectorBundleKZero ((toScheme k).obj X) → ∀ n : ℕ, tateTwist F 𝔇.tate (𝔇.H X) n,
      (∀ X α (n : ℕ), ch X α n ∈
          LinearMap.range (tateTwistMap (L := 𝔇.tate) (𝔇.grade X (2 * (n : ℤ))).subtype n)) ∧
        (∀ X α β, ch X (α + β) = ch X α + ch X β) ∧
        (∀ X α β, ch X (α * β) = 𝔇.cupConv X (ch X α) (ch X β)) ∧
        (∀ X, ch X 1 = 𝔇.oneConv X) ∧
        (∀ {X Y : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory} (f : X ⟶ Y) α (n : ℕ),
          ch X (VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom ((toScheme k).map f) α) n =
            𝔇.pullTw f n (ch Y α n)) ∧
          ∀ X (L : ((toScheme k).obj X).Modules)
            (hL : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible ((toScheme k).obj X).presheaf
              ((toScheme k).obj X).ringCatSheaf.2 L),
            ch X (VectorBundleKZero.classOf _ L) = 𝔇.expTw X (𝔇.c₁ X (picardClassOf _ L hL))
declarations.comment: under exactly (D0), (D1), (D2') and (A1)-(A4), for all smooth projective schemes over k (not necessarily irreducible or nonempty), with the tensor-defined Tate twists: existence and uniqueness of the rule K_0(Vect(X)) -> prod_{i >= 0} H^{2i}(X)(i), a ring homomorphism for the cup product of the product. (D1) is Z-graded as in the chapter's conventions; the proof uses condition (4) of Section 45.12 only through injectivity and the resolution of the top power, which is what (A3) gives on A when H^* has negative-degree classes

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.FirstChernClassData.existsUnique_codimensionCycleClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FIF, on the integral Chow ring.** Assume given (D0), (D1), (D2')
satisfying axioms (A1), (A2), (A3) and (A4). There is a unique rule which assigns to every smooth
projective `X` over `k` a graded ring homomorphism

  `γ : CH^*(X) ⟶ ⨁_{i ≥ 0} H^{2i}(X)(i)`

compatible with pullbacks such that `γ(ch(α)) = ch^H(α)` for `α ∈ K₀(Vect(X))`.

`CH^*(X) = ⨁_i CH^i(X)` is the integral Chow ring, `CH^i(X) = ∏_d CH_{d-i}(X_d)` with the
intersection product of Chow Homology, Section 0FC0, and unit the fundamental class `[X]`;
pullback is the Gysin map `f^!` of Chow Homology, Tag 0FF3, graded by codimension. A graded ring
homomorphism is given by its components `γ : CH^i(X) ⟶ H^{2i}(X)(i)`: additive, multiplicative
for the cup product, and sending `[X]` to `1`. The equation `γ(ch(α)) = ch^H(α)` involves the
rational class `ch(α) ∩ [X] ∈ CH^*(X) ⊗ 𝐐` and is read through `CH^*(X) ⟶ CH^*(X) ⊗ 𝐐`: the
`𝐐`-linear extension `γ_𝐐` of `γ` to `CH^*(X) ⊗ 𝐐` (an additive map agreeing with `γ` on the
integral classes) satisfies `γ_𝐐(ch(α) ∩ [X]) = ch^H(α)`, `ch^H` being the cohomological Chern
character of Tag 0FIE.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_codimensionCycleClass (hA1 : 𝔇.CoproductAxiom) (hA2 : 𝔇.PullbackAxiom)
    (hA3 : 𝔇.ProjectiveBundleAxiom) (hA4 : 𝔇.DivisorAxiom) :
    ∃! γ : ∀ (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory) (i : ℕ),
        codimensionChowGroup k X.obj.hom i →+ tateTwist F 𝔇.tate (𝔇.H X) i,
      (∀ (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory) (i : ℕ)
          (a : codimensionChowGroup k X.obj.hom i),
        γ X i a ∈
          LinearMap.range (tateTwistMap (L := 𝔇.tate) (𝔇.grade X (2 * (i : ℤ))).subtype i)) ∧
      (∀ (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory) (i j : ℕ)
          (a : codimensionChowGroup k X.obj.hom i)
        (b : codimensionChowGroup k X.obj.hom j),
        γ X (i + j) (codimensionIntersectionProduct k X.obj.hom i j a b) =
          tateCup 𝔇.finrank_tate (𝔇.cup X) i j (i + j) (by ring) (γ X i a)
            (γ X j b)) ∧
      (∀ X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory, γ X 0 (fundamentalClass X) = 𝔇.unitTw X) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory} (f : X ⟶ Y) (i : ℕ)
        (b : codimensionChowGroup k Y.obj.hom i),
        γ X i (codimensionGysin X.obj.hom Y.obj.hom (w f) i b) = 𝔇.pullTw f i (γ Y i b)) ∧
      ∀ ch : ∀ X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory,
          VectorBundleKZero ((toScheme k).obj X) → ∀ n : ℕ, tateTwist F 𝔇.tate (𝔇.H X) n,
        𝔇.IsCohomologicalChernCharacter ch →
        ∃ γℚ : ∀ X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory,
            smoothRationalChowRing (k := k) X.obj.hom → ∀ n : ℕ, tateTwist F 𝔇.tate (𝔇.H X) n,
          (∀ (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory)
              (α β : smoothRationalChowRing (k := k) X.obj.hom),
            γℚ X (α + β) = γℚ X α + γℚ X β) ∧
          (∀ (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory) (i : ℕ)
              (a : codimensionChowGroup k X.obj.hom i),
            γℚ X (smoothChowEquiv X.obj.hom (codimensionToRationalChow k X.obj.hom i a)) i =
              γ X i a ∧
            ∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ i →
              γℚ X (smoothChowEquiv X.obj.hom (codimensionToRationalChow k X.obj.hom i a)) n =
                0) ∧
          ∀ (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory)
              (a : VectorBundleKZero ((toScheme k).obj X)),
            γℚ X (rationalChernCharacterAlgEquiv (isRegular_of_smooth_over_field X.obj.hom)
              (exists_bounds_relativeDimension_fieldChowSituation k X.obj.hom) (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a)) =
              ch X a
declarations.comment: the integral form: existence and uniqueness, under exactly (D0), (D1), (D2') and (A1)-(A4), of γ on the integral Chow groups CH^i(X) = prod_d CH_{d-i}(X_d) of every smooth projective X over k, with values in H^{2i}(X)(i), additive, multiplicative for the intersection product of 0FC0 and the cup product, γ([X]) = 1, compatible with the codimension-graded Gysin pullbacks f^! of 0FF3, and with γ(ch(α)) = ch^H(α) read through CH -> CH ⊗ Q (the Q-linear extension of γ sends ch(α) ∩ [X] to ch^H(α), ch^H as in 0FIE). Derived from the rational form existsUnique_cycleClassMap; nothing is assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.FirstChernClassData.existsUnique_cycleClassMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FIF.** Assume given (D0), (D1), (D2') satisfying axioms (A1), (A2),
(A3) and (A4). There is a unique rule which assigns to every smooth projective `X` over `k` a
graded ring homomorphism

  `γ : CH^*(X) ⊗ 𝐐 ⟶ ⨁_{i ≥ 0} H^{2i}(X)(i)`

compatible with pullbacks such that `γ(ch(α) ∩ [X]) = ch^H(α)` for `α ∈ K₀(Vect(X))`, `ch^H` being
the cohomological Chern character of Tag 0FIE.

`CH^*(X) ⊗ 𝐐` is `CH_*(X) ⊗ 𝐐` with the intersection product of Chow Homology, Section 0FEX, and
its codimension grading; pullback is the Gysin map `f^!` of Chow Homology, Tag 0FF3; `ch(α) ∩ [X]`
is the isomorphism of Chow Homology, Tags 0FEY and 0FEM. A value of `γ` is a family
`(γ(α)_n)_{n ≥ 0}`, `γ(α)_n ∈ H^*(X)(n)`; graded means that a class of codimension `i` has
`γ(α)_i ∈ H^{2i}(X)(i)` and all other components zero (so `γ(α) ∈ ⨁_{i ≥ 0} H^{2i}(X)(i)`), and
the ring structure of the target is the cup product `cupConv` with unit `oneConv`, as in Tag 0FIE.
The rule `ch^H` is quantified over: Tag 0FIE says exactly one rule has its properties.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_cycleClassMap (hA1 : 𝔇.CoproductAxiom) (hA2 : 𝔇.PullbackAxiom)
    (hA3 : 𝔇.ProjectiveBundleAxiom) (hA4 : 𝔇.DivisorAxiom) :
    ∃! γ : ∀ X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory,
        smoothRationalChowRing (k := k) X.obj.hom → ∀ n : ℕ, tateTwist F 𝔇.tate (𝔇.H X) n,
      (∀ (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory) (i : ℕ)
          (α : smoothRationalChowRing (k := k) X.obj.hom),
        (smoothChowEquiv X.obj.hom).symm α ∈
            codimensionChowSubmodule (fieldChowSituation k) X.obj.hom i →
          γ X α i ∈
              LinearMap.range (tateTwistMap (L := 𝔇.tate) (𝔇.grade X (2 * (i : ℤ))).subtype i) ∧
            ∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ i → γ X α n = 0) ∧
      (∀ (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory)
          (α β : smoothRationalChowRing (k := k) X.obj.hom),
        γ X (α + β) = γ X α + γ X β) ∧
      (∀ (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory)
          (α β : smoothRationalChowRing (k := k) X.obj.hom),
        γ X (α * β) = 𝔇.cupConv X (γ X α) (γ X β)) ∧
      (∀ (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory), γ X 1 = 𝔇.oneConv X) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory} (f : X ⟶ Y)
          (α : smoothRationalChowRing (k := k) Y.obj.hom) (n : ℕ),
        γ X (smoothGysinRingHom X.obj.hom Y.obj.hom (w f) α) n = 𝔇.pullTw f n (γ Y α n)) ∧
      ∀ ch : ∀ X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory,
          VectorBundleKZero ((toScheme k).obj X) → ∀ n : ℕ, tateTwist F 𝔇.tate (𝔇.H X) n,
        𝔇.IsCohomologicalChernCharacter ch → ∀ (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory)
          (a : VectorBundleKZero ((toScheme k).obj X)),
          γ X (rationalChernCharacterAlgEquiv (isRegular_of_smooth_over_field X.obj.hom)
            (exists_bounds_relativeDimension_fieldChowSituation k X.obj.hom) (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a)) =
            ch X a
declarations.comment: existence and uniqueness, under exactly (D0), (D1), (D2') and (A1)-(A4) (FirstChernClassData with its four axioms), for all smooth projective X over k: γ on CH^*(X) ⊗ Q (the actual rational Chow group of X with the intersection product of Chow Homology, Section 0FEX, and its codimension grading) is graded, additive, multiplicative and unital for the cup product of prod_i H^{2i}(X)(i), compatible with the actual Gysin pullbacks f^!, and γ(ch(α) ∩ [X]) = ch^H(α) for every α in K_0(Vect(X)) and the ch^H of Tag 0FIE. The source prints the last equation as ch^H(α) = γ(ch(α)), which typechecks only after capping with [X], and takes γ on CH^*(X); its proof defines γ on CH^*(X) ⊗ Q, where the equation lives, and so does this statement. 0FEY, 0FEM, 0FF8, 0FEN, 0FEX and 0FIA are proved, not assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.CycleClassSetup.isCycleClassRule_cycleClassMap
declarations.doc:
**The existence half of Stacks Tag 0FIF.** The transported cohomological Chern character is
graded, compatible with pullbacks, and satisfies `γ(ch(α) ∩ [X]) = ch^H(α)`.

The grading is the source's Adams operator argument: a class of codimension `i` answers to a
`2^i`-eigenvector of `ψ²`, whose cohomological Chern character lies in `H^{2i}(X)(i)` by Tag
0FIA. Compatibility with pullbacks is that of `ch^H` and of the Chern character isomorphism, the
latter transported through its inverse. The defining equation holds by construction.
declarations.statement: theorem isCycleClassRule_cycleClassMap : IsCycleClassRule S S.cycleClassMap
declarations.comment: existence: the rule, constructed rather than chosen, together with its three properties — graded, compatible with pullbacks, and `γ(ch(α) ∩ [X]) = ch^H(α)`. The source prints that equation as `ch^H(α) = γ(ch(α))`, which typechecks only after capping with `[X]`; the form proved is the one the source's own proof defines, and `γ` is correspondingly taken on `CH^*(X) ⊗ ℚ`, where the equation lives. Tag 0FIE (`ch^H`), Tags 0FEY and 0FEM (the ring isomorphism `K₀(Vect(X)) ⊗ ℚ ≅ CH^*(X) ⊗ ℚ`), Tag 0FEJ (`ψ²`) and Tags 0FEX and 0FIA (the two eigenvalue statements) are hypotheses, carried by `CycleClassSetup`

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.eq_of_isCycleClassRule
declarations.doc:
**The uniqueness half of Stacks Tag 0FIF.** Two rules with the three properties are equal.

Only the defining equation is used: the Chern character isomorphism of Tags 0FEY and 0FEM is
surjective, so a rule is determined by its values on the classes `ch(α) ∩ [X]`.
declarations.comment: uniqueness: the defining equation `γ(ch(α) ∩ [X]) = ch^H(α)` alone determines the rule, the Chern character isomorphism of Tags 0FEY and 0FEM being surjective. As in the existence half the equation is the corrected form of the source's `ch^H(α) = γ(ch(α))` and `γ` is taken on `CH^*(X) ⊗ ℚ`

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.SmoothProjectiveScheme.exists_blowup_relations
declarations.doc:
**Lemma 0FIH.** Let `b : X' ⟶ X` be the blowing up of a smooth projective scheme `X` over `k`
(not necessarily equidimensional) in a smooth closed subscheme `i : Z ⟶ X`, with exceptional
divisor `j : E ⟶ X'` and `π : E ⟶ Z`. Assume that some element of `K_0(Vect(X))` restricts on
`Z` to the class of `𝒞_{Z/X}`, and that every irreducible component of `Z` has codimension
`r ≥ 1` in `X` (its generic point has coheight `r` in `X`). Then there is a cycle
`θ ∈ CH^{r-1}(X')` such that

* `b^![Z] = [E] · θ` in `CH^r(X')`, with `b^!` the Gysin map of Stacks 0FF3 and `·` the
  intersection product of Stacks 0FC0, both graded by codimension; and
* `π_*(j^!θ) = [Z]`: for every `e`, on the part `X'_{e+1}` of `X'` of dimension `e + 1` the
  Gysin map of the regular immersion `j` (`Stacks.Chow.regularImmersionPartGysin`) carries `θ`
  to a class of `CH_{e-(r-1)}(E ×_{X'} X'_{e+1})` whose pushforward to `Z` is the fundamental
  class `[Z]_{e-(r-1)}`, the sum of the components of `Z` of dimension `e - (r - 1)`.

Since `CH_*(E)` is the direct sum of the `CH_*(E ×_{X'} X'_d)`, the piece over `X'_0` is empty,
and `[Z] = ∑_m [Z]_m`, the second family of equalities is `π_*(j^!θ) = [Z]` in
`CH_*(Z) = ⊕_m CH_m(Z)`. The source writes `[Z] ∈ CH^r(Z)`; as `π_*j^!θ` has codimension `0` in
`Z`, this is the fundamental class `[Z] ∈ CH^0(Z)`. The hypothesis `r ≥ 1` is implicit in the
source (`θ ∈ CH^{r-1}(X')`): for `r = 0` and `Z` nonempty, `Z` is a union of components of `X`,
`E` is empty and `π_*(j^!θ) = 0 ≠ [Z]`.

The cycle is `θ = c_{r-1}(b^*α^∨ - [𝒪_{X'}(E)]) ∩ [X']`
(`Stacks.WeilCohomology.SmoothProjectiveScheme.blowupTheta`), as in the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_blowup_relations {r : ℕ} (hr0 : 0 < r)
    (hr : ∀ z : Z.obj.left, closure ({z} : Set Z.obj.left) ∈ irreducibleComponents Z.obj.left →
      Order.coheight (i.hom.left z) = r)
    (hK : ∃ α : VectorBundleKZero X.obj.left,
      VectorBundleKZero.pullback i.hom.left α = classOf _ (centreConormal i)) :
    ∃ θ : codimensionChowGroup k (blowupObj i).obj.hom ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ),
      codimensionGysin (blowupObj i).obj.hom X.obj.hom (Over.w (blowupHom i).hom) (r : ℤ)
          (closedSubschemeClass X.obj.hom i.hom.left (r : ℤ)) ≍
        codimensionIntersectionProduct k (blowupObj i).obj.hom 1 ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
          (closedSubschemeClass (blowupObj i).obj.hom (exceptionalHom i).hom.left 1) θ ∧
      ∀ e : ℕ, properChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
          (pullback.fst (exceptionalHom i).hom.left (dimPart (blowupObj i).obj.hom (e + 1)).ι ≫
            (exceptionalHom i).hom.left ≫ (blowupObj i).obj.hom)
          Z.obj.hom
          (pullback.fst (exceptionalHom i).hom.left (dimPart (blowupObj i).obj.hom (e + 1)).ι ≫
            (exceptionalProj i).hom.left)
          (by rw [Category.assoc, Over.w (exceptionalProj i).hom, Over.w (exceptionalHom i).hom])
          ((e : ℤ) - ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
          (properPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence_of_isProper _ _ _ _ _ _)
          (regularImmersionPartGysin (blowupObj i).obj.hom (exceptionalHom i).hom.left
            (isRegularImmersion_of_isClosedImmersion (exceptionalHom i)) e (e + 1)
            ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (θ (e + 1))) =
        fundamentalChowClass (fieldChowSituation k) Z.obj.hom ((e : ℤ) - ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.FirstChernClassData.IsCohomologicalChernCharacter.cup_codimensionCycleClass_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0FII.** Let (D0), (D1), (D2') satisfy (A1)–(A4) and (A7), with `γ` the
cycle class map of Tag 0FIF. Let `X` be a smooth projective scheme over `k` and `i : Z ⟶ X` a
smooth closed subscheme every irreducible component of which has codimension `r` in `X`, such that
the class of `𝒞_{Z/X}` in `K_0(Z)` is the restriction of an element of `K_0(X)`. If `a ∈ H^*(X)`
restricts to `0` on `Z`, then `γ([Z]) ∪ a = 0`, written `a ∪ γ([Z])` with `γ([Z])` twisted.

"Every irreducible component of `Z` has codimension `r`" is read at the generic points of the
components: the codimension in `X` of the closure of the image of such a point is its coheight.
For `r ≥ 1` the proof is the source's, on each part of `X` of constant dimension
(`mul_κ_codimensionCycleClass_eq_zero_of_pos`). For `r = 0` the source's argument does not
apply, `Z` not being nowhere dense; there `Z` is open and closed
(`isOpenImmersion_of_coheight_eq_zero`) and (A1) gives the vanishing directly
(`cup_codimensionCycleClass_eq_zero_of_isOpenImmersion`).
declarations.statement:
theorem cup_codimensionCycleClass_eq_zero (hA1 : 𝔇.CoproductAxiom)
    (hA3 : 𝔇.ProjectiveBundleAxiom) (hA4 : 𝔇.DivisorAxiom) (hA7 : 𝔇.BlowupAxiom)
    {Z X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i.hom.left]
    (r : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ z : Z.obj.left, closure ({z} : Set Z.obj.left) ∈ irreducibleComponents Z.obj.left →
      Order.coheight (i.hom.left z) = r)
    (hK : ∃ α : VectorBundleKZero X.obj.left,
      VectorBundleKZero.pullback i.hom.left α = VectorBundleKZero.classOf _ (centreConormal i))
    (a : 𝔇.H X) (ha : 𝔇.pull i a = 0) :
    tateCupLeft (𝔇.cup X) (r : ℤ) a
      (h.codimensionCycleClass X r (closedSubschemeClass X.obj.hom i.hom.left r)) = 0
declarations.comment: for any smooth projective X and smooth closed Z all of whose irreducible components have codimension r, with [C_{Z/X}] restricted from K_0(X): a|_Z = 0 implies γ([Z]) ∪ a = 0, γ the cycle class map of 0FIF; the case r = 0 by (A1)

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.FirstChernClassData.IsCohomologicalChernCharacter.codimensionCycleClass_cup_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0FII, in the source's order: `γ([Z]) ∪ a = 0`.** Here `γ([Z]) ∪ a` is
the cup product with the twisted class on the left, `tateCupLeft` of the flipped cup product. It
follows from `cup_codimensionCycleClass_eq_zero` by graded commutativity of `H^*(X)`, `γ([Z])`
having even degree `2r`.
declarations.statement:
theorem codimensionCycleClass_cup_eq_zero (hA1 : 𝔇.CoproductAxiom)
    (hA3 : 𝔇.ProjectiveBundleAxiom) (hA4 : 𝔇.DivisorAxiom) (hA7 : 𝔇.BlowupAxiom)
    {Z X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i.hom.left]
    (r : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ z : Z.obj.left, closure ({z} : Set Z.obj.left) ∈ irreducibleComponents Z.obj.left →
      Order.coheight (i.hom.left z) = r)
    (hK : ∃ α : VectorBundleKZero X.obj.left,
      VectorBundleKZero.pullback i.hom.left α = VectorBundleKZero.classOf _ (centreConormal i))
    (a : 𝔇.H X) (ha : 𝔇.pull i a = 0) :
    tateCupLeft (𝔇.cup X).flip (r : ℤ) a
      (h.codimensionCycleClass X r (closedSubschemeClass X.obj.hom i.hom.left r)) = 0
declarations.comment: in the source's order γ([Z]) ∪ a = 0, for any smooth projective X and smooth closed Z all of whose irreducible components have codimension r, with [C_{Z/X}] restricted from K_0(X), and a|_Z = 0; γ the cycle class map of 0FIF

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.FirstChernClassData.IsCohomologicalChernCharacter.poincareDuality_toWeilData
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0FIJ.** Let (D0), (D1), (D2') satisfy axioms (A1)–(A7). Then axiom
(A) of Section 0FHA holds with `∫_X = λ` as in axiom (A6): for `X` nonempty and equidimensional
of dimension `d`, `H^i(X)` is finite dimensional and `H^i(X) × H^{2d-i}(X)(d) ⟶ F`,
`(a, b) ↦ λ(a ∪ b)`, is a perfect pairing.
declarations.statement: theorem poincareDuality_toWeilData : (h.toWeilData hA1 hA3 hA5 hA6).PoincareDuality
declarations.comment: axiom (A) for the data of (A1)-(A7), with trace map λ of (A6) and γ the cycle class map of 0FIF

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.FirstChernClassData.IsCohomologicalChernCharacter.perfectDuality_diagonalClass_and_existsUnique_trace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 0FIK: uniqueness of trace maps.** Let (D0), (D1), (D2') satisfy
(A1)–(A7), with `γ` the cycle class map of Tag 0FIF, and let `X` be a nonempty smooth projective
scheme over `k`, equidimensional of dimension `d`. Then:

* `γ([Δ]) ∈ ⨁_i H^i(X) ⊗ H^{2d-i}(X)(d)` defines a perfect duality between `H^i(X)` and
  `H^{2d-i}(X)(d)` for all `i`: both are finite dimensional, and contraction against the
  `(i, 2d-i)` Künneth component of `γ([Δ])`, `μ ↦ (1 ⊗ μ)γ([Δ])_{i,2d-i}`, is a bijection
  `(H^{2d-i}(X)(d))^* ⟶ H^i(X)`;
* the linear map `∫_X = λ : H^{2d}(X)(d) ⟶ F` of axiom (A6), normalised by
  `(1 ⊗ λ)γ([Δ]) = 1`, exists and is unique.

The proof is the remark's: the left-dual structure of Lemma 0FIJ, through the identity
`γ([Δ]) ∪ p₁^*a = γ([Δ]) ∪ p₂^*a` (`key_diagonalClass`), and the linear algebra of Tag 0FFV
(`...Concrete.DiagonalExpansion`). Axiom (A2) enters only through `γ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem perfectDuality_diagonalClass_and_existsUnique_trace (hA1 : 𝔇.CoproductAxiom)
    (hA3 : 𝔇.ProjectiveBundleAxiom) (hA4 : 𝔇.DivisorAxiom) (hA5 : 𝔇.KunnethAxiom)
    (hA6 : 𝔇.TraceAxiomFor hA5 h.codimensionCycleClass) (hA7 : 𝔇.BlowupAxiom)
    (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory) (d : ℕ)
    (hX : IsNonemptyEquidimensional X d) :
    (∀ i j : ℤ, i + j = 2 * (d : ℤ) →
      FiniteDimensional F (𝔇.grade X i) ∧
        FiniteDimensional F (tateTwist F 𝔇.tate (𝔇.grade X j) d) ∧
        Function.Bijective (𝔇.diagonalContract hA5 X d
          (h.codimensionCycleClass (prod X X) d (diagonalClass X d)) i j)) ∧
      ∃! lam : tateTwist F 𝔇.tate (𝔇.grade X (2 * (d : ℤ))) d →ₗ[F] F,
        𝔇.traceContract hA5 X d lam
          (h.codimensionCycleClass (prod X X) d (diagonalClass X d)) = 1
declarations.comment: for X nonempty smooth projective equidimensional of dimension d and data satisfying (A1)-(A7): γ([Δ]) defines a perfect duality between H^i(X) and H^{2d-i}(X)(d) for all i (both finite dimensional, contraction (H^{2d-i}(X)(d))^* → H^i(X) bijective), and the trace map λ of (A6) is unique

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilChernData.kunneth_toWeilData
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0FIL.** Let (D0), (D1), (D2') be data satisfying axioms (A1)–(A7) of
Section 45.14. Then axiom (B) of Section 0FHA holds for the data (D0)–(D3) they define
(`WeilChernData.toWeilData`: `γ` the cycle class map of Tag 0FIF, `∫_X = λ` the trace map of
(A6)): for smooth projective `X`, `Y` over `k`, (a) `H^*(X) ⊗_F H^*(Y) ⟶ H^*(X × Y)`,
`α ⊗ β ↦ pr₁^*α ∪ pr₂^*β`, is an isomorphism, and (b) if `X` and `Y` are nonempty and
equidimensional, `∫_{X × Y} = ∫_X ⊗ ∫_Y` via (a).
declarations.statement: theorem kunneth_toWeilData (𝔚 : WeilChernData k F) : 𝔚.toWeilData.Kunneth
declarations.comment: axiom (B) of 0FHA for the data of (A1)-(A7): the Künneth map is an isomorphism and ∫_{X×Y} = ∫_X ⊗ ∫_Y, with ∫ = λ of (A6) and γ the cycle class map of 0FIF

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilChernData.cycleClassPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0FIM.** Assume given data (D0), (D1) and (D2') satisfying axioms
(A1)–(A7). Then axiom (C)(d) of Section 0FHA holds for the data of Section 0FHA they define:
`∫_{Spec k} γ([Spec k]) = 1`, where `γ` is the cycle class map of Tag 0FIF and `∫ = λ` is the
trace map of axiom (A6).
declarations.statement: theorem cycleClassPoint : 𝔚.toWeilData.CycleClassPoint

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilChernData.cycleClass_equidimensionalPushforward_bundleProj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0FIN.** Let (D0), (D1), (D2') satisfy axioms (A1)–(A7), let `ℰ` be
a finite locally free module of rank `r + 1 ≥ 1` on a nonempty equidimensional smooth projective
`X` over `k` and `p : P = 𝐏(ℰ) ⟶ X` its projective bundle, as in axiom (A3). Then `γ` commutes
with pushforward along `p`: for `P` and `X` of dimensions `e` and `d` and `α ∈ CH^i(P)`,
`γ(p_*α) = p_*γ(α)` in `H^{2j}(X)(j)`, `j = i + d - e`, where `p_*α` is proper pushforward of
cycles and `p_*γ(α)` the pushforward on cohomology of Section 0FHA, for the data
`WeilChernData.toWeilData` (`∫_X = λ` of (A6), `γ` of Tag 0FIF). This is clause (C)(b),
`WeilData.CycleClassPushforward`, for the morphism `p`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cycleClass_equidimensionalPushforward_bundleProj {d e : ℕ}
    (hX : IsNonemptyEquidimensional X d) (hP : IsNonemptyEquidimensional (bundle X E r) e)
    (i j : ℤ) (hij : j = i + d - e) (α : codimensionChowGroup k (bundle X E r).obj.hom i) :
    𝔚.toWeilData.cycleClass X j (equidimensionalPushforward (bundleProj X E r) e d i j hij α) =
      𝔚.toWeilData.pushforward 𝔚.perfectPairing (bundleProj X E r) hP hX (2 * i) i
        (2 * j) j (by omega) (by omega) (𝔚.toWeilData.cycleClass (bundle X E r) i α)
declarations.comment: the whole lemma, under exactly (A1)-(A7) (WeilChernData): for p : P(E) -> X with E of rank r + 1 >= 1 and X nonempty equidimensional, gamma(p_* alpha) = p_* gamma(alpha) for every alpha in CH^i(P), with the pushforward of Section 0FHA for toWeilData; nothing assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilChernData.cycleClassPushforward_of_closedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0FIP.** Assume given data (D0), (D1), (D2') satisfying axioms
(A1)–(A7). In order to show that `γ` commutes with pushforward (axiom (C)(b) of Section 0FHA for
the data `𝔚.toWeilData`) it suffices to show that `i_*(1) = γ([Z])` in `H^{2c}(X)(c)`,
`c = d - e`, whenever `i : Z ⟶ X` is a closed immersion of nonempty smooth projective
equidimensional schemes over `k`, of dimensions `e` and `d`. Here `[Z] ∈ CH^c(X)` is the class of
the closed subscheme `Z` and `i_*` the pushforward on cohomology defined by Poincaré duality.
declarations.statement:
theorem cycleClassPushforward_of_closedImmersion
    (hi : ∀ {Z X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory} (i : Z ⟶ X)
      [IsClosedImmersion i.hom.left] {e d : ℕ} (hZ : IsNonemptyEquidimensional Z e)
      (hX : IsNonemptyEquidimensional X d) (c : ℤ) (hc : c = d - e),
      𝔚.toWeilData.pushforward 𝔚.perfectPairing i hZ hX 0 0 (2 * c) c (by omega) (by omega)
          (𝔚.toWeilData.unitTw Z 0 0 rfl) =
        𝔚.toWeilData.cycleClass X c (closedSubschemeClass X.obj.hom i.hom.left c)) :
    𝔚.toWeilData.CycleClassPushforward 𝔚.perfectPairing
declarations.comment: the whole lemma, under exactly (A1)-(A7) (WeilChernData): if i_*(1) = gamma([Z]) for every closed immersion i : Z -> X of nonempty equidimensional smooth projective schemes over k, then gamma commutes with pushforward (axiom (C)(b) for toWeilData); nothing assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilChernData.pushforwardCompatible_fst_grassmannian
declarations.doc:
Let data (D0), (D1), (D2') satisfy axioms (A1)–(A7) of Section 45.14 (`WeilChernData`), with
`γ` the cycle class map of Tag 0FIF and the pushforward on cohomology of Section 45.9 built from
the trace maps `λ` of (A6) (`WeilChernData.toWeilData`, Poincaré duality being Lemma 0FIJ). For
integers `l < n` (in particular `0 < l < n`) and a smooth projective scheme `X` over `k`, `γ`
commutes with pushforward along the projection `p : X × G(l, n) ⟶ X`: whenever `X` is nonempty and
equidimensional of dimension `d` and `X × G(l, n)` of dimension `d'`, `γ(p_*α) = p_*γ(α)` in
`H^{2q}(X)(q)` for every `α ∈ CH^i(X × G(l, n))`, `q = i + d - d'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardCompatible_fst_grassmannian {l n : ℕ} (hln : l < n)
    (X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory) :
    𝔚.toWeilData.PushforwardCompatible 𝔚.perfectPairing
      (fst X (SmoothProjectiveScheme.grassmannian k l n))
declarations.comment: the whole lemma, under exactly (A1)-(A7) (WeilChernData): for l < n (so in particular 0 < l < n) and X nonempty equidimensional, gamma commutes with pushforward along p : X × G(l, n) -> X, gamma(p_* alpha) = p_* gamma(alpha) for every alpha in CH^i(X × G(l, n)), with the pushforward of Section 0FHA for toWeilData; nothing assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilChernData.cycleClassPushforward_of_extendableConormal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0FIR.** Assume given data (D0), (D1), (D2') satisfying axioms
(A1)–(A7). In order to show that `γ` commutes with pushforward (axiom (C)(b) of Section 0FHA for
the data `𝔚.toWeilData`) it suffices to show that `i_*(1) = γ([Z])` in `H^{2c}(X)(c)`,
`c = d - e`, whenever `i : Z ⟶ X` is a closed immersion of nonempty smooth projective
equidimensional schemes over `k`, of dimensions `e` and `d`, such that the class of the conormal
sheaf `𝒞_{Z/X}` in `K₀(Z)` is the pullback of a class in `K₀(X)`. Here `[Z] ∈ CH^c(X)` is the
class of the closed subscheme `Z` and `i_*` the pushforward on cohomology defined by Poincaré
duality.
declarations.statement:
theorem cycleClassPushforward_of_extendableConormal
    (hi : ∀ {Z X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory} (i : Z ⟶ X)
      [IsClosedImmersion i.hom.left]
      {e d : ℕ} (hZ : IsNonemptyEquidimensional Z e) (hX : IsNonemptyEquidimensional X d)
      (c : ℤ) (hc : c = d - e),
      (∃ β : VectorBundleKZero X.obj.left, pullbackRingHom i.hom.left β =
        classOf Z.obj.left (Stacks.Conormal.conormalSheaf i.hom.left)) →
      𝔚.toWeilData.pushforward 𝔚.perfectPairing i hZ hX 0 0 (2 * c) c (by omega) (by omega)
          (𝔚.toWeilData.unitTw Z 0 0 rfl) =
        𝔚.toWeilData.cycleClass X c (closedSubschemeClass X.obj.hom i.hom.left c)) :
    𝔚.toWeilData.CycleClassPushforward 𝔚.perfectPairing
declarations.comment: the whole lemma, under exactly (A1)-(A7) (WeilChernData): if i_*(1) = gamma([Z]) for every closed immersion i : Z -> X of nonempty equidimensional smooth projective schemes over k whose conormal class in K_0(Z) is the pullback of a class in K_0(X), then gamma commutes with pushforward (axiom (C)(b) for toWeilData); nothing assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.integration_comp_pullback_eq_integration
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FIS.** For a blowup `b : X' ⟶ X` of a nonempty equidimensional smooth
projective scheme of dimension `d` in a nowhere dense smooth centre, integration over `X'` after
pullback is integration over `X`: both satisfy the normalization `(1 ⊗ ∫)(η) = 1` of `(A6)`
against the degree-zero Künneth component of the diagonal class of `X`, which determines the
trace map.
declarations.statement:
theorem integration_comp_pullback_eq_integration
    (pullbackZero : A →ₗ[F] A') (pullbackTop : T →ₗ[F] T') (restrict : A' →ₗ[F] P)
    (one : A) (one' : A') (integration : T →ₗ[F] F) (integration' : T' →ₗ[F] F)
    (η : A ⊗[F] T) (η' : A' ⊗[F] T')
    (restrict_injective : Function.Injective restrict)
    (pullbackZero_injective : Function.Injective pullbackZero)
    (pullbackZero_one : pullbackZero one = one')
    (restrict_eq : TensorProduct.map (restrict ∘ₗ pullbackZero) pullbackTop η =
      TensorProduct.map restrict LinearMap.id η')
    (normalization : tensorContractRight integration η = one)
    (normalization' : tensorContractRight integration' η' = one')
    (nondegenerate : Function.Injective fun μ : T →ₗ[F] F => tensorContractRight μ η) :
    integration' ∘ₗ pullbackTop = integration
declarations.comment: integration agrees with integration after pullback to the blowup

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.pushforwardOne_blowup
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FIS.** For a blowup `b : X' ⟶ X` of a nonempty equidimensional smooth
projective scheme of dimension `d` in a nowhere dense smooth centre, the Poincaré-dual
pushforward carries the unit class of `X'` to the unit class of `X`: `b_*(1) = 1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardOne_blowup
    (pullbackZero : A →ₗ[F] A') (pullbackTop : T →ₗ[F] T') (restrict : A' →ₗ[F] P)
    (one : A) (one' : A') (integration : T →ₗ[F] F) (integration' : T' →ₗ[F] F)
    (pairing : T →ₗ[F] A →ₗ[F] F) [pairing.IsPerfPair] (pairing' : T' →ₗ[F] A' →ₗ[F] F)
    (η : A ⊗[F] T) (η' : A' ⊗[F] T')
    (restrict_injective : Function.Injective restrict)
    (pullbackZero_injective : Function.Injective pullbackZero)
    (pullbackZero_one : pullbackZero one = one')
    (restrict_eq : TensorProduct.map (restrict ∘ₗ pullbackZero) pullbackTop η =
      TensorProduct.map restrict LinearMap.id η')
    (normalization : tensorContractRight integration η = one)
    (normalization' : tensorContractRight integration' η' = one')
    (nondegenerate : Function.Injective fun μ : T →ₗ[F] F => tensorContractRight μ η)
    (pairing_one : ∀ β, pairing β one = integration β)
    (pairing_one' : ∀ β, pairing' β one' = integration' β) :
    poincareDualPushforward pairing' pairing pullbackTop one' = one

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.FirstChernClassData.trace_comp_pullGradeTw_blowupHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FIS.** Let data (D0), (D1), (D2') satisfy axioms (A1)–(A8) of
Section 45.14 (of which (A1), (A3), (A4), (A5), (A7), (A8) are used), with `γ` the cycle class map
of Tag 0FIF. Let `b : X' ⟶ X` be the blowing up of a smooth projective scheme `X` over `k`,
nonempty and equidimensional of dimension `d`, in a nowhere dense smooth centre `Z ⊆ X`. Then the
trace map `∫_{X'}` of `X'` composed with `b^* : H^{2d}(X)(d) ⟶ H^{2d}(X')(d)` is the trace map
`∫_X` of `X`: for the linear maps `λ`, `λ'` of axiom (A6) for `X` and `X'` (unique by Remark 0FIK),
`λ' ∘ b^* = λ`. This is the identity the source's proof establishes ("`∫_X` is equal to `∫_{X'}`
composed with the pullback map"), equivalent to `b_*(1) = 1` for the pushforward of Section 45.9
built from these trace maps.
declarations.statement:
theorem trace_comp_pullGradeTw_blowupHom (h : 𝔇.IsCohomologicalChernCharacter ch)
    (hA1 : 𝔇.CoproductAxiom) (hA3 : 𝔇.ProjectiveBundleAxiom) (hA4 : 𝔇.DivisorAxiom)
    (hA5 : 𝔇.KunnethAxiom) (hA7 : 𝔇.BlowupAxiom) (hA8 : 𝔇.GlobalSectionsAxiom)
    {Z X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i.hom.left]
    (hZ : IsNowhereDense (Set.range i.hom.left.base)) {d : ℕ}
    (hX : IsNonemptyEquidimensional X d)
    (lam : tateTwist F 𝔇.tate (𝔇.grade X (2 * (d : ℤ))) d →ₗ[F] F)
    (lam' : tateTwist F 𝔇.tate (𝔇.grade (blowupObj i) (2 * (d : ℤ))) d →ₗ[F] F)
    (hlam : 𝔇.traceContract hA5 X d lam
      (h.codimensionCycleClass (prod X X) d (diagonalClass X d)) = 1)
    (hlam' : 𝔇.traceContract hA5 (blowupObj i) d lam'
      (h.codimensionCycleClass (prod (blowupObj i) (blowupObj i)) d
        (diagonalClass (blowupObj i) d)) = 1) :
    lam' ∘ₗ 𝔇.pullGradeTw (blowupHom i) (2 * (d : ℤ)) d = lam
declarations.comment: ∫_{X'} ∘ b^* = ∫_X on H^{2d}(X)(d) for the blowing up in a nowhere dense smooth centre, the trace maps being the λ of (A6) and γ the cycle class map of 0FIF, under (A1)-(A8); the form b_*(1) = 1 of the statement is this identity read through Poincaré duality

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.FirstChernClassData.pushforward_unitTw_blowupHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FIS: `b_*(1) = 1`.** Let data (D0), (D1), (D2') satisfy axioms
(A1)–(A8) of Section 45.14 (of which (A1), (A3)–(A8) are used), `γ` the cycle class map of
Tag 0FIF, and let `W` be the data (D0)–(D3) of Section 45.9 they define, with trace maps the `λ`
of (A6) (`IsCohomologicalChernCharacter.toWeilData`), which satisfy axiom (A) by Lemma 0FIJ. Let
`b : X' ⟶ X` be the blowing up of a smooth projective scheme `X` over `k`, nonempty and
equidimensional of dimension `d`, in a nowhere dense smooth centre. Then the pushforward
`b_* : H^0(X') ⟶ H^0(X)` of Section 45.9 sends `1` to `1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforward_unitTw_blowupHom (h : 𝔇.IsCohomologicalChernCharacter ch)
    (hA1 : 𝔇.CoproductAxiom) (hA3 : 𝔇.ProjectiveBundleAxiom) (hA4 : 𝔇.DivisorAxiom)
    (hA5 : 𝔇.KunnethAxiom) (hA6 : 𝔇.TraceAxiomFor hA5 h.codimensionCycleClass)
    (hA7 : 𝔇.BlowupAxiom) (hA8 : 𝔇.GlobalSectionsAxiom)
    {Z X : (SmoothProjectiveScheme k).FullSubcategory} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i.hom.left]
    (hZ : IsNowhereDense (Set.range i.hom.left.base)) {d : ℕ}
    (hX : IsNonemptyEquidimensional X d) :
    (h.toWeilData hA1 hA3 hA5 hA6).pushforward
        (h.poincareDuality_toWeilData hA1 hA3 hA5 hA6 hA4 hA7).perfectPairing (blowupHom i)
        (isNonemptyEquidimensional_blowupObj i hX hZ) hX 0 0 0 0 rfl rfl
        ((h.toWeilData hA1 hA3 hA5 hA6).unitTw (blowupObj i) 0 0 rfl) =
      (h.toWeilData hA1 hA3 hA5 hA6).unitTw X 0 0 rfl
declarations.comment: b_*(1) = 1 for the blowing up in a nowhere dense smooth centre, for the pushforward of Section 45.9 attached to the data of (A1)-(A8) with the trace maps of (A6) and γ of 0FIF

declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilChernData.cycleClassPushforward_of_globalSections
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FIT**: for data (D0), (D1), (D2') satisfying axioms (A1)–(A8) (a `WeilChernData`,
which bundles (A1)–(A7), and (A8) `GlobalSections`), the cycle class map `γ` commutes with
pushforward: axiom (C)(b) of Section 0FHA for `WeilChernData.toWeilData`, i.e.
`γ(f_*α) = f_*γ(α)` for every morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of nonempty equidimensional smooth projective
schemes over `k` and every `α ∈ CH^p(X)`. This is Lemma 0FIP's reduction
(`cycleClassPushforward_of_grassmannian`) applied to
`pushforward_unitTw_eq_cycleClass_of_globalSections`. The source's proof cites (A9) for
`j_*1 = γ([E])`; here that step is `cycleClass_exceptional_eq_pushforward_unitTw_of_lt`, proved
from (A1)–(A8).
declarations.statement:
theorem cycleClassPushforward_of_globalSections (hA8 : 𝔚.GlobalSections) :
    𝔚.toWeilData.CycleClassPushforward 𝔚.perfectPairing
declarations.comment: the whole lemma, under exactly (A1)-(A8): WeilChernData bundles (A1)-(A7) and the only hypothesis is (A8) GlobalSections; conclusion: gamma commutes with pushforward (axiom (C)(b) for toWeilData) for every morphism of nonempty equidimensional smooth projective schemes; nothing assumed, (A9) is not used
