declarations.name: Stacks.WeilCohomology.WeilChernData.exists_weilCohomologyTheory
declarations.doc:
**Proposition 0FIU: data (D0), (D1), (D2') satisfying (A1)–(A8) give a Weil cohomology
theory**: there is a Weil cohomology theory (Definition 0FI2) whose data (D0)–(D3) are
`𝔚.toWeilData`, i.e. the given `F(1)` and `H^*`, the cycle class map `γ` of Tag 0FIF and the trace
map `∫_X = λ` of axiom (A6).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_weilCohomologyTheory (hA8 : 𝔚.GlobalSections) :
    ∃ T : WeilCohomologyTheory k F, T.toWeilData = 𝔚.toWeilData
declarations.comment: the whole proposition, under exactly (A1)-(A8): WeilChernData bundles (A1)-(A7) and the only hypothesis is (A8) GlobalSections; conclusion: a Weil cohomology theory (Definition 0FI2) whose data (D0)-(D3) are F(1), H^*, gamma of 0FIF and the trace of (A6); nothing assumed, (A9) is not used

declarations.name: Stacks.Equidimensional.equidimensional_of_isCatenary_of_propertySkRing_two
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FIW** (EGA IV, Corollary 5.10.9). Let `A` be a Noetherian local ring
which is catenary and satisfies Serre's condition `(S₂)`. Then `Spec(A)` is equidimensional.
declarations.statement:
theorem equidimensional_of_isCatenary_of_propertySkRing_two (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] (hcat : Ring.IsCatenary A)
    (hS₂ : PropertySkRing A 2) :
    Equidimensional (PrimeSpectrum A)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.picRestrictionInjective_of_regularQuotient_of_depth
declarations.doc:
[SGA2, Exposé XI, Lemma 3.16]. Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring and `f ∈ 𝔪`. Assume
`A` is a quotient of a regular ring `R`, that `f` is a nonzerodivisor, and that (a)
`depth(A_𝔭) ≥ 2` for every prime `𝔭` with `dim(A/𝔭) = 1` and (b) `depth(A/fA) ≥ 3`. Let `U`,
resp. `U₀`, be the punctured spectrum of `A`, resp. `A/fA`. Then `Pic(U) → Pic(U₀)` is
injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem picRestrictionInjective_of_regularQuotient_of_depth (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] (f : A) (hfm : f ∈ maximalIdeal A) (_R : Type u)
    [CommRing _R] [IsRegularRing _R] (_π : _R →+* A) (_hπ : Function.Surjective _π)
    (hf : IsRegular f)
    (_ha : ∀ p : Ideal A, ∀ _ : p.IsPrime, ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p) = 1 → TwoLeDepthLocalization A p)
    (hb : 3 ≤ Module.depth A (maximalIdeal A) (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) :
    PicRestrictionInjective A f
declarations.comment: the SGA2 lemma: for a Noetherian local ring that is a quotient of a regular ring and a nonzerodivisor `f` of the maximal ideal with `depth(A/fA) ≥ 3`, the map `Pic(U) → Pic(U₀)` from the punctured spectrum of `A` to that of `A/fA` is injective. The five hypotheses of the source are all demanded. The Euler characteristic of the invertible coherent triple completing a module trivial on `U₀` is shown to vanish in this depth, which by [Stacks, Tag 0F28] trivialises the module; the finiteness of `H^2` of its sections that this needs is [Stacks, Tag 0BPY]. The source's footnote that hypothesis (a) follows from hypothesis (b) is `twoLeDepthLocalization_of_dim_eq_one`, and the dualizing complex of a quotient of a regular ring is `hasDualizingComplexOfRegularQuotient`.

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.hasDualizingComplexOfRegularQuotient
declarations.doc: A Noetherian local ring that is a quotient of a regular ring has a dualizing complex.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasDualizingComplexOfRegularQuotient (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] : HasDualizingComplexOfRegularQuotient A
declarations.comment: item (1): a Noetherian local ring that is a quotient of a regular ring has a dualizing complex

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.twoLeDepthLocalization_of_four_le_depth
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a Noetherian local ring. If `depth(A) ≥ 4` and `𝔭` is a prime with
`dim(A/𝔭) ≤ 2` then `depth(A_𝔭) ≥ 2`.
declarations.statement:
theorem twoLeDepthLocalization_of_four_le_depth (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] (hA : 4 ≤ Module.depth A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A) (p : Ideal A)
    [p.IsPrime] (hdim : ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p) ≤ 2) :
    TwoLeDepthLocalization A p
declarations.comment: item (2): for a Noetherian local ring with `depth(A) ≥ 4`, every prime `𝔭` with `dim(A/𝔭) = 2` (indeed `≤ 2`) has `depth(A_𝔭) ≥ 2`

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.three_le_depth_quotient_iff_four_le_depth
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring and `f ∈ 𝔪` a nonzerodivisor. Then
`depth(A/fA) ≥ 3` if and only if `depth(A) ≥ 4`.
declarations.statement:
theorem three_le_depth_quotient_iff_four_le_depth (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] (f : A) (hfm : f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hf : IsSMulRegular A f) :
    3 ≤ Module.depth A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) ↔
      4 ≤ Module.depth A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
declarations.comment: hypothesis (b): for `f ∈ 𝔪` a nonzerodivisor of a Noetherian local ring, `depth(A/fA) ≥ 3` is equivalent to `depth(A) ≥ 4`

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.twoLeDepthLocalization_of_dim_eq_one
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring. If `f ∈ 𝔪` is a nonzerodivisor with
`depth(A/fA) ≥ 3`, then every prime `𝔭` with `dim(A/𝔭) = 1` has `depth(A_𝔭) ≥ 2`.
declarations.statement:
theorem twoLeDepthLocalization_of_dim_eq_one (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] (f : A) (hfm : f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (hf : IsSMulRegular A f)
    (hb : 3 ≤ Module.depth A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) (p : Ideal A)
    [p.IsPrime] (hdim : ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p) = 1) :
    TwoLeDepthLocalization A p
declarations.comment: footnote: (b) implies (a) -- for `f ∈ 𝔪` a nonzerodivisor of a Noetherian local ring with `depth(A/fA) ≥ 3`, every prime `𝔭` with `dim(A/𝔭) = 1` has `depth(A_𝔭) ≥ 2`

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.kollarHypotheses_of_regularQuotient
declarations.doc:
The hypotheses of the SGA2 lemma give the four hypotheses of Kollár's proposition
[Stacks, Tag 0F2B]. Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring, `f ∈ 𝔪`, and assume `A` is a
quotient of a regular ring `R`, that `f` is a nonzerodivisor and that `depth(A/fA) ≥ 3`. Then

1. `A` has a dualizing complex,
2. `f` is a nonzerodivisor,
3. `depth(A/fA) ≥ 2`, and
4. every prime `𝔭 ∋ f` with `dim(A/𝔭) = 2` has `depth(A_𝔭) ≥ 2`.
declarations.statement:
theorem kollarHypotheses_of_regularQuotient (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] (f : A) (hfm : f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [IsRegularRing R] (π : R →+* A) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hf : IsSMulRegular A f)
    (hb : 3 ≤ Module.depth A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) :
    (∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex K) ∧
      IsSMulRegular A f ∧
      2 ≤ Module.depth A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) ∧
      ∀ p : Ideal A, ∀ _ : p.IsPrime, f ∈ p → ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p) = 2 →
        TwoLeDepthLocalization A p
declarations.comment: the deduction from 0F2B: the hypotheses of the SGA2 lemma (a Noetherian local ring that is a quotient of a regular ring, `f ∈ 𝔪` a nonzerodivisor, `depth(A/fA) ≥ 3`) give the four hypotheses of 0F2B -- a dualizing complex by item (1), `f` a nonzerodivisor, `depth(A/fA) ≥ 2`, and `depth(A_𝔭) ≥ 2` for every prime `𝔭 ∋ f` with `dim(A/𝔭) = 2` by item (2)

declarations.name: exists_connectedComponent_ne_quasiComponent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FIY** (Engelking, Example 6.1.24). In general the connected component `Z` of a
point and its quasi-component `E` — the intersection of all clopen sets containing it — are
different, even though `Z ⊆ E` always holds (`connectedComponent_subset_quasiComponent`).

The witness is `Engelking`, the space `{x, y, z 0, z 1, …}` with basis of opens `{z n}`,
`{x} ∪ {z n, z (n+1), …}` and `{y} ∪ {z n, z (n+1), …}`, at the point `x`: there
`Z = {x}` while `E = {x, y}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_connectedComponent_ne_quasiComponent :
    ∃ (X : Type) (_ : TopologicalSpace X) (x : X),
      connectedComponent x ≠ quasiComponent x

declarations.name: isNormalRing_of_isNormalRing_adicCompletion
declarations.doc: A Noetherian local ring is normal if its completion at the maximal ideal is normal.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNormalRing_of_isNormalRing_adicCompletion
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (hA : IsNormalRing (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)) :
    IsNormalRing A

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PlaneFlatteningExample.flatFunctor_unique_isEmpty_not_representable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FJ1.** Let `k` be a field, `X = S = Spec k[x, y]` and `𝓕` the quasi-coherent
module associated to `k[x, x⁻¹, y]/(y)`, with flatness functor `F_flat`, and write
`F_flat(A) = F_flat(Spec A)` for a `k[x, y]`-algebra `A`.  Then `F_flat(k[x, y]/(x, y)^n)` is a
singleton for every `n`, while `F_flat(k[[x, y]])` is empty.  Hence `F_flat` is not
representable even by an algebraic space (on any big fppf site containing `Spec k[[x, y]]`, the
restriction of `F_flat` is isomorphic to no algebraic space over `S`), and in particular it is
not representable by a scheme over `S`: the universal flattening of `𝓕` does not exist.
declarations.statement:
public theorem flatFunctor_unique_isEmpty_not_representable (E : PlaneFlatteningExample.{u}) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty (Unique (E.flatValue (E.R ⧸ Ideal.span ({E.x, E.y} : Set E.R) ^ n)))) ∧
    IsEmpty (E.flatValue E.formalPlane) ∧
    (∀ (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains E.X), B.Contains (Spec (.of E.formalPlane)) →
      ¬ ∃ X : (BigFppfOver B E.X hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u, IsAlgebraicSpace B E.X hS X ∧
        Nonempty (X ≅ (Over.post B.inclusion).op ⋙
          E.flatnessSituation.flatFunctor ⋙ uliftFunctor)) ∧
    ¬ E.flatnessSituation.flatFunctor.IsRepresentable

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism_of_isRegular_target
declarations.doc:
Let `X ⟶ Y ⟶ S` be a commutative triangle of morphisms of schemes with `S` locally
Noetherian, `Y ⟶ S` locally of finite type and `Y` regular. If `X ⟶ S` is a local complete
intersection morphism, then so is `f : X ⟶ Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism_of_isRegular_target {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ S) {h : X ⟶ S} (hcomm : f ≫ g = h) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] [LocallyOfFiniteType g]
    (hY : IsRegular Y) (hh : IsLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism h) :
    IsLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism f
declarations.comment: f is a local complete intersection morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.koszulAt_of_isRegular_target
declarations.doc:
Let `X ⟶ Y ⟶ S` be a commutative triangle of morphisms of schemes with `S` locally
Noetherian, `Y ⟶ S` locally of finite type and `Y` regular. If `X ⟶ S` is a local complete
intersection morphism, then `g : Y ⟶ S` is Koszul at the image of every point of `X`.
declarations.comment: Y ⟶ S is Koszul at the image of every point of X

declarations.name: ProjectiveDeterminant.determinant_submodule_eq_annihilator
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FJA.** The determinant line of a finite projective module is the
annihilator of the degree-one elements in its exterior algebra.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinant_submodule_eq_annihilator (R : Type u) (M : Type v)
    [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Projective R M] :
    ProjectiveDeterminant.submodule (R := R) (M := M) =
      ⨅ m : M, LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m))

declarations.name: ProjectiveDeterminant.determinantTensorDeterminantEquiv_of_exact
declarations.doc:
A short exact sequence `0 → M' → M → M'' → 0` of finite projective modules has a canonical
determinant isomorphism. Its value on `x' ⊗ x''` is the wedge of the image of `x'` with any lift of
`x''` to the exterior algebra of `M`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def determinantTensorDeterminantEquiv_of_exact
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {M' : Type v} {M : Type w} {M'' : Type x}
    [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M'] [Module.Finite R M'] [Module.Projective R M']
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Projective R M]
    [AddCommGroup M''] [Module R M''] [Module.Finite R M''] [Module.Projective R M'']
    (f : M' →ₗ[R] M) (g : M →ₗ[R] M'')
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hfg : Function.Exact f g) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    { γ : TensorProduct R
          (↥(⨅ m : M', LinearMap.ker
            (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m))))
          (↥(⨅ m : M'', LinearMap.ker
            (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m)))) ≃ₗ[R]
        ↥(⨅ m : M, LinearMap.ker
          (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m))) //
      ∀ (x' : ↥(⨅ m : M', LinearMap.ker
            (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m))))
        (x'' : ↥(⨅ m : M'', LinearMap.ker
            (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m))))
        (y'' : ExteriorAlgebra R M),
        ExteriorAlgebra.map g y'' = (x'' : ExteriorAlgebra R M'') →
          ((γ (x' ⊗ₜ[R] x'') : ↥(⨅ m : M, LinearMap.ker
              (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m)))) : ExteriorAlgebra R M) =
            ExteriorAlgebra.map f (x' : ExteriorAlgebra R M') * y'' }

declarations.name: ProjectiveDeterminant.determinantTensorDeterminantEquiv_naturality
declarations.doc:
The canonical determinant isomorphism of a short exact sequence of finite projective modules is
natural under an isomorphism of short exact sequences.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantTensorDeterminantEquiv_naturality
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {M' : Type v₁} {M : Type v₂} {M'' : Type v₃}
    {K' : Type w₁} {K : Type w₂} {K'' : Type w₃}
    [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M'] [Module.Finite R M'] [Module.Projective R M']
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Projective R M]
    [AddCommGroup M''] [Module R M''] [Module.Finite R M''] [Module.Projective R M'']
    [AddCommGroup K'] [Module R K'] [Module.Finite R K'] [Module.Projective R K']
    [AddCommGroup K] [Module R K] [Module.Finite R K] [Module.Projective R K]
    [AddCommGroup K''] [Module R K''] [Module.Finite R K''] [Module.Projective R K'']
    (f : M' →ₗ[R] M) (g : M →ₗ[R] M'')
    (fK : K' →ₗ[R] K) (gK : K →ₗ[R] K'')
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hfg : Function.Exact f g) (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (hfK : Function.Injective fK) (hfgK : Function.Exact fK gK)
    (hgK : Function.Surjective gK)
    (a : M' ≃ₗ[R] K') (b : M ≃ₗ[R] K) (c : M'' ≃ₗ[R] K'')
    (hab : ∀ x : M', b (f x) = fK (a x))
    (hbc : ∀ x : M, c (g x) = gK (b x)) :
    let D_M' : Submodule R (ExteriorAlgebra R M') :=
      ⨅ x : M', LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R x))
    let D_M : Submodule R (ExteriorAlgebra R M) :=
      ⨅ x : M, LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R x))
    let D_M'' : Submodule R (ExteriorAlgebra R M'') :=
      ⨅ x : M'', LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R x))
    let D_K' : Submodule R (ExteriorAlgebra R K') :=
      ⨅ x : K', LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R x))
    let D_K : Submodule R (ExteriorAlgebra R K) :=
      ⨅ x : K, LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R x))
    let D_K'' : Submodule R (ExteriorAlgebra R K'') :=
      ⨅ x : K'', LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R x))
    let γM := (determinantTensorDeterminantEquiv_of_exact f g hf hfg hg).val
    let γK := (determinantTensorDeterminantEquiv_of_exact fK gK hfK hfgK hgK).val
    Set.BijOn (ExteriorAlgebra.map a)
        (D_M' : Set (ExteriorAlgebra R M')) (D_K' : Set (ExteriorAlgebra R K')) ∧
      Set.BijOn (ExteriorAlgebra.map b)
        (D_M : Set (ExteriorAlgebra R M)) (D_K : Set (ExteriorAlgebra R K)) ∧
      Set.BijOn (ExteriorAlgebra.map c)
        (D_M'' : Set (ExteriorAlgebra R M'')) (D_K'' : Set (ExteriorAlgebra R K'')) ∧
      ∀ (x' : D_M') (x'' : D_M'') (y' : D_K') (y'' : D_K''),
        ExteriorAlgebra.map a (x' : ExteriorAlgebra R M') =
          (y' : ExteriorAlgebra R K') →
        ExteriorAlgebra.map c (x'' : ExteriorAlgebra R M'') =
          (y'' : ExteriorAlgebra R K'') →
        ExteriorAlgebra.map b
            ((γM (x' ⊗ₜ[R] x'') : D_M) : ExteriorAlgebra R M) =
          ((γK (y' ⊗ₜ[R] y'') : D_K) : ExteriorAlgebra R K)

declarations.name: ProjectiveDeterminant.determinantEquiv_filtration
declarations.doc:
For finite projective successive quotients of a filtration `K ≤ L ≤ M`, combining the canonical
determinant equivalences first across `K ≤ L` or first across the induced sequence
`L / K → M / K → M / L` gives the same equivalence to the determinant line of `M`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantEquiv_filtration
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (K L : Submodule R M) (hKL : K ≤ L)
    [Module.Finite R K] [Module.Projective R K]
    [Module.Finite R (L ⧸ K.submoduleOf L)]
    [Module.Projective R (L ⧸ K.submoduleOf L)]
    [Module.Finite R (M ⧸ L)] [Module.Projective R (M ⧸ L)] :
    let iQ : (L ⧸ K.submoduleOf L) →ₗ[R] (M ⧸ K) :=
      (K.submoduleOf L).mapQ K L.subtype (by
        intro x hx
        exact hx)
    let pQ : (M ⧸ K) →ₗ[R] (M ⧸ L) :=
      K.mapQ L LinearMap.id (by simpa using hKL)
    ∃ hLfin : Module.Finite R L,
      ∃ hLproj : Module.Projective R L,
        ∃ hMKfin : Module.Finite R (M ⧸ K),
          ∃ hMKproj : Module.Projective R (M ⧸ K),
            ∃ hMfin : Module.Finite R M,
              ∃ hMproj : Module.Projective R M,
                let _ : Module.Finite R L := hLfin
                let _ : Module.Projective R L := hLproj
                let _ : Module.Finite R (M ⧸ K) := hMKfin
                let _ : Module.Projective R (M ⧸ K) := hMKproj
                let _ : Module.Finite R M := hMfin
                let _ : Module.Projective R M := hMproj
                let hiQ : Function.Injective iQ
    := by
                  intro x y hxy
                  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩

declarations.name: ProjectiveDeterminant.determinantTensorDeterminantEquiv_prodComm
declarations.doc:
Switching the summands in a direct sum is compatible with the canonical isomorphism from the
tensor product of their determinant lines, up to the determinant of minus the identity on the
tensor product of the summands.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantTensorDeterminantEquiv_prodComm
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (M' : Type v) (M'' : Type w)
    [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M'] [Module.Finite R M'] [Module.Projective R M']
    [AddCommGroup M''] [Module R M''] [Module.Finite R M''] [Module.Projective R M''] :
    let D' : Submodule R (ExteriorAlgebra R M') :=
      ⨅ m : M', LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m))
    let D'' : Submodule R (ExteriorAlgebra R M'') :=
      ⨅ m : M'', LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m))
    let D'_prod_D'' : Submodule R (ExteriorAlgebra R (M' × M'')) :=
      ⨅ m : M' × M'', LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m))
    let D''_prod_D' : Submodule R (ExteriorAlgebra R (M'' × M')) :=
      ⨅ m : M'' × M', LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft R (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m))
    let γ' := (determinantTensorDeterminantEquiv_of_exact
      (LinearMap.inl R M' M'') (LinearMap.snd R M' M'')
      LinearMap.inl_injective Function.Exact.inl_snd LinearMap.snd_surjective).val
    let γ'' := (determinantTensorDeterminantEquiv_of_exact
      (LinearMap.inl R M'' M') (LinearMap.snd R M'' M')
      LinearMap.inl_injective Function.Exact.inl_snd LinearMap.snd_surjective).val
    ∃ ε : Rˣ,
      (ε : R) = ProjectiveDeterminant.det
        (-(LinearMap.id : TensorProduct R M' M'' →ₗ[R] TensorProduct R M' M'')) ∧
      ∀ x : TensorProduct R D' D'',
        ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearEquiv.prodComm R M' M'')
            ((γ' x : D'_prod_D'') : ExteriorAlgebra R (M' × M'')) =
          ((γ'' ((ε : R) • TensorProduct.comm R D' D'' x) : D''_prod_D') :
            ExteriorAlgebra R (M'' × M'))

declarations.name: ProjectiveDeterminant.det_one_add_comp_comm
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FJF.** For maps in opposite directions between finite projective modules, the
determinants of the identity plus the two possible composites agree.
declarations.statement:
public theorem det_one_add_comp_comm
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Projective R M]
    {N : Type w} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Projective R N]
    (a : M →ₗ[R] N) (b : N →ₗ[R] M) :
    ProjectiveDeterminant.det (LinearMap.id + a.comp b) =
      ProjectiveDeterminant.det (LinearMap.id + b.comp a)

declarations.name: TwoTermComplex.determinantEquivOfSurjectiveQuasiIso_apply_delta
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FJJ.** The canonical determinant equivalence associated to a
degreewise-surjective quasi-isomorphism of two-term finite-projective complexes maps the
canonical determinant element of the source to that of the target.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantEquivOfSurjectiveQuasiIso_apply_delta
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {K₁ : Type v₁} {K₀ : Type v₀} {L₁ : Type w₁} {L₀ : Type w₀}
    [AddCommGroup K₁] [Module R K₁] [Module.Finite R K₁] [Module.Projective R K₁]
    [AddCommGroup K₀] [Module R K₀] [Module.Finite R K₀] [Module.Projective R K₀]
    [AddCommGroup L₁] [Module R L₁] [Module.Finite R L₁] [Module.Projective R L₁]
    [AddCommGroup L₀] [Module R L₀] [Module.Finite R L₀] [Module.Projective R L₀]
    (K : K₁ →ₗ[R] K₀) (L : L₁ →ₗ[R] L₀) (a : TwoTermComplex.Hom K L)
    (ha : a.IsDegreewiseSurjective) (hqa : a.IsQuasiIso) (hL : TwoTermComplex.IsRankZero L) :
    letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker a.neg) :=
      TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite a.neg ha.1
    letI : Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker a.neg) :=
      TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective a.neg ha.1
    letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker a.zero) :=
      TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite a.zero ha.2
    letI : Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker a.zero) :=
      TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective a.zero ha.2
    let D := TwoTermComplex.determinantEquivOfSurjectiveQuasiIso K L a ha hqa
    ∃ hK : TwoTermComplex.IsRankZero K,
      D.equiv (TwoTermComplex.delta K hK) = TwoTermComplex.delta L hL

declarations.name: TwoTermComplex.determinantEquiv_eq_of_homotopic_surjections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FJK.** Homotopic degreewise-surjective quasi-isomorphisms between two-term
complexes of finite projective modules induce the same canonical equivalence of determinant
lines.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantEquiv_eq_of_homotopic_surjections
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {K₁ : Type v₁} {K₀ : Type v₀} {L₁ : Type w₁} {L₀ : Type w₀}
    [AddCommGroup K₁] [Module R K₁] [Module.Finite R K₁] [Module.Projective R K₁]
    [AddCommGroup K₀] [Module R K₀] [Module.Finite R K₀] [Module.Projective R K₀]
    [AddCommGroup L₁] [Module R L₁] [Module.Finite R L₁] [Module.Projective R L₁]
    [AddCommGroup L₀] [Module R L₀] [Module.Finite R L₀] [Module.Projective R L₀]
    (K : K₁ →ₗ[R] K₀) (L : L₁ →ₗ[R] L₀) (a : TwoTermComplex.Hom K L)
    (ha : a.IsDegreewiseSurjective) (hqa : a.IsQuasiIso) (h : K₀ →ₗ[R] L₁)
    (hbneg : Function.Surjective (a.neg + h.comp K))
    (hbzero : Function.Surjective (a.zero + L.comp h)) :
    let b : TwoTermComplex.Hom K L :=
      { neg := a.neg + h.comp K
        zero := a.zero + L.comp h
        comm
    := by
          ext x
          simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, map_add]
          rw [show a.zero (K x) = L (a.neg x) from LinearMap.congr_fun a.comm x] }
    b.IsQuasiIso ∧ ∀ hqb : b.IsQuasiIso,
      letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker a.neg) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite a.neg ha.1
      letI : Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker a.neg) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective a.neg ha.1
      letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker a.zero) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite a.zero ha.2
      letI : Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker a.zero) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective a.zero ha.2
      letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker b.neg) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite b.neg hbneg
      letI : Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker b.neg) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective b.neg hbneg
      letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker b.zero) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite b.zero hbzero
      letI : Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker b.zero) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective b.zero hbzero
      let Da := TwoTermComplex.determinantEquivOfSurjectiveQuasiIso K L a ha hqa
      let Db := TwoTermComplex.determinantEquivOfSurjectiveQuasiIso K L b
        ⟨hbneg, hbzero⟩ hqb
      Da.equiv = Db.equiv

declarations.name: TwoTermComplex.determinantEquivOfSurjectiveQuasiIso_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FJL.** The canonical determinant equivalence associated to a composite of
degreewise-surjective quasi-isomorphisms of two-term finite-projective complexes is the
composite of their canonical determinant equivalences.
declarations.statement:
public theorem determinantEquivOfSurjectiveQuasiIso_comp
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {K₁ : Type v₁} {K₀ : Type v₀} {L₁ : Type w₁} {L₀ : Type w₀}
    {M₁ : Type x₁} {M₀ : Type x₀}
    [AddCommGroup K₁] [Module R K₁] [Module.Finite R K₁] [Module.Projective R K₁]
    [AddCommGroup K₀] [Module R K₀] [Module.Finite R K₀] [Module.Projective R K₀]
    [AddCommGroup L₁] [Module R L₁] [Module.Finite R L₁] [Module.Projective R L₁]
    [AddCommGroup L₀] [Module R L₀] [Module.Finite R L₀] [Module.Projective R L₀]
    [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module R M₁] [Module.Finite R M₁] [Module.Projective R M₁]
    [AddCommGroup M₀] [Module R M₀] [Module.Finite R M₀] [Module.Projective R M₀]
    (K : K₁ →ₗ[R] K₀) (L : L₁ →ₗ[R] L₀) (M : M₁ →ₗ[R] M₀)
    (a : TwoTermComplex.Hom K L) (b : TwoTermComplex.Hom L M)
    (ha : a.IsDegreewiseSurjective) (hqa : a.IsQuasiIso)
    (hb : b.IsDegreewiseSurjective) (hqb : b.IsQuasiIso) :
    let c : TwoTermComplex.Hom K M :=
      { neg := b.neg.comp a.neg
        zero := b.zero.comp a.zero
        comm
    := by rw [LinearMap.comp_assoc, a.comm, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, b.comm,
          LinearMap.comp_assoc] }
    let hc : c.IsDegreewiseSurjective :=
      ⟨hb.1.comp ha.1, hb.2.comp ha.2⟩
    ∃ hqc : c.IsQuasiIso,
      letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker a.neg) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite a.neg ha.1
      letI : Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker a.neg) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective a.neg ha.1
      letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker a.zero) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite a.zero ha.2
      letI : Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker a.zero) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective a.zero ha.2
      letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker b.neg) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite b.neg hb.1
      letI : Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker b.neg) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective b.neg hb.1
      letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker b.zero) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite b.zero hb.2
      letI : Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker b.zero) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective b.zero hb.2
      letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker c.neg) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite c.neg hc.1
      letI : Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker c.neg) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective c.neg hc.1
      letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker c.zero) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite c.zero hc.2
      letI : Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker c.zero) :=
        TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective c.zero hc.2
      let Da := TwoTermComplex.determinantEquivOfSurjectiveQuasiIso K L a ha hqa
      let Db := TwoTermComplex.determinantEquivOfSurjectiveQuasiIso L M b hb hqb
      let Dc := TwoTermComplex.determinantEquivOfSurjectiveQuasiIso K M c hc hqc
      Da.equiv.trans Db.equiv = Dc.equiv

declarations.name: TwoTermDeterminant.exists_determinantFunctor_natural_delta
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FJM.** There is a determinant functor from perfect complexes of Tor-amplitude
`[-1, 0]` and isomorphisms to invertible modules and isomorphisms. Its value is canonically
identified with the determinant line of every finite-projective two-term presentation; on
rank-zero objects the determinant of the differential defines an element natural under all
isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_determinantFunctor_natural_delta {R : Type u} [CommRing R] :
    ∃ (det : Core (PerfectTwoTermComplex R) ⥤ Core (InvertibleModule R))
      (comparison : ∀ (K : PerfectTwoTermComplex R) (P : TwoTermPresentation K.obj),
        letI := P.finite (-1)
        letI := P.projective (-1)
        letI := P.finite 0
        letI := P.projective 0
        (det.obj ⟨K⟩).of.obj ≃ₗ[R]
          TwoTermComplex.determinantLine (P.complex.d (-1) 0).hom)
      (delta : ∀ (K : PerfectTwoTermComplex R),
        IsRankZero K.obj → (det.obj ⟨K⟩).of.obj),
      (∀ (K : PerfectTwoTermComplex R) (P : TwoTermPresentation K.obj)
          (hP : P.IsRankZero),
        letI := P.finite (-1)
        letI := P.projective (-1)
        letI := P.finite 0
        letI := P.projective 0
        (comparison K P).toLinearMap (delta K ⟨P, hP⟩) =
          TwoTermComplex.delta (P.complex.d (-1) 0).hom hP) ∧
      (∀ (K L : PerfectTwoTermComplex R) (P : TwoTermPresentation K.obj)
          (Q : TwoTermPresentation L.obj)
          (a : (⟨K⟩ : Core (PerfectTwoTermComplex R)) ⟶ ⟨L⟩)
          (f : P.complex ⟶ Q.complex)
          (_hf : P.iso.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f ≫ Q.iso.inv = a.iso.hom.hom)
          (hs : (P.hom Q f).IsDegreewiseSurjective) (hq : (P.hom Q f).IsQuasiIso),
        letI := P.finite (-1)
        letI := P.projective (-1)
        letI := P.finite 0
        letI := P.projective 0
        letI := Q.finite (-1)
        letI := Q.projective (-1)
        letI := Q.finite 0
        letI := Q.projective 0
        let g := P.hom Q f
        letI := TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite g.neg hs.1
        letI := TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective g.neg hs.1
        letI := TwoTermComplex.kernel_finite g.zero hs.2
        letI := TwoTermComplex.kernel_projective g.zero hs.2
        ∀ x,
          (comparison L Q).toLinearMap ((det.map a).iso.hom x) =
            (TwoTermComplex.determinantEquivOfSurjectiveQuasiIso
              (P.complex.d (-1) 0).hom (Q.complex.d (-1) 0).hom g hs hq).equiv
                ((comparison K P).toLinearMap x)) ∧
      ∀ (K L : PerfectTwoTermComplex R)
        (a : (⟨K⟩ : Core (PerfectTwoTermComplex R)) ⟶ ⟨L⟩)
        (hK : IsRankZero K.obj) (hL : IsRankZero L.obj),
        (det.map a).iso.hom (delta K hK) = delta L hL

declarations.name: TwoTermDeterminant.det
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FJM.** The determinant functor, from perfect objects of the derived category of
`R`-modules of Tor-amplitude in `[-1, 0]` with isomorphisms as morphisms, to invertible
`R`-modules with isomorphisms as morphisms.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def det (R : Type u) [CommRing R] :
    Core (PerfectTwoTermComplex R) ⥤ Core (InvertibleModule R)

the determinant functor as a named definition, rather than as the subject of an

declarations.name: TwoTermDeterminant.delta
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FJM.** The canonical element of the determinant of a perfect object of
Tor-amplitude in `[-1, 0]` and rank zero, given by the determinant of the differential of a

declarations.name: TwoTermDeterminant.det_map_delta
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FJM.** The determinant functor carries the canonical element of a rank-zero
perfect object of Tor-amplitude in `[-1, 0]` to the canonical element of any isomorphic
object.
declarations.statement:
public theorem det_map_delta {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {K L : PerfectTwoTermComplex R}
    (a : (⟨K⟩ : Core (PerfectTwoTermComplex R)) ⟶ ⟨L⟩)
    (hK : IsRankZero K.obj) (hL : IsRankZero L.obj) :
