public instance universalSyntomicOpen_smooth (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] :
    Smooth (specZIsTerminal.from (universalSyntomicOpen d).toScheme)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.universalEtaleOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FL2.** The open subscheme `U'_d` of the base `X_d` of the universal
finite free family of rank `d` over which the family is étale.

It is the interior of `AlgebraicGeometry.universalEtaleLocus`; that set is already open, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.universalEtaleLocus_isOpen`.
declarations.statement: def universalEtaleOpen : (scheme.{u} d).Opens
declarations.comment: the étale open subscheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factorsThrough_universalEtaleOpen_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FL2.** A morphism `g : T ⟶ X_d` to the base of the universal finite
free family of rank `d` factors through the open subscheme
`AlgebraicGeometry.universalEtaleOpen` exactly when the base change of the family along `g` is
étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsThrough_universalEtaleOpen_iff (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ scheme.{u} d) :
    (∃ ĝ : T ⟶ (universalEtaleOpen.{u} d).toScheme,
        ĝ ≫ (universalEtaleOpen.{u} d).ι = g) ↔
      Etale (pullback.snd (universalFamily.{u} d (universalAlgebraStructure d)) g)
declarations.comment: universal property of the étale open

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.universalEtaleOpen_le_universalSyntomicOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FL2.** The open subscheme over which the universal finite free family
of rank `d` is étale is contained in the open subscheme over which it is syntomic, because the
family is syntomic at every point at which it is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem universalEtaleOpen_le_universalSyntomicOpen :
    universalEtaleOpen.{u} d ≤ universalSyntomicOpen.{u} d
declarations.comment: containment in the syntomic open

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.dense_universalEtaleOpen_in_universalSyntomicOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FL2.** The open subscheme `U'_d` of the base of the universal finite
free family of rank `d` over which that family is étale is dense in the open subscheme `U_d` over
which it is syntomic.
declarations.statement:
theorem dense_universalEtaleOpen_in_universalSyntomicOpen :
    Dense ((universalSyntomicOpen.{u} d).ι ⁻¹'
      (↑(universalEtaleOpen.{u} d) : Set (scheme.{u} d)))
declarations.comment: density in the syntomic open

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.universalSyntomicPreimage_smooth_and_not_smooth_restrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FL3.** Let `pi_d : Y_d ⟶ X_d` be the universal finite free family of
rank `d` (Tag 0FKZ) and `U_d ⊆ X_d` the maximal open over which it is finite syntomic (Tag 0FL0).
Then `V_d = pi_d^{-1}(U_d)` is smooth over `Spec(ZZ)`, while for `d ≥ 2` the morphism
`V_d ⟶ U_d` is not smooth.
declarations.statement:
theorem universalSyntomicPreimage_smooth_and_not_smooth_restrict (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] :
    Smooth (specZIsTerminal.from (universalSyntomicPreimage d).toScheme) ∧
      (2 ≤ d → ¬ Smooth (universalFamily d (universalAlgebraStructure d) ∣_
        universalSyntomicOpen d))
declarations.comment: V_d = pi_d^{-1}(U_d) is smooth over Spec(Z), for the universal finite free family pi_d of rank d of Tag 0FKZ and the open U_d of Tag 0FL0; and for d ≥ 2 the morphism V_d → U_d, the restriction of pi_d over U_d, is not smooth. The deformation problem of the remark is Algebra.exists_finite_syntomic_section_lift.

declarations.name: Algebra.exists_finite_syntomic_section_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FL3,** the deformation problem the remark reduces the smoothness of
`V_d` over `Z` to, and its solution. Along a surjection `C' → C` with nilpotent kernel `I` onto a
nonzero artinian ring — a small extension, in particular — a finite syntomic `C`-algebra `B` with
a section `B → C` lifts to a finite syntomic `C'`-algebra `B'` with a section `B' → C'`, together
with a surjection `B' → B` with kernel `IB'` carrying the one section to the other: the tensor
product of `B' → C'` with `C` is `B → C`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.exists_finite_syntomic_section_lift
    {C' C B : Type u} [CommRing C'] [CommRing C] [CommRing B] [Algebra C' C] [Algebra C B]
    [IsArtinianRing C] [Nontrivial C] [Algebra.Syntomic C B] [Module.Finite C B]
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap C' C))
    (hnil : IsNilpotent (RingHom.ker (algebraMap C' C)))
    (σ : B →ₐ[C] C) :
    ∃ (B' : Type u) (_ : CommRing B') (_ : Algebra C' B'),
      Algebra.Syntomic C' B' ∧ Module.Finite C' B' ∧
        ∃ (sec : B' →ₐ[C'] C') (φ : B' →+* B),
          Function.Surjective φ ∧
          RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.map (algebraMap C' B') (RingHom.ker (algebraMap C' C)) ∧
          (∀ c : C', φ (algebraMap C' B' c) = algebraMap C B (algebraMap C' C c)) ∧
          (∀ b : B', σ (φ b) = algebraMap C' C (sec b))
declarations.comment: the deformation problem the remark reduces the smoothness of V_d over Z to, and the remark's solution of it: along a surjection C' → C with nilpotent kernel onto a nonzero artinian ring (a small extension of artinian local rings in particular) a finite syntomic C-algebra with a section lifts to a finite syntomic C'-algebra with a section whose tensor product with C recovers it, the reduction being a surjection B' → B with kernel I·B' that matches the two sections.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isPullback_universalFamily_restrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FL4.** For a finite syntomic morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` and a point `x` of
`X` in the image of `f` there are an integer `d ≥ 1`, an open `U ∋ x` with preimage
`V = f⁻¹(U)`, and a morphism `U ⟶ U_d` into the open subscheme of Tag 0FL0, for which the middle
square of the source's diagram — `V ⟶ V_d = π_d^{-1}(U_d)` over `U ⟶ U_d` — is cartesian.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isPullback_universalFamily_restrict (hf : IsFinite f ∧ Syntomic f) (x : X)
    (hx : ∃ y : Y, f.base y = x) :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (_ : NeZero d) (U : X.Opens) (_ : x ∈ U)
      (gU : U.toScheme ⟶ (universalSyntomicOpen.{u} d).toScheme)
      (q : (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme ⟶ (universalFamily.{u} d (universalAlgebraStructure d) ⁻¹ᵁ
        universalSyntomicOpen.{u} d).toScheme),
      IsPullback q (f ∣_ U)
        (universalFamily.{u} d (universalAlgebraStructure d) ∣_
          universalSyntomicOpen.{u} d) gU
declarations.comment: the diagram, at a point of the image of `f`: the integer `d`, the open `U ∋ x` with `V = f⁻¹(U)`, the morphism `U ⟶ U_d` into the open subscheme of Lemma 0FL0, and the cartesian middle square over the restriction of `π_d` of Example 0FKZ to `V_d = π_d⁻¹(U_d)`. A point outside the image of `f` is excluded, and must be: the local rank of `f` there is `0`, whereas Example 0FKZ has `d ≥ 1`, so `π_d` is surjective and no base change of it along a morphism out of a nonempty `U` has empty fibres.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isIso_relativeDifferentialFormsMap_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
In a cartesian square of schemes, the canonical map `f^*Ω^n_{X/S} ⟶ Ω^n_{X'/S'}` on relative
differential forms is an isomorphism in every degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_relativeDifferentialFormsMap_of_isPullback (H : IsPullback f p' p g) (n : ℤ) :
    IsIso (relativeDifferentialFormsMap f p p' g H.w n)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.deRhamCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Relative de Rham cohomology** `H^i_{dR}(X/S)` of a morphism of schemes: the `i`-th
cohomology of the derived global sections of the relative de Rham complex.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev deRhamCohomology (p : X ⟶ S) (i : ℤ) : AddCommGrpCat.{u}
declarations.comment: the definition `H^i_dR(X/S) = H^i(RΓ(X, Ω^•_{X/S}))`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.deRhamCohomologyBaseModule
declarations.doc:
**Relative de Rham cohomology is a module over `H^0(S, 𝒪_S)`**: the de Rham complex is a
complex of `p^{-1}𝒪_S`-modules, so its hypercohomology is a module over `Γ(X, p^{-1}𝒪_S)`, and
hence over `H^0(S, 𝒪_S)` along the unit of the inverse-image adjunction.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def deRhamCohomologyBaseModule (p : X ⟶ S) (i : ℤ) :
    ModuleCat.{u} (S.sheaf.obj.obj (Opposite.op ⊤))
declarations.comment: the `H^0(S, 𝒪_S)`-module structure on `H^i_dR(X/S)`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.deRhamDerivedSectionsPullback
declarations.doc:
**The pullback map `f^* : RΓ(X, Ω^•_{X/S}) ⟶ RΓ(X', Ω^•_{X'/S'})`** of a commutative square
of schemes: derived global sections of the canonical map of de Rham complexes, followed by the
identification of derived global sections on `X'` with derived global sections of the derived
direct image.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def deRhamDerivedSectionsPullback (hcomm : f ≫ p = p' ≫ g) :
    (sectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace.carrier ⊤).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj
          (SheafOfModules.deRhamAbelianComplexPlus (deRhamAlgebras p)
            (SheafOfModules.deRhamDifferential (deRhamAlgebras p)))) ⟶
      (sectionsFunctor X'.toRingedSpace.carrier ⊤).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj
          (SheafOfModules.deRhamAbelianComplexPlus (deRhamAlgebras p')
            (SheafOfModules.deRhamDifferential (deRhamAlgebras p'))))
declarations.comment: the pullback map `f^* : RΓ(X, Ω^•_{X/S}) ⟶ RΓ(X', Ω^•_{X'/S'})`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.deRhamCohomologyPullback
declarations.doc:
**The pullback map `f^* : H^i_{dR}(X/S) ⟶ H^i_{dR}(X'/S')`** of a commutative square of
schemes: the map induced on cohomology by the pullback map on derived global sections.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def deRhamCohomologyPullback (hcomm : f ≫ p = p' ≫ g) (i : ℤ) :
    deRhamCohomology p i ⟶ deRhamCohomology p' i
declarations.comment: the pullback map `f^* : H^i_dR(X/S) ⟶ H^i_dR(X'/S')`

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.exists_funnyMap
declarations.doc:
The top-wedge construction descends to `⋀ᵖ(L / d(M⁻¹))`, independently of both the
retraction and the basis: there is a family of maps whose value on the image of every
`η : ⋀ᵖ L` is `funnyMapLift p n r π d b η`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_funnyMap (n : ℕ)
    (i : K →ₗ[R] L) (π : L →ₗ[R] Mzero)
    (d : Mneg →ₗ[R] L) (dM : Mneg →ₗ[R] Mzero)
    (_hi : Function.Injective i) (_hexact : Function.Exact i π)
    (_hπ : Function.Surjective π) (_hsquare : π.comp d = dM)
    (_hzero : Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) R Mzero))
    (_hneg : Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) R Mneg)) :
    ∃ c : ∀ p : ℕ, (⋀[R]^p (L ⧸ LinearMap.range d)) →ₗ[R]
        (⋀[R]^p K) ⊗[R] twoTermDeterminant R n Mneg Mzero,
      ∀ (p : ℕ) (r : L →ₗ[R] K), r.comp i = LinearMap.id →
        ∀ (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R Mneg) (η : ⋀[R]^p L),
          c p (exteriorPower.map p (LinearMap.range d).mkQ η) =
            funnyMapLift p n r π d b η
declarations.comment: top-wedge construction

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.funnyMap
declarations.doc:
The canonical maps `cᵖ : ⋀ᵖ(L / d(M⁻¹)) → ⋀ᵖK ⊗ det(M⁻¹ → M⁰)` attached to the exact
two-term diagram, characterized by `funnyMap_apply_lift`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def funnyMap (n : ℕ)
    (i : K →ₗ[R] L) (π : L →ₗ[R] Mzero)
    (d : Mneg →ₗ[R] L) (dM : Mneg →ₗ[R] Mzero)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hexact : Function.Exact i π)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hsquare : π.comp d = dM)
    (hzero : Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) R Mzero))
    (hneg : Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) R Mneg)) :
    ∀ p : ℕ, (⋀[R]^p (L ⧸ LinearMap.range d)) →ₗ[R]
      (⋀[R]^p K) ⊗[R] twoTermDeterminant R n Mneg Mzero
declarations.comment: canonical maps

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.funnyMap_comp
declarations.doc:
Restricting the degree-`p` canonical map to `K` is tensoring with the determinant
element.
declarations.statement:
theorem funnyMap_comp (n p : ℕ)
    (i : K →ₗ[R] L) (π : L →ₗ[R] Mzero)
    (d : Mneg →ₗ[R] L) (dM : Mneg →ₗ[R] Mzero)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hexact : Function.Exact i π)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hsquare : π.comp d = dM)
    (hzero : Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) R Mzero))
    (hneg : Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) R Mneg)) (ω : ⋀[R]^p K) :
    funnyMap n i π d dM hi hexact hπ hsquare hzero hneg p
        (exteriorPower.map p ((LinearMap.range d).mkQ.comp i) ω) =
      ω ⊗ₜ[R] twoTermDeterminantElement R dM hneg
declarations.comment: restriction to K

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.funnyMap_zero
declarations.doc: In degree zero, the canonical map takes `1` to the determinant element.
declarations.statement:
theorem funnyMap_zero (n : ℕ)
    (i : K →ₗ[R] L) (π : L →ₗ[R] Mzero)
    (d : Mneg →ₗ[R] L) (dM : Mneg →ₗ[R] Mzero)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hexact : Function.Exact i π)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hsquare : π.comp d = dM)
    (hzero : Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) R Mzero))
    (hneg : Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) R Mneg)) :
    funnyMap n i π d dM hi hexact hπ hsquare hzero hneg 0
        (exteriorPower.ιMulti R 0 (fun j ↦ Fin.elim0 j)) =
      (exteriorPower.ιMulti R 0 (fun j ↦ Fin.elim0 j)) ⊗ₜ[R]
        twoTermDeterminantElement R dM hneg
declarations.comment: degree zero

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.funnyMap_wedge
declarations.doc: The canonical maps commute with wedging on the left by an exterior power of `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem funnyMap_wedge (n q p : ℕ)
    (i : K →ₗ[R] L) (π : L →ₗ[R] Mzero)
    (d : Mneg →ₗ[R] L) (dM : Mneg →ₗ[R] Mzero)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hexact : Function.Exact i π)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hsquare : π.comp d = dM)
    (hzero : Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) R Mzero))
    (hneg : Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) R Mneg))
    (ω : ⋀[R]^q K) (η : ⋀[R]^p (L ⧸ LinearMap.range d)) :
    funnyMap n i π d dM hi hexact hπ hsquare hzero hneg (q + p)
        (exteriorPower.wedgeMul (R := R) q p
          (exteriorPower.map q ((LinearMap.range d).mkQ.comp i) ω) η) =
      (exteriorPower.wedgeMul (R := R) q p ω).rTensor
        (twoTermDeterminant R n Mneg Mzero)
        (funnyMap n i π d dM hi hexact hπ hsquare hzero hneg p η)
declarations.comment: wedge compatibility

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.presentationFunnyMap
declarations.doc:
The canonical maps on absolute differential forms associated to a square presentation of `B`
over `A` which is a relative global complete intersection:
`Ω^p_{B⁄ℤ} → Ω^p_{A⁄ℤ} ⊗ det(NL_{B/A})`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def presentationFunnyMap (p : ℕ) :
    (⋀[B]^p Ω[B⁄ℤ]) →ₗ[B]
      (⋀[B]^p (B ⊗[A] Ω[A⁄ℤ])) ⊗[B]
        twoTermDeterminant B n P.toExtension.Cotangent P.toExtension.CotangentSpace
declarations.comment: canonical maps

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.presentationFunnyMap_zero
declarations.doc:
In degree zero the canonical map takes the unit to the determinant element of the relative
naive cotangent complex.
declarations.statement:
theorem presentationFunnyMap_zero :
    presentationFunnyMap P 0 (exteriorPower.ιMulti B 0 (fun j ↦ Fin.elim0 j)) =
      (exteriorPower.ιMulti B 0 (fun j ↦ Fin.elim0 j)) ⊗ₜ[B]
        cotangentDeterminantElement P
declarations.comment: degree zero

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.presentationFunnyMap_wedge
declarations.doc:
The canonical maps commute with wedging by a base-changed absolute differential form
on `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem presentationFunnyMap_wedge (q p : ℕ) (ω : ⋀[B]^q (B ⊗[A] Ω[A⁄ℤ]))
    (η : ⋀[B]^p Ω[B⁄ℤ]) :
    presentationFunnyMap P (q + p)
        (exteriorPower.wedgeMul (R := B) q p
          (exteriorPower.map q (KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange ℤ A B) ω) η) =
      (exteriorPower.wedgeMul (R := B) q p ω).rTensor
        (twoTermDeterminant B n P.toExtension.Cotangent P.toExtension.CotangentSpace)
        (presentationFunnyMap P p η)
declarations.comment: wedge compatibility

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.presentationFunnyMap_comp
declarations.doc:
Composing the canonical map on forms with pullback from `A` is multiplication by the
determinant element of the relative naive cotangent complex.
declarations.statement:
theorem presentationFunnyMap_comp (p : ℕ) (ω : ⋀[B]^p (B ⊗[A] Ω[A⁄ℤ])) :
    presentationFunnyMap P p
        (exteriorPower.map p (KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange ℤ A B) ω) =
      ω ⊗ₜ[B] cotangentDeterminantElement P
declarations.comment: composition with pullback

declarations.name: Algebra.isRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersection_of_quasiFinite
declarations.doc:
A quasi-finite `A`-algebra `B` admitting a presentation
`B = A[x_1, …, x_n]/(f_1, …, f_n)` by as many relations as variables is a relative global
complete intersection over `A` (Definition 00SP).
declarations.comment:
the source's `B` is a relative global complete intersection over `A`, at the level
of the algebra; the presentation-level form, which is what the rest of the remark uses, is
`Algebra.Presentation.isRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersection_of_quasiFinite`

registrations.name: Algebra.Presentation.exists_basis_cotangent_relation
registrations.comment: conormal basis

registrations.name: Stacks.DeRham.cotangentDiagram
registrations.comment: the displayed diagram itself, instantiated at a square presentation which is a relative global complete intersection: the short exact sequence 0 -> B (x)_A Omega_{A/Z} -> B (x)_P Omega_{P/Z} -> Omega_{P/A} (x)_P B -> 0 of B-modules whose outer terms are free of rank n, the two-term complex out of the conormal module into it, the commuting square identifying that complex with the cotangent complex of the presentation, and the identification of the cokernel with Omega_{B/Z} under which the base-change map from Omega_{A/Z} becomes the quotient map. The type of such diagrams is the structure Stacks.DeRham.CotangentDiagram; this is the witness, so the diagram is exhibited and not just described

registrations.name: Algebra.Presentation.isRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersection_of_quasiFinite
registrations.comment: the relative global complete intersection: the source's `A → B` quasi-finite is `Algebra.QuasiFinite A B`, which for an algebra with a finite presentation is its Definition 00PL, and `B = A[x_1, …, x_n]/(f_1, …, f_n)` is a presentation with `Nat.card σ = Nat.card ι`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GarelRule.existsUnique_isNormalized_isMultiplicative_isCompatible
declarations.doc:
There exists a unique rule that to every locally quasi-finite syntomic morphism of schemes
`f : Y ⟶ X` assigns `𝒪_Y`-module maps
`c^p_{Y/X} : Ω^p_{Y/ℤ} ⟶ f^*Ω^p_{X/ℤ} ⊗_{𝒪_Y} det(NL_{Y/X})` for `p ≥ 0` satisfying (0H9C),
(0H9D) and (0H9E). In particular, the composition of `c^p_{Y/X}` with
`f^*Ω^p_{X/ℤ} ⟶ Ω^p_{Y/ℤ}` is multiplication by `δ(NL_{Y/X})`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_isNormalized_isMultiplicative_isCompatible :
    (∃! c : GarelRule.{u}, c.IsNormalized ∧ c.IsMultiplicative ∧ c.IsCompatible) ∧
      ∀ c : GarelRule.{u}, c.IsNormalized → c.IsMultiplicative → c.IsCompatible →
        ∀ ⦃X Y : Scheme.{u}⦄ (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : Syntomic f) (hq : LocallyQuasiFinite f) (p : ℕ),
          f.absoluteFormsMap p ≫ c f hf hq p =
            (ρ_ (f.pullbackForms p)).inv ≫ (f.pullbackForms p ◁
              Scheme.Modules.globalSectionHom (f.detNL hf) (haveI := hq; f.deltaNL hf))
declarations.comment: the unique rule c^p_{Y/X} satisfying 0H9C, 0H9D and 0H9E, and its composition with f^*Ω^p_{X/Z} → Ω^p_{Y/Z} is multiplication by δ(NL_{Y/X})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.existsUnique_formsTraceRule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Lemma 0FLB.** There exists a unique rule that to every finite syntomic morphism of
schemes `f : Y ⟶ X` assigns `𝒪_X`-module maps `Θ^p_{Y/X} : f_*Ω^p_{Y/ℤ} ⟶ Ω^p_{X/ℤ}` such that
(1) the composition with `Ω^p_{X/ℤ} ⊗_{𝒪_X} f_*𝒪_Y → f_*Ω^p_{Y/ℤ}` is `id ⊗ Trace_f`
(`FormsTraceRule.IsTrace`, on local sections `ω ⊗ b ↦ b · f^*ω`), and (2) the rule is compatible
with base change (`FormsTraceRule.IsBaseChange`). The rule is `formsTraceRule`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_formsTraceRule :
    ∃! Θ : FormsTraceRule.{u}, Θ.IsTrace ∧ Θ.IsBaseChange

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.formsTrace_isComplexMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Proposition 0FLC.** Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a finite syntomic morphism of schemes. The
maps `Θ^p_{Y/X} : f_*Ω^p_{Y/ℤ} ⟶ Ω^p_{X/ℤ}` of Lemma 0FLB (`formsTrace`, the rule
`formsTraceRule` of `existsUnique_formsTraceRule`) define a map of complexes
`f_*Ω^•_{Y/ℤ} ⟶ Ω^•_{X/ℤ}`: on every open `U` of `X`, `Θ^{p+1}(dη) = d Θ^p(η)`. Moreover:

1. in degree `0` it is `Trace_f : f_*𝒪_Y ⟶ 𝒪_X`, through `Ω^0 ≅ 𝒪` on both sides;
2. `Θ(ω ∧ η) = ω ∧ Θ(η)` for local sections `ω` of `Ω^q_{X/ℤ}` and `η` of `f_*Ω^p_{Y/ℤ}`
   (`ω` acting on `f_*Ω^•_{Y/ℤ}` through `f^*`);
3. if `f` is a morphism over a base scheme `S`, i.e. for every `g : X ⟶ S`, the maps `Θ^p_{Y/X}`
   induce maps `f_*Ω^p_{Y/S} ⟶ Ω^p_{X/S}` (compatible with `Θ^p_{Y/X}` through the canonical
   surjections `Ω^p_{·/ℤ} → Ω^p_{·/S}`) forming a map of complexes.
declarations.statement:
theorem formsTrace_isComplexMap :
    haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.flat hf
    haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.locallyOfFinitePresentation hf
    -- a map of complexes
    (∀ (p : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (η : Γ(absoluteDifferentialForms Y p, f ⁻¹ᵁ U)),
      (f.formsTrace hf (p + 1)).app U
          ((Y.toSpecZ.deRhamComplex.d p (p + 1)).val.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)) η) =
        (X.toSpecZ.deRhamComplex.d p (p + 1)).val.app (op U) ((f.formsTrace hf p).app U η)) ∧
    -- (1) degree zero is the trace
    f.formsTrace hf 0 ≫ (relativeDifferentialFormsZeroIso X.toSpecZ).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (relativeDifferentialFormsZeroIso Y.toSpecZ).hom ≫
        f.finiteTrace ∧
    -- (2) linearity over the forms of `X`
    (∀ (q p : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (ω : Γ(absoluteDifferentialForms X q, U))
      (η : Γ(absoluteDifferentialForms Y p, f ⁻¹ᵁ U)),
      (f.formsTrace hf (q + p)).app U
          ((eqToHom (congrArg (absoluteDifferentialForms Y) (Nat.cast_add q p).symm)).val.app
            (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)) (((absoluteDifferentialFormsAlgebra Y).mul q p).app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ U))
              (f.absoluteFormsPullback q U ω) η)) =
        (eqToHom (congrArg (absoluteDifferentialForms X) (Nat.cast_add q p).symm)).val.app (op U)
          (((absoluteDifferentialFormsAlgebra X).mul q p).app (op U) ω
            ((f.formsTrace hf p).app U η))) ∧
    -- (3) the relative version over a base
    (∀ {S : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ S), ∃ ΘS : ∀ p : ℕ,
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (relativeDifferentialForms (f ≫ g) p) ⟶
          relativeDifferentialForms g p,
      (∀ p : ℕ, (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map ((f ≫ g).absoluteToRelativeFormsMap p) ≫
          ΘS p = f.formsTrace hf p ≫ g.absoluteToRelativeFormsMap p) ∧
      ∀ (p : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (η : Γ(relativeDifferentialForms (f ≫ g) p, f ⁻¹ᵁ U)),
        (ΘS (p + 1)).app U (((f ≫ g).deRhamComplex.d p (p + 1)).val.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)) η) =
          (g.deRhamComplex.d p (p + 1)).val.app (op U) ((ΘS p).app U η))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.formsTrace_app_top_eq_frameTrace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Example 0FLD: the map `Θ_{B/A}` is the one of Proposition 0FLC.** Let `B` have a
power basis of positive dimension over `A`, for instance `B = A[x]/(f)` with `f` monic of degree
`d ≥ 1`. Then `Spec B → Spec A` is finite syntomic (`isFinite_specMap_of_powerBasis`,
`syntomic_specMap_of_powerBasis`), and on global sections the map of de Rham complexes
`Θ_{Spec B/Spec A}` given by `Scheme.Hom.formsTrace` is the trace map `Θ_{B/A} = frameTrace A B`
on the forms of `B`: the global section of `Ω^p_{Spec B/ℤ}` corresponding to a `p`-form `x` of `B`
goes to the global section of `Ω^p_{Spec A/ℤ}` corresponding to `Θ_{B/A}(x)` (with `A`, `B`
identified with their rings of global sections by the canonical isomorphisms).
declarations.statement:
theorem formsTrace_app_top_eq_frameTrace (pb : PowerBasis A B) (hdim : 0 < pb.dim)
    [Algebra A Γ(Spec (.of A), ⊤)]
    [Algebra B Γ(Spec (.of B), Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)]
    (hA : algebraMap A Γ(Spec (.of A), ⊤) = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv.hom)
    (hB : algebraMap B Γ(Spec (.of B), Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv.hom)
    (p : ℕ) (x : ⋀[B]^p Ω[B⁄ℤ]) :
    haveI := isFinite_specMap_of_powerBasis pb
    Scheme.absoluteFormsSectionsEquiv (Spec (.of A)) (isAffineOpen_top _) p
        (((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))).formsTrace
            (syntomic_specMap_of_powerBasis pb) p).app ⊤
          ((Scheme.absoluteFormsSectionsEquiv (Spec (.of B))
              ((isAffineOpen_top _).preimage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))))
                p).symm
            (formsMap B Γ(Spec (.of B), Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) p
              x))) =
      formsMap A Γ(Spec (.of A), ⊤) p (frameTrace A B p x)
declarations.comment: the map `Θ_{B/A} : Ω^•_B → Ω^•_A` of the example is the map of Proposition 0FLC for `Spec B → Spec A` on global sections

declarations.name: Stacks.FormsTrace.frameTrace_oneForm_D_root
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Example 0FLD: `Θ(dt) = -da₁`.** Let `f = x^d + ∑_{0 ≤ i < d} a_{d - i} x^i` with
`d ≥ 1`, let `B ≅ A[x]/(f)` and let `t ∈ B` be the image of `x`. Then the trace map
`Θ_{B/A} : Ω^•_B → Ω^•_A` of Proposition 0FLC sends `dt` to `-da₁`.
declarations.statement:
theorem frameTrace_oneForm_D_root (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (e : AdjoinRoot (monicOfCoefficients d a) ≃ₐ[A] B) :
    frameTrace A B 1
        (oneForm B Ω[B⁄ℤ] (D ℤ B (e (AdjoinRoot.root (monicOfCoefficients d a))))) =
      oneForm A Ω[A⁄ℤ] (-D ℤ A (a 1))
declarations.comment: `Θ(dt) = -da₁`

declarations.name: Stacks.FormsTrace.frameTrace_root_smul_oneForm_D_root
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Example 0FLD: `Θ(t dt) = a₁ da₁ - da₂`.** Let `f = x^d + ∑_{0 ≤ i < d} a_{d - i} x^i`
with `d ≥ 2`, let `B ≅ A[x]/(f)` and let `t ∈ B` be the image of `x`. Then the trace map
`Θ_{B/A}` of Proposition 0FLC sends `t dt` to `a₁ da₁ - da₂`.
declarations.statement:
theorem frameTrace_root_smul_oneForm_D_root (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (e : AdjoinRoot (monicOfCoefficients d a) ≃ₐ[A] B) :
    frameTrace A B 1 (e (AdjoinRoot.root (monicOfCoefficients d a)) •
        oneForm B Ω[B⁄ℤ] (D ℤ B (e (AdjoinRoot.root (monicOfCoefficients d a))))) =
      oneForm A Ω[A⁄ℤ] (a 1 • D ℤ A (a 1) - D ℤ A (a 2))
declarations.comment: `Θ(t dt) = a₁ da₁ - da₂`

declarations.name: Stacks.FormsTrace.frameTrace_root_sq_smul_oneForm_D_root
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Example 0FLD: `Θ(t² dt) = -a₁² da₁ + a₁ da₂ + a₂ da₁ - da₃`.** Let
`f = x^d + ∑_{0 ≤ i < d} a_{d - i} x^i` with `d ≥ 3`, let `B ≅ A[x]/(f)` and let `t ∈ B` be the
image of `x`. Then the trace map `Θ_{B/A}` of Proposition 0FLC sends `t² dt` to
`-a₁² da₁ + a₁ da₂ + a₂ da₁ - da₃` (and the source's "modulo calculation error" is not needed).
declarations.statement:
theorem frameTrace_root_sq_smul_oneForm_D_root (hd : 3 ≤ d)
    (e : AdjoinRoot (monicOfCoefficients d a) ≃ₐ[A] B) :
    frameTrace A B 1 (e (AdjoinRoot.root (monicOfCoefficients d a)) ^ 2 •
        oneForm B Ω[B⁄ℤ] (D ℤ B (e (AdjoinRoot.root (monicOfCoefficients d a))))) =
      oneForm A Ω[A⁄ℤ] (-(a 1 ^ 2 • D ℤ A (a 1)) + a 1 • D ℤ A (a 2) + a 2 • D ℤ A (a 1) -
        D ℤ A (a 3))
declarations.comment: `Θ(t² dt) = -a₁² da₁ + a₁ da₂ + a₂ da₁ - da₃`

declarations.name: Stacks.FormsTrace.frameTrace_root_pow_smul_oneForm_D_root_X_pow_sub_C
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Example 0FLD: for `f = x^d - a`, `Θ(t^i dt) = 0` for `i = 0, …, d - 2`.** Let
`B ≅ A[x]/(x^d - a)` with `d ≥ 1` and let `t ∈ B` be the image of `x`. Then the trace map
`Θ_{B/A}` of Proposition 0FLC kills `t^i dt` for `i + 1 < d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem frameTrace_root_pow_smul_oneForm_D_root_X_pow_sub_C
    (e : AdjoinRoot (Polynomial.X ^ d - C a) ≃ₐ[A] B) {i : ℕ} (hi : i + 1 < d) :
    frameTrace A B 1 (e (AdjoinRoot.root (Polynomial.X ^ d - C a)) ^ i •
        oneForm B Ω[B⁄ℤ] (D ℤ B (e (AdjoinRoot.root (Polynomial.X ^ d - C a))))) = 0
declarations.comment: for `f = x^d - a`: `Θ(t^i dt) = 0` for `i = 0, …, d - 2`

declarations.name: Stacks.FormsTrace.frameTrace_root_pow_pred_smul_oneForm_D_root_X_pow_sub_C
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Example 0FLD: for `f = x^d - a`, `Θ(t^{d-1} dt) = da`.** Let `B ≅ A[x]/(x^d - a)`
with `d ≥ 1` and let `t ∈ B` be the image of `x`. Then the trace map `Θ_{B/A}` of
Proposition 0FLC sends `t^{d-1} dt` to `da`.
declarations.statement:
theorem frameTrace_root_pow_pred_smul_oneForm_D_root_X_pow_sub_C
    (e : AdjoinRoot (Polynomial.X ^ d - C a) ≃ₐ[A] B) :
    frameTrace A B 1 (e (AdjoinRoot.root (Polynomial.X ^ d - C a)) ^ (d - 1) •
        oneForm B Ω[B⁄ℤ] (D ℤ B (e (AdjoinRoot.root (Polynomial.X ^ d - C a))))) =
      oneForm A Ω[A⁄ℤ] (D ℤ A a)
declarations.comment: for `f = x^d - a`: `Θ(t^{d-1} dt) = da`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.logarithmicDifferentialComplexMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FLE.** **Logarithmic differentiation as a morphism of complexes of
abelian sheaves** `𝒪_X^*[-1] ⟶ Ω^•_{𝒪_X/A}`. There is a single condition to check, that
`d log u` is closed, and it is
`AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.d_logarithmicDifferentialAbelian`.
declarations.statement: def logarithmicDifferentialComplexMap : unitsComplex X ⟶ deRhamAbelianComplexInt B D
declarations.comment: d log as a map of complexes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.deRhamFirstChernClassAbelian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FLE.** **The first Chern class in relative de Rham cohomology**, in
the abelian-sheaf realization: the image of a Picard class under the map on degree-two
hypercohomology induced by logarithmic differentiation `𝒪_X^*[-1] ⟶ Ω^•_{𝒪_X/A}`.
declarations.comment: the de Rham first Chern class

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.hodgeFirstChernClassAbelian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FLE.** **The first Chern class in Hodge cohomology**
`c₁^{Hodge} : Pic(X) ⟶ H¹(X, Ω¹_{𝒪_X/A})`, in the abelian-sheaf realization: the identification
`Pic(X) = H¹(X, 𝒪_X^*)` of Stacks Tag 09NU followed by the map on first cohomology induced by
logarithmic differentiation `𝒪_X^* ⟶ Ω¹_{𝒪_X/A}`.

The construction is the one of `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.hodgeFirstChernClass`, carried out
for a ringed space over a base ring sheaf rather than for a morphism of schemes — the two use
the same functor `(Γ(X, -)).rightDerived 1` and the same `d log`, but different spellings of the
identification of Tag 09NU, and no comparison between them is proved here. This realization is
the one the first step of the Hodge filtration projects onto, in
`AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.hodgeFirstChernClassAbelian_eq`.
declarations.comment: the Hodge first Chern class, for a ringed space over a base ring sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.logarithmicDifferentialSheafHom
declarations.doc:
**Logarithmic differentiation as a morphism of sheaves of abelian groups**
`𝒪_X^* ⟶ Ω_{X/S}`, the sheaf of units being written additively.
declarations.statement:
def logarithmicDifferentialSheafHom :
    unitsSheaf X.toRingedSpace ⟶ relativeDifferentialsAbelian p
declarations.comment: d log into the sheaf of relative differentials

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.hodgeFirstChernClass
declarations.doc:
**The first Chern class in Hodge cohomology** `c₁^{Hodge} : Pic(X) ⟶ H¹(X, Ω_{X/S})`: the
identification `Pic(X) = H¹(X, 𝒪_X^*)` of Stacks Tag 09NU followed by the map on first cohomology
induced by logarithmic differentiation.
declarations.statement:
def hodgeFirstChernClass {X S : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ S) :
    Stacks.Picard.ofScheme X →+ hodgeCohomologyOne p
declarations.comment: the Hodge first Chern class

declarations.name: KaehlerDifferential.relativeTraceComplex_trace_eq_higherTraceComplexMap
declarations.doc:
**Tr = Θ_{S/R}.**  Let `𝐅_p ⊂ Λ ⊂ R ⊂ S` with `S ≅ R[x]/(x ^ p - a)`, and let `f` be any
frame of `S/R` (for instance the monogenic one, `KaehlerDifferential.rootExtFrame`; the trace maps
do not depend on it).  The map of relative de Rham complexes `Θ_{S/R} : Ω^•_{S/Λ} ⟶ Ω^•_{R/Λ}`
induced by the trace maps on absolute forms of Proposition 0FLC is the map built from the trace
`Tr` of Lemma 0AX5.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeTraceComplex_trace_eq_higherTraceComplexMap (hp : p.Prime) [CharP Λ p] (a : R)
    (e : AdjoinRoot (Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.C a) ≃ₐ[R] S) {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (f : ChartFrame d R S) :
    relativeTraceComplex Λ f.trace f.isWedgeLinear_trace f.commutesWithD_trace =
      higherTraceComplexMap hp a e
declarations.comment: Tr = Θ_{S/R}, for Θ_{S/R} the map of relative de Rham complexes induced (0FLC (3)) by the trace maps on absolute forms of the framed algebra S/R

declarations.name: HomologicalComplex₂.totalShift₁₂Iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FLG**, the inverse of the tag's `γ : Tot(A)[a + b] → Tot(A[a, b])`: the composite
of Mathlib's `totalShift₁Iso a` on `A[0, b]` and `totalShift₂Iso b` on `A`. On the summand
`A^{p, q}` it is `(-1)^{pb}`, the tag's sign; see `ι_totalShift₁₂Iso_hom_f`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def totalShift₁₂Iso :
    ((shiftFunctor₂ C y ⋙ shiftFunctor₁ C x).obj K).total (up ℤ) ≅ (K.total (up ℤ))⟦x + y⟧
declarations.comment: the tag's `γ` for a general `[a, b]`, inverted to run in Mathlib's direction

declarations.name: HomologicalComplex₂.ι_totalShift₁₂Iso_hom_f
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FLG**, the sign of `γ⁻¹`: on the summand `A^{p, q}` of `Tot(A[a, b])`, which is
the summand `A^{p + a, q + b}` of `A`, it is `(-1)^{(p + a) b}`.
declarations.statement:
lemma ι_totalShift₁₂Iso_hom_f (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (p' : ℤ) (hp' : p' = p + x)
    (q' : ℤ) (hq' : q' = q + y) (n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' = n + (x + y)) :
    ((shiftFunctor₂ C y ⋙ shiftFunctor₁ C x).obj K).ιTotal (up ℤ) p q n h ≫
        (K.totalShift₁₂Iso x y).hom.f n =
      (p' * y).negOnePow • (((shiftFunctor₂ C y).obj K).shiftFunctor₁XXIso p x p' hp' q).hom ≫
        (K.shiftFunctor₂XXIso p' q y q' hq').hom ≫ K.ιTotal (up ℤ) p' q' n' (by dsimp; lia) ≫
          (CochainComplex.shiftFunctorObjXIso (K.total (up ℤ)) (x + y) n n' hn').inv
declarations.comment: the sign of `γ⁻¹`: `(-1)^{pb}` on the summand `A^{p, q}` of `Tot(A)`

declarations.name: HomologicalComplex₂.ι_totalShift₁₂Iso_inv_f
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FLG**, the tag's `γ : Tot(A)[a + b] → Tot(A[a, b])` itself: on the summand
`A^{p', q'}` of `Tot(A)[a + b]` it is `(-1)^{p' b}` times the identification of `A^{p', q'}` with
the summand `(A[a, b])^{p, q}`, where `p' = p + a` and `q' = q + b`.
declarations.statement:
lemma ι_totalShift₁₂Iso_inv_f (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (p' : ℤ) (hp' : p' = p + x)
    (q' : ℤ) (hq' : q' = q + y) (n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' = n + (x + y)) :
    K.ιTotal (up ℤ) p' q' n' (by dsimp; lia) ≫
        (CochainComplex.shiftFunctorObjXIso (K.total (up ℤ)) (x + y) n n' hn').inv ≫
          (K.totalShift₁₂Iso x y).inv.f n =
      (p' * y).negOnePow • (K.shiftFunctor₂XXIso p' q y q' hq').inv ≫
        (((shiftFunctor₂ C y).obj K).shiftFunctor₁XXIso p x p' hp' q).inv ≫
          ((shiftFunctor₂ C y ⋙ shiftFunctor₁ C x).obj K).ιTotal (up ℤ) p q n h
declarations.comment: the tag's `γ`: `ε(p, q, a, b) = (-1)^{pb}` on the summand `A^{p, q}`

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.isIso_cechToDerivedGlobalSections_app
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FLH]** Let `(X, O_X)` be a ringed space, let `U : I → Opens X` be an open
covering of `X` and let `K^•` be a bounded below complex of `O_X`-modules with
`H^i(U_{i_0 … i_p}, K^q) = 0` for all `i > 0`, all tuples `i_0, …, i_p` of members of the
covering, and all degrees `q`. Then the comparison map `Tot(Č^•(U, K^•)) ⟶ RΓ(X, K^•)` of
Tag 08BN is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_cechToDerivedGlobalSections_app
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u}) (hU : ⊤ = iSup U)
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus (SheafOfModules.{u} R))
    (hacyclic : ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : Fin (n + 1) → I) (q : ℤ) (i : ℕ), 0 < i →
      IsZero (((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} R
        (op (⨅ k, U (s k)))).rightDerived i).obj (K.1.X q))) :
    IsIso (((cechToDerivedGlobalSections X R).map U hU).app K)
declarations.comment:
the vanishing condition is the one of Tag 01ET: the higher right derived
functors of sections over each intersection vanish on each term of the complex

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.FilteredComplex.exists_filteredKInjectiveResolution_stupidTruncation_iso_cartanEilenbergFirst
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FLK, the bounded below case.** Let `F^•` be a bounded below complex of
`O_X`-modules. Then

1. the spectral sequence of [Stacks, Tag 0BKK] for the brutal truncation filtration
   `σ_{≥ p}F^•` can be constructed through Remark [Stacks, Tag 0BKL]: there is a filtered
   K-injective resolution `R` of `σ_{≥ •}F^•` which is bounded below, has a filtration finite in
   every degree and is filtered injective in every degree;
2. its spectral sequence `R.spectralSequence` (the 0BKK spectral sequence) has
   `E_1^{p, q} = H^{p + q}(X, F^p[-p]) = H^q(X, F^p)`, is bounded and converges to
   `H^{i + j}(X, F^•)`;
3. it is isomorphic to the first spectral sequence of [Stacks, Tag 015J] of every
   Cartan-Eilenberg resolution of `F^•`.

Clause 2 holds for every filtered K-injective resolution of `σ_{≥ •}F^•`, by
`stupidTruncation_filteredKInjectiveResolution_spectralSequence`, and is restated here for the
resolution of clause 1.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_filteredKInjectiveResolution_stupidTruncation_iso_cartanEilenbergFirst
    (F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) ℤ) (a : ℤ)
    (hF : F.IsStrictlyGE a)
    (RΓ : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} ((structureSheafRing X).obj.obj (op ⊤))))
    (α : Stacks.Cohomology.HypercohomologyEdge.HomologyComparison.homotopySections
      (structureSheafRing X) (⊤ : Opens X.carrier) ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RΓ)
    (hRΓ : RΓ.IsRightDerivedFunctor α
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) :
    ∃ R : FilteredKInjectiveResolution X (CochainComplex.stupidTruncationFiltration F),
      R.obj.X.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ R.obj.filtration.IsDegreewiseFinite ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (CochainComplex.evalFil R.obj n).IsFilteredInjective) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty ((R.spectralSequence.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, q) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (ModuleCat.{u} ((structureSheafRing X).obj.obj (op ⊤))) (p + q)).obj
          (RΓ.obj (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) 0).obj (F.X p))⟦(-p : ℤ)⟧)))) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty ((R.spectralSequence.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, q) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (ModuleCat.{u} ((structureSheafRing X).obj.obj (op ⊤))) q).obj
          (RΓ.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) 0).obj (F.X p))))) ∧
      IsBounded R.spectralSequence ∧
      SpectralSequence.AbutsTo R.spectralSequence (fun n => hypercohomology X RΓ F n) ∧
      ∀ I : F.CartanEilenbergResolution,
        Nonempty (R.spectralSequence ≅ cartanEilenbergFirstSpectralSequence X I)
declarations.comment: bounded below: the 0BKK spectral sequence of a filtered K-injective resolution of (F, σ_{≥p}F) built via Remark 0BKL has E_1^{p, q} = H^{p + q}(X, F^p[-p]) = H^q(X, F^p), is bounded, converges to H^{p + q}(X, F), and is isomorphic to the first spectral sequence (Tag 015J) of every Cartan-Eilenberg resolution of F

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.FilteredComplex.stupidTruncation_filteredKInjectiveResolution_spectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FLK.** Let `F^•` be a complex of `O_X`-modules on a ringed space `X`, filtered by
its brutal truncations `F^pF^• = σ_{≥ p}F^•`. This filtered complex has a filtered K-injective
resolution, and for *every* filtered K-injective resolution `R` of it the spectral sequence of
[Stacks, Tag 0BKK] it computes (`R.spectralSequence`) has
`E_1^{p, q} = H^{p + q}(X, F^p[-p]) = H^q(X, F^p)`, the cohomology being taken with respect to any
right-derived global-sections functor `RΓ`. If `F^•` is bounded below, this spectral sequence is
bounded and converges to `H^{i + j}(X, F^•)`.

The remaining bounded below assertions of the tag, that the sequence can be built through Remark
[Stacks, Tag 0BKL] and that it is the first spectral sequence of [Stacks, Tag 015J], are
`exists_filteredKInjectiveResolution_stupidTruncation_iso_cartanEilenbergFirst`.
declarations.statement:
theorem stupidTruncation_filteredKInjectiveResolution_spectralSequence (X : RingedSpace.{u, u})
    (F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) ℤ)
    (RΓ : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} ((structureSheafRing X).obj.obj (op ⊤))))
    (α : homotopySections (structureSheafRing X) (⊤ : Opens X.carrier) ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RΓ)
    (hRΓ : RΓ.IsRightDerivedFunctor α
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) :
    Nonempty (FilteredKInjectiveResolution X (CochainComplex.stupidTruncationFiltration F)) ∧
    ∀ R : FilteredKInjectiveResolution X (CochainComplex.stupidTruncationFiltration F),
      (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty ((R.spectralSequence.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, q) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (ModuleCat.{u} ((structureSheafRing X).obj.obj (op ⊤))) (p + q)).obj
          (RΓ.obj (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) 0).obj (F.X p))⟦(-p : ℤ)⟧)))) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty ((R.spectralSequence.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, q) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (ModuleCat.{u} ((structureSheafRing X).obj.obj (op ⊤))) q).obj
          (RΓ.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) 0).obj (F.X p))))) ∧
      ∀ a : ℤ, F.IsStrictlyGE a →
        IsBounded R.spectralSequence ∧
        SpectralSequence.AbutsTo R.spectralSequence (fun n => hypercohomology X RΓ F n)
declarations.comment: for the spectral sequence of 0BKK computed by any filtered K-injective resolution of (F, σ_{≥p}F): existence of the resolution, E_1^{p, q} = H^{p + q}(X, F^p[-p]) = H^q(X, F^p), and, for F bounded below, boundedness and convergence to H^{p + q}(X, F). The construction via Remark 0BKL and the comparison with Tag 015J are exists_filteredKInjectiveResolution_stupidTruncation_iso_cartanEilenbergFirst

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.FilteredComplex.relativeSpectralSequence_of_filteredKInjectiveResolution
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FLL**, the first page and the conditional bounded convergence, for a supplied
filtered K-injective resolution. The right-derived pushforward, its unit and the resolution are
fixed inputs, so all of the conclusions concern these same data.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeSpectralSequence_of_filteredKInjectiveResolution
    (hRf : Rf.IsRightDerivedFunctor η
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (j : K ⟶ J)
    (hj : QuasiIso j.hom)
    (hjStep : ∀ p : ℤ, QuasiIso (j.natTrans.app (op p)))
    (hjGraded : ∀ p : ℤ, QuasiIso ((FilteredObject.gr p).map j))
    (hStepInjective : ∀ p n : ℤ, Injective ((J.filtration.obj (op p)).X n))
    (hKInjective : J.X.IsKInjective)
    (hStepKInjective : ∀ p : ℤ, (J.filtration.obj (op p)).IsKInjective)
    (hGradedKInjective : ∀ p : ℤ, ((FilteredObject.gr p).obj J).IsKInjective) :
    let E := pushforwardSpectralSequence f J
    (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty
      ((E.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, q) ≅
        higherDirectImage (X := X) (Y := Y) Rf ((FilteredObject.gr p).obj K) (p + q))) ∧
      ((∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₀ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p₀ ≤ p →
          IsZero (higherDirectImage Rf (K.filtration.obj (op p)) n)) →
        (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₁ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p ≤ p₁ →
          IsIso (higherDirectImageMap Rf (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)) →
        (∀ n : ℤ, {p : ℤ | ¬ IsZero ((E.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, n - p))}.Finite) ∧
          ∃ (F : ∀ n : ℤ, ℤ → Subobject (higherDirectImage Rf K.X n))
            (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, Antitone (F n)),
            (∀ n p : ℤ, F n p = imageSubobject
              (higherDirectImageMap Rf (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)) ∧
            (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ F n a = ⊤ ∧ F n b = ⊥) ∧
            (∀ p q : ℤ, E.HasPageInfinityAt (p, q)) ∧
            ∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty
              (E.pageInfinity (p, q) ≅
                cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (F (p + q) (p + 1)) (F (p + q) p)
                  (hF (p + q) (by omega)))))
declarations.comment: computation by a supplied filtered K-injective resolution

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.FilteredComplex.exists_relativeSpectralSequence_of_filteredComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FLL.** A filtered complex of `O_X`-modules has a canonical cohomological spectral
sequence of `O_Y`-modules, with `d_r` of bidegree `(r, -r + 1)`, whose first page is
`E_1^{p, q} = R^{p + q}f_*gr^pF^•`. If for every `n` the higher direct image
`R^nf_*F^pF^•` vanishes for `p ≫ 0` and maps isomorphically to `R^nf_*F^•` for `p ≪ 0`, the
spectral sequence is bounded and converges to `R^*f_*F^•`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_relativeSpectralSequence_of_filteredComplex :
    ∃ (Rf : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y)))
      (η : homotopyPushforward f ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Rf),
      Rf.IsRightDerivedFunctor η
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ∧
      ∃ (J : CochainComplex.Filtered (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))) (j : K ⟶ J),
      QuasiIso j.hom ∧
      (∀ p : ℤ, QuasiIso (j.natTrans.app (op p))) ∧
      (∀ p : ℤ, QuasiIso ((FilteredObject.gr p).map j)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Injective (J.X.X n)) ∧
      (∀ p n : ℤ, Injective ((J.filtration.obj (op p)).X n)) ∧
      (∀ p n : ℤ, Injective (((FilteredObject.gr p).obj J).X n)) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty
        (((pushforwardSpectralSequence f J).page 1 (by omega)).X (p, q) ≅
          higherDirectImage (X := X) (Y := Y) Rf ((FilteredObject.gr p).obj K) (p + q))) ∧
      ((∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₀ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p₀ ≤ p →
          IsZero (higherDirectImage Rf (K.filtration.obj (op p)) n)) →
        (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₁ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p ≤ p₁ →
          IsIso (higherDirectImageMap Rf (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)) →
        (∀ n : ℤ, {p : ℤ | ¬ IsZero
          (((pushforwardSpectralSequence f J).page 1 (by omega)).X (p, n - p))}.Finite) ∧
          ∃ (F : ∀ n : ℤ, ℤ → Subobject (higherDirectImage Rf K.X n))
            (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, Antitone (F n)),
            (∀ n p : ℤ, F n p = imageSubobject
              (higherDirectImageMap Rf (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)) ∧
            (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ F n a = ⊤ ∧ F n b = ⊥) ∧
            (∀ p q : ℤ, (pushforwardSpectralSequence f J).HasPageInfinityAt (p, q)) ∧
            ∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty
              ((pushforwardSpectralSequence f J).pageInfinity (p, q) ≅
                cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (F (p + q) (p + 1)) (F (p + q) p)
                  (hF (p + q) (by omega)))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFlatOver_pushforward_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FLM.** A quasi-coherent module on the source of an affine morphism is
flat over a base scheme if and only if its direct image is.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFlatOver_pushforward_iff {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S)
    [IsAffineHom f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    IsFlatOver (f ≫ g).toLRSHom.toShHom F ↔
      IsFlatOver g.toLRSHom.toShHom ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedKunneth.kunnethMap
declarations.doc:
**The relative Künneth morphism**
`Ra_*K ⊗^L_{𝒪_S} Rb_*M ⟶ Rf_*(Lp^*K ⊗^L_{𝒪_W} Lq^*M)`, Equation 36.23.0.1: the adjoint
transpose of the monoidality isomorphism of Stacks 079U for `Lf^*` followed by the tensor
product of the two counit legs.  It is defined for arbitrary `K ∈ D(𝒪_X)` and `M ∈ D(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
def kunnethMap
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)))
    (M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y))) :
    ((Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor S.sheaf).obj
          ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward a).obj K)).obj
        ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward b).obj M) ⟶
      (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward f).obj
        (((Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor W.sheaf).obj
            ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback p).obj K)).obj
          ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback q).obj M))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedKunneth.kunnethMap_natural_left
declarations.doc: The relative Künneth morphism is natural in the derived module on `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem kunnethMap_natural_left
    {K K' : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))}
    (k : K ⟶ K')
    (M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y))) :
    ((Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor S.sheaf).map
          ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward a).map k)).app
        ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward b).obj M) ≫
        kunnethMap a b p q f hp hq K' M =
      kunnethMap a b p q f hp hq K M ≫
        (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward f).map
          (((Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor W.sheaf).map
              ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback p).map k)).app
            ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback q).obj M))
declarations.comment: naturality in the complex on the first factor

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedKunneth.kunnethMap_natural_right
declarations.doc: The relative Künneth morphism is natural in the derived module on `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem kunnethMap_natural_right
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)))
    {M M' : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y))}
    (m : M ⟶ M') :
    ((Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor S.sheaf).obj
          ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward a).obj K)).map
        ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward b).map m) ≫
        kunnethMap a b p q f hp hq K M' =
      kunnethMap a b p q f hp hq K M ≫
        (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward f).map
          (((Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor W.sheaf).obj
              ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback p).obj K)).map
            ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback q).map m))
declarations.comment: naturality in the complex on the second factor

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedKunneth.isIso_kunnethMapScheme
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FLQ], the relative conclusion, with no hypothesis beyond the tag's own.**
Let `a : X ⟶ S` and `b : Y ⟶ S` be quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphisms of schemes with
`X` and `Y` Tor independent over `S`, let `W = X ×_S Y` with projections `p` and `q`, and let
`K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and `M ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.  Then the relative Künneth morphism of
[Stacks, Tag 0FLP]

`Ra_*K ⊗^𝐋_{𝒪_S} Rb_*M ⟶ R(p ≫ a)_*(Lp^*K ⊗^𝐋_{𝒪_W} Lq^*M)`

is an isomorphism.

This is `isIso_kunnethMap_pullback_of_torIndependent_of_baseChange` with its one remaining
carried proposition discharged against the proved [Stacks, Tag 08IB].  All three comparisons the
source's proof chains together are now proved in this library: `hproj₁` and `hproj₂` from
[Stacks, Tag 08EU], with the interchanged-order conjugation supplied by the proved braiding
compatibility of [Stacks, Tag 079U], and `hbase` from [Stacks, Tag 08IB].
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_kunnethMapScheme
    [QuasiCompact a] [QuasiSeparated a] [QuasiCompact b] [QuasiSeparated b]
    (hTor : TorIndependent a b)
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (M : DerivedCategory Y.Modules)
    (hK : IsQCohAll K) (hM : IsQCohAll M) :
    IsIso (kunnethMap a.toLRSHom.toShHom b.toLRSHom.toShHom
      (pullback.fst a b).toLRSHom.toShHom (pullback.snd a b).toLRSHom.toShHom
      (pullback.fst a b ≫ a).toLRSHom.toShHom rfl
      (Stacks.Cohomology.GlobalKunneth.toShHom_pullback_condition a b) K M)
declarations.comment: first statement: for qcqs a and b with X and Y Tor independent over S, the relative Künneth map (0FLP) at X ×_S Y is an isomorphism for K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X) and M ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedKunneth.isIso_kunnethMapScheme_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FLQ], the relative conclusion, at an arbitrary cartesian square of
schemes.**  Let `a : X ⟶ S` and `b : Y ⟶ S` be quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphisms of
schemes with `X` and `Y` Tor independent over `S`, let `p : W ⟶ X` and `q : W ⟶ Y` make `W` a
fibre product of `a` and `b`, and let `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and `M ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.  Then the
relative Künneth morphism of [Stacks, Tag 0FLP]

`Ra_*K ⊗^𝐋_{𝒪_S} Rb_*M ⟶ R(p ≫ a)_*(Lp^*K ⊗^𝐋_{𝒪_W} Lq^*M)`

is an isomorphism.

The three comparisons of
`Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedKunneth.isIso_kunnethMap_of_projectionFormulas_of_baseChange` are
proved at the given square: the projection formula at `a` by [Stacks, Tag 08EU], the base change
leg by [Stacks, Tag 08IB] at the flipped square, and the interchanged-order projection formula at
`p` by [Stacks, Tag 08EU] at `p` (quasi-compact and quasi-separated as a base change of `b`)
conjugated by the symmetries of the derived tensor product.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_kunnethMapScheme_of_isPullback {W : Scheme.{u}} (p : W ⟶ X) (q : W ⟶ Y)
    (hW : IsPullback p q a b)
    [QuasiCompact a] [QuasiSeparated a] [QuasiCompact b] [QuasiSeparated b]
    (hTor : TorIndependent a b)
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (M : DerivedCategory Y.Modules)
    (hK : IsQCohAll K) (hM : IsQCohAll M) :
    IsIso (kunnethMap a.toLRSHom.toShHom b.toLRSHom.toShHom
      p.toLRSHom.toShHom q.toLRSHom.toShHom (p ≫ a).toLRSHom.toShHom rfl
      (congrArg (fun g : W ⟶ S => g.toLRSHom.toShHom) hW.w.symm) K M)
declarations.comment: the relative conclusion, at an arbitrary cartesian square of schemes

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedKunneth.isIso_kunnethGlobalMapScheme
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FLQ], the global conclusion over an affine base, with no hypothesis beyond
the tag's own.**

Let `a : X ⟶ S` and `b : Y ⟶ S` be quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphisms of schemes with
`S` affine and `X` and `Y` Tor independent over `S`, let `W = X ×_S Y` with projections `p` and
`q`, and let `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and `M ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.  Then the global Künneth morphism of
[Stacks, Tag 0G7V]

`RΓ(X, K) ⊗^𝐋_A RΓ(Y, M) ⟶ RΓ(W, Lp^*K ⊗^𝐋_{𝒪_W} Lq^*M)`

for the global cup product of Cohomology, Section 0FKU is an isomorphism.

The cup product is the canonical one, not a parameter: it is
`Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedGlobalCupProduct.globalCupProduct` of the one-point comparison
`Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedSectionsLeftAdjoint.onePointComparisonOnARingedSpace`, which is the
relative cup product of [Stacks, Tag 0B68] for the structure morphism `π : S ⟶ ({*}, A)` of
[Stacks, Tag 01BH] read through the identification of modules on the point with `A`-modules,
exactly as the source defines `μ`.

The three inputs of `isIso_kunnethGlobalMapScheme_of_onePointComparison` are discharged: the
tensor comparison of that one-point comparison is invertible because it is the `hom` of an
isomorphism of bifunctors, and affineness of the base supplies the invertibility of the unit and
of the counit on the quasi-coherent part, which is the Spec–Γ equivalence of
[Stacks, Tag 06Z0].
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_kunnethGlobalMapScheme
    [IsAffine S] [QuasiCompact a] [QuasiSeparated a] [QuasiCompact b] [QuasiSeparated b]
    (hTor : TorIndependent a b)
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (M : DerivedCategory Y.Modules)
    (hK : IsQCohAll K) (hM : IsQCohAll M) :
    IsIso (Stacks.Cohomology.GlobalKunneth.kunnethGlobalMapScheme a b
      (globalCupProduct
        (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedSectionsLeftAdjoint.onePointComparisonOnARingedSpace
          S.toRingedSpace)) K M)
declarations.comment: second statement: under the same hypotheses with S affine, the global Künneth map (0G7V) RΓ(X, K) ⊗^L_A RΓ(Y, M) → RΓ(X ×_S Y, Lp^*K ⊗^L Lq^*M), built from the cup product of Section 0FKU, is an isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.BoxKunneth.globalBoxCupProduct
declarations.doc:
**The global cup product of [Stacks, Tag 0FLR]**

`RΓ(X, 𝓕^•) ⊗^𝐋_A RΓ(Y, 𝓖^•) ⟶ RΓ(X ×_S Y, Tot(𝓕^• ⊠ 𝓖^•))`

in `D(A)` for `A = Γ(S, 𝒪_S)`, for `𝓕^•` on `X/S` and `𝓖^•` on `Y/S` arbitrary `ℤ`-indexed
complexes of quasi-coherent modules whose differentials are differential operators of finite
order. It is the composite of the two pullback maps on derived global sections, the global cup
product of [Stacks, Section 0FKU] (together these are the global Künneth map
`Stacks.Cohomology.GlobalKunneth.kunnethGlobalMapCanonical` of [Stacks, Tag 0G7V] for the
inverse-image ringed spaces), and derived global sections of steps (4) and (5).
declarations.statement:
def globalBoxCupProduct :
    ((tensorBase S.toRingedSpace).obj
          ((sectionsOverBase (inverseImageBaseProjection a)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (leftComplex a K)))).obj
        ((sectionsOverBase (inverseImageBaseProjection b)).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (rightComplex b L))) ⟶
      (sectionsOverBase (inverseImageBaseProjection (pullback.fst a b ≫ a))).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor K L (boxProductRelativeCurried a b)
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
declarations.comment: the map, as the composite of the five maps of the source: steps (1) to (3) are the global Künneth map of Tag 0G7V at the global cup product `globalCupProductCanonical` of Section 0FKU, the pullbacks being `Lp^*`, which computes `p^{-1}` along `(X ×_S Y, f^{-1}𝒪_S) ⟶ (X, a^{-1}𝒪_S)`; steps (4) and (5) are `boxTotalComplexDerivedComparison`

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.BoxKunneth.globalBoxCupProduct_eq
declarations.doc:
**The map is the five-step composite**: the global Künneth map of [Stacks, Tag 0G7V] at the
global cup product of [Stacks, Section 0FKU], followed by derived global sections of steps (4)
and (5).
declarations.statement:
theorem globalBoxCupProduct_eq :
    globalBoxCupProduct a b K L =
      kunnethGlobalMap (inverseImageBaseProjection a) (inverseImageBaseProjection b)
          (fstProjection a b) (sndProjection a b)
          (inverseImageBaseProjection (pullback.fst a b ≫ a))
          (fstProjection_comp a b) (sndProjection_comp a b)
          (globalCupProductCanonical S.toRingedSpace)
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (leftComplex a K)) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (rightComplex b L)) ≫
        (sectionsOverBase (inverseImageBaseProjection (pullback.fst a b ≫ a))).map
          (boxTotalComplexDerivedComparison a b K L)
declarations.comment: the map is the composite of steps (1) to (3), the global Künneth map of Tag 0G7V at the global cup product of Section 0FKU, with derived global sections of steps (4) and (5)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.BoxKunnethFlat.isIso_globalBoxCupProduct_of_isFlatOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FLT.** Let `a : X ⟶ S` and `b : Y ⟶ S` be morphisms of schemes and
let `𝓕^•` and `𝓖^•` be complexes of quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-, respectively `𝒪_Y`-modules whose
differentials are differential operators of finite order on `X/S` and on `Y/S`. The cup product
`RΓ(X, 𝓕^•) ⊗^𝐋_A RΓ(Y, 𝓖^•) ⟶ RΓ(X ×_S Y, Tot(𝓕^• ⊠ 𝓖^•))` of [Stacks, Tag 0FLR] is an
isomorphism in `D(A)` if

1. `S = Spec(A)` is affine,
2. `X` and `Y` are quasi-compact with affine diagonal,
3. `𝓕^•` is bounded,
4. `𝓖^•` is bounded below,
5. every `𝓕^n` is `S`-flat, and
6. every `𝓖^m` is `S`-flat.

Here the cup product is `Stacks.Cohomology.BoxKunneth.globalBoxCupProduct`, built from the
canonical global cup product, with `A` the ring of global sections of `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_globalBoxCupProduct_of_isFlatOver [IsAffine S] [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from Y))]
    (K : CochainComplex (FiniteOrderDifferentialOperatorCategory a) ℤ)
    (L : CochainComplex (FiniteOrderDifferentialOperatorCategory b) ℤ)
    (hK : ∃ m₁ m₂ : ℤ, K.IsStrictlyGE m₁ ∧ K.IsStrictlyLE m₂)
    (hL : ∃ n : ℤ, L.IsStrictlyGE n)
    (hKflat : ∀ n, IsFlatOver a.toLRSHom.toShHom (K.X n).module)
    (hLflat : ∀ n, IsFlatOver b.toLRSHom.toShHom (L.X n).module) :
    IsIso (globalBoxCupProduct a b K L)
declarations.comment: the whole statement under exactly the source's hypotheses: S affine; X, Y quasi-compact with affine diagonal; F^• bounded (terms vanish outside some [m₁, m₂]); G^• bounded below (terms vanish below some n); every term of F^• and of G^• flat over S. The cup product is the parameter-free map of Tag 0FLR built from the canonical global cup product; nothing the source proves is assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.BoxKunneth.isIso_globalBoxKunnethMap
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FLT].**  Let `a : X ⟶ S` and `b : Y ⟶ S` be morphisms of schemes with `S`
affine, let `A = Γ(S, 𝒪_S)`, and let `𝓕^•` on `X/S` and `𝓖^•` on `Y/S` be complexes of
quasi-coherent modules with differentials differential operators of finite order.  If `X` and `Y`
are quasi-compact with affine diagonal, `𝓕^•` is bounded, `𝓖^•` is bounded below, and every term
of `𝓕^•` and of `𝓖^•` is flat over `S`, then the cup product of [Stacks, Tag 0FLR]

`RΓ(X, 𝓕^•) ⊗^𝐋_A RΓ(Y, 𝓖^•) ⟶ RΓ(X ×_S Y, Tot(𝓕^• ⊠ 𝓖^•))`

is an isomorphism in `D(A)`.

The three inputs of the proof are carried as the hypotheses `hκ`, `hrel` and `hstep`, and the
geometric hypotheses are therefore not consumed; the implementation notes of this file say what
each of the three is and what the source's own dévissage would need in addition.  `hκ` is the
invertibility of the `A`-linear global cup product on the affine base, `hrel` is
[Stacks, Tag 0FLQ] at the two inverse-image complexes, and `hstep` is the invertibility of steps
(4) and (5), in which the source consumes the flatness of the terms.  What is proved here is that
the three suffice.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_globalBoxKunnethMap [IsAffine S] [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from Y))]
    (_hK : ∀ n, IsFlatOver a.toLRSHom.toShHom (K.X n).module)
    (_hL : ∀ n, IsFlatOver b.toLRSHom.toShHom (L.X n).module)
    (κ : GlobalCupProduct S.toRingedSpace)
    (hκ : IsIso (κ.app
      ((derivedPushforward (inverseImageBaseProjection a)).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (leftComplex a K)),
        (derivedPushforward (inverseImageBaseProjection b)).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (rightComplex b L)))))
    (hrel : IsIso (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedKunneth.kunnethMap (inverseImageBaseProjection a)
      (inverseImageBaseProjection b) (fstProjection a b) (sndProjection a b)
      (inverseImageBaseProjection (pullback.fst a b ≫ a)) (fstProjection_comp a b)
      (sndProjection_comp a b) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (leftComplex a K))
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (rightComplex b L))))
    (hstep : IsIso (boxTotalDerivedComparison a b K L n₁ n₂
      (boxTotalComparison a b K L n₁ n₂))) :
    IsIso (globalBoxKunnethMap a b K L n₁ n₂ κ)
declarations.comment: the isomorphism; three inputs are carried, so the geometric hypotheses are not consumed: hκ, invertibility of the global cup product on the affine base, which no bare GlobalCupProduct has; hrel, Tag 0FLQ at the two inverse-image complexes; hstep, steps (4) and (5), which the tag's termwise relative S-flatness cannot discharge in this library

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isIso_relativeDifferentialFormsMap_of_etale
declarations.doc:
In a commutative square of schemes whose two horizontal arrows `f : X' ⟶ X` and `g : S' ⟶ S`
are étale, the canonical map `f^*Ω^n_{X/S} ⟶ Ω^n_{X'/S'}` on relative differential forms is an
isomorphism in every degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_relativeDifferentialFormsMap_of_etale (hcomm : f ≫ p = p' ≫ g)
    [Etale f] [Etale g] (n : ℤ) :
    IsIso (relativeDifferentialFormsMap f p p' g hcomm n)
declarations.comment: isomorphism on each exterior power

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentialFormsComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tags 0FL5 and 0FLV.** The canonical homomorphism of sheaves of graded
algebras `⋀(f^*Ω_{X/S}) ⟶ ⋀(Ω_{X'/S'})` attached to a commutative square of schemes: the unique
unital homomorphism extending the canonical map on relative differentials of Tag 01UV.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def relativeDifferentialFormsComparison (hcomm : f ≫ p = p' ≫ g) :
    SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.UnitalHom
      (Scheme.Modules.exteriorAlgebra
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (relativeDifferentials p)))
      (relativeDifferentialFormsAlgebra p')
declarations.comment: canonical graded comparison

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentialFormsComparison_generator
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tags 0FL5 and 0FLV.** In degree one the canonical comparison of exterior
algebras is the canonical map on relative differentials of Tag 01UV.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeDifferentialFormsComparison_generator (hcomm : f ≫ p = p' ≫ g) :
    Scheme.Modules.exteriorGenerator
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (relativeDifferentials p)) ≫
        (relativeDifferentialFormsComparison f p p' g hcomm).app 1 =
      relativeDifferentialsMap f p p' g hcomm ≫
        Scheme.Modules.exteriorGenerator (relativeDifferentials p')
declarations.comment: canonical map in degree one

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRhamPullback.deRhamPullbackChain_f_exteriorPowerPullback
declarations.doc:
**The degreewise factorization of `ρ` through `⋀^n(f^*Ω_{Y/S})`**: the comparison
`f^{-1}Ω^n_{Y/S} ⟶ f^*Ω^n_{Y/S}`, the comparison `f^*(⋀^nΩ_{Y/S}) ≅ ⋀^n(f^*Ω_{Y/S})` of Tag
01CI, and the degree-`n` component of the homomorphism of exterior algebras of Tag 0FLV.
declarations.statement:
theorem deRhamPullbackChain_f_exteriorPowerPullback (n : ℕ) :
    (deRhamPullbackChain f g).f n =
      relativeInverseImageToPullback f g (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentialForms g (n : ℤ)) ≫
        (_root_.pushforward (toInverseImageBase (f ≫ g))).map
          (((Stacks.PullbackExteriorAlgebra.exteriorAlgebraPullbackIso f.toLRSHom.toShHom
                (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentialFormsAlgebra g)
                (Scheme.Modules.exteriorGenerator (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials g))
                (Scheme.Modules.exteriorAlgebra
                  ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials g)))
                (Scheme.Modules.exteriorGenerator
                  ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials g)))
                (Scheme.Modules.isExteriorAlgebra_exteriorAlgebra
                  (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials g))
                (Scheme.Modules.isExteriorAlgebra_exteriorAlgebra _)).app (n : ℤ)).hom ≫
            (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentialFormsComparison f g (f ≫ g) (𝟙 S)
              ((Category.comp_id (f ≫ g)).symm)).app (n : ℤ))
declarations.comment: the degree-n component of f⁻¹Ω^•_{Y/S} ⟶ Ω^•_{X/S} factors through ⋀ⁿ(f^*Ω_{Y/S})

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDifferentialsIso.deRhamSectionsComplexIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 0FLW] at the level of complexes.** For a morphism of affine schemes
`Spec φ : Spec A ⟶ Spec R`, the global relative differential forms of `Spec φ` are the algebraic
de Rham complex `Ω^•_{A/R} = (⋀^•_A Ω[A⁄R], d)` **as a cochain complex of `R`-modules**: the
degreewise comparison of
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDifferentialsIso.differentialFormsSectionsIso` commutes with the
de Rham differential in every degree, not only in degree zero.

This is the comparison the tag's proof starts from, complete as a statement about complexes.
The tag's two assertions — that `RΓ(Spec A, Ω^•_{Spec A/Spec R})` is `Ω^•_{A/R}` in `D(R)`, and
the resulting statement about de Rham cohomology — are *not* proved here, since `Γ` is not `RΓ`;
the passage needs the affine acyclicity of a quasi-coherent sheaf together with Leray's
acyclicity lemma, and it is carried out in
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDifferentialsIso.DeRhamDerived`, where
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDifferentialsIso.derivedDeRhamSectionsIso` and
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDifferentialsIso.deRhamCohomologyIsoInt` take this
isomorphism as their starting point.
declarations.statement: def deRhamSectionsComplexIso : ringDeRhamComplex φ ≅ deRhamSectionsComplex φ
declarations.comment: Γ(Spec A, Ω^•) ≅ Ω^•_{A/R} as a cochain complex of R-modules; not derived

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDifferentialsIso.derivedDeRhamSectionsIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 0FLW], the derived statement.** For a morphism of affine schemes
`Spec φ : Spec A ⟶ Spec R` the algebraic de Rham complex `Ω^•_{A/R}` computes the derived global
sections of the relative de Rham complex:
$$ R\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec} A, \Omega^\bullet_{\operatorname{Spec} A/\operatorname{Spec} R})
  = \Omega^\bullet_{A/R} \quad\text{in } D(R). $$

Both objects are read in `D(R)`: the left-hand side through
`Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedSectionsOverBase.derivedSectionsOver` along the base ring map
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.affineBaseRingMap`, the right-hand side as the extension by zero of
`KaehlerDifferential.deRhamComplex`.

The comparison is the composite of three isomorphisms: the complex-level comparison
`deRhamSectionsComplexIso` of global differential forms with `Ω^•_{A/R}`, the interchange of
extension by zero with a degreewise functor, and the invertibility of
`Γ ⟶ RΓ` supplied by Leray's acyclicity lemma at a bounded below complex of acyclic terms.
declarations.comment: RΓ(Spec A, Ω^•) ≅ Ω^•_{A/R} in D(R)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDifferentialsIso.deRhamCohomologyIsoInt
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 0FLW], the cohomology statement.** De Rham cohomology of a morphism of
affine schemes is the cohomology of the algebraic de Rham complex:
`H^i_{dR}(Spec A/Spec R) = H^i(Ω^•_{A/R})`, in every integer degree.
declarations.comment: H^i_dR(Spec A/Spec R) ≅ H^i(Ω^•_{A/R})

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDifferentialsIso.differentialFormsSectionsIso
declarations.doc:
**The global relative differential `p`-forms of `Spec φ : Spec A ⟶ Spec R` are
`⋀^p_A Ω[A⁄R]`, as `A`-modules.** The sheaf of relative differential `p`-forms is the
quasi-coherent sheaf attached to that module, and the unit of the adjunction between the
associated-sheaf functor and global sections recovers a module from its quasi-coherent sheaf.

This is the degreewise half of [Stacks Project, Tag 0FLW]: it matches the terms of the two
complexes the tag compares, in every degree, and no differential.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def differentialFormsSectionsIso (p : ℕ) :
    ModuleCat.of ↥A ↥(⋀[↥A]^p ↥(CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential φ)) ≅
      moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentialForms (Spec.map φ) (p : ℤ))
declarations.comment: degreewise only: `⋀^p_A Ω[A⁄R] ≅ Γ(Spec A, Ω^p)` for every `p`; no differential

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDifferentialsIso.deRhamComplex_d_zero_one_apply
declarations.doc:
**The first differential of the relative de Rham complex of `Spec φ`, read on global
sections, is the universal derivation of `A` over `R`.** On the degree-zero form `b · 1` attached
to a global section `b` of `𝒪_{Spec A}` it is the universal differential of the element of `A`
corresponding to `b`, viewed in the global differential `1`-forms through the degree-one
comparison.

This is the one square of [Stacks Project, Tag 0FLW] that is matched; the differential in
positive degree is not.
declarations.statement:
theorem deRhamComplex_d_zero_one_apply (b : ↥((Spec A).sheaf.obj.obj (op ⊤))) :
    (((Spec.map φ).deRhamComplex).d 0 1).val.app (op ⊤)
        (b • (Scheme.Hom.deRhamAlgebras (Spec.map φ)).exterior.one.eval (op ⊤)) =
      (oneFormsSectionsIso φ).hom.hom
        (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).hom b))
declarations.comment: the degree-zero differential square only; no differential in positive degree

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRhamDirectImage.isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedDeRhamDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FLX.** For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes
`p : X ⟶ S` the derived direct image `Rp_*Ω^•_{X/S}` of the relative de Rham complex is an
object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_S)`: every one of its cohomology sheaves is quasi-coherent.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedDeRhamDirectImage [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (i : ℤ) :
    ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor S.Modules i).obj
      (derivedDeRhamDirectImage f)).IsQuasicoherent

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRhamDirectImage.derivedCategoryB_derivedDeRhamDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FLX.** `Rp_*Ω^•_{X/S}` is an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_S)`, in the
membership form: the object property on `D(𝒪_S)` cutting out the complexes with quasi-coherent
cohomology holds of it. Since `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.deRhamComplex` is bounded below, the
derived direct image is read in `D⁺(𝒪_S)` and compared with `D(𝒪_S)` along the inclusion, under
which the cohomology functors agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryB_derivedDeRhamDirectImage [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (_root_.SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent S.ringCatSheaf)
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj (derivedDeRhamDirectImage f))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.DeRhamCoherentDirectImage.derivedCategoryB_derivedDeRhamDirectImage_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FLY].** For a proper morphism `p : X ⟶ S` with `S` locally Noetherian,
`Rp_*Ω^•_{X/S}` is an object of `D_Coh(𝒪_S)`.

Coherence of the higher direct images `R^b p_* Ω^a_{X/S}` is [Stacks, Tag 02O5]; this library
proves it with no hypothesis, in the affine-base form
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProperCoherenceWitness.higherDirectImageIsCoherentOverAffineBase` that
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/ProperCoherentImage/Basic.lean` shows equivalent to it.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryB_derivedDeRhamDirectImage_of_isProper
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] [IsProper f] :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
      (fun M => M.IsCoherent) (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj (derivedDeRhamDirectImage f))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.DeRhamCohomologyDirectImage.moduleFinite_deRhamCohomologyBaseModule_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FLZ].** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring and let `X` be a proper scheme over
`S = Spec A`. Then `H^i_{dR}(X/S)` is a finite `A`-module, for every `i`.

The de Rham cohomology is the library's `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.deRhamCohomology`, read as
an `A`-module along `A ≅ Γ(Spec A, 𝒪)`; no hypothesis beyond the tag's own is assumed. By
[Stacks, Tag 0D5W] it is the cohomology of `RΓ(Spec A, Rp_*Ω^•_{X/S})`, whose cohomology sheaves
are coherent by [Stacks, Tag 0FLY] — unconditionally, [Stacks, Tag 02O5] being discharged in
this library — and over a Noetherian affine base the cohomology of derived global sections of a
complex with coherent cohomology sheaves is a finite module.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleFinite_deRhamCohomologyBaseModule_of_isProper [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsProper q]
    (i : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite A
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom).obj
        (Scheme.Hom.deRhamCohomologyBaseModule q i))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProperSmoothDeRham.isIso_derivedBaseChangeMap_deRhamComplex
declarations.doc:
**Base change for `Rf_*Ω^•_{X/S}`.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a proper smooth morphism of schemes
and let

```
X' --g'--> X
|          |
f'         f
v          v
S' --g---> S
```

be a cartesian square. Write `π : (X, f^{-1}𝒪_S) ⟶ S` and `π' : (X', f'^{-1}𝒪_{S'}) ⟶ S'`, so that
`Rπ_*Ω^•_{X/S}` is `Rf_*Ω^•_{X/S}` as an object of `D(𝒪_S)`, and let
`g₀ : (X', f'^{-1}𝒪_{S'}) ⟶ (X, f^{-1}𝒪_S)` be the induced morphism, lying over `g`. Then the
canonical map

`Lg^*Rπ_*Ω^•_{X/S} ⟶ Rπ'_*Lg₀^*Ω^•_{X/S} ⟶ Rπ'_*Ω^•_{X'/S'}`

— the derived base change map of Stacks 08HY followed by `Rπ'_*` of
`deRhamBaseChangeComparison` — is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedBaseChangeMap_deRhamComplex (hsq : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsProper f]
    [Smooth f] :
    IsIso (derivedBaseChangeMap (inverseImageBaseMap g' f' f g hsq.w)
        (inverseImageBaseProjection f') (inverseImageBaseProjection f) g.toLRSHom.toShHom
        (inverseImageBaseMap_comp_inverseImageBaseProjection g' f' f g hsq.w)
        (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          (deRhamComplexInt f))) ≫
      (derivedPushforward (inverseImageBaseProjection f')).map
        (deRhamBaseChangeComparison g' f' f g hsq.w))
declarations.comment: formation of Rf_*Omega^bullet_X/S commutes with arbitrary change of base: for a proper smooth f and any cartesian square the derived base change map of Tag 08HY along the inverse-image ringed spaces, followed by the canonical map of de Rham complexes, is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProperSmoothDeRham.isPerfect_derivedPushforward_deRhamComplex
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FM0], perfectness of `Rf_*Ω^•_{X/S}`.** For a proper smooth morphism of
schemes `f : X ⟶ S`, the derived direct image of the relative de Rham complex along
`π : (X, f^{-1}𝒪_S) ⟶ S` is a perfect object of `D(𝒪_S)`.

Perfectness is local on `S`. Over an affine open `V ⊆ S` the forms `Ω^p_{X/S}` vanish on
`f^{-1}V` for `p` large, so the restriction to `V` of `Rπ_*σ_{≥p}Ω^•_{X/S}` vanishes; descending
along the triangles `σ_{≥p+1} ⟶ σ_{≥p} ⟶ Ω^p[-p]` of the stupid filtration, the outer vertices
have perfect images — the graded pieces by the perfectness of `Rf_*Ω^p_{X/S}` — and perfectness
has the two-out-of-three property (Stacks 08CR).
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_derivedPushforward_deRhamComplex [IsProper f] [Smooth f] :
    Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect (X := S.toRingedSpace)
      ((derivedPushforward (inverseImageBaseProjection f)).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (deRhamComplexInt f)))
declarations.comment: Rf_*Omega^bullet_X/S is a perfect object of D(O_S) for a proper smooth f: the derived direct image of the relative de Rham complex along (X, f^{-1}O_S) -> S

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProperSmoothDeRham.isIso_derivedBaseChangeMap_forms
declarations.doc:
**Base change for `Rf_*Ω^p_{X/S}`.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a proper smooth morphism of schemes
and let

```
X' --g'--> X
|          |
f'         f
v          v
S' --g---> S
```

be a cartesian square. Then the canonical map

`Lg^*Rf_*Ω^p_{X/S} ⟶ Rf'_*L(g')^*Ω^p_{X/S} ⟶ Rf'_*Ω^p_{X'/S'}`

— the derived base change map of Stacks 08HY followed by `Rf'_*` of the comparison
`formsBaseChangeComparison` — is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedBaseChangeMap_forms {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'} {f : X ⟶ S}
    {g : S' ⟶ S} (hsq : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsProper f] [Smooth f] (p : ℕ) :
