declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR1, in terms of components**: `Hom^n(L, M)` is the subset of
`∏_{p + q = n} Hom_O(L^{-q}, M^p)` of the families `f = (f_{p, q})` with
`f_{p, q}(m a) = f_{p - i, q + i}(m) a`; a homogeneous map corresponds to the family of its
components.
declarations.comment:
`Hom^n(L, M) ⊂ ∏_{p + q = n} Hom_O(L^{-q}, M^p)` is the subset of the families
with `f_{p, q}(m a) = f_{p - i, q + i}(m) a`

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedModuleCat
declarations.doc:
**The graded category `Mod^gr(A)` of Stacks 0FR1**: its objects are the right graded
`A`-modules. This is a type synonym so that it can carry the category structure whose morphisms
are the finite sums of homogeneous maps, rather than only the maps of degree zero.
declarations.statement: def GradedModuleCat (A : GradedAlgebra.{t, a} R)
declarations.comment: the objects of `Mod^gr(A)`: right graded `A`-modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedModuleCat.instCategory
declarations.doc:
**The category `Mod^gr(A)` of Stacks 0FR1**: the morphisms `L → M` are
`⨁_n Hom^n(L, M)`, and composition is composition of homogeneous maps,
`Hom^m(L, M) × Hom^n(K, L) → Hom^{n + m}(K, M)`, extended additively.
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance instCategory : Category (GradedModuleCat.{t, a, w} A)
declarations.comment: `Hom_{Mod^gr(A)}(L, M) = ⨁_n Hom^n(L, M)`, with composition `(g, f) ↦ g ∘ f`

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedModuleCat.instLinear
declarations.doc: `Mod^gr(A)` is linear over `R = Γ(C, O)`: composition is `R`-bilinear.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance instLinear :
    Linear (Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.GlobalSectionRing R) (GradedModuleCat.{t, a, w} A)
declarations.comment: `Mod^gr(A)` is `R`-linear, `R = Γ(C, O)`

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedModuleCat.instGradedCategory
declarations.doc:
**The graded category `Mod^gr(A)` over `R = Γ(C, O)` of Stacks 0FR1**: the degree-`n`
morphisms `L → M` are the homogeneous maps `Hom^n(L, M)`, identities have degree zero and
composition adds degrees.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance instGradedCategory :
    GradedCategory (Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.GlobalSectionRing R)
      (GradedModuleCat.{t, a, w} A)
declarations.comment:
`Mod^gr(A)` is a graded category over `R = Γ(C, O)` with degree-`n` morphisms
`Hom^n(L, M)`

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedModuleCat.degreeZeroEquivalence
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def degreeZeroEquivalence :
    DegreeZero (Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.GlobalSectionRing R) (GradedModuleCat.{t, a, w} A) ≌
      GradedModule.{t, a, w} A
declarations.comment: the associated category `(Mod^gr(A))^0` is the category of graded `A`-modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.balanceMap
declarations.doc:
The balance map `⨁_{r+s+t=n} P^r ⊗_O A^s ⊗_O N^t ⟶ ⨁_{p+q=n} P^p ⊗_O N^q` of degree `n`,
sending `x ⊗ a ⊗ y` to `xa ⊗ y - x ⊗ ay`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def balanceMap (n : ℤ) : relationSum P N n ⟶ tensorSum P N n
declarations.comment: the map of the presentation, sending `x ⊗ a ⊗ y` to `xa ⊗ y - x ⊗ ay`

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.gradedTensor
declarations.doc:
Degree `n` of the relative tensor product `P ⊗_A N` of a right graded `A`-module with a left
graded `A`-module: the associated sheaf of the cokernel of the balance map.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def gradedTensor (n : ℤ) : SheafOfModules.{m} (toRingCat J Osharp)
declarations.comment: degree `n` of the graded tensor product, as the cokernel of the balance map

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.gradedTensorFunctor
declarations.doc:
The functor `- ⊗_A N` from right graded `A`-modules to graded `O`-modules, for a fixed left
graded `A`-module `N`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedTensorFunctor :
    GradedModule.{t, m, m} A ⥤ GradedObject ℤ (SheafOfModules.{m} (toRingCat J Osharp))
declarations.comment: the functor `- ⊗_A N` on right graded modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.gradedTensorMapRightOfDegree
declarations.doc:
**`- ⊗_A N` on homomorphisms of degree `d`.** The component `(P ⊗_A N)^n → (P' ⊗_A N)^k`,
for `n + d = k`, of the map of degree `d` induced by a homomorphism `f : P → P'` of right graded
`A`-modules homogeneous of degree `d`; it sends `x ⊗ y` to `f(x) ⊗ y`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedTensorMapRightOfDegree {n k : ℤ} (hk : n + d = k) :
    gradedTensor P N n ⟶ gradedTensor P' N k
declarations.comment: `- ⊗_A N` as a functor of graded categories: the map of degree `d` induced by a homomorphism of degree `d`

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.gradedTensorMapRightOfDegree_comp
declarations.doc:
**`- ⊗_A N` preserves composition of the graded category.** For `f : P → P'` homogeneous of
degree `d` and `g : P' → P''` homogeneous of degree `e`, the map of degree `d + e` induced by the
composite `g ∘ f` is the composite of the maps induced by `f` and by `g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem gradedTensorMapRightOfDegree_comp {P P' P'' : GradedModule.{t, m, m} A} {d e : ℤ}
    (f : GradedHomOfDegree P P' d) (g : GradedHomOfDegree P' P'' e)
    (N : LeftGradedModule.{t, m, m} A) {n j k : ℤ} (hj : n + d = j) (hk : j + e = k) :
    gradedTensorMapRightOfDegree (g.comp f) N (show n + (d + e) = k by omega) =
      gradedTensorMapRightOfDegree f N hj ≫ gradedTensorMapRightOfDegree g N hk
declarations.comment: `- ⊗_A N` as a functor of graded categories: compatibility with composition

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.unitorIso
declarations.doc:
**The unit isomorphism of the relative tensor product**: `A ⊗_A N ≅ N` in degree `n`, for `A`
a sheaf of graded algebras acting on itself on the right and `N` a left graded `A`-module.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def unitorIso (n : ℤ) :
    gradedTensor (GradedModule.regularModule A) N n ≅ N.piece n
declarations.comment: the unit isomorphism A ⊗_A N ≅ N of the relative tensor product, in degree n

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.isGradedFlat_regularModule
declarations.doc:
**A sheaf of graded algebras is flat as a right graded module over itself.** The functor
`N ↦ A ⊗_A N` is isomorphic to the identity by `SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.unitorIso`, so it
carries a degreewise short exact sequence to a degreewise short exact sequence.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGradedFlat_regularModule (A : GradedAlgebra.{t, m} (toRingCat J Osharp)) :
    IsGradedFlat (GradedModule.regularModule A)
declarations.comment: the regular right graded module is flat, by the unit isomorphism

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedLocalBalanced
declarations.doc:
An `A`-balanced bilinear family of degree `n` over an object `U` of the site, from a right
graded `A`-module `M` and a graded `(A, B)`-bimodule `N` to a right graded `B`-module `L`: maps
`M^i|_U × N^j|_U → L^{i + j + n}|_U` which are bilinear over the sheaf of rings, compatible with
restriction, `A`-balanced and `B`-linear in the second variable.
declarations.statement:
structure GradedLocalBalanced (M : GradedModule.{t, a, w} A) (N : GradedBimodule.{t, a, z} A B)
    (L : GradedModule.{t, a, s} B) (n : ℤ) (U : C)
declarations.comment: local balanced bilinear families out of a graded module and a bimodule

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedGlobalBalanced
declarations.doc:
An `A`-balanced bilinear family of degree `n` over the whole site: maps
`M^i × N^j → L^{i + j + n}` on sections which are bilinear over the sheaf of rings, compatible
with restriction, `A`-balanced and `B`-linear in the second variable.
declarations.statement:
structure GradedGlobalBalanced (M : GradedModule.{t, a, w} A) (N : GradedBimodule.{t, a, z} A B)
    (L : GradedModule.{t, a, s} B) (n : ℤ)
declarations.comment: balanced bilinear families out of a graded module and a bimodule

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.IsGradedTensorProduct
declarations.doc:
A right graded `B`-module `T` is the tensor product `M ⊗_A N` of a right graded `A`-module
`M` with a graded `(A, B)`-bimodule `N` when it carries an `A`-balanced bilinear map `tmul` of
degree zero whose right `B`-action is `(x ⊗ y) b = x ⊗ y b` and which is universal: composing a
degree-`n` local homomorphism out of `T` with `tmul` is a bijection onto the `A`-balanced
bilinear families of degree `n`.
declarations.statement:
structure IsGradedTensorProduct (M : GradedModule.{t, a, w} A)
    (N : GradedBimodule.{t, a, z} A B) (T : GradedModule.{t, a, s} B)
declarations.comment: the graded tensor product, by its universal property

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedLocalHomSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR3, the degree-`n` term `SheafHom^n_A(M, L)`.** The sheaf of `R`-modules whose
sections over `U` are the degree-`n` local homomorphisms `M|_U → L|_U`: the families
`f = (f_i)` of `R|_U`-linear maps `f_i : M^i|_U → L^{i + n}|_U` with `f_{i + p}(x a) = f_i(x) a`
for local sections `a` of `A^p`. These are exactly the local sections of
`∏_i SheafHom_R(M^i, L^{i + n})` satisfying that condition, so this is the subsheaf of the
product described in the source.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedLocalHomSheaf (M : GradedModule.{t, a, w} A)
    (L : GradedModule.{t, a, z} A) (n : ℤ) : SheafOfModules.{max u v w z} R
declarations.comment:
the degree-`n` term `SheafHom^n_A(M, L)`, a subsheaf of
`∏ SheafHom_O(M^i, L^{i + n})`, as a sheaf of `O`-modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedSheafHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR3, the graded `O`-module `SheafHom^gr_A(M, L)`.** The internal hom of two right
graded `A`-modules, as a graded sheaf of `R`-modules: in degree `n` the sheaf
`SheafOfModules.gradedLocalHomSheaf M L n` of degree-`n` local homomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev gradedSheafHom (M : GradedModule.{t, a, w} A)
    (L : GradedModule.{t, a, z} A) : ℤ → SheafOfModules.{max u v w z} R
declarations.comment: the graded `O`-module `SheafHom^gr_A(M, L)`

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedSheafHomComp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR3, the composition map.** The morphism of sheaves of `O`-modules
`SheafHom^m_A(L, M) ⊗_O SheafHom^n_A(K, L) ⟶ SheafHom^{n + m}_A(K, M)` given locally by
composition, `g ⊗ f ↦ g ∘ f` (`SheafOfModules.gradedSheafHomComp_tmul`).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedSheafHomComp (m n : ℤ) :
    gradedSheafHomTensor O K L M m n ⟶ gradedLocalHomSheaf K M (n + m)
declarations.comment:
the composition map
`SheafHom^m_A(L, M) ⊗_O SheafHom^n_A(K, L) → SheafHom^{n + m}_A(K, M)`

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedSheafHomCompSum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR3, the composition map of graded `O`-modules.** Degree `k` of the tensor product
of the graded `O`-modules `SheafHom^gr_A(L, M)` and `SheafHom^gr_A(K, L)` is
`⨁_{m + n = k} SheafHom^m_A(L, M) ⊗_O SheafHom^n_A(K, L)` (the tensor product of
[Stacks, Tag 0FR2] over the graded algebra `O`, concentrated in degree `0`), and the composition
map on it is `SheafOfModules.gradedSheafHomComp m n` on the summand of index `(m, n)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedSheafHomCompSum (k : ℤ) :
    (∐ fun p : {p : ℤ × ℤ // p.1 + p.2 = k} =>
      gradedSheafHomTensor O K L M p.1.1 p.1.2) ⟶ gradedLocalHomSheaf K M k
declarations.comment:
the composition map on degree `k` of
`SheafHom^gr_A(L, M) ⊗_O SheafHom^gr_A(K, L)`

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedHomLinearEquivSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR3, `Hom_{Mod^gr(A)}(M, L) = Γ(C, SheafHom^gr_A(M, L))`.** In each degree `n`,
the homomorphisms `M → L` of right graded `A`-modules homogeneous of degree `n` are the global
sections of `SheafHom^n_A(M, L)`, as modules over the ring `Γ(C, R)` of global sections: a
homomorphism is sent to the compatible family of its restrictions to the slice sites. Its
compatibility with composition is `SheafOfModules.gradedHomLinearEquivSections_comp`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedHomLinearEquivSections (M L : GradedModule.{t, a, w} A) (n : ℤ) :
    GradedHomOfDegree M L n ≃ₗ[Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.GlobalSectionRing R]
      Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.GlobalSections R (gradedLocalHomSheaf M L n)
declarations.comment:
`Hom_{Mod^gr(A)}(M, L) = Γ(C, SheafHom^gr_A(M, L))` as graded `Γ(C, O)`-modules,
degreewise

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedHomLinearEquivSections_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR3, compatibility with composition.** Under
`Hom_{Mod^gr(A)}(-, -) = Γ(C, SheafHom^gr_A(-, -))`, composition `g ∘ f` of homogeneous
homomorphisms corresponds to the composition map
`SheafHom^m_A(L, M) ⊗_O SheafHom^n_A(K, L) → SheafHom^{n + m}_A(K, M)` applied to the image of
the section `g ⊗ f` of the tensor product, over every object.
declarations.statement:
theorem gradedHomLinearEquivSections_comp {m n : ℤ} (g : GradedHomOfDegree L M m)
    (f : GradedHomOfDegree K L n) (X : Cᵒᵖ) :
    (gradedHomLinearEquivSections K M (n + m) (g.comp f)).1 X =
      PresheafOfModules.Hom.app (gradedSheafHomComp O (K := K) (L := L) (M := M) m n).val X
        (PresheafOfModules.Hom.app ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
          (𝟙 (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.toRingCat J O).obj)).unit.app
            (PresheafOfModules.tensorObj (gradedLocalHomPresheafOver O L M m)
              (gradedLocalHomPresheafOver O K L n))) X
          ((show (gradedLocalHomPresheafOver O L M m).obj X from
              (gradedHomLinearEquivSections L M m g).1 X) ⊗ₜ
            (show (gradedLocalHomPresheafOver O K L n).obj X from
              (gradedHomLinearEquivSections K L n f).1 X)))
declarations.comment: the identification with global sections is compatible with composition

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedBimodule.smulCommClass_sections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR4: the two actions on the sections of a graded bimodule commute**,
`a (x b) = (a x) b`. Together with `leftModuleSections` and `rightModuleSections` this makes
`N(U) = ⨁_n N^n(U)` an `(A(U), B(U))`-bimodule, graded by `incl_smul_incl` and
`op_incl_smul_incl`, and bilinear over `O(U)` by `isScalarTower_left_sections`,
`smulCommClass_base_left_sections`, `isScalarTower_right_sections` and
`smulCommClass_base_right_sections`.
declarations.statement:
instance smulCommClass_sections :
    SMulCommClass (A.toPresheafGradedAlgebra.Total X) (B.toPresheafGradedAlgebra.Total X)ᵐᵒᵖ
      (N.Sections X)
declarations.comment: N(U) = ⨁ N^n(U) is a graded (A(U), B(U))-bimodule

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.gradedTensorRight
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR4: the right graded `B`-module `M ⊗_A N`**, for `M` a right graded `A`-module and
`N` a graded `(A, B)`-bimodule: degree `n` is degree `n` of the graded tensor product of Stacks
0FR2, and a homogeneous section `b` of `B` acts on `x ⊗ y` by `x ⊗ (y b)`
(`SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.gradedTensorRight_smul_tmul`). The functors `- ⊗_A N` are
`SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.gradedTensorRightFunctor` and
`SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.gradedTensorRightHomOfDegree`, with the laws of a functor of graded
categories in `StacksFrontier/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/GradedBimoduleTensorFunctor.lean`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def gradedTensorRight : GradedModule.{t, max u v z, max u v z} B
declarations.comment: M ⊗_A N is a right graded B-module, with (x ⊗ y) b = x ⊗ (y b)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.gradedTensorRightHomOfDegreeLinear
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR4: `- ⊗_A N` is a functor of graded categories over `Γ(C, O)`, on the morphisms
of degree `n`**: the map `Hom^n(M, M') → Hom^n(M ⊗_A N, M' ⊗_A N)` is `Γ(C, O)`-linear. Its
compatibility with composition is
`SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.gradedTensorRightHomOfDegree_comp`, and with identities
`SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.gradedTensorRightHomOfDegree_ofHom`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedTensorRightHomOfDegreeLinear
    (M M' : GradedModule.{t, max u v z, max u v z} A) (n : ℤ) :
    GradedHomOfDegree M M' n →ₗ[Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.GlobalSectionRing
        (toRingCat J Osharp)]
      GradedHomOfDegree (gradedTensorRight M N) (gradedTensorRight M' N) n
declarations.comment: - ⊗_A N is Γ(C, O)-linear on Hom^n, as a functor of graded categories

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedSheafHomModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR4: `SheafHom^gr_B(N, L)` is a right graded `A`-module.** For a graded
`(A, B)`-bimodule `N` and a right graded `B`-module `L`, the graded `O`-module
`SheafHom^gr_B(N, L)` of [Stacks, Tag 0FR3] with the multiplication maps
`SheafHom^n_B(N, L) × A^m → SheafHom^{n + m}_B(N, L)` sending `(f, a)` to the local
homomorphism `(f a)(y) = f (a y)`, which involves no signs.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedSheafHomModule (N : GradedBimodule.{t, a, z} A B)
    (L : GradedModule.{t, a, s} B) : GradedModule.{t, a, max u v z s} A
declarations.comment: SheafHom^gr_B(N, L) is a right graded A-module, with (f a)(y) = f(a y)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.isGradedInternalHom_gradedSheafHomModule
declarations.doc:
**The constructed module is the internal hom with its right `A`-action**, in the sense of
`SheafOfModules.IsGradedInternalHom`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def isGradedInternalHom_gradedSheafHomModule :
    IsGradedInternalHom N L (gradedSheafHomModule N L)
declarations.comment:
the right graded A-module SheafHom^gr_B(N, L), as the internal hom with its
right A-action

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedSheafHomFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR4: the functor `SheafHom^gr_B(N, -) : Mod(B) ⥤ Mod(A)`**, from right graded
`B`-modules to right graded `A`-modules, sending `L` to `SheafHom^gr_B(N, L)` and a homomorphism
to postcomposition with it.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedSheafHomFunctor (N : GradedBimodule.{t, a, z} A B) :
    GradedModule.{t, a, s} B ⥤ GradedModule.{t, a, max u v z s} A
declarations.comment: the functor SheafHom^gr_B(N, -) : Mod(B) → Mod(A)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedSheafHomMapOfDegree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR4, the functor of graded categories `SheafHom^gr_B(N, -)`, on morphisms.** A
homomorphism `g : L → L'` of right graded `B`-modules homogeneous of degree `k` induces the
homomorphism `SheafHom^gr_B(N, L) → SheafHom^gr_B(N, L')` of right graded `A`-modules
homogeneous of degree `k` given by postcomposition with `g`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedSheafHomMapOfDegree (g : GradedHomOfDegree L L' k) :
    GradedHomOfDegree (gradedSheafHomModule N L) (gradedSheafHomModule N L') k
declarations.comment:
SheafHom^gr_B(N, -) : Mod^gr(B) → Mod^gr(A) on homogeneous homomorphisms of
degree k

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedSheafHomMapOfDegreeLinear
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FR4: `SheafHom^gr_B(N, -)` is a functor of graded categories over `Γ(C, O)`, on
the morphisms of degree `k`**: the map
`Hom^k(L, L') → Hom^k(SheafHom^gr_B(N, L), SheafHom^gr_B(N, L'))` is `Γ(C, O)`-linear. Its
compatibility with composition is `SheafOfModules.gradedSheafHomMapOfDegree_comp`, and with
identities `SheafOfModules.gradedSheafHomMapOfDegree_ofHom`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedSheafHomMapOfDegreeLinear (L L' : GradedModule.{t, a, s} B) (k : ℤ) :
    GradedHomOfDegree L L' k →ₗ[Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.GlobalSectionRing R]
      GradedHomOfDegree (gradedSheafHomModule N L) (gradedSheafHomModule N L') k
declarations.comment:
SheafHom^gr_B(N, -) is Γ(C, O)-linear on Hom^k, as a functor of graded
categories

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.gradedTensorRightFunctor
declarations.doc:
**The functor `- ⊗_A N : Mod(A) ⥤ Mod(B)`** of right graded modules, for a graded
`(A, B)`-bimodule `N`.
declarations.statement:
def gradedTensorRightFunctor :
    GradedModule.{t, max u v z, max u v z} A ⥤ GradedModule.{t, max u v z, max u v z} B
declarations.comment: the functor - ⊗_A N : Mod(A) → Mod(B)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.gradedTensorRightHomOfDegree
declarations.doc:
**The homomorphism `M ⊗_A N ⟶ M' ⊗_A N` homogeneous of degree `d`** induced by a homomorphism
`g : M ⟶ M'` homogeneous of degree `d`: the action of `- ⊗_A N` on homogeneous morphisms,
determined by `x ⊗ y ↦ (g x) ⊗ y`.
declarations.statement:
def gradedTensorRightHomOfDegree {d : ℤ} (g : GradedHomOfDegree M M' d) :
    GradedHomOfDegree (gradedTensorRight M N) (gradedTensorRight M' N) d
declarations.comment: - ⊗_A N : Mod^gr(A) → Mod^gr(B) on homogeneous homomorphisms of degree n

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedBimodule
declarations.doc:
A graded `(A, B)`-bimodule is a family of sheaves of modules indexed by `ℤ` carrying
commuting unital left `A`- and right `B`-actions.
declarations.statement: structure GradedBimodule (A B : GradedAlgebra.{t, a} R)
declarations.comment: graded bimodules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedBimodule.Hom
declarations.doc:
A homomorphism of graded `(A, B)`-bimodules is a degreewise morphism of sheaves of modules
which respects both actions.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (M N : GradedBimodule.{t, a, m} A B)
declarations.comment: homomorphisms of graded bimodules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.balancedEquiv
declarations.doc:
The degree-`n` local homomorphisms `M|_U → SheafHom^gr_B(N, L)|_U` of right graded
`A`-modules are the `A`-balanced bilinear families of degree `n` over `U`. This is the local
form of the tensor-hom adjunction, and the hint of the proof of Stacks 0FR6.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def balancedEquiv (hH : IsGradedInternalHom N L H)
    (M : GradedModule.{t, a, w} A) (n : ℤ) (U : C) :
    GradedLocalHom M H n U ≃ GradedLocalBalanced M N L n U
declarations.comment: proof: local homomorphisms into the internal hom are balanced bilinear families

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Tensor-hom adjunction for sheaves of graded modules**, first identity: the degree-`n`
homomorphisms `M ⊗_A N → L` of right graded `B`-modules are the degree-`n` homomorphisms
`M → SheafHom^gr_B(N, L)` of right graded `A`-modules.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def tensorHomEquiv (hT : IsGradedTensorProduct M N T)
    (hH : IsGradedInternalHom N L H) (n : ℤ) :
    GradedHomOfDegree T L n ≃ GradedHomOfDegree M H n
declarations.comment: Hom_{Mod^gr(B)}(M ⊗_A N, L) = Hom_{Mod^gr(A)}(M, SheafHom^gr_B(N, L))

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.isGradedSheafHom_tensor
declarations.doc:
**Tensor-hom adjunction for sheaves of graded modules**, second identity: a graded sheaf of
`R`-modules which is the internal hom `SheafHom^gr_B(M ⊗_A N, L)` is also the internal hom
`SheafHom^gr_A(M, SheafHom^gr_B(N, L))`.
declarations.comment: SheafHom^gr_B(M ⊗_A N, L) = SheafHom^gr_A(M, SheafHom^gr_B(N, L))

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv_naturality_left
declarations.doc:
**Tensor-hom adjunction for sheaves of graded modules**, first identity, functoriality in
`M`: for a morphism `u : M' ⟶ M` of right graded `A`-modules, precomposition with the induced
`u ⊗ 1 : M' ⊗_A N ⟶ M ⊗_A N` corresponds to precomposition with `u`.
declarations.statement:
theorem tensorHomEquiv_naturality_left (hT : IsGradedTensorProduct M N T)
    (hT' : IsGradedTensorProduct M' N T') (hH : IsGradedInternalHom N L H) (u : M' ⟶ M) {n : ℤ}
    (φ : GradedHomOfDegree T L n) :
    tensorHomEquiv hT' hH n (GradedHomOfDegree.compLeft (hT'.map hT u (𝟙 N)) φ) =
      GradedHomOfDegree.compLeft u (tensorHomEquiv hT hH n φ)
declarations.comment: first identity, natural in M

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv_naturality_bimodule
declarations.doc:
**Tensor-hom adjunction for sheaves of graded modules**, first identity, functoriality in
`N`: for a morphism `σ : N ⟶ N'` of graded `(A, B)`-bimodules, precomposition with the induced
`1 ⊗ σ : M ⊗_A N ⟶ M ⊗_A N'` corresponds to postcomposition with the induced
`SheafHom^gr_B(N', L) ⟶ SheafHom^gr_B(N, L)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem tensorHomEquiv_naturality_bimodule (hT : IsGradedTensorProduct M N T)
    (hT' : IsGradedTensorProduct M N' T') (hH : IsGradedInternalHom N L H)
    (hH' : IsGradedInternalHom N' L H') (σ : N ⟶ N') {n : ℤ} (φ : GradedHomOfDegree T' L n) :
    tensorHomEquiv hT hH n (GradedHomOfDegree.compLeft (hT.map hT' (𝟙 M) σ) φ) =
      (tensorHomEquiv hT' hH' n φ).compRight (hH'.map hH σ (𝟙 L))
declarations.comment: first identity, natural in N

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv_naturality_right
declarations.doc:
**Tensor-hom adjunction for sheaves of graded modules**, first identity, functoriality in
`L`: for a morphism `k : L ⟶ L'` of right graded `B`-modules, postcomposition with `k`
corresponds to postcomposition with the induced `SheafHom^gr_B(N, L) ⟶ SheafHom^gr_B(N, L')`.
declarations.statement:
theorem tensorHomEquiv_naturality_right (hT : IsGradedTensorProduct M N T)
    (hH : IsGradedInternalHom N L H) (hH' : IsGradedInternalHom N L' H') (k : L ⟶ L') {n : ℤ}
    (φ : GradedHomOfDegree T L n) :
    tensorHomEquiv hT hH' n (φ.compRight k) =
      (tensorHomEquiv hT hH n φ).compRight (hH.map hH' (𝟙 N) k)
declarations.comment: first identity, natural in L

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.isGradedSheafHom_tensor_map_left
declarations.doc:
**Tensor-hom adjunction for sheaves of graded modules**, second identity, functoriality in
`M`: for a morphism `u : M' ⟶ M` of right graded `A`-modules, the morphism
`SheafHom^gr_B(M ⊗_A N, L) ⟶ SheafHom^gr_B(M' ⊗_A N, L)` induced by `u ⊗ 1` is the morphism
`SheafHom^gr_A(M, SheafHom^gr_B(N, L)) ⟶ SheafHom^gr_A(M', SheafHom^gr_B(N, L))` induced by
`u`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGradedSheafHom_tensor_map_left (hT : IsGradedTensorProduct M N T)
    (hT' : IsGradedTensorProduct M' N T') (hH : IsGradedInternalHom N L H)
    (hG : IsGradedSheafHom T L G) (hG' : IsGradedSheafHom T' L G') (u : M' ⟶ M) (n : ℤ) :
    hG.map hG' (hT'.map hT u (𝟙 N)) (𝟙 L) n =
      (isGradedSheafHom_tensor hT hH hG).map (isGradedSheafHom_tensor hT' hH hG') u (𝟙 H) n
declarations.comment: second identity, natural in M

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.isGradedSheafHom_tensor_map_bimodule
declarations.doc:
**Tensor-hom adjunction for sheaves of graded modules**, second identity, functoriality in
`N`: for a morphism `σ : N ⟶ N'` of graded `(A, B)`-bimodules, the morphism
`SheafHom^gr_B(M ⊗_A N', L) ⟶ SheafHom^gr_B(M ⊗_A N, L)` induced by `1 ⊗ σ` is the morphism
`SheafHom^gr_A(M, SheafHom^gr_B(N', L)) ⟶ SheafHom^gr_A(M, SheafHom^gr_B(N, L))` induced by the
morphism `SheafHom^gr_B(N', L) ⟶ SheafHom^gr_B(N, L)` which `σ` induces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGradedSheafHom_tensor_map_bimodule (hT : IsGradedTensorProduct M N T)
    (hT' : IsGradedTensorProduct M N' T') (hH : IsGradedInternalHom N L H)
    (hH' : IsGradedInternalHom N' L H') (hG : IsGradedSheafHom T L G)
    (hG' : IsGradedSheafHom T' L G') (σ : N ⟶ N') (n : ℤ) :
    hG'.map hG (hT.map hT' (𝟙 M) σ) (𝟙 L) n =
      (isGradedSheafHom_tensor hT' hH' hG').map (isGradedSheafHom_tensor hT hH hG) (𝟙 M)
        (hH'.map hH σ (𝟙 L)) n
declarations.comment: second identity, natural in N

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.isGradedSheafHom_tensor_map_right
declarations.doc:
**Tensor-hom adjunction for sheaves of graded modules**, second identity, functoriality in
`L`: for a morphism `k : L ⟶ L'` of right graded `B`-modules, the morphism
`SheafHom^gr_B(M ⊗_A N, L) ⟶ SheafHom^gr_B(M ⊗_A N, L')` induced by `k` is the morphism
`SheafHom^gr_A(M, SheafHom^gr_B(N, L)) ⟶ SheafHom^gr_A(M, SheafHom^gr_B(N, L'))` induced by the
morphism `SheafHom^gr_B(N, L) ⟶ SheafHom^gr_B(N, L')` which `k` induces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGradedSheafHom_tensor_map_right (hT : IsGradedTensorProduct M N T)
    (hH : IsGradedInternalHom N L H) (hH' : IsGradedInternalHom N L' H')
    (hG : IsGradedSheafHom T L G) (hG' : IsGradedSheafHom T L' G') (k : L ⟶ L') (n : ℤ) :
    hG.map hG' (𝟙 T) k n =
      (isGradedSheafHom_tensor hT hH hG).map (isGradedSheafHom_tensor hT hH' hG') (𝟙 M)
        (hH.map hH' (𝟙 N) k) n
declarations.comment: second identity, natural in L

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.GradedModuleInverseImage.inverseImageGradedModule
declarations.doc:
**The inverse image `f⁻¹N` of a right graded `B`-module** along a morphism of topoi, a right
graded `f⁻¹B`-module. Its degree-`n` piece is the inverse image `f⁻¹N^n` of the degree-`n` piece
of `N`, and its multiplication `f⁻¹N^n × f⁻¹B^m ⟶ f⁻¹N^{n+m}` is the inverse image `f⁻¹ν_{n,m}`
of the multiplication `ν_{n,m}` of `N`, which uses that `f⁻¹` commutes with products.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def inverseImageGradedModule
    (N : SheafOfModules.GradedModule.{w', w', w'} B) :
    SheafOfModules.GradedModule.{w, w, w} (inverseImageGradedAlgebra f O B)
declarations.comment: the graded f⁻¹B-module f⁻¹N, with degree-n piece f⁻¹N^n and multiplication f⁻¹ν_{n,m}

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.GradedModuleInverseImage.inverseImageGradedModuleFunctor
declarations.doc:
**The inverse image functor `f⁻¹ : Mod(B) ⥤ Mod(f⁻¹B)`** on right graded modules. Its
degreewise components are the inverse images of the degreewise components.
declarations.comment: the functor f⁻¹ : Mod(B) ⥤ Mod(f⁻¹B)

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.GradedModuleInverseImage.inverseImageGradedHomOfDegree
declarations.doc:
**The inverse image of a homomorphism homogeneous of degree `d`**, again homogeneous of
degree `d`: the action on morphisms of `f⁻¹ : Mod^gr(B) ⥤ Mod^gr(f⁻¹B)`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def inverseImageGradedHomOfDegree
    {N N' : SheafOfModules.GradedModule.{w', w', w'} B} {d : ℤ}
    (g : SheafOfModules.GradedHomOfDegree N N' d) :
    SheafOfModules.GradedHomOfDegree (inverseImageGradedModule f O N)
      (inverseImageGradedModule f O N') d
declarations.comment: f⁻¹ on homogeneous morphisms of degree n

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedModule.semilinearHomOfDegreeEquiv
declarations.doc:
**`f_*M` corepresents the `φ`-semilinear homomorphisms into `M` homogeneous of degree `n`**:
such a homomorphism out of `N` is exactly a homomorphism `N ⟶ f_*M` of right graded `B`-modules
homogeneous of degree `n`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def semilinearHomOfDegreeEquiv (N : GradedModule.{t, a', m} B)
    (M : GradedModule.{t, a, m} A) (n : ℤ) :
    SemilinearHomOfDegree φ N M n ≃ GradedHomOfDegree N (pushforwardObj φ M) n
declarations.comment: f_*M corepresents the φ-semilinear homomorphisms into M homogeneous of degree n, the morphisms of the graded category Mod^gr

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.GradedModuleToposPullback.tensorAlgebra
declarations.doc:
**The functor `- ⊗_{f⁻¹B, φ} A : Mod(f⁻¹B) ⥤ Mod(A)`**, for a homomorphism
`φ : f⁻¹B ⟶ A` of sheaves of graded `f⁻¹O_D`-algebras: the graded tensor product with `A`, read
as a graded `(f⁻¹B, A)`-bimodule through `φ`, a right graded `A`-module.
declarations.statement:
def tensorAlgebra
    (φ : SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.UnitalHom (inverseImageAlgebra f B) (restrictedAlgebra f A)) :
    SheafOfModules.GradedModule.{max u v z, max u v z, max u v z} (inverseImageAlgebra f B) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.GradedModule.{max u v z, max u v z, max u v z} A
declarations.comment: the functor - ⊗_{f⁻¹B} A : Mod(f⁻¹B) ⥤ Mod(A) of Section 0FR4, A a graded (f⁻¹B, A)-bimodule through φ : f⁻¹B → A

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.GradedModuleToposPullback.pullbackObj
declarations.doc:
**The pullback `f^*N = f⁻¹N ⊗_{f⁻¹B, φ} A` of a right graded `B`-module** along a morphism of
ringed topoi `f` and a homomorphism `φ : f⁻¹B ⟶ A` of sheaves of graded `f⁻¹O_D`-algebras: the
graded tensor product of the inverse image `f⁻¹N`, a right graded `f⁻¹B`-module, with `A`, a
graded `(f⁻¹B, A)`-bimodule through `φ`.
declarations.statement:
def pullbackObj
    (φ : SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.UnitalHom (inverseImageAlgebra f B) (restrictedAlgebra f A))
    (N : SheafOfModules.GradedModule.{w', w', w'} B) :
    SheafOfModules.GradedModule.{max u v z, max u v z, max u v z} A
declarations.comment: f^*N = f⁻¹N ⊗_{f⁻¹B, φ} A

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.GradedModuleToposPullback.pullbackFunctor
declarations.doc:
**The pullback functor `f^* : Mod(B) ⥤ Mod(A)`** of right graded modules along a morphism of
ringed topoi and a homomorphism `φ : f⁻¹B ⟶ A`: the inverse image `f⁻¹ : Mod(B) ⥤ Mod(f⁻¹B)`
followed by `- ⊗_{f⁻¹B, φ} A : Mod(f⁻¹B) ⥤ Mod(A)`.
declarations.statement:
def pullbackFunctor
    (φ : SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.UnitalHom (inverseImageAlgebra f B) (restrictedAlgebra f A)) :
    SheafOfModules.GradedModule.{w', w', w'} B ⥤
      SheafOfModules.GradedModule.{max u v z, max u v z, max u v z} A
declarations.comment: f^* : Mod(B) ⥤ Mod(A), the composite of f⁻¹ and - ⊗_{f⁻¹B, φ} A

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.GradedModuleToposPullback.tensorAlgebraHomOfDegree
declarations.doc: **`- ⊗_{f⁻¹B, φ} A` on homomorphisms homogeneous of degree `d`.**
declarations.comment: - ⊗_{f⁻¹B} A on homogeneous morphisms of degree n

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.GradedModuleToposPullback.pullbackHomOfDegree
declarations.doc:
**`f^*` as a functor of graded categories `Mod^gr(B) ⥤ Mod^gr(A)`, on homogeneous morphisms
of degree `d`**: the inverse image of a homomorphism homogeneous of degree `d`, followed by
`- ⊗_{f⁻¹B, φ} A`. On objects it is `pullbackObj`.
declarations.statement:
def pullbackHomOfDegree
    (φ : SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.UnitalHom (inverseImageAlgebra f B) (restrictedAlgebra f A))
    {N N' : SheafOfModules.GradedModule.{w', w', w'} B} {d : ℤ}
    (g : SheafOfModules.GradedHomOfDegree N N' d) :
    SheafOfModules.GradedHomOfDegree (pullbackObj f φ N) (pullbackObj f φ N') d
declarations.comment: f^* as a functor of graded categories, on homogeneous morphisms of degree n

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedModule.pushforwardObj
declarations.doc:
The direct image `f_*M` of a right graded `A`-module along a morphism of ringed sites and a
homomorphism `φ : B ⟶ f_*A` of sheaves of graded algebras: its degree-`n` piece is the direct
image of the degree-`n` piece of `M`, and a homogeneous section `b` of `B` acts through
`φ b`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pushforwardObj (φ : GradedAlgebra.SemilinearHom u σ B A)
    (M : GradedModule.{t, a, m} A) : GradedModule.{t, a', m} B
declarations.comment: the direct image f_*M of a graded module, with multiplication f_*μ ∘ (id, φ)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedModule.pushforwardMap
declarations.doc:
The direct image of a homomorphism of right graded `A`-modules is its degreewise direct
image.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pushforwardMap (φ : GradedAlgebra.SemilinearHom u σ B A)
    {M N : GradedModule.{t, a, m} A} (g : M ⟶ N) :
    pushforwardObj φ M ⟶ pushforwardObj φ N
declarations.comment: the direct image is functorial in the graded module

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedModule.pushforwardFunctor
declarations.doc: The direct image functor `f_* : Mod(A) ⥤ Mod(B)` on sheaves of graded modules.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pushforwardFunctor (φ : GradedAlgebra.SemilinearHom u σ B A) :
    GradedModule.{t, a, m} A ⥤ GradedModule.{t, a', m} B
declarations.comment: the functor f_* : Mod(A) ⥤ Mod(B)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedModule.pushforwardHomOfDegree
declarations.doc:
The direct image of a homomorphism of right graded `A`-modules homogeneous of degree `n`:
the degreewise direct image again, which is homogeneous of degree `n`. This is the action on
morphisms of the induced functor `f_* : Mod^gr(A) ⥤ Mod^gr(B)` of graded categories, whose
action on objects is `SheafOfModules.GradedModule.pushforwardObj`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pushforwardHomOfDegree (φ : GradedAlgebra.SemilinearHom u σ B A)
    {M L : GradedModule.{t, a, m} A} {n : ℤ} (g : GradedHomOfDegree M L n) :
    GradedHomOfDegree (pushforwardObj φ M) (pushforwardObj φ L) n
declarations.comment: f_* as a functor of graded categories, on homogeneous morphisms of degree n

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedModule.semilinearHomEquiv
declarations.doc:
**A `φ`-semilinear homomorphism `P ⟶ M` is exactly a homomorphism `P ⟶ f_*M` of right graded
`B`-modules.**
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def semilinearHomEquiv (φ : GradedAlgebra.SemilinearHom u σ B A)
    (P : GradedModule.{t, a', m} B) (M : GradedModule.{t, a, m} A) :
    SemilinearHom φ P M ≃ (P ⟶ pushforwardObj φ M)
declarations.comment: f_*M corepresents the φ-semilinear homomorphisms into M

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedTensorPullback.tensorPullbackHomOfDegreeEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FR8**: for a morphism of ringed sites `f`, a sheaf of graded `O_C`-algebras `B` on the
target, a sheaf of graded `O_D`-algebras `A` on the source and a homomorphism `φ : f⁻¹B ⟶ A` of
sheaves of graded algebras, the homomorphisms `f^*N ⟶ M` of right graded `A`-modules homogeneous
of degree `n`, for the pullback `f^*N = f⁻¹N ⊗_{f⁻¹B, φ} A` (`tensorPullbackObj`), are exactly
the homomorphisms `N ⟶ f_*M` of right graded `B`-modules homogeneous of degree `n`:

`Hom_{Mod^gr(B)}(N, f_*M) = Hom_{Mod^gr(A)}(f^*N, M)`.

Here `f_*M` is the direct image of `M`, degreewise, with `B` acting through `φ` read as a
homomorphism `B ⟶ f_*A` (`structureSemilinearHom`).
declarations.comment: Hom_{Mod^gr(B)}(N, f_*M) = Hom_{Mod^gr(A)}(f^*N, M) in every homogeneous degree, for the explicit pullback f^*N = f^{-1}N ⊗_{f^{-1}B, φ} A

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedTensorPullback.tensorPullbackPushforwardAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**The pullback `f^*N = f⁻¹N ⊗_{f⁻¹B, φ} A` is left adjoint to the direct image** on sheaves
of graded modules: the degree-zero case of Tag 0FR8, read as an adjunction `f^* ⊣ f_*`, so
natural in both `N` and `M`.
declarations.comment: the adjunction f^* ⊣ f_*, for the explicit pullback f^*N = f^{-1}N ⊗_{f^{-1}B, φ} A

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedExtendHomEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FRA.** The homomorphisms `j_!M ⟶ N` of right graded `A`-modules are the
homomorphisms `M ⟶ j^*N` of right graded `A_U`-modules. The bijection is the degreewise
adjunction `j_{U!} ⊣ j_U^*` of ordinary sheaves of modules; the content is that it matches the
`A`-linear maps with the `A_U`-linear maps.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedExtendHomEquiv
    (M : GradedModule.{w, max u v m, max u v m} (A.over U))
    (N : GradedModule.{w, max u v m, max u v m} A) :
    (gradedExtensionByZero.{m} O U A M ⟶ N) ≃ (M ⟶ N.over U)
declarations.comment: Hom(j_! M, N) = Hom(M, j^* N)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedExtensionByZeroAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FRA, as an adjunction.** `j_! : Mod^gr(A_U) ⥤ Mod^gr(A)` is left adjoint to
`j^* : Mod^gr(A) ⥤ Mod^gr(A_U)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedExtensionByZeroAdjunction :
    gradedExtensionByZeroFunctor.{m} O U A ⊣ GradedModule.overFunctor A U
declarations.comment: the identification is an adjunction `j_! ⊣ j^*` of graded modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedHomOfDegreeExtendEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FRA.** In every degree `d` the homogeneous homomorphisms `j_!M ⟶ N` of right graded
`A`-modules are the homogeneous homomorphisms `M ⟶ j^*N` of right graded `A_U`-modules. The
bijection is the degreewise adjunction `j_{U!} ⊣ j_U^*` of ordinary sheaves of modules; the
content is that it matches the `A`-linear maps with the `A_U`-linear maps. In degree `0`, read
together with the naturality below, this is the adjunction `j_! ⊣ j^*` of the source.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedHomOfDegreeExtendEquiv (d : ℤ) :
    GradedHomOfDegree (gradedExtensionByZero.{m} O U A M) N d ≃
      GradedHomOfDegree M (N.over U) d
declarations.comment: Hom(j_! M, N) = Hom(M, j^* N), in each degree

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedHomOfDegreeExtendEquiv_naturality_left
declarations.doc: **Tag 0FRA, naturality in the source.**
declarations.statement:
theorem gradedHomOfDegreeExtendEquiv_naturality_left
    {M' : GradedModule.{w, max u v m, max u v m} (A.over U)} (g : M' ⟶ M) (d : ℤ)
    (f : GradedHomOfDegree (gradedExtensionByZero.{m} O U A M) N d) :
    gradedHomOfDegreeExtendEquiv.{m} O U A d
        (GradedHomOfDegree.compLeft (gradedExtensionByZeroMap.{m} O U A g) f) =
      GradedHomOfDegree.compLeft g (gradedHomOfDegreeExtendEquiv.{m} O U A d f)
declarations.comment: naturality of Hom(j_! M, N) = Hom(M, j^* N) in M

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.gradedHomOfDegreeExtendEquiv_naturality_right
declarations.doc: **Tag 0FRA, naturality in the target.**
declarations.statement:
theorem gradedHomOfDegreeExtendEquiv_naturality_right
    {N' : GradedModule.{w, max u v m, max u v m} A} (k : N ⟶ N') (d : ℤ)
    (f : GradedHomOfDegree (gradedExtensionByZero.{m} O U A M) N d) :
    gradedHomOfDegreeExtendEquiv.{m} O U A d (f.compRight k) =
      (gradedHomOfDegreeExtendEquiv.{m} O U A d f).compRight
        (GradedModule.overMap k U)
declarations.comment: naturality of Hom(j_! M, N) = Hom(M, j^* N) in N

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.extendTensorIso
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FRB.** In every degree `n` the relative tensor product of the extension by zero of
a right graded `A_U`-module `M` with a left graded `A`-module `N` is the extension by zero of
the relative tensor product of `M` with the restriction of `N`:
`j_!M ⊗_A N = j_!(M ⊗_{A_U} N|_U)` as sheaves of `O`-modules. The isomorphism sends the local
section `j_!x ⊗ y` to `j_!(x ⊗ y)`, and it is natural in `M` and in `N` by
`SheafOfModules.extendTensorHom_naturality_left` and `..._naturality_right`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def extendTensorIso (n : ℤ) :
    extendTensor.{m} O U A M N n ≅
      (extendSheaf.{m} O U).obj (sliceTensor.{m} O U A M N n)
declarations.comment: j_! M ⊗_A N = j_!(M ⊗_{A_U} N|_U) as graded O-modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.extendTensorHom_naturality_right
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FRB, functoriality in the left graded module.** The identification
`j_!M ⊗_A N = j_!(M ⊗_{A_U} N|_U)` commutes with a homomorphism `N ⟶ N'` of left graded
`A`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem extendTensorHom_naturality_right {N' : LeftGradedModule.{w, max u v m, max u v m} A}
    (f : N ⟶ N') (n : ℤ) :
    RelativeTensor.gradedTensorMap (gradedExtensionByZero.{m} O U A M) f n ≫
        extendTensorHom.{m} O U A M N' n =
      extendTensorHom.{m} O U A M N n ≫ (extendSheaf.{m} O U).map
        (RelativeTensor.gradedTensorMap (J := J.over U) (Osharp := O.over U) M
          (LeftGradedModule.overMap f U) n)
declarations.comment: functoriality of j_! M ⊗_A N = j_!(M ⊗_{A_U} N|_U) in N

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.extendTensorHom_naturality_left
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FRB, functoriality in the right graded module.** The identification
`j_!M ⊗_A N = j_!(M ⊗_{A_U} N|_U)` commutes with a homomorphism `M ⟶ M'` of right graded
`A_U`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem extendTensorHom_naturality_left {M' : GradedModule.{w, max u v m, max u v m} (A.over U)}
    (h : M ⟶ M') (n : ℤ) :
    RelativeTensor.gradedTensorMapRight (gradedExtensionByZeroMap.{m} O U A h) N n ≫
        extendTensorHom.{m} O U A M' N n =
      extendTensorHom.{m} O U A M N n ≫ (extendSheaf.{m} O U).map
        (RelativeTensor.gradedTensorMapRight (J := J.over U) (Osharp := O.over U) h
          (N.over U) n)
declarations.comment: functoriality of j_! M ⊗_A N = j_!(M ⊗_{A_U} N|_U) in M

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedModule.isGrothendieckAbelian
declarations.doc:
**The category of right graded modules over a sheaf of graded algebras on a site is a
Grothendieck abelian category.**

It is abelian and has filtered colimits by Tag 0FR0, those colimits are exact by
`gradedModule_ab5`, it is locally small, and it has the separator
`⨁_{k, U} j_{U!} A_U[k]`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance isGrothendieckAbelian (A : GradedAlgebra.{t, a} R) :
    IsGrothendieckAbelian.{max u v a w} (GradedModule.{t, a, max u v a w} A)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.Hom
declarations.doc:
A homomorphism of sheaves of differential graded algebras: a morphism of the underlying
cochain complexes which respects the graded multiplication.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (A B : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R)
declarations.comment: homomorphisms of differential graded algebras

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.op
declarations.doc:
**The opposite sheaf of differential graded algebras.** The underlying complex and the unit
are those of `A`, and the multiplication interchanges its variables and twists by the Koszul
sign.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def op : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R
declarations.comment: the opposite of a sheaf of differential graded algebras

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra
declarations.doc: A sheaf of differential graded algebras over a sheaf of rings on a site.
declarations.statement: structure DifferentialGradedAlgebra (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{t})
declarations.comment: sheaves of differential graded algebras

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.pushforwardDifferentialGradedAlgebra
declarations.doc:
**An additive lax monoidal functor between categories of sheaves of modules induces a
functor between the categories of sheaves of differential graded algebras.** This is part (1)
of the functoriality of sheaves of differential graded algebras: for a morphism of ringed topoi
`(f, f♯)` and `F = f_*` — lax monoidal because it is right adjoint to the strong monoidal
pullback, and additive because it is a right adjoint between abelian categories — it is the
pushforward `A ↦ (f_*A, f_*d)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pushforwardDifferentialGradedAlgebra :
    DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{w, w} (toRingCat J Osharp) ⥤
      DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{w, w} (toRingCat K Psharp)
declarations.comment: part (1): pushforward

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.pullbackDifferentialGradedAlgebra
declarations.doc:
**An additive strong monoidal functor between categories of sheaves of modules induces a
functor between the categories of sheaves of differential graded algebras.** This is part (2)
of the functoriality of sheaves of differential graded algebras: for a morphism of ringed topoi
`(f, f♯)` and `L = f^*` — strong monoidal for the tensor product of Tag 01CA, and additive
because it is a left adjoint between abelian categories — it is the pullback
`B ↦ (f^*B, f^*d)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pullbackDifferentialGradedAlgebra :
    DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{w, w} (toRingCat K Psharp) ⥤
      DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{w, w} (toRingCat J Osharp)
declarations.comment: part (2): pullback

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.differentialGradedAlgebraAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Pullback of sheaves of differential graded algebras is left adjoint to pushforward.**
This is part (3) of the functoriality of sheaves of differential graded algebras: for a morphism
of ringed topoi `(f, f♯)`, homomorphisms `f^*B ⟶ A` correspond to homomorphisms `B ⟶ f_*A`,
naturally in both arguments. The two functors are the constructions of parts (1) and (2), not
functors merely asserted to exist.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def differentialGradedAlgebraAdjunction :
    pullbackDifferentialGradedAlgebra L hP hO ⊣ pushforwardDifferentialGradedAlgebra G hO hP
declarations.comment: part (3): adjunction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.Hom.dgaPushforward
declarations.doc:
**The direct image of a sheaf of differential graded algebras along a morphism of ringed
sites.** Its underlying sheaf of graded algebras is the direct image of that of `A` and its
differential is `f_*d`; this is part (1) of the functoriality of sheaves of differential graded
algebras.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def dgaPushforward :
    SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (Sheaf.toRingCat X.J X.O) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (Sheaf.toRingCat Y.J Y.O)
declarations.comment: part (1) at a morphism of ringed sites: `(f_*A, f_*d)`, functorially

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.Hom.dgaPullback
declarations.doc:
**The inverse image of a sheaf of differential graded algebras along a morphism of ringed
sites.** Its underlying sheaf of graded algebras is the inverse image of that of `B` and its
differential is `f^*d`; this is part (2) of the functoriality of sheaves of differential graded
algebras.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def dgaPullback :
    SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (Sheaf.toRingCat Y.J Y.O) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (Sheaf.toRingCat X.J X.O)
declarations.comment: part (2) at a morphism of ringed sites: `(f^*B, f^*d)`, functorially

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.Hom.dgaPushforward_obj_complex
declarations.doc:
**The differential of `f_*A` is `f_*d`**: its cochain complex is the direct image of the
cochain complex of `A` degreewise.
declarations.statement:
theorem dgaPushforward_obj_complex
    (A : SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (Sheaf.toRingCat X.J X.O)) :
    ((dgaPushforward f hY hX).obj A).complex =
      ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} (Stacks.DifferentialGradedInverseImage.inverseImageRingHom
            (structureMapPresheaf f) hY hX)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        A.complex
declarations.comment: part (1) at a morphism of ringed sites: `(f_*A, f_*d)`, functorially

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.Hom.dgaPullback_obj_complex
declarations.doc:
**The differential of `f^*B` is `f^*d`**: its cochain complex is the inverse image of the
cochain complex of `B` degreewise.
declarations.statement:
theorem dgaPullback_obj_complex
    (B : SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (Sheaf.toRingCat Y.J Y.O)) :
    ((dgaPullback f hY hX).obj B).complex =
      ((Stacks.DifferentialGradedInverseImage.inverseImageModules
          (structureMapPresheaf f) hY hX).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        B.complex
declarations.comment: part (2) at a morphism of ringed sites: `(f^*B, f^*d)`, functorially

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.Hom.dgaPushforward_obj_toGradedAlgebra
declarations.doc:
**The underlying sheaf of graded algebras of `f_*A` is the direct image of that of `A`**, in
the sense of the functoriality of sheaves of graded algebras: so `f_*A` really is the sheaf of
graded algebras of that remark, equipped with the differential `f_*d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem dgaPushforward_obj_toGradedAlgebra
    (A : SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (Sheaf.toRingCat X.J X.O)) :
    ((dgaPushforward f hY hX).obj A).toGradedAlgebra =
      SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.transport
        (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} (Stacks.DifferentialGradedInverseImage.inverseImageRingHom
          (structureMapPresheaf f) hY hX)) A.toGradedAlgebra hX hY
declarations.comment: part (1) at a morphism of ringed sites: `(f_*A, f_*d)`, functorially

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.Hom.dgaPullback_obj_toGradedAlgebra
declarations.doc:
**The underlying sheaf of graded algebras of `f^*B` is the inverse image of that of `B`**, in
the sense of the functoriality of sheaves of graded algebras: so `f^*B` really is the sheaf of
graded algebras of that remark, equipped with the differential `f^*d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem dgaPullback_obj_toGradedAlgebra
    (B : SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (Sheaf.toRingCat Y.J Y.O)) :
    ((dgaPullback f hY hX).obj B).toGradedAlgebra =
      SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.transport
        (Stacks.DifferentialGradedInverseImage.inverseImageModules
          (structureMapPresheaf f) hY hX) B.toGradedAlgebra hY hX
declarations.comment: part (2) at a morphism of ringed sites: `(f^*B, f^*d)`, functorially

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.Hom.dgaAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**The inverse image of sheaves of differential graded algebras along a morphism of ringed
sites is left adjoint to the direct image.** This is part (3) of the functoriality of sheaves of
differential graded algebras, its two functors being those of parts (2) and (1).
declarations.statement: noncomputable def dgaAdjunction : dgaPullback f hY hX ⊣ dgaPushforward f hY hX
declarations.comment: part (3) at a morphism of ringed sites: `(f^*B ⟶ A) ≃ (B ⟶ f_*A)`

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.LeftDifferentialGradedModule.opRight
declarations.doc:
**A left differential graded `A`-module read as a right differential graded
`A.op`-module.** The cochain complex is unchanged and the action is interchanged and twisted by
the Koszul sign.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def opRight : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, w} A.op
declarations.comment: left differential graded modules as right modules over the opposite algebra

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.opLeft
declarations.doc:
**A right differential graded `A`-module read as a left differential graded
`A.op`-module.** The cochain complex is unchanged and the action is interchanged and twisted by
the Koszul sign.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def opLeft : LeftDifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, w} A.op
declarations.comment: right differential graded modules as left modules over the opposite algebra

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.unopLeft
declarations.doc:
**A right differential graded `A.op`-module read as a left differential graded
`A`-module.** The cochain complex is unchanged and the action is interchanged and twisted by the
Koszul sign.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def unopLeft : LeftDifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, w} A
declarations.comment: right differential graded modules over the opposite algebra as left modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule
declarations.doc: A right differential graded module over a sheaf of differential graded algebras.
declarations.statement: structure DifferentialGradedModule (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R)
declarations.comment: right differential graded modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.Hom
declarations.doc: A morphism of right differential graded modules.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (M N : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)
declarations.comment: homomorphisms of differential graded modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.LeftDifferentialGradedModule
declarations.doc:
A left differential graded module over a sheaf of differential graded algebras. The sign in
the Leibniz rule is determined by the degree of the algebra section.
declarations.statement: structure LeftDifferentialGradedModule (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R)
declarations.comment: left differential graded modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.LeftDifferentialGradedModule.Hom
declarations.doc: A morphism of left differential graded modules.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (M N : LeftDifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)
declarations.comment: homomorphisms of left differential graded modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.differentialGradedModule_abelian_ab5_hasLimits_hasColimits_forget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FRJ.** Let `R` be a sheaf of rings on a site `(C, J)` and let `A` be a sheaf of
differential graded `R`-algebras. The category `Mod(A, d)` of right differential graded
`A`-modules is abelian and has

1. arbitrary direct sums,
2. arbitrary colimits,
3. exact filtered colimits,
4. arbitrary products,
5. arbitrary limits,

and the functor `Mod(A, d) ⥤ Mod(A)` forgetting the differential commutes with all limits and
with all colimits.

Abelianness is phrased as `Nonempty (Abelian _)` because `CategoryTheory.Abelian` is data; the
seven remaining clauses are propositions on the nose.
declarations.statement:
theorem differentialGradedModule_abelian_ab5_hasLimits_hasColimits_forget
    (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{m}] [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{m}] :
    Nonempty (Abelian (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)) ∧
      HasCoproducts.{m} (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A) ∧
      HasColimitsOfSize.{m, m} (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A) ∧
      AB5OfSize.{m, m} (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A) ∧
      HasProducts.{m} (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A) ∧
      HasLimitsOfSize.{m, m} (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A) ∧
      PreservesLimitsOfSize.{s₁, s₂} (forgetToGradedModule.{t, a, m} A) ∧
      PreservesColimitsOfSize.{s₁, s₂} (forgetToGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.toCochainComplex_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**A short exact sequence of differential graded modules has an underlying short exact
sequence of cochain complexes of sheaves of modules.**
declarations.statement:
theorem toCochainComplex_shortExact
    (S : ShortComplex (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)) (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (S.map (toCochainComplex.{t, a, m} A)).ShortExact
declarations.comment: underlying short exact sequence

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.cohomologyExactAtFirst
declarations.doc:
Exactness of the cohomology sequence at the cohomology of the first module, including the
connecting map from the preceding degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologyExactAtFirst
    (S : ShortComplex (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)) (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℤ) :
    (ShortComplex.mk
      ((toCochainComplex_shortExact A S hS).δ (n - 1) n (by simp))
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap S.f.toHomologicalComplex n)
      ((toCochainComplex_shortExact A S hS).δ_comp (n - 1) n (by simp))).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness at the first cohomology sheaf

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.cohomologyExactAtMiddle
declarations.doc: Exactness of the cohomology sequence at the cohomology of the middle module.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologyExactAtMiddle
    (S : ShortComplex (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)) (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℤ) :
    ((S.map (toCochainComplex.{t, a, m} A)).map
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{m} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n)).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness at the middle cohomology sheaf

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.cohomologyExactAtThird
declarations.doc:
Exactness of the cohomology sequence at the cohomology of the third module, before the
canonical connecting map to the next degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologyExactAtThird
    (S : ShortComplex (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)) (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℤ) :
    (ShortComplex.mk
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap S.g.toHomologicalComplex n)
      ((toCochainComplex_shortExact A S hS).δ n (n + 1) (by simp))
      ((toCochainComplex_shortExact A S hS).comp_δ n (n + 1) (by simp))).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness at the third cohomology sheaf

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.dgTensorOpIso
declarations.doc:
**The relative tensor product read over the opposite algebra.** Interchanging the two
factors and twisting by the Koszul sign identifies `P ⊗_{A.op} M.opLeft` with
`M ⊗_A P.unopLeft`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def dgTensorOpIso : dgTensor P M.opLeft ≅ dgTensor M P.unopLeft
declarations.comment: the relative tensor product of the opposite algebra, interchanged

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.dgTensorSumDiff_balance
declarations.doc:
The signed differential of the direct sums is compatible with the balance maps: this is the
two Leibniz rules, and it is what makes the differential descend to `P ⊗_A N`.
declarations.statement:
theorem dgTensorSumDiff_balance (n : ℤ) :
    balanceMap (gP P) (gN N) n ≫ dgTensorSumDiff P N n =
      relationSumDiff P N n ≫ balanceMap (gP P) (gN N) (n + 1)
declarations.comment: the differential is well defined: it kills `xa ⊗ y - x ⊗ ay`

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.dgTensorDiffPre
declarations.doc:
The differential of degree `n` of the relative tensor product `P ⊗_A N`, as a morphism of
presheaves of modules: the descent of the signed differential to the cokernel of the balance
map.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def dgTensorDiffPre (n : ℤ) :
    gradedTensorPre (gP P) (gN N) n ⟶ gradedTensorPre (gP P) (gN N) (n + 1)
declarations.comment: the differential `d (x ⊗ y) = dx ⊗ y + (-1)^{deg x} x ⊗ dy`

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.dgTensor
declarations.doc:
The relative tensor product `P ⊗_A N` of a right differential graded `A`-module with a left
differential graded `A`-module, as a cochain complex of sheaves of modules.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def dgTensor : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{m} (toRingCat J Osharp)) ℤ
declarations.comment: the relative tensor product as a complex of `O`-modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.dgTensorFunctor
declarations.doc:
The functor `- ⊗_A N` from right differential graded `A`-modules to complexes of
`O`-modules, for a fixed left differential graded `A`-module `N`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def dgTensorFunctor :
    DifferentialGradedModule.{t, m, m} A ⥤
      CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{m} (toRingCat J Osharp)) ℤ
declarations.comment: the functor `- ⊗_A N` to complexes of `O`-modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.RelativeTensor.dgUnitorIso
declarations.doc:
**The unit isomorphism of the relative tensor product of differential graded modules**:
`A ⊗_A N ≅ N` as cochain complexes of sheaves of modules, for `A` a sheaf of differential graded
algebras acting on itself on the right and `N` a left differential graded `A`-module.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def dgUnitorIso :
    dgTensor (DifferentialGradedModule.regularModule A) N ≅ N.complex
declarations.comment: the unit isomorphism A ⊗_A N ≅ N of complexes, for A the regular right module

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.LocalBalancedBilinear
declarations.doc:
An `A`-balanced bilinear family of degree `n` over `U`, from a right differential graded
`A`-module `M` and a differential graded `(A, B)`-bimodule `N` to a right differential graded
`B`-module `L`: maps `M^i|_U × N^j|_U → L^{i + j + n}|_U` which are bilinear over the sheaf of
rings, compatible with restriction, `A`-balanced and `B`-linear in the second variable.
declarations.statement:
structure LocalBalancedBilinear (M : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, w} A)
    (N : DifferentialGradedBimodule.{t, a, z} A B)
    (L : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, s} B) (n : ℤ) (U : C)
declarations.comment: local balanced bilinear families, the universal property of the tensor product

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.LocalHom
declarations.doc:
A local section of `SheafHom^n_A(M, L)` over `U`: a map `M|_U → L|_U` of right differential
graded `A|_U`-modules homogeneous of degree `n`.
declarations.statement:
structure LocalHom (M : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, w} A)
    (L : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, z} A) (n : ℤ) (U : C)
    extends LocalGradedHom M L n U
declarations.comment:
a local section of SheafHom^n_A(M, L) over U: an A|_U-linear map M|_U → L|_U
homogeneous of degree n

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.LocalHom.comp
declarations.doc: The composition of local homomorphisms of right differential graded `A|_U`-modules.
declarations.comment:
the composition map of the internal hom on local sections: composition of
homogeneous A|_U-linear maps, of degree n + m

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.LocalHom.diffTo_comp
declarations.doc:
**The Leibniz rule for the composition of the internal hom**, on local homomorphisms: for
`g` of degree `n` and `f` of degree `m`, `d(f ∘ g) = d(f) ∘ g + (-1)^m f ∘ d(g)`. Here
`f ∘ g` is `g.comp f`, and the degrees are free so that both sides are local homomorphisms of
one and the same degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem diffTo_comp (g : LocalHom K L n U) (f : LocalHom L M m U) {k l : ℤ} (h : n + m = k)
    (hl : k + 1 = l) :
    (g.comp f h).diffTo l hl =
      g.comp f.diffAt (by omega) + (m.negOnePow : ℤ) • g.diffAt.comp f (by omega)
declarations.comment: the Leibniz rule d(f ∘ g) = d(f) ∘ g + (-1)^m f ∘ d(g) on local sections

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.sheafHomComp
declarations.doc:
**The composition map of the internal hom**
`SheafHom^m_A(L, M) × SheafHom^n_A(K, L) ⟶ SheafHom^{n + m}_A(K, M)`, `(f, g) ↦ f ∘ g`: an
`O`-bilinear map of sheaves of `O`-modules, given on local sections by composition of local
homomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def sheafHomComp (K : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, z} A)
    (L : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, s} A) (M : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, w} A)
    (m n : ℤ) :
    BilinearMap ((sheafHomComplex L M).X m) ((sheafHomComplex K L).X n)
      ((sheafHomComplex K M).X (n + m))
declarations.comment:
the composition map SheafHom^m(L, M) × SheafHom^n(K, L) → SheafHom^{n + m}(K, M),
O-bilinear and compatible with restriction

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.sheafHomComp_leibniz
declarations.doc:
**The composition map of the internal hom is a morphism of differential graded
`O`-modules**: `d(f ∘ g) = d(f) ∘ g + (-1)^m f ∘ d(g)` for a local section `f` of
`SheafHom^m_A(L, M)` and a local section `g` of `SheafHom^n_A(K, L)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafHomComp_leibniz (K : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, z} A)
    (L : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, s} A) (M : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, w} A)
    (m n : ℤ) (U : C) (f : ((sheafHomComplex L M).X m).val.obj (op U))
    (g : ((sheafHomComplex K L).X n).val.obj (op U)) :
    ((sheafHomComplex K M).d (n + m) (n + m + 1)).val.app (op U)
        ((sheafHomComp K L M m n).app (op U) f g) =
      gradedCast (fun q => ((sheafHomComplex K M).X q).val.obj (op U)) (add_assoc n m 1).symm
          ((sheafHomComp K L M (m + 1) n).app (op U)
            (((sheafHomComplex L M).d m (m + 1)).val.app (op U) f) g) +
        (m.negOnePow : ℤ) •
          gradedCast (fun q => ((sheafHomComplex K M).X q).val.obj (op U)) (add_right_comm n 1 m)
            ((sheafHomComp K L M m (n + 1)).app (op U) f
              (((sheafHomComplex K L).d n (n + 1)).val.app (op U) g))
declarations.comment:
the composition map is a morphism of differential graded O-modules:
d(f ∘ g) = d(f) ∘ g + (-1)^m f ∘ d(g)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv
declarations.doc:
**`Hom_{Mod^dg(A, d)}(K, L) = Γ(C, SheafHom^dg_A(K, L))`**, in degree `n`: a homogeneous
right-linear map `K ⟶ L` of degree `n` is the same thing as a global section of
`SheafHom^n_A(K, L)`, the section over `U` being the restriction of the map to `K|_U → L|_U`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv (K L : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, a, w} A)
    (n : ℤ) : HomogeneousMap A K L n ≃ ((sheafHomComplex K L).X n).sections
declarations.comment: Hom_{Mod^dg(A)}(K, L) = Γ(C, SheafHom^dg_A(K, L)) in each degree

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv_add
declarations.doc:
The identification of homogeneous maps with global sections of the internal hom is
additive: a homogeneous map `χ` with underlying cochain `φ + φ'` goes to the sum of the global
sections of `φ` and `φ'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv_add (φ φ' χ : HomogeneousMap A K L n)
    (hχ : χ.val = φ.val + φ'.val) (U : X.Cᵒᵖ) :
    (homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv K L n χ).eval U =
      (homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv K L n φ).eval U +
        (homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv K L n φ').eval U
declarations.comment: Hom_{Mod^dg(A)}(K, L) = Γ(C, SheafHom^dg_A(K, L)) is additive

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv_smul
declarations.doc:
The identification of homogeneous maps with global sections of the internal hom is linear
over `R = Γ(C, O)`: a homogeneous map `χ` which is `r • φ`, i.e. whose components are those of
`φ` multiplied by the image of `r` in the ring of sections over every object, goes to the global
section of `φ` multiplied by the image of `r` over every object.
declarations.statement:
theorem homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv_smul (r : (limit X.O.obj : CommRingCat.{u}))
    (φ χ : HomogeneousMap A K L n)
    (hχ : ∀ (i j : ℤ) (hij : i + n = j) (U : X.Cᵒᵖ) (x : (K.complex.X i).val.obj U),
      (χ.val.v i j hij).val.app U x =
        (show (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).obj.obj U from
            ((forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).map (limit.π X.O.obj U)).hom r) •
          (φ.val.v i j hij).val.app U x)
    (U : X.Cᵒᵖ) :
    (homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv K L n χ).eval U =
      (show (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).obj.obj U from
          ((forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).map (limit.π X.O.obj U)).hom r) •
        (homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv K L n φ).eval U
declarations.comment: Hom_{Mod^dg(A)}(K, L) = Γ(C, SheafHom^dg_A(K, L)) is linear over R = Γ(C, O)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv_delta
declarations.doc:
The identification of homogeneous maps with global sections of the internal hom is
compatible with the differentials: the commutator `δ φ` of a homogeneous map goes to the
differential of the global section of `φ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv_delta (φ : HomogeneousMap A K L n)
    (χ : HomogeneousMap A K L (n + 1)) (hχ : χ.val = δ n (n + 1) φ.val) (U : X.C) :
    (homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv K L (n + 1) χ).eval (op U) =
      ((sheafHomComplex K L).d n (n + 1)).val.app (op U)
        ((homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv K L n φ).eval (op U))
declarations.comment:
Hom_{Mod^dg(A)}(K, L) = Γ(C, SheafHom^dg_A(K, L)) is compatible with the
differentials

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv_comp
declarations.doc:
The identification of homogeneous maps with global sections of the internal hom is
compatible with composition: the composite `ψ ∘ φ` of homogeneous maps goes to the image of the
global sections of `ψ` and `φ` under the composition map of the internal hom.
declarations.statement:
theorem homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv_comp (φ : HomogeneousMap A K L n)
    (ψ : HomogeneousMap A L M m) (χ : HomogeneousMap A K M (n + m))
    (hχ : χ.val = φ.val.comp ψ.val rfl) (U : X.Cᵒᵖ) :
    (homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv K M (n + m) χ).eval U =
      (sheafHomComp K L M m n).app U ((homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv L M m ψ).eval U)
        ((homogeneousMapSectionsEquiv K L n φ).eval U)
declarations.comment:
Hom_{Mod^dg(A)}(K, L) = Γ(C, SheafHom^dg_A(K, L)) is compatible with
composition

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgHomSectionsEquiv
declarations.doc:
**`Hom_{Mod^dg(A, d)}(K, L) = Γ(C, SheafHom^dg_A(K, L))`** in degree `n`, read in the
differential graded category `Mod^dg(A, d)` itself.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def dgHomSectionsEquiv (K L : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, a, w} A) (n : ℤ) :
    D.category.Hom (moduleObject A D K) (moduleObject A D L) n ≃
      ((sheafHomComplex K L).X n).sections
declarations.comment:
Hom_{Mod^dg(A, d)}(K, L) = Γ(C, SheafHom^dg_A(K, L)), in the differential
graded category

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgHomSectionsEquiv_add
declarations.doc:
The identification of the morphisms of `Mod^dg(A, d)` with global sections of the internal
hom is additive.
declarations.statement:
theorem dgHomSectionsEquiv_add
    (f g : D.category.Hom (moduleObject A D K) (moduleObject A D L) n) (U : X.Cᵒᵖ) :
    (dgHomSectionsEquiv D K L n (f + g)).eval U =
      (dgHomSectionsEquiv D K L n f).eval U + (dgHomSectionsEquiv D K L n g).eval U
declarations.comment: Hom_{Mod^dg(A, d)}(K, L) = Γ(C, SheafHom^dg_A(K, L)) is additive

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgHomSectionsEquiv_d
declarations.doc:
The identification of the morphisms of `Mod^dg(A, d)` with global sections of the internal
hom is compatible with the differentials.
declarations.statement:
theorem dgHomSectionsEquiv_d
    (f : D.category.Hom (moduleObject A D K) (moduleObject A D L) n) (U : X.C) :
    (dgHomSectionsEquiv D K L (n + 1) (D.category.d f)).eval (op U) =
      ((sheafHomComplex K L).d n (n + 1)).val.app (op U)
        ((dgHomSectionsEquiv D K L n f).eval (op U))
declarations.comment:
Hom_{Mod^dg(A, d)}(K, L) = Γ(C, SheafHom^dg_A(K, L)) is compatible with the
differentials

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgHomSectionsEquiv_comp
declarations.doc:
The identification of the morphisms of `Mod^dg(A, d)` with global sections of the internal
hom is compatible with composition: the composite `g ∘ f` goes to the image of the global
sections of `g` and `f` under the composition map of the internal hom.
declarations.statement:
theorem dgHomSectionsEquiv_comp
    (g : D.category.Hom (moduleObject A D L) (moduleObject A D M) m)
    (f : D.category.Hom (moduleObject A D K) (moduleObject A D L) n) (U : X.Cᵒᵖ) :
    (dgHomSectionsEquiv D K M (n + m) (D.category.comp (add_comm m n) g f)).eval U =
      (sheafHomComp K L M m n).app U ((dgHomSectionsEquiv D L M m g).eval U)
        ((dgHomSectionsEquiv D K L n f).eval U)
declarations.comment:
Hom_{Mod^dg(A, d)}(K, L) = Γ(C, SheafHom^dg_A(K, L)) is compatible with
composition

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.LocalHom.diffAt
declarations.doc:
The differential `d(f) = d_L ∘ f - (-1)^n f ∘ d_K` of a degree-`n` local homomorphism, a
degree-`(n + 1)` local homomorphism.
declarations.statement: def diffAt (f : LocalHom K L n U) : LocalHom K L (n + 1) U
declarations.comment:
the differential d(f) = d_L ∘ f - (-1)^n f ∘ d_K, homogeneous of degree n + 1 and
A-linear

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.LocalHom.diffAt_diffAt
declarations.doc: The differential of the internal hom squares to zero.
declarations.statement: theorem diffAt_diffAt (f : LocalHom K L n U) : f.diffAt.diffAt = 0
declarations.comment: the differential of the internal hom squares to zero

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.localHomPresheaf_isSheaf
declarations.doc:
**The local homomorphisms form a sheaf**: the presheaf `U ↦ SheafHom^n_A(K, L)(U)` satisfies
the sheaf condition.
declarations.statement:
theorem localHomPresheaf_isSheaf (K : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, z} A)
    (L : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, s} A) (n : ℤ) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf J (localHomPresheaf K L n).presheaf
declarations.comment: the local homomorphisms form a sheaf SheafHom^n_A(K, L) of O-modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.sheafHomComplex
declarations.doc:
**The internal hom `SheafHom^dg_A(K, L)`**, as a complex of sheaves of `R`-modules: in degree
`n` the sheaf of degree-`n` local homomorphisms `K|_U → L|_U`, with differential
`d(f) = d_L ∘ f - (-1)^n f ∘ d_K`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev sheafHomComplex (K : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, z} A)
    (L : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, s} A) :
    CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v z s} R) ℤ
declarations.comment:
the internal hom SheafHom^dg_A(K, L) = ⨁_n SheafHom^n_A(K, L), a complex of
O-modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.isInternalHom_sheafHomComplex
declarations.doc:
**The constructed complex is the internal hom**: its sections are the local homomorphisms,
additively, `R`-linearly and compatibly with restriction, and its differential is
`SheafOfModules.localDiffApp`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def isInternalHom_sheafHomComplex (K : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, z} A)
    (L : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, s} A) :
    IsInternalHom K L (sheafHomComplex K L)
declarations.comment:
the sections of SheafHom^n_A(K, L) over U are the A|_U-linear maps K|_U → L|_U
homogeneous of degree n, and its differential is d(f) = d_L ∘ f - (-1)^n f ∘ d_K

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Base change** `- ⊗_{A, φ} B : Mod(A, d) ⥤ Mod(B, d)` along a homomorphism `φ : A ⟶ B` of
sheaves of differential graded algebras on a ringed site: the tensor product with `B` viewed as
the differential graded `(A, B)`-bimodule `{}_A B_B`. Its value at `M` is a tensor product
`M ⊗_A {}_A B_B`, `(baseChangeData φ hφ).isTensorProduct M`.
declarations.comment: the base change functor - ⊗_{A,φ} B on differential graded modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.baseChangeRestrictionAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FRP.** Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site, let `A` and `B` be sheaves of differential
graded `O`-algebras and let `φ : A ⟶ B` be a homomorphism of differential graded `O`-algebras.
Then the base change functor `- ⊗_{A, φ} B : Mod(A, d) ⥤ Mod(B, d)`, the tensor product with the
differential graded `(A, B)`-bimodule `{}_A B_B`, is left adjoint to the restriction functor
`res_φ : Mod(B, d) ⥤ Mod(A, d)`:

`Hom_{Mod(B, d)}(M ⊗_{A, φ} B, L) = Hom_{Mod(A, d)}(M, res_φ L)`

functorially in `M` and `L`, the bijection sending `g` to `x ↦ g (x ⊗ 1)`.
declarations.statement:
def baseChangeRestrictionAdjunction :
    baseChange φ hφ ⊣ restriction.{w, max u v, max u v} φ hφ
declarations.comment: base change - ⊗_{A,φ} B is left adjoint to restriction res_φ

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.baseChangeHomogeneousEquiv
declarations.doc:
**`Hom_{Mod^dg(B, d)}(M ⊗_{A, φ} B, L) = Hom_{Mod^dg(A, d)}(M, res_φ L)` in each degree**
([Stacks, Tag 0FRP](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0FRP)): the degree-`n` homogeneous
right-linear maps `M ⊗_{A, φ} B → L` are the degree-`n` homogeneous right-linear maps
`M → res_φ L`. This is the tensor-hom identity of Tag 0FRS for the bimodule `{}_A B_B`, whose
internal hom into `L` is `res_φ L` by `isSheafHomRestrictionObj`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def baseChangeHomogeneousEquiv (M : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} A')
    (L : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} B') (n : ℤ) :
    HomogeneousMap B' ((baseChange ψ hψ).obj M) L n ≃
      HomogeneousMap A' M ((restriction.{u, u, u} ψ hψ).obj L) n
declarations.comment: Hom_{Mod^dg(B,d)}(M ⊗_A B, L) = Hom_{Mod^dg(A,d)}(M, res_φ L), degreewise

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.baseChangeHomogeneousEquiv_add
declarations.doc: The identification `baseChangeHomogeneousEquiv` is additive.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangeHomogeneousEquiv_add (M : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} A')
    (L : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} B') (n : ℤ)
    (f f' g : HomogeneousMap B' ((baseChange ψ hψ).obj M) L n) (hg : g.val = f.val + f'.val) :
    (baseChangeHomogeneousEquiv ψ hψ M L n g).val =
      (baseChangeHomogeneousEquiv ψ hψ M L n f).val +
        (baseChangeHomogeneousEquiv ψ hψ M L n f').val
declarations.comment: Hom_{Mod^dg(B,d)}(M ⊗_A B, L) = Hom_{Mod^dg(A,d)}(M, res_φ L), additively

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.baseChangeHomogeneousEquiv_delta
declarations.doc:
The identification `baseChangeHomogeneousEquiv` commutes with the differentials of the two
hom complexes, so it is an identification of hom complexes.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangeHomogeneousEquiv_delta (M : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} A')
    (L : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} B') (n : ℤ)
    (f : HomogeneousMap B' ((baseChange ψ hψ).obj M) L n)
    (g : HomogeneousMap B' ((baseChange ψ hψ).obj M) L (n + 1)) (hg : g.val = δ n (n + 1) f.val) :
    (baseChangeHomogeneousEquiv ψ hψ M L (n + 1) g).val =
      δ n (n + 1) (baseChangeHomogeneousEquiv ψ hψ M L n f).val
declarations.comment: Hom_{Mod^dg(B,d)}(M ⊗_A B, L) = Hom_{Mod^dg(A,d)}(M, res_φ L), with differentials

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedBimodule.equivLeftStructure
declarations.doc:
**A differential graded `(A, B)`-bimodule is exactly a right differential graded `B`-module
which is also a left differential graded `A`-module on the same complex, the two actions
commuting.**
declarations.comment: a dg (A,B)-bimodule is a right dg B-module with a commuting left dg A-structure

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.asBimodule
declarations.doc:
**`{}_A B_B`: a sheaf of differential graded algebras `B` is a differential graded
