graded module on the sheaf of graded sets of closed sections of `M`, each further stage is the
twisted extension of the previous one by the free module on the boundary pairs of its
homomorphism to `M`, and the resolution is the colimit of the resulting sequence.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_flat_quasiIso (M : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, m, m} A) :
    ∃ (Q : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, m, m} A) (f : Q ⟶ M),
      QuasiIso f.toHomologicalComplex ∧
        RelativeTensor.IsGradedFlat (GradedModule.ofDifferentialGraded Q) ∧
          RelativeTensor.IsKFlat Q
declarations.comment: the tower of the first proof, built from M alone: the free differential graded module on the sheaf of graded sets of closed sections of M, then the twisted extensions by the free modules on the boundary pairs of each stage, then the colimit. The ring universe and the module universe stay independent here; at a common universe the same tower reaches the full goodness of Section 0FSA in SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_good_quasiIso

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.acyclic_dgTensor_of_isGood_of_acyclic_topos
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FSI (1).** *"Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site. Let `A` be a sheaf of differential graded
algebras on `(C, O)`. Let `P` be a good acyclic right differential graded `A`-module. Then for any
differential graded left `A`-module `N` the tensor product `P ⊗_A N` is acyclic."*

Goodness is `SheafOfModules.IsGoodToposBaseChange`, the definition of Tag 0FSA.
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_toposCorepresentableBy_and_acyclic_and_isGood
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FSI (2).** *"Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site. Let `A` be a sheaf of differential graded
algebras on `(C, O)`. Let `P` be a good acyclic right differential graded `A`-module. Then for any
morphism `(f, f♯) : (Sh(C'), O') ⟶ (Sh(C), O)` of ringed topoi and any differential graded
`O'`-algebra `A'` and any map `φ : f⁻¹A ⟶ A'` of differential graded `f⁻¹O`-algebras the pullback
`f^*P` is acyclic and good."*

The map `φ` is written in its adjoint form, a unital `ψ : A ⟶ f_*A'`. The pullback `f^*P` along
`(f, A', ψ)` is an object corepresenting `Q ↦ Hom_A(P, f_{*,ψ}Q)`: one exists, and every one is
acyclic and good, goodness being `SheafOfModules.IsGoodToposBaseChange`, the definition of
Tag 0FSA.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_toposCorepresentableBy_and_acyclic_and_isGood
    {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedTopos.{u, u, u}}
    {A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat Y.J Y.O)}
    {P : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} A} (good : IsGoodToposBaseChange.{u, u, u} P)
    (acyclic : P.complex.Acyclic) (f : RingedToposHom X Y)
    (A' : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat X.J X.O))
    (ψ : A ⟶ toposPushforwardAlgebra (toposDirectImageModules (X := X) (Y := Y) f) A')
    (hψ : ψ.IsUnital) :
    (∃ T : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} A',
        Nonempty ((toposPushforward (toposDirectImageModules (X := X) (Y := Y) f) ψ hψ ⋙
          coyoneda.obj (Opposite.op P)).CorepresentableBy T)) ∧
      ∀ T : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} A',
        (toposPushforward (toposDirectImageModules (X := X) (Y := Y) f) ψ hψ ⋙
            coyoneda.obj (Opposite.op P)).CorepresentableBy T →
          T.complex.Acyclic ∧ IsGoodToposBaseChange.{u, u, u} T
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.forgetToGradedModule_isRightAdjoint
declarations.doc:
For a sheaf of differential graded algebras, the functor from right differential graded
modules to right graded modules that forgets the differential has a left adjoint.
declarations.statement:
instance forgetToGradedModule_isRightAdjoint (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R) :
    (forgetToGradedModule.{t, a, m} A).IsRightAdjoint

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.dgHull_acyclic
declarations.doc: The differential graded hull of a right graded module is acyclic.
declarations.statement:
theorem dgHull_acyclic (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R)
    (N : GradedModule.{t, a, m} A.toGradedAlgebra) :
    (((forgetToGradedModule.{t, a, m} A).leftAdjoint.obj N).complex).Acyclic
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.dgHull_unit_mono
declarations.doc:
The unit of the adjunction embeds a right graded module into its differential graded
hull.
declarations.statement:
theorem dgHull_unit_mono (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R)
    (N : GradedModule.{t, a, m} A.toGradedAlgebra) :
    Mono ((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (forgetToGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)).unit.app N)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.dgHull_differential_cokernel_iso
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FSL, part (2).** The differential of the differential graded hull induces an
isomorphism from a graded module to the shift by one of the cokernel of the adjunction unit;
in each homogeneous degree it is the unit followed by the differential and the projection to
the cokernel.
declarations.statement:
theorem dgHull_differential_cokernel_iso :
    ∃ f : GradedModule.ShiftedHom N (cokernel ((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
        (forgetToGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)).unit.app N)) 1,
      (∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (f.app n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, HEq (f.app n)
        (((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (forgetToGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)).unit.app N).app n
          ≫ ((forgetToGradedModule.{t, a, m} A).leftAdjoint.obj N).complex.d n (n + 1)
          ≫ (cokernel.π ((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
              (forgetToGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)).unit.app N)).app (n + 1)))
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.GradedModule.exists_monomorphisms_injective_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0FSN.** For a sheaf of graded algebras `A` over a sheaf of rings on a site
there is a set `T` and, for each `t : T`, a monomorphism `N t ⟶ N' t` of right graded
`A`-modules, such that a right graded `A`-module `I` is injective if and only if every
morphism `N t ⟶ I` extends along `N t ⟶ N' t` to a morphism `N' t ⟶ I`.

This is the criterion for Grothendieck abelian categories, Tag 079G, applied to the category of
right graded `A`-modules, which is Grothendieck abelian by Tag 0FRD.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_monomorphisms_injective_iff (A : GradedAlgebra.{t, a} R) :
    ∃ (T : Type max u v a w) (N N' : T → GradedModule.{t, a, max u v a w} A)
      (i : ∀ s, N s ⟶ N' s),
      (∀ s, Mono (i s)) ∧
        ∀ I : GradedModule.{t, a, max u v a w} A,
          Injective I ↔ ∀ (s : T) (f : N s ⟶ I), ∃ g : N' s ⟶ I, i s ≫ g = f

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.GradedInjective
declarations.doc:
A right differential graded module is graded injective when it is injective after
forgetting its differential.
declarations.statement: abbrev GradedInjective (I : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A) : Prop

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.homComplex_shortExact_of_gradedInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FSQ, first display.** For a graded injective differential graded module `I` and
a short exact sequence of differential graded modules — not assumed admissible — the degree-`n`
homogeneous morphisms into `I` form a short exact sequence.
declarations.statement:
theorem homComplex_shortExact_of_gradedInjective
    {M₁ M₂ M₃ I : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, w} A} (f : M₁ ⟶ M₂) (g : M₂ ⟶ M₃)
    (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).ShortExact)
    (hI : GradedInjective I) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (precompCocycle (dgCategoryData.{u, v, w} A).category
        (cocycleOfHom A (dgCategoryData A) g) (asObject A I) n) ∧
      Function.Exact
        (precompCocycle (dgCategoryData.{u, v, w} A).category
          (cocycleOfHom A (dgCategoryData A) g) (asObject A I) n)
        (precompCocycle (dgCategoryData.{u, v, w} A).category
          (cocycleOfHom A (dgCategoryData A) f) (asObject A I) n) ∧
      Function.Surjective (precompCocycle (dgCategoryData.{u, v, w} A).category
        (cocycleOfHom A (dgCategoryData A) f) (asObject A I) n)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_longExact_homotopyHomShift_of_gradedInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FSQ.** Let `I` be a graded injective differential graded module and let
`0 → M₁ → M₂ → M₃ → 0` be a short exact sequence of differential graded modules, *not* assumed
admissible. Then the groups of morphisms into the translates of `I` in the homotopy category sit
in a long exact sequence
`Hom(M₃, I[n]) → Hom(M₂, I[n]) → Hom(M₁, I[n]) → Hom(M₃, I[n+1])`,
the first two maps being composition in the homotopy category. The point is that this holds even
though the given sequence is not admissible, so that it defines no distinguished triangle.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_longExact_homotopyHomShift_of_gradedInjective
    {M₁ M₂ M₃ I : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, w} A} (f : M₁ ⟶ M₂) (g : M₂ ⟶ M₃)
    (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).ShortExact)
    (hI : GradedInjective I) :
    ∃ δ : ∀ n : ℤ, homotopyHomShift A M₁ I n →+ homotopyHomShift A M₃ I (n + 1),
      (∀ n : ℤ, Function.Exact (precompHomotopyHom A g I n) (precompHomotopyHom A f I n)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, Function.Exact (precompHomotopyHom A f I n) (δ n)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, Function.Exact (δ n) (precompHomotopyHom A g I (n + 1)))

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.gradedInjective_pi
declarations.doc: A product of graded injective right differential graded modules is graded injective.

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_acyclic_monomorphisms_gradedInjective_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0FSS.** For a sheaf of differential graded algebras `A` over a sheaf of rings
on a site there is a set `T` and, for each `s : T`, a monomorphism `M s ⟶ M' s` of *acyclic*
right differential graded `A`-modules, such that a right differential graded `A`-module `I` is
graded injective (Tag 0FSP) if and only if every morphism `M s ⟶ I` extends along
`M s ⟶ M' s` to a morphism `M' s ⟶ I`.

The family is the image under the differential graded hull of a detecting family for
injectivity of graded modules (Tag 0FSN): the hull preserves monomorphisms and has acyclic
values by Tag 0FSL, and the extension property is transported along the hull adjunction of
Tag 0FSK.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_acyclic_monomorphisms_gradedInjective_iff
    (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R) :
    ∃ (T : Type max u v a w) (M M' : T → DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, max u v a w} A)
      (i : ∀ s, M s ⟶ M' s),
      (∀ s, Mono (i s)) ∧ (∀ s, (M s).complex.Acyclic) ∧ (∀ s, (M' s).complex.Acyclic) ∧
        ∀ I : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, max u v a w} A,
          GradedInjective I ↔
            ∀ (s : T) (f : M s ⟶ I), ∃ g : M' s ⟶ I, i s ≫ g = f

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_set_indexed_acyclic_family
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FST.** Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site and let `(A, d)` be a sheaf of
differential graded `O`-algebras. There exists a **set** `S` and, for each `s ∈ S`, an acyclic
right differential graded `A`-module `M s` such that every nonzero acyclic right differential
graded `A`-module receives an injective map from some `M s`.

The index type lies in the universe of the modules themselves, which is what makes it a set:
the members of the family are representatives for the isomorphism classes of the nonzero
acyclic modules with at most `acyclicSubmoduleSizeBound A` subobjects, of which there are only
a set by Tag 079E, and `exists_small_acyclic_submodule` is the source's estimate that every
nonzero acyclic module contains such a submodule.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_set_indexed_acyclic_family (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R) :
    ∃ (S : Type max u v a w) (Ms : S → DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, max u v a w} A),
      (∀ s, (Ms s).complex.Acyclic ∧ ¬ IsZero (Ms s).complex) ∧
        (∀ M : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, max u v a w} A, M.complex.Acyclic →
          (¬ IsZero M.complex → ∃ (s : S) (f : Ms s ⟶ M), Mono f))

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.IsKInjective
declarations.doc:
A right differential graded module is K-injective when the homotopy classes of morphisms
into it from every acyclic right differential graded module vanish.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsKInjective (I : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A) : Prop

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.isKInjective_pi
declarations.doc: A product of K-injective right differential graded modules is K-injective.

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_extension_of_acyclic_of_mono
declarations.doc:
A map from an acyclic differential graded module to a K-injective, graded
injective module extends across any monomorphism.

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.isLocal_quotient_obj_of_isKInjective
declarations.doc:
A K-injective and graded injective right differential graded module `I` is local for the
quasi-isomorphisms of `K(Mod(A, d))`: precomposition with a quasi-isomorphism is bijective on
homotopy classes of morphisms into `I`.
declarations.comment:
the bijectivity of precomposition with a quasi-isomorphism on homotopy classes of
morphisms into a graded injective K-injective module, which the source's proof establishes and
of which the lemma's dotted arrow is the surjectivity half

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_homotopic_lift_of_quasiIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0FSX.** Let `I` be a K-injective and graded injective right differential
graded module. For a quasi-isomorphism `b : M ⟶ M'` of right differential graded modules and a
morphism `a : M ⟶ I` there is a morphism `c : M' ⟶ I` making the triangle commute up to
homotopy, that is with `b ≫ c` homotopic to `a`.

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_setIndexed_acyclic_monomorphisms_iff
declarations.doc:
For a sheaf of differential graded algebras `A` on a ringed site there is a *set* `Idx` and,
for each `r : Idx`, a monomorphism `Ms r ⟶ Ms' r` of acyclic right differential graded
`A`-modules, such that a right differential graded `A`-module `I` is K-injective (Tag 0FSU) and
graded injective (Tag 0FSP) if and only if every morphism `Ms r ⟶ I` extends along
`Ms r ⟶ Ms' r` to a morphism `Ms' r ⟶ I`. The index type lies in the universe of the modules
themselves.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_setIndexed_acyclic_monomorphisms_iff
    (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, v} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) :
    ∃ (Idx : Type max u v w)
      (Ms Ms' : Idx → DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A)
      (i : ∀ r, Ms r ⟶ Ms' r),
      (∀ r, Mono (i r)) ∧ (∀ r, (Ms r).complex.Acyclic) ∧ (∀ r, (Ms' r).complex.Acyclic) ∧
        ∀ I : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A,
          (IsKInjective I ∧ GradedInjective I) ↔
            ∀ (r : Idx) (f : Ms r ⟶ I), ∃ g : Ms' r ⟶ I, i r ≫ g = f
declarations.comment: the index type in the module universe, so that the family is a set

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_acyclic_monomorphisms_isKInjective_gradedInjective_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0FSY.** For a sheaf of differential graded algebras `A` on a ringed site there
is a set `Idx` and, for each `r : Idx`, a monomorphism `Ms r ⟶ Ms' r` of *acyclic* right
differential graded `A`-modules, such that a right differential graded `A`-module `I` is
K-injective (Tag 0FSU) and graded injective (Tag 0FSP) if and only if every morphism
`Ms r ⟶ I` extends along `Ms r ⟶ Ms' r` to a morphism `Ms' r ⟶ I`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_acyclic_monomorphisms_isKInjective_gradedInjective_iff
    (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, v} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) :
    ∃ (Idx : Type (max u v w + 1))
      (Ms Ms' : Idx → DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A)
      (i : ∀ r, Ms r ⟶ Ms' r),
      (∀ r, Mono (i r)) ∧ (∀ r, (Ms r).complex.Acyclic) ∧ (∀ r, (Ms' r).complex.Acyclic) ∧
        ∀ I : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A,
          (IsKInjective I ∧ GradedInjective I) ↔
            ∀ (r : Idx) (f : Ms r ⟶ I), ∃ g : Ms' r ⟶ I, i r ≫ g = f

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.functorSetOfMonos
declarations.doc:
Functorially attach all maps from the sources of a set of acyclic
monomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def functorSetOfMonos {X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.{u, u, u}}
    {A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, v} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)}
    [HasSheafify X.J AddCommGrpCat.{max u w t}]
    [X.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u w t}]
    {Idx : Type t} (M M' : Idx → DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u w t} A)
    (i : ∀ r, M r ⟶ M' r)
    (hi : ∀ r, Mono (i r))
    (hM : ∀ r, (M r).complex.Acyclic)
    (hM' : ∀ r, (M' r).complex.Acyclic) :
    SetOfMonosExtension M M' i

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.nonempty_gradedInjectiveKInjectiveResolution
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a ringed site and let `A` be a sheaf of differential graded
algebras on it. Every right differential graded `A`-module admits a quasi-isomorphic
monomorphism into a graded injective K-injective right differential graded `A`-module,
functorially in the module.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_gradedInjectiveKInjectiveResolution
    (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, v} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) :
    Nonempty (GradedInjectiveKInjectiveResolution.{u, v, w} A)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_gradedInjectiveKInjectiveResolution
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0FT0.** Let `X` be a ringed site and let `A` be a sheaf of differential graded
algebras on it. Suppose given a set-indexed family of monomorphisms `i r : Ms r ⟶ Ms' r` of
acyclic right differential graded `A`-modules which *detects* the K-injective graded injective
modules: a module into which every morphism from `Ms r` extends along `i r` is K-injective and
graded injective. Then every right differential graded `A`-module admits a functorial
quasi-isomorphic monomorphism into a graded injective K-injective module.

The detecting family is the conclusion of Tag 0FSY, produced by
`exists_setIndexed_acyclic_monomorphisms_iff`; see the implementation notes.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_gradedInjectiveKInjectiveResolution
    (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, v} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))
    {Idx : Type max u v w}
    (Ms Ms' : Idx → DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A) (i : ∀ r, Ms r ⟶ Ms' r)
    (hi : ∀ r, Mono (i r)) (hMs : ∀ r, (Ms r).complex.Acyclic)
    (hMs' : ∀ r, (Ms' r).complex.Acyclic)
    (hdetect : ∀ I : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A,
      (∀ (r : Idx) (f : Ms r ⟶ I), ∃ g : Ms' r ⟶ I, i r ≫ g = f) →
        IsKInjective I ∧ GradedInjective I) :
    Nonempty (GradedInjectiveKInjectiveResolution.{u, v, w} A)
declarations.comment: the functorial resolution

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_quasiIso_gradedInjective_isKInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0FT0.** Let `X` be a ringed site and let `A` be a sheaf of differential graded
algebras on it. Given a set-indexed family of monomorphisms of acyclic right differential graded
`A`-modules detecting the K-injective graded injective modules, every right differential graded
`A`-module `M` admits a quasi-isomorphism `M ⟶ I` with `I` graded injective and K-injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quasiIso_gradedInjective_isKInjective
    (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, v} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))
    {Idx : Type max u v w}
    (Ms Ms' : Idx → DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A) (i : ∀ r, Ms r ⟶ Ms' r)
    (hi : ∀ r, Mono (i r)) (hMs : ∀ r, (Ms r).complex.Acyclic)
    (hMs' : ∀ r, (Ms' r).complex.Acyclic)
    (hdetect : ∀ I : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A,
      (∀ (r : Idx) (f : Ms r ⟶ I), ∃ g : Ms' r ⟶ I, i r ≫ g = f) →
        IsKInjective I ∧ GradedInjective I)
    (M : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A) :
    ∃ (I : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A) (f : M ⟶ I),
      QuasiIso f.toHomologicalComplex ∧ GradedInjective I ∧ IsKInjective I
declarations.comment: the resolution of a single module

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.zerothCohomology_map_eq_of_homotopic
declarations.doc:
Homotopic morphisms of right differential graded modules act identically on zeroth
cohomology.
declarations.statement:
theorem zerothCohomology_map_eq_of_homotopic (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R)
    (M N : DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A) (f g : M ⟶ N) (h : Homotopic f g) :
    (zerothCohomologyFunctor A).map f = (zerothCohomologyFunctor A).map g
declarations.comment: h0_factors

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.HomotopyCategory.zerothCohomologyFunctor
declarations.doc: Zeroth cohomology on the homotopy category of right differential graded modules.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def zerothCohomologyFunctor (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R) :
    HomotopyCategory.{t, a, m} A ⥤ SheafOfModules.{m} R
declarations.comment: h0_factors

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.HomotopyCategory.zerothCohomologyFunctor_isHomological
declarations.doc:
Zeroth cohomology on the homotopy category of right differential graded `A`-modules is a
homological functor: it takes a distinguished triangle of `K(Mod(A, d))` to an exact sequence of
sheaves of `O`-modules.
declarations.statement:
instance zerothCohomologyFunctor_isHomological :
    (HomotopyCategory.zerothCohomologyFunctor.{u, v, w} A).IsHomological
declarations.comment: H^0 on the homotopy category is a homological functor

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.acyclic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FT3.** The acyclic objects of the homotopy category of right
differential graded `A`-modules: those whose underlying complex of sheaves of `O`-modules has
vanishing cohomology in every degree.
declarations.statement: def acyclic : ObjectProperty (HomotopyCategory.{u, v, w} A)
declarations.comment: the full subcategory of acyclic modules

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.acyclic_isClosedUnderIsomorphisms
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FT3.** The subcategory of acyclic objects is strictly full: it is the
homological kernel of a functor, which is closed under isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
instance acyclic_isClosedUnderIsomorphisms :
    (acyclic.{u, v, w} A).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms
declarations.comment: strict fullness

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.acyclic_isTriangulated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FT3.** The acyclic objects form a triangulated subcategory of the
homotopy category: they are the homological kernel of zeroth cohomology, which is a homological
functor on a triangulated category.
declarations.statement: instance acyclic_isTriangulated : (acyclic.{u, v, w} A).IsTriangulated
declarations.comment: triangulated subcategory

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.acyclic_isSaturated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FT3.** The triangulated subcategory of acyclic objects is saturated:
the homological kernel of a homological functor is stable under retracts, and a direct summand is
a retract.
declarations.statement: instance acyclic_isSaturated : (acyclic.{u, v, w} A).IsSaturated
declarations.comment: saturation

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.acyclic_trW_eq_quasiIsomorphisms
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FT4.** The quasi-isomorphisms of `K(Mod(A, d))` are exactly the
arrows whose cone is acyclic, that is, the class of arrows attached to the triangulated
subcategory `Ac` of acyclic objects.

Both inclusions are read off one distinguished triangle on the given arrow: such a triangle is
isomorphic to the triangle of an admissible short exact sequence `M → N → P` of right
differential graded modules, whose underlying sequence of complexes of sheaves of modules is
short exact, and for a short exact sequence of complexes the first map is a quasi-isomorphism
exactly when the third term is acyclic.
declarations.statement:
theorem acyclic_trW_eq_quasiIsomorphisms :
    (acyclic.{u, v, w} A).trW = quasiIsomorphisms A
declarations.comment: Qis is the class of arrows attached to Ac

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.quasiIsomorphisms_isCompatibleWithTriangulation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FT4.** The quasi-isomorphisms are compatible with the triangulation
of `K(Mod(A, d))`: they are the class of arrows attached to the triangulated subcategory of
acyclic objects.
declarations.statement:
instance quasiIsomorphisms_isCompatibleWithTriangulation :
    (quasiIsomorphisms.{u, v, w} A).IsCompatibleWithTriangulation
declarations.comment: Qis is compatible with the triangulation of K(Mod(A,d))

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedCategory_isTriangulated
declarations.doc:
**The derived category `D(A, d)` is a triangulated category**, with the images of the
distinguished triangles of `K(Mod(A, d))` as its distinguished triangles. Its pre-triangulated
structure is the one Mathlib puts on a localization at a class of morphisms compatible with the
triangulation, and is found by instance search; stating this makes that search run, since
`CategoryTheory.IsTriangulated` presupposes it.
declarations.statement: theorem derivedCategory_isTriangulated : IsTriangulated (derivedCategory.{u, v, w} A)
declarations.comment: D(A,d) is pre-triangulated, and triangulated

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.quasiIsomorphisms_mem_of_comp_mem_comp
declarations.doc:
Axiom MS4, the saturation axiom: an arrow of the homotopy category of right differential
graded `A`-modules which becomes a quasi-isomorphism after composing with an arrow on either side
is a quasi-isomorphism already.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasiIsomorphisms_mem_of_comp_mem_comp {X Y Z T : HomotopyCategory.{t, a, m} A}
    (φ : X ⟶ Y) (ψ : Y ⟶ Z) (χ : Z ⟶ T)
    (hφψ : quasiIsomorphisms.{t, a, m} A (φ ≫ ψ))
    (hψχ : quasiIsomorphisms.{t, a, m} A (ψ ≫ χ)) :
    quasiIsomorphisms.{t, a, m} A ψ
declarations.comment: axiom MS4: saturation of Qis

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.quasiIsomorphisms_iff_isIso_homotopyForget
declarations.doc:
An arrow of the homotopy category of right differential graded `A`-modules is a
quasi-isomorphism exactly when its image under `homotopyForget` is an isomorphism in the derived
category of sheaves of `R`-modules.
declarations.comment: Qis is the class of arrows inverted by K(A) ⟶ D(R)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.quasiIsomorphisms_hasLeftCalculusOfFractions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FT4.** Axioms MS2 and MS3 for the quasi-isomorphisms of the homotopy
category of right differential graded `A`-modules, in their left form: the left Ore condition
and the left cancellation condition, which together with MS1 are a left calculus of
fractions.
declarations.statement:
instance quasiIsomorphisms_hasLeftCalculusOfFractions :
    (quasiIsomorphisms A).HasLeftCalculusOfFractions
declarations.comment: axioms MS2 and MS3: the left calculus of fractions

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.quasiIsomorphisms_hasRightCalculusOfFractions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FT4.** Axioms MS2 and MS3 for the quasi-isomorphisms of the homotopy
category of right differential graded `A`-modules, in their right form: the right Ore condition
and the right cancellation condition, which together with MS1 are a right calculus of
fractions.
declarations.statement:
instance quasiIsomorphisms_hasRightCalculusOfFractions :
    (quasiIsomorphisms A).HasRightCalculusOfFractions
declarations.comment: axioms MS2 and MS3: the right calculus of fractions

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.quasiIsomorphisms_isCompatibleWithTriangulation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FT4.** The quasi-isomorphisms of the homotopy category of right
differential graded `A`-modules are compatible with its triangulated structure: a morphism of
distinguished triangles whose first two components are quasi-isomorphisms may be completed by a
third which is one as well.
declarations.statement:
instance quasiIsomorphisms_isCompatibleWithTriangulation :
    (quasiIsomorphisms A).IsCompatibleWithTriangulation
declarations.comment: compatibility with the triangulated structure

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.quasiIsomorphisms_isSaturated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FT4.** The quasi-isomorphisms of the homotopy category of right
differential graded `A`-modules are a saturated multiplicative system: MS1, the two Ore
conditions MS2, the two cancellation conditions MS3 and the saturation axiom MS4. Saturation
comes from that of the subcategory of acyclic objects, Stacks Project Tag 0FT3.
declarations.statement: theorem quasiIsomorphisms_isSaturated : (quasiIsomorphisms A).IsSaturated
declarations.comment: Qis is a saturated multiplicative system

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.Localization.isTriangulated_functor
registrations.comment: the localization functor is exact

registrations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.quasiIsomorphisms
registrations.comment: the class Qis of quasi-isomorphisms of K(A)

registrations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.quasiIsomorphisms_quotient_map_iff
registrations.comment: well-definedness: Qis may be read off any representing morphism

registrations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.quasiIsomorphisms_isMultiplicative
registrations.comment: axiom MS1: Qis contains the identities and is stable under composition

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedCategory
declarations.doc:
The derived category of a sheaf of differential graded algebras `(A, d)`: the localization
of the homotopy category of right differential graded `A`-modules at the quasi-isomorphisms.
declarations.statement: abbrev derivedCategory (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R) : Type _

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.toDerivedCategory
declarations.doc:
The canonical functor from the homotopy category of right differential graded `A`-modules to
the derived category of `(A, d)`, which inverts the quasi-isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
abbrev toDerivedCategory (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R) :
    HomotopyCategory.{t, a, m} A ⥤ derivedCategory.{t, a, m} A
declarations.comment: the localization functor

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.toDerivedCategory_kernel_eq_acyclic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FT6.** The kernel of the localization functor
`Q : K(Mod(A, d)) ⟶ D(A, d)` is the subcategory `Ac` of acyclic right differential graded
modules: the quasi-isomorphisms are the class of arrows attached to `Ac`, and a strictly full
saturated triangulated subcategory is recovered as the objects killed by the localization at
the class of arrows it determines.
declarations.statement:
theorem toDerivedCategory_kernel_eq_acyclic :
    (toDerivedCategory.{u, v, w} A).kernel = acyclic.{u, v, w} A
declarations.comment: ker(Q) = Ac

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedZerothCohomologyFunctor
declarations.doc:
Zeroth cohomology on the derived category of `(A, d)`: the factorization of zeroth
cohomology on the homotopy category through the localization at the quasi-isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
def derivedZerothCohomologyFunctor (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R) :
    derivedCategory.{t, a, m} A ⥤ SheafOfModules.{m} R
declarations.comment: the factorization of H^0 through the derived category

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedZerothCohomologyFunctorIso
declarations.doc:
Zeroth cohomology on the homotopy category is the restriction of zeroth cohomology on the
derived category along the localization functor.
declarations.comment: the factorization of H^0 through the derived category

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedZerothCohomologyFunctor_isHomological
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FT7.** Zeroth cohomology on the derived category of `(A, d)` is a
homological functor: it takes a distinguished triangle of `D(A, d)` to an exact sequence of
sheaves of `O`-modules.

Zeroth cohomology on `D(A, d)` restricts along the localization functor to zeroth cohomology on
`K(Mod(A, d))`, which is homological by tag 0FT2, and that localization functor is exact and
essentially surjective on arrows.
declarations.statement:
instance derivedZerothCohomologyFunctor_isHomological :
    (derivedZerothCohomologyFunctor.{u, v, w} A).IsHomological
declarations.comment: H^0 on the derived category is a homological functor

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedHomEquivHomotopyHomOfKInjective
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, d)` be a sheaf of differential graded algebras on a ringed site, let `M`, `N` be
right differential graded `A`-modules and let `N ⟶ I` be a quasi-isomorphism into a graded
injective and K-injective right differential graded module `I`. Then morphisms `M ⟶ N` in
`D(A, d)` are the homotopy classes of morphisms `M ⟶ I`.

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedHomEquivHomotopyHomOfKInjective_symm_apply
declarations.doc:
The identification `derivedHomEquivHomotopyHomOfKInjective` sends a homotopy class
`f : M ⟶ I` to its image in `D(A, d)` composed with the inverse of the given
quasi-isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedHomEquivHomotopyHomOfKInjective_symm_apply
    {M N I : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, w} A}
    (hI : IsKInjective I) (hI' : GradedInjective I) {b : N ⟶ I}
    (hb : QuasiIso b.toHomologicalComplex)
    (f : (HomotopyCategory.quotient A).obj M ⟶ (HomotopyCategory.quotient A).obj I) :
    (derivedHomEquivHomotopyHomOfKInjective (M := M) hI hI' hb).symm f =
      (toDerivedCategory.{u, v, w} A).map f ≫ (toDerivedCategoryIso b hb).inv
declarations.comment:
the identification is the one of the source and not an arbitrary bijection: it
sends a homotopy class to its image in D(A, d) composed with the inverse of the given
quasi-isomorphism

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedCategory_sumsAndProducts
declarations.doc:
Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site and let `(A, d)` be a sheaf of differential graded algebras on
`(C, O)`. Then (1) `D(A, d)` has both direct sums and products, (2) direct sums are obtained by
taking direct sums of differential graded `A`-modules, (3) products are obtained by taking
products of K-injective differential graded modules. The four conjuncts are the three parts, in
order, the third read in two ways:

1. the derived category has arbitrary products and arbitrary direct sums;
2. for every family `M` of right differential graded `A`-modules, the image of the direct sum
   `∐ M`, with the images of its canonical inclusions, is a direct sum in `D(A, d)`;
3. for every family `I` of K-injective right differential graded `A`-modules, the image of the
   product `∏ᶜ I`, with the images of its canonical projections, is a product in `D(A, d)`;
   and, for any family `M` with quasi-isomorphisms `s t : M t ⟶ I t` into K-injective modules,
   the image of `∏ᶜ I`, with its projections followed by the inverses of the images of the
   `s t`, is a product of the images of the `M t` in `D(A, d)`.

The modules, and the index sets of the families, lie in any universe `max u v w` containing the
site and the algebra.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategory_sumsAndProducts
    (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, v} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) :
    (HasProducts.{max u v w} (derivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A) ∧
        HasCoproducts.{max u v w} (derivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A)) ∧
      (∀ (T : Type max u v w) (M : T → DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A),
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A ⋙ toDerivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A).obj (∐ M))
          (fun t => (HomotopyCategory.quotient A ⋙ toDerivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A).map
            (Sigma.ι M t))))) ∧
      (∀ (T : Type max u v w) (I : T → DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A),
        (∀ t, IsKInjective (I t)) →
          Nonempty (IsLimit (Fan.mk
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A ⋙ toDerivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A).obj (∏ᶜ I))
            (fun t => (HomotopyCategory.quotient A ⋙ toDerivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A).map
              (Pi.π I t))))) ∧
      (∀ (T : Type max u v w) (M I : T → DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A)
        (s : ∀ t, M t ⟶ I t) (qis : ∀ t, QuasiIso (s t).toHomologicalComplex),
        (∀ t, IsKInjective (I t)) →
          Nonempty (IsLimit (Fan.mk
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A ⋙ toDerivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A).obj (∏ᶜ I))
            (fun t => (HomotopyCategory.quotient A ⋙ toDerivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A).map
                (Pi.π I t) ≫
              (Localization.isoOfHom (toDerivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A)
                (quasiIsomorphisms.{u, v, max u v w} A)
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A).map (s t))
                ((quasiIsomorphisms_quotient_map_iff (s t)).2 (qis t))).inv))))

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.coneDescHom
declarations.doc:
**The comparison `q : C(a) ⟶ M`.** For a short complex `K --a--> L --b--> M` of right
differential graded `A`-modules, this is the morphism of differential graded modules out of the
cone of `a` of tag 0FS5 whose underlying morphism of complexes is Mathlib's comparison of the
mapping cone with the third term: read through the degreewise splitting of the cone it is the
second projection followed by `b`. It commutes with the right action because the cone acts in its
second coordinate as `L` does (`ConePackage.action_second`) and `b` commutes with the action.
declarations.statement:
def coneDescHom (S : ShortComplex (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)) :
    (conePackage S.f).cone ⟶ S.X₃
declarations.comment: the comparison q of the cone with the quotient

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.coneIncl_coneDescHom
declarations.doc:
The comparison restricts along the cone's inclusion of the middle term to the second map of
the short complex: this is the equation `i ≫ q = b` that identifies `q` with the map of the
source.
declarations.statement:
theorem coneIncl_coneDescHom (S : ShortComplex (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)) :
    (conePackage S.f).inclusion ≫ coneDescHom S = S.g
declarations.comment: the comparison q restricts to b along the cone inclusion

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.quasiIso_coneDescHom
declarations.doc:
**The comparison is a quasi-isomorphism** when the short complex is short exact. The
underlying complex of the cone is Mathlib's mapping cone, the underlying short complex of
complexes is short exact by tag 0FRK, and Mathlib's
`CochainComplex.mappingCone.quasiIso_descShortComplex` applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasiIso_coneDescHom {S : ShortComplex (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)}
    (hS : S.ShortExact) : QuasiIso (coneDescHom S).toHomologicalComplex
declarations.comment: q is a quasi-isomorphism

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.moduleToDerivedCategory
declarations.doc:
The localization functor `Mod(A, d) ⥤ D(A, d)`: the quotient by homotopy of tag 0FS1 followed
by the localization at the quasi-isomorphisms of tag 0FT5.
declarations.statement:
abbrev moduleToDerivedCategory (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{t, a} R) :
    DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A ⥤ derivedCategory.{t, a, m} A
declarations.comment: the localization functor Mod(A,d) → D(A,d)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.isIso_moduleToDerivedCategory_map_coneDescHom
declarations.doc: **The comparison `q` becomes invertible in `D(A, d)`**, so that `q⁻¹` is available there.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_moduleToDerivedCategory_map_coneDescHom
    {S : ShortComplex (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    IsIso ((moduleToDerivedCategory A).map (coneDescHom S))
declarations.comment: q is invertible in D(A,d)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.shortExactδ
declarations.doc:
**The connecting morphism `δ = - p ∘ q⁻¹` of a short exact sequence of right differential
graded modules**, as a morphism of `D(A, d)` from the image of the third term to the image of the
degree-one shift of the first term. Here `q` is the comparison
`SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.coneDescHom`, invertible in `D(A, d)`, and `p` is the
canonical cone projection `ConePackage.projection` of tag 0FS5; **the minus sign is the one the
source attaches to the cone projection**, and dropping it gives a different connecting morphism.

Because `D(A, d)` carries no translation functor in this development — that is tag 0FT4, see the
implementation notes — the target is spelled as the image of the differential graded shift
`SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.shift` of the first term rather than as a translate of
the image.
declarations.comment: the connecting morphism δ = - p ∘ q⁻¹

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.shortExactδ_eq
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FTB, the formula for the connecting morphism**: it is `- p ∘ q⁻¹`, with `q` the
comparison of the cone with the third term — which restricts to the second map of the sequence
along the cone's inclusion — and `p` the canonical cone projection.
declarations.statement:
theorem shortExactδ_eq {S : ShortComplex (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)}
    (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (conePackage S.f).inclusion ≫ coneDescHom S = S.g ∧
      ∃ _ : IsIso ((moduleToDerivedCategory A).map (coneDescHom S)),
        shortExactδ hS =
          inv ((moduleToDerivedCategory A).map (coneDescHom S)) ≫
            (moduleToDerivedCategory A).map (-(conePackage S.f).projection)
declarations.comment: the connecting morphism δ = - p ∘ q⁻¹

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.shortExactδ_naturality
declarations.doc:
**The naturality of the connecting morphism.** For a morphism `φ` of short exact
sequences of right differential graded `A`-modules, the square formed by the connecting
morphisms `δ = - p ∘ q⁻¹` of the two sequences, the image of `φ.τ₃` and the image of the induced
morphism of the chosen degree-one shifts of the first terms commutes. This is the second of the
two conditions in the definition of a `δ`-functor, [Stacks, Tag 0150].

Because `D(A, d)` carries no translation functor in this development — see the implementation
notes of
`StacksFrontier/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/DifferentialGradedConeComparison.lean` — the
right-hand vertical arrow is the image of the differential graded shift
`SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.coneShiftHom` of `φ.τ₁` rather than a translate of the
image of `φ.τ₁`.
declarations.statement:
theorem shortExactδ_naturality {S₁ S₂ : ShortComplex (DifferentialGradedModule.{t, a, m} A)}
    (h₁ : S₁.ShortExact) (h₂ : S₂.ShortExact) (φ : S₁ ⟶ S₂) :
    shortExactδ h₁ ≫ (moduleToDerivedCategory A).map (coneShiftHom φ.τ₁) =
      (moduleToDerivedCategory A).map φ.τ₃ ≫ shortExactδ h₂
declarations.comment: the naturality of the connecting morphism δ in the short exact sequence

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.shortExactδTranslate_distinguished
declarations.doc:
For a short exact sequence `0 → K --a--> L --b--> M → 0` of right differential graded
modules, the triangle `(F K, F L, F M, F a, F b, δ)` with `δ = shortExactδTranslate hS` is
distinguished in `D(A, d)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem shortExactδTranslate_distinguished
    {S : ShortComplex (DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, w} A)} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    Triangle.mk ((moduleToDerivedCategory.{u, v, w} A).map S.f)
        ((moduleToDerivedCategory.{u, v, w} A).map S.g) (shortExactδTranslate hS) ∈
      distTriang (derivedCategory.{u, v, w} A)
declarations.comment: the distinguished-triangle axiom of the delta-functor

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.shortExactδTranslate_naturality
declarations.doc: The connecting morphism `shortExactδTranslate` is natural in the short exact sequence.
declarations.statement:
theorem shortExactδTranslate_naturality
    {S₁ S₂ : ShortComplex (DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, w} A)}
    (h₁ : S₁.ShortExact) (h₂ : S₂.ShortExact) (φ : S₁ ⟶ S₂) :
    shortExactδTranslate h₁ ≫ ((moduleToDerivedCategory A).map φ.τ₁)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
      (moduleToDerivedCategory A).map φ.τ₃ ≫ shortExactδTranslate h₂
declarations.comment: naturality of the connecting morphism in maps of short exact sequences

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.deltaFunctorStructure
declarations.doc:
The `δ`-functor structure on the localization functor `Mod(A, d) ⥤ D(A, d)`, with
`δ = - p ∘ q⁻¹` the connecting morphism `shortExactδTranslate`.
declarations.comment: the canonical delta-functor: the localization Mod(A, d) to D(A, d) carries the natural structure of a delta-functor, with delta equal to -p after q inverse, unconditionally

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.isHomotopyColimit_moduleToDerivedCategory_obj_colimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FTC.** *"Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site. Let `(A, d)` be a sheaf of differential
graded algebras on `(C, O)`. Let `Mₙ` be a system of differential graded `A`-modules. Then the
derived colimit `hocolim Mₙ` in `D(A, d)` is represented by the differential graded module
`colim Mₙ`."*

The conclusion is `CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.IsHomotopyColimit` of Definition 090Z for the
image system in `D(A, d)`: the image of `colim Mₙ` sits in a distinguished triangle
`⊕ₙ Mₙ --(1 - f)--> ⊕ₙ Mₙ ⟶ colim Mₙ ⟶ (⊕ₙ Mₙ)⟦1⟧` of `D(A, d)`.

The three inputs are all proved in this development: the pre-triangulated structure on `D(A, d)`
in which the statement is read is the one Tag 0FT4 produces, found by instance search from
`quasiIsomorphisms_hasLeftCalculusOfFractions` and
`quasiIsomorphisms_isCompatibleWithTriangulation`; the `δ`-functor structure `d` is Tag 0FTB,
`deltaFunctorStructure`; and the two colimit instances on `D(A, d)` are Tag 0FT9, parts (1) and
(2), `hasColimitsOfShape_discrete_nat_derivedCategory` and
`preservesColimitsOfShape_discrete_nat_moduleToDerivedCategory`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isHomotopyColimit_moduleToDerivedCategory_obj_colimit
    (F : ℕ ⥤ DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A) :
    IsHomotopyColimit (F ⋙ moduleToDerivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A)
      ((moduleToDerivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A).obj (colimit F))

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_isTriangulated_homotopyToposPullbackTensorTopos
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FTE.** Let `(f, f♯) : (Sh(𝒞), O_𝒞) ⟶ (Sh(𝒟), O_𝒟)` be a morphism of ringed topoi,
let `𝒜` and `𝒜'` be sheaves of differential graded `O_𝒞`-algebras, let `ℬ` be a sheaf of
differential graded `O_𝒟`-algebras, let `φ : ℬ ⟶ f_*𝒜` be a homomorphism and let `𝒩` be a
differential graded `(𝒜, 𝒜')`-bimodule. Then the functor `ℳ ↦ f^*ℳ ⊗_𝒜 𝒩` induces an exact
functor

`K(Mod(ℬ, d)) ⥤ K(Mod(𝒜', d))`

of triangulated categories: there is a functor `Φ` of homotopy categories through which the
functor of modules factors along the two quotient functors, it is the only one, and it commutes
with the translations and carries distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles.

Here `f^*ℳ` is the pullback `f^*ℳ ⊗_{f^*ℬ} 𝒜` along `(f, 𝒜, φ)`, the homomorphism `φ` is
unital, as a homomorphism of differential graded algebras is in the source, and `Φ` is
`homotopyToposPullbackTensor`, by `homotopyToposPullbackTensor_eq`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isTriangulated_homotopyToposPullbackTensorTopos
    {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedTopos.{u, u, u}} (f : RingedToposHom X Y)
    {A A' : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat X.J X.O)}
    {B : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat Y.J Y.O)}
    (φ : B ⟶ toposPushforwardAlgebra (Osharp := X.O) (Psharp := Y.O)
      (toposDirectImageModules (X := X) (Y := Y) f) A) (hφ : φ.IsUnital)
    (N : DifferentialGradedBimodule.{u, u, u} A A') :
    ∃ (Φ : HomotopyCategory.{u, u, u} B ⥤ HomotopyCategory.{u, u, u} A')
      (_ : Φ.CommShift ℤ), Φ.IsTriangulated ∧
      HomotopyCategory.quotient B ⋙ Φ =
        toposPullbackTensor (X := X) (Y := Y) f φ hφ N ⋙ HomotopyCategory.quotient A' ∧
      ∀ Ψ : HomotopyCategory.{u, u, u} B ⥤ HomotopyCategory.{u, u, u} A',
        HomotopyCategory.quotient B ⋙ Ψ =
          toposPullbackTensor (X := X) (Y := Y) f φ hφ N ⋙ HomotopyCategory.quotient A' →
            Ψ = Φ

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.isLeftDerived_derivedPullbackTensorRingedTopos
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FTF.** Let `(f, f♯) : (Sh(C), O_C) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)` be a morphism of
ringed topoi, let `A` and `A'` be sheaves of differential graded `O_C`-algebras, let `B` be a sheaf
of differential graded `O_D`-algebras, let `φ : B ⟶ f_*A` be a homomorphism of sheaves of
differential graded algebras and let `𝒩` be a differential graded `(A, A')`-bimodule. The exact
functor `K(Mod(B, d)) ⟶ K(Mod(A', d))`, `M ↦ f^*M ⊗_A 𝒩` of Tag 0FTE (where `f^*M = f^*M ⊗_{f^*B} A`
is the pullback along `(f, A, φ)`), composed with the localization functor
`K(Mod(A', d)) → D(A', d)`, has a left derived extension `D(B, d) → D(A', d)` whose value on a good
right differential graded `B`-module `P` is `f^*P ⊗_A 𝒩`: `derivedPullbackTensorRingedTopos`, with
its comparison map, is the left derived functor, the comparison map is invertible at every good
module (so that the value there is `derivedPullbackTensorRingedToposObjIso`), and the extension is
an exact functor of triangulated categories.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLeftDerived_derivedPullbackTensorRingedTopos :
    (derivedPullbackTensorRingedTopos f φ hφ N).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
        (derivedPullbackTensorRingedToposCounit f φ hφ N) (quasiIsomorphisms.{u, u, u} B) ∧
      (∀ P : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} B, IsGoodToposBaseChange.{u, u, u} P →
        IsIso ((derivedPullbackTensorRingedToposCounit f φ hφ N).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient B).obj P))) ∧
      ∃ (_ : (derivedPullbackTensorRingedTopos f φ hφ N).CommShift ℤ),
        (derivedPullbackTensorRingedTopos f φ hφ N).IsTriangulated

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedPullbackRingedTopos
declarations.doc:
**The derived pullback** `Lf^* : D(B, d) ⥤ D(A, d)` along a morphism of ringed topoi
`(f, f♯) : (Sh(C), O_C) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)` and a homomorphism `φ : B ⟶ f_*A` of sheaves of
differential graded algebras: the functor of Tag 0FTF for the diagonal bimodule `{}_A A_A`, that
is `derivedPullbackTensorRingedTopos f φ hφ A.diagonalBimodule`. It is the left derived functor
of `M ↦ f^*M ⊗_A A` followed by the localization
(`isLeftDerivedFunctor_derivedPullbackRingedTopos`), and its value on a good module `P` is
`f^*P = f^*P ⊗_{f^*B} A` (`derivedPullbackRingedToposObjIso`).
declarations.statement: def derivedPullbackRingedTopos : derivedCategory.{u, u, u} B ⥤ derivedCategory.{u, u, u} A
declarations.comment: (2) derived pullback Lf^*

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedTensorProductTopos
declarations.doc:
**The derived tensor product** `- ⊗^𝐋_A N : D(A, d) ⥤ D(A', d)`. Let `(Sh(C), O)` be a ringed
topos, let `A` and `A'` be sheaves of differential graded `O`-algebras and let `N` be a
differential graded `(A, A')`-bimodule. The derived tensor product is the functor
`D(A, d) ⥤ D(A', d)` of Tag 0FTF for the identity morphism of `(Sh(C), O)` and the identity
homomorphism `A ⟶ id_*A`: `derivedPullbackTensorRingedTopos` at `RingedToposHom.id` and
`toposIdAlgebraHom`. It is the left derived functor of `M ↦ M ⊗_A N` followed by the localization,
and it is the derived tensor product `derivedTensorProduct` constructed on the ringed site
(`derivedTensorProductToposIso`).
declarations.statement:
def derivedTensorProductTopos :
    derivedCategory.{u, u, u} A ⥤ derivedCategory.{u, u, u} A'
declarations.comment: (1) the derived tensor product - ⊗^L_A N

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_iso_derivedPullbackTensorRingedTopos_derivedPullbackRingedTopos_comp_topos
declarations.doc:
Let `(f, f♯) : (Sh(C), O_C) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)` be a morphism of ringed topoi, `A`, `A'` sheaves
of differential graded `O_C`-algebras, `B` a sheaf of differential graded `O_D`-algebras,
`φ : B ⟶ f_*A` a homomorphism of differential graded algebras and `𝒩` a differential graded
`(A, A')`-bimodule. The functor `D(B, d) ⥤ D(A', d)` of Tag 0FTF,
`derivedPullbackTensorRingedTopos f φ hφ 𝒩`, is `M ↦ Lf^*M ⊗^𝐋_A 𝒩`, where `Lf^*` is the
derived pullback of Tag 0FTG (2) and `- ⊗^𝐋_A 𝒩` the derived tensor product of Tag 0FTG (1),
`derivedTensorProductTopos`: there is an isomorphism
`derivedPullbackTensorRingedTopos f φ hφ 𝒩 ≅ Lf^* ⋙ - ⊗^𝐋_A 𝒩` carrying the comparison map of
the former to that of the latter.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_derivedPullbackTensorRingedTopos_derivedPullbackRingedTopos_comp_topos :
    ∃ e : derivedPullbackTensorRingedTopos f φ hφ N ≅
        derivedPullbackRingedTopos f φ hφ ⋙ derivedTensorProductTopos N,
      Functor.whiskerLeft (toDerivedCategory B) e.hom ≫
          derivedPullbackRingedToposTensorToposCounit f φ hφ N =
        derivedPullbackTensorRingedToposCounit f φ hφ N

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedPullbackRingedToposCompIso
declarations.doc:
Let `(f, f♯) : (Sh(C), O) ⟶ (Sh(C'), O')` and `(g, g♯) : (Sh(C'), O') ⟶ (Sh(C''), O'')` be
morphisms of ringed topoi, `𝒜`, `𝒜'`, `𝒜''` differential graded `O`-, `O'`- and `O''`-algebras,
and `φ : 𝒜' ⟶ f_*𝒜`, `φ' : 𝒜'' ⟶ g_*𝒜'` homomorphisms of differential graded algebras. Then
`L(g ∘ f)^* = Lf^* ∘ Lg^*` as functors `D(𝒜'', d) ⥤ D(𝒜, d)`, the derived pullback along `g ∘ f`
being taken along the composite homomorphism `𝒜'' ⟶ g_*𝒜' ⟶ g_*f_*𝒜 = (g ∘ f)_*𝒜`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPullbackRingedToposCompIso :
    derivedPullbackRingedTopos (X := X) (Y := Z)
        (RingedToposHom.comp (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) g f)
        (toposCompHom (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) f g A φ φ')
        (isUnital_toposCompHom (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) f g A hφ hφ') ≅
      derivedPullbackRingedTopos (X := Y) (Y := Z) g φ' hφ' ⋙
        derivedPullbackRingedTopos (X := X) (Y := Y) f φ hφ

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.isIso_derivedTensorProductMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FTJ.** Let `(𝒞, 𝒪)` be a ringed site, let `𝒜` and `ℬ` be differential graded
`𝒪`-algebras and let `ν : 𝒩 ⟶ 𝒩'` be a homomorphism of differential graded
`(𝒜, ℬ)`-bimodules which is an isomorphism on cohomology sheaves. Then the canonical
transformation `t : (- ⊗^𝐋_𝒜 𝒩) ⟶ (- ⊗^𝐋_𝒜 𝒩')` is an isomorphism of functors
`D(𝒜, d) ⥤ D(ℬ, d)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedTensorProductMap (ν : N ⟶ N') (qis : IsCohomologyIso ν.toHomologicalComplex) :
    IsIso (derivedTensorProductMap ν)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.isIso_derivedTensorProductCounit_of_isGood
declarations.doc:
Let `(𝒞, 𝒪)` be a ringed site, `𝒜`, `𝒜'` differential graded `𝒪`-algebras and `𝒩` a
differential graded `(𝒜, 𝒜')`-bimodule which is good (Tag 0FSA) as a left differential graded
`𝒜`-module. Then `ℳ ⊗^𝐋_𝒜 𝒩 = ℳ ⊗_𝒜 𝒩` for every differential graded `𝒜`-module `ℳ`: the canonical
map from the derived tensor product to the tensor product is an isomorphism of functors.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedTensorProductCounit_of_isGood
    (hN : IsGoodToposBaseChange.{u, v₁, u₁} (Y := X.toRingedTopos)
      (A := (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat X.J X.O)).op)
      N.toLeftDifferentialGradedModule.opRight) :
    IsIso (derivedTensorProductCounit N)
declarations.comment: M ⊗^L_A N = M ⊗_A N for N good as a left module

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedTensorProductCompIso
declarations.doc:
Let `(𝒞, 𝒪)` be a ringed site, let `𝒜`, `𝒜'`, `𝒜''` be sheaves of differential graded
`𝒪`-algebras, let `𝒩` be a differential graded `(𝒜, 𝒜')`-bimodule and `𝒩'` a differential graded
`(𝒜', 𝒜'')`-bimodule. Assume that the canonical map `𝒩 ⊗^𝐋_{𝒜'} 𝒩' ⟶ 𝒩 ⊗_{𝒜'} 𝒩'` of `D(𝒜'', d)` is
an isomorphism. Then `(ℳ ⊗^𝐋_𝒜 𝒩) ⊗^𝐋_{𝒜'} 𝒩' = ℳ ⊗^𝐋_𝒜 (𝒩 ⊗_{𝒜'} 𝒩')` as functors
`D(𝒜, d) ⥤ D(𝒜'', d)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivedTensorProductCompIso
    (hN : IsIso ((derivedTensorProductCounit N').app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A').obj N.toRightModule))) :
    derivedTensorProduct N ⋙ derivedTensorProduct N' ≅
      derivedTensorProduct (DifferentialGradedBimodule.tensorBimodule N N')

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_rightDerivedExtension
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a ringed site and let `(A, d)` be a sheaf of differential graded algebras on it.
Every functor `T : K(Mod(A, d)) ⥤ D` out of the homotopy category of right differential graded
`A`-modules has a right derived extension `RT : D(A, d) ⥤ D` along the localization, and the value
of `RT` on a graded injective and K-injective right differential graded `A`-module `I` is
`T(I)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_rightDerivedExtension
    (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, v} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))
    {H : Type*} [Category H] (T : HomotopyCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A ⥤ H) :
    ∃ (RT : derivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A ⥤ H)
      (β : T ⟶ toDerivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A ⋙ RT),
      RT.IsRightDerivedFunctor β (quasiIsomorphisms.{u, v, max u v w} A) ∧
        ∀ I : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, v, max u v w} A,
          GradedInjective I → IsKInjective I →
            RT.obj ((toDerivedCategory.{u, v, max u v w} A).obj
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A).obj I)) =
              T.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A).obj I)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedSheafHom_isRightDerivedFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FTP (1): the derived internal hom.** Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site, let
`𝒜`, `ℬ` be sheaves of differential graded `O`-algebras and let `𝒩` be a differential graded
`(𝒜, ℬ)`-bimodule. The derived internal hom `RSheafHom_ℬ(𝒩, -) : D(ℬ, d) ⥤ D(𝒜, d)`, with its
comparison map, is the right derived functor of the internal hom functor
`K(SheafHom^dg_ℬ(𝒩, -)) : K(Mod(ℬ, d)) ⥤ K(Mod(𝒜, d))` followed by the localization, and its value
on a graded injective K-injective module `ℐ` is `SheafHom^dg_ℬ(𝒩, ℐ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedSheafHom_isRightDerivedFunctor {X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.{u, u, u}}
    {A B : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)}
    (N : DifferentialGradedBimodule.{u, u, u} A B) :
    (derivedSheafHom N).IsRightDerivedFunctor (derivedSheafHomUnit N)
        (quasiIsomorphisms.{u, u, u} B) ∧
      ∀ I : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} B, IsDGInjective I →
        IsIso ((derivedSheafHomUnit N).app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient B).obj I))
declarations.comment: (1) derived internal hom

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedToposPushforward_isRightDerivedFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FTP (2): the derived pushforward.** Let
`(f, f♯) : (Sh(C), O_C) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)` be a morphism of ringed topoi, let `𝒜` be a sheaf of
differential graded `O_C`-algebras, `ℬ` one of `O_D`-algebras and `φ : ℬ ⟶ f_*𝒜` a homomorphism
of sheaves of differential graded `O_D`-algebras; these preserve `1` in the source, which is the
hypothesis `unital`. The derived pushforward `Rf_* : D(𝒜, d) ⥤ D(ℬ, d)`, with its comparison map,
is the right derived functor of the pushforward `K(f_*) : K(Mod(𝒜, d)) ⥤ K(Mod(ℬ, d))` followed by
the localization, and its value on a graded injective K-injective module `ℐ` is `f_*ℐ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedToposPushforward_isRightDerivedFunctor
    {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedTopos.{u, u, u}} (f : RingedToposHom X Y)
    (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat X.J X.O))
    (B : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat Y.J Y.O))
    (φ : B ⟶ toposPushforwardAlgebra (Osharp := X.O) (Psharp := Y.O)
      (toposDirectImageModules (X := X) (Y := Y) f) A) (unital : φ.IsUnital) :
    (derivedToposPushforward f A B φ unital).IsRightDerivedFunctor
        (derivedToposPushforwardUnit f A B φ unital) (quasiIsomorphisms.{u, u, u} A) ∧
      ∀ I : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} A, IsDGInjective I →
        IsIso ((derivedToposPushforwardUnit f A B φ unital).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A).obj I))
declarations.comment: (2) derived pushforward

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedTensorProductSheafHomAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FTQ**: let `(C, O)` be a ringed site, let `𝒜` and `ℬ` be sheaves of differential
graded `O`-algebras and let `𝒩` be a differential graded `(𝒜, ℬ)`-bimodule. Then the derived
internal hom `RSheafHom_ℬ(𝒩, -) : D(ℬ, d) ⥤ D(𝒜, d)` is right adjoint to the derived tensor
product `- ⊗^𝐋_𝒜 𝒩 : D(𝒜, d) ⥤ D(ℬ, d)`.

The adjunction is derived (Tag 0FND, `CategoryTheory.Adjunction.derived`) from the tensor-hom
adjunction of homotopy categories (Tag 0FRS).
declarations.statement: def derivedTensorProductSheafHomAdjunction : derivedTensorProduct N ⊣ derivedSheafHom N

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedPullbackRingedToposAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FTR.** Let `(f, f♯) : (Sh(C), O_C) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)` be a morphism of
ringed topoi, let `A` be a differential graded `O_C`-algebra, let `B` be a differential graded
`O_D`-algebra and let `φ : B ⟶ f_*A` be a homomorphism of differential graded `O_D`-algebras.
Then `Rf_* : D(A, d) ⥤ D(B, d)` is right adjoint to `Lf^* : D(B, d) ⥤ D(A, d)`.

`Lf^*` is the derived pullback of Tag 0FTG (2), `derivedPullbackRingedTopos`, and `Rf_*` the
derived pushforward of Tag 0FTP (2), `derivedToposPushforward`. The adjunction is derived
(Tag 0FND, `CategoryTheory.Adjunction.derived`) from the adjunction `f^* ⊣ f_*` of homotopy
categories, `homotopyToposPullbackPushforwardAdjunction`, which is Tag 0FRU descended.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPullbackRingedToposAdjunction :
    derivedPullbackRingedTopos f φ hφ ⊣ derivedToposPushforward f A B φ hφ

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_isTriangulated_homotopyToposPushforwardSheafHomTopos
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FTS.** Let `(f, f♯) : (Sh(𝒞), O_𝒞) ⟶ (Sh(𝒟), O_𝒟)` be a morphism of ringed topoi,
let `𝒜` and `𝒜'` be sheaves of differential graded `O_𝒞`-algebras, let `ℬ` be a sheaf of
differential graded `O_𝒟`-algebras, let `φ : ℬ ⟶ f_*𝒜` be a homomorphism and let `𝒩` be a
differential graded `(𝒜, 𝒜')`-bimodule. Then the functor `ℳ ↦ f_*SheafHom^dg_{𝒜'}(𝒩, ℳ)`
induces an exact functor

`K(Mod(𝒜', d)) ⥤ K(Mod(ℬ, d))`

of triangulated categories: there is a functor `Φ` of homotopy categories through which the
functor of modules factors along the two quotient functors, it is the only one, and it commutes
with the translations and carries distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles.

The homomorphism `φ` is unital, as a homomorphism of differential graded algebras is in the
source; the direct image `f_*` is that of sheaves of modules along `(f, f♯)`, made a functor of
right differential graded modules by transporting the action along its lax monoidal structure
and restricting scalars along `φ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isTriangulated_homotopyToposPushforwardSheafHomTopos
    {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedTopos.{u, u, u}} (f : RingedToposHom X Y)
    {A A' : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat X.J X.O)}
    {B : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat Y.J Y.O)}
    (φ : B ⟶ toposPushforwardAlgebra (Osharp := X.O) (Psharp := Y.O)
      (toposDirectImageModules (X := X) (Y := Y) f) A) (hφ : φ.IsUnital)
    (N : DifferentialGradedBimodule.{u, u, u} A A') :
    ∃ (Φ : HomotopyCategory.{u, u, u} A' ⥤ HomotopyCategory.{u, u, u} B)
      (_ : Φ.CommShift ℤ), Φ.IsTriangulated ∧
      HomotopyCategory.quotient A' ⋙ Φ =
        (sheafHomFunctor N ⋙
          toposPushforward (toposDirectImageModules (X := X) (Y := Y) f) φ hφ) ⋙
          HomotopyCategory.quotient B ∧
      ∀ Ψ : HomotopyCategory.{u, u, u} A' ⥤ HomotopyCategory.{u, u, u} B,
        HomotopyCategory.quotient A' ⋙ Ψ =
          (sheafHomFunctor N ⋙
            toposPushforward (toposDirectImageModules (X := X) (Y := Y) f) φ hφ) ⋙
            HomotopyCategory.quotient B → Ψ = Φ

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.exists_iso_derivedToposPushforwardSheafHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FTT.** Let `(f, f♯) : (Sh(𝒞), O_𝒞) ⟶ (Sh(𝒟), O_𝒟)` be a morphism of ringed topoi,
let `𝒜` and `𝒜'` be sheaves of differential graded `O_𝒞`-algebras, let `ℬ` be a sheaf of
differential graded `O_𝒟`-algebras, let `φ : ℬ ⟶ f_*𝒜` be a homomorphism and let `𝒩` be a
differential graded `(𝒜, 𝒜')`-bimodule. Let `RT : D(𝒜', d) ⥤ D(ℬ, d)` be the right derived
extension of the functor `ℳ ↦ f_*SheafHom^dg_{𝒜'}(𝒩, ℳ)` of [Stacks, Tag 0FTS], let
`RSheafHom^dg_{𝒜'}(𝒩, -)` be the derived internal hom and `Rf_*` the derived pushforward of
[Stacks, Tag 0FTP]. Then

`RT(ℳ) = Rf_* RSheafHom^dg_{𝒜'}(𝒩, ℳ)`

functorially in `ℳ`: there is an isomorphism of functors `RT ≅ RSheafHom^dg_{𝒜'}(𝒩, -) ⋙ Rf_*`,
and it may be chosen compatible with the comparison maps, which is
`exists_iso_derivedToposPushforwardSheafHom_fac`.

The homomorphism `φ` is unital, as a homomorphism of differential graded algebras is in the
source; the direct image `f_*` is that of sheaves of modules along `(f, f♯)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_derivedToposPushforwardSheafHom
    (N : DifferentialGradedBimodule.{u, u, u} A A') :
    Nonempty (derivedToposPushforwardSheafHom f φ hφ N ≅
      derivedSheafHom (X := X.toRingedSite) N ⋙ derivedToposPushforward f A B φ hφ)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedToposPushforward_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0FTU.** Let `(f, f♯) : (Sh(C), O) ⟶ (Sh(C'), O')` and
`(g, g♯) : (Sh(C'), O') ⟶ (Sh(C''), O'')` be morphisms of ringed topoi. Let `A`, `A'` and `A''`
be a differential graded `O`-algebra, `O'`-algebra and `O''`-algebra, and let `φ : A' ⟶ f_*A`
and `φ' : A'' ⟶ g_*A'` be homomorphisms of differential graded algebras. Then
`R(g ∘ f)_* = Rg_* ∘ Rf_* : D(A, d) ⟶ D(A'', d)`.

Here `R(g ∘ f)_*` is the derived pushforward along the composite morphism of ringed topoi
`g.comp f` and the composite homomorphism `A'' ⟶ g_*A' ⟶ g_*f_*A = (g ∘ f)_*A`
(`toposCompAlgebraHom`, degreewise `toposCompAlgebraHom_f`), and each derived pushforward is the
right derived extension of the direct image of differential graded modules on homotopy
categories (`derivedToposPushforward`). The three clauses are:

1. the direct image of differential graded modules along `g ∘ f` is the direct image along `f`
   followed by the direct image along `g`, by the isomorphism `ηU` which in every degree is the
   comparison `(g ∘ f)_* ≅ g_* ∘ f_*` of direct images of sheaves of modules;
2. `R(g ∘ f)_*` is isomorphic to `Rf_*` followed by `Rg_*`, by an isomorphism `ηD`;
3. `ηD` is the one induced by `ηU` (`IsInducedDerivedCompIso`): composed with the comparison map
   of `R(g ∘ f)_*` it is the image of `ηU` followed by the composite of the comparison maps of
   `Rf_*` and `Rg_*`.

The equality of the source is an isomorphism here, the derived functors being pinned by their
universal property. The ringed topoi have their sites and structure sheaves in one universe, the
setting of the K-injective resolutions of Tag 0FT0.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedToposPushforward_comp
    (f : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom X Y) (g : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom Y Z)
    (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat X.J X.O))
    (A' : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat Y.J Y.O))
    (A'' : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat Z.J Z.O))
    (φ : A' ⟶ toposPushforwardAlgebra (Osharp := X.O) (Psharp := Y.O)
      (toposDirectImageModules (X := X) (Y := Y) f.toModulesHom) A)
    (unitalφ : φ.IsUnital)
    (φ' : A'' ⟶ toposPushforwardAlgebra (Osharp := Y.O) (Psharp := Z.O)
      (toposDirectImageModules (X := Y) (Y := Z) g.toModulesHom) A')
    (unitalφ' : φ'.IsUnital) :
    ∃ (ηU : toposPushforward (toposDirectImageModules (X := X) (Y := Z) (g.comp f).toModulesHom)
          (toposCompAlgebraHom (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) f g A φ φ')
          (isUnital_toposCompAlgebraHom (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) f g A unitalφ unitalφ') ≅
        toposPushforward (toposDirectImageModules (X := X) (Y := Y) f.toModulesHom) φ unitalφ ⋙
          toposPushforward (toposDirectImageModules (X := Y) (Y := Z) g.toModulesHom) φ' unitalφ')
      (ηD : derivedToposPushforward (X := X) (Y := Z) (g.comp f).toModulesHom A A''
          (toposCompAlgebraHom (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) f g A φ φ')
          (isUnital_toposCompAlgebraHom (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) f g A unitalφ unitalφ') ≅
        derivedToposPushforward (X := X) (Y := Y) f.toModulesHom A A' φ unitalφ ⋙
          derivedToposPushforward (X := Y) (Y := Z) g.toModulesHom A' A'' φ' unitalφ'),
      (∀ (M : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} A) (n : ℤ),
        (ηU.inv.app M).toHomologicalComplex.f n =
          (toposDirectImageModulesCompIso (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) f g).hom.app
            (M.complex.X n)) ∧
      IsInducedDerivedCompIso ηU ηD

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedSheafHomTensorBimoduleIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0FTV**: let `(C, O)` be a ringed site, let `𝒜`, `𝒜'`, `𝒜''` be sheaves of
differential graded `O`-algebras, let `𝒩` be a differential graded `(𝒜, 𝒜')`-bimodule and `𝒩'` a
differential graded `(𝒜', 𝒜'')`-bimodule, and assume that the canonical map
`𝒩 ⊗^𝐋_{𝒜'} 𝒩' ⟶ 𝒩 ⊗_{𝒜'} 𝒩'` of `D(𝒜'', d)` is a quasi-isomorphism, `𝒩` being read as a right
differential graded `𝒜'`-module. Then

`RSheafHom_{𝒜''}(𝒩 ⊗_{𝒜'} 𝒩', -) ≅ RSheafHom_{𝒜'}(𝒩, RSheafHom_{𝒜''}(𝒩', -))`

as functors `D(𝒜'', d) ⥤ D(𝒜, d)`. Both are right adjoint to `- ⊗^𝐋_𝒜 (𝒩 ⊗_{𝒜'} 𝒩')`: the first
by Tag 0FTQ, the second as the composite of the adjunctions of Tag 0FTQ for `𝒩` and `𝒩'`,
transported along the isomorphism `(- ⊗^𝐋_𝒜 𝒩) ⊗^𝐋_{𝒜'} 𝒩' ≅ - ⊗^𝐋_𝒜 (𝒩 ⊗_{𝒜'} 𝒩')` of
Tag 0FTL.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSheafHomTensorBimoduleIso
    (hN : IsIso ((derivedTensorProductCounit N').app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A').obj N.toRightModule))) :
    derivedSheafHom (DifferentialGradedBimodule.tensorBimodule N N') ≅
      derivedSheafHom N' ⋙ derivedSheafHom N

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedToposPushforwardForgetIsoTopos
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FTW.** Let `(f, f♯) : (Sh(C), O_C) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)` be a morphism of
ringed topoi, let `A` be a sheaf of differential graded `O_C`-algebras, `B` one of
`O_D`-algebras and `φ : B ⟶ f_*A` a homomorphism of sheaves of differential graded
`O_D`-algebras. Homomorphisms of differential graded algebras preserve `1` in the source, while a
homomorphism in this development need not, so this is the hypothesis `hφ : φ.IsUnital`. Then the
square

`D(A, d) ⥤ D(O_C) ⥤ D(O_D)` and `D(A, d) ⥤ D(B, d) ⥤ D(O_D)`

of the forgetful functors and the derived pushforwards commutes: `Rf_* ⋙ forget ≅ forget ⋙ Rf_*`.
Both composites are right derived functors of the direct image of differential graded modules
followed by forgetting the action, and the isomorphism is the one compatible with their
comparison maps.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivedToposPushforwardForgetIsoTopos
    {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedTopos.{u, u, u}} (f : RingedToposHom X Y)
    (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat X.J X.O))
    (B : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat Y.J Y.O))
    (φ : B ⟶ toposPushforwardAlgebra (Osharp := X.O) (Psharp := Y.O)
      (toposDirectImageModules (X := X) (Y := Y) f) A) (hφ : φ.IsUnital) :
    derivedToposPushforward f A B φ hφ ⋙ derivedForget B ≅
      derivedForget A ⋙ derivedModulePushforward (X := X) (Y := Y) f

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.cohomologyAddEquivDerivedHom
declarations.doc:
Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site, `A` a sheaf of differential graded `O`-algebras, `M` a right
differential graded `A`-module and `n` an integer. Then `H^n(C, M) = Hom_{D(A, d)}(A, M[n])`,
where on the left `M` is viewed as a complex of `O`-modules.

The identification is the source's: for a quasi-isomorphism `M[n] ⟶ I` into a graded injective
and K-injective module (Tag 0FT0), morphisms `A ⟶ M[n]` of `D(A, d)` are morphisms `A ⟶ I` of
the homotopy category (Tag 0FT8), which are morphisms `O ⟶ I` of complexes up to homotopy, and
these compute `H^0(RΓ(C, I)) = H^n(C, M)`. The last step is the source's `RΓ(C, M) = Γ(C, I)`;
it is proved here by comparing with a K-injective resolution of `I` in `D(O)`, using that `O`
is resolved by flat and K-flat right differential graded `(O, 0)`-modules, the tensor product
with `A` of such a resolution is a resolution of `A` (Tag 0FSI), and extension of scalars along
`(O, 0) ⟶ A` is left adjoint to restriction (Tag 0FRP).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cohomologyAddEquivDerivedHom
    (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))
    (M : DifferentialGradedModule.{u, u, u} A) (n : ℤ) :
    cohomology M n ≃+
      ((toDerivedCategory.{u, u, u} A).obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A).obj (regularModule A)) ⟶
        ((toDerivedCategory.{u, u, u} A).obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A).obj M))⟦n⟧)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.isEquivalence_derivedExtension
declarations.doc:
Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site and let `φ : A ⟶ B` be a homomorphism of sheaves of
differential graded `O`-algebras which induces an isomorphism on cohomology sheaves. Then derived
extension of scalars

`D(A, d) ⟶ D(B, d)`, `M ↦ M ⊗^𝐋_A B`

is an equivalence of categories.

The source's functor `M ↦ M ⊗^𝐋_A B` is defined only for a homomorphism `φ` preserving `1`,
since `B` is made a left `A`-module through `φ`; so `PreservesOne` is implicit in the
statement.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_derivedExtension
    {A B : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)}
    (φ : A ⟶ B) (unital : φ.PreservesOne) (qis : φ.IsQuasiIso) :
    (derivedExtension φ unital).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.freeDGAlgebra_colimit_isGoodToposBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FU1.** *"In the situation above the differential graded `O`-algebra `A = colim Aᵢ` has
the following property: for any morphism `(f, f^♯) : (Sh(C'), O') ⟶ (Sh(C), O)` of ringed topoi,
the pullback `f^*A` is flat as a graded `O'`-module and is K-flat as a complex of
`O'`-modules."*

The situation: a family `𝒮` of sheaves of graded sets indexed by a nonempty well-ordered set of
levels (the source's `S₀, S₁, …`, indexed by `ℕ`), and a derivation datum `δ` on the free graded
`O`-algebra `A = O⟨⨿ᵢ Sᵢ⟩` whose values are closed (`hδ`) and triangular (`htri`: the value on a
generator of level `k` lies, locally, in the subalgebra generated by the letters of level `< k`,
which is the source's `δₖ : Sₖ ⟶ A_{k-1}`), with the Leibniz extension of `δ` as differential.

The first conjunct is `A = colim Aᵢ`: `A` is the colimit of the stages `Aᵢ`, the subcomplexes
spanned by the words in the letters of level at most `i`. The second is the property: `A`,
regarded as a right differential graded module over `(O, 0)`, is good in the sense of Tag 0FSA,
that is flat as a graded `O`-module, K-flat as a complex of `O`-modules, and the same for its
pullback along every morphism of ringed topoi.
declarations.statement:
theorem freeDGAlgebra_colimit_isGoodToposBaseChange :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (stagesCocone 𝒮 δ hδ htri)) ∧
      IsGoodToposBaseChange.{u, v₁, u₁}
      (toUnitModule (Osharp := X.O) (freeDGAlgebra (Osharp := X.O) 𝒮 δ hδ))

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.exists_good_quasiIso_differentialGradedAlgebra
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0FU2.** *"Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site. Let `(B, d)` be a differential graded
`O`-algebra. There exists a quasi-isomorphism of differential graded `O`-algebras
`(A, d) ⟶ (B, d)` such that `A` is graded flat and K-flat as a complex of `O`-modules and such
that the same is true after pullback by any morphism of ringed topoi."*

The homomorphism is unital; graded flatness, K-flatness and their persistence after pullback are
the goodness of Tag 0FSA of `A` over `(O, 0)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_good_quasiIso_differentialGradedAlgebra
    (B : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat Y.J Y.O)) :
    ∃ (A : DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (toRingCat Y.J Y.O)) (f : A ⟶ B),
      (∀ U : Y.Cᵒᵖ, (f.toHomologicalComplex.f 0).val.app U (A.one.eval U) = B.one.eval U) ∧
        QuasiIso f.toHomologicalComplex ∧
          IsGoodToposBaseChange.{u, v₁, u₁}
            (DifferentialGradedAlgebra.toUnitModule (Osharp := Y.O) A)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FlatKunneth.isIso_kunnethMapOfSheavesSchemeCanonical_of_affineDiagonal
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FU4].**  Let `a : X ⟶ S` and `b : Y ⟶ S` be morphisms of schemes with `S`
affine, let `A = Γ(S, 𝒪_S)`, and let `p`, `q` be the projections of `X ×_S Y`.  If `ℱ` on `X` and
`𝒢` on `Y` are `S`-flat and quasi-coherent and `X` and `Y` are quasi-compact with affine
diagonal, then the Künneth map of [Stacks, Tag 0G49]

`RΓ(X, ℱ) ⊗^𝐋_A RΓ(Y, 𝒢) ⟶ RΓ(X ×_S Y, p^*ℱ ⊗_{𝒪_{X ×_S Y}} q^*𝒢)`

is an isomorphism in `D(A)`.  The map is
`Stacks.Cohomology.GlobalKunneth.kunnethMapOfSheavesSchemeCanonical`, built from the global cup
product of Cohomology, Section 0FKU with no parameter.

Nothing is carried.  Quasi-compactness and affineness of the diagonals give the
quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of `a` and `b`; affineness of `S`, flatness of `𝒢` and
quasi-coherence of `ℱ` and `𝒢` are consumed by
`isIso_kunnethMapOfSheavesSchemeCanonical_of_isFlatOver`, which this specializes.  Flatness of
`ℱ` is the tag's hypothesis but the proof does not need it: one flat factor suffices, by the
Tor vanishing of [Stacks, Tag 0GMU].
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_kunnethMapOfSheavesSchemeCanonical_of_affineDiagonal [IsAffine S] [CompactSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from Y))]
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (_hF : IsFlatOver a.toLRSHom.toShHom F) (hG : IsFlatOver b.toLRSHom.toShHom G) :
    IsIso (kunnethMapOfSheavesSchemeCanonical a b F G)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.GlobalKunneth.isIso_kunnethMapOfSheavesScheme
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FU4].**  Let `a : X ⟶ S` and `b : Y ⟶ S` be morphisms of schemes with `S`
affine, let `A = Γ(S, 𝒪_S)` and let `p`, `q` be the projections of `W = X ×_S Y`.  If `X` and `Y`
are quasi-compact with affine diagonal and `ℱ` on `X`, `𝒢` on `Y` are quasi-coherent and flat
over `S`, then the Künneth map of [Stacks, Tag 0G49]

`RΓ(X, ℱ) ⊗^𝐋_A RΓ(Y, 𝒢) ⟶ RΓ(X ×_S Y, ℱ ⊠ 𝒢)`

is an isomorphism in `D(A)`.

The three inputs of the proof are carried as the hypotheses `hκ`, `hrel` and `hext`, and the
geometric hypotheses are therefore not consumed; the implementation notes of this file say what
each of the three is and why none is available in the library.  `hκ` is the invertibility of the
