`A`-linear global cup product on the affine base, `hrel` is [Stacks, Tag 0FLQ] at the two sheaves
placed in degree zero, and `hext` is the invertibility of the derived-to-ordinary comparison in
which the source consumes the flatness of `ℱ` and `𝒢`.  What is proved here is that the three
suffice.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_kunnethMapOfSheavesScheme [IsAffine S] [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from Y))]
    (κ : GlobalCupProduct S.toRingedSpace) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (_hF : IsFlatOver a.toLRSHom.toShHom F) (_hG : IsFlatOver b.toLRSHom.toShHom G)
    (hκ : IsIso (κ.app ((derivedPushforward a.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (singleD F),
      (derivedPushforward b.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (singleD G))))
    (hrel : IsIso (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedKunneth.kunnethMap a.toLRSHom.toShHom
      b.toLRSHom.toShHom (pullback.fst a b).toLRSHom.toShHom
      (pullback.snd a b).toLRSHom.toShHom (pullback.fst a b ≫ a).toLRSHom.toShHom rfl
      (toShHom_pullback_condition a b) (singleD F) (singleD G)))
    (hext : IsIso (externalTensorComparison (pullback.fst a b).toLRSHom.toShHom
      (pullback.snd a b).toLRSHom.toShHom F G)) :
    IsIso (kunnethMapOfSheavesScheme a b κ F G)
declarations.comment: the isomorphism at X ×_S Y; three inputs are carried, so the geometric hypotheses are not consumed: hκ, invertibility of the global cup product on the affine base, which no bare GlobalCupProduct has; hrel, Tag 0FLQ at the sheaves in degree zero; hext, the 06YU comparison, which the tag's relative S-flatness cannot discharge in this library

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The relative de Rham complex of `φ`, with wedge multiplication and the unit of the exterior
algebra, as a sheaf of differential graded `A`-algebras.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra :
    _root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (underlyingRingSheaf A)
declarations.comment: relative_de_rham_dga

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra_complex
declarations.doc:
The complex underlying the relative de Rham differential graded algebra is the relative de
Rham complex, extended by zero to negative degrees.
declarations.statement:
theorem deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra_complex :
    (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D).complex = deRhamComplexInt B D
declarations.comment: relative_de_rham_dga

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra_mul
declarations.doc:
Multiplication in the relative de Rham differential graded algebra is wedge multiplication of
differential forms, on every pair of homogeneous local sections.
declarations.statement:
theorem deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra_mul (p q : ℕ) (U : (Opens X.carrier)ᵒᵖ)
    (ω : ((deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D).complex.X (p : ℤ)).val.obj U)
    (η : ((deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D).complex.X (q : ℤ)).val.obj U)
    (ω' : (B.exteriorPower p).val.obj U) (η' : (B.exteriorPower q).val.obj U)
    (hω : HEq ω ω') (hη : HEq η η') :
    HEq (((deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D).mul (p : ℤ) (q : ℤ)).app U ω η)
      (formProduct B p q U ω' η')
declarations.comment: relative_de_rham_dga

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra_one
declarations.doc:
The unit of the relative de Rham differential graded algebra is the unit of the exterior
algebra of `Ω`.
declarations.statement:
theorem deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra_one (U : (Opens X.carrier)ᵒᵖ) :
    HEq ((deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D).one.eval U) (B.exterior.one.eval U)
declarations.comment: relative_de_rham_dga

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.summandValue_wedgeProduct_heq_mul
declarations.doc:
**The multiplication `deRhamDerivedMul` is that of the differential graded algebra
`Ω^•`** (the first assertion of Tag 0FU6, `deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra`): on the summand
`Ω^p ⊗ Ω^q` of the total complex the wedge product of Tag 0FM2 underlying `deRhamDerivedMul`
sends a local pure tensor `ω ⊗ η` to the product `ω · η` in the differential graded algebra.
declarations.statement:
theorem summandValue_wedgeProduct_heq_mul (p q : ℕ) (U : (Opens X.carrier)ᵒᵖ)
    (ω : (deRhamTerm B p).val.obj U) (η : (deRhamTerm B q).val.obj U)
    (x : ((deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D).complex.X (p : ℤ)).val.obj U)
    (y : ((deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D).complex.X (q : ℤ)).val.obj U)
    (hx : HEq x ω) (hy : HEq y η) :
    HEq (((deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D).mul (p : ℤ) (q : ℤ)).app U x y)
      (summandValue B D (wedgeProduct B D) p q U ω η)
declarations.comment: the multiplication of mu is that of the differential graded algebra

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.deRhamRelativeCupProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FU6: the relative cup product of a commutative square.**  For a
commutative square of schemes

```
X --f--> Y
|p       |q
v        v
S --h--> T
```

the relative cup product
`μ : Rf_*Ω^•_{X/S} ⊗^𝐋_{q⁻¹𝒪_T} Rf_*Ω^•_{X/S} ⟶ Rf_*Ω^•_{X/S}` in `D(Y, q⁻¹𝒪_T)`: the relative cup
product of Tag 0B68 for the morphism of ringed spaces `(X, p⁻¹𝒪_S) ⟶ (Y, q⁻¹𝒪_T)` of the square,
followed by `Rf_*` of the wedge multiplication `Ω^•_{X/S} ⊗^𝐋 Ω^•_{X/S} ⟶ Ω^•_{X/S}` of the
differential graded `p⁻¹𝒪_S`-algebra `Ω^•_{X/S}`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def deRhamRelativeCupProduct (w : f ≫ q = p ≫ h) :
    ((derivedTensorProductFunctor (SheafOfModules.baseRingedSpace (X := Y.toRingedSpace)
          ((TopCat.Sheaf.pullback CommRingCat.{u} q.base).obj T.sheaf)).sheaf).obj
        ((derivedPushforward (squareHom w)).obj (deRhamDerived p))).obj
        ((derivedPushforward (squareHom w)).obj (deRhamDerived p)) ⟶
      (derivedPushforward (squareHom w)).obj (deRhamDerived p)
declarations.comment: the relative cup product mu of a commutative square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.deRhamRelativeCupProduct_assoc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FU6: the relative cup product is associative**:
`(μ ⊗ 1) ≫ μ = α ≫ (1 ⊗ μ) ≫ μ` in `D(Y, q⁻¹𝒪_T)`, where `α` is the associativity constraint of
the derived tensor product (Tag 0FPB).
declarations.statement:
theorem deRhamRelativeCupProduct_assoc (w : f ≫ q = p ≫ h) :
    (Functor.uncurry.obj (derivedTensorProductFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.baseRingedSpace (X := Y.toRingedSpace)
            ((TopCat.Sheaf.pullback CommRingCat.{u} q.base).obj T.sheaf)).sheaf)).map
        (deRhamRelativeCupProduct w ×ₘ
          𝟙 ((derivedPushforward (squareHom w)).obj (deRhamDerived p))) ≫
        deRhamRelativeCupProduct w =
      derivedAssociator (SheafOfModules.baseRingedSpace (X := Y.toRingedSpace)
            ((TopCat.Sheaf.pullback CommRingCat.{u} q.base).obj T.sheaf))
          ((derivedPushforward (squareHom w)).obj (deRhamDerived p))
          ((derivedPushforward (squareHom w)).obj (deRhamDerived p))
          ((derivedPushforward (squareHom w)).obj (deRhamDerived p)) ≫
        (Functor.uncurry.obj (derivedTensorProductFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.baseRingedSpace (X := Y.toRingedSpace)
              ((TopCat.Sheaf.pullback CommRingCat.{u} q.base).obj T.sheaf)).sheaf)).map
          (𝟙 ((derivedPushforward (squareHom w)).obj (deRhamDerived p)) ×ₘ
            deRhamRelativeCupProduct w) ≫
          deRhamRelativeCupProduct w
declarations.comment: mu is associative

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.lerayMap_deRhamRelativeCupProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FU6: the relative cup product induces the cup product on
cohomology.**  For `ξ ∈ Hⁱ(Y, Rf_*Ω^•_{X/S})` and `η ∈ Hʲ(Y, Rf_*Ω^•_{X/S})`, the Leray
identification `Hⁿ(Y, Rf_*Ω^•_{X/S}) = Hⁿ(X, Ω^•_{X/S}) = Hⁿ_{dR}(X/S)` carries
`Hⁱ⁺ʲ(RΓ(Y, μ))(ξ ∪ η)` -- the cup product on `Y` followed by `μ` -- to the cup product
`leray ξ ∪ leray η` on de Rham cohomology of Section 50.4 (Tag 0FM3, `deRhamCohomologyCup`).
declarations.statement:
theorem lerayMap_deRhamRelativeCupProduct (w : f ≫ q = p ≫ h) (i j : ℤ)
    (ξ : cohomologyModule ((derivedPushforward (squareHom w)).obj (deRhamDerived p)) i)
    (η : cohomologyModule ((derivedPushforward (squareHom w)).obj (deRhamDerived p)) j) :
    lerayMap (squareHom w) (deRhamDerived p) (i + j)
      (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ (i + j)).map
        ((baseSections (SheafOfModules.baseRingedSpace (X := Y.toRingedSpace)
            ((TopCat.Sheaf.pullback CommRingCat.{u} q.base).obj T.sheaf))).map
          (deRhamRelativeCupProduct w))).hom
        ((cupPairing (cupProductOnSpace (SheafOfModules.baseRingedSpace (X := Y.toRingedSpace)
            ((TopCat.Sheaf.pullback CommRingCat.{u} q.base).obj T.sheaf))) _ _ i j).hom
          (ξ ⊗ₜ η))) =
      SheafOfModules.deRhamCohomologyCup _ _ i j (lerayMap (squareHom w) (deRhamDerived p) i ξ)
        (lerayMap (squareHom w) (deRhamDerived p) j η)
declarations.comment: mu induces the cup product on cohomology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.deRhamCohomologyCup_eq_deRhamClassMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FU7, property (3).** The morphism `ξ' : Ω^• ⟶ Ω^•[n]` attached to
`ξ ∈ H^n_{dR}(X/S)` sends `η ∈ H^m_{dR}(X/S)` to `ξ ∪ η ∈ H^{n + m}_{dR}(X/S)`: the map `ξ'`
induces on `H^m(X, -)`, read through `H^m(X, Ω^•[n]) = H^{n + m}_{dR}(X/S)`, is left cup product
with `ξ` (the cup product of Tag 0FM3).
declarations.statement:
theorem deRhamCohomologyCup_eq_deRhamClassMorphism (n m : ℤ) (ξ : deRhamCohomology B D n)
    (η : deRhamCohomology B D m) :
    deRhamCohomologyCup B D n m ξ η =
      (deRhamShiftHomologyIso B D n m (n + m) rfl).hom
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ m).map
          ((derivedSectionsBase A).map (deRhamClassMorphism B D n ξ)) η)
declarations.comment:
property (3): the morphism xi' sends eta in H^m_dR to the cup product xi cup eta in
  H^{n+m}_dR, read through H^m(X, Omega^bullet[n]) = H^{n+m}_dR

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.deRhamRelativeCupProduct_deRhamClassMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FU7, property (5).** For a morphism of ringed spaces
`f : (X, A) ⟶ (Y, 𝒪_Y)` (for a commutative square of schemes as in Remark 0FU6 this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.squareHom`, with `A = p⁻¹𝒪_S` and `𝒪_Y` replaced by `q⁻¹𝒪_T`) and
`ξ ∈ H^n_{dR}`, the square

`Rf_*Ω^• ⊗^𝐋 Rf_*Ω^• --μ--> Rf_*Ω^•`, `Rf_*Ω^•[n] ⊗^𝐋 Rf_*Ω^• --μ--> Rf_*Ω^•[n]`

with vertical maps `Rf_*ξ' ⊗ 1` and `Rf_*ξ'` commutes in `D(Y)`. The top `μ` is the relative cup
product `deRhamRelativeCupProduct` of Remark 0FU6; the bottom `μ` is the relative cup product
followed by `Rf_*` of the multiplication `derivedShiftedMul` of the right differential graded
module `Ω^•[n]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem deRhamRelativeCupProduct_deRhamClassMorphism (n : ℤ) (ξ : deRhamCohomology B D n) :
    Eq ((Functor.uncurry.obj
          (Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor Y.sheaf)).map
        ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward F).map
          (deRhamClassMorphism B D n ξ) ×ₘ
          𝟙 ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward F).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra (X := X) (A := A) (φ := φ) B D).complex))) ≫
        Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedRelativeCupProduct.relativeCupProduct F
          ((DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra (X := X) (A := A) (φ := φ) B D).complex)⟦n⟧)
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra (X := X) (A := A) (φ := φ) B D).complex) ≫
        (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward F).map
          (derivedShiftedMul (S := baseRingedSpace A)
            (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra (X := X) (A := A) (φ := φ) B D) n))
      (deRhamRelativeCupProduct B D F ≫
        (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward F).map
          (deRhamClassMorphism B D n ξ))
declarations.comment:
property (5): for a morphism of ringed spaces f : (X, A) -> (Y, O_Y), as for a
  diagram of Remark 0FU6, the square of relative cup products mu with vertical maps Rf_* xi' tensor
  id and Rf_* xi' commutes in D(Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.lift_and_unit_iff_eq_restrictShiftedHom_deRhamClassMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FU7, property (4).** The construction of `ξ'` commutes with
restriction to opens: for an open `U ⊆ X`, write `Ω^•_{U/S} = Ω^•_{X/S}|_U` for the restriction
of the de Rham complex (a sheaf of differential graded algebras over the slice site at `U`) and
`ξ|_U ∈ Hom_{D(f^{-1}𝒪_S|_U)}(f^{-1}𝒪_S|_U, Ω^•_{U/S}[n]) = H^n_{dR}(U/S)` for the restriction of
`ξ`. A morphism `f : Ω^•_{U/S} ⟶ Ω^•_{U/S}[n]` of `D(f^{-1}𝒪_S|_U)` is the map corresponding to
`ξ|_U` (it lifts to the derived category of right differential graded `Ω^•_{U/S}`-modules, and
its value `f(1)` at the unit is `ξ|_U`) if and only if it is the restriction `ξ'|_U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem lift_and_unit_iff_eq_restrictShiftedHom_deRhamClassMorphism (n : ℤ)
    (ξ : deRhamCohomology B D n) (U : Opens X.carrier)
    (f : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.regularModule
        (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgaOver (X := baseSite A) U
          (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D))).complex ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.regularModule
        (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgaOver (X := baseSite A) U
          (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D))).complex)⟦n⟧) :
    ((∃ g' : (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.toDerivedCategory.{u, u, u}
        (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgaOver (X := baseSite A) U
          (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D))).obj
        ((_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.HomotopyCategory.quotient
          (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgaOver (X := baseSite A) U
            (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D))).obj
          (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.regularModule
            (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgaOver (X := baseSite A) U
              (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D)))) ⟶
      ((_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.toDerivedCategory.{u, u, u}
        (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgaOver (X := baseSite A) U
          (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D))).obj
        ((_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.HomotopyCategory.quotient
          (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgaOver (X := baseSite A) U
            (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D))).obj
          (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.regularModule
            (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgaOver (X := baseSite A) U
              (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D)))))⟦n⟧,
        Eq (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.derivedForgetShiftedHom
          (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgaOver (X := baseSite A) U
            (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D))
          (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.regularModule
            (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgaOver (X := baseSite A) U
              (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D))) n g') f) ∧
      Eq (DerivedCategory.Q.map (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.unitComplexRingHom
          (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.dgaOver (X := baseSite A) U
            (deRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra B D))) ≫ f)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.structureSheafComplexOverHom
            (X := baseSite A) U) ≫
          _root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.restrictShiftedHom (X := baseSite A) U n
            (deRhamDerivedClass B D n ξ))) ↔
      Eq f (_root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedModule.restrictShiftedHom (X := baseSite A) U n
        (deRhamClassMorphism B D n ξ))
declarations.comment:
property (4): for an open U, the morphism corresponding to xi|_U (it lifts to the
  derived category of right differential graded Omega^bullet|_U-modules and its value at the unit is
  xi|_U) is the restriction xi'|_U

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.deRhamClassMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FU7.** The morphism

`ξ' : Ω^•_{X/S} ⟶ Ω^•_{X/S}[n]`

in `D(f^{-1}𝒪_S)` attached to a relative de Rham cohomology class `ξ ∈ H^n_{dR}(X/S)`: the
morphism of `D(Ω^•, d)` which Section 0FU3 attaches to `ξ`, with its differential graded
structure forgotten.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev deRhamClassMorphism (n : ℤ) (ξ : deRhamCohomology B D n) :
    deRhamDerivedObject B D ⟶ (deRhamDerivedObject B D)⟦n⟧
declarations.comment:
the morphism xi' : Omega^bullet -> Omega^bullet[n] of D(f^{-1}O_S) attached to a de
  Rham class xi in H^n_dR by Differential Graded Sheaves Section 0FU3

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.exists_lift_deRhamClassMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FU7, property (1).** `ξ'` lifts to a morphism of the derived category
of right differential graded `Ω^•_{X/S}`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_lift_deRhamClassMorphism (n : ℤ) (ξ : deRhamCohomology B D n) :
    ∃ g : deRhamDerivedRegular B D ⟶ (deRhamDerivedRegular B D)⟦n⟧,
      deRhamForgetHom B D n g = deRhamClassMorphism B D n ξ
declarations.comment:
property (1): the morphism lifts to the derived category of right differential
  graded modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.deRhamEvalOne_deRhamClassMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FU7, property (2).** `ξ'(1) = ξ` in
`H^0(X, Ω^•_{X/S}[n]) = H^n_{dR}(X/S)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem deRhamEvalOne_deRhamClassMorphism (n : ℤ) (ξ : deRhamCohomology B D n) :
    deRhamEvalOne B D n (deRhamClassMorphism B D n ξ) = ξ
declarations.comment: property (2): the value of the morphism at the unit is the class

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.eq_deRhamClassMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FU7, uniqueness.** A morphism `Ω^•_{X/S} ⟶ Ω^•_{X/S}[n]` of
`D(f^{-1}𝒪_S)` which lifts to the derived category of right differential graded
`Ω^•_{X/S}`-modules and whose value at the unit is `ξ` is `ξ'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_deRhamClassMorphism (n : ℤ) (ξ : deRhamCohomology B D n)
    {f : deRhamDerivedObject B D ⟶ (deRhamDerivedObject B D)⟦n⟧}
    (hlift : ∃ g : deRhamDerivedRegular B D ⟶ (deRhamDerivedRegular B D)⟦n⟧,
      deRhamForgetHom B D n g = f)
    (hev : deRhamEvalOne B D n f = ξ) :
    f = deRhamClassMorphism B D n ξ
declarations.comment:
uniqueness: a morphism with properties (1) and (2) is the morphism attached to the
  class

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.existsUnique_deRhamClassMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FU7.** A class `ξ ∈ H^n_{dR}(X/S)` determines a unique morphism
`ξ' : Ω^•_{X/S} ⟶ Ω^•_{X/S}[n]` of `D(f^{-1}𝒪_S)` with properties (1) and (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_deRhamClassMorphism (n : ℤ) (ξ : deRhamCohomology B D n) :
    ∃! f : deRhamDerivedObject B D ⟶ (deRhamDerivedObject B D)⟦n⟧,
      (∃ g : deRhamDerivedRegular B D ⟶ (deRhamDerivedRegular B D)⟦n⟧,
        deRhamForgetHom B D n g = f) ∧ deRhamEvalOne B D n f = ξ
declarations.comment:
existence and uniqueness: a class determines a unique morphism with properties (1)
  and (2)

declarations.name: KaehlerDifferential.deRhamDifferential_maps_gradedDifferentialFormComponent
declarations.doc:
The de Rham differential preserves the total degree of homogeneous
differential forms.
declarations.statement:
theorem deRhamDifferential_maps_gradedDifferentialFormComponent
    {G : Type u} {R : Type v} {A : Type w}
    [AddCommMonoid G] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (gr : G → Submodule R A) (hunit : (1 : A) ∈ gr 0) (p : ℕ) (g : G)
    (d : (⋀[A]^p (KaehlerDifferential R A)) →ₗ[R]
      (⋀[A]^(p + 1) (KaehlerDifferential R A)))
    (hd : ∀ a : Fin (p + 1) → A,
      d (a 0 • exteriorPower.ιMulti A p (fun i ↦
        KaehlerDifferential.D R A (a i.succ))) =
        exteriorPower.ιMulti A (p + 1) (fun i ↦
          KaehlerDifferential.D R A (a i))) :
    Submodule.map d (gradedDifferentialFormComponent gr p g) ≤
      gradedDifferentialFormComponent gr (p + 1) g
declarations.comment: differential_preserves_degree

declarations.name: KaehlerDifferential.isInternal_gradedDifferentialComponent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FU9.** The Kähler differentials of a graded
commutative algebra are the internal direct sum of their homogeneous
components.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInternal_gradedDifferentialComponent
    {G : Type u} {R : Type v} {A : Type w}
    [AddCommMonoid G] [DecidableEq G]
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (gr : G → Submodule R A) [GradedAlgebra gr] :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (gradedDifferentialComponent gr)
declarations.comment: differentials_direct_sum

declarations.name: KaehlerDifferential.isInternal_gradedDifferentialFormComponent
declarations.doc:
Differential forms decompose as the internal direct sum of their
homogeneous total-degree components.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInternal_gradedDifferentialFormComponent
    {G : Type u} {R : Type v} {A : Type w}
    [AddCommMonoid G] [DecidableEq G]
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (gr : G → Submodule R A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid gr]
    (hgr : DirectSum.IsInternal gr) (p : ℕ) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal
      (gradedDifferentialFormComponent gr p)
declarations.comment: forms_direct_sum

declarations.name: KaehlerDifferential.gradedDifferentialFormComponent_wedgeMul_mem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FU9.** The wedge product is compatible with the gradings: the wedge
of a form of exterior degree `p` and total degree `g` with a form of exterior degree `q` and
total degree `h` has exterior degree `p + q` and total degree `g + h`.
declarations.comment: wedge_compatible_with_gradings

declarations.name: KaehlerDifferential.gradedDifferentialFormComponent
declarations.doc:
The degree-`g` component of the `p`-forms of `A` over `R`, generated over
`R` by `a₀ ⋅ da₁ ∧ ⋯ ∧ daₚ` for homogeneous elements whose degrees sum
to `g`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedDifferentialFormComponent
    {G : Type u} {R : Type v} {A : Type w}
    [AddCommMonoid G] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (gr : G → Submodule R A) (p : ℕ) (g : G) :
    Submodule R (⋀[A]^p (KaehlerDifferential R A))
declarations.comment: graded_differential_form_components

declarations.name: KaehlerDifferential.gradedDifferentialComponent
declarations.doc:
The degree-`g` component of the Kähler differentials of `A` over `R`.

This is the degree-one differential-form component, viewed in
`KaehlerDifferential R A` through the canonical degree-one exterior-power
equivalence.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gradedDifferentialComponent
    {G : Type u} {R : Type v} {A : Type w}
    [AddCommMonoid G] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (gr : G → Submodule R A) (g : G) :
    Submodule R (KaehlerDifferential R A)
declarations.comment: graded_differential_form_components

declarations.name: Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.gradedLaurentForms
declarations.doc:
**The degree-`n` part `Ω^p_{L^⋆/S, n}` of the pushed-forward relative differential forms of
the complement of the zero section of a line bundle**: the smallest sub-`𝒪_X`-module sheaf of
`(L^⋆ → X)_* Ω^p_{L^⋆/S}` containing, over every affine open of `X`, the homogeneous forms of
degree `n`. This is the sheaf-level counterpart of the graded components of Tag 0FU9.
declarations.statement:
def Situation.gradedLaurentForms (p : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    (D.laurentFormsPushforward (p : ℤ)).Submodule
declarations.comment: the sheaf-level graded components of the pushed-forward de Rham forms of L-star

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.deRhamComplexLogPoles
declarations.doc:
**The de Rham complex of log poles** `Ω^•_{X/S}(log Y)` for a
morphism of schemes `f : X ⟶ S` and an effective Cartier divisor `Y ⊆ X`, cut out by `I`, for
which the de Rham complex of log poles is defined ([Stacks, Tag 0FMV]): the complex of sheaves
of `f⁻¹𝒪_S`-modules on `X` constructed in [Stacks, Tag 0FMW].
declarations.statement:
def deRhamComplexLogPoles :
    CochainComplex (_root_.SheafOfModules.{u} (baseRingSheaf f)) ℕ
declarations.comment: the complex of sheaves of f⁻¹𝒪_S-modules on X, for an arbitrary morphism of schemes and an arbitrary effective Cartier divisor for which the de Rham complex of log poles is defined (0FMV)

declarations.name: Stacks.LogPoles.deRhamComplexLogPoles
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FUA.**  **The de Rham complex of log poles**
`Ω^•_{X/S}(log Y)` for an effective Cartier divisor `Y = Spec (R ⧸ (t))` in `X = Spec R` over
`S = Spec A`: the complex constructed in Stacks Tag 0FMW, namely `Stacks.LogPoles.logComplex`.
A form of degree `p + 1` is a pair `(ω, η)` standing for `ω + dlog t ∧ η`, taken modulo the
relations `t ω + dt ∧ η = 0`, and the differential is `(ω, η) ↦ (dω, -dη)`.
declarations.comment: the de Rham complex of log poles is the complex constructed in 0FMW; as 0FMW is formalized in its affine local form, this names that complex, for a principal divisor (t)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isRegular_atPrime_baseChange_of_isQuasiRegular
declarations.doc:
Let `A → B` be flat and of finite presentation and let `f₁, …, f_r ∈ B` be a quasi-regular
sequence whose quotient is flat over `A`.  For any `A`-algebra `A'` and any prime `q` of
`B' = B ⊗_A A'` containing the base-changed sequence, that sequence is regular in the local ring
`B'_q`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRegular_atPrime_baseChange_of_isQuasiRegular
    {A B A' : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [CommRing A'] [Algebra A A'] [Module.Flat A B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation A B] {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → B)
    (hflat : Module.Flat A (B ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)))
    (hf : IsQuasiRegular B (List.ofFn f))
    (q : Ideal (B ⊗[A] A')) [q.IsPrime]
    (hq : Ideal.span (Set.range (KoszulH1.fp (A := A) (A' := A') f)) ≤ q) :
    IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime q)
      ((List.ofFn (KoszulH1.fp (A := A) (A' := A') f)).map
        (algebraMap (B ⊗[A] A') (Localization.AtPrime q)))
declarations.comment: regularity at primes after base change

registrations.name: Koszul.quasiRegular_and_h1Regular_baseChange_of_quotient_flat
registrations.comment: quasi-regularity and constant length after base change

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.exists_etale_coordinateSubspaceEmbedding_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FUE.** Let `S` be a scheme and let `i : Y ⟶ X` be a closed immersion
of schemes smooth over `S`. For every `y : Y` there are integers `m, n ≥ 0`, an open
`U ⊆ X` whose inverse image `V = i⁻¹(U)` contains `y`, an étale morphism
`π : U ⟶ 𝐀^{m+n}_S` over `S` and a morphism `q : V ⟶ 𝐀^m_S` making
```
Y ←── V ──→ 𝐀^m_S
│      │        │
↓      ↓        ↓
X ←── U ──→ 𝐀^{m+n}_S
```
commute with cartesian right-hand square, i.e. `V = π⁻¹(𝐀^m_S)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etale_coordinateSubspaceEmbedding_isPullback
    {S X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (i : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [Smooth f] [Smooth (i ≫ f)] (y : Y) :
    ∃ (m n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (_ : y ∈ i ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (π : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (m + n))) S)
      (q : (i ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin m)) S),
      Etale π ∧
        π ≫ (AffineSpace.over (ULift.{u} (Fin (m + n))) S).hom = U.ι ≫ f ∧
        IsPullback
          (i.resLE U (i ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl) q π (coordinateSubspaceEmbedding S m n)

declarations.name: Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.residueShortComplex_shortExact
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes, `L` an invertible
`𝒪_X`-module and `π : L^⋆ ⟶ X` the complement of the zero section of the line bundle of `L`, with
`Ω^•_{L^⋆/S,0}` the weight-zero part of `π_*Ω^•_{L^⋆/S}` for the grading by the action of `𝔾_m`
(`Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.weightZeroComplex`, Tag 0FU9). Then the sequence of complexes of
sheaves of abelian groups on `X`

`0 → Ω^•_{X/S} → Ω^•_{L^⋆/S,0} → Ω^•_{X/S}[-1] → 0`

is short exact. The first map is the pullback of forms along `π`
(`Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.pullbackHom`); the second is the residue
(`Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.residueHom`), which over an open where `L` is trivialized by a
generator `s`, so that `s` is a unit of degree one on `L^⋆`, sends `π^*α + d log s ∧ π^*β` to `β`
(`Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.residueHom_decomposition`) independently of the trivialization.
declarations.statement: theorem Situation.residueShortComplex_shortExact : D.residueShortComplex.ShortExact

declarations.name: LaurentDeRham.weightComponent_eq_weightForms
declarations.doc:
**The weight components of the de Rham complex of `A[T;T⁻¹]`, explicitly**: a relative form of
weight `g` is uniquely `Tᵍ ω' + Tᵍ dlog T ∧ ω` with `ω'` and `ω` pulled back from `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem weightComponent_eq_weightForms (g : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    weightComponent R A g p = weightForms R A g p
declarations.comment: the local computation: 1 and dlog T generate the weight-zero forms

declarations.name: LaurentDeRham.residue_mapExteriorPower_add_wedgeLeft
declarations.doc: **The defining formula of the residue**: `Res (ω' + dlog T ∧ ω) = ω`.
declarations.statement:
theorem residue_mapExteriorPower_add_wedgeLeft (p : ℕ) (ω' : ↥(⋀[A]^(p + 1) (Ω[A⁄R])))
    (ω : ↥(⋀[A]^p (Ω[A⁄R]))) :
    residue R A p (mapExteriorPower R A A[T;T⁻¹] (p + 1) ω' +
        exteriorPower.wedgeLeft (dlogT R A) p (mapExteriorPower R A A[T;T⁻¹] p ω)) = ω
declarations.comment: the local computation: the defining formula for the residue

declarations.name: LaurentDeRham.shortExact_residueShortComplex
declarations.doc:
**The residue short exact sequence of complexes** of Stacks 0FUF, in its affine form:
`0 → Ω^•_{A/R} → Ω^•_{A[T;T⁻¹]/R,0} → Ω^•_{A/R}[-1] → 0`.  The first map is the pullback of forms
along `A → A[T;T⁻¹]`, the second is the residue `ω' + dlog T ∧ ω ↦ ω`, and the shift carries the
differential `−d`.
declarations.statement: theorem shortExact_residueShortComplex : (residueShortComplex R A).ShortExact
declarations.comment: the affine local case: the residue short exact sequence for A[T;T⁻¹] over R

declarations.name: LaurentDeRham.residue_mapExteriorPower_add_wedgeLeft_dlogUnit
declarations.doc:
**The defining formula of the residue holds in every coordinate**:
`Res (ω' + dlog u ∧ ω) = ω` for every unit `u` of `A[T;T⁻¹]` homogeneous of weight one.
declarations.statement:
theorem residue_mapExteriorPower_add_wedgeLeft_dlogUnit {v : A[T;T⁻¹]ˣ}
    (hv : (v : A[T;T⁻¹]) ∈ weightGrading R A 1) (p : ℕ)
    (ω' : ↥(⋀[A]^(p + 1) (Ω[A⁄R]))) (ω : ↥(⋀[A]^p (Ω[A⁄R]))) :
    residue R A p (mapExteriorPower R A A[T;T⁻¹] (p + 1) ω' +
        exteriorPower.wedgeLeft (Stacks.LogPoles.dlogUnit R v) p
          (mapExteriorPower R A A[T;T⁻¹] p ω)) = ω
declarations.comment:
the local computation: the residue formula holds for every trivialization, not
only for the coordinate T

declarations.name: LaurentDeRham.exists_of_mem_weightComponent_succ_dlogUnit
declarations.doc:
**`1` and `dlog u` generate the weight-zero forms** for every coordinate `u`: a weight-zero
form of positive degree is `ω' + dlog u ∧ ω` with `ω'` and `ω` pulled back from `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_weightComponent_succ_dlogUnit {v : A[T;T⁻¹]ˣ}
    (hv : (v : A[T;T⁻¹]) ∈ weightGrading R A 1) {p : ℕ}
    {x : ↥(⋀[A[T;T⁻¹]]^(p + 1) (Ω[A[T;T⁻¹]⁄R]))} (hx : x ∈ weightComponent R A 0 (p + 1)) :
    ∃ (ω' : ↥(⋀[A]^(p + 1) (Ω[A⁄R]))) (ω : ↥(⋀[A]^p (Ω[A⁄R]))),
      x = mapExteriorPower R A A[T;T⁻¹] (p + 1) ω' +
        exteriorPower.wedgeLeft (Stacks.LogPoles.dlogUnit R v) p
          (mapExteriorPower R A A[T;T⁻¹] p ω)
declarations.comment:
the local computation: 1 and dlog u generate the weight-zero forms for every
trivialization, not only for the coordinate T

declarations.name: LaurentDeRham.eq_of_mapExteriorPower_add_wedgeLeft_dlogUnit
declarations.doc:
**The residue does not depend on the coordinate.**  If a weight-zero form is written
`ω₁' + dlog u ∧ ω₁` in one coordinate and `ω₂' + dlog v ∧ ω₂` in another, then `ω₁ = ω₂`: both
are its residue.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_mapExteriorPower_add_wedgeLeft_dlogUnit {v w : A[T;T⁻¹]ˣ}
    (hv : (v : A[T;T⁻¹]) ∈ weightGrading R A 1)
    (hw : (w : A[T;T⁻¹]) ∈ weightGrading R A 1) {p : ℕ}
    {ω₁' ω₂' : ↥(⋀[A]^(p + 1) (Ω[A⁄R]))} {ω₁ ω₂ : ↥(⋀[A]^p (Ω[A⁄R]))}
    (h : mapExteriorPower R A A[T;T⁻¹] (p + 1) ω₁' +
          exteriorPower.wedgeLeft (Stacks.LogPoles.dlogUnit R v) p
            (mapExteriorPower R A A[T;T⁻¹] p ω₁) =
        mapExteriorPower R A A[T;T⁻¹] (p + 1) ω₂' +
          exteriorPower.wedgeLeft (Stacks.LogPoles.dlogUnit R w) p
            (mapExteriorPower R A A[T;T⁻¹] p ω₂)) :
    ω₁ = ω₂
declarations.comment: the local computation: the residue is independent of the trivialization

declarations.name: Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.residueShiftedSequence_boundary_eq_deRhamClassMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FUG.** For a line bundle `ℒ` on `X` over `S`, the boundary map
`δ : Ω^•_{X/S} ⟶ Ω^•_{X/S}[2]` in `D(f^{-1}𝒪_S)` of the shifted residue sequence of Tag 0FUF is the
morphism `ξ'` of Tag 0FU7 attached to the de Rham first Chern class `ξ = c₁^{dR}(ℒ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Situation.residueShiftedSequence_boundary_eq_deRhamClassMorphism (D : Situation.{u}) :
    D.residueShiftedSequence.boundary =
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.deRhamClassMorphism (Scheme.Hom.deRhamAlgebras D.f)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.deRhamDifferential (Scheme.Hom.deRhamAlgebras D.f)) 2
        (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.deRhamCohomologyFirstChernClass (X := D.X.toRingedSpace)
          (Scheme.Hom.deRhamAlgebras D.f)
          (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.deRhamDifferential (Scheme.Hom.deRhamAlgebras D.f)) D.L
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.ofAlgebraicGeometry _ _ D.L D.invertible))
declarations.comment:
the boundary map of the shifted residue sequence of 0FUF for the complement of the
  zero section of a line bundle is the map of 0FU7 for its de Rham first Chern class

declarations.name: Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.gradedTwistIso
declarations.doc:
**Clause (1) of Tag 0FUH**: the degree-`n` part of the pushed-forward relative differential
forms of the complement of the zero section is the degree-zero part twisted by `L^{⊗ n}`,
`Ω^p_{L^⋆/S, n} = Ω^p_{L^⋆/S, 0} ⊗_{𝒪_X} L^{⊗ n}`. The isomorphism is multiplication of a form by
the homogeneous function of a local section of `L^{⊗ n}`, so it is the canonical map and not a
choice. That the two sides are *quasi-coherent* `𝒪_X`-modules, which is the rest of what the
printed clause asserts, is `Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.isQuasicoherent_gradedAt` and
`Situation.isQuasicoherent_gradedTwistSource` of
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.DeRham.LineBundle.HomogeneousTwistCompatible`.
declarations.comment: clause (1): the degree-n part is identified with the twisted degree-zero part

declarations.name: Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.isQuasicoherent_gradedAt
declarations.doc:
**The degree-`n` part `Ω^p_{L^⋆/S, n}` is quasi-coherent**, read at the indexing the tensor
product of Tag 05NA and the comparison map of clause (1) are defined over. This is
`Situation.isQuasicoherent_gradedLaurentForms` at the `Situation.gradedAt` spelling, which is the
same object by definition.
declarations.statement:
theorem Situation.isQuasicoherent_gradedAt (p : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    (D.gradedAt p n).IsQuasicoherent
declarations.comment: clause (1): the degree-n part is a quasi-coherent O_X-module

declarations.name: Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.isQuasicoherent_gradedTwistSource
declarations.doc:
**The source `Ω^p_{L^⋆/S, 0} ⊗_{𝒪_X} L^{⊗ n}` of the comparison map of clause (1) is
quasi-coherent**: both factors are, the degree-zero part by
`Situation.isQuasicoherent_gradedAt` and the tensor power by
`Situation.isQuasicoherent_tensorPower`, so Tag 0GQM applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem Situation.isQuasicoherent_gradedTwistSource (p : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor D.X.sheaf).obj (D.gradedAt p 0)).obj
      (D.tensorPowerAt n)).IsQuasicoherent
declarations.comment: clause (1): the twisted degree-zero part is a quasi-coherent O_X-module

declarations.name: Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.gradedFormsIsoLaurent
declarations.doc:
For `n > 0` and `p ≥ 0`, the weight-`n` part of the pushed-forward relative `p`-forms of the
total space `𝕃` of `L` over `S` is the weight-`n` part of the pushed-forward relative `p`-forms of
`L^⋆` over `S`: `Ω^p_{𝕃/S, n} ≅ Ω^p_{L^⋆/S, n}`, through the restriction of forms along `L^⋆ ⊆ 𝕃`.

The printed statement reads `Ω^p_{L/X, n}`, a misprint for `Ω^p_{L/S, n}`: the forms relative to
`X` satisfy `Ω^p_{L/X, n} = 0` for `p ≥ 2` while `Ω^p_{L^⋆/S, n}` is in general nonzero, and the
use of this lemma in the proof of Tag 0FUK concerns the forms relative to `S`.
declarations.comment:
clause (3): for `n > 0`, `Ω^p_{L/S, n} = Ω^p_{L^⋆/S, n}` (printed `L/X`, a misprint
for `L/S`)

declarations.name: Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.deRhamComplexIsoTotalWeightZero
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes, `L` an invertible `𝒪_X`-module and `π : 𝕃 ⟶ X`
its total space. Then `Ω^•_{X/S} = Ω^•_{𝕃/S, 0}` as complexes: the de Rham complex of `X` over
`S` is isomorphic to the weight-zero subcomplex of `π_* Ω^•_{𝕃/S}`, through the canonical map
`Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.deRhamPushforward` (see
`Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.deRhamComplexIsoTotalWeightZero_hom_ι`).

The printed statement writes `Ω^•_{L/X, 0}`; the subscript `L/X` is a misprint for `L/S`: the
relative forms of `L` over `X` vanish in degree one in weight zero, and the paragraph before the
lemma as well as its use in the proof of Tag 0FUK (`π_*Ω^a_{L/S} = Ω^a_{P/S} ⊕ ⋯`) concern
`L/S`.
declarations.statement: def Situation.deRhamComplexIsoTotalWeightZero : D.baseDeRhamComplex ≅ D.totalWeightZeroComplex
declarations.comment:
clause (2): `Ω^•_{X/S} = Ω^•_{L/S, 0}` as complexes (printed `L/X`, a misprint
for `L/S`)

declarations.name: LaurentDeRham.weightComponentSmulEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Clause (1) of Stacks 0FUH, affine locally**: multiplication by `Tⁿ` is an isomorphism from
the weight-zero part of `Ω^p_{A[T;T⁻¹]/R}` onto its weight-`n` part, for every integer `n`.  It
is the local form of `Ω^p_{L^⋆/S, n} = Ω^p_{L^⋆/S, 0} ⊗ L^{⊗n}`, the trivialization of `L^{⊗n}`
over the affine being `Tⁿ`.
declarations.statement:
def weightComponentSmulEquiv (n : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    ↥(weightComponent R A 0 p) ≃ₗ[R] ↥(weightComponent R A n p)
declarations.comment: clause (1), affine local case: Tⁿ • carries weight zero onto weight n

declarations.name: PolynomialDeRham.deRhamComplexWeightZeroIso
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2) of Stacks 0FUH, affine locally**: the de Rham complex of `A` over `R` is the
weight-zero part of the de Rham complex of `A[X]` over `R`, through the pullback of forms.  It is
the local form of `Ω^•_{X/S} = Ω^•_{L/S, 0}`.
declarations.statement: def deRhamComplexWeightZeroIso : deRhamComplex R A ≅ deRhamComplexWeightZero R A
declarations.comment: clause (2), affine local case; the printed subscript L/X is a typo for L/S

declarations.name: PolynomialDeRham.laurentWeightEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Clause (3) of Stacks 0FUH, affine locally**: for `n > 0` the restriction of forms along
`A[X] → A[T;T⁻¹]` is an isomorphism from the weight-`n` part of `Ω^p_{A[X]/R}` onto the weight-`n`
part of `Ω^p_{A[T;T⁻¹]/R}`.  It is the local form of `Ω^p_{L/S, n} = Ω^p_{L^⋆/S, n}`; positivity
of `n` is needed, since in weight `n ≤ 0` the form `Tⁿ dlog T` is not the restriction of a form on
the total space.
declarations.statement:
def laurentWeightEquiv (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (p : ℕ) :
    ↥(weightComponent R A n p) ≃ₗ[R] ↥(LaurentDeRham.weightComponent R A (n : ℤ) p)
declarations.comment: clause (3), affine local case; the printed subscript L/X is a typo for L/S

declarations.name: Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.quasiIso_deRhamPushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FUI, first assertion.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes with
`S` lying over `Spec R` for a `ℚ`-algebra `R` — for instance `R = ℚ` — let `L` be an invertible
`𝒪_X`-module and let `π : 𝕃 ⟶ X` be its total space. Then the canonical map
`Ω^•_{X/S} ⟶ π_*Ω^•_{𝕃/S}` is a quasi-isomorphism.
declarations.statement: theorem Situation.quasiIso_deRhamPushforward : QuasiIso D.deRhamPushforward
declarations.comment:
first assertion: `Ω^•_{X/S} ⟶ π_*Ω^•_{L/S}` is a quasi-isomorphism when `S`
lies over `Spec ℚ` (here over `Spec R` for any `ℚ`-algebra `R`)

declarations.name: Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.isIso_deRhamCohomologyPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FUI, second assertion.** In the situation of
`Stacks.LineBundle.Situation.quasiIso_deRhamPushforward`, pullback along the projection
`π : 𝕃 ⟶ X` of the total space of the line bundle is an isomorphism
`H^i_{dR}(X/S) ≅ H^i_{dR}(𝕃/S)` in every degree `i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Situation.isIso_deRhamCohomologyPullback (i : ℤ) :
    IsIso (Scheme.Hom.deRhamCohomologyPullback D.totalSpaceToBase D.f
      (D.totalSpaceToBase ≫ D.f) (𝟙 D.S) D.totalSpaceToBase_comp i)
declarations.comment:
second assertion: `H^*_dR(X/S) = H^*_dR(L/S)`, the pullback along `π` being an
isomorphism in every degree, when `S` lies over `Spec ℚ` (here over `Spec R` for any
`ℚ`-algebra `R`)

declarations.name: PolynomialDeRham.inclHomotopyEquiv
declarations.doc:
**The Poincaré lemma for a polynomial algebra**: over a `ℚ`-algebra the inclusion
`Ω^•_{A/R} → Ω^•_{A[X]/R}` is a homotopy equivalence, with homotopy inverse the map induced by
evaluation at `0`.
declarations.statement: def inclHomotopyEquiv : HomotopyEquiv (deRhamComplex R A) (deRhamComplex R A[X])
declarations.comment: the affine case: the de Rham complex is unchanged by adjoining a variable

declarations.name: PolynomialDeRham.quasiIso_incl
declarations.doc: The inclusion `Ω^•_{A/R} → Ω^•_{A[X]/R}` is a quasi-isomorphism.
declarations.statement: instance quasiIso_incl : QuasiIso (incl R A)
declarations.comment: the affine case, as a quasi-isomorphism

declarations.name: PolynomialDeRham.polynomialEquiv_oneEquiv_deRhamDifferential_zero_X_pow
declarations.doc:
**The decomposition of the de Rham complex of the affine line**: on the monomial basis the only
differential of `Ω^•_{A[X]/A}` sends `Xⁿ` to `n X^{n-1} dX`.  Together with
`PolynomialDeRham.subsingleton_exteriorPower_polynomial`, which says the complex stops after degree
one, this is the direct sum `A ⊕ ⨁_{n ≥ 1} (A · Xⁿ --n--> A · X^{n-1} dX)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem polynomialEquiv_oneEquiv_deRhamDifferential_zero_X_pow (n : ℕ) :
    polynomialEquiv A (exteriorPower.oneEquiv A[X] (Ω[A[X]⁄A]) (deRhamDifferential (A := A) 0
        ((exteriorPower.zeroEquiv A[X] (Ω[A[X]⁄A])).symm ((X : A[X]) ^ n)))) =
      (n : A[X]) * (X : A[X]) ^ (n - 1)
declarations.comment:
the displayed decomposition of the de Rham complex of the affine line: d Xⁿ =
n X^{n-1} dX

declarations.name: PolynomialDeRham.not_quasiIso_incl
declarations.doc:
**The Poincaré lemma fails in positive characteristic.**  For a field `k` of characteristic
`p > 0` the inclusion of de Rham complexes `Ω^•_{k/k} → Ω^•_{k[X]/k}` is not a quasi-isomorphism:
the source vanishes in degree one, while the target has `X^{p-1} dX` as a non-exact closed form.
So the hypothesis `ℚ ⊆ A` of `PolynomialDeRham.quasiIso_incl` cannot be dropped.

This is the affine content of Stacks 0FUJ: taking `X = S = Spec(k)` and `L = 𝐀^1_k` in Stacks
0FUI, the map `Ω^•_{X/S} → π_*Ω^•_{L/S}` on global sections is exactly `incl k k`.
declarations.statement: theorem not_quasiIso_incl (hp : p ≠ 0) : ¬ QuasiIso (incl k k)
declarations.comment:
the counterexample: in characteristic p > 0 the Poincaré lemma 0FUI fails for the
affine line over a field, so its ℚ-algebra hypothesis is necessary

declarations.name: PolynomialDeRham.not_finiteDimensional_ker_deRhamDifferential_zero
declarations.doc:
In characteristic `p > 0` the closed degree-zero forms on `𝐀^1_k` are infinite dimensional:
`H^0_{dR}(𝐀^1_k/k)` contains every `p`-th power substitution `expand k p f`, because
`d/dX (expand k p f) = expand k p (df/dX) · p X^{p-1} = 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_finiteDimensional_ker_deRhamDifferential_zero (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    ¬ FiniteDimensional k (LinearMap.ker (deRhamDifferential (A := k) (B := k[X]) 0))
declarations.comment:
H⁰ of the de Rham complex of the affine line is infinite dimensional in
characteristic p > 0

declarations.name: PolynomialDeRham.not_finiteDimensional_deRhamCohomology_one
declarations.doc:
In characteristic `p > 0` the degree-one de Rham cohomology of `𝐀^1_k` is infinite dimensional:
`f ↦ [expand k p f · X^{p-1} dX]` is an injective `k`-linear map out of `k[X]`, because the
coefficient of a derivative in every degree `≡ -1 mod p` vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_finiteDimensional_deRhamCohomology_one (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    ¬ FiniteDimensional k (↥(⋀[k[X]]^1 (Ω[k[X]⁄k])) ⧸
      LinearMap.range (deRhamDifferential (A := k) (B := k[X]) 0))
declarations.comment:
H¹ of the de Rham complex of the affine line is infinite dimensional in
characteristic p > 0

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpaceHodge.isZero_hodgeCohomology
declarations.doc: **Clause (1) of [Stacks, Tag 0FUK].** `H^q(ℙⁿ_A, Ωᵖ) = 0` unless `0 ≤ p = q ≤ n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_hodgeCohomology (p q : ℕ) (hpq : ¬(p = q ∧ p ≤ m + 1)) :
    IsZero (hodgeCohomology A m p q)
declarations.comment: clause (1)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpaceHodge.nonempty_hodgeCohomology_diag_iso
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2) of [Stacks, Tag 0FUK].** For `0 ≤ p ≤ n` the `A`-module `H^p(ℙⁿ_A, Ωᵖ)` is
isomorphic to `A`; its generator is, in the source, the `p`-fold boundary of
`1 ∈ H⁰(ℙⁿ_A, 𝒪)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_hodgeCohomology_diag_iso (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ m + 1) :
    Nonempty (hodgeCohomology A m p p ≅ ModuleCat.of A A)
declarations.comment: clause (2), as an isomorphism with `A`

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpaceHodge.free_hodgeCohomology_diag
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2) of [Stacks, Tag 0FUK], as freeness.** For `0 ≤ p ≤ n` the `A`-module
`H^p(ℙⁿ_A, Ωᵖ)` is free, being isomorphic to `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem free_hodgeCohomology_diag (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ m + 1) :
    Module.Free A ↥(hodgeCohomology A m p p)
declarations.comment: clause (2), freeness

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpaceHodge.isZero_twistedHodgeCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Clause (3) of [Stacks, Tag 0FUK].** For `q > 0`, `k > 0` and arbitrary `p` we have
`H^q(ℙⁿ_A, Ωᵖ(k)) = 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_twistedHodgeCohomology (p : ℕ) {k : ℤ} (hk : 0 < k) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    IsZero (twistedHodgeCohomology A m p k q)
declarations.comment: clause (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.DeRhamLerayHirsch.bijective_sum_deRhamCup_pullback
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FUM]**, the Leray–Hirsch theorem over an affine base. Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a
smooth proper morphism of schemes over `S`, with `Y` and `S` affine, let `n_1, …, n_r ≥ 0` and let
`ξ_i ∈ H^{n_i}_{dR}(X/S)` be classes whose images in `H^*_{dR}(X_y/κ(y))` form a basis over
`κ(y)` for every point `y ∈ Y`. Then

`⨁_{i=1}^r H^*_{dR}(Y/S) ⟶ H^*_{dR}(X/S)`, `(a_1, …, a_r) ↦ ∑ ξ_i ∪ f^*a_i`

is an isomorphism: in every degree `N` the map `⨁_i H^{N-n_i}_{dR}(Y/S) ⟶ H^N_{dR}(X/S)` is
bijective.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_sum_deRhamCup_pullback [Smooth f] [IsProper f] [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine S]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ)
    (ξ : ∀ i, SheafOfModules.deRhamCohomology (Scheme.Hom.deRhamAlgebras (f ≫ g))
      (SheafOfModules.deRhamDifferential (Scheme.Hom.deRhamAlgebras (f ≫ g))) (n i : ℤ))
    (hb : ∀ y : Y, ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin r) (Y.residueField y)
        (DirectSum ℤ fun m : ℤ => ↥(fibreDeRhamModule f y m)),
      ∀ i, b i = DirectSum.lof (Y.residueField y) ℤ (fun m : ℤ => ↥(fibreDeRhamModule f y m))
        (n i : ℤ) (fibreClassOverS f g y (n i : ℤ) (ξ i)))
    (N : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (fun a : ∀ i, SheafOfModules.deRhamCohomology
        (Scheme.Hom.deRhamAlgebras g)
        (SheafOfModules.deRhamDifferential (Scheme.Hom.deRhamAlgebras g)) (N - n i) =>
      ∑ i, (eqToHom (congrArg (SheafOfModules.deRhamCohomology
          (Scheme.Hom.deRhamAlgebras (f ≫ g))
          (SheafOfModules.deRhamDifferential (Scheme.Hom.deRhamAlgebras (f ≫ g))))
          (add_sub_cancel (n i : ℤ) N))).hom
        (SheafOfModules.deRhamCohomologyCup _ _ (n i) (N - n i) (ξ i)
          (deRhamPullbackModule f g (N - n i) (a i))))
declarations.comment: Leray-Hirsch over an affine base: for f : X -> Y smooth proper over S with Y and S affine, and classes xi_i in H^{n_i}_dR(X/S) (n_i >= 0) whose images in H^*_dR(X_y/kappa(y)) form a kappa(y)-basis at every point y of Y, the map (+)_i H^*_dR(Y/S) -> H^*_dR(X/S), (a_i) |-> sum xi_i cup f^*a_i, is an isomorphism, i.e. bijective in every degree N

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.iterate_deRhamClassMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FUN: the composite `ξ'[d(t - 1)] ∘ ⋯ ∘ ξ'[d] ∘ ξ' : Ω^• ⟶ Ω^•[dt]` is
the morphism of Remark 0FU7 attached to `ξ^t`**, for `ξ ∈ H^d_{dR}`; Remark 0FUN states it for
`ξ = c₁^{dR}(𝒪_P(1))` and `d = 2`.
declarations.statement:
theorem iterate_deRhamClassMorphism (d : ℕ) (ξ : deRhamCohomology B D (d : ℤ)) (t : ℕ) :
    ShiftedHom.iterate d (deRhamClassMorphism B D d ξ) t =
      deRhamClassMorphism B D ((d * t : ℕ) : ℤ) (deRhamCohomologyPow B D d ξ t)
declarations.comment: xi'[2(t-1)] o ... o xi'[2] o xi' is the morphism of Remark 0FU7 attached to xi^t; stated for every class xi of every degree d, the remark's case being xi = c_1^dR(O_P(1)), d = 2

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.DeRhamLerayHirsch.ι_lerayHirschPowerMorphism
declarations.doc: **The summand `t` of `ξ̃` is `Rf_*ξ'[-d] ∘ ⋯ ∘ Rf_*ξ'[-dt] ∘ c[-dt]`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem ι_lerayHirschPowerMorphism (t : Fin r) :
    biproduct.ι (fun t : Fin r => (deRhamObject g)⟦-((d * (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℤ)⟧) t ≫
        lerayHirschPowerMorphism f g d ξ r =
      (deRhamDirectImageMap f g)⟦-((d * (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℤ)⟧' ≫
        ShiftedHom.negIterate d (classDirectImageEndo f g d ξ) t
declarations.comment: the restriction of xi~ to the summand Omega_{X/S}[-2t] is Rp_*xi'[-2] o ... o Rp_*xi'[-2t] o c_{P/X}[-2t]; stated for every morphism p : P -> X over S, every class xi of every degree d and every number r of summands

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.DeRhamLerayHirsch.ι_lerayHirschPowerMorphism_zero
declarations.doc:
**The summand `t = 0` of `ξ̃` is the canonical map `c : Ω^•_{Y/S} ⟶ Rf_*Ω^•_{X/S}`**, read on
`Ω^•_{Y/S}[0] = Ω^•_{Y/S}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem ι_lerayHirschPowerMorphism_zero (hr : 0 < r) :
    biproduct.ι (fun t : Fin r => (deRhamObject g)⟦-((d * (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℤ)⟧) ⟨0, hr⟩ ≫
        lerayHirschPowerMorphism f g d ξ r =
      (shiftFunctorZero' _ (-((d * 0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (by simp)).hom.app (deRhamObject g) ≫
        deRhamDirectImageMap f g
declarations.comment: the arrow of xi~ for t = 0 is the canonical map c_{P/X} of Section 07HX; stated for every morphism p : P -> X over S and every class xi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.DeRhamLerayHirsch.lerayHirschPowerMorphism_comp_classDirectImageEndo
declarations.doc: **The square of Remark 0FUN commutes**: `Rf_*ξ' ∘ ξ̃|_K = (ξ̃|_M)[d] ∘ id`.
declarations.statement:
theorem lerayHirschPowerMorphism_comp_classDirectImageEndo :
    powerSummandsInitι g d r ≫ lerayHirschPowerMorphism f g d ξ r ≫ classDirectImageEndo f g d ξ =
      powerSummandsInitIso g d r ≫
        (powerSummandsTailι g d r ≫ lerayHirschPowerMorphism f g d ξ r)⟦(d : ℤ)⟧'
declarations.comment: the square K -> M[2], Rp_*Omega_{P/S} -> Rp_*Omega_{P/S}[2] commutes: Rp_*xi' o xi~|_K = (xi~|_M)[2] o id; stated for every morphism p : P -> X over S, every class xi of every degree d and every number r of summands

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.DeRhamLerayHirsch.isIso_projectiveBundleLerayHirschMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 0FUN: the Leray--Hirsch morphism of a projective bundle is an
isomorphism.** For `ℰ` locally free of constant rank `r` and `p : P = 𝐏(ℰ) ⟶ X`, the morphism
`ξ̃ = ⨁_t ξ̃_t[-2t] : ⨁_{0 ≤ t < r} Ω^•_{X/S}[-2t] ⟶ Rp_*Ω^•_{P/S}` attached to the classes
`c₁^{dR}(𝒪_P(1))^t ∈ H^{2t}_{dR}(P/S)` is an isomorphism in `D(X, (X ⟶ S)^{-1}𝒪_S)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_projectiveBundleLerayHirschMorphism :
    IsIso (projectiveBundleLerayHirschMorphism g E r)
declarations.comment: in the situation of Proposition 0FMT (E locally free of constant rank r on X, X -> S, p : P = P(E) -> X), the map xi~ : (+)_{t = 0, ..., r-1} Omega_{X/S}[-2t] -> Rp_*Omega_{P/S} attached to the classes c_1^dR(O_P(1))^t is an isomorphism in D(X, (X -> S)^{-1}O_S)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.DeRhamLerayHirsch.isIso_biprodDesc_projectiveBundleLerayHirschMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 0FUN: `c_{P/X} ⊕ ξ̃|_M` is an isomorphism.** For `ℰ` locally free of
constant rank `r ≥ 1` and `M = ⨁_{1 ≤ t < r} Ω^•_{X/S}[-2t]`, the morphism
`c_{P/X} ⊕ ξ̃|_M : Ω^•_{X/S} ⊕ M ⟶ Rp_*Ω^•_{P/S}` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_biprodDesc_projectiveBundleLerayHirschMorphism (hr : 0 < r) :
    IsIso (biprod.desc (deRhamDirectImageMap (projectiveBundleToBase X E) g)
      (powerSummandsTailι g 2 r ≫ projectiveBundleLerayHirschMorphism g E r))
declarations.comment: with M = (+)_{t = 1, ..., r-1} Omega_{X/S}[-2t], the map c_{P/X} (+) xi~|_M : Omega_{X/S} (+) M -> Rp_*Omega_{P/S} is an isomorphism; stated for r >= 1, the remark's arrow for t = 0 presupposing it (for r = 0 and X nonempty the target is 0 and the source is not)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.logFormsWedgeMap_spec
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FUP, clause (1).** The wedge products
`Ω^p_{X/S} × Ω^q_{X/S} → Ω^{p+q}_{X/S}` extend to `𝒪_X`-bilinear maps
`Ω^p_{X/S}(log Y) × Ω^q_{X/S}(log Y) → Ω^{p+q}_{X/S}(log Y)`, namely
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.logFormsWedgeMap`; the extension is unique among all `𝒪_X`-bilinear
maps extending the wedge product; and it satisfies the Leibniz rule
`d(ω ∧ η) = d(ω) ∧ η + (-1)^{deg ω} ω ∧ d(η)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem logFormsWedgeMap_spec :
    (∀ (p q : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) (ω : Γ(relativeDifferentialForms f (p : ℤ), W))
      (η : Γ(relativeDifferentialForms f (q : ℤ), W)),
      (logFormsWedgeMap hI hlog p q).app (op W) ((logPolesFormsInclusion f I p).val.app (op W) ω)
          ((logPolesFormsInclusion f I q).val.app (op W) η) =
        (logPolesFormsInclusion f I (p + q)).val.app (op W) (formWedge f p q W ω η)) ∧
    (∀ (p q : ℕ) (m : _root_.SheafOfModules.BilinearMap (logPolesForms f I p)
        (logPolesForms f I q) (logPolesForms f I (p + q))),
      (∀ (W : X.Opens) (ω : Γ(relativeDifferentialForms f (p : ℤ), W))
        (η : Γ(relativeDifferentialForms f (q : ℤ), W)),
        m.app (op W) ((logPolesFormsInclusion f I p).val.app (op W) ω)
            ((logPolesFormsInclusion f I q).val.app (op W) η) =
          (logPolesFormsInclusion f I (p + q)).val.app (op W) (formWedge f p q W ω η)) →
      m = logFormsWedgeMap hI hlog p q) ∧
    (∀ (p q : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) (φ : (logPolesForms f I p).val.obj (op W))
      (ψ : (logPolesForms f I q).val.obj (op W)),
      logD hI hlog ((logFormsWedgeMap hI hlog p q).app (op W) φ ψ) =
        logFormsCast (Nat.add_right_comm p 1 q)
            ((logFormsWedgeMap hI hlog (p + 1) q).app (op W) (logD hI hlog φ) ψ) +
          ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p) • (logFormsWedgeMap hI hlog p (q + 1)).app (op W) φ (logD hI hlog ψ))
declarations.comment: clause (1): existence, uniqueness among all O_X-bilinear extensions (the Leibniz rule is not needed for uniqueness), and the Leibniz rule

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.logPolesDifferentialGradedAlgebra_spec
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FUP, clause (2).** With the multiplication of clause (1), the de Rham
complex of log poles `Ω^•_{X/S}(log Y)` of Tag 0FUA is a sheaf of differential graded
`f⁻¹𝒪_S`-algebras `A`, and the inclusion `Ω^•_{X/S} ⟶ Ω^•_{X/S}(log Y)` underlies a
homomorphism of sheaves of differential graded algebras from the relative de Rham complex of
Tag 0FU6 to `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem logPolesDifferentialGradedAlgebra_spec :
    ∃ (A : _root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.{u, u} (baseRingSheaf f))
      (φ : _root_.SheafOfModules.DifferentialGradedAlgebra.Hom
        (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.relativeDeRhamDifferentialGradedAlgebra
          (inverseImageStructureMap f)) A),
      A.complex = deRhamComplexLogPolesInt f I hI hlog ∧
      (∀ (p q : ℕ) (U : X.Opensᵒᵖ) (x : (A.complex.X (p : ℤ)).val.obj U)
        (y : (A.complex.X (q : ℤ)).val.obj U) (x' : (logPolesForms f I p).val.obj U)
        (y' : (logPolesForms f I q).val.obj U), HEq x x' → HEq y y' →
          HEq ((A.mul (p : ℤ) (q : ℤ)).app U x y)
            ((logFormsWedgeMap hI hlog p q).app U x' y')) ∧
      (∀ U : X.Opensᵒᵖ, HEq (A.one.eval U)
        ((logPolesFormsInclusion f I 0).val.app U (formOne U.unop))) ∧
      HEq φ.toHomologicalComplex (deRhamComplexLogPolesIntInclusion f I hI hlog)
declarations.comment: clause (2): the sheaf of differential graded f⁻¹O_S-algebras on the complex of 0FUA, with the multiplication of clause (1), and the inclusion as a homomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.logExteriorDesc_spec
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FUP, clause (3).** Via the maps of clause (1),
`Ω^p_{X/S}(log Y) = ⋀^p(Ω^1_{X/S}(log Y))`. The forms with logarithmic poles form a sheaf of graded
`𝒪_X`-algebras `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.logGradedAlgebra` under the wedge product of
clause (1); the unital homomorphism `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.logExteriorDesc` to it from the
exterior algebra of `Ω^1_{X/S}(log Y)` is the identity of `Ω^1_{X/S}(log Y)` in degree one, so in
degree `p` it sends `φ₁ ∧ ⋯ ∧ φ_p` to the wedge product of the `φᵢ`, and it is an isomorphism in
every degree `p`.
declarations.statement:
theorem logExteriorDesc_spec :
    (∀ (p q : ℕ) (U : X.Opensᵒᵖ) (x : (logPolesForms f I p).val.obj U)
      (y : (logPolesForms f I q).val.obj U),
      ((logGradedAlgebra f I hI hlog).mul (p : ℤ) (q : ℤ)).app U x y =
        (logFormsWedgeMap hI hlog p q).app U x y) ∧
    Scheme.Modules.exteriorGenerator (logPolesForms f I 1) ≫ (logExteriorDesc f I hI hlog).app 1 =
      logGenerator f I hI hlog ∧
    ∀ p : ℕ, IsIso ((logExteriorDesc f I hI hlog).app (p : ℤ))
declarations.comment: clause (3): the map from the p-th exterior power of Ω¹(log Y) induced by the wedge product of clause (1) is an isomorphism onto Ω^p(log Y), for every p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.logRes_logFormsWedge_spec
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FUP, clause (4).** The residue
`Res : Ω^•_{X/S}(log Y) → Ω^•_{Y/S}[-1]` satisfies `Res(ω ∧ η) = Res(ω) ∧ η|_Y` for a local
section `ω` of `Ω^p_{X/S}(log Y)` and a local section `η` of `Ω^q_{X/S}`: in degree `p + 1` this
is the first conjunct; in degree `0` the residue vanishes, and so does `Res(ω ∧ η)`, the second
conjunct.
declarations.statement:
theorem logRes_logFormsWedge_spec :
    (∀ (p q : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) (ω : (logPolesForms f I (p + 1)).val.obj (op W))
      (η : Γ(relativeDifferentialForms f (q : ℤ), W)),
      logRes hI hlog (logFormsCast (Nat.add_right_comm p 1 q)
          (logFormsWedge hI hlog ω ((logPolesFormsInclusion f I q).val.app (op W) η))) =
        formWedge (I.subschemeι ≫ f) p q (I.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W) (logRes hI hlog ω)
          (formRes I.subschemeι (q : ℤ) W η)) ∧
    (∀ (q : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) (ω : (logPolesForms f I 0).val.obj (op W))
      (η : Γ(relativeDifferentialForms f ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ), W)),
      logRes hI hlog (logFormsCast (Nat.zero_add (q + 1))
          (logFormsWedge hI hlog ω ((logPolesFormsInclusion f I (q + 1)).val.app (op W) η))) = 0)
declarations.comment: clause (4), in every degree of ω: the formula in degree p + 1, and the vanishing of Res(ω ∧ η) for ω of degree 0, where Res(ω) = 0

declarations.name: Stacks.LogPoles.logWedge
declarations.doc:
**The product on the de Rham complex of log poles**, `Ω^p(log Y) × Ω^q(log Y) → Ω^{p+q}(log
Y)`, as an `𝒪_X`-bilinear map.  On the pair model it is
`(ω₁, η₁) ∧ (ω₂, η₂) = (ω₁ ∧ ω₂, η₁ ∧ ω₂ + (-1)^{p+1} ω₁ ∧ η₂)`, with the three degenerate cases
where a degree is zero given by wedging a function into both components.
declarations.statement:
def logWedge (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra A R]
    (ht : ∀ p : ℕ, IsSMulRegular (↥(⋀[R]^p (Ω[R⁄A]))) t) :
    (p q : ℕ) →
      (logFormsR A t p →ₗ[R] logFormsR A t q →ₗ[R] logFormsR A t (p + q))
declarations.comment: clause (1), existence: the O_X-bilinear extension of the wedge product to the log poles complex of 0FMW, at the ring level for a principal divisor (t); the Leibniz rule for this product is not proved

declarations.name: Stacks.LogPoles.logWedge_logInclR
declarations.doc:
**The product extends the wedge product of the forms with no pole.**  This is the defining
property of the extension in clause (1) of Stacks Tag 0FUP: a form with no pole is the pair
`(ω, 0)`, and the formula on pairs leaves the second component zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem logWedge_logInclR
    (ht : ∀ p : ℕ, IsSMulRegular (↥(⋀[R]^p (Ω[R⁄A]))) t)
    (p q : ℕ) (ω : ⋀[R]^p (Ω[R⁄A])) (η : ⋀[R]^q (Ω[R⁄A])) :
    logWedge A ht p q (logInclR t p ω) (logInclR t q η) =
      logInclR t (p + q) (exteriorPower.wedgeMul p q ω η)
declarations.comment: clause (1), existence: the constructed product restricts to the wedge product on the forms with no pole, which is the defining property of the extension

declarations.name: Stacks.LogPoles.eq_logWedge_of_logInclR
declarations.doc:
**The product of clause (1) is the unique `𝒪_X`-bilinear extension.**  Any `𝒪_X`-bilinear
product on the de Rham complex of log poles that restricts to the wedge product on the forms with
no pole is `Stacks.LogPoles.logWedge`.  This discharges the hypothesis of the uniqueness
statement `Stacks.LogPoles.logWedge_unique` with the construction, so uniqueness is not vacuous.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_logWedge_of_logInclR
    (ht : ∀ p : ℕ, IsSMulRegular (↥(⋀[R]^p (Ω[R⁄A]))) t)
    (w : (p q : ℕ) →
      logFormsR A t p →ₗ[R] logFormsR A t q →ₗ[R] logFormsR A t (p + q))
    (hw : ∀ (p q : ℕ) (ω : ⋀[R]^p (Ω[R⁄A])) (η : ⋀[R]^q (Ω[R⁄A])),
      w p q (logInclR t p ω) (logInclR t q η) =
        logInclR t (p + q) (exteriorPower.wedgeMul p q ω η)) :
    w = logWedge A ht
declarations.comment: clause (1): the product built here is THE O_X-bilinear extension, discharging the hypothesis of the uniqueness statement; the Leibniz rule is not proved

declarations.name: Stacks.LogPoles.logWedge_unique
declarations.doc:
If `t` is a nonzerodivisor on the forms, two `𝒪_X`-bilinear products on the de Rham complex
of log poles that both restrict to the wedge product on the forms with no pole are equal.
declarations.statement:
theorem logWedge_unique {t : R}
    (ht : ∀ p : ℕ, IsSMulRegular (↥(⋀[R]^p (Ω[R⁄A]))) t)
    (w₁ w₂ : (p q : ℕ) →
      logFormsR A t p →ₗ[R] logFormsR A t q →ₗ[R] logFormsR A t (p + q))
    (h₁ : ∀ (p q : ℕ) (ω : ⋀[R]^p (Ω[R⁄A])) (η : ⋀[R]^q (Ω[R⁄A])),
      w₁ p q (logInclR t p ω) (logInclR t q η) =
        logInclR t (p + q) (exteriorPower.wedgeMul p q ω η))
    (h₂ : ∀ (p q : ℕ) (ω : ⋀[R]^p (Ω[R⁄A])) (η : ⋀[R]^q (Ω[R⁄A])),
      w₂ p q (logInclR t p ω) (logInclR t q η) =
        logInclR t (p + q) (exteriorPower.wedgeMul p q ω η)) :
    w₁ = w₂
declarations.comment: clause (1), the uniqueness half, strengthened by dropping the Leibniz hypothesis: an O_X-bilinear extension of the wedge to the log poles complex of 0FMW is unique. Existence, and clauses (2), (3), (4), are not proved here

declarations.name: Stacks.LineBundle.idealChernMorphism_eq_comp_boundary
declarations.doc:
The upper left triangle `ξ' = δ ∘ res`: the map `idealChernMorphism` is the restriction of
forms followed by the boundary map of the shifted log poles sequence.
declarations.statement:
theorem idealChernMorphism_eq_comp_boundary :
    idealChernMorphism f I =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (Scheme.Hom.divisorRestrictionInt f I) ≫
        (Scheme.Hom.logPolesShiftedSequence f hI hlog).boundary
declarations.comment:
the upper left triangle: the map of 0FU7 for c_1^dR(O_X(-Y)) is the boundary map
delta of the shifted sequence of 0FMW composed with the restriction of forms

declarations.name: Stacks.LineBundle.logPolesBoundary_comp_restriction_eq
declarations.doc:
The lower right triangle: `res[2] ∘ δ = ζ'`, with `ζ'` read on `X` through the exact direct
image along `i : Y ⟶ X` and `Ω^•_{Y/S}` identified with its direct image by
`Stacks.LineBundle.divisorDeRhamIntHom`.
declarations.statement:
theorem logPolesBoundary_comp_restriction_eq :
    (Scheme.Hom.logPolesShiftedSequence f hI hlog).boundary ≫
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (Scheme.Hom.divisorRestrictionInt f I ≫ divisorDeRhamIntHom f I))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧' =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (divisorDeRhamIntHom f I) ≫
        divisorPushforwardDerivedMap f I (divisorChernMorphism f I)
declarations.comment:
the lower right triangle: the boundary map delta followed by the restriction of
forms in degree two is the map of 0FU7 on Y for c_1^dR(O_X(-Y)|_Y), read on X through the exact
direct image along the closed immersion

declarations.name: Stacks.LineBundle.idealChernMorphism_comp_restriction
declarations.doc: The square: `res[2] ∘ ξ' = ζ' ∘ res`.
declarations.statement:
theorem idealChernMorphism_comp_restriction :
    idealChernMorphism f I ≫
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (Scheme.Hom.divisorRestrictionInt f I ≫ divisorDeRhamIntHom f I))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧' =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (Scheme.Hom.divisorRestrictionInt f I ≫ divisorDeRhamIntHom f I) ≫
        divisorPushforwardDerivedMap f I (divisorChernMorphism f I)
declarations.comment:
the square of the diagram, deduced from the two triangles: the restriction of
forms in degree two after the map of 0FU7 for c_1^dR(O_X(-Y)) equals the map of 0FU7 on Y for
c_1^dR(O_X(-Y)|_Y) after the restriction of forms, with the latter read on X through the exact
direct image along the closed immersion

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.isIso_coordinateFormsRestrictionHomology
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FUR], clause (3).** For `n ≥ 1`, every `a ≥ 0` and every `q ≥ 1`, the map
`H^q(Rb_*Ω^a_{L/S}) ⟶ H^q(Rb_*j_*Ω^a_{E/S})` induced by restricting forms to the exceptional
divisor is an isomorphism; `Rb_*j_*Ω^a_{E/S} = i_*Rp_*Ω^a_{E/S}`, see
`Stacks.DeRham.isIso_homology_coordinateBlowupFormsDerivedComparison` for the comparison map
itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_coordinateFormsRestrictionHomology (hn : 1 ≤ n) (a : ℕ) (q : ℤ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    IsIso (formsRestrictionHomology (coordinateBlowupToAmbient R m n) (coordinateExceptionalι R m n)
      (coordinateBlowupToAmbient R m n ≫ coordinateAmbientToBase R m n) a q)
declarations.comment: clause (3), in the setting of Section 0FUB, which fixes a ring R and sets S = Spec(R), Z = A^m_S ⊂ X = A^{m+n}_S with n ≥ 1

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.isIso_homology_coordinateBlowupFormsDerivedComparison
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FUR], clause (3), for the comparison map** `Rb_*Ω^a_{L/S} ⟶ i_*Rp_*Ω^a_{E/S}`
(`Stacks.DeRham.blowupFormsDerivedComparison` of the coordinate closed immersion
`i : Z = 𝐀^m_S ⟶ X`): for `n ≥ 1`, every `a ≥ 0` and every `q ≥ 1` it is an isomorphism on
`H^q`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_homology_coordinateBlowupFormsDerivedComparison (hn : 1 ≤ n) (a : ℕ) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).map
      (blowupFormsDerivedComparison (coordinateAmbientToBase R m n)
        (Stacks.MoreMorphisms.coordinateEmbedding R m n) (a : ℤ)))
declarations.comment: clause (3), for the comparison map Rb_*Ω^a ⟶ i_*Rp_*Ω^a, in the setting of Section 0FUB, which fixes a ring R and sets S = Spec(R), Z = A^m_S ⊂ X = A^{m+n}_S with n ≥ 1

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.isIso_coordinateBlowupFormsDirectImage_of_one
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FUR], clause (1), in the case `n = 1`.** The canonical map
`Ω^a_{X/S} ⟶ b_*Ω^a_{L/S}` is an isomorphism in every degree `a ≥ 0`, because for `n = 1` the
centre of the blowup is an effective Cartier divisor and so `b` is an isomorphism. This is the
case the source's own proof of clause (1) disposes of first.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_coordinateBlowupFormsDirectImage_of_one (a : ℕ) :
    IsIso (coordinateBlowupFormsDirectImage R m 1 a)
declarations.comment: clause (1) for n = 1, in every degree a ≥ 0; n > 1 is not proved

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.isIso_coordinateBundleFormsDirectImage_of_one
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FUR], clause (2), in the case `n = 1`.** The canonical map
`Ω^a_{Z/S} ⟶ p_*Ω^a_{P/S}` is an isomorphism in every degree `a ≥ 0`, because for `n = 1` the
projective bundle `P = 𝐏⁰_Z` is the centre itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_coordinateBundleFormsDirectImage_of_one (a : ℕ) :
    IsIso (coordinateBundleFormsDirectImage R m 1 a)
declarations.comment: clause (2) for n = 1, in every degree a ≥ 0; at general n only the single degree a = 0 is proved, by Stacks.DeRham.isIso_coordinateBundleFormsDirectImage_zero in StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.DeRham.CoordinateBundleFormsDegreeZero; the degrees a > 0 at general n are not proved

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.isIso_coordinateBlowupFormsDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FUR], clause (1).** For every ring `R`, every `m`, every `n ≥ 1` and every
degree `a ≥ 0`, the canonical map `Ω^a_{X/S} ⟶ b_*Ω^a_{L/S}` is an isomorphism, where
`X = 𝐀^{m+n}_S`, `S = Spec R`, and `b : L ⟶ X` is the blowup of `X` along `Z = 𝐀^m_S`. For `n = 1`
the blowup is an isomorphism (`Stacks.DeRham.isIso_coordinateBlowupFormsDirectImage_of_one`); for
`n ≥ 2` both sides are quasi-coherent on the affine `X`, so it suffices that the map be bijective
on global sections, which is `Stacks.DeRham.bijective_coordinateBlowupFormsDirectImage_appTop`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_coordinateBlowupFormsDirectImage (m n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (a : ℕ) :
    IsIso (coordinateBlowupFormsDirectImage R m n a)
declarations.comment: clause (1), in the setting of Section 0FUB, which fixes a ring R and sets S = Spec(R), Z = A^m_S ⊂ X = A^{m+n}_S with n ≥ 1

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.isIso_coordinateBundleFormsDirectImage_zero
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FUR], clause (2), in degree `a = 0`, for every `n`.** The canonical map
`Ω^0_{Z/S} ⟶ p_*Ω^0_{P/S}` is an isomorphism, with no restriction on `n`.

In degree zero both sides are structure sheaves: the comparison map is, after conjugation by the
degree-zero identifications, the canonical map `𝒪_Z ⟶ p_*𝒪_P`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.formsDirectImageComparison_zero`), and that map is an isomorphism
because the direct image of the structure sheaf of projective space over any base is the
structure sheaf of the base, which is the degree-zero row of [Stacks, Tag 01XW] at the zeroth
twist. This is the `s = 0` summand that the source's own proof of clause (2) is left with after
the projection formula kills the others; what is avoided here is the decomposition of the forms
of a product, at the cost of reaching only degree `0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_coordinateBundleFormsDirectImage_zero :
    IsIso (coordinateBundleFormsDirectImage R m n 0)
declarations.comment: clause (2) in the single degree a = 0, at general n: the canonical map Ω^0_{Z/S} ⟶ p_*Ω^0_{P/S} is an isomorphism for every n, with no restriction on n; the degrees a > 0 of clause (2) at n > 1, clause (1) at n > 1, and clause (3) in any case, are not proved here

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.isIso_coordinateBundleFormsDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FUR], clause (2).** For every ring `R`, all `m, n` and every degree
`a ≥ 0`, the canonical map `Ω^a_{Z/S} ⟶ p_*Ω^a_{P/S}` is an isomorphism, where `Z = 𝐀^m_S`,
`S = Spec R`, and `p : P = 𝐏^{n-1}_Z ⟶ Z`. For `n ≤ 1` the bundle is the centre itself
(`Stacks.DeRham.isIso_coordinateBundleFormsDirectImage_of_one`; with truncated subtraction `n = 0`
gives the same bundle as `n = 1`), and `n ≥ 2` is
`Stacks.DeRham.isIso_coordinateBundleFormsDirectImage_add_two`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_coordinateBundleFormsDirectImage (a : ℕ) :
    IsIso (coordinateBundleFormsDirectImage R m n a)
declarations.comment: clause (2), in the setting of Section 0FUB, which fixes a ring R and sets S = Spec(R), Z = A^m_S ⊂ X = A^{m+n}_S with n ≥ 1

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.CoordinateCone.isIso_coneBundleFormsDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FUR], clause (2).** In the standard situation of Section 50.16 — a ring `R`,
`S = Spec R`, `m ≥ 0`, `n ≥ 1`, `A = R[x₁, …, x_m, y₁, …, y_n]` graded by `deg xᵢ = 0`,
`deg yⱼ = 1`, the centre `Z = Spec(A₀) = 𝐀^m_S` and the projective bundle
`P = Proj(A) = 𝐏^{n-1}_Z` with its projection `p : P ⟶ Z` — the canonical map
`Ω^a_{Z/S} ⟶ p_*Ω^a_{P/S}` is an isomorphism for every `a ≥ 0`.

Both sides are quasi-coherent on the affine `Z`, and on global sections the map is bijective by
`bijective_coneBundleFormsPullback_top`: the cone `L = Proj(⨁_d A_{≥ d})` over `P` is the blowup
of `X = Spec A` along `Z`, a form on `P` is the restriction along the zero section of its pullback
to `L`, and by clause (1) that pullback comes from `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_coneBundleFormsDirectImage (hn : 1 ≤ n) (a : ℕ) :
    IsIso (formsDirectImageComparison (coneBundleToCentre R m n) (coneCentreToBase R m n)
      (a : ℤ))
declarations.comment: clause (2): Ω^a_{Z/S} ⟶ p_*Ω^a_{P/S} is an isomorphism, every a ≥ 0, every n ≥ 1, for P = Proj(A) and Z = Spec(A₀) as in Section 50.16

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.CoordinateCone.isIso_homology_coneFormsDerivedComparison
declarations.doc:
**Clause (3) of [Stacks, Tag 0FUR].** In the standard situation of Section 50.16 — `X = Spec A`
for `A = R[x₁, …, x_m, y₁, …, y_n]`, `Z = Spec A₀ = V(y₁, …, y_n)`, `b : L ⟶ X` the blowing up of
`X` along `Z` with exceptional divisor `P = Proj(A) = 𝐏^{n-1}_Z`, `p : P ⟶ Z` and `i : Z ⟶ X` —
the canonical map `Rb_*Ω^a_{L/S} ⟶ i_*Rp_*Ω^a_{P/S}` is an isomorphism on cohomology sheaves in
every degree `q ≥ 1`, for every `a ≥ 0`.

By `isIso_homology_coneFormsDerivedComparison_of_vanishing` it is enough that `π_*r` is an
epimorphism (`epi_pushforward_coneProjection_coneFormsRestriction`) and that its kernel has no
cohomology on `P` in positive degrees (`isZero_rightDerived_coneFormsKernel`), where
`π : L ⟶ P` is the cone projection and `r : Ω^a_{L/S} ⟶ 0_*Ω^a_{P/S}` the restriction of forms to
the zero section.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_homology_coneFormsDerivedComparison (a q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
      (coneFormsDerivedComparison R m n (a : ℤ)))
declarations.comment: clause (3): Rb_*Ω^a_{L/S} ⟶ i_*Rp_*Ω^a_{P/S} is an isomorphism on cohomology sheaves in every degree q ≥ 1, every a ≥ 0, every n ≥ 1, for the blowup L of X = Spec(A) along Z = Spec(A₀) as in Section 50.16

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.smooth_exceptionalDivisor_isoProjectiveBundle_twistOne_of_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FUT.**  Let `S` be a scheme and let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion
of schemes smooth over `S`, with ideal sheaf `ℐ = ker(i) ⊂ 𝒪_X`.  Let `b : X' ⟶ X` be the blowup
of `X` in `ℐ` and `E ⊆ X'` its exceptional divisor.  Then `X'` and `E` are smooth over `S`; the
morphism `p : E ⟶ Z` is canonically isomorphic to the projective space bundle
`𝐏(ℐ/ℐ²) ⟶ Z`; and the relative `𝒪_E(1)` of that bundle structure is the restriction of
`𝒪_{X'}(-E)` to `E`.

The morphisms to the centre are the two morphisms `p : E ⟶ Z` and `q : 𝐏(ℐ/ℐ²) ⟶ Z` over `X`,
each determined by its composite with the closed immersion `i`, and the third assertion is that
the identification `E ≅ 𝐏(ℐ/ℐ²)` carries `p` to `q`.

This is `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.smooth_exceptionalDivisor_isoProjectiveBundle_twistOne` read at
the ideal sheaf `i.ker` of the closed immersion, whose closed subscheme `V(i.ker)` receives `Z`
by the canonical isomorphism `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.toImage` onto the scheme-theoretic
image; smoothness transports along that isomorphism, and `p` and `q` are read on `Z` through its
inverse.
declarations.statement:
theorem smooth_exceptionalDivisor_isoProjectiveBundle_twistOne_of_isClosedImmersion
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [Smooth f] [Smooth (i ≫ f)] :
    Smooth (blowUpToBase i.ker ≫ f) ∧
      Smooth ((exceptionalIdeal i.ker).subschemeι ≫ blowUpToBase i.ker ≫ f) ∧
      ∃ (p : exceptionalDivisor i.ker ⟶ Z)
        (q : projectiveBundle i.ker.subscheme
            (Stacks.Conormal.conormalSheafDegreeOne i.ker.subschemeι) ⟶ Z)
        (e : exceptionalDivisor i.ker ≅
          projectiveBundle i.ker.subscheme
            (Stacks.Conormal.conormalSheafDegreeOne i.ker.subschemeι)),
        p ≫ i = (exceptionalIdeal i.ker).subschemeι ≫ blowUpToBase i.ker ∧
          q ≫ i = projectiveBundleToBase i.ker.subscheme
                (Stacks.Conormal.conormalSheafDegreeOne i.ker.subschemeι) ≫ i.ker.subschemeι ∧
            e.hom ≫ q = p ∧
              Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback e.hom).obj
                  (Situation.twistSheaf (symmetricSituationOfQuasicoherent i.ker.subscheme
                    (Stacks.Conormal.conormalSheafDegreeOne i.ker.subschemeι)) 1)
                ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (exceptionalIdeal i.ker).subschemeι).obj
                    (exceptionalIdealModule i.ker))
declarations.comment: all four assertions, for a closed immersion of schemes smooth over the base

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.smooth_blowUpToBase_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0FUT**, first assertion. Let `S` be a scheme and let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a
closed immersion of schemes smooth over `S`. Then the blowup of `X` in `Z` is smooth over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem smooth_blowUpToBase_comp {S X Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [Smooth f] [Smooth (i ≫ f)] :
    Smooth (blowUpToBase i.ker ≫ f)
declarations.comment: smoothness of the blowup

declarations.name: Stacks.DeRham.isIso_formsDirectImageComparison_blowUpToBase
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0FUU], clause (1), in corrected form.**  Let `f : X ⟶ S` be smooth, let
`i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion with `Z` smooth over `S` and with image of empty interior in
`X`, and let `b : X' ⟶ X` be the blowing up of `X` along `Z`.  Then for every `a ≥ 0` the
canonical map `Ω^a_{X/S} ⟶ b_*Ω^a_{X'/S}` is an isomorphism.

The hypothesis on the interior is a correction of the source.  The source states the clause for
every closed immersion of schemes smooth over `S`, and it is false when `Z` contains a non-empty
open subset of `X`: for `S = X = Z = Spec k` the blowup is empty, and `𝒪_X ⟶ 0` is not an
isomorphism (`Stacks.DeRham.exists_smooth_not_isIso_formsDirectImage`).  The proof is the
source's: the étale-local reduction to the coordinate model ([Stacks, Tag 0FUE]), with clause (1)
of [Stacks, Tag 0FUR] there.  Empty interior is exactly what makes the codimension `n ≥ 1` on
every chart.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_formsDirectImageComparison_blowUpToBase [IsClosedImmersion i] [Smooth f]
    [Smooth (i ≫ f)] (hint : interior (Set.range i.base) = ∅) (a : ℕ) :
    IsIso (formsDirectImageComparison (blowUpToBase i.ker) f (a : ℤ))
